translations.translation: AllAhara nAme zuru, yini sakalera prati daYAvAna, parama daYAlu|
samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
yini sakalera prati daYAvAna, parama daYAlu,
yini karmaphala-divasera mAlika|
[he AllAha] AmarA tomArai ivAdata kari evaM tomArai kAche sAhAyya cAi|
AmAdera sarala pathe paricAlita kara|
sei sakala lokera pathe, yAdera prati tumi anugraha karecha| oi sakala lokera pathe naYa, yAdera prati gayava nAyila haYeche evaM tAdera patheo naYa, yArA pathahArA|
Alipha-lAma-mIma
eTi emana kitAva, yAra madhye konao sandeha nei| eTA hidAYAta emana bhIti avalamvanakArIdera janya
yArA adRzya jinisasamUhe ImAna rAkhe evaM sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake yA-kichu diYechi, tA theke (AllAhara santoSajanaka kAje) vyaYa kare|
evaM yArA ImAna rAkhe ApanAra prati yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tAteo evaM ApanAra pUrve yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tAteo evaM tArA AkhirAte paripUrNa vizvAsa rAkhe|
erAi emana loka, yArA tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate saThika pathera upara Ache evaM erAi emana loka, yArA saphalatA lAbhakArI|
nizcaYai ye sakala loka kuphara avalamvana kareche, tAderake Apani bhaYa dekhAna vA nAi dekhAna ubhaYaTAi tAdera pakSe samAna| tArA ImAna Anave nA|
AllAha tAdera antare o tAdera kAne mohara kare diYechena, Ara tAdera cokhera upara pardA par3e Ache evaM tAdera janya raYeche bhaYAnaka zAsti|
kichu loka emana Ache, yArA vale, AmarA AllAha o zeSa divase ImAna enechi, athaca (prakRtapakSe) tArA mumina naYa|
tArA AllAhake evaM yArA (vAstavika) ImAna eneche tAderake dheA~kA deYa evaM (satya kathA ei ye,) tArA nijedera chAr3A anya kAuke dheA~kA deYa nA| kintu (e viSaYera) konao upalavdhi tAdera nei|
tAdera antare Ache roga| AllAha tAdera roga Arao vRddhi kare diYechena| Ara tAdera janya yantraNAmaYa zAsti prastuta raYeche, yehetu tArA mithyA valata|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, tomarA pRthivIte phAsAda sRSTi karo nA, tArA vale, AmarA to zAnti pratiSThAkArI|
mane rekha, erAi phAsAdakArI, kintu era upalavdhi tAdera nei|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, tomarAo sei rakama ImAna Ana, yemana anya loke ImAna eneche| takhana tArA vale, AmarAo ki sei rakama ImAna Anava, ye rakama ImAna eneche nirveAdha lokerA? jene rekha, erAi nirveAdha, kintu tArA tA jAne nA|

yArA ImAna eneche, tAdera sAthe yakhana erA milita haYa, takhana vale, AmarA ImAna enechi Ara yakhana nijedera zaYatAnadera sAthe ekAnte milita haYa, takhana vale, AmarA tomAderai saGge Achi| AmarA to kevala tAmAzA karachilAma|
AllAha tAdera sAthe tAmAzA (-era AcaraNa) karena evaM tAderake Dhila dena, yAte tArA tAdera avAdhyatAYa ghurapAka khete thAke|
erAi tArA, yArA hidAYAtera parivarte gomarAhI kraYa kareche| phale tAdera vyavasAYe lAbha haYani evaM tArA saThika pathao pAYani|

tAdera dRSTAnta sei vyaktira mata, ye Aguna jvAlAlo, tArapara yakhana sei Aguna tAra AzapAza Alokita kare tulala, takhana AllAha tAdera Alo ker3e nilena evaM tAderake andhakArera madhye e avasthAYa cher3e dilena ye, tArA kichui dekhate pAYa nA|
tArA vadhira, vovA o andha| sutarAM tArA phire Asave nA|

athavA (oi munAphikadera dRSTAnta e rakama) yemana AkAza theke varSyamAna vRSTi, yAra madhye Ache andhakAra, vajra o vijalI| tArA vajradhvanira kAraNe mRtyubhaYe nijedera kAne AGgula deYa evaM AllAha tAAlA kAphiraderake gherAo kare rekhechena|

mane haYa yena vijalI tAdera dRSTizakti ker3e neve| yakhanai vijalI tAdera sAmane Alo dAna kare tArA tAte (sei Alote) calate zuru kare, AvAra yakhana tA tAdera upara andhakAra vistAra kare, tArA dA~r3iYe yAYa| yadi AllAha icchA karatena, tAdera zravaNazakti o dRSTizakti ker3e nitena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|
he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera ivAdata kara, yini sRSTi karechena tomAderake evaM tomAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche tAderake, yAte tomarA muttAkI haYe yAo|

(sei pratipAlakera), yini tomAdera janya bhUmike vichAnA vAniYechena evaM AkAzake chAda| Ara AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karechena| tArapara tAra mAdhyame tomAdera jIvikArUpe phala-phalAdi udagata karechena| sutarAM tomarA AllAhara konao zarIka sthira karo nA- yakhana tomarA (esava viSaYa) jAna|

tomarA yadi ei (kuraAna) samparke vindumAtra sandehe thAka, yA Ami AmAra vAndA (muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma)-era prati nAyila karechi, tave tomarA era mata konao ekaTA sUrA vAniYe Ana| Ara satyavAdI hale tomarA AllAha chAr3A nijedera sAhAyyakArIdera Deke nAo|

tAraparao yadi tomarA e kAja karate nA pAra Ara eTA to nizcita ye, tomarA tA kakhanao karate pArave nA, tave bhaYa kara sei Agunake, yAra indhana have mAnuSa o pAthara| tA kAphiradera janya prastuta karA haYeche|

yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tAderake susaMvAda dina ye, tAdera janya emana sava vAgAna (prastuta) raYeche, yAra nice nahara pravAhita thAkave| yakhanai tAderake tA theke riyaka hiseve konao phala deoYA have, tArA valave, eTA to seTAi, yA AmAderake Ageo deoYA haYechila| tAderake emana riyakai deoYA have, yA dekhate ekai rakamera have| tAdera janya sekhAne thAkave putaHpavitra strI evaM tArA tAte anantakAla thAkave|

nizcaYai AllAha (konao viSaYake spaSTa karAra janya) konao rakamera udAharaNa dite lajjAvodha karena nA, tA mazA (era mata tuccha jinisa) hoka vA tArao upare (adhikatara tuccha) hoka| tave yArA mumina tArA jAne, e udAharaNa satya, yA tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke Agata| kintu yArA kAphira tArA vale, ei (tuccha) udAharaNa dvArA AllAhara uddezya kI? (ebhAve) AllAha e udAharaNa dvArA vahu mAnuSake gomarAhIte lipta karena evaM vahujanake hidAYAta dAna karena| Ara tini gomarAha karena kevala tAderakei, yArA nApharamAna|

sei sakala loka, yArA AllAhara saGge kRta pratizrutike paripakka karAra parao bheGge phele evaM AllAha yei samparkake yukta rAkhate Adeza karechena tA chinna kare evaM pRthivIte azAnti vistAra kare| vastuta emana sava lokai ati kSatigrasta|

tomarA AllAhara sAthe kupharI karmapanthA kibhAve avalamvana kara, athaca tomarA chile niSprANa, ataHpara tinii tomAderake jIvana dAna karechena| ataHpara tinii tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, ataHpara tini (punarAYa) tomAderake jIvita karavena, tArapara tomarA tA~rai kAche phire yAve|

tinii sei sattA, yini pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache tA tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena| tArapara tini AkAzera prati lakSya karena evaM tAke sAta AkAzarUpe suSThubhAve nirmANa karena| Ara tini pratyeka jinisera paripUrNa jJAna rAkhena|

evaM (sei samaYera vRttAnta zona), yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka phirizatAderake valalena, Ami pRthivIte eka khalIphA vAnAte cAi| tArA valate lAgalena, Apani ki pRthivIte emana kAuke sRSTi karavena, ye sekhAne azAnti vistAra karave o khuna-khArAvI karave, athaca AmarA ApanAra tAsavIha, hAmada o pavitratA ghoSaNAYa niYojita Achi? AllAha valalena, Ami emana sava viSaYa jAni, yA tomarA jAna nA|
evaM (AllAha) Adamake samasta nAma zikSA dilena| tArapara tAderake phirizatAdera sAmane peza karalena evaM (tAderake) valalena, tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave AmAke esava jinisera nAma jAnAo|
tArA valalena, ApanAra sattAi pavitra| Apani AmAderake yataTuku jJAna diYechena, tAra vAire AmarA kichui jAni nA| prakRtapakSe jJAna o prajJAra mAlika to kevala Apanii|

AllAha valalena, he Adama! tumi tAderake esava jinisera nAma vale dAo| sutarAM yakhana tini tAderake se savera nAma vale dilena, takhana AllAha (phirizatAderake) valalena, Ami ki tomAderake valini, Ami AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra rahasya jAni evaM tomarA yA-kichu prakAza kara evaM yA kichu gopana kara sesava samparke AmAra jJAna Ache?

evaM (sei samaYera AlocanA zona), yakhana Ami phirizatAdera valalAma, Adamake sijadA kara, phale tArA sakale sijadA karala, kintu ivalIsa chAr3A| se asvIkAra karala o darpita AcaraNa karala evaM se kAphiradera antarbhukta haYe gela|
Ami valalAma, he Adama! tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte thAka evaM era yekhAna theke icchA prANa bhare khAo| kintu oi gAchera kAcheo yeo nA| anyathAYa tomarA jAlimadera madhye gaNya have|

ataHpara (ei hala ye,) zaYatAna tAderake sekhAna theke TaliYe dila evaM tA~rA yAra (ye sukhera) bhetara chila tA theke tA~derake vera kare chAr3ala| Ami (Adama, tAra strI o ivalisake) valalAma, ekhana tomarA sakale ekhAna theke vera haYe yAo| tomarA eke anyera zatru have| Ara tomAdera janya pRthivIte (sthirIkRta) Ache ekaTA kAla paryanta avasthAna o kiJcit bhoga|
ataHpara Adama svIYa pratipAlakera pakSa hate (taovAra) kichu zavda zikhe nila (yA dvArA se taovA karala) phale AllAha tAra taovA kavula karalena| nizcaYai tini atizaYa kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu|

Ami valalAma, evAra tomarA sakale ekhAna theke neme yAo| ataHpara AmAra nikaTa theke tomAdera nikaTa yadi konao hidAYAta peৗ~che, tave yArA AmAra hidAYAtera anusaraNa karave, tAdera konao bhaYa thAkave nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
Ara yArA kupharIte lipta have evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna karave, tArA jAhAnnAmavAsI| tArA sekhAne sarvadA thAkave|

he vanI isarAIla! tomarA AmAra sei ni‘Amata smaraNa kara, yA Ami tomAderake diYechilAma evaM tomarA AmAra sAthe kRta pratizruti pUrNa kara, tAhale Amio tomAdera sAthe AmAra kRta pratizruti pUraNa karava| Ara tomarA (anya kAuke naYa; varaM) kevala AmAkei bhaYa kara|

Ara Ami ye vANI nAyila karechi tAte ImAna Ana, yakhana tA tomAdera kAche ye kitAva (tAorAta) Ache, tAra samarthakao vaTe| Ara tomarAi era prathama asvIkArakArI haYo nA| Ara AmAra AYAtasamUhake tuccha mUlyera vinimaYe vikri karo nA| Ara tomAdera antare (anya kArao naYa) kevala AmArai bhaYake sthita kara|
evaM satyake mithyAra sAthe mizrita karo nA evaM satyake gopanao karo nA, yakhana (prakRta avasthA) tomarA bhAlobhAve jAna|
evaM tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta AdAYa kara o rukU‘kArIdera sAthe rukU‘ kara|
tomarA ki anya lokaderake puNyera Adeza kara Ara nijederake bhule yAo, athaca tomarA kitAva tilAoYAtao kara| tomarA ki etaTukuo vojha nA?
evaM savara o sAlAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya lAbha kara| sAlAtake avazyai kaThina mane haYa, kintu tAdera pakSe (kaThina) naYa, yArA khuzU‘ (arthAt dhyAna o vinaYa)-era sAthe par3e|
yArA e viSaYera prati kheYAla rAkhe ye, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera sAthe milita have evaM tAderake tA~rai kAche phire yete have|
he vanI isarAIla! AmAra sei ni‘Amata smaraNa kara, yA Ami tomAderake dAna karechilAma evaM eTAo (smaraNa kara) ye, Ami tomAderake samagra vizve zreSThatva diYechilAma|

evaM sei dinake bhaYa kara, ye dina konao vyakti kArao konao kAje Asave nA, kArao pakSa hate konao supAriza gRhIta have nA, kArao theke konao rakama muktipaNa grahaNa karA have nA evaM tAdera konao rakama sAhAyyao karA have nA|

evaM (sei samaYakeo smaraNa kara), yakhana Ami tomAderake phira‘Aunera lokajana theke mukti dei, yArA tomAderake kaThina zAsti dicchila| tomAdera putraderake yavAha kare phelachila evaM tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhachila| Ara ei yAvatIYa paristhitite tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera janya chila mahA parIkSA|

evaM (smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami tomAdera janya sAgarake vidIrNa karechilAma evaM ebhAve tomAdera sakalake rakSA karechilAma evaM phira‘Aunera lokajanake (sAgare) nimajjita karechilAma| Ara tomarA esava dRzya pratyakSa karachile|
evaM (sei samaYaTio smaraNa kara), yakhana Ami mUsAke calliza rAtera pratizruti diYechilAma| ataHpara tomarA tAra prasthAnera pare (nijedera sattAra upara) juluma karataH vAchurake mAvUda vAnAle|
ataHpara esava kichura parao Ami tomAderake kSamA karalAma, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
evaM (smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami mUsAke dilAma kitAva evaM satya o mithyAra madhye pArthakyakaraNera mApakAThi, yAte tomarA saThika pathe cale Asa|

evaM yakhana mUsA nija sampradAYake valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! vAchurake upAsya vAniYe prakRtapakSe tomarA nijerA nijedera pratii juluma karecha| sutarAM ekhana nija sRSTikartAra kAche taovA kara evaM nijerA nijederake hatyA kara| eTAi tomAdera sRSTikartAra nikaTa tomAdera pakSe zreYa| ebhAve AllAha tAAlA tomAdera taovA kavula karalena| nizcaYa tinii ati var3a kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu|

Ara yakhana tomarA valechile, he mUsA! AmarA kichutei tomAke vizvAsa karava nA, yatakSaNa nA AllAhake nijedera cokhe prakAzye dekhate pAva| era pariNAme vajra ese tomAderake emanabhAve pAkar3Ao karala ye, tomarA kevala tAkiYei thAkale|
ataHpara Ami tomAderake tomAdera mRtyura para natuna jIvana dAna karalAma, yAte tomarA kRtajJa hao|

evaM Ami tomAderake meghera chAYA dilAma evaM tomAdera prati mAnn o sAlaoYA avatIrNa karalAma (o valalAma), ye pavitra riyaka Ami tomAderake dAna karalAma, tA (Agrahabhare) khAo| Ara tArA (esava nApharamAnI kare) AmAra kichu kSati kareni; varaM tArA nijedera sattAra uparai juluma karate thAke|

evaM (sei kathAo smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami valechilAma, oi janapade praveza kara evaM tAra yekhAna theke icchA prANa bhare khAo| Ara (janapadera) pravezadvAra diYe natazire praveza karave Ara valate thAkave, (he AllAha!) AmarA ApanAra kAche kSamAprArthI| (ebhAve) Ami tomAdera aparAdhasamUha kSamA karava evaM puNyavAnaderake Arao vezi (saoYAva) deva|

kintu yArA juluma karechila tAderake yA valA haYechila, tAke vadale phelala anya kathAYa| phale tArA ye nApharamAnI kare Asachila tAra zAstisvarUpa Ami e jAlimadera upara AsamAna theke zAsti avatIrNa karalAma|

evaM (sei samaYera kathAo smaraNa kara) yakhana mUsA nija sampradAYera janya pAni prArthanA karala| takhana Ami valalAma, tomAra lAThi dvArA pAthare AghAta kara| sutarAM tA theke vAraTi prasravaNa utsArita hala| pratyeka gotra nija pAni grahaNera sthAna jene nila| (Ami valalAma) AllAha pradatta riyaka khAo o pAna karo evaM pRthivIte azAnti vistAra karo nA|

evaM (sei samaYera kathAo smaraNa kara) yakhana tomarA valechile, he mUsA! AmarA ekai khAvAre savara karate pArava nA| sutarAM svIYa pratipAlakera kAche AmAdera janya prArthanA karuna, tini yena AmAdera janya bhUmijAta dravya hate kichu utpanna karena arthAt jamira tarakAri, kA~kar3a, gama, DAla, o pi~YAja| mUsA valala, ye khAvAra utkRSTa chila, tomarA ki tAke emana jinisa dvArA parivartana karate cAccha, yA nikRSTa? (Thika Ache,) konao nagare giYe avataraNa kara| (sekhAne) tomarA yA ceYecha sesava jinisa peYe yAve| Ara tAdera (iYAhudIdera) upara lAJchanA o asahAYatvera chApa mere deoYA hala evaM tArA AllAhara gayava niYe phirala| tA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karata evaM navIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| tA e kAraNe ye, tArA nApharamAnI karechila evaM tArA atyadhika sImAlaMghana karata|

(sAra kathA,) musalima hoka vA iYAhudI, khrisTAna hoka vA sAvI, ye-keu AllAha o AkhirAta divasera prati ImAna Anave evaM satkarma karave, tArA AllAhara nikaTa nija pratidAnera upayukta have evaM tAdera konao bhaYa thAkave nA Ara tArA konao duHkheo bhugave nA|

evaM (sei samaYera kathAo smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami tomAdera theke (tAorAtera anusaraNa samparke) pratizruti niYechilAma evaM tUra pAhAr3ake tomAdera upara uttolana kare dharechilAma (Ara valechilAma ye,) Ami tomAderake yA (ye kitAva) diYechi, tA zakta kare dhara evaM tAte yA (lekhA) Ache tA smaraNa rAkha, yAte tomarA tAkaoYA arjana karate pAra|
esava kichura para tomarA punarAYa (saThika patha theke) phire gele| yadi tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA hata, tave tomarA avazyai mArAtmaka kSatigrastadera antarbhukta hate|
evaM tomarA nijedera sei sakala lokake bhAla karei jAna, yArA zanivAra viSaYe sImAlaMghana karechila| phale Ami tAderake valechilAma, tomarA dhikRta vAnare pariNata hao|
ataHpara Ami e ghaTanAke sei kAlera o tAra paravartI kAlera lokadera janya dRSTAnta evaM yArA bhaYa kare tAdera janya upadeza grahaNera mAdhyame vAniYe dei|

evaM (sei samaYera kathAo smaraNa kara), yakhana mUsA nija sampradAYake valechila, AllAha tomAderake ekaTi gAbhI yavAha karate Adeza karachena| tArA valala, Apani ki AmAdera saGge ThATTA karachena? mUsA valala, Ami AllAhara kAche (emana) ajJadera antarbhukta haoYA theke pAnAha cAi (yArA ThATTAsvarUpa mithyA kathA vale)

tArA valala, Apani ApanAra pratipAlakera kAche AmAdera janya Avedana karuna, tini yena AmAderake spaSTa kare vale dena, se gAbhITi kemana have| se valala, AllAha valachena, seTi ati vaYaska have nA evaM ati vAccAo naYa- (varaM) ubhaYera mAjhAmAjhi have| sutarAM tomAderake ye Adeza karA haYeche tA ekhana pAlana kara|

tArA valala, Apani ApanAra pratipAlakera kAche Avedana karuna, tini yena AmAderake spaSTa kare vale dena, tAra raM kI have? mUsA valala, AllAha valachena, tA emana gAr3ha haluda varNera have, yA darzakadera mugdha kare deYa|

tArA (AvAra) valala, Apani ApanAra pratipAlakera kAche Avedana karuna, tini yena AmAderake spaSTa kare dena, se gAbhITi kemana have? gAbhITi to AmAderake sandehe phele diYeche| AllAha cAile AmarA avazyai seTira dizA peYe yAva|

mUsA valala, AllAha valachena, seTi emana gAbhI, yA jami karSaNe vyavahRta naYa evaM yA kSete pAnio deYa nA| sampUrNa sustha, yAte konao dAga nei| tArA valala, hyA~ evAra Apani yathAyatha dizA niYe esechena| ataHpara tArA seTi yavAha karala, yadio mane hacchila nA tArA tA karate pArave|

evaM (smaraNa kara) yakhana tomarA eka vyaktike hatyA karechile, tArapara tomarA tAra vyApAre eke anyera upara doSa cApAcchile| Ara tomarA yA gopana karachile AllAha se rahasya prakAza karavAra chilena|

ataHpara Ami valalAma, tAke (nihatake) tAra (gAbhIra) ekaTA aMza dvArA AghAta kara| ebhAvei AllAha mRtaderake jIvita karena evaM tomAderake nija (kudaratera) nidarzanAvalI dekhAna, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

esava kichura para tomAdera antara AvAra zakta haYe gela, emanaki tA haYe gela pAtharera mata; varaM tAra ceYeo vezi zakta| (kenanA) pAtharera madhye kichu to emanao Ache, yA theke nadI-nAlA pravAhita haYa, tAra madhye kichu emana Ache yA pheTe yAYa evaM tA theke pAni nirgata haYa, AvAra tAra madhye emana (pAthara)-o Ache, yA AllAhara bhaYe dhvase par3e| Ara (era viparIte) tomarA yA kara, AllAha se samparke anavahita nana|

(he musalimagaNa!) ekhanao ki tomarA ei AzA kara ye, tomAdera kathAYa tArA ImAna Anave? athaca tAdera madhye ekaTi dala emana chila, yArA AllAhara kAlAma zunata| ataHpara tA bhAlobhAve vojhAra parao jene-zune tAte vikRti ghaTAta|

yakhana erA tAdera (sei musalimadera) sAthe milita haYa, yArA Agei ImAna eneche, takhana (mukhe) vale deYa, AmarA (-o) ImAna enechi| AvAra erA yakhana nibhRte eke anyera sAthe milita haYa, takhana (paraspare eke anyake) vale, tomarA ki tAderake (musalimaderake) sei sava kathA vale diccha, yA AllAha tomAdera kAche prakAza karechena? tave to tArA (musalimagaNa) tomAdera pratipAlakera kAche giYe seguloke tomAdera viruddhe pramANarUpe peza karave! tomAdera ki etaTuku vuddhio nei?
esava loka ki (yArA e rakama kathA vale,) jAne nA ye, tArA ye sava kathA gopana kare o yA prakAza kare savai AllAha jAnena?
tAdera madhye kichu loka Ache nirakSara, yArA kitAva (tAorAta)-era konao jJAna to rAkhe nA, tave kichu AzA-AkAGkSA puSe rekheche| tArA kevala amUlaka dhAraNAi kare|

sutarAM dhvaMsa sei sakala lokera janya, yArA nija hAte kitAva lekhe, tArapara (mAnuSake) vale eTA AllAhara pakSa theke, yAte tAra mAdhyame kiJcita AYa-rojagAra karate pAre| sutarAM tAdera hAta yA racanA kareche se kAraNeo tAdera janya dhvaMsa evaM tArA yA upArjana kareche, se kAraNeo tAdera janya dhvaMsa|

iYAhudIrA vale, Aguna kakhanai AmAderake gaNA-guNati kaYeka dinera vezi sparza karave nA| Apani tAderake vale dina, tomarA ki AllAhara pakSa hate konao pratizruti grahaNa karecha, phale AllAha tA~ra se pratizrutira viparIta kAja karavena nA, nA ki tomarA AllAhara prati emana kathA Aropa karacha, ye samparke tomAdera konao khavara nei?
(Aguna tomAderake kena sparza karave nA,) avazyai (karave), yesava loka pApa kAmAYa evaM tAra pApa tAke veSTana kare phele, tArAi jAhAnnAmavAsI| tArA sarvadA sekhAne thAkave|
yesava loka ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tArA jAnnAtavAsI| tArA sarvadA sekhAne thAkave|

evaM (sei samaYera kathA smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami vanI isarAIlera theke pratizruti niYechilAma ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karave nA, pitA-mAtAra sAthe bhAlo vyavahAra karave evaM AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma o misakInadera sAtheo| Ara mAnuSera sAthe bhAlo kathA valave, sAlAta kAYema karave o yAkAta deve| (kintu) pare tomAdera madhya hate alpa kichu loka chAr3A vAki sakale (sei pratizruti theke) viruddhabhAvApanna haYe mukha phiriYe nile|

evaM (smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami tomAdera theke pratizruti niYechilAma ye, tomarA eke anyera rakta vahAve nA evaM Apana lokaderake nijedera ghara-vAr3i theke vahiSkAra karave nA| ataHpara tomarA tA svIkAra karechile evaM tomarA nijerA tAra sAkSI|

ataHpara (Aja) tomarAi sei loka, yArA Apana lokaderake hatyA karacha evaM nijederai madhya hate kichu lokake tAdera ghara-vAr3i theke vera kare diccha evaM pApa o sImAlaMghane lipta haYe tAdera viruddhe (tAdera zatrudera) sAhAyya karacha| tArA yadi (zatrudera hAte) kaYedI haYe tomAdera kAche Ase, tave tomarA muktipaNa diYe tAderake chAr3iYe nAo| athaca tAderake (ghara-vAr3i hate) vera karAi tomAdera janya hArAma chila| tave ki tomarA kitAvera (arthAt tAorAtera) kichu aMze ImAna rAkha evaM kichu aMza asvIkAra kara? tAhale vala, tomAdera madhye yArA erUpa kare tAdera zAsti e chAr3A Ara kI hate pAre ye, pArthiva jIvane tAdera janya thAkave lAJchanA Ara kiYAmatera dina tAderake niYe yAoYA have kaThinatara AyAvera dike? tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha se samparke udAsIna nana|
erAi tArA, yArA AkhirAtera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvanake kraYa kare niYeche| sutarAM tAdera zAsti kichumAtra lAghava karA have nA evaM tAderake sAhAyyao karA have nA|

nizcaYai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM tAra pare paryAYakrame rAsUlagaNake pAThiYechi, Ara mAraYAmera putra IsAke suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI diYechi evaM ruhula kudasera mAdhyame tAke zaktizAlI karechi| ataHpara eTA kemana AcaraNa ye, yakhanai konao rAsUla tomAdera kAche emana kona viSaYa niYe upasthita haYeche, yA tomAdera manera cAhidA sammata naYa, takhanai tomarA dambha dekhiYecha? ataeva kataka (navI)-ke tomarA mithyAvAdI valecha evaM katakake hatyA karacha|
Ara esava loka vale, AmAdera antara AcchAdanera bhetara| kakhanao naYa; varaM tAdera kupharIra kAraNe AllAha tAdera prati abhisampAta karechena| e kAraNe tArA alpai ImAna Ane|

yakhana tAdera nikaTa AllAhara pakSa hate emana kitAva (arthAt kuraAna) Asala, yA tAdera kAche (pUrva theke) yA Ache, tAra (arthAt tAorAtera) samarthana kare (takhana tAdera AcaraNa lakSya kare dekha), yadio pUrve erA kAphiradera (arthAt pauttalikadera) viruddhe (e kitAvera mAdhyame) AllAhara kAche vijaYa prArthanA karata, kintu yakhana sei jinisa Asala, yAke tArA cinate perechila, takhana tAke asvIkAra kare vasala| sutarAM emana kAphiradera prati AllAhara lAnata|

katai nA nikRSTa se mUlya, yAra vinimaYe tArA nijedera AtmAke vikri kareche| tA ei ye, tArA AllAhara nAyilakRta kitAvake kevala ei antarjvAlAra kAraNe asvIkAra karache ye, AllAha nija anugrahera konao aMza (arthAt ohI) nija vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA kena nAyila karavena? sutarAM tArA (tAdera e antardAhera kAraNe) gayavera upara gayava niYe phirala| vastuta kAphiragaNa lAJchanAkara zAstirai upayukta|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, AllAha ye kAlAma nAyila karechena tAra prati ImAna Ana, takhana tArA vale, AmarA to (kevala) sei kAlAmera uparai ImAna rAkhava, yA AmAdera prati nAyila karA haYeche (arthAt tAorAta)| Ara echAr3A (anyAnya yata AsamAnI kitAva Ache, se) sava kichuke tArA asvIkAra kare| athaca tAo satya evaM tA tAdera kAche ye kitAva Ache, tAra samarthanao kare| (he navI) tumi tAdera vale dAo, tomarA yadi vAstavikai (tAorAtera upara) ImAna rAkhate tave pUrve AllAhara navIgaNake hatyA karachile kena?
Ara svaYaM mUsA ujjvala nidarzanAvalIsaha tomAdera kAche esechila| ataHpara tomarA tAra pazcAte ei avicAre lipta hale ye, tomarA vAchurake mAvuda vAniYe nile|

evaM (sei samaYera kathA smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami tomAdera theke pratizruti nilAma evaM tomAdera upara tUra (pAhAr3a)ke uttolana karalAma (evaM valalAma) Ami tomAderake yA-kichu diYechi tA zakta kare dhara| evaM (yA-kichu valA haYa, tA) zona| tArA (mukhe) valala, zunalAma evaM (antare valala), amAnya karalAma| (prakRtapakSe) tAdera kupharera azubha pariNAme tAdera antare vAchura je~ke vasechila| Apani (tAderake) vale dina, tomarA yadi mumina haYe thAka, tave tomAdera ImAna tomAderake ye viSaYera nirdeza deYa tA katai nA manda!

Apani (tAderake) vale dina, AllAhara nikaTa AkhirAtera nivAsa yadi aparApara mAnuSa vyatIta kevala tomAderai janya nirdiSTa haYa (yemana tomarA valacha), tave tomarA mRtyura AkAGkSA kare dekhAo- yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
kintu (Ami vale dicchi), tArA tAdera ye kRtakarma sAmane pAThiYeche, se kAraNe kakhanao erUpa AkAGkSA karave nA| AllAha jAlimadera samparke savizeSa avahita|

(varaM) nizcaYai tumi ve~ce thAkAra prati tAderake anyAnya mAnuSa apekSA vezi lobhAtura pAve- emanaki muzarikadera ceYeo vezi| tAdera ekeka jana kAmanA kare yadi eka hAjAra vachara AYu lAbha karata, athaca dIrghAYu lAbha tAke AyAva theke rakSA karate pArave nA| Ara tArA yA-kichui karache AllAha tA bhAlobhAve dekhachena|

(he navI) vale dina, konao vyakti yadi jivarAIlera zatru haYa, tave (hoka nA!) se to AllAhara anumatikramei e kAlAma tomAra antare avatIrNa kareche, yA tAra pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhera samarthana kare evaM yA ImAnadAradera janya sAkSAt hidAYAta o susaMvAda|
yadi konao vyakti AllAhara, tA~ra phirizatAdera, tA~ra rAsUlagaNera evaM jivarAIla o mikAIlera zatru haYa, tave (se zune rAkhuka) AllAha kAphiradera zatru|
nizcaYai Ami ApanAra prati emana sava AYAta nAyila karechi, yA satyake parisphuTakArI, Ara seguloke asvIkAra kare kevala avAdhyarAi|
(tA eTA kemana AcaraNa ye,) yakhanai tArA konao pratizruti diYeche, sarvadA tAdera ekaTi dala tA bheGge chur3e pheleche; varaM tAdera adhikAMzei ImAna Ane nA|

Ara yakhana tAdera nikaTa AllAhara tarapha theke eka rAsUla Asala, ye tAdera nikaTa yA Ache (arthAt tAorAta) tAra samarthana karachila, takhana kitAvIdera madhya hate ekaTi dala AllAhara kitAva (tAorAta o inajIla)ke ebhAve pechane nikSepa karala, yena tArA kichu jAnatai nA (arthAt tAte zeSa navI samparke ye nirdezanA deoYA haYechila tA yena jAnatai nA)|

Ara tArA (vanI isarAIla) sulAYamAna (AlAihisa sAlAma)-era zAsanAmale zaYatAnagaNa yA-kichu (mantra) par3ata tAra pechane par3e gela| sulAYamAna (AlAihisa sAlAma) kona kuphara kareni| avazya zaYatAnagaNa mAnuSake yAdu zikSA diYe kupharIte lipta haYechila| tAchAr3A (vanI isarAIla) vAvila zahare hArUta o mArUta nAmaka phirizatAdvaYera prati yA nAyila haYechila tAra pechane par3e gela| e phirizatAdvaYa kAuke tatakSaNa paryanta konao tAlIma dita nA, yatakSaNa nA vale dita, AmarA kevalai parIkSAsvarUpa (prerita haYechi)| sutarAM tomarA (yAdura pechane par3e) kupharI avalamvana karo nA| tathApi tArA tAdera theke emana jinisa zikSA karata, yA dvArA tArA svAmI-strIra madhye viccheda ghaTAta, (tave prakAza thAke ye,) tArA tAra mAdhyame AllAhara icchA chAr3A kArao kona kSati sAdhana karate pArata nA| (kintu) tArA emana jinisa zikhata, yA tAdera pakSe kSatikara chila evaM upakArI chila nA| Ara tArA eTAo bhAlo kare jAnata ye, ye vyakti tAra khariddAra have AkhirAte tAra konao hisyA thAkave nA| vastuta tArA yAra vinimaYe nijederake vikri kareche tA ati manda| yadi tAdera (e viSaYera prakRta) jJAna thAkata!
evaM (era viparIte) tArA yadi ImAna o tAkaoYA avalamvana karata, tave AllAhara pakSa hate prAptavya saoYAva niHsandehe aneka utkRSTa| yadi tAdera (e satya samparke prakRta) jJAna thAkata!
he ImAnadAragaNa! (rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAmake lakSya kare) ‘rA‘inA’ valo nA; varaM ‘unajuranA’ valo evaM zravaNa karo| Ara kAphiradera janya raYeche yantraNAmaYa zAsti|

kAphira vyaktivarga, tA kitAvIdera antarbhukta hoka vA muzarikadera, pachanda kare nA, tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera prati konao kalyANa avatIrNa hoka| athaca AllAha yAke cAna svIYa rahamatera dvArA viziSTa kare nena evaM AllAha mahA anugrahera mAlika|
Ami yakhanai konao AYAta mAnasUkha (rahita) kari vA tA bhuliYe dei, takhana tAra ceYe uttama vA se rakama (AYAta) AnaYana kari| tomarA ki jAna nA, AllAha sakala viSaYe kSamatA rAkhena?
tumi ki jAna nA AllAha tAAlA emana sattA ye, AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva kevala tA~rai evaM AllAha chAr3A tomAdera konao abhibhAvaka nei evaM sAhAyyakArIo nei?

tomarA ki tomAdera rAsUlake sei rakamera prazna karate cAo, yemana prazna pUrve mUsAke karA haYechila? ye vyakti ImAnera parivarte kuphara avalamvana kare, nizcaYai se sarala patha theke vicyuta haYeche|

(he musalimagaNa!) kitAvIdera anekei tAdera kAche satya parisphuTa haoYAra parao tAdera antarera IrSAvazata kAmanA kare, yadi tomAderake tomAdera ImAna AnAra para punarAYa kAphira vAniYe dite pArata! sutarAM tomarA kSamA kara o upekSA kara, yAvat nA AllAha nija phAYasAlA pAThiYe dena| nizcaYai AllAha sakala viSaYe kSamatAvAna|

evaM sAlAta kAYema kara o yAkAta AdAYa kara evaM (smaraNa rekha), tomarA ye-konao satkarma nijedera kalyANArthe sammukhe preraNa karave, AllAhara kAche tA pAve| nizcaYai tomarA ye-konao kAja kara AllAha tA dekhachena|

evaM tArA (iYAhudI o nAsArAgaNa) vale, jAnnAte iYAhudI o nAsArAgaNa chAr3A anya keu kakhanao praveza karave nA| esava tAdera AkAGkSA mAtra| Apani tAderake vale dina tomarA yadi (tomAdera e dAvIte) satyavAdI hao, tave tomAdera pramANa peza kara|

kena naYa? (niYama to ei ye,) ye vyaktii nija cehArA AllAhara sAmane nata karave evaM se satkarmazIlao have, se nija pratipAlakera kAche tAra pratidAna pAve| Ara erUpa lokadera konao bhaYa thAkave nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|

iYAhudIrA vale, khrisTAnadera (dharmera) konao bhitti nei evaM khrisTAnarA vale, iYAhudIdera (dharmera) konao bhitti nei| athaca erA sakale (AsamAnI) kitAva par3e| anurUpa (sei muzarikagaNa) yAdera konao (AsamAnI) jJAna nei, tArAo edera (kitAvIdera) mata kathA valate zuru kare diYeche| sutarAM tArA ye viSaYe matavirodha karache AllAhai kiYAmatera dina tAdera madhye se viSaYe phAYasAlA karavena|

sei vyaktira ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke Ache, ye AllAhara masajidasamUhe AllAhara nAma nite vAdhA pradAna kare evaM tAke virAna karAra ceSTA kare? erUpa lokera to bhIta-vihvala nA haYe tAte praveza karAi saGgata naYa| tAdera janya duniYAYa raYeche lAJchanA evaM tAdera janya AkhirAte raYeche mahA zAsti|
pUrva o pazcima sava AllAharai| sutarAM tomarA ye dikei mukha pherAve seTA AllAharai dika| nizcaYai AllAha sarvavyApI o sarvajJa|
tArA vale, AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena, (athaca) tA~ra sattA (e jAtIYa jinisa theke) pavitra; varaM AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache tA tA~rai| sakalei tA~ra anugata|
tini AsamAnasamUha o yamInera astitvadAtA| tini yakhana konao viSaYera phAYasAlA karena takhana kevala etaTuku valena ye, ‘haYe yAo’, amani tA haYe yAYa|

yesava loka jJAna rAkhe nA, tArA vale, AllAha AmAdera saGge (sarAsari) kathA valena nA kena? kiMvA AmAdera kAche konao nidarzana Ase nA kena? emanibhAve tAdera pUrve yesava loka gata haYeche, tArAo tAdera kathAra mata kathA valata| tAdera sakalera antara paraspara sadRza| prakRtapakSe ye sava loka vizvAsa karate cAYa, tAdera janya pUrvei Ami nidarzanAvalI spaSTa kare diYechi|

(he navI!) nizcaYai Ami tomAke satyasaha ebhAve preraNa karechi ye, tumi (jAnnAtera) susaMvAda deve evaM (jAhAnnAma samparke) bhIti pradarzana karave| yesava loka (svecchAYa) jAhAnnAma (era patha) veche niYeche, tAdera samparke tomAke jijJAsAvAda karA have nA|

iYAhudI o nAsArA tomAra prati kichutei khuzI have nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi tAdera dharmera anusaraNa karave| vale dAo, prakRta hidAYAta to AllAharai hidAYAta| tomAra kAche (ohIra mAdhyame) ye jJAna eseche, tAra parao yadi tumi tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kara, tave AllAhara theke rakSA karAra janya tomAra konao abhibhAvaka thAkave nA evaM sAhAyyakArIo nA|
yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi tArA yakhana tA tilAoYAta kare, yebhAve tilAoYAta karA ucita takhana tArAi tAra prati (prakRta) ImAna rAkhe| Ara yArA tA asvIkAra kare, tArAi kSatigrasta loka|
he vanI isarAIla! tomarA AmAra sei niYAmata smaraNa kara, yA Ami tomAderake diYechilAma evaM e viSaYaTi (-o smaraNa kara) ye, Ami jagatasamUhera madhye tomAderake zreSThatva diYechilAma|
evaM sei dinake bhaYa kara, ye-dina keu kArao konao kAje Asave nA, kArao theke konaorUpa muktipaNa gRhIta have nA, konao supAriza kArao upakAra karave nA evaM tArA konao sAhAyyao lAbha karave nA|

evaM (sei samaYake smaraNa kara), yakhana ivarAhImake tA~ra pratipAlaka kaYekaTi viSaYa dvArA parIkSA karalena evaM se tA sava pUraNa karala| AllAha (tAke) valalena, Ami tomAke samasta mAnuSera imAma vAnAte cAi| ivarAhIma valala, AmAra santAnadera madhya hate? AllAha valalena, AmAra (e) pratizruti jAlimadera janya prayojya naYa|

evaM (sei samaYake smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami vAitullAhake pariNata kari mAnuSera vAravAra phire AsAra jAYagA evaM paripUrNa nirApattAra sthAne| tomarA ‘mAkAme ivarAhIma’ ke sAlAtera sthAna vAniYe nAo| evaM Ami ivarAhIma o isamAIlake hukuma kari, tomarA AmAra gharake sei sakala lokera janya pavitra kara, yArA (ekhAne) tAoYApha karave, itikApha karave evaM rukU‘ o sijadA AdAYa karave|

evaM (sei samaYakeo smaraNa kara) yakhana ivarAhIma valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! eTAke eka nirApada nagara vAniYe dAo evaM era vAsindAdera madhye yArA AllAha o AkhirAte ImAna Anave tAderake vibhinna rakama phalera riyaka dAna kara| AllAha valalena, evaM ye vyakti kuphara avalamvana karave tAkeo Ami kichu kAlera janya jIvana bhogera suyoga deva, (kintu) tArapara tAke hi~car3e niYe yAva jAhAnnAmera zAstira dike evaM tA nikRSTatama ThikAnA|

evaM (sei samaYera kathA cintA kara) yakhana ivarAhIma vAitullAhara bhita u~cu karachila evaM isamAIlao (tAra sAthe zarIka chila evaM tArA valachila) he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera pakSa hate (e sevA) kavula karuna| nizcaYa Apani evaM kevala Apanii sava kichu zonena o savakichu jAnena|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake ApanAra ekAnta anugata vAniYe nina evaM AmAdera vaMzadharadera madhyeo emana ummata sRSTi karuna, yArA ApanAra ekAnta anugata have evaM AmAderake AmAdera ivAdatera paddhati zikSA dina evaM AmAdera taovA kavula kare nina| nizcaYai Apani evaM kevala Apanii kSamApravaNa (evaM) atizaYa daYAra mAlika|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tAdera madhye emana ekajana rAsUlao preraNa karuna, ye tAderai madhya hate have evaM ye tAdera sAmane ApanAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karave, tAderake kitAva o hikamatera zikSA deve evaM tAderake parizuddha karave| nizcaYai ApanAra evaM kevala ApanArai sattA emana, yA~ra kSamatA paripUrNa, prajJAo paripUrNa|

ye vyakti nijeke nirveAdha sAvyasta kareche, se chAr3A Ara ke ivarAhImera patha parihAra kare? vAstavatA to ei ye, Ami duniYAYa tAke (nijera janya) veche niYechi, Ara AkhirAte se satkarmazIladera antarbhukta have|
yakhana tA~ra pratipAlaka tA~ke valalena, ‘Anugatye natazira hao’, takhana se (saGge saGge) valala, Ami rAvvUla AlAmInera (pratiTi hukumera) sAmane mAthA nata karalAma|

ivarAhIma tA~ra santAnaderake e kathArai asiYata karala evaM iYAkuvao (tA~ra santAnaderake) ye, he AmAra putragaNa! AllAha tomAdera janya e dIna manonIta karechena| sutarAM tomAdera mRtyu yena e avasthAYai Ase yakhana tomarA musalima thAkave|

tomarA nijerA ki sei samaYa upasthita chile yakhana iYAkuvera mRtyukSaNa ese giYechila, yakhana se tAra putradera valechila, AmAra para tomarA kAra ivAdata karave? tArA sakale valechila, AmarA sei eka AllAharai ivAdata karava, yini ApanAra mAvuda evaM ApanAra vApa-dAdA ivarAhIma, isamAIla o isahAkerao mAvuda| AmarA kevala tA~rai anugata|
tArA chila ekaTi ummata, yA gata haYeche| tArA yA-kichu arjana kareche tA tAderai evaM tomarA yA-kichu arjana karecha tA tomAderai| tomAderake jijJesa karA have nA ye, tArA ki kAja karata|

evaM tArA (iYAhudI o khrisTAnarA musalimaderake) vale, tomarA iYAhudI vA khrisTAna haYe yAo, tave saThika patha peYe yAve| vale dAo, varaM (AmarA to) ivarAhImera dIna (mene calava), yini yathAyatha sarala pathera upara chilena| tini sei sava lokera antarbhukta chilena nA, yArA (AllAhara saGge anyake) zarIka karata|

(he musalimagaNa!) vale dAo ye, AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi evaM sei vANIra pratio, yA AmAdera upara nAyila karA haYeche evaM tAra pratio, yA ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva o tA~dera santAnadera prati nAyila karA haYeche evaM tAra pratio, yA mUsA o IsAke deoYA haYechila evaM tAra pratio, yA anyAnya navIgaNake tA~dera pratipAlakera pakSa hate deoYA haYechila| AmarA ei navIgaNera madhye konao pArthakya kari nA evaM AmarA tA~rai (eka AllAharai) anugata|

ataHpara tArAo yadi se rakama ImAna Ane yemana tomarA ImAna enecha, tave tArA saThika patha peYe yAve| Ara tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tave tArA mUlata zatrutAYa lipta haYe par3eche| sutarAM zIghrai AllAha tomAra sAhAyyArthe tAdera dekhe nevena evaM tini sakala kathA zonena o savakichu jAnena|
(he musalimagaNa! vale dAo, AmAdera upara to) AllAha nija raM Aropa karechena| ke Ache, ye AllAha apekSA utkRSTa raM Aropa karate pAre? Ara AmarA kevala tA~rai ivAdata kari|

vale dAo, tomarA ki AllAha samparke AmAdera sAthe vitarka karacha? athaca tini AmAdera pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka tave (eTA anya kathA ye,) AmAdera karma AmAdera janya evaM tomAdera karma tomAdera janya, Ara AmarA to (AmAdera ivAdatake) tA~rai janya khAlesa kare niYechi|

tomarA ki vala, ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva o tA~dera vaMzadharagaNa iYAhudI vA nAsArA chila? (he musalimagaNa! tAderake) vale dAo, tomarAi ki vezi jAna, nA AllAha? Ara sei vyakti apekSA var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre, ye tAra nikaTa AllAha hate ye sAkSya peৗ~cheche tA gopana kare? tomarA yA-kichu kara, se samparke AllAha gAphela nana|
(yAi hoka) tArA chila ekaTi ummata, yA vigata haYeche| tArA yA-kichu arjana kareche tA tAdera, Ara yA-kichu tomarA arjana karecha tA tomAdera| tArA kI kAja karata tA tomAderake jijJesa karA have nA|

acirei nirveAdha lokerA valave, seTA kI jinisa, yA ederake (musalimaderake) tAdera sei kivalA theke anya dike mukha phirAte udvuddha karala, yAra abhimukhI tArA e yAvat chila? Apani vale dina, pUrva o pazcima sava AllAharai| tini yAke cAna sarala pathera hidAYAta dAna karena|

(he musalimagaNa!) ebhAvei Ami tomAderake eka madhyapanthI ummata vAniYechi, yAte tomarA anyAnya loka samparke sAkSI hao evaM rAsUla hana tomAdera pakSe sAkSI| pUrve tumi ye kivalAra anusArI chile, Ami tA anya konao kAraNe naYa; varaM kevala e kAraNei sthira karechilAma ye, Ami dekhate cAi- ke rAsUlera Adeza mAne Ara ke tAra pichana dike phire yAYa, sandeha nei e viSaYaTA var3a kaThina, tave AllAha yAderake hidAYAta diYechena, tAdera pakSe (moTei kaThina) nA| Ara AllAha emana nana ye, tini tomAdera ImAna nisphala kare devena| vastuta AllAha mAnuSera prati ati mamatAvAna, parama daYAlu|

(he navI!) Ami tomAra cehArAke vAravAra AkAzera dike uThate dekhachi| sutarAM ye kivalAke tumi pachanda kara Ami zIghrai se dike tomAke phiriYe deva| sutarAM evAra masajidula hArAmera dike nijera cehArA pherAo| evaM (bhaviSyate) tomarA yekhAnei thAka (sAlAta AdAYakAle) nijera cehArA se dikei pherAve| yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche, tArA jAne eTAi satya, yA tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eseche| Ara tArA yA-kichu karache AllAha se samvandhe udAsIna nana|

yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila tumi yadi tAdera kAche sava rakamera nidarzanao niYe Asa, tavuo tArA tomAra kivalA anusaraNa karave nA| tumio tAdera kivalA anusaraNa karAra nao, Ara tAdera paraspareo eke anyera kivalA anusaraNa karAra naYa| tomAra nikaTa jJAna AsAra parao yadi tumi tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kara, tave takhana avazyai jAlimadera madhye gaNya have|
yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi tArA tAke (etaTA bhAlobhAve) cene yemana cene nijedera santAnaderake| nizcaYai tAdera madhye kichu loka jene-zune satya gopana kare|
Ara satya seTAi, yA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate eseche| sutarAM kichutei sandehakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|

pratyeka sampradAYerai ekaTi kivalA Ache, ye dike tArA mukha kare| sutarAM tomarA satkarme eke anyera agragAmI haoYAra ceSTA kara| tomarA yekhAnei thAka, AllAha tomAdera sakalake (nijera nikaTa) niYe Asavena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

Ara tumi yekhAna thekei (sapharera janya) vera hao nA kena, (sAlAtera samaYa) nijera mukha masajidula hArAmera dike pherAo| nizcaYai eTAi satya, yA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke eseche| Ara tomarA yA-kichu kara, se samparke AllAha anavahita nana|

evaM tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao nA kena, masajidula hArAmera dike tomAra mukha pherAo evaM tomarA yekhAnei thAka, tomAdera mukha se dikei rekha, yAte tomAdera viruddhe mAnuSera konao pramANa pezera suyoga nA thAke; avazya tAdera madhye yArA juluma karate abhyasta (tArA kakhanao kSAnta have nA) tAdera konao bhaYa karo nA; varaM AmAke bhaYa kara| Ara yAte tomAdera prati Ami nija anugraha paripUrNa kare dei evaM yAte tomarA hidAYAta lAbha kara|

(e anugraha Thika sei rakamai) yemana Ami tomAdera madhye ekajana rAsUla pAThiYechi tomAderai madhya hate, ye tomAdera sAmane AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta kare, tomAderake parizuddha kare, tomAderake kitAva o hikamatera tAlIma deYa evaM tomAderake emana sava viSaYa zikSA deYa yA tomarA jAnate nA|
sutarAM tomarA AmAke smaraNa kara, Ami tomAderake smaraNa karava Ara AmAra zukara AdAYa kara, AmAra akRtajJatA karo nA|
he muminagaNa! savara o sAlAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya lAbha kara| nizcaYai AllAha savarakArIdera saGge Achena|
Ara yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYeche tAderake mRta valo nA| prakRtapakSe tArA jIvita, kintu tomarA (tAdera jIvita thAkAra viSaYaTA) upalavdhi karate pAra nA|

Ara Ami avazyai tomAderake parIkSA karava (kakhanao) kichuTA bhaYa-bhIti dvArA, (kakhanao) kSudhA dvArA evaM (kakhanao) jAna-mAla o phala-phasalera kSaYakSati dvArA| susaMvAda zonAo tAderake, yArA (erUpa avasthAYa) savarera paricaYa deYa|
yArA tAdera konao musivata dekhA dile vale oThe, ‘AmarA sakale AllAharai evaM AmAderake tA~ra kAchei phire yete have|
erAi tArA, yAdera prati tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate vizeSa karuNA o daYA raYeche evaM erAi Ache hidAYAtera upara|

nizcaYai sAphA o mAraoYA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra antarbhukta| sutarAM ye vyaktii vAitullAhara hajja karave vA umarA karave tAra janya e duTora pradakSiNa karAte konao gunAha nei| konao vyakti svata:sphUrtabhAve konao kalyANakara kAja karale AllAha avazyai guNagrAhI (evaM) sarvajJa|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra nAyilakRta ujjvala nidarzanAvalI o hidAYAtake gopana kare, yadio Ami kitAve tA mAnuSera janya suspaSTarUpe varNanA karechi, tAdera prati AllAha lAnata varSaNa karena evaM anyAnya lAnatakArIgaNao lAnata varSaNa kare|

tave yArA tAovA kareche, nijederake saMzodhana kareche evaM (gopana karA viSaYagulo) suspaSTarUpe varNanA kareche, Ami tAdera tAovA kavula kare thAki| vastuta Ami atizaYa tAovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM kAphira avasthAYai mArA geche, tAdera prati AllAhara, phirizatAdera evaM samasta mAnuSera lAnata|
tArA se lAnatera madhye sthAYIbhAve thAkave| tAdera theke zAsti lAghava karA have nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deoYA have nA|
tomAdera mAvuda ekai mAvuda, tini chAr3A anya konao mAvuda nei| tini sakalera prati daYAvAna, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYai AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sRjane, rAta dinera ekaTAnA Avartane, sei sava nauyAne yA mAnuSera upakArI sAmagrI niYe sAgare vaYe cale, sei pAnite yA AllAha AkAza theke varSaNa karechena evaM tAra mAdhyame bhUmike tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita karechena o tAte sarvaprakAra jIva-jantu char3iYe diYechena evaM vAYura dika parivartane evaM sei meghamAlAte yA AkAza o pRthivIra madhye AjJAvaha haYe sevAYa niYojita Ache, vahu nidarzana Ache sei sava lokera janya yArA nijedera jJAna-vuddhike kAje lAgAYa|

evaM (etadasattveo) mAnuSera madhye emana kichu lokao Ache, yArA AllAha chAr3A anyaderake (tA~ra prabhutve) aMzIdAra sAvyasta kare, yAderake tArA bhAlovAse AllAhara bhAlovAsAra mata| tave yArA ImAna eneche tArA AllAhakei sarvApekSA vezi bhAlovAse| hAYa! e jAlimagaNa (duniYAYa) yakhana konao zAsti pratyakSa kare, takhanai yadi vujhata ye, samasta zakti AllAharai evaM (AkhirAte) AllAhara AyAva have sukaThina!

(sei samaYaTi have emana) yakhana anusRtagaNa tAdera anusaraNakArIdera saGge sampUrNarUpe samparkahInatAra ghoSaNA deve evaM tArA sakale AyAva dekhate pAve evaM tAdera pArasparika sava samparka chinna haYe yAve|

Ara yArA (tAdera arthAt netRvargera) anusaraNa karata tArA valave, hAYa! ekavAra yadi AmAdera (duniYAYa) phire yAoYAra suyoga hata, tave AmarAo tAdera (arthAt netRvargera) saGge ebhAvei samparkahInatA ghoSaNA karatAma, yemana tArA AmAdera saGge samparkahInatA ghoSaNA kareche| ebhAve AllAha tAderake dekhAvena ye, tAdera kAryAvalI (Aja) tAdera janya sampUrNa manastApe pariNata haYeche| Ara tArA konao avasthAYai jAhAnnAma theke vera hate pArave nA|
he mAnuSa! pRthivIte yA-kichu hAlAla, utkRSTa vastu Ache tA khAo evaM zaYatAnera padacihna dhare calo nA| nizcita jAna, se tomAdera eka prakAzya zatru|
se to tomAderake anyAYa o azlIla kAja karate evaM AllAha samparke emana kathA valatei Adeza kare, yA tomarA jAna nA|

yakhana tAderake (kAphiraderake) valA haYa, AllAha ye vANI nAyila karechena tAra anusaraNa kara, takhana tArA vale, nA, AmarA to kevala se sakala viSaYerai anusaraNa karava, yAra upara AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke peYechi| AcchA! yakhana tAdera vApa-dAdA (dvInera) kichumAtra vujha-samajha rAkhata nA, Ara tArA konao (aizI) hidAYAtao lAbha kareni, takhanao ki (tAdera anusaraNa karA ucita)?

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, (satyera dAoYAtera vyApAre) tAdera dRSTAnta Thika e rakama, yemana konao vyakti emana kichuke (pazuke) DAke, yA hA~ka-DAka chAr3A Ara kichui zone nA| tArA vadhira, mUka, andha| sutarAM tArA kichui vojhe nA|
he muminagaNa! Ami tomAderake jIvikArUpe ye utkRSTha vastusamUha diYechi, tA theke (yA icchA) khAo evaM AllAhara zukara AdAYa kara- yadi tomarA kevala tA~rai ivAdata kare thAka|

tini to tomAdera janya kevala mRta jantu, rakta o zukarera gozata hArAma karechena evaM sei jantuo, yAra prati AllAha chAr3A anyera nAma uccAraNa karA haYa| hyA~, konao vyakti yadi carama ananyopAYa avasthAYa thAke (phale esava vastu hate kichu kheYe neYa) Ara tAra uddezya majA bhoga karA nA haYa evaM se (praYojanera) sImA atikramao nA kare, tave tAra konao gunAha nei| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

prakRtapakSe yArA AllAhara nAyilakRta kitAvake gopana kare evaM tAra vinimaYe tuccha mUlya grahaNa kare, tArA tAdera peTe Aguna chAr3A kichui bhare nA| kiYAmatera dina AllAha tAdera saGge kathA valavena nA evaM tAderake pavitrao karavena nA, Ara tAdera janya Ache marmantuda zAsti|
erAi tArA, yArA hidAYAtera parivarte gomarAhI evaM mAgaphirAtera parivarte AyAva kraYa kare niYeche| sutarAM (bheve dekha) jAhAnnAmera Aguna sahya karAra janya tArA katai nA dhairyazIla!
tA e kAraNe ye, AllAha satyasamvalita kitAva nAyila karechena, Ara yArA kitAvera vyApAre matavirodhe lipta haYeche tArA jedAjedite vahu dUra cale geche|

puNya to kevala eTAi naYa ye, tomarA nijedera cehArA pUrva vA pazcima dike pherAve; varaM puNya hala (sei vyaktira kAra‌yAvalI), ye ImAna rAkhe AllAhara, zeSa dinera o phirizatAdera prati evaM (AllAhara) kitAva o navIgaNera prati| Ara AllAhara bhAlovAsAYa nija sampada dAna kare AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma, misakIna, musAphira o saoYAlakArIderake evaM dAsamuktite evaM sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa evaM yArA konao pratizruti dile tA pUraNe yatnavAna thAke evaM saGkaTe, kaSTe o yuddhakAle dhairyadhAraNa kare| erAi tArA, yArA sAccA (nAme abhihita haoYAra upayukta) evaM erAi muttAkI|

he muminagaNa! yAderake (icchAkRta anyAYabhAve) hatyA karA haYeche, tAdera vyApAre tomAdera prati kisAsa (-era vidhAna) pharaya karA haYeche- svAdhIna vyaktira vadale svAdhIna vyakti, golAmera vadale golAma, nArIra vadale nArI (-kei hatyA karA have)| ataHpara hatyAkArIke yadi tAra bhAi (nihatera ali)-era pakSa hate kichuTA kSamA karA haYa, tave nyAYAnugabhAve (raktapaNa) dAvI karAra adhikAra (alira) Ache| Ara uttamarUpe tA AdAYa karA (hatyAkArIra) kartavya| eTA tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka laghukaraNa evaM ekaTi rahamata| eraparao keu sImAlaMghana karale se yantraNAmaYa zAstira upayukta|
evaM he vuddhimAnerA! kisAsera bhetara tomAdera janya raYeche jIvana (rakSAra vyavasthA)| AzA karA yAYa tomarA (era viruddhAcaraNa) parihAra karave|

tomAdera upara pharaya karA haYeche ye, tomAdera madhye keu yadi artha-sampada rekhe yAYa, tave yakhana tAra mRtyukSaNa upasthita have, takhana nija pitA-mAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera pakSe nyAYasaGgatabhAve osiYata karave| eTA muttAkIdera avazya kartavya|
ye vyakti se osiYata zonAra para tAte konao rada-vadala karave, tAra gunAha tAdera uparai vartAve yArA tAte rada-vadala karave| nizcaYai AllAha (savakichu) zonena o jAnena|

hA~ kArao yadi AzaMkA haYa, osiYatakArI anyAYa pakSapAtitva vA gunAhera kAja karave Ara se saMzliSTa vyaktivargera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa tave tAra konao gunAha have nA| nizcaYai AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa! tomAdera prati royA pharaya karA haYeche, yemana tomAdera pUrvavartI lokadera prati pharaya karA haYechila, yAte tomAdera madhye tAkaoYA sRSTi haYa|

gaNA-gunati kaYeka dina (royA rAkhate have)| tAraparao yadi tomAdera madhye keu asustha haYa vA saphare thAke, tave anya samaYe se samAna saMkhyA pUraNa karave| yArA era zakti rAkhe, tArA ekajana misakInake khAvAra khAiYe (royAra) phidaYA AdAYa karate pArave| echAr3A keu yadi svataHsphUrtabhAve kona puNyera kAja kare, tave tAra pakSe tA zreYa| Ara tomAdera yadi samajha thAke, tave royA rAkhAi tomAdera janya vezi bhAlo|

ramayAna mAsa- ye mAse kuraAna nAyila karA haYeche, yA mAnuSera janya (AdyopAnta) hidAYAta evaM emana suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI samvalita, yA saThika patha dekhAYa evaM (satya o mithyAra madhye) cUr3Anta phAYasAlA kare deYa| sutarAM tomAdera madhye ye vyaktii e mAsa pAve, se yena e samaYa avazyai royA rAkhe| Ara tomAdera madhye keu yadi asustha haYa vA saphare thAke, tave anya dine se samAna saMkhyA pUraNa karave| AllAha tomAdera pakSe yA sahaja seTAi cAna, tomAdera janya jaTilatA cAna nA, evaM (tini cAna) yAte tomarA royAra saMkhyA pUraNa kare nAo evaM AllAha tomAderake ye patha dekhiYechena, sejanya AllAhara tAkavIra pATha kara evaM kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

(he navI!) AmAra vAndAgaNa yakhana ApanAra kAche AmAra samparke jijJesa kare, takhana (Apani tAderake valuna ye,) Ami eta nikaTavartI ye, keu yakhana AmAke DAke Ami tAra DAka zuni| sutarAM tArAo AmAra kathA antara diYe grahaNa karuka evaM AmAra prati ImAna Anuka, yAte tArA saThika pathe ese yAYa|

royAra rAte tomAdera janya hAlAla kare deoYA haYeche tomAdera strIdera sAthe sahavAsa| tArA tomAdera janya pozAka evaM tomarAo tAdera janya pozAka| AllAha jAnatena, tomarA nijedera sAthe kheYAnata karachile| ataHpara tini tomAdera prati daYAparavaza haYechena evaM tomAdera truTi kSamA karechena| sutarAM ekhana tomarA tAdera sAthe sahavAsa kara evaM AllAha tomAdera janya yA-kichu likhe rekhechena tA sandhAna kara| Ara yatakSaNa nA bhorera sAdA rekhA kAlo rekhA theke pRthaka haYe yAYa, tatakSaNa paryanta tomarA khAo o pAna kara| tArapara rAtera Agamana paryanta royA pUrNa kara| Ara tAdera sAthe (strIdera sAthe) sahavAsa karo nA, yakhana tomarA masajide itikApharata thAka| esava AllAhara (nirdhArita) sImA| sutarAM tomarA egulora nikaTe yeo nA| ebhAve AllAha mAnuSera sAmane svIYa nidarzanAvalI spaSTarUpe varNanA karena, yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

tomarA paraspare eke anyera sampada anyAYabhAve bhoga karo nA evaM vicArakera kAche se samparke ei uddezye mAmalA ruju karo nA ye, mAnuSera sampada theke konao aMza jene zune pApera pathe grAsa karave|

loke ApanAra kAche natuna cA~da samparke jijJesa kare| Apani tAderake vale dina, eTA mAnuSera (vibhinna kAja-karmera) evaM hajjera samaYa nirdhAraNa karAra janya| Ara eTA konao puNya naYa ye, tomarA ghare tAra pechana dika theke praveza karave| varaM keu tAkaoYA avalamvana karale seTAi puNya| tomarA ghare tAra darajA diYei praveza kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare cala, yAte tomarA saphalatA arjana karate pAra|
yArA tomAdera sAthe yuddha kare tomarA AllAhara pathe tAdera sAthe yuddha kara, tave sImAlaMghana karo nA| nizcita jena, AllAha sImAlaMghanakArIdera bhAlovAsena nA|

tomarA tAderake yekhAne pAo hatyA kara evaM tAderake sei sthAna theke vera kare dAo, yekhAna theke tArA tomAdera vera karechila| vastuta phitanA hatyA apekSA gurutara aparAdha! Ara tomarA masajidula hArAmera nikaTa tAdera saGge tatakSaNa paryanta yuddha karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA nijerA sekhAne tomAdera saGge yuddha zuru kare, hA~ tArA yadi (sekhAne) yuddha zuru kare tave tomarA tAderake hatyA karate pAra| erUpa kAphiradera zAsti seTAi|
ataHpara tArA yadi nirasta haYa, tave nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA tAdera saGge yuddha karate thAka, yatakSaNa nA phitanA khatama haYe yAYa evaM dIna AllAhara haYe yAYa| ataHpara tArA yadi kSAnta haYa, tave jAlimarA chAr3A anya kArao prati konao kaThoratA naYa|

pavitra mAsera vadalA pavitra mAsa, Ara pavitratAra kSetreo vadalAra vidhAna prayojya| sutarAM keu yadi tomAdera prati juluma kare, tave tomarAo tAra julumera vadalA nite pAra sei parimANe, yemana juluma se tomAdera prati kareche| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kare calo evaM jene rekha, AllAha tAderai saGge thAkena, yArA (nijedera antare tA~ra) bhaYa rAkhe|
Ara AllAhara pathe artha vyaYa kara evaM nija hAte nijederake dhvaMse nikSepa karo nA| evaM satkarma avalamvana kara| nizcaYai AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlovAsena|

evaM AllAhara janya hajja o umarA pUrNa kara| hA~ tomAderake yadi vAdhA deoYA haYa, tave ye kuravAnI sambhava haYa (tA AllAhara uddezye nivedana kara)| Ara nijedera mAthA tatakSaNa paryanta kAmio nA, yatakSaNa nA kuravAnI nija jAYagAYa peৗ~che yAYa| hA~ tomAdera madhye keu yadi asustha haYe par3e vA tAra mAthAYa kleza dekhA deYa, tave se royA vA sAdAkA kiMvA kuravAnIra phidaYA deve| tArapara yakhana tomarA nirApada haYe yAve, takhana ye vyakti hajjera sAthe umarAra suvidhAo bhoga karave, se (AllAhara uddezye peza karave) ye kuravAnI sahajalabhya haYa| Ara kArao yadi se sAmarthya nA thAke, tave se hajjera dine tinaTi royA rAkhave evaM sAtaTi (royA rAkhave) sei samaYa, yakhana tomarA (vAr3ite) pratyAvartana karave| ebhAve moTa dazaTi royA have| e vidhAna sei sava lokera janya, yAdera parivAravarga masajidula hArAmera nikaTe vAsa kare nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kare calo evaM jene rekha, AllAhara AyAva sukaThina|

hajjera nirdiSTa kaYekaTi mAsa Ache| ye vyakti sesava mAse (iharAma ve~dhe) nijera upara hajja avadhArita kare neYa, se hajjera samaYe kona azlIla kathA valave nA, kona gunAha karave nA evaM jhagar3Ao naYa| tomarA yA-kichu satkarma karave AllAha tA jAnena| Ara (hajjera saphare) patha kharacA sAthe niYe niYo| vastuta tAkaoYAi utkRSTa avalamvana| Ara he vuddhimAnerA! tomarA AmAke bhaYa kare calo|

tomarA (hajjera samaYe vyavasA vA majura khATAra mAdhyame) svIYa pratipAlakera anugraha sandhAna karale tAte tomAdera konao gunAha nei| ataHpara tomarA yakhana ArAphAta theke raoYAnA have, takhana mAzaArula hArAmera nikaTa (yA muyadAliphAYa avasthita) AllAhara yikira karo| Ara tAra yikira tomarA sebhAvei karave, yebhAve tini tomAderake hidAYAta karechena, Ara era Age tomarA vilakula ajJa chile|
tAchAr3A (ekathAo smaraNa rekha ye,) tomarA sei sthAna thekei raoYAnA have, yekhAna theke anyAnya loka raoYAnA haYa| Ara AllAhara kAche kSamA cAo| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA yakhana hajjera kAryAvalI zeSa karave, takhana AllAhake seibhAve smaraNa karave, yebhAve nijedera vApa-dAdAke smaraNa kare thAka; varaM tAra ceYeo vezi smaraNa karave| kichu loka to emana Ache, yArA (du‘AYa kevala) vale, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake duniYAra kalyANa dAna kara, Ara AkhirAte tAdera konao aMza nei|
AvAra tAdera madhye emana lokao Ache, yArA vale, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake dAna kara duniYAYao kalyANa evaM AkhirAteo kalyANa evaM AmAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA kara|
erA emana loka, yArA tAdera arjita karmera aMza (saoYAva rUpe) lAbha karave| AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

evaM tomarA AllAhake ganA-guNati kaYeka dina (yakhana tomarA minAYa avasthAnarata thAka) smaraNa karate thAka| ataHpara ye vyakti tAr3AtAr3i kare du’dinei cale yAve, tAra konao gunAha nei evaM ye vyakti (eka dina) pare yAve tArao konao gunAha nei| eTA tAra janya, ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kare| tomarA sakale AllAhabhIti avalamvana kara evaM vizvAsa rAkha ye, tomAdera sakalake tA~rai kAche niYe ekatra karA have|

evaM mAnuSera madhye emana lokao Ache, pArthiva jIvana samparke yAra kathA tomAke mugdha kare, Ara tAra antare yA Ache, se vyApAre AllAhake sAkSIo vAnAYa, athaca se (tomAra) zatrudera madhye sarvApekSA kaTTara|

se yakhana uThe cale yAYa, takhana yamIne tAra daur3a-jhApa haYa ei uddezye ye, se tAte azAnti char3Ave evaM phasala o (jIva-jantura) vaMza nipAta karave, athaca AllAha azAnti sRSTi pachanda karena nA|
yakhana tAke valA haYa AllAhake bhaYa kara, takhana AtmAbhimAna tAke Arao vezi gunAhe prarocita kare| sutarAM emana vyaktira janya jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa have evaM tA ati manda vichAnA|
evaM (apara dike) mAnuSera madhye emana lokao Ache, ye AllAhara santuSTira janya nija prANake vikri kare deYa| AllAha (erUpa) vAndAdera prati ati daYAlu|
he muminagaNa! isalAme sampUrNarUpe praveza kara evaM zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA| nizcaYai se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|
tomAdera kAche ye ujjvala nidarzanAvalI eseche tAraparao yadi tomarA (saThika patha theke) skhalita hao, tave mane rekha, AllAha mahA kSamatAvAna (o) prajJAmaYa|

tArA (kAphiragaNa ImAna AnAra janya) ki echAr3A Ara konao jinisera apekSA karache ye, AllAha svaYaM meghera cA~doYAYa tAdera sAmane ese upasthita havena evaM phirizatAgaNao (tA~ra sAthe thAkave), Ara sakala viSaYe mImAMsA kare deoYA have? athaca sakala viSaYa zeSa paryanta AllAhara kAchei phiriYe deoYA have|

vanI isarAIlake jijJesa kara, tAderake Ami kata suspaSTa nidarzana diYechilAma| ye vyakti tAra nikaTa AllAhara niYAmata ese yAoYAra para tA parivartana kare phele, (tAra mane rAkhA ucita ye,) AllAhara zAsti var3a kaThina|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera janya pArthiva jIvanake atyanta cittAkarSaka kare tolA haYeche| tArA muminaderake upahAsa kare, athaca yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche tArA kiYAmatera dina tAdera ceYe kata upare thAkave| AllAha yAke cAna aparimita riyaka dAna karena|

(zurute) samasta mAnuSa ekai dInera anusArI chila| tArapara (yakhana tAdera madhye matabheda dekhA dila takhana) AllAha navI pAThAlena, (satyapanthIdera janya) susaMvAdadAtA o (mithyAzraYIdera janya) bhIti pradarzanakArIrUpe| Ara tAdera sAthe satyasamvalita kitAva nAyila karalena, yAte tA mAnuSera madhye sei sava viSaYe mImAMsA kare deYa, yA niYe tAdera madhye matabheda chila| Ara (paritApera viSaYa hala) anya keu naYa; varaM yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila, tArAi tAdera kAche samujjvala nidarzanAvalI AsAra parao kevala pArasparika reSAreSira kAraNe tAtei (sei kitAvei) matabheda sRSTi karala| ataHpara yArA ImAna eneche, AllAha tAderake tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karata, se viSaYe nija icchAYa saThika pathe peৗ~che dena| Ara AllAha yAke cAna tAke sarala-saThika pathe peৗ~che dena|

(he musalimagaNa!) tomarA ki mane karecha, tomarA jAnnAte (emanitei) praveza karave, athaca ekhanao paryanta tomAdera upara sei rakama avasthA Aseni, yemanaTA esechila tomAdera pUrvavartI lokadera upara| tAderake sparza karechila artha-saMkaTa o duHkha-kaSTa evaM tAderake karA haYechila prakampita, emanaki rAsUla evaM tA~ra ImAnadAra saGgIgaNa vale uThechila, AllAhara sAhAyya kakhana Asave? mane rekha, AllAhara sAhAyya nikaTei|

loke ApanAke jijJesa kare, (AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera janya) tArA kI vyaYa karave? Apani vale dina, tomarA ye sampadai vyaYa kara tA pitA-mAtA, AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma, misakIna o musAphiradera janya haoYA cAi| Ara tomarA kalyANakara ye kAjai kara nA kena, AllAha se samparke sampUrNa avagata|

tomAdera prati (zatrura sAthe) yuddha pharaya karA haYeche, Ara tomAdera kAche tA apriYa| eTA to khuvai sambhava ye, tomarA ekaTA jinisake manda mane kara, athaca tomAdera pakSe tA maGgalajanaka| Ara eTAo sambhava ye, tomarA ekaTA jinisake pachanda kara, athaca tomAdera pakSe tA manda| Ara (prakRta viSaYa to) AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|

loke ApanAke maryAdApUrNa mAsa samparke jijJesa kare, tAte yuddha karA kemana? Apani vale dina, tAte yuddha karA mahApApa, kintu (mAnuSake) AllAhara patha theke phiriYe rAkhA, tAra viruddhe kuphurI panthA avalamvana karA, masajidula hArAme praveze vAdhA deoYA evaM tAra vAsindAderake tA theke vera kare deoYA AllAhara nikaTa Arao var3a pApa| Ara phitanA to hatyA apekSAo gurutara| tArA (kAphiragaNa) kramAgata tomAdera saGge yuddha karate thAkave, emanaki pArale tArA tomAderake tomAdera dIna theke pherAte ceSTA karave| yadi tomAdera madhye keu nija dIna parityAga kare, tArapara kAphira avasthAYa mArA yAYa, tave erUpa lokera karma duniYA o AkhirAte vRthA yAve| tArAi jAhAnnAmI| tArA sekhAnei sarvadA thAkave|
(apara dike) yArA ImAna eneche evaM yArA hijarata kareche evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche, tArA niHsandehe AllAhara rahamatera AzAvAdI| Ara AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(apara dike) yArA ImAna eneche evaM yArA hijarata kareche evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche, tArA niHsandehe AllAhara rahamatera AzAvAdI| Ara AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|loke ApanAke mada o juYA samparke jijJesa kare| Apani vale dina, e du’Tora madhye mahA pApao raYeche evaM mAnuSera janya kichu upakArao Ache| Ara e du’Tora pApa tAra upakAra apekSA gurutara| loke ApanAke jijJesa kare, (AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera uddezye) tArA kI vyaYa karave? Apani vale dina, yA (tomAdera praYojanera) atirikta| AllAha ebhAvei tomAdera janya svIYa vidhAnAvalI suspaSTarUpe varNanA karena, yAte tomarA cintA-bhAvanA karate pAra

duniYA samparkeo evaM AkhirAta samparkeo| evaM loke ApanAke iYAtImadera samparke jijJesa kare| Apani vale dina ye, tAdera kalyANa kAmanA uttama| tomarA yadi tAdera sAthe milemize thAka, tave (konao asuvidhA nei| kenanA) tArA to tomAdera bhAi-i vaTe| Ara AllAha bhAlo kare jAnena, ke anartha sRSTikArI Ara ke samAdhAnakArI| AllAha cAile tomAderake saMkaTe phelate pAratena| nizcaYai AllAha mahA kSamatAvAna, prajJAmaYa|

muzarika nArIgaNa yatakSaNa paryanta ImAna nA Ane tatakSaNa tAderake vivAha karo nA| nizcaYai ekajana mumina dAsI ye-konao muzarika nArI apekSA zreYa, yadio sei muzarika nArI tomAdera mugdha kare| Ara nijedera nArIdera vivAha muzarika puruSadera sAthe sampanna karo nA yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna Ane| nizcaYai ekajana mumina golAma ye-kona muzarika puruSa apekSA zreYa yadio sei muzarika puruSa tomAdera mugdha kare| tArA sakale to jAhAnnAmera dike DAke, yakhana AllAha nija hukume jAnnAta o mAgaphirAtera dike DAkena evaM tini svIYa vidhAnAvalI mAnuSera janya suspaSTarUpe varNanA karena, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

loke ApanAra kAche hAYaya samparke jijJesa kare| Apani vale dina, tA azuci| sutarAM hAYayera samaYa strIdera theke pRthaka theka evaM yatakSaNa paryanta tArA pavitra nA haYa, tatakSaNa tAdera kAche yeYo nA (arthAt sahavAsa karo nA)| hA~ yakhana tArA pavitra haYe yAve, takhana tAdera kAche sei panthAYa yAve, yebhAve AllAha tomAderake nirdeza diYechena| nizcaYai AllAha sei sakala lokake bhAlovAsena, yArA tA~ra dike vezi vezi ruju kare evaM bhAlovAsena tAderake, yArA vezi vezi pAka-pavitra thAke|

tomAdera strIgaNa tomAdera janya zasyakSetra| sutarAM nijedera zasyakSetre yekhAna theke icchA yAo evaM nijera janya (utkRSTa karma) sammukhe preraNa kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare calo Ara jene rekha, tomarA avazyai tA~ra saGge milita have evaM muminaderake susaMvAda zonAo|

evaM tomarA nijedera zapathasamUhe AllAha (-era nAma) ke puNya o tAkaoYAra kAjasamUha theke evaM mAnuSera madhye Aposa raphA karAno theke virata thAkAra upalakSa vAnio nA| AllAha savakichu zonena, jAnena|
tomAdera lAgava kasamera kAraNe AllAha tomAderake dharavena nA| kintu ye kasama tomarA tomAdera manera icchAkrame karecha sejanya tini tomAderake dharavena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yArA nijedera strIdera sAthe IlA kare (arthAt tAdera kAche nA yAoYAra kasama kare) tAdera janya raYeche cAra mAsera avakAza| sutarAM yadi tArA (era madhye kasama bheGge) phire Ase, tave nizcaYai AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara tArA yadi tAlAkerai saMkalpa kare neYa, tave AllAha savakichu zonena, jAnena|

ye nArIdera tAlAka deoYA haYeche, tArA tina vAra hAYeya AsA paryanta nijederake pratIkSAYa rAkhave| Ara tArA yadi AllAha o zeSa divase ImAna rAkhe, tave AllAha tAdera garbhAzaYe yA-kichu (bhruNa vA hAYaya) sRSTi karechena tA gopana karA tAdera pakSe vaidha have nA| tAdera svAmIgaNa yadi paristhiti bhAlo karate cAYa, tave e meYAdera madhye tAderake (nijedera strItve) oYApasa grahaNera adhikAra tAdera raYeche| Ara strIderao nyAYasaGgata adhikAra raYeche, yemana tAdera prati (svAmIdera) adhikAra raYeche| avazya tAdera upara puruSadera eka starera zreSThatva raYeche| AllAha parAkrAnta o prajJAmaYa|

tAlAka (vezira vezi) du’vAra haoYA cAi| ataHpara (svAmIra janya du’Ti pathai kholA Ache): haYata nItisammatabhAve (strIke) rekhe deve (arthAt tAlAka pratyAhAra kare neve), athavA utkRSTa panthAYa tAke cher3e deve (arthAt pratyAhAra nA kare varaM iddata zeSa karate deve)| Ara (he svAmIgaNa!) tomarA tAderake (strIgaNake) yA-kichu diYecha, (tAlAkera vadale) tA pherata neoYA tomAdera pakSe hAlAla naYa| tave ubhaYe yadi AzaGkA vodha kare ye, tArA (vivAha vahAla rAkhA avasthAYa) AllAhara sthirIkRta sImA kAYema rAkhate sakSama have nA, tave bhinna kathA| sutarAM tomarA yadi AzaMkA kara, tArA AllAhara sImA pratiSThita rAkhate pArave nA, tave tAdera janya ete konao gunAha nei ye, strI muktipaNa diYe nijeke chAr3iYe neve| eTA AllAhara sthirIkRta sImA| sutarAM tomarA esava laMghana karo nA| yArA AllAhara sImA atikrama kare tArA var3ai jAlima|

ataHpara se (svAmI) yadi (tRtIYa) tAlAka diYe deYa tave se (tAlAkaprApta strI) tAra janya tatakSaNa paryanta hAlAla have nA, yatakSaNa nA se anya konao svAmIke vivAha karave| ataHpara yadi se (dvitIYa svAmI) tAke tAlAka diYe deYa, tave tAdera janya ete konao gunAha nei ye, tArA (natuna vivAhera mAdhyame) punarAYa eke anyera kAche phire Asave zarta hala, tAdera pravala dhAraNA thAkate have ye, (evAra) tArA AllAhara sImA kAYema rAkhate pArave| esava AllAhara sthirIkRta sImA, yA tini jJAnavAna lokadera janya spaSTarUpe varNanA karachena|

yakhana tomarA nArIderake tAlAka diYe dAo, tArapara tArA tAdera iddatera kAchAkAchi peৗ~che yAYa, takhana haYa tAderake nyAYasaGgatabhAve (nija strItve) rekhe deve, naYata tAderake nyAYasaGgatabhAve cher3e deve| tAderake kaSTa deoYAra lakSye ejanya ATake rekha nA ye, tAdera prati juluma karate pArave| ye vyakti erUpa karave, se svaYaM nija sattAra pratii juluma karave| tomarA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake tAmAzArUpe grahaNa karo nA| AllAha tomAdera prati ye anugraha karechena evaM tomAderake upadeza dAnera lakSye tomAdera prati ye kitAva o hikamata nAyila karechena tA smaraNa rekha| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kare calo evaM jene rekha, AllAha sarvaviSaYe avagata|

tomarA yakhana nArIderake tAlAka deve, tArapara tArA iddata pUrNa karave, takhana (he abhibhAvakerA!) tomarA tAderake e kAje vAdhA diYo nA ye, tArA tAdera (prathama) svAmIderake (punarAYa) vivAha karave yadi tArA paraspare nyAYasammatabhAve eke anyera prati rAji haYe yAYa| era dvArA tomAdera madhye sei sava lokake upadeza deoYA hacche, yArA AllAha o zeSa divase ImAna rAkhe| eTAi tomAdera pakSe vezi zuddha o pavitra panthA| AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|

mAYerA tAdera santAnaderake pUrNa du’ vachara dudha pAna karAve| (e samaYakAla) tAdera janya, yArA dudha pAna karAnora meYAda pUrNa karate cAYa| santAna ye pitAra, tAra kartavya nyAYasammatabhAve mAYedera khorapoSera bhAra vahana karA| (hA~) kAuke tAra sAmarthyare vAire kleza deoYA haYa nA| mAke tAra santAnera kAraNe kaSTa deoYA yAve nA evaM pitAkeo tAra santAnera kAraNe naYa| anurUpa dAYitva oYArizera uparao raYeche| ataHpara tArA (pitA-mAtA) pArasparika sammati o parAmarzakrame (du’ vachara pUrNa haoYAra Agei) yadi dudha chAr3Ate cAYa, tave tAteo tAdera konao gunAha nei| tomarA yadi tomAdera santAnaderake (kona dhAtrIra) dudha pAna karAte cAo, tAteo tomAdera konao gunAha nei yadi tomarA dhAryakRta pArizramika (dhAtrImAtAke) nyAYabhAve AdAYa kara evaM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kare calo evaM jene rekha, AllAha tomAdera yAvatIYa kAja bhAlobhAve dekhachena|

tomAdera madhye yArA mArA yAYa o strI rekhe yAYa, tAdera se strIgaNa nijederake cAra mAsa daza dina pratIkSAYa rAkhave| ataHpara tArA yakhana nija iddata (-era meYAda)-e peৗ~che yAve, takhana tArA nijedera vyApAre nyAYasammatabhAve yA-kichu karave (yemana dvitIYa vivAha), tAte tomAdera konao gunAha nei| tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha se samparke samyaka avagata|

evaM (iddatera bhetara) tomarA yadi nArIderake izArA-iGgite vivAhera prastAva dAo athavA (tAderake vivAha karAra icchA) nija antare gopana rAkha, tave tAte tomAdera konao gunAha nei| AllAha jAnena ye, tomarA antare tAderake (vivAha karAra) kalpanA karave| tave tAderake vivAha karAra dvipAkSika pratizruti diYo nA| hA~ nyAYasammatabhAve kona kathA valale seTA bhinna kathA| Ara iddatera nirdiSTa meYAda uttIrNa nA haoYA paryanta vivAhera Akada pAkA karAra icchAo karo nA| smaraNa rekha, tomAdera antare yA-kichu Ache AllAha tA jAnena| sutarAM tA~ke bhaYa kare calo evaM smaraNa rekha, AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

eteo tomAdera kona gunAha nei ye, tomarA strIderake emana samaYe tAlAka deve ye, takhanao paryanta tomarA tAderake sparza karani evaM tAdera moharao dhArya karani| (erUpa avasthAYa) tomarA tAderake (kichu) upahAra diYo sacchala vyakti nija sAmarthya anuyAYI evaM asacchala vyakti nija sAmarthya anuyAYI| uttama panthAYa e upaDhaukana diYo| eTA satkarmazIladera prati eka atyAvazyakIYa karaNIYa|

tomarA tAderake sparza karAra Agei yadi tAlAka dAo evaM tomarA (vivAhakAle) tAdera janya mohara dhArya kare thAka, tave ye parimANa mohara dhArya karechile tAra ardheka (deoYA oYAjiva), avazya strIgaNa yadi chAr3a deYa (evaM ardheka moharao dAvI nA kare) athavA yAra hAte vivAhera granthi (arthAt svAmI), se yadi chAr3a deYa (evaM pUrNa mohara diYe deYa), tave bhinna kathA| yadi tomarA chAr3a dAo, tave seTAi tAkaoYAra vezi nikaTavartI| Ara paraspara audAryapUrNa AcaraNa bhule yeYo nA| tomarA yA-kichui kara, AllAha tA nizcita dekhachena|
tomarA nAmAyasamUhera prati puropuri yatnavAna theka evaM (vizeSabhAve) madhyavartI nAmAyera prati evaM AllAhara sAmane Adavera sAthe anugata haYe dA~r3iYo|

tomarA yadi (zatrura) bhaYa kara, tave dA~r3iYe vA ArohI avasthAYa (nAmAya par3e niYo)| ataHpara tomarA yakhana nirApada avasthA lAbha kara, takhana AllAhara yikira seibhAve kara yebhAve tini tomAderake zikSA diYechena, ye samparke tomarA anavagata chile|

tomAdera madhye yAdera mRtyu haYe yAYa evaM strI rekhe yAYa, tArA yena (mRtyukAle) strIdera anukUle osiYata kare yAYa ye, tArA eka vachara paryanta (parityakta sampada theke khorapoSa grahaNera) suvidhA bhoga karave evaM tAderake (svAmIgRha theke) vera karA yAve nA| hA~, tArA nijerAi yadi vera haYe yAYa, tave nijedera vyApAre tArA vidhimata yA karave, tAte tomAdera konao gunAha nei| AllAha mahAkSamatAvAna, prajJAmaYa|
tAlAkaprAptAderake vidhimata phAYadA dAna muttAkIdera upara tAdera adhikAra|
ebhAvei AllAha svIYa vidhAnAvalI tomAdera kAche suspaSTarUpe varNanA karena, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

tumi ki tAdera avasthA jAna nA, yArA mRtyu hate vA~cAra janya nijedera ghara-vAr3i theke vera haYe giYechila evaM tArA saMkhyAYa chila hAjAra-hAjAra? ataHpara AllAha tAdera valalena, mare yAo| tArapara tini tAdera jIvita karalena| prakRtapakSe AllAha mAnuSera prati ati anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
evaM AllAhara pathe yuddha kara evaM jene rAkha, AllAha savakichu zonena o savakichu jAnena|

ke Ache, ye AllAhake uttama panthAYa RNa deve, phale tini tAra kalyANe tA vahuguNa vRddhi karavena? AllAhai saMkaTa sRSTi karena evaM tinii svacchalatA dAna karena, Ara tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|

tumi ki mUsA paravartI vanI isarAIlera sei dalera ghaTanA jAna nA, yakhana tArA tAdera eka navIke valechila, AmAdera janya ekajana vAdazAha niyukta kare dina, yAte (tAra patAkA tale) AmarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karate pAri| navI valalena, tomAdera dvArA emana ghaTA asambhava ki ye, yakhana tomAdera upara yuddha pharaya karA have, takhana Ara tomarA yuddha karave nA? tArA valala, AmAdera emana ki kAraNa thAkate pAre ye, AmarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karava nA, athaca AmAderake AmAdera ghara-vAr3i o AmAdera santAna-santatidera theke vera kare deoYA haYecha? ataHpara (eTAi ghaTala ye,) yakhana tAdera prati yuddha pharaya karA hala, tAdera madhyakAra alpa kichu loka chAr3A vAki sakale pechane phire gela| AllAha jAlimadera samparke samyaka avahita|

tAdera navI tAderake valala, AllAha tomAdera janya tAlUtake vAdazAha kare pAThiYechena| tArA valate lAgala, tAra ki kare AmAdera upara vAdazAhI lAbha hate pAre, yakhana tAra viparIte AmarAi vAdazAhIra vezi hakadAra? tAchAr3A tAra to Arthika svacchalatAo lAbha haYani| navI valala, AllAha tAke tomAdera upara manonIta karechena evaM jJAna o zarIrera dika theke tAke (tomAdera apekSA) samRddhi dAna karechena| AllAha tA~ra rAjatva yAke icchA dAna kare thAkena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa o sarvajJa|

tAderake tAdera navI Arao valala, tAlUtera vAdazAhIra AlAmata ei ye, tomAdera kAche sei sinduka (phire) Asave, yAra bhetara tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate prazAntira upakaraNa evaM mUsA o hAruna yA-kichu rekhe geche tAra kichu avazeSa raYeche| phirizatAgaNa seTi vaYe Anave| tomarA mumina haYe thAkale tAra madhye tomAdera janya aneka var3a nidarzana raYeche|

ataHpara tAlUta yakhana sainyadera sAthe raoYAnA hala, takhana se (sainyaderake) valala, AllAha ekaTi nadIra dvArA tomAderake parIkSA karavena| ye vyakti se nadIra pAni pAna karave, se AmAra loka naYa| Ara ye tA AsvAdana karave nA, se AmAra loka| avazya keu nija hAta dvArA eka A~jalA bhare nile konao doSa nei| tArapara (ei ghaTala ye,) tAdera alpa saMkhyaka loka chAr3A vAki sakale nadI theke (pracura) pAni pAna karala| sutarAM yakhana se (tAlUta) evaM tAra saGgera muminagaNa nadIra opAre peৗ~chala, takhana tArA (yArA tAlUtera Adeza mAneni) valate lAgala, Aja jAlUta o tAra sainyadera sAthe lar3Ai karAra konao zakti AmAdera nei| (kintu) yAdera vizvAsa chila ye, tArA avazyai AllAhara saGge giYe milita have, tArA valala, emana kata choTa dalai nA raYeche, yArA AllAhara hukume var3a dalera upara jaYayukta haYeche! Ara AllAha tAdera sAthe raYechena, yArA savarera paricaYa deYa|

tArA yakhana jAlUta o tAra sainyadera mukhomukhi hala, takhana tArA valala, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera upara savarera guNa Dhele dAo evaM AmAderake avicala-pada rAkha, Ara kAphira sampradAYera upara AmAderake sAhAyya o vijaYa dAna kara|

sutarAM AllAhara hukume tArA tAderake (jAlUtera vAhinIke) parAbhUta karala evaM dAUda jAlUtake hatyA karala| evaM AllAha tAke rAjatva o prajJA dAna karalena evaM tini ye jJAna cAilena tAke dAna karalena| AllAha yadi mAnuSake tAdera katakera mAdhyame katakake pratihata nA karatena, tave pRthivI viparyasta haYe par3ata| kintu AllAha jagatasamUhera prati ati anugrahazIla|
egulo AllAhara AYAta, yA Ami ApanAra sAmane yathAyathabhAve par3e zonAcchi evaM nizcaYai Apani yAderake rAsUla kare pAThAno haYeche tAdera antarbhukta|

ei ye rAsUlagaNa, (yAderake Ami mAnuSera isalAhera janya pAThiYechi) tAdera katakake katakera upara zreSThatva diYechi| tAdera madhye keu emana Ache, yAra saGge AllAha kathA valechena evaM tAdera madhye kAuke kAuke tini vahu ucca maryAdA dAna karechena| Ara Ami mAraYAmera putra IsAke suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI diYechi o rUhula-kudasera mAdhyame tAra sAhAyya karechi| AllAha yadi cAitena, tave tAdera paravartIkAlera mAnuSa tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI ese yAoYAra para Atmakalahe lipta hata nA| kintu tArA matavirodhe lipta hala| tAdera madhye kichu to emana, yArA ImAna eneche evaM kichu emana, yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche| AllAha cAile tArA Atmakalahe lipta hata nA| kintu AllAha seTAi karena yA tini cAna|

he muminagaNa! Ami tomAderake ye riyaka diYechi tA theke sei dina AsAra Agei (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kara, yedina konao vecAkenA thAkave nA, konao vandhutva (kAje Asave) nA evaM konao supArizao nA| Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArAi jAlima|

AllAha tini, yini chAr3A konao mAvuda nei, yini ciraJjIva, (samagra sRSTira) niYantraka, yA~ra kakhanao tandrA pAYa nA evaM nidrAo naYa, AkAzamaNDale yA-kichu Ache (tAo) evaM pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache (tAo) sava tA~rai| ke Ache, ye tA~ra samIpe tA~ra anumati chAr3A supAriza karave? tini sakala vAndAra pUrva-pazcAt sakala avasthA samparke samyaka avagata| tArA tA~ra jJAnera konao viSaYa nija AYatte nite pAre nA kevala sei viSaYa chAr3A, yA tini nije icchA karena| tA~ra kurasI AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIke pariveSTana kare rekheche| Ara e du’Tora tattvAvadhAne tA~ra vindumAtra kaSTa haYa nA evaM tini ati ucca maryAdAsampanna o mahimAmaYa|

dInera viSaYe konao javaradasti nei| hidAYAtera patha gomarAhI theke suspaSTa haYe geche| era para ye vyakti tAgutake asvIkAra kare AllAhara prati ImAna Anave, se eka majavuta hAtala A~kar3e dharala, yA bheGge yAoYAra konao AzaGkA nei| AllAha savakichu zonena o savakichu jAnena|

AllAha muminadera abhibhAvaka| tini tAderake andhakAra theke vera kare Alote niYe Asena| Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera abhibhAvaka zaYatAna, yArA tAderake Alo theke vera kare andhakAre niYe yAYa| tArA sakale agnivAsI| tArA sarvadA tAtei thAkave|

tumi ki sei vyaktira avasthA cintA karecha, yAke AllAha rAjatva dAna karAra kAraNe se nija pratipAlakera (astitva) samparke ivarAhImera saGge vitarke lipta haYa? yakhana ivarAhIma valala, AmAra pratipAlaka tinii, yini jIvanao dAna karena evaM mRtyuo! takhana se valate lAgala, Amio jIvana dei evaM mRtyu ghaTAi! ivarAhIma valala, AcchA! tA AllAha to sUryake pUrva theke udita karena, tumi tA pazcima theke udita kara to! e kathAYa se kAphira niruttara haYe gela| Ara AllAha (erUpa) jAlimaderake hidAYAta karena nA|

athavA (tumi) sei rakama vyakti (-era ghaTanA) samparke (cintA karecha), ye ekaTi vasatira upara diYe emana eka samaYa gamana karachila, yakhana tA chAda ulTe (thuvar3e) par3e raYechila| se valala, AllAha e vasatike era mRtyura para kibhAve jIvita karavena? anantara AllAha tAke ekaza’ vacharera janya mRtyu dAna karalena evaM tArapara tAke jIvita karalena| (ataHpara) jijJesa karalena, tumi kata kAla yAvat (e avasthAYa) thekecha? se valala, eka dina vA eka dinera kichu aMza! AllAha valalena, nA, varaM tumi (ebhAve) ekaza’ vachara thekecha| evAra nija pAnAhAra sAmagrIra prati lakSya kare dekha tA ekaTuo paceni| AvAra (anyadike) nija gAdhATike dekha, (pace gale tAra kI avasthA haYeche)| (Ami eTA karechi) ejanya ye, Ami tomAke mAnuSera janya (nija kudaratera) ekaTi nidarzana vAnAte cAi evaM (evAra nija gAdhAra) asthisamUha dekha, Ami kibhAve seguloke utthita kari evaM tAte gozatera pozAka parAi| sutarAM yakhana satya tAra sAmane suspaSTa haYe gela, takhana se vale uThala, AmAra vizvAsa Ache AllAha sava viSaYe kSamatA rAkhena|

evaM (sei samaYera vivaraNa zona) yakhana ivarAhIma valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! Apani mRtake kibhAve jIvita karavena AmAke tA dekhAna| AllAha valalena, tumi ki vizvAsa karacha nA? valala, vizvAsa kena karava nA? kintu (e Agraha prakAza karechi ejanya ye,) yAte AmAra antara paripUrNa prazAnti lAbha kare| AllAha valalena, AcchA, cAraTi pAkhi dhara evaM seguloke tomAra poSa mAniYe nAo| tArapara (seguloke yavAha kare) tAra ekeka aMza ekeka pAhAr3e rekhe dAo| tArapara tAderake DAka dAo| savagulo tomAra kAche chuTe cale Asave| Ara jene rekha, AllAha tAAlA mahAkSamatAvAna, prajJAmaYa|

yArA AllAhara pathe nijedera artha vyaYa kare, tAdera dRSTAnta e rakama yemana ekaTi zasya dAnA sAtaTi zISa udagata kare (evaM) pratiTi zISe ekaza’ dAnA janmAYa| Ara AllAha yAra janya icchA karena (saoYAve) kaYeka guNa vRddhi kare dena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa (evaM) sarvajJa|

yArA nija sampada AllAhara pathe vyaYa kare, Ara vyaYa karAra para kheA~TA deYa nA evaM konarUpa kaSTao deYa nA, tArA nija pratipAlakera kAche tAdera saoYAva pAve| tAdera konao bhaYa thAkave nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
uttama kathA vale deoYA o kSamA karA sei sadAkA apekSA zreYa, yAra para konao kaSTa deoYA haYa| AllAha ati veniYAya, ati sahanazIla|

he muminagaNa! khoTA diYe o kaSTa diYe nijedera sadAkAke sei vyaktira mata naSTa karo nA, ye nijera sampada vyaYa kare mAnuSake dekhAnora janya evaM AllAha o parakAle vizvAsa rAkhe nA| sutarAM tAra dRSTAnta e rakama yemana eka masRNa pAtharera upara mATi jame Ache, ataHpara tAte pravala vRSTi par3e evaM tA (sei mATike dhuYe niYe yAYa evaM) seTike (punarAYa) masRNa pAthara vAniYe deYa| erUpa loka yA upArjana kare, tAra kichumAtra tArA hastagata karate pAre nA| Ara AllAha (erUpa) kAphiraderake hidAYAte upanIta karena nA|

Ara yArA nijedera sampada vyaYa kare AllAhara santuSTi lAbha evaM nijedera madhye paripakvatA AnaYanera janya, tAdera dRSTAnta e rakama yemana konao TilAra upara ekaTi vAgAna raYeche, tAra upara pravala vRSTipAta hala, phale tA dviguNa phala janmAla| yadi tAte pravala vRSTi nAo par3e, tave hAlakA vRSTio (tAra janya yatheSTa)| Ara tomarA yA-kichu kara, AllAha tA ati uttamarUpe dekhena|
