tomAdera madhye keu ki eTA pachanda karave ye, tAra khejura o AGgurera ekaTA vAgAna thAkave, yAra pAdadeza diYe nadI-nAlA pravAhita thAkave (evaM) tA theke Arao vibhinna rakamera phala tAra arjita have, ataHpara se vArdhakya-kavalita have Ara tAra thAkave durvala santAna-santati, e avasthAYa akasmAt eka agnikSarA jhar3a ese se vAgAne AghAta hAnave, phale goTA vAgAna bhasmibhUta haYe yAve? ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya svIYa AYAtasamUha pariSkArabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA cintA kara|

he muminagaNa! tomarA yA-kichu upArjana karecha evaM Ami tomAdera janya bhUmi theke yA-kichu utpanna karechi, tAra utkRSTa jinisasamUha theke ekaTi aMza (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kara| Ara erUpa manda jinisa (AllAhara nAme) deoYAra niYata karo nA yA (anya keu tomAderake dile ghRNAra kAraNe) tomarA cakSu vandha nA kare tA grahaNa karave nA| mane rekha, AllAha veniYAya, sarvaprakAra prazaMsA tA~rai dike phere|
zaYatAna tomAderake dAridryera bhaYa dekhAYa evaM tomAderake azlIlatAra Adeza kare, Ara AllAha tomAderake svIYa mAgaphirAta o anugrahera pratizruti dena| AllAha ati prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
tini yAke cAna jJAnavattA dAna karena, Ara yAke jJAnavattA dAna karA hala, tAra vipula parimANe kalyANa lAbha hala| upadeza to kevala tArAi grahaNa kare, yArA vuddhira adhikArI|
tomarA yA-kichu vyaYa kara vA ye mAnatai mAna, AllAha tA jAnena| Ara jAlimagaNa konao rakamera sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

tomarA dAna-sadAkA yadi prakAzye dAo, seo bhAlo, Ara yadi tA gopane garIvaderake dAna kara tave tA tomAdera pakSe katai nA zreYa! evaM AllAha tomAdera mandakarmasamUhera prAYazcitta kare devena| vastuta AllAha tomAdera yAvatIYa kAja samparke pUrNa avagata|

(he navI!) tAderake (kAphiraderake) saThika pathe AnaYana karA ApanAra dAYitva naYa| kintu AllAha yAke cAna saThika pathe AnaYana karena| tomarA ye sampadai vyaYa kara tA tomAdera nijederai kalyANArthe haYe thAke, Ara tomarA AllAhara santuSTi kAmanA chAr3A anya konao uddezye vyaYa kara nA| Ara tomarA ye sampadai vyaYa karave, tomAderake tA paripUrNarUpe deoYA have evaM tomAdera prati vindumAtra juluma karA have nA|

(Arthika sahayogitAra janya vizeSabhAve) upayukta sei sakala garIva, yArA nijederake AllAhara pathe ebhAve Avaddha kare rekheche ye, (arthera sandhAne) tArA bhUmite calApherA karate pAre nA| tArA yehetu (ati saMyamI haoYAra kAraNe kArao kAche) saoYAla kare nA, tAi anavagata loke tAderake vittavAna mane kare| tumi tAdera cehArAra AlAmata dvArA tAderake (arthAt tAdera abhyantarINa avasthA) cinate pArave| (kintu) tArA mAnuSera kAche nA-chor3a haYe saoYAla kare nA| tomarA ye sampadai vyaYa kara, AllAha tA bhAlo karei jAnena|
yArA nijedera sampada dine o rAte vyaYa kare prakAzyeo evaM gopaneo, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera kAche nijedera saoYAva pAve evaM tAdera konao bhaYa thAkave nA Ara tArA konao duHkhao pAve nA|

yArA suda khAYa, (kiYAmatera dina) tArA sei vyaktira mata uThave, zaYatAna yAke sparza dvArA pAgala vAniYe diYeche| eTA ejanya have ye, tArA valechila, ‘vyavasAo to suderai mata| athaca AllAha vikrike hAlAla karechena evaM sudake hArAma karechena| sutarAM ye vyaktira nikaTa tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate upadeza-vANI ese geche, se yadi (sudI kAravAra hate) nivRtta haYa, tave atIte yA-kichu haYeche tA tArai| Ara tAra (abhyantarINa avasthAra) vyApAra AllAhara ekhatiYAre| Ara ye vyakti punarAYa (se kAjai) karala, to erUpa loka jAhAnnAmI have| tArA tAtei sarvadA thAkave|
AllAha sudake nizcihna karena evaM dAna-sadAkAke vardhita karena| Ara AllAha emana pratiTi lokake apachanda karena ye nAzokara, pApiSTha|
(hA~) yArA ImAna Ane, satkarma kare, sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa, tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera kAche raYeche tAdera pratidAna| tAdera konao bhaYa thAkave nA evaM tArA konao duHkhao pAve nA|
he muminagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tomarA yadi prakRta mumina haYe thAka, tave sudera ye aMzai (kArao kAche) avaziSTa raYe geche, tA cher3e dAo|

tavuo yadi tomarA (tA) nA kara, tave AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa theke yuddhera ghoSaNA zune nAo| Ara tomarA yadi (suda theke) tAovA kara, tave tomAdera mUla pu~ji tomAdera prApya| tomarAo (kArao prati) juluma karave nA evaM tomAdera pratio juluma karA have nA|

evaM konao (denAdAra) vyakti yadi asacchala haYa, tave sacchalatA lAbha paryanta (tAke) avakAza dite have| Ara yadi sadAkAi kare dAo, tave tomAdera pakSe seTA adhikatara zreYa yadi tomarA upalavdhi kara|

evaM tomarA sei dinake bhaYa kara, yakhana tomarA sakale AllAhara kAche phire yAve| ataHpara pratyeka vyaktike paripUrNarUpe deoYA have yA se arjana kareche, Ara tAdera prati konao juluma karA have nA|

he muminagaNa! tomarA yakhana nirdiSTa meYAdera janya konao RNera kAravAra kara, takhana tA likhe nAo| tomAdera madhye konao lekhaka yena nyAYaniSThabhAve (tA) likhe deYa| ye vyakti likhate jAne, se yena likhate asvIkAra nA kare| AllAha yakhana tAke eTA zikSA diYechena, takhana tAra lekhA ucita| haka yAra upara sAvyasta hacche, se yena (tA) lekhAYa| Ara se yena tAra pratipAlakake bhaYa kare evaM tAte (sei hakera madhye) kichu nA kamAYa| yAra upara haka sAvyasta hacche, se yadi nirveAdha athavA durvala haYa athavA (anya konao kAraNe lekhAra viSaYa) lekhAte sakSama nA haYa, tave tAra abhibhAvaka yena nyAyyabhAve (tA) lekhAYa| Ara nijedera puruSadera madhya hate du’janake sAkSI vAnAve| yadi du’jana puruSa upasthita nA thAke, tave ekajana puruSa o du’jana strIloka sei sakala sAkSIdera madhya hate, yAderake tomarA pachanda kara, yAte strIlokadera madhya hate ekajana bhule gele anyajana tAke smaraNa kariYe dite pAre| sAkSIderake yakhana (sAkSya deoYAra janya) DAkA have, takhana tArA yena asvIkAra nA kare| ye kAravAra meYAdera sAthe sampRkta tA choTa hoka vA var3a, likhate virakta haYo nA| e viSaYaTi AllAhara nikaTa adhikatara inasAphasammata evaM sAkSyake pratiSThita rAkhAra pakSe vezi sahAYaka evaM tomAdera madhye yAte (bhaviSyate) sandeha dekhA nA	deYa tAra (nizcaYatA vidhAnera) nikaTatara| hA~, tomarA tomAdera madhye ye vyavasAra nagada lenadena kara, tave tA nA lekhAle tomAdera konao asuvidhA nei| yakhana vecAkenA karave takhana sAkSI rAkhave| ye lekhave tAke konao kaSTa deoYA yAve nA evaM sAkSIkeo naYa| tomarA yadi (tA) kara tave tomAdera pakSa hate tA avAdhyatA have| tomarA antare AllAhara bhaYa rekha| AllAha tomAderake zikSA dAna karena evaM AllAha sarvaviSaYe jJAta|

tomarA yadi saphare thAka evaM takhana konao lekhaka nA pAo, tave (AdAYera nizcaYatA svarUpa) vandhaka grahaNa karA yAve| avazya tomarA yadi eke anyera prati vizvAsa rAkha, tave yAra prati vizvAsa rAkhA haYeche, se yena nija AmAnata (yathAyathabhAve) AdAYa kare deYa evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare yini tAra pratipAlaka| Ara tomarA sAkSya gopana karave nA| ye tA gopana karave tAra antara pApI| tomarA ye-kAjai kara nA kena, AllAha se samvandhe pUrNa avagata|

yA-kichu Ache AkAzamaNDale evaM yA-kichu Ache pRthivIte, sava AllAharai| tomAdera antare yA Ache, tA tomarA prakAza kara vA gopana kara, AllAha tomAdera theke tAra hisAva nevena| ataHpara yAke icchA tini kSamA karavena evaM yAke icchA zAsti devena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

rAsUla (arthAt hayarata muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) tAte ImAna eneche, yA tA~ra upara tA~ra pratipAlakera pakSa hate nAyila karA haYeche evaM (tA~ra sAthe) muminagaNao| tA~rA sakale AllAhara prati, tA~ra phirizatAdera prati, tA~ra kitAvasamUhera prati evaM tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna eneche| (tArA vale,) AmarA tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye konao pArthakya kari nA (ye, kArao prati ImAna Anava evaM kArao prati Anava nA)| evaM tA~rA vale, AmarA (AllAha o rAsUlera vidhAnasamUha manoyoga sahakAre) zunechi evaM tA (khuzImane) pAlana karachi| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ApanAra mAgaphirAtera bhikhArI, Ara ApanArai kAche AmAdera pratyAvartana|

AllAha kArao upara tAra sAdhyera vAire dAYitva arpaNa karena nA| tAra kalyANa have se kAjei yA se svecchAYa kare evaM tAra kSatio have se kAjei, yA se svecchAYa kare| (he musalimagaNa! tomarA AllAhara kAche ei du‘A kara ye,) he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera dvArA yadi konao bhula-truTi haYe yAYa tave sejanya tumi AmAdera pAkar3Ao karo nA| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera prati sei rakamera dAYitvabhAra arpaNa karo nA, yemana tA arpaNa karechile AmAdera pUrvavartIdera prati| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera upara emana bhAra cApiYo nA, yA vahana karAra zakti AmAdera nei| AmAdera (truTisamUha) mArjanA kara, AmAdera kSamA kara evaM AmAdera prati daYA kara| tumii AmAdera abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI| sutarAM kAphira sampradAYera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya kara|
Alipha-lAma-mIma
AllAha tinii, yini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| yini ciraJjIva, (samagra jagatera) niYantraka|
tini tomAra prati satyasamvalita kitAva nAyila karechena, yA tAra pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhera samarthana kare evaM tinii tAorAta o inajIla nAyila karechena

era Age, mAnuSera janya sAkSAta hidAYAtarUpe evaM tinii satya o mithyA yAcAiYera mAnadaNDa nAyila karechena| nizcaYai yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche, tAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti| AllAha ati parAkramazAlI o mandera pratiphaladAtA|
nizcita jene rekha, AllAhara kAche kona jinisa gopana thAkate pAre nA pRthivIteo naYa evaM AkAzeo naYa|
tinii sei sattA, yini mAYera peTe yebhAve icchA tomAdera AkRti dAna karena| tini vyatIta kona mAvuda nei| tini parama parAkrAnta evaM samucca prajJArao adhikArI|

(he rAsUla!) se AllAhai emana sattA, yini tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechena, yAra kichu AYAta muhakAma, yAra upara kitAvera mUla bhitti evaM apara kichu AYAta mutAzAviha| yAdera antare vakratA Ache, tArA sei mutAzAviha AYAtasamUhera pechane par3e thAke, uddezya phitanA sRSTi karA evaM sesava AYAtera tAvIla kheA~jA, athaca sesava AYAtera yathArtha marma AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA| Ara yAdera jJAna paripakka tArA vale, AmarA era (sei marmera) prati vizvAsa rAkhi (yA AllAha tAAlAra jAnA)| savakichui AmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate evaM upadeza kevala tArAi grahaNa kare, yArA vuddhimAna|

(erUpa loka prArthanA kare), he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAderake yakhana hidAYAta dAna karecha tArapara Ara AmAdera antare vakratA sRSTi karo nA evaM ekAntabhAve nijera pakSa hate AmAderake rahamata dAna kara| nizcaYai tumii mahAdAtA|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi samasta mAnuSake emana eka dina ekatra karave, ye dinera Agamane kona sandeha nei| nizcaYai AllAha oYAdAra viparIta karena nA|
nizcaYai yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, AllAhara viparIte tAdera sampadao tAdera kona kAje Asave nA evaM tAdera santAna-santatio naYa| Ara tArAi jAhAnnAmera indhana|

(tAdera avasthA) phira‘Auna o tAra pUrvavartI lokadera avasthAra mata| tArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karechila| phale AllAha tAderake tAdera pApAcArera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karechilena| vastuta AllAhara zAsti ati kaThina|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAderake vale dAo, acirei tomarA parAbhUta have evaM tomAderake ekatra kare jAhAnnAme niYe yAoYA have, Ara tA ati manda ThikAnA|

tomAdera janya sei dui dalera (ghaTanAra) madhye nidarzana raYeche, yArA eke anyera saGge saMgharSe lipta haYechila| (tAdera madhye) ekaTi dala AllAhara pathe lar3Ai karachila evaM dvitIYaTi chila kAphira| tArA nijederake kholA cokhe tAdera ceYe dviguNa dekhachila| AllAha yAke icchA karena nija sAhAyya dvArA zaktizAlI karena| nizcaYai era bhetara cakSuSmAnadera janya zikSA raYeche|

mAnuSera janya oi sakala vastura Asaktike manorama karA haYeche, yA tAra pravRttira cAhidA motAveka arthAt nArI, santAna, rAzikRta sonA-rupA, cihnita azvarAji, catuSpada jantu o kSeta-khAmAra| esava iha-jIvanera bhoga-sAmagrI| (kintu) sthAYI pariNAmera saundarya kevala AllAharai kAche|

vala, Ami ki tomAderake esava apekSA utkRSTa jinisera saMvAda deva? yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera kAche Ache emana vAga-vAgicA, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita, yekhAne tArA sarvadA thAkave evaM (tAdera janya Ache) pavitra strI o AllAhara pakSa hate santuSTi| AllAha sakala vAndAke bhAlobhAve dekhachena|
yArA vale, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA (tomAra prati) ImAna enechi| sutarAM AmAdera pAparAzi kSamA kara evaM AmAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA kara|
tArA dhairyazIla, satyavAdI, ivAdatagoyAra, (AllAhara santuSTi vidhAnera lakSye) artha vyaYakArI evaM sAharIra samaYa kSamA prArthanAkArI|

AllAha svaYaM e viSaYera sAkSya dena evaM phirizatAgaNa o jJAnIgaNao ye, tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei, yini inasAphera sAthe (vizva jagatera) niYama-zRGkhalA niYantraNa karachena| tini chAr3A anya keu ivAdatera upayukta naYa| tA~ra kSamatA paripUrNa evaM hikamatao paripUrNa|

nizcaYai AllAhara nikaTa (grahaNayogya) dIna kevala isalAmai| yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila tArA tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra para kevala pArasparika vidveSavazata bhinna patha avalamvana kareche| Ara ye-keu AllAhara AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna karave (tAra smaraNa rAkhA ucita ye,) AllAha ati druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

tAraparao yadi tArA tomAra sAthe vitarke lipta haYa, tave vale dAo, Ami to nijera cehArAke AllAhara abhimukhI karechi evaM yArA AmAra anusaraNa kareche tArAo| Ara kitAvIderake evaM (Aravera muzarika) nirakSaraderake vale dAo, tomarAo ki isalAma grahaNa karale? yadi tArA isalAma grahaNa kare, tave hidAYAta peYe gela, Ara yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tave tomAra dAYitva kevala vArtA peৗ~che deoYA| AllAha vAndAdera samyaka dekhachena|
yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kare, navIderake anyAYabhAve hatyA kare evaM mAnuSera madhye yArA inasAphera nirdeza deYa tAderakeo hatyA kare, tAderake yantraNAmaYa zAstira ‘susaMvAda’ dAo|
erAi tArA, duniYA o AkhirAte yAdera karma niSphala haYe geche, Ara tAdera konao sAhAyyakArI lAbha have nA|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yAderake kitAvera kichu aMza deoYA haYechila| tAderake AllAhara kitAvera dike DAkA haYa, yAte tA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa| tathApi tAdera ekadala upekSAra sAthe (tA theke) mukha phiriYe neYa|
tA e kAraNe ye, tArA vale thAke, Aguna kakhanai AmAderake dina katakera vezi sparza karave nA| Ara tArA yesava mithyA udbhAvana kareche, tAi tAderake tAdera dIna samparke dheA~kAYa pheleche|

kintu takhana (tAdera) kI avasthA have, yakhana Ami tAderake emana eka dina (-era sammukhIna karA)-era janya ekatra karava, yAra Agamanera vyApAre vindumAtra sandeha nei| Ara pratyekake se yA-kichu arjana kareche tA puropuri deoYA have evaM kArao prati kona juluma karA have nA|

vala, he AllAha! sArvabhauma zaktira mAlika! tumi yAke cAo kSamatA dAna kara, Ara yAra theke cAo kSamatA ker3e nAo| yAke icchA sammAna dAna kara evaM yAke cAo lAJchita kara| samasta kalyANa tomArai hAte| nizcaYai tumi sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna|

tumii rAtake dinera madhye praveza karAo evaM dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAo| tumii niSprANa vastu hate prANavAna vastu vera kara evaM prANavAna theke niSprANa vastu vera kara, Ara yAke icchA aparimita riyaka dAna kara|

muminagaNa yena muminaderake cher3e kAphiraderake (nijedera) mitra nA vAnAYa| ye erUpa karave AllAhara saGge tAra konao samparka nei| tave tAdera (juluma) theke vA~cAra janya yadi AtmarakSAmUlaka konao panthA avalamvana kara, seTA bhinna kathA| AllAha tomAderake nija (zAsti) samparke sAvadhAna karachena Ara tA~rai dike (sakalake) phire yete have|

(he rAsUla! mAnuSake) vale dAo, tomAdera antare yA-kichu Ache, tomarA tA gopana rAkha vA prakAza kara, AllAha tA avagata Achena evaM tini jAnena yA-kichu AkAzamaNDala o yamIne Ache, AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

(sei dinake smaraNa rekha), ye dina pratyeke ye ye bhAlo kAja kareche tA sAmane upasthita pAve evaM ye manda kAja kareche (tAo nijera sAmane upasthita dekhe) AkAGkSA karave, tAra o sei manda kAjera madhye yadi aneka dUrera vyavadhAna thAkata! AllAha tomAderake nija (zAsti) samparke sAvadhAna karachena| Ara AllAha nija vAndAdera prati ati mamatAvAna|

(he navI! mAnuSake) vale dAo, tomarA yadi AllAhake bhAlovese thAka, tave AmAra anusaraNa kara, tAhale AllAha tomAdera bhAlovAsavena evaM tomAdera pAparAzi kSamA karavena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
vale dAo, AllAha o rAsUlera Anugatya kara| tAraparao yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tave AllAha kAphiraderake pachanda karena nA|
AllAha Adama, nuha, ivarAhImera vaMzadharagaNa o imarAnera vaMzadharagaNake samasta jagatera upara zreSThatva diYechena|
erA emana vaMzadhara, yAra sadasyagaNa (satkarma o ikhalAse) eke anyera sAthe sAdRzyapUrNa chila| Ara AllAha (pratyekera kathA) zonena evaM (savakichu) jAnena|

(sutarAM du‘A zravaNa-saMkrAnta sei ghaTanA smaraNa kara) yakhana imarAnera strI valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra garbhe ye zizu Ache, tAke sakala kAja theke mukta rekhe tomAra janya utsarga karalAma| sutarAM tumi AmAra pakSa hate tA kavula kara| nizcaYai tumi (sakala kichu) zona o (sakala viSaYe) jAna|

ataHpara yakhana tAra kanyA santAna janmagrahaNa karala takhana se (AkSepa kare) valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami ye kanyA santAna janma dilAma! athaca AllAha bhAlo karei jAnena, tAra kI janma niYeche| Ara ‘chele to meYera mata haYa nA’| Ami tAra nAma rAkhalAma mAraYAma evaM tAke o tAra vaMzadharagaNake abhizapta zaYatAna theke hephAjatera janya tomAra AzraYe arpaNa karalAma|

sutarAM tAra pratipAlaka tAke (mAraYAmake) uttamabhAve kavula karalena evaM tAke utkRSTa panthAYa pratipAlana karalena| Ara yAkAriYA tAra tattvAvadhAYaka hala| yakhanai yAkAriYA tAra kAche tAra ivAdatakhAnAYa yeta, tAra kAche kona riyaka peta| se jijJesa karala, mAraYAma! tomAra kAche esava jinisa kothA theke Ase? se valala, eTA AllAhara nikaTa theke| AllAha yAke cAna aparimita riyaka dAna karena|
e samaYa yAkAriYA svIYa pratipAlakera kAche du‘A karala| valate lAgala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke tomAra nikaTa hate kona pavitra santAna dAna kara| nizcaYai tumi du‘A zravaNakArI|

sutarAM (ekadA) yAkAriYA yakhana ivAdatakhAnAYa sAlAta AdAYa karachilena, takhana phirizatAgaNa tA~ke DAka diYe valala, AllAha ApanAke iYAhaiYA (-era janma) samparke susaMvAda dicchena, (yini janmagrahaNa karavena) AllAhara eka kAlimAra samarthakarUpe, yini havena mAnuSera netA, jitendriYa, evaM puNyavAnadera antarbhukta ekajana navI|
yAkAriYA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra putra santAna janma neve kibhAve, yakhana AmAra vArdhakya ese par3eche evaM AmAra strIo vandhyA? AllAha valalena, ebhAvei! AllAha yA cAna karena|

se valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra janya kona nidarzana sthira kare dina| AllAha valalena, tomAra nidarzana ei ye, tumi tina dina paryanta mAnuSera sAthe izArA vyatireke konao kathA valate pArave nA| evaM tumi svIYa pratipAlakera adhika parimANe yikira karate thAka, Ara tAra tAsavIha pATha kara vikAla velAYa o USAkAle|

evaM (evAra sei samaYakAra vivaraNa zona) yakhana phirizatAgaNa valechila, he mAraYAma! nizcaYai AllAha tomAke veche niYechena, tomAke pavitratA dAna karechena evaM vizvera samasta nArIra madhye tomAke zreSThatva dAna karechena|
he mAraYAma! tumi nija pratipAlakera ivAdate mazagula thAka evaM sijadA kara o rukUkArIdera sAthe rukUo kara|

(he navI!) esava adRzyera saMvAda, yA ohIra mAdhyame tomAke dicchi| takhana tumi tAdera kAche chile nA, yakhana ke mAraYAmera tattvAvadhAna karave (e viSaYe siddhAnta grahaNera janya) tArA nija-nija kalama nikSepa karachila| evaM takhanao tumi tAdera kAche chile nA, yakhana tArA (e viSaYe) eke anyera sAthe vAdAnuvAda karachila|

(sei samaYera kathAo smaraNa kara) yakhana phirizatAgaNa valechila, he mAraYAma! AllAha tomAke nijera eka kAlimAra (janmagrahaNera) susaMvAda dicchena, yAra nAma have mAsIha IsA ivane mAraYAma, ye duniYA o AkhirAta ubhaYa sthAne maryAdAvAna have evaM (AllAhara) nikaTatama vAndAdera antarbhukta have|
evaM se dolanAYao mAnuSera sAthe kathA valave evaM pUrNa vaYaseo, Ara se have puNyavAnadera antarbhukta|

mAraYAma valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra kibhAve putra janma neve, yakhana kona puruSa AmAke sparza paryanta kareni? AllAha valalena, ebhAvei AllAha yA cAna sRSTi karena| tini yakhana kona kAja karAra siddhAnta nena, takhana tAra janya kevala valena, ‘haYe yAo’| phale tA haYe yAYa|
evaM tini (AllAha) tA~ke (arthAt IsA ivane mAraYAmake) kitAva o hikamata evaM tAorAta o inajIla zikSA dAna karavena|

evaM tA~ke vanI isarAIlera nikaTa rAsUla vAniYe pAThAvena| (se mAnuSake valave), Ami tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate nidarzana niYe esechi, (Ara se nidarzana ei) ye, Ami tomAdera sAmane kAdA dvArA eka pAkhira AkRti tairi karava, tArapara tAte phu deva, phale tA AllAhara hukume pAkhi haYe yAve evaM Ami AllAhara hukume janmAndha o kuSTha rogIke nirAmaYa kare deva, mRtaderake jIvita karava AllAhara hukume evaM tomarA nija gRhe yA khAo kiMvA maojuda kara, tA sava tomAderake jAniYe deva| tomarA mumina haYe thAkale esava viSaYera madhye tomAdera janya (yatheSTa) nidarzana raYeche|

evaM AmAra pUrve ye kitAva eseche arthAt tAorAta, Ami tAra samarthanakArI evaM (AmAke ejanya pAThAno haYeche) yAte tomAdera prati yA hArAma karA haYeche, tanmadhye kichu jinisa tomAdera janya hAlAla kari evaM Ami tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke nidarzana niYe esechi| sutarAM AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra kathA mAna|
nizcaYai AllAha AmAra pratipAlaka evaM tomAraderao pratipAlaka| eTAi sarala patha (ye,) tomarA kevala tA~rai ivAdata karave|

ataHpara IsA yakhana upalavdhi karala tAdera kuphara, takhana se (tAra anusArIderake) valala, ‘ke ke Ache, yArA AllAhara pathe AmAra sAhAyyakArI have’? hAoYArIgaNa valala, AmarA AllAhara (dInera) sAhAyyakArI| AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi evaM Apani sAkSI thAkuna ye, AmarA anugata|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Apani yA-kichu nAyila karechena AmarA tAte ImAna enechi evaM AmarA rAsUlera anusaraNa karechi| sutarAM AmAderake sei sakala lokera madhye likhe nina, yArA (satyera) sAkSyadAtA|
Ara kAphiragaNa (IsA AlAihisa sAlAmera viruddhe) gupta kauzala avalamvana karala evaM AllAhao gupta kauzala karalena| vastuta AllAha sarvApekSA zreSTha kauzalI|

(tA~ra kauzala sei samaYa prakAza pela) yakhana AllAha valechilena, he IsA! Ami tomAke (sahi-sAlAmate) pherata niYe neva, tomAke nijera kAche tule neva evaM yArA kupharI avalamvana kareche tAdera (utpIr3ana) theke tomAke mukta karava, Ara yArA tomAra anusaraNa kareche tAderake kiYAmata divasa paryanta sei sakala lokera upara pravala rAkhava, yArA (tomAke) asvIkAra kareche| tArapara tomAdera sakalake AmAra kAche phire Asate have| takhana Ami tomAdera madhye sei viSaYe mImAMsA karava, yA niYe tomarA virodha karate|
sutarAM yArA kupharI avalamvana kareche tAderake to Ami duniYA o AkhirAte kaThina zAsti deva evaM tAdera konao rakamera sAhAyyakArI lAbha have nA|
Ara yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAderake AllAha tAdera paripUrNa saoYAva dAna karavena| AllAha jAlimaderake bhAlovAsena nA|
(he navI!) esava emana AYAta o sAragarbha upadeza, yA Ami tomAke par3e zonAcchi|
AllAhara nikaTa IsAra dRSTAnta Adamera mata| AllAha tA~ke mATi hate sRSTi karena, tArapara tAke valena, ‘haYe yAo’| phale se haYe yAYa|
satya seTAi, yA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate eseche| sutarAM tumi sandehakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|

tomAra kAche (hayarata IsA AlAihisa sAlAmera ghaTanA samparke) ye prakRta jJAna eseche, tAraparao yArA e viSaYe tomAra saGge vitarke lipta haYa, (tAderake) vale dAo, eso, AmarA DAki AmAdera santAnaderake evaM tomarA tomAdera santAnaderake, AmarA AmAdera nArIderake evaM tomarA tomAdera nArIderake, Ara AmAdera nija lokaderake evaM tomAdera nija lokaderake, tArapara AmarA sakale mile (AllAhara sAmane) kAkuti-minati kari evaM yArA mithyAvAdI, tAdera prati AllAhara lAnata pAThAi|
nizcaYai eTAi (ghaTanAvalIra) prakRta varNanA| AllAha chAr3A konao mAvuda nei evaM nizcaYai AllAha parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|
tathApi yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave AllAha to vizRGkhalA sRSTikArIderake bhAlobhAvei jAnena|

(iYAhudI o nAsArAdera) vale dAo ye, he Ahale kitAva! tomarA emana eka kathAra dike ese yAo, yA AmAdera o tomAdera madhye ekai rakama| (Ara tA ei ye,) AmarA AllAha chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karava nA| tA~ra saGge konao kichuke zarIka karava nA evaM AllAhake cher3e AmarA eke anyake ‘ravva’ vAnAva nA| tathApi yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave vale dAo, sAkSI thAka ye, AmarA musalima|
he Ahale kitAva! tomarA ivarAhIma samparke kena vitarka karacha, athaca tAorAta o inajIla to tA~ra pare nAyila haYeche| tomarA ki (etaTukuo) vojha nA?

dekha, tomarAi to tArA, yArA emana viSaYe vitarka karecha, ye viSaYe kichu nA kichu jJAna tomAdera chila| evAra emana sava viSaYe kena vitarka karacha, ye samparke tomAdera moTei jJAna nei| AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|
ivarAhIma iYAhudIo chila nA evaM khrisTAnao naYa| varaM se to ekaniSTha musalima chila| se kakhanao zirakakArIdera antarbhukta chila nA|

ivarAhImera sAthe ghaniSThatAra sarvApekSA vezi hakadAra loka tArA, yArA tA~ra anusaraNa kareche evaM ei navI (arthAt zeSa navI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYA sAllAma) evaM sei sakala loka, yArA ImAna eneche| Ara AllAha muminadera abhibhAvaka|
(he muminagaNa!) kitAvIdera ekaTi dala tomAderake pathabhraSTa karate cAYa, prakRtapakSe tArA nijedera chAr3A anya kAuke pathabhraSTa karache nA, yadio tAdera se upalavdhi nei|
he Ahale kitAva! tomarA AllAhara AYAtasamUha kena asvIkAra karacha, yakhana tomarA nijerAi sAkSI (ye, tA AllAhara pakSa hate avatIrNa)?
he Ahale kitAva! tomarA satyake mithyAra sAthe kena golAccha? evaM jene zune kena satya gopana karacha?

Ahale kitAvera ekaTi dala (eke anyake) vale, musalimadera prati ye kitAva nAyila haYeche, dinera zuru dike to tAte ImAna Anave Ara dinera zeSAMze tA asvIkAra karave| haYata ebhAve musalimagaNa (-o tAdera dIna theke) phire yAve|

Ara yArA tomAdera dInera anusArI, tAdera chAr3A anya kAuke AntarikabhAve mAnave nA| Apani (tAdera) vale dina, AllAha pradatta hidAYAtai prakRta hidAYAta| (tomarA esava karacha kevala ei jidera vazavartIte ye,) tomAderake ye jinisa (navuoYAta o AsamAnI kitAva) deoYA haYechila, se rakama jinisa anya keu pAve kena? kiMvA tArA (musalimagaNa) tomAdera pratipAlakera sAmane tomAdera upara vijaYI haYe gela kena? Apani vale dina, zreSThatva AllAharai hAte| tini yAke cAna tA dAna karena| Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvaviSaYe jJAta|
tini nija rahamatera janya yAke icchA vizeSabhAve manonIta karena evaM AllAha mahA anugrahera mAlika|

kitAvIdera madhye emana lokao Ache, yAra kAche tumi sampadera ekaTA stUpao yadi AmAnata rAkha, tave se tA tomAke oYApasa karave| AvAra tAdera madhyei emana lokao Ache, yAra kAche ekaTi dInArao AmAnata rAkhale se tomAke tA pherata deve nA yadi nA tumi tAra mAthAra upara dA~r3iYe thAka| tAdera e karmapanthA e kAraNe ye, tArA vale thAke, ummIdera (arthAt aiYAhudI Aravadera) vyApAre AmAdera theke kona kaiphiYata neoYA have nA| Ara (ebhAve) jene zune tArA AllAha samparke mithyAcAra kare|
kena kaiphiYata neoYA have nA? (niYama to ei ye,) ye keu nija aGgIkAra pUrNa kare o (gunAha theke) ve~ce thAke, AllAha erUpa paraheyagAraderake bhAlovAsena|

(pakSAntare) yArA AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra o nijedera kasamera vinimaYe tuccha mUlya grahaNa kare, AkhirAte tAdera konao aMza nei| Ara AllAha kiYAmatera dina tAdera saGge kathA valavena nA, tAdera dike (sadaYa dRSTite) tAkAvena nA evaM tAderake pavitra karavena nA| tAdera janya thAkave kevala yantraNAmaYa zAsti|

tAderai madhye ekadala loka emana Ache, yArA kitAva (tAorAta) par3Ara samaYa nijedera jihvAke pe~cAYa, yAte tomarA (tAdera pe~ciYe tairi karA) se kathAke kitAvera aMza mane kara, athaca tA kitAvera aMza naYa evaM tArA vale, eTA AllAhara nikaTa theke avatIrNa, athaca tA AllAhara nikaTa theke avatIrNa naYa evaM (ebhAve) tArA jene zune AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare|

konao mAnuSera janya saGgata naYa ye, AllAha tAke kitAva, hikamata o navuoYAta dAna karavena Ara se tA sattveo mAnuSake valave, tomarA AllAhake cher3e AmAra vAndA haYe yAo| era parivarte (se to eTAi valave ye,) tomarA AllAhaoYAlA haYe yAo, tomarA ye kitAva zikSA dAo o yA-kichu nijerA par3a, tAra phalazrutite|
evaM phirizatA o navIgaNake ravva sAvyasta karAra nirdezao se tomAderake dite pAre nA| tomarA musalima haYe yAoYAra parao ki se tomAderake kupharIra hukuma deve?

evaM (tAderake sei samaYera kathA smaraNa karAo) yakhana AllAha navIgaNa theke pratizruti niYechilena, Ami yadi tomAderake kitAva o hikamata dAna kari, tArapara tomAdera nikaTa kona rAsUla Agamana kare, ye tomAdera kAche ye kitAva Ache tAra samarthana kare, tave tomarA avazyai tAra prati ImAna Anave evaM avazyai tAra sAhAyya karave| AllAha (sei navIderake) valechilena, tomarA ki ekathA svIkAra karacha evaM AmAra pakSa hate pradatta e dAYitva grahaNa karacha? tArA valechila, AmarA svIkAra karachi| AllAha valalena, tave tomarA (eke anyera svIkArokti samparke) sAkSI thAka evaM Amio tomAdera saGge sAkSI thAkalAma|
eraparao yArA (hidAYAta theke) mukha phiriYe neve, tArAi nApharamAna|

tave ki tArA AllAhara dInera parivarte anya konao dInera sandhAne Ache? athaca AsamAna o yamIne yata mAkhaluka Ache, tArA sakale AllAharai sAmane mAthA nata kare rekheche, (kataka to) svecchAYa evaM (kataka) vAdhya haYe| evaM tA~rai dike tArA sakale phire yAve|

vale dAo, AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara prati, AmAdera upara ye kitAva nAyila karA haYeche tAra prati, ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva o (tA~dera) vaMzadharera prati yA (ye hidAYAta) nAyila karA haYeche tAra prati evaM mUsA, IsA o anyAnya navIgaNake tA~dera pratipAlakera pakSa hate yA deoYA haYeche tAra prati| AmarA tA~dera (ullikhita navIdera) madhye konao pArthakya kari nA evaM AmarA tA~rai (eka AllAharai) sammukhe natazira|
ye vyaktii isalAma chAr3A anya konao dIna avalamvana karate cAve, tAra theke se dIna kavula karA have nA evaM AkhirAte se mahA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|

AllAha emana lokadera kibhAve hidAYAta devena, yArA ImAna AnAra para kuphara avalamvana kareche, athaca tArA sAkSya diYechila ye, rAsUla satya evaM tAdera kAche ujjvala nidarzanAvalIo esechila| AllAha erUpa jAlimaderake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|
erUpa lokadera zAsti ei ye, tAdera prati AllAhara, phirizatAdera o samasta mAnuSera lAnata|
tArai madhye (lAnatera madhye) tArA sarvadA thAkave| tAdera zAsti lAghava karA have nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deoYA have nA|
avazya yArA era parao tAovA karave o nijederake saMzodhana karave, (tAdera janya) AllAha avazyai kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu|
(pakSAntare) yArA ImAna AnAra para kupharI avalamvana kareche, tArapara kupharIte agragAmI hate thekeche, tAdera tAovA kichutei kavula have nA| evaM erUpa lokai vipathagAmI|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche o kAphira avasthAYai mArA geche, tAdera kArao theke pRthivI bharti sonAo gRhIta have nA yadio tArA nijedera prANa rakSArthe tA dite cAYa| tAdera janya raYeche marmantuda zAsti evaM tAdera konao rakamera sAhAyyakArI lAbha have nA|
tomarA kichutei puNyera nAgAla pAve nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA tomAdera priYa vastu hate (AllAhara janya) vyaYa karave| tomarA yA-kichui vyaYa kara, AllAha se samparke pUrNa avagata|

tAorAta nAyila haoYAra Age vanI isarAIlera janya (-o) samasta khAdyadravya hAlAla chila (-yA musalimadera janya hAlAla), kevala sei vastu chAr3A, yA isarAIla (arthAt iYAkuva AlAihisa sAlAma) nijera janya hArAma karechila| (he navI! iYAhudIderake) vale dAo, tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tave tAorAta niYe eso evaM tA pATha karo|
esava viSaYa (spaSTa haYe yAoYA)-era parao yArA AllAhara prati apavAda Aropa kare, tArAi jAlima|
Apani valuna, AllAha satya valechena| sutarAM tomarA ivarAhImera dIna anusaraNa kara, ye chila sampUrNarUpe saThika pathera upara| yArA AllAhara zarIka sthira kare se tAdera antarbhukta chila nA|
vAstavatA ei ye, mAnuSera (ivAdatera) janya sarvaprathama ye ghara tairi karA haYa, nizcaYai tA seTi, yA makkAYa avasthita, yA varakatamaYa evaM samagra jagatera mAnuSera janya hidAYAtera upAYa|

tAte Ache suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI, mAkAme ivarAhIma| ye tAte praveza kare, se nirApada haYe yAYa| mAnuSera madhye yArA sekhAne peৗ~chAra sAmarthya rAkhe, tAdera upara AllAhara janya e gharera hajja karA pharaya| keu (eTA) asvIkAra karale AllAha to vizva jagatera samasta mAnuSa hate veniYAya|
vale dAo, he kitAvIgaNa! tomarA AllAhara AYAtasamUha kena asvIkAra karacha? tomarA yA-kichu karacha AllAha tAra sAkSI|

vale dAo, he kitAvIgaNa! muminaderake AllAhara pathe vAdhA diccha kena tAte vakratA sRSTira ceSTA kare, athaca tomarA nijerAi (prakRta avasthAra) sAkSI? tomarA yA-kichu karacha, AllAha se samparke gAphila nana|
he muminagaNa! tomarA yadi kitAvIdera ekaTi dalera (arthAt iYAhudIdera) kathA mene nAo, tave tArA tomAderake tomAdera ImAna AnAra para punarAYa kAphira vAniYe chAr3ave|

tomarA ki karei vA kuphara avalamvana karave, yakhana tomAdera sAmane AllAhara AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA hacche evaM tA~ra rAsUla tomAdera madhye vartamAna raYechena? Ara (AllAhara nIti ei ye,) ye vyakti AllAhara AzraYake majavutabhAve A~kar3e dhare, tAke sarala patha paryanta peৗ~che deoYA haYa|
he muminagaNa! antare AllAhake seibhAve bhaYa kara, yebhAve tAke bhaYa karA ucita| (sAvadhAna! anya konao avasthAYa yena) tomAdera mRtyu (nA Ase, varaM) ei avasthAYai yena Ase ye, tomarA musalima|

AllAhara razike (arthAt tA~ra dIna o kitAvake) dRr3habhAve dhare rAkha evaM paraspare vibheda karo nA| AllAha tomAdera prati ye anugraha karechena tA smaraNa rAkha| ekaTA samaYa chila, yakhana tomarA eke anyera zatru chile| ataHpara AllAha tomAdera antarasamUhake jur3e dilena| phale tA~ra anugrahe tomarA bhAi-bhAi haYe gele| tomarA agniku-era prAnte chila| AllAha tomAderake (isalAmera mAdhyame) sekhAna theke mukti dilena| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya svIYa nidarzanasamUha suspaSTarUpe varNanA karena, yAte tomarA saThika pathe cale Asa|
tomAdera madhye emana ekaTi dala thAkA cAi, yArA (mAnuSake) kalyANera dike DAkave, satkAjera Adeza karave o manda kAje vAdhA deve| erUpa lokai saphalatA lAbhakArI|

evaM tomarA sei sakala lokera (arthAt iYAhudI o nAsArAra) mata haYo nA, yArA tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI AsAra parao paraspara vicchinna haYe giYechila o Apase matabheda sRSTi karechila| erUpa lokadera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti

sei dina, ye dina kataka mukha (ImAna o Anugatyera AloYa) ujjvala have evaM kataka mukha (kuphala o pApera kAlimAYa) kAlo haYe yAve| yAdera mukha kAlo haYe yAve, (tAderake valA have,) tomarA ki ImAna AnAra para kuphala avalamvana karechile? sutarAM tomarA zAsti AsvAdana kara, yehetu tomarA kupharI karate|
pakSAntare yAdera mukha ujjvala have, tArA AllAhara rahamatera bhetara sthAna pAve evaM tArA tAtei sarvadA thAkave|
esava AllAhara AYAta, yA Ami tomAke yathAyathabhAve par3e zonAcchi| AllAha jagadvAsIra prati konao rakama juluma karate cAna nA|
AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA AllAharai evaM tA~rai dike sakala viSaYa phire yAve|

(he musalimagaNa!) tomarA sei zreSThatama dala, mAnuSera kalyANera janya yAdera astitva dAna karA haYeche| tomarA satkAjera Adeza kare thAka o anyAYa kAje vAdhA diYe thAka evaM AllAhara prati ImAna rAkha| kitAvIgaNa yadi ImAna Anata, tave tAdera pakSe tA katai nA bhAlo hata| tAdera madhye kataka to ImAnadAra, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai nApharamAna|

tArA sAmAnya kaSTa dAna (arthAt maukhika gAlamanda karA) chAr3A tomAdera vizeSa konao kSati kakhanai karate pArave nA| Ara tArA yadi kakhanao tomAdera saGge yuddha kare, tave avazyai tomAdera pRSThapradarzana karave, ataHpara tArA konao sAhAyya lAbha karave nA|

tAderake yekhAnei pAoYA yAka, tAdera upara lAJchanAra chApa mere deoYA haYeche, avazya AllAhara tarapha theke yadi kona upAYa sRSTi haYe yAYa kiMvA mAnuSera pakSa hate konao avalamvana vera haYe Ase, (yA tAderake poSakatA dAna karave) tave bhinna kathA| evaM tArA AllAhara krodha niYe phireche, Ara tAdera upara cApiYe deoYA haYeche abhAvagrastatA| era kAraNa ei ye, tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karata evaM navIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| (tAchAr3A) era kAraNa ei ye, tArA avAdhyatA karata o sImAlaMghane lipta thAkata|

(tave) kitAvIdera sakale eka rakama naYa| kitAvIdera madhyei emana lokao Ache, yArA (saThika pathe) pratiSThita, yArA rAtera velA AllAhara AYAtasamUha pATha kare evaM tArA (AllAhara uddeze) sijadAvanata haYa|
tArA AllAha o AkhirAta-divase ImAna rAkhe, satkAjera Adeza kare, asatkAje niSedha kare evaM uttama kAjera dike dhAvita haYa| Ara erAi sAlihInera madhye gaNya|
tArA yesava bhAlo kAja kare, kichutei tAra amaryAdA karA have nA| AllAha muttAkIdera samparke samyaka jJAta|

(era viparIte) yArA kuphala avalamvana kareche, AllAhara viparIte tAdera artha-sampada tAdera konao kAje Asave nA evaM tAdera santAna-santatio naYa evaM tArA jAhAnnAmavAsI| tAtei tArA sarvadA thAkave|

tArA e duniYAra jIvane yA-kichu vyaYa kare, tAra dRSTAnta e rakama, yemana himazItala vAYu emana ekadala lokera zasya-kSete AghAta hAne o tA dhvaMsa kare deYa, yArA nijedera prati juluma kareche, AllAha tAdera prati juluma karenani; varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera upara juluma karache|

he muminagaNa! tomarA nijedera vAirera konao vyaktike antaraGga vandhu vAniYo nA| tArA tomAdera aniSTa kAmanAYa kona rakama truTi kare nA| yAte tomarA kaSTa pAo tAi tArA kAmanA kare| tAdera mukha thekei Akroza vera haYe geche| Ara tAdera antare yA-kichu (vidveSa) gopana Ache, tA Arao gurutara| Ami Asala vRttAnta tomAdera kAche spaSTabhAve varNanA kare dilAma yadi tomarA vuddhike kAje lAgAo!

dekha, tomarA to emana ye, tomarA tAderake mahavvata kara, kintu tArA tomAderake mahavvata kare nA| Ara tomarA to samasta (AsamAnI) kitAvera upara ImAna rAkha, kintu (tAdera avasthA ei ye,) tArA yakhana tomAdera sAthe milita haYa, takhana vale, AmarA (kuraAnera upara) ImAna enechi, Ara yakhana nibhRte cale yAYa takhana tomAdera prati Akroze nijedera AGgula kAmar3AYa| (tAderake) vale dAo, tomarA nijedera Akroze nijerA mara| AllAha antarera gupta viSaYao bhAlo kare jAnena|

tomAdera yadi kona kalyANa lAbha haYa, tAdera khArApa lAge, pakSAntare tomAdera manda kichu ghaTale tArA tAte khuzI haYa| tomarA savara o tAkaoYA avalamvana karale tAdera cakrAnta tomAdera kona kSati sAdhana karate pArave nA| tArA yA-kichu karache tA savai AllAhara (jJAna o zaktira) AotAbhukta|

(he navI! uhuda yuddhera sei samaYera kathA smaraNa kara) yakhana sakAla velA tumi nija gRha theke vera haYe musalimaderake yuddhera ghA~TisamUhe motAYena karechile| Ara AllAha to sava kichui zonena o jAnena|
yakhana tomAderai madhyakAra du’Ti dala himmata hAriYe phelAra upakrama karechila| athaca AllAha tAdera abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI chilena| muminadera to AllAharai upara nirbhara karA ucita|

AllAha vadara (yuddha)-era kSetre emana avasthAYa tomAdera sAhAyya karechilena, yakhana tomarA sampUrNa sahAYa-samvalahIna chile| sutarAM tomarA antare (kevala) AllAhara bhaYakei jAYagA diYo, yAte tomarA kRtajJa hate pAra|
(vadarera yuddhakAle) yakhana tumi muminaderake valachile, tomAdera janya ki yatheSTa naYa ye, tomAdera pratipAlaka tina hAjAra phirizatA pAThiYe tomAdera sAhAyya karavena?

nizcaYai, varaM tomarA yadi savara o tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM tArA ei muhUrte akasmAt tomAdera kAche ese par3e, tave tomAdera pratipAlaka pA~ca hAjAra phirizatAke tomAdera sAhAyyArthe pAThiYe devena, yArA (tAdera vizeSa cihne) cihnita thAkave|

AllAha e vyavasthA kevala ejanyai karechilena, yAte tomarA susaMvAda lAbha kara evaM era dvArA tomAdera antare svasti lAbha haYa| anyathAYa vijaYa to (anya kArao pakSa theke naYa), kevala AllAhara pakSa theke lAbha haYa, yini paripUrNa kSamatArao mAlika evaM paripUrNa hikamaterao mAlika|

(evaM AllAha tAAlA vadarera yuddhe e sAhAyya karechilena ejanya), yAte ye sakala loka kuphara avalamvana kareche, tAdera ekAMzake khatama kare phelena athavA tAderake emana glAnimaYa parAjaYa dAna karena, yAte tArA vyartha manoratha haYe phire yAYa|
(he navI!) tomAra ei viSaYe siddhAnta neoYAra kona ekhatiYAra nei ye, AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karavena, nA tAderake zAsti devena, yehetu tArA jAlima|
AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA AllAharai| tini yAke icchA kSamA karena, Ara yAke cAna zAsti dena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa! tomarA kaYeka guNa vRddhi kare suda kheYo nA evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA saphalatA lAbha karate pAra|
evaM sei Agunake bhaYa kara, yA kAphiradera janya prastuta karA haYeche|
evaM AllAha o rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yAte tomAdera prati rahamatera AcaraNa karA haYa|

evaM nija pratipAlakera pakSa hate mAgaphirAta o sei jAnnAta lAbhera janya eke anyera sAthe pratiyogitAYa lipta hao, yAra prazastatA AkAzamaNDala o pRthivItulya| tA sei muttAkIdera janya prastuta karA haYeche
yArA sacchala o asacchala avasthAYa (AllAhara janya artha) vyaYa kare evaM yArA nijera krodha hajama karate o mAnuSake kSamA karate abhyasta| AllAha erUpa puNyavAnaderake bhAlovAsena|

evaM tArA sei sakala loka, yArA kakhanao kona azlIla kAja kare phelale vA (anya konaobhAve) nijedera prati juluma karale saGge saGge AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM tAra phalazrutite nijedera gunAhera janya kSamA prArthanA kare Ara AllAha chAr3A Ara keivA Ache, ye gunAha kSamA karate pAre? Ara tArA jenezune tAdera kRtakarme avicala thAke nA|

erAi sei loka, yAdera puraskAra hacche tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate mAgaphirAta evaM sei udyAnasamUha, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita, yAte tArA sthAYI jIvana lAbha karave| tA katai nA utkRSTa pratidAna, yA karma sampAdanakArIgaNa lAbha karave|
tomAdera pUrve vahu ghaTanA ghaTe geche| sutarAM tomarA pRthivIte paribhramaNa kare dekhe nAo, yArA (navIgaNake) asvIkAra karechila tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche!
esava mAnuSera janya suspaSTa ghoSaNA| Ara muttAkIdera janya hidAYAta o upadeza|
(he musalimagaNa!) tomarA hInavala haYo nA evaM cintita haYo nA| tomarA prakRta mumina hale tomarAi vijaYI have|

tomAdera yadi AghAta lege thAke, tave tAderao anurUpa AghAta (itaHpUrve) legechila| e to dina-parikramA, yA Ami mAnuSera madhye pAlAkrame vadalAte thAki| era uddezya chila muminaderake parIkSA karA evaM tomAdera madhye kichu lokake zahIda karA| Ara AllAha jAlimaderake bhAlovAsena nA|
evaM (uddezya chila ei-o ye,) AllAha muminaderake yAte parizuddha karate pArena o kAphiraderake sampUrNa nizcihna kare phelena|

nAki tomarA mane kara, tomarA (emanitei) jAnnAte peৗ~che yAve, athaca AllAha ekhanao paryanta tomAdera madhya hate sei sakala lokake yAcAi kare dekhenani, yArA jihAda karave evaM tAderakeo yAcAi kare dekhenani, yArA avicala thAkave|
tomarA nijerAi to mRtyura sammukhIna haoYAra Age (zAhAdAtera) mRtyu kAmanA karechile| sutarAM evAra tomarA tA cAkSuSa dekhe nile|

Ara muhAmmAda (sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYA sAllAma) ekajana rAsUla vai to nana! tA~ra pUrve vahu rAsUla gata haYeche| tA~ra yadi mRtyu haYe yAYa kiMvA tA~ke hatyA kare phelA haYa, tave ki tomarA ulTo dike phire yAve? ye-keu ulTo dike phire yAve, se kakhanai AllAhara kichumAtra kSati karate pArave nA| Ara yArA kRtajJa vAndA, AllAha tAderake puraskAra dAna karavena|

konao vyaktira ekhatiYAre naYa ye, AllAhara hukuma chAr3A tAra mRtyu Asave, nirdiSTa eka samaYe tAra Agamana likhita raYeche| ye vyakti duniYAra pratidAna cAive Ami tAke tAra aMza diYe deva| Ara ye vyakti AkhirAtera pratidAna cAive Ami tAke tAra aMza diYe deva| Ara yArA kRtajJa, Ami zIghrai tAderake (tAdera) puraskAra pradAna karava|

emana kata navI raYeche, yAdera saGge mile vahu AllAhaoYAlA yuddha kareche| era phale AllAhara pathe tAdera ye kaSTa-kleza bhoga karate haYeche, tAte tArA himmata hArAYani, durvala haYe par3eni evaM tArA nati svIkArao kareni| AllAha avicala lokaderake bhAlovAsena|

tAdera kathA e chAr3A Ara kichui chila nA ye, tArA valechila, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera gunAhasamUha evaM AmAdera dvArA AmAdera kAryAvalIte ye sImAlaMghana ghaTe geche tA kSamA kare dina| AmAderake dRr3hapada rAkhuna evaM kAphira sampradAYera viruddhe AmAderake vijaYa dAna karuna|
sutarAM AllAha tAderake duniYAra puraskArao dAna karalena evaM AkhirAtera utkRSTatara puraskArao| AllAha satkarmazIladerake bhAlovAsena|

he muminagaNa! yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tomarA yadi tAdera kathA mAna, tave tArA tomAderake tomAdera pechana dike (kupharera dike) phiriYe deve| phale tomarA ulTe giYe kaThinabhAve kSatigrasta have|
(tArA tomAdera kalyANakAmI naYa) varaM AllAhai tomAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tini zreSThatama sAhAyyakArI|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, Ami acirei tAdera antare bhIti saJcAra karava| kenanA tArA emana sava jinisake AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta kareche, yAdera samparke AllAha konao pramANa avatIrNa karenani| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| Ara tA jAlimadera nikRSTatama ThikAnA|

AllAha tomAdera sAthe nija pratizruti pUraNa karechilena, yakhana tA~rai hukume tomarA zatruderake hatyA karachile, ye paryanta nA tomarA durvalatA pradarzana karale evaM nirdeza samparke nijedera madhye matabheda karale evaM AllAha tomAderake tomAdera pachandera vastu dekhAnora para tomarA (nijedera AmIrera) kathA amAnya karale| tomAdera madhye kichu loka to emana, yArA duniYA kAmanA karachila, Ara kichu chila emana, yArA cAcchila AkhirAta| ataHpara AllAha tomAderake parIkSA karAra janya tAdera theke tomAderake phiriYe dilena, avazya tini tomAderake kSamA kare diYechena| AllAha muminadera prati ati anugrahazIla|

(sei samaYera kathA smaraNa kara) yakhana tomarA urdhvazvAse chuTachile evaM kArao dike ghure tAkAcchile nA, Ara rAsUla tomAdera pichana dika theke tomAderake DAkachila| phale AllAha (rAsUlake) vedanA (deoYA)-era vadale tomAderake (parAjaYera) vedanA dilena, yAte tomarA bhaviSyate vezi duHkha nA kara, nA sei jinisera kAraNe yA tomAdera hAtachAr3A haYeche evaM nA anya konao masivatera kAraNe yA tomAdera dekhA dite pAre| AllAha tomAdera kAryAvalI samparke sampUrNarUpe avagata|

ataHpara AllAha tomAdera prati duHkhera para prazAnti avatIrNa karalena tandrArUpe, yA tomAdera madhye kataka lokake Acchanna karechila| Ara ekaTi dala emana chila, yAdera cintA chila kevala nijedera jAna niYe| tArA AllAha samparke anyAYa dhAraNA karachila, sampUrNa jAhilI dhAraNA| tArA valachila, AmAdera konao ekhatiYAra Ache nAki? vale dAo, samasta ekhatiYAra kevala AllAharai| tArA tAdera antare emana sava kathA gopana rAkhe, yA tomAra kAche prakAza kare nA| tArA vale, AmAdera yadi kichu ekhatiYAra thAkata, tave AmarA ekhAne nihata hatAma nA| vale dAo, tomarA yadi nija-gRheo thAkate, tavuo katala haoYA yAdera niYatite lekhA Ache, tArA nijerAi vera haYe nija-nija vadhyabhUmite peৗ~che yeta| (esava haYechila) e kAraNe ye, tomAdera vakSadeze yA-kichu Ache AllAha tA parIkSA karate cAna evaM yA-kichu tomAdera antare Ache, tA parizodhana karate cAna| AllAha antarera bheda samparke samyaka jJAta|

ubhaYa vAhinIra pArasparika saMgharSera dina tomAdera madhya hate yArA pRSThapradarzana karechila, prakRtapakSe zaYatAna tAderake tAdera kichu kRtakarmera kAraNe padaskhalane lipta karechila| nizcaYai AllAha tAderake kSamA kare diYechena| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama sahiSNu|

he muminagaNa! sei sava lokera mata haYe yeYo nA, yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM tAdera bhAiYerA yakhana konao deze saphara kare kiMvA yuddhe aMzagrahaNa kare, takhana tAdera samparke tArA vale, tArA AmAdera saGge thAkale mArA yeta nA evaM nihatao hata nA| (tAdera e kathAra) pariNAma to (kevala) ei ye, erUpa kathAke AllAha tAdera antarera AkSepe pariNata karena| (nacet) jIvana o mRtyu to AllAhai dena| Ara tomarA ye karmai kara, AllAha tA dekhachena|
tomarA yadi AllAhara pathe nihata hao vA mArA yAo, tavuo AllAhara pakSa hate (prAptavya) mAgaphirAta o rahamata seisava vastu hate Dhera zreYa, yA tArA saJcaYa karache|
tomarA yadi mArA yAo vA nihata hao, tave tomAderake AllAharai kAche niYe ekatra karA have|

(he navI! esava ghaTanAra para) AllAhara rahamatai chila, yaddaruna tAdera prati tumi komala AcaraNa karecha| tumi yadi rUr3ha prakRtira o kaThora hRdaYa hate, tave tArA tomAra AzapAza theke sare vikSipta haYe yeta| sutarAM tAderake kSamA kara, tAdera janya mAgaphirAtera du‘A kara evaM (gurutvapUrNa) viSaYe tAdera sAthe parAmarza karate thAka| ataHpara tumi yakhana (kona viSaYe) manasthira karave, takhana AllAhara upara nirbhara karo| nizcaYai AllAha tAoYAkkulakArIderake bhAlovAsena|

AllAha tomAderake sAhAyya karale keu tomAderake parAsta karate pArave nA| Ara tini yadi tomAderake asahAYa cher3e dena, tave tini chAr3A ke Ache, ye tomAderake sAhAyya karave? muminadera ucita kevala AllAharai upara bharasA karA|

eTA konao navIra pakSe sambhava naYa ye, ganImatera sampade kheYAnata karave| ye-keu kheYAnata karave, se kiYAmatera dina sei mAla niYe uThave, yA se kheYAnatera mAdhyame hastagata karechila| ataHpara pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera puropuri pratidAna deoYA have evaM kArao prati juluma karA have nA|
tave ye vyakti AllAhara santuSTi anusaraNa kare, se ki oi vyaktira mata hate pAre ye, AllAhara asantuSTi niYe phireche Ara yAra ThikAnA hacche jAhAnnAma; yA ati nikRSTa ThikAnA?
AllAhara nikaTa tArA vibhinna staraviziSTa| tArA yA-kichu kare AllAha tA bhAlobhAvei dekhena|

prakRtapakSe AllAha muminadera prati (ati var3a) anugraha karechena, yakhana tini tAdera kAche tAderai madhya hate ekajana rAsUla pAThiYechena, ye tAdera sAmane AllAhara AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta kare, tAderake parizuddha kare evaM tAderake kitAva o hikamata zikSA deYa, Ara nizcaYa era Age tArA suspaSTa gomarAhIra madhye chila|

yakhana tomarA emana eka masivate AkrAnta hale, yAra dviguNa masivate tomarA (zatruderake) AkrAnta karecha, takhana ki tomarA vala ye, e masivata kothA hate ese gela? vala, eTA tomAdera nijedera thekei eseche| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|
ubhaYa vAhinIra pArasparika saMgharSera dina tomAdera ye vipada ghaTechila, tA AllAhara hukumei (ghaTechila), yAte tini muminaderakeo parakha kare dekhate pArena|

evaM dekhate pArena munAphikaderakeo| Ara tAderake (munAphikaderake) valA haYechila, eso, AllAhara pathe yuddha kara kiMvA pratirodha kara| takhana tArA valechila, ‘AmarA yadi dekhatAma (yuddhera mata) yuddha have, tave avazyai tomAdera anusaraNa karatAma|’ se dina (yakhana tArA ekathA valachila) tArA ImAna apekSA kupharerai vezi nikaTavartI chila| tArA tAdera mukhe emana kathA vale, yA tAdera antare nei| tArA yA-kichu lukAYa, AllAha tA bhAlo karei jAnena|

tArA sei loka, yArA nijedera (zahIda) bhAidera samparke vase vase mantavya kare ye, tArA yadi AmAdera kathA zunata, tave katala hata nA| vale dAo, tomarA satyavAdI hale khoda nijedera thekei mRtyuke haTiYe dAo to dekhi!
evaM (he navI!) yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYeche, tAderake kakhanaoi mRta mane karo nA; varaM tArA jIvita| tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera kAche riyaka deoYA haYa|

AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake yA-kichu diYechena, tArA tAte praphulla| Ara tAdera pare ekhanao yArA (zAhAdatera mAdhyame) tAdera saGge milita haYani, tAdera vyApAre e kAraNe tArA Ananda vodha kare ye, (tArA yakhana tAdera saGge ese milita have, takhana) tAdera konao bhaYa thAkave nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
tArA AllAhara ni‘Amata o anugrahera kAraNe Ananda udayApana kare evaM e kAraNeo ye, AllAha muminadera karmaphala naSTa karena nA|
yArA yakhama haoYAra parao AllAha o rAsUlera DAke sAr3A diYeche, erUpa satkarmazIla o muttAkIdera janya Ache mahA pratidAna|

yAderake loke valechila, (makkAra kAphira) lokerA tomAdera (sAthe yuddha karAra) janya (punarAYa) senA saMgraha kareche, sutarAM tAderake bhaYa kara| takhana eTA (ei saMvAda) tAdera ImAnera mAtrA Arao vAr3iYe deYa evaM tArA vale oThe, AmAdera janya AllAhai yatheSTa evaM tini uttama karmavidhAYaka|

pariNAme tArA AllAhara ni‘Amata o anugraha niYe ebhAve phire Asala ye, vindumAtra aniSTa tAdera sparza kareni evaM tArA AllAha yAte khuzI hana tAra anusaraNa kareche| vastuta AllAha mahA anugrahera mAlika|
prakRtapakSe se to zaYatAna, ye tAra vandhudera samparke bhaYa dekhAYa| sutarAM tomarA yadi mumina haYe thAka, tave tAderake bhaYa karo nA| varaM kevala AmAkei bhaYa kara|

evaM (he navI!) yArA kupharIte paraspara pratiyogitAra sAthe agrasara hacche, tArA yena tomAke duHkhe nA phele| nizcita jena, tArA AllAhara vindumAtra kSati karate pArave nA| AllAha cAna AkhirAte tAdera kona aMza nA rAkhate| tAdera janya mahA zAsti (prastuta) raYeche|
yArA ImAnera vadale kuphara kharida kareche, tArA kakhanaoi AllAhara vindumAtra kSati karate pArave nA| tAdera janya (prastuta) raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA yena kichutei mane nA kare, Ami tAderake ye avakAza diYechi tAdera pakSe tA bhAlo| prakRtapakSe Ami tAderake avakAza dei kevala e kAraNe, yAte tArA pApAcAre Arao agragAmI haYa evaM (parizeSe) tAdera janya Ache lAJchanAkara zAsti|

AllAha erUpa karate pArena nA ye, tomarA (ekhana) ye avasthAYa Acho muminaderake se avasthAYai rekhe devena, yatakSaNa nA tini pavitra hate apavitrake pRthaka kare dena evaM (apara dike) tini erUpao karate pArena nA ye, tomAderake (sarAsari) gAYavera viSaYa jAniYe devena| hA~, tini (yataTuku jAnAno darakAra mane karena, tAra janya) nija navIgaNera madhya hate yAke cAna veche nena| sutarAM tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati vizvAsa rAkha| yadi tomarA vizvAsa rAkha o tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave mahA pratidAnera upayukta have|

AllAha pradatta anugrahe (sampade) yArA kRpaNatA kare, tArA yena kichutei mane nA kare, eTA tAdera janya bhAlo kichu| varaM eTA tAdera pakSe ati manda| ye sampadera bhetara tArA kRpaNatA kare, kiYAmatera dina tAke tAdera galAYa ver3i vAniYe deoYA have| AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra mIrAcha kevala AllAharai janya| tomarA yA-kichui kara AllAha se samparke samyaka avagata|

AllAha tAdera kathA zunechena, yArA vale, AllAha garIva evaM AmarA dhanI| tArA yA vale Ami tA (tAdera AmalanAmAYa) likhe rAkhi evaM tArA navIgaNake anyAYabhAve ye hatyA kareche seTAo| ataHpara Ami valava, jvalanta Agunera svAda grahaNa kara|
esava tomAdera nija hAtera sei kRtakarmera phala, yA tomarA sammukhe preraNa karechile| naYata AllAha vAndAdera prati julumakArI nana|

(erA) sei loka, yArA vale, AllAha AmAdera pratizruti niYechena ye, AmarA konao navIra prati tatakSaNa paryanta ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA se AmAdera kAche emana kona kuravAnI upasthita karave, yAke Aguna grAsa karave| tumi vala, AmAra Ageo tomAdera nikaTa vahu navI suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe upasthita haYechila evaM sei jinisa niYeo, yAra kathA tomarA (AmAke) valacha| tA sattveo tomarA tAderake hatyA karale kena, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao?

(he navI!) tathApi yadi tArA tomAke pratyAkhyAna kare, tave (eTA natuna kona viSaYa naYa) tomAra Ageo emana vahu navIke pratyAkhyAna karA haYeche, yArA suspaSTa nidarzanAvalIo niYe esechila evaM likhita sahIphA o emana kitAvao, yA chila (satyake) AlokitakArI|

pratyeka prANIkei mRtyura svAda grahaNa karate have evaM tomAdera sakalake (tomAdera karmera) puropuri pratidAna kiYAmatera dinai deoYA have| ataHpara yAkei jAhAnnAma theke dUre sariYe deoYA have o jAnnAte praveza kariYe deoYA have, se-i prakRta arthe saphalakAma have| Ara (jAnnAtera viparIte) pArthiva jIvana to pratAraNAra upakaraNa chAr3A kichui naYa|

(he musalimagaNa!) avazyai tomAderake tomAdera artha-sampada o jIvanera vyApAre (Arao) parIkSA karA have evaM tomarA ‘Ahale kitAva’ o ‘muzarika’ ubhaYa sampradAYera pakSa hate aneka pIr3AdAYaka kathA zunave| tomarA yadi savara o tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave nizcaYai eTA ati var3a himmatera kAja (yA tomAderake avalamvana karatei have)|

Ara (sei samaYera kathA tAdera bhule yAoYA ucita naYa) yakhana AllAha ‘Ahale kitAva’ theke ei pratizruti niYechilena ye, tomarA e kitAvake avazyai mAnuSera sAmane suspaSTabhAve varNanA karave evaM eTA gopana karave nA| ataHpara tArA e pratizrutike tAdera pechana dike chur3e mAre evaM era vinimaYe tuccha mUlya arjana kare| katai nA manda sei jinisa, yA tArA kraYa karache|

tumi kichutei mane karo nA ye, yArA nijedera kRtakarmera upara var3a khuzI, Ara ye kAja kareni tAra janya prazaMsAra AzAvAdI, erUpa lokadera samparke kichutei mane karo nA ye, tArA zAsti hate AtmarakSAYa saphala have| tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti (prastuta) raYeche|
AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva kevala AllAharai| AllAha sarvaviSaYe paripUrNa kSamatA rAkhena|
nizcaYai AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sRjane o rAta-dinera pAlAkrame Agamane vahu nidarzana Ache ai sakala vuddhimAnadera janya

yArA dA~r3iYe, vase o zuYe (sarvAvasthAYa) AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sRSTi samparke cintA kare (evaM tA lakSya kare vale oThe) he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Apani esava uddezyahInabhAve sRSTi karenani| Apani (emana phajula kAja theke) pavitra| sutarAM Apani AmAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA karuna|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Apani yAkei jAhAnnAme dAkhila karavena, tAke nizcitabhAvei lAJchita karalena| Ara jAlimagaNa to konao sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA eka ghoSakake ImAnera dike DAka dite zunechi ye, ‘tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera prati ImAna Ana|’ sutarAM AmarA ImAna enechi| kAjei he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera gunAhasamUha kSamA kare dina, AmAdera mandasamUha AmAdera theke miTiYe dina evaM AmAderake puNyavAnadera madhye zAmila kare nijera kAche tule nina|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake sei savakichu dAna karuna, yAra pratizruti Apani nija rAsUlagaNera mAdhyame AmAderake diYechena| AmAderake kiYAmatera dina lAJchita karavena nA| nizcaYai Apani kakhanao pratizrutira viparIta karena nA|

sutarAM tAdera pratipAlaka tAdera du‘A kavula karalena evaM (valalena,) Ami tomAdera madhye kona AmalakArIra karmaphala naSTa karava nA, tA se puruSa hoka vA nArI| tomarA paraspare ekai rakama| sutarAM yArA hijarata kareche evaM tAderake nijedera ghara-vAr3i theke uccheda karA haYeche, AmAra pathe utpIr3ana karA haYeche evaM (dInera janya) tArA yuddha kareche o nihata haYeche, Ami avazyai tAdera sakalera theke tAdera doSa-truTi miTiYe deva evaM tAderake avazyai emana sava udyAne dAkhila karava, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| (esava kichu) AllAhara pakSa hate puraskArasvarUpa have| vastuta AllAharai kAche Ache utkRSTa puraskAra|
yArA kuphala avalamvana kareche, deze deze tAdera (sAcchandyapUrNa) vicaraNa yena tomAke kichutei dheA~kAYa nA phele|
(eTA) sAmAnya bhoga (yA tArA luTache), ataHpara tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma, Ara tA nikRSTatama vichAnA|

kintu yArA nijedera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare cale, tAdera janya Ache emana sava udyAna, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita| AllAhara pakSa hate AtitheYatAsvarUpa tArA sarvadA sekhAne thAkave| Ara AllAhara kAche yA-kichu Ache, puNyavAnadera janya tAi zreYa|

nizcaYai Ahale kitAvera madhyeo emana loka Ache, yArA AllAhara sammukhe vinaYa pradarzanapUrvaka AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhe evaM sei kitAvera pratio, yA tomAdera prati nAyila karA haYeche Ara sei kitAvera pratio yA tAdera prati nAyila karA haYechila| Ara AllAhara AYAtasamUhake tArA tuccha mUlyera vinimaYe vikri kare nA| erAi tArA, yAdera pratidAna raYeche tAdera pratipAlakera kAche| nizcaYai AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|
he muminagaNa! savara avalamvana kara, mukAvilAra samaYa avicalatA pradarzana kara evaM sImAnta rakSAYa sthita thAka| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kare cala, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

he loka sakala! nija pratipAlakake bhaYa kara, yini tomAderake sRSTi karechena eka vyakti hate evaM tArai theke tAra strIke sRSTi karechena| Ara tAdera ubhaYa theke vahu nara-nArI (pRthivIte) char3iYe diYechena evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAra achilA diYe tomarA eke anyera kAche (nijedera haka) ceYe thAka| evaM AtmIYadera (adhikAra kharva karA)ke bhaYa kara| nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera prati satarka dRSTi rAkhena|
iYAtImaderake tAdera sampada diYe dAo, Ara bhAlo mAlake manda mAla dvArA parivartana karo nA| Ara tAdera (iYAtImadera) sampadake nijedera sampadera sAthe miziYe kheYo nA| nizcaYai eTA mahApApa|

tomarA yadi AzaMkA vodha kara ye, iYAtImadera prati inasApha rakSA karate pArave nA, tave (tAderake vivAha nA kare) anya nArIdera madhye yAke tomAdera pachanda haYa vivAha kara dui-duijana, tina-tinajana athavA cAra-cArajanake| avazya yadi AzaMkA vodha kara ye, tomarA tAdera (strIdera) madhye suvicAra karate pArave nA, tave eka strIte athavA tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsIte (kSAnta thAka)| ete tomAdera pakSapAtitva nA karAra sambhAvanA vezi|
nArIderake khuzI mane tAdera mAhara AdAYa kara| tArA nijerA yadi svataHsphUrtabhAve tAra kichu aMza cher3e deYa, tave tA sAnande, svacchandabhAve bhoga karate pAra|

tomarA avujha (iYAtIma)dera kAche nijedera sei sampada arpaNa karo nA, yAke AllAha tomAdera janya jIvanera avalamvana vAniYechena| tave tAderake tA hate khAoYAo o parAo, Ara tAdera sAthe nyAYasaGgatabhAve kathA vala|

iYAtImaderake parIkSA karate thAka| yatakSaNa nA tArA vivAhera vaYase peৗ~chAYa, ataHpara yadi tAdera madhye vujha-samajha upalavdhi kara, tave tAdera sampada tAdera hAte arpaNa kara| Ara tA ei bheve apacaYera sAthe o tAr3Ahur3A kare kheYe phela nA ye, pAche tArA var3a haYe yAYa| Ara (iYAtImadera abhibhAvakadera madhye) ye nije sacchala, se to nijeke (iYAtImadera sampada khAoYA theke) sampUrNarUpe pavitra rAkhave, Ara ye abhAvagrasta se nyAYasaGgata panthAYa (tA) khete pArave| ataHpara tomarA tAdera sampada yakhana tAdera hAte arpaNa karave, takhana tAdera samparke sAkSI rAkhave| hisAva grahaNera janya AllAhai yatheSTa|

puruSadera janyao sei sampade aMza raYeche, yA pitA-mAtA o nikaTatama AtmIYavarga rekhe yAYa Ara nArIdera janyao sei sampade aMza raYeche, yA pitA-mAtA o nikaTatama AtmIYavarga rekhe yAYa, cAi se (parityakta) sampada kama hoka vA vezi| e aMza (AllAhara tarapha theke) nirdhArita|
Ara yakhana (mIrAcha) vaNTanera samaYa (oYAriza naYa emana) AtmIYa, iYAtIma o misakIna upasthita haYa, takhana tAderakeo tA theke kichu dAo evaM tAdera sAthe sadAlApa kara|

Ara seisava loka (iYAtImadera sampade asAdhutA karate) bhaYa karuka, yArA nijedera pechane asahAYa santAna rekhe gele tAdera vyApAre udvigna thAkata| sutarAM tArA yena AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM sarala-saThika kathA vale|
nizcaYai yArA iYAtImadera sampada anyAYabhAve bhoga kare, tArA nijedera peTe kevala Aguna bharati kare| tArA acirei eka jvalanta Agune praveza karave|

AllAha tomAdera santAna-santati samparke tomAderake nirdeza dicchena ye, puruSera aMza dui nArIra samAna| yadi (kevala) dui vA tatodhika nArIi thAke, tave mRta vyakti yA-kichu rekhe geche, tArA tAra dui-tRtIYAMza pAve| yadi kevala ekajana nArI thAke, tave se (parityakta sampattira) ardheka pAve| mRta vyaktira pitA-mAtAra madhya hate pratyekera prApya parityakta sampattira eka-SaSThAMza, yadi mRta vyaktira santAna thAke| Ara yadi tAra kona santAna nA thAke evaM tAra pitA-mAtAi tAra oYAriza haYa, tave tAra mAYera prApya eka-tRtIYAMza| avazya tAra yadi kaYeka bhAi thAke, tave tAra mAYera janya eka-SaSThAMza, (Ara e vaNTana karA have) mRta vyakti ye osiYata kare geche tA kAryakara karAra kiMvA (tAra yadi kona) denA (thAke, tA) parizodha karAra para| tomarA Asale jAna nA, tomAdera pitA o putrera madhye ke upakAra sAdhanera dika theke tomAdera nikaTatara| (esava) AllAha kartRka nirdhArita aMza| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAdera strIgaNa yA-kichu rekhe yAYa, tAra ardhAMza tomAdera yadi tAdera konao santAna (jIvita) nA thAke| yadi tAdera konao santAna thAke, tave tArA (ye) osiYata (kare yAYa tA) kAryakara karAra evaM ye denA rekhe yAYa tA parizodha karAra para, tomarA tAra rekhe yAoYA sampadera eka-caturthAMza pAve| Ara tomarA yA-kichu cher3e yAo, tAra eka-caturthAMza tArA (strIgaNa) pAve yadi tomAdera (jIvita) kona santAna nA thAke| yadi tomAdera santAna thAke, tave tomarA ye osiYata kare yAo tA kAryakara karAra evaM (tomAdera) denA parizodha karAra para tArA tomAdera rekhe yAoYA sampattira eka-aSTamAMza pAve| yAra mIrAcha vaNTana karA hacche, sei puruSa vA nArI yadi emana haYa ye, nA tAra pitA-mAtA jIvita Ache, nA santAna-santati Ara tAra eka bhAi vA eka vona jIvita thAke, tave tAdera pratyekera prApya eka-SaSThAMza| tArA yadi Arao vezi saMkhyaka thAke, tave tArA sakale eka-tRtIYAMzera madhye aMzIdAra have, (kintu tA) ye osiYata karA haYeche tA kAryakara karAra vA denA parizodha karAra para yadi (osiYata vA denAra svIkArokti dvArA) se kArao kSati nA kare thAke| (esava) AllAhara hukuma| AllAha sarvaviSaYe jJAta, sahanazIla|

esava AllAhara (sthirIkRta) sImA| ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave, tini tAke emana udyAnasamUhe dAkhila karavena, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita have| tArA sarvadA tAte thAkave| Ara eTA mahA sAphalya|

pakSAntare ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera avAdhyatA karave evaM tA~ra (sthirIkRta) sImA laMghana karave, tini tAke dAkhila karavena jAhAnnAme, yAte se sarvadA thAkave evaM tAra janya Ache lAJchanAkara zAsti|

tomAdera nArIdera madhye yArA azlIla kAja karave, tAdera samparke tomAdera madhya hate cArajana sAkSI rAkha| tArA yadi (tAdera azlIla kAja samparke) sAkSya deYa, tave tAderake gharera bhetara Avaddha rAkha, yAvata nA mRtyu tAdera tule niYe yAYa kiMvA AllAha tAdera janya kona patha sRSTi kare dena|

Ara tomAdera madhye ye dui puruSa azlIla karma karave, tAderakeo zAsti dAna kara| ataHpara tArA yadi tAovA kare o nijedera saMzodhana kare phele, tave tAderake kSamA kare dAo| nizcaYai AllAha atizaYa tAovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|

AllAha avazyai sei sava lokera tAovA kavula karena yArA ajJatAvazata konao gunAha kare phele, tArapara jaladi tAovA kare neYa| sutarAM AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe jJAta, prajJAmaYa|

tAovA kavula tAdera prApya naYa, yArA asatkarma karate thAke, parizeSe tAdera kArao yakhana mRtyukSaNa ese par3e, takhana vale, ekhana Ami tAovA karalAma| evaM tAdera janyao naYa, yArA kAphera avasthAYai mArA yAYa| erUpa lokadera janya to Ami yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

he muminagaNa! tomAdera janya eTA hAlAla naYa ye, tomarA jorapUrvaka nArIdera mAlika vane vasave| Ara tAderake ei uddezye avaruddha kare rekha nA ye, tomarA tAderake yA-kichu diYecha tAra kiYadaMza AtmasAt karave, avazya tArA yadi prakAzya azlIlatAYa lipta haYa, tave bhinna kathA| Ara tAdera sAthe sadbhAve jIvana yApana kara| tomarA yadi tAderake apachanda kara, tave era yatheSTa sambhAvanA raYeche ye, tomarA konao jinisake apachanda karacha athaca AllAha tAte prabhUta kalyANa nihita rekhechena|

Ara tomarA yadi eka strIra parivarte anya strIke vivAha karate cAo evaM tAdera ekajanake agAdha mAhara diYe thAka, tave tA theke kichui pherata niYo nA| tomarA ki apavAda diYe evaM prakAzya gunAhe lipta haYe tA (mAhara) pherata neve?
Ara ki karei vA tomarA tA pherata nite pAra, yakhana tomarA eke anyera var3a ghaniSTha haYe giYechile evaM tArA tomAdera theke kaThina pratizruti grahaNa karechila?
ye nArIderake tomAdera vApa-dAdA (kakhanao) vivAha kareche, tomarA tAderake vivAha karo nA| tave pUrve yA haYeche, haYeche| eTA atyanta azlIla o ghRNya karma evaM nikRSTa AcaraNa|

tomAdera prati hArAma karA haYeche tomAdera mA, tomAdera meYe, tomAdera vona, tomAdera phuphu, tomAdera khAlA, bhAtijI, bhAgni, tomAdera sei sakala mA, yArA tomAderake dudha pAna kariYeche, tomAdera dudha vona, tomAdera strIdera mA, tomAdera pratipAlanAdhIna tomAdera sat kanyA, yArA tomAdera emana strIdera garbhajAta, yAdera sAthe tomarA nibhRte milita haYecha| tomarA yadi tAdera sAthe nibhRta-milana nA kare thAka (evaM tAderake tAlAka diYe dAo vA tAdera mRtyu haYe yAYa), tave (tAdera kanyAderake vivAha karAte) tomAdera kona gunAha nei| tomAdera aurasajAta putradera strIgaNao (tomAdera janya hArAma) evaM eTAo (hArAma) ye, tomarA dui vonake ekatre vivAha karave| tave pUrve yA haYeche, haYeche| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

sei sakala nArIo (tomAdera janya hArAma), yArA anya svAmIdera vivAhAdhIna Ache| tave ye dAsIrA tomAdera mAlikAnAYa ese geche, (tArA vyatikrama)| eTA tomAdera prati AllAhara vidhAna| Ara e chAr3A anya nArIderake nijedera artha-sampada kharacera mAdhyame (arthAt mAhara diYe nijedera vivAhe AnAra) kAmanA karAke vaidha karA haYeche, ei zarte ye, tomarA (vivAha dvArA) cAritrika pavitratA rakSAra icchA karave, kevala kAma caritArthakArI have nA| sutarAM tomarA (vivAha sUtre) ye sakala nArI dvArA Ananda bhoga karecha, tAderake dhAryakRta mAhara pradAna kara| avazya (mAhara) dhArya karAra parao tomarA paraspare yei (kama-vezi karA) samparke sammata have, tAte tomAdera kona gunAha nei| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAdera madhye yArA svAdhIna musalima nArIdera vivAha karAra sAmarthya rAkhe nA, tArA tomAdera adhikArabhukta musalima dAsIderake vivAha karate pAre| AllAha tomAdera ImAna samparke sampUrNa oYAkiphahAla| tomarA sakale paraspara samatulya| sutarAM sei dAsIderake tAdera mAlikadera anumatikrame vivAha karave evaM tAderake nyAYAnugabhAve tAdera mAhara pradAna karave ei zarte ye, (vivAhera mAdhyame) tAdera cAritrika pavitratA rakSA karA have, tArA kevala kAma-caritArthakAriNI have nA evaM gupta praNaYI grahaNakAriNIo naYa| tArA yakhana vivAhera hephAjate ese gela, takhana yadi konao gurutara azlIlatAYa (vyabhicAre) lipta haYe par3e, tave tAdera zAsti have svAdhInA (avivAhitA) nArIra janya dhAryakRta zAstira ardheka| esava (arthAt dAsIderake vivAha karAra viSaYaTA) tomAdera madhya hate yArA (vivAha nA karale) gunAhe lipta haYe par3Ara AzaMkA vodha kare, tAdera janya| Ara tomarA yadi saMyamI haYe thAka, tave seTAi tomAdera pakSe zreYa| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

AllAha cAna tomAdera janya (vidhAnasamUha) spaSTa kare dite, tomAdera pUrvavartI (nekakAra) lokadera rIti-nItira upara tomAderake paricAlita karate evaM tomAdera tAovA kavula karate| AllAha sarvaviSaYe jJAta, prajJAmaYa|
AllAha to tomAdera tAovA kavula karate cAna, Ara yArA kupravRttira anugamana kare, tArA cAYa tomarA yena (saThika patha theke) vahu dUre sare yAo|
AllAha tomAdera bhAra lAghava karate cAna| mAnuSake durvalarUpe sRSTi karA haYeche|

he muminagaNa! tomarA paraspare eke anyera sampada anyAYabhAve grAsa karo nA, tave pArasparika santuSTikrame kona vyavasAYa karA hale (tA jAYeya)| evaM tomarA nijerA nijedera hatyA karo nA| nizcaYai, AllAha tomAdera prati parama daYAlu|
ye vyakti sImAlaMghana o julumera sAthe erUpa karave, Ami tAke Agune DhokAva, Ara AllAhara pakSe eTA ati sahaja|

tomAderake yei var3a var3a gunAha karate niSedha karA haYeche, tomarA yadi tA parihAra kare cala, tave Ami nijei tomAdera choTa choTa gunAha tomAdera theke miTiYe deva evaM tomAderake eka maryAdApUrNa sthAne dAkhila karava|

yA dvArA Ami tomAdera katakake katakera upara zreSThatva diYechi, tAra AkAGkSA karo nA| puruSa yA arjana kare tAte tAra aMza thAkave evaM nArI yA arjana kare tAte tAra aMza thAkave| AllAhara kAche tA~ra anugraha prArthanA kara| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe samyaka jJAta|

pitA-mAtA o nikaTatama AtmIYavarga ye sampada rekhe yAYa, tAra pratiTite Ami kichu oYAriza nirdhAraNa karechi| Ara yAdera sAthe tomarA cuktivaddha haYecha, tAderake tAdera aMza pradAna kara| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe sAkSI|

puruSa nArIdera abhibhAvaka, yehetu AllAha tAdera ekera upara anyake zreSThatva diYechena evaM yehetu puruSagaNa nijedera artha-sampada vyaYa kare| sutarAM sAdhvI strIgaNa anugata haYe thAke, (puruSera)anupasthitite AllAha pradatta hiphAjate (tAra adhikArasamUha) saMrakSaNa kare| Ara ye sakala strIra vyApAre tomarA avAdhyatAra AzaMkA kara, (prathame) tAderake vujhAo evaM (tAte kAja nA hale) tAderake zaYana zayyAYa ekA cher3e dAo evaM (tAteo saMzodhana nA hale) tAderake prahAra karate pAra| ataHpara tArA yadi tomAdera Anugatya kare, tave tAdera viruddhe konao (vyavasthA grahaNera) patha khu~jo nA| nizcaYai AllAha sakalera upara, sakalera var3a|

tomarA yadi svAmI-strIra madhye kalaha sRSTira AzaGkA kara, tave (tAdera madhye mImAMsA karAra janya) puruSera parivAra hate ekajana sAlisa o nArIra parivAra hate ekajana sAlisa pAThiYe deve| tArA du’jana yadi mImAMsA karate cAYa, tave AllAha ubhaYera madhye aikya sRSTi kare devena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe jJAta evaM sarvaviSaYe avahita|

evaM AllAhara ivAdata kara o tA~ra saGge kAuke zarIka karo nA| pitA-mAtAra prati sadvyavahAra kara| AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma, misakIna, nikaTa prativezI, dUra prativezI, saGge vasA (vA dA~r3Ano) vyakti, pathacArI evaM nijera dAsa-dAsIra pratio (sadvyavahAra kara)| nizcaYai AllAha kona darpita ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA|

yArA nijerA kRpaNatA kare evaM mAnuSakeo kRpaNatAra nirdeza deYa, Ara AllAha nija anugraha hate tAdera yA dAna karechena tA gopana kare| Ami (erUpa) akRtajJadera janya lAJchanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

evaM yArA nijedera artha-sampada kharaca kare mAnuSake dekhAnora janya, nA AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhe evaM nA AkhirAta divasera prati| vastuta zaYatAna kArao saGgI haYe gele saGgIrUpe se var3ai nikRSTa|
tAdera kI kSati hata, yadi tArA AllAha o parakAle ImAna Anata evaM AllAha tAderake ye riyaka diYechena tA theke kichu (satkAje) vyaYa karata? AllAha tAdera avasthA samparke samyaka avagata|
AllAha (kArao prati) aNu-parimANao juluma karena nA| Ara yadi kona satkarma haYa, tAke kaYeka guNa vRddhi karena evaM nijera pakSa hate mahA puraskAra dAna karena|

sutarAM (tArA bheve dekhuka) sei dina (tAdera avasthA) kemana have, yakhana Ami pratyeka ummata theke ekajana sAkSI upasthita karava evaM (he navI), Ami tomAke oisava lokera viruddhe sAkSIrUpe upasthita karava?

yArA kuphura avalamvana kareche evaM rAsUlera avAdhyatA kareche, se dina tArA AkAGkSA prakAza karave, yadi tAderake mATira (bhetara dhasiYe tAra) sAthe ekAkAra kare phelA hata! Ara tArA AllAha hate konao kathAi gopana karate pArave nA|

he muminagaNa! yakhana tomarA nezAgrasta thAka, takhana sAlAtera kAcheo yeYo nA, yAvat nA tomarA yA vala tA vujhate pAra| evaM junuvI (sahavAsajanita apavitratA) avasthAYao, yatakSaNa nA gosala kare nAo (sAlAta jAYeya naYa)| tave tomarA musAphira hale (evaM pAni nA pele, tAYAmmuma kare sAlAta AdAYa karate pAra)| tomarA yadi asustha hao vA saphare thAka vA tomAdera keu zaucasthAna hate Ase athavA tomarA nArIdera sparza kare thAka, ataHpara pAni nA pAo, tave pavitra mATi dvArA tAYAmmuma kare neve evaM nijedera cehArA o hAta (se mATi dvArA) mAseha karave| nizcaYai AllAha ati pApamocanakArI, kSamAzIla|
yAderake kitAvera ekaTA aMza (arthAt tAorAtera jJAna) deoYA haYechila, tumi ki dekhani, tArA kibhAve pathabhraSTatA kraYa karache? evaM tArA cAYa, tomarAo yena pathabhraSTa haYe yAo|
AllAha tomAdera zatruderake bhAlo karei jAnena| abhibhAvakarUpeo AllAhai yatheSTa evaM sAhAyyakArI hiseveo AllAhai yatheSTa|

iYAhudIdera madhye (kichu loka emana Ache), yArA (tAorAtera) zavdAvalIke tAra prakRta sthAna theke sariYe deYa evaM nijedera jihvA vA~kiYe o dInake nindA kare vale, ‘sAmi‘nA oYA AsAYanA’ evaM ‘isamA’ gAYarA musamA‘ina’ evaM ‘rA‘inA’, athaca tArA yadi valata ‘sAmi‘nA oYA AtA‘nA’ evaM ‘isamA’ oYAnajuranA’ tave seTAi tAdera pakSe uttama o saThika panthA hata| vastuta tAdera kupharera kAraNe AllAha tAdera prati lAnata karechena| sutarAM alpa saMkhyaka loka chAr3A tArA ImAna Anave nA|

he kitAvIgaNa! tomAdera kAche ye kitAva (pUrva theke) Ache tAra samarthakarUpe (evAra) Ami yA (kuraAna) avatIrNa karechi, tomarA tAte ImAna Ana, era Age ye, Ami kataka cehArAke miTiYe diYe seguloke pazcAddeza-svarUpa vAniYe deva athavA zanivAraoYAlAdera upara yemana lAnata karechilAma, tAdera upara temana lAnata karava| AllAhara Adeza sarvadA kAryakarI haYei thAke|

nizcaYai AllAha e viSaYake kSamA karena nA ye, tAra saGge kAuke zarIka karA have| era ceYe nicera ye-kona viSaYe yAke icchA kSamA karena| ye vyakti AllAhara saGge kAuke zarIka kare, se eka gurutara pApe lipta hala|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA nijerA nijedera zuddha vale prakAza kare, athaca AllAhai yAke cAna zuddhatA dAna karena evaM (e dAne) tAdera prati sAmAnya parimANao juluma karA haYa nA|
dekha, tArA AllAhara prati ki rakamera mithyA apavAda Aropa kare| prakAzya gunAhera janya eTAi yatheSTa|

yAderake kitAvera ekaTA aMza (arthAt tAorAtera kichu jJAna) deoYA haYechila, tumi ki dekhani tArA (kibhAve) pratimA o zaYatAnera samarthana karache evaM tArA kAphiradera (arthAt mUrtipUjakadera) samvandhe vale, muminadera apekSA tArAi vezi sarala pathe Ache?
erAi tArA, yAdera prati AllAha lAnata karechena| AllAha yAra prati lAnata karena, tumi tAra kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
tave ki (vizva-jagatera) sArvabhaumatve tAdera kona aMza Ache? yadi tAi hata, tave tArA mAnuSake khejura-vIcira AvaraNa parimANao kichu dita nA|

nAki tArA ei kAraNe mAnuSera prati IrSA kare ye, tini tAderake nija anugraha dAna karena (kena?)| Ami to ivarAhImera vaMzadharadigake kitAva o hikamata dAna karechilAma evaM tAderake virATa rAjatva diYechilAma|
sutarAM tAdera madhye kataka to tAra prati ImAna Ane evaM kataka tAra theke mukha phiriYe neYa| (oi kAphiradera sAjA deoYAra janya) jvalanta AgunarUpe jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche, Ami tAderake jAhAnnAme DhokAva| yakhanai tAdera cAmar3A jvale siddha haYe yAve, takhana Ami tAderake tAra parivarte anya cAmar3A diYe deva, yAte tArA zAstira svAda grahaNa karate pAre| nizcaYai AllAha mahAkSamatAvAna prajJAmaYa|

yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, Ami tAderake emana sava udyAne dAkhila karava, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| tAte tAdera janya putaHpavitra strI thAkave| Ara Ami tAderake dAkhila karava nivir3a chAYAYa|

(he musalimagaNa!) nizcaYai AllAha tomAderake Adeza karachena ye, tomarA AmAnatasamUha tAra hakadArake AdAYa kare deve evaM yakhana mAnuSera madhye vicAra karave, takhana inasAphera sAthe vicAra karave| AllAha tomAderake ye viSaYe upadeza dena, tA katai nA utkRSTa| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

he muminagaNa! tomarA Anugatya kara AllAhara, tA~ra rAsUlera evaM tomAdera madhye yArA ekhatiYAradhArI tAderao| ataHpara tomAdera madhye yadi konao viSaYe virodha dekhA deYa, tave tomarA AllAha o parakAle satyikArera vizvAsI haYe thAkale se viSaYake AllAha o rAsUlera upara nyasta kara| eTAi utkRSTatara evaM era pariNAmao sarvApekSA zubha|

(he navI!) tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA dAvI kare, tomAra prati ye kAlAma nAyila karA haYeche tArA tAteo ImAna eneche evaM tomAra pUrve yA nAyila karA haYechila tAteo, (kintu) tAdera avasthA ei ye, tArA tAgUtera kAche vicAraprArthI hate cAYa? athaca tAderake Adeza karA haYechila, yena (suspaSTabhAve) tAke asvIkAra kare| vastuta zaYatAna tAderake caramabhAve gomarAha karate cAYa|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, eso sei phAYasAlAra dike, yA AllAha nAyila karechena evaM eso rAsUlera dike, takhana munAphikaderake dekhave tomAra theke sampUrNarUpe mukha phiriYe neYa|

yakhana tAdera upara tAdera nijedera kRtakarmera kAraNe konao masivata ese par3e (takhana) tAdera kI avasthA dA~r3AYa? takhana tArA ApanAra kAche ese AllAhara nAme kasama karate thAke ye, AmAdera uddezya kalyANa sAdhana o mImAMsA kariYe deoYA chAr3A anya kichu chila nA|
tArA emana ye, AllAha tAdera manera yAvatIYa viSaYa jAnena| sutarAM tumi tAderake upekSA kara, tAderake upadeza dAo evaM tAdera nijedera samparke tAdera saGge hRdaYagrAhI kathA vala|

Ami pratyeka rAsUlake kevala e lakSyei pAThiYechi ye, AllAhara hukume tA~ra Anugatya karA have| tArA yakhana tAdera nijedera prati juluma karechila, takhana yadi tArA tomAra kAche ese AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karata evaM rAsUlao tAdera janya mAgaphirAtera du‘A karata, tave tArA AllAhake ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlui peta|

nA, (he navI!) tomAra pratipAlakera zapatha! tArA tatakSaNa paryanta mumina hate pArave nA, yatakSaNa nA nijedera pArasparika jhagar3A-vivAdera kSetre tomAke vicAraka mAnave, tArapara tumi ye rAYa dAo, se vyApAre nijedera antare konaorUpa kuNThAvodha nA karave evaM avanata mastake tA grahaNa kare neve|

Ami yadi tAdera upara pharaya kare ditAma ye, tomarA nijerA nijederake hatyA kara athavA nijedera ghara-vAr3i theke vera haYe yAo, tave tArA tA karata nA tAdera alpasaMkhyaka loka chAr3A| tAderake ye viSaYe upadeza deoYA hacche, tArA yadi tA pAlana karata, tave tAdera pakSe tA var3ai kalyANakara hata evaM tA (tAdera antare) avicalatA sRSTite atyanta sahAYaka hata|
evaM takhana avazyai Ami nijera pakSa hate tAderake mahA pratidAna dAna karatAma|
evaM avazyai tAderake sarala patha paryanta peৗ~che ditAma|

yArA AllAha o rAsUlera Anugatya karave, tArA sei sakala lokera saGge thAkave, yAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechena, arthAt navIgaNa, siddIkagaNa, zahIdagaNa o sAlihagaNera saGge| katai nA uttama saGgI tArA!
eTA kevalai AllAha pradatta zreSThatva| Ara (mAnuSera avasthAdi samparke) paripUrNa oYAkivahAla haoYAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa|
he muminagaNa! tomarA (zatrura sAthe lar3Ai kAle) nijedera AtmarakSAra upakaraNa saGge rAkha| ataHpara pRthaka pRthaka vAhinIrUpe (jihAdera janya) vera hao, kiMvA sakale ekai saGge vera hao|

nizcaYai tomAdera madhye emana lokao Ache, ye (jihAde vera hate) gar3imasi karave| tArapara (jihAda kAle) tomAdera konao masivata dekhA dile valave, AllAha AmAra upara var3a anugraha karechena ye, Ami tAdera sAthe upasthita chilAma nA|

Ara AllAhara pakSa hate tomarA konao anugraha (vijaYa o ganImatera mAla) lAbha karale se valave yena tomAdera o tAra madhye kakhanao konao samprIti chila nA ‘hAYa, yadi Amio tAdera saGge thAkatAma, tave Amio mahAsAphalya lAbha karatAma!

sutarAM yArA AkhirAtera vinimaYe duniYAra jIvanake vikri kare, tArA AllAhara pathe yuddha karuka| ye vyakti AllAhara pathe yuddha karave, ataHpara nihata have vA jaYayukta have, (sarvAvasthAYa) Ami tAke mahA puraskAra dAna karava|

(he musalimagaNa!) tomAdera janya era kI vaidhatA Ache ye, tomarA AllAhara pathe sei sakala asahAYa nara-nArI o zizudera janya lar3Ai karave nA, yArA du‘A karache, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake ei janapada theke yAra adhivAsIrA jAlima anyatra sariYe nAo evaM AmAdera janya tomAra pakSa hate ekajana abhibhAvaka vAniYe dAo evaM AmAdera janya tomAra pakSa hate ekajana sAhAyyakArI dA~r3a kariYe dAo?
