yArA ImAna eneche, tArA AllAhara pathe yuddha kare, Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArA yuddha kare tAgUtera pathe| sutarAM (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA zaYatAnera vandhudera saGge yuddha kara| (smaraNa rekha), zaYatAnera kauzala ati durvala|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, (makkI jIvane) yAderake valA hata, tomarA nijedera hAta saMyata rAkha, sAlAta kAYema kara o yAkAta dAo| ataHpara yakhana tAdera prati yuddha pharaya karA hala, takhana tAdera madhya hate ekaTi dala mAnuSake (zatruderake) emana bhaYa karate lAgala, yemana AllAhake bhaYa karA haYe thAke, kiMvA tAra ceYeo vezi bhaYa| tArA valate lAgala, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Apani AmAdera prati yuddha kena pharaya karalena? alpa kAlera janya AmAderake avakAza dilena nA kena? vale dAo, pArthiva bhoga sAmAnya| ye vyakti tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tAra janya AkhirAta utkRSTatara| tomAdera prati sutA parimANao juluma karA have nA|

tomarA yekhAnei thAka (eka dina nA eka dina) mRtyu tomAdera nAgAla pAvei, cAi tomarA surakSita kona durgei thAka nA kena| tAdera (arthAt munAphikadera) yadi kona kalyANa lAbha haYa, tave vale, eTA AllAhara pakSa hate| pakSAntare yadi tAdera manda kichu ghaTe, tave (he navI!) tArA (tomAke) vale, eTA ApanAra kAraNei ghaTeche| vale dAo, sava kichui AllAhara pakSa hate| oi sava lokera hala ki ye, tArA konao kathA vojhAra dhAre kAcheo yAYa nA?

tomAra yA-kichu kalyANa lAbha haYa, tA kevala AllAharai pakSa hate, Ara tomAra yA-kichu akalyANa ghaTe, tA tomAra nijerai kAraNe| evaM (he navI!) Ami tomAke mAnuSera kAche rAsUla kare pAThiYechi| Ara (e viSaYera) sAkSIrUpe AllAhai yatheSTa|

ye vyakti rAsUlera Anugatya kare se AllAharai Anugatya karala, Ara yArA (tA~ra Anugatya hate) mukha phiriYe neYa, Ami (he navI!) tomAke tAdera tattvAvadhAYaka vAniYe pAThAini (ye, tAdera kAjera dAYa-dAYitva tomAra upara vartAve)|

Ara tArA (munAphikagaNa sAmane to) vale, AmarA Anugatyera upara Achi, kintu tArA yakhana tomAra kAcha theke vAire cale yAYa, takhana tAdera ekaTA dala rAtera velA tomAra kathAra viparIte parAmarza kare| tArA rAtera velA ye parAmarza kare, AllAha tA sava likhe rAkhachena| sutarAM tumi tAdera kona paraoYA karo nA evaM AllAhara upara nirbhara kara| (tomAra) sAhAyyakArIrUpe AllAhai yatheSTa|
tArA ki kuraAna samvandhe cintA kare nA? eTA yadi AllAha chAr3A anya kArao pakSa hate hata tave era madhya vahu asaGgati peta|

tAdera kAche yakhana zAntira vA bhItira kona saMvAda Ase, tArA tA (yAcAi nA karei) pracAra zuru kare deYa| tArA yadi tA rAsUla vA tAdera madhye yArA kartRtvera adhikArI tAdera kAche niYe yeta, tave tAdera madhye yArA tAra (tathya) anusandhAnI, tArA tAra (yathArthatA) jene nita| evaM (he musalimagaNa!) tomAdera prati yadi AllAhara anugraha o tA~ra rahamata nA hata, tave tomarA avazyai zaYatAnera anusaraNa karate, alpasaMkhyaka chAr3A|

sutarAM (he navI!) tumi AllAhara pathe yuddha kara| tomAra upara tomAra nijera chAr3A anya kArao dAYabhAra nei| avazya muminaderake utsAha dite thAka| asambhava naYa ye, AllAha kAphiradera yuddha kSamatA rukhe devena| AllAhara zakti sarvApekSA pracaNDa evaM tA~ra zAsti ati kaThora|
ye vyakti kona bhAlo supAriza kare, tAra tAte aMza thAke, Ara ye vyakti kona manda supAriza kare, tArao tAte aMza thAke, AllAha sarvaviSaYe najara rAkhena|
yakhana keu tomAderake sAlAma kare, takhana tomarA (tAke) tadapekSAo uttamarUpe sAlAma diYo kiMvA (antatapakSe) sei zavdei tAra javAva diYo| nizcaYai AllAha savakichura hisAva rAkhena|
AllAhatini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tini kiYAmatera dina tomAderake avazyai ekatra karavena; ye dinera (AsAra) vyApAre konao sandeha nei| emana ke Ache, ye kathAYa AllAha apekSA vezi satyavAdI?

ataHpara tomAdera ki hala ye, munAphikadera vyApAre tomarA du’dala haYe gele? athaca tArA ye kAja kareche tAra daruNa AllAha tAderake ulTiYe diYechena| AllAha yAke (tAra icchA anuyAYI) gomarAhIte lipta karechena, tomarA ki tAke hidAYAtera upara Anate cAo? AllAha yAke gomarAhIte lipta karena, tAra janya tumi kakhanai kona (kalyANera) patha pAve nA|

tArA kAmanA kare, tArA nijerA yemana kuphara avalamvana kareche, temani tomarAo kAphira haYe yAo, yAte tomarA paraspara samAna haYe yAo| sutarAM (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA tAdera madhya hate kAuke tatakSaNa paryanta vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA, yatakSaNa paryanta tArA AllAhara pathe hijarata nA kare| yadi tArA (hijarata karAke) upekSA kare, tave tAderake pAkar3Ao kara evaM tAderake yekhAnei pAo hatyA kara, Ara tAdera kAukei nijera vandhurUpeo grahaNa karave nA evaM sAhAyyakArIrUpeo nA|

tave oi sakala loka (e nirdeza theke) vyatikrama, yArA emana konao sampradAYera sAthe giYe milita haYeche, yAdera o tomAdera madhye konao (zAnti) cukti Ache| athavA yArA tomAdera kAche emana avasthAYa Ase, yakhana tAdera mana kuNThita thAke tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karate evaM nija sampradAYera viruddheo yuddha karate| AllAha cAile tAderake tomAdera upara kSamatA dAna karatena, phale tArA tomAdera viruddhe avazyai yuddha karata| sutarAM tArA yadi tomAdera theke pAza kATiYe cale o tomAdera saGge yuddha nA kare evaM tomAdera kAche zAntira prastAva deYa, tave AllAha tAdera viruddhe tomAderake konaorUpa (vyavasthA grahaNera) adhikAra denani|

(munAphikadera madhye) apara kichu lokake pAve, yArA tomAdera thekeo nirApada thAkate cAYa evaM tAdera sampradAYa hateo nirApada thAkate cAYa| (kintu) yakhanai tAderake phitanAra dike phire yAoYAra janya DAkA haYa, amani tArA ulTe giYe tAte patita haYa| sutarAM esava loka yadi tomAdera (saGge yuddha karA) theke sare nA yAYa, zAnti prastAva nA deYa evaM nijedera hAta saMyata nA kare, tave tAderakeo pAkar3Ao kara evaM yekhAnei tAderake pAo hatyA kara| AllAha erUpa lokadera viruddhe tomAderake suspaSTa ekhatiYAra dAna karechena|

eTA konao musalimera kAja hate pAre nA ye, se (icchAkRta) konao musalimake hatyA karave| bhulavazata erUpa haYe gele seTA bhinna kathA| ye vyakti konao musalimake bhulavazata hatyA karave, (tAra upara pharaya) ekajana musalima golAmake AyAda karA evaM nihatera oYArizaderake diYAta (raktapaNa) AdAYa karA, avazya tArA kSamA kare dile bhinna kathA| nihata vyakti yadi tomAdera zatru sampradAYera loka haYa, kintu se nije musalima, tave (kevala ekajana musalima golAmake AyAda karA, pharaya diYAta vA raktapaNa dite have nA)| nihata vyakti yadi emana sampradAYera loka haYa (yArA musalima naYa vaTe, kintu) yAdera o tomAdera madhye kona cukti sampAdita raYeche, tave (sekSetreo) tAra oYArizaderake raktapaNa deoYA o ekajana musalima golAma AyAda karA (pharaya)| avazya kArao kAche (golAma) nA thAkale se anavarata du’mAsa royA rAkhave| eTA AllAhara pakSa hate deoYA tAovAra vyavasthA| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

ye vyakti konao musalimake jenezune hatyA karave, tAra zAsti jAhAnnAma, yAte se sarvadA thAkave evaM AllAha tAra prati gayava nAyila karavena o tAke lAnata karavena| Ara AllAha tAra janya mahAzAsti prastuta kare rekhechena|

he muminagaNa! tomarA yakhana AllAhara pathe saphara karave, takhana yAcAi-vAchAi kare dekhave| keu tomAderake sAlAma dile pArthiva jIvanera upakaraNa lAbhera AkAGkSAYa tAke valave nA ye, ‘tumi mumina nao’| kenanA AllAha nikaTa pracura ganImatera sampada raYeche| tomarAo to pUrve e rakamai chile| ataHpara AllAha tomAdera prati anugraha karalena| sutarAM yAcAi-vAchAi kare dekhave| nizcaYai tomarA yA-kichu kara, AllAha se samparke sampUrNarUpe avagata|

ye musalimagaNa konao oyara nA thAkA sattveo (yuddhe yogadAna nA kare varaM ghare) vase thAke, tArA o AllAhara pathe nijedera mAla o jAna dvArA jihAdakArIgaNa samAna naYa| yArA nijedera mAla o jAna dvArA jihAda kare AllAha tAderake, yArA vase thAke tAdera upara maryAdAYa zreSThatva diYechena| tave AllAha sakalakei kalyANera pratizruti diYechena| Ara yArA ghare vase thAke AllAha tAdera upara mujAhidaderake zreSThatva diYe mahA puraskAra dAna karechena|
arthAt vizeSabhAve nijera pakSa hate ucca maryAdA, mAgaphirAta o rahamata| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

nija sattAra upara julumarata thAkA avasthAYai phirizatAgaNa yAdera rUha kavjA karAra janya Ase, (tAderake lakSya kare) tArA vale, tomarA kI avasthAYa chile? tArA vale, yamIne AmAderake asahAYa kare rAkhA haYechila| phirizatAgaNa vale, AllAhara yamIna ki prazasta chila nA ye, tomarA tAte hijarata karate? sutarAM erUpa lokadera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma evaM tA ati manda pariNati|
tave sei sakala asahAYa nara, nArI o zizu (ei pariNati hate) vyatikrama, yArA (hijaratera) konao upAYa avalamvana karate pAre nA evaM (vera haoYAra) konao patha pAYa nA|
tAdera vyApAre pUrNa AzA raYeche ye, AllAha tAdera kSamA karavena| AllAha var3a pApamocanakArI, ati kSamAzIla|

ye vyakti AllAhara pathe hijarata karave, se yamIne vahu jAYagA o prazastatA pAve| Ara ye vyakti nija gRha theke AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera dike hijarata karAra janya vera haYa, ataHpara tAra mRtyu ese par3e, tArao saoYAva AllAhara kAche sthirIkRta raYeche| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA yakhana yamIne saphara kara evaM tomAdera AzaMkA haYa ye, kAphiragaNa tomAderake vipanna karave, takhana sAlAta kasara karale tAte tomAdera konao gunAha nei| nizcaYai kAphiragaNa tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

evaM (he navI!) tumi yakhana tAdera madhye upasthita thAka o tAdera nAmAya par3Ao, takhana (zatrura sAthe mukAvilAra samaYa tAra niYama ei ye,) musalimadera ekaTi dala tomAra sAthe dA~r3Ave evaM nijedera astra sAthe rAkhave| ataHpara tArA yakhana sijadA kare neve, takhana tArA tomAdera pichane cale yAve evaM anya dala, yArA ekhanao nAmAya par3eni, sAmane ese yAve evaM tArA tomAra sAthe nAmAya par3ave| tArAo nijedera AtmarakSAra upakaraNa o astra sAthe rAkhave| kAphiragaNa kAmanA kare, tomarA yena tomAdera astrazastra o AsavAvapatra samvandhe asatarka hao, yAte tArA atarkite tomAdera upara jhA~piYe par3ate pAre| yadi vRSTira kAraNe tomAdera kaSTa haYa athavA tomarA pIr3ita thAka, tave nijedera astra rekhe dileo tomAdera konao gunAha nei; kintu AtmarakSAra sAmagrI sAthe rAkhave| nizcaYai AllAha kAphiradera janya lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta rekhechena|

yakhana tomarA sAlAta AdAYa kare phelave, takhana AllAhake (sarvAvasthAYa) smaraNa karate thAkave dA~r3iYe, vase evaM zooYA avasthAYao| ataHpara yakhana (zatrura dika theke) nirApattA vodha karave, takhana sAlAta yathArIti AdAYa karave| nizcaYai sAlAta musalimadera eka avazya pAlanIYa kAja nirdhArita samaYe|

tomarA oi sava lokera (arthAt kAphira duzamanadera) anusandhAne durvalatA dekhiYo nA| tomAdera yadi kaSTa haYe thAke, tave tAderao to tomAderai mata kaSTa haYa| Ara tomarA AllAhara kAche emana jinisera AzA kara, yAra AzA tArA kare nA| AllAha sarvajJa prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYai Ami tomAra prati satya-samvalita kitAva nAyila karechi, yAte AllAha tomAke ye upalavdhi diYechena, se anuyAYI mAnuSera madhye mImAMsA karate pAra| Ara tumi kheYAnatakArIdera pakSAvalamvanakArI haYo nA|
evaM AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA kara| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
evaM yArA nijedera saGgei kheYAnata kare tumi tAdera pakSe vAka-vitaNDA karo nA| AllAha konao kheYAnatakArI pApiSThake pachanda karena nA|

tArA mAnuSera sAthe to lajjA kare, kintu AllAhara sAthe lajjA kare nA, athaca tArA rAtera velA yakhana AllAhara apachandanIYa kathA vale takhanao tini tAdera saGge thAkena| tArA yA-kichu karache tA savai AllAhara AYatte|

tomAdera kSamatA to etaTukui ye, pArthiva jIvane tAdera (arthAt kheYAnatakArIdera) anukUle (mAnuSera sAthe) vAka-vitaNDA karale| kintu kiYAmatera dina AllAhara saGge ke tAdera anukUle vAka-vitaNDA karave vA ke tAdera ukila have?
ye vyakti konao manda kAja kare phele vA nijera prati juluma kare vase, tArapara AllAhara kAche kSamA cAYa, se avazyai AllAhake ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlui pAve|
ye vyakti konao gunAha kAmAYa, se to tA kAmAYa tAra nijerai kSati sAdhane| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
ye vyakti konao doSa vA pApakarme lipta haYa, tArapara konao nirdeASa vyaktira upara tA cApAYa, se nijera upara gurutara apavAda o prakAzya gunAhera bhAra cApiYe deYa|

evaM (he navI!) tomAra prati AllAhara anugraha o rahamata nA thAkale tAdera ekaTi dala to tomAke sarala patha hate vicyuta karAra icchA karei phelata| (prakRtapakSe) tArA nijedera chAr3A anya kAuke pathabhraSTa karache nA| tArA tomAra kichumAtra kSati karate pArave nA| AllAha tomAra prati kitAva o hikamata nAyila karechena evaM tomAke emana sava viSaYe jJAna diYechena, yA tumi jAnate nA| vastuta tomAra prati sarvadAi AllAhara mahA anugraha raYeche|

mAnuSera vahu gopana kathAYa konao kalyANa nei| tave konao vyakti dAna-sadakA vA konao satkAjera kiMvA mAnuSera madhye mImAMsAra Adeza karale, seTA bhinna kathA| ye vyakti AllAhara santoSa lAbhera uddezye erUpa karave, Ami tAke mahA pratidAna deva|

Ara ye vyakti tAra sAmane hidAYAta spaSTa haYe yAoYAra parao rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa karave o muminadera patha chAr3A anya konao patha anusaraNa karave, Ami tAke sei pathei cher3e deva, yA se avalamvana kareche| Ara tAke jAhAnnAme nikSepa karava, yA ati manda ThikAnA|

nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra saGge zarIka karAke kSamA karena nA| era nicera ye-konao gunAha yAra kSetre cAna kSamA kare dena| ye vyakti AllAhara saGge (kAuke) zarIka kare, se (saThika patha theke) vahu dUre sare yAYa|
tArA AllAhake cher3e anya yAdera kAche prArthanA jAnAYa, tArA kevala katipaYa nArI| Ara tArA yAke DAke se to avAdhya zaYatAna chAr3A keu naYa
yAra prati AllAha lAnata karechena| Ara se (AllAhake) valechila, Ami tomAra vAndAdera madhya hate nirdhArita eka aMzake niYe neva|

evaM Ami tAderake sarala patha hate nizcitabhAve vicyuta karava, tAderake (aneka) AzA-bharasA deva evaM tAderake Adeza karava, phale tArA catuSpada jantura kAna cire phelave evaM tAderake Adeza karava, phale tArA AllAhara sRSTike vikRta karave| ye vyakti AllAhara parivarte zaYatAnake vandhu vAnAYa, se suspaSTa lokasAnera madhye par3e yAYa|
se to tAderake pratizruti deYa evaM tAderake AzA-AkAGkSAYa lipta kare| (prakRtapakSe) zaYatAna tAderake ye pratizrutii deYa, tA dheA~kA chAr3A kichui naYa|
tAdera sakalera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| tArA tA theke vA~cAra janya pAlAnora konao patha pAve nA|

yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, Ami tAderake emana sava vAgAne dAkhila karava, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave| eTA AllAhara oYAdA, yA satya| evaM kathAYa AllAha apekSA vezi satyavAdI ke hate pAre?

(jAnnAte yAoYAra janya) nA tomAdera AkAGkSAsamUha yatheSTa evaM nA kitAvIdera AkAGkSAsamUha| ye-keu manda kAja karave, tAke tAra pratiphala deoYA have evaM se nijera janya AllAha chAr3A konao vandhu o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
Ara ye vyakti satkAja karave, se puruSa hoka vA nArI, yadi se mumina haYe thAke, tave erUpa loka jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera prati sAmAnya parimANao juluma karA have nA|

tAra ceYe uttama dIna Ara kAra hate pAre, ye (tAra goTA astitvasaha) nija cehArAke AllAhara sammukhe avanata kareche, sei saGge se satkarme abhyasta evaM ekaniSTha ivarAhImera dIna anusaraNa kareche| Ara (eTA to jAnA kathA ye,) AllAha ivarAhImake nijera viziSTa vandhu vAniYe niYechilena|
AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache tA AllAharai evaM AllAha yAvatIYa jinisake (nija kSamatA dvArA) pariveSTana kare rekhechena|

evaM (he navI!) loke tomAra kAche nArIdera samparke zarIYatera vidhAna jijJesa kare| vale dAo, AllAha tAdera samparke tomAderake vidhAna jAnAcchena evaM ei kitAva (arthAt kuraAna)-era ye sava AYAta tomAderake par3e zonAno hacche, tAo (tomaderake zarIYatera vidhAna jAnAYa) sei iYAtIma nArIdera samparke, yAderake tomarA tAdera nirdhArita adhikAra pradAna kara nA, athaca tomarA tAderake vivAhao karate cAo evaM asahAYa zizudera samparkeo (vidhAna jAnAYa) evaM (tomAderake jora nirdeza deYa) yena iYAtImadera vyApAre inasApha pratiSThA kara| tomarA yA-kichu satkAja karave, AllAha se samparke sampUrNa jJAta|

konao nArI yadi tAra svAmIra pakSa hate durvyavahAra vA upekSAra AzaGkA kare, tave tAdera janya ete kona asuvidhA nei ye, tArA pArasparika sammatikrame konao rakamera Aposa-niSpatti karave| Ara Aposa-niSpattii uttama| mAnuSera antare (kichu nA kichu) lAlasAra pravaNatA to nihita rAkhAi haYeche| tomarA yadi ihasAna o tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave tomarA yA-kichui karave, AllAha se samparke sampUrNa avagata Achena|

tomarA cAileo strIdera madhye samAna AcaraNa karate sakSama have nA| tave (konao ekajanera prati) sampUrNarUpe jhu~ke par3o nA, yAra phale anyajanake mAjhakhAne jhulanta vastura mata phele rAkhave| tomarA yadi saMzodhana kara o tAkaoYA avalamvana kare cala, tave (jene rekha), AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara yadi ubhaYe vicchinna haYe yAYa, tave AllAha nijera (kudarata o rahamatera) prAcurya dvArA tAdera pratyekake (aparera praYojana theke) veniYAya kare devena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, prabhUta hikamatera adhikArI|

AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA AllAharai| Ami tomAdera Age kitAvIderake evaM tomAderakeo jora nirdeza diYechi ye, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| tomarA yadi kuphara avalamvana kara, tave (tAte AllAhara kI kSati?) kenanA) AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache tA AllAharai| AllAha (sakalera theke) veniYAya evaM tini prazaMsArha|
AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache tA AllAharai Ara karma nirvAhera janya AllAhai yatheSTa|
he mAnuSa! tini cAile tomAdera sakalake (pRthivI hate) niYe yete pArena evaM anyaderake (tomAdera sthAne) niYe Asate pArena| AllAha e viSaYe pUrNa sakSama|
ye vyakti (kevala) duniYAra pratidAna cAYa (tAra smaraNa rAkhA ucita), AllAhara kAche duniYA o AkhirAta ubhaYera pratidAna raYeche| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

he muminagaNa! tomarA inasApha pratiSThAkArI haYe yAo AllAhara janya sAkSyadAtArUpe, yadio tA tomAdera nijedera viruddhe kiMvA pitA-mAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera viruddhe haYa| se vyakti (yAra viruddhe sAkSya deoYAra Adeza karA hacche) yadi dhanI vA garIva haYa, tave AllAha ubhaYa prakAra lokera vyApAre (tomAdera ceYe) vezi kalyANakAmI| sutarAM tomarA inasApha karAra vyApAre icchA-abhirucira anusaraNa karo nA| tomarA yadi pe~cAo (arthAt mithyA sAkSya dAo) athavA (saThika sAkSya deoYA theke) pAza kATiYe yAo, tave (jene rekha) AllAha tomAdera yAvatIYa kAja samparke sampUrNa avagata|

he muminagaNa! ImAna rAkha AllAhara prati, tA~ra rAsUlera prati, ye kitAva tA~ra rAsUlera upara nAyila karechena tAra prati evaM ye kitAva tAra Age nAyila karechena tAra prati| ye vyakti AllAhake, tA~ra phirizatAgaNake, tA~ra kitAvasamUhake, tA~ra rAsUlagaNake evaM parakAlake asvIkAra kare, se vahu dUrera bhraSTatAYa pathabhraSTa haYe yAYa|

yArA ImAna eneche, tArapara kAphira haYe geche, tArapara ImAna eneche, tArapara AvAra kAphira haYe geche, tArapara kuphare agragAmI hate thekeche, AllAha tAderake kSamA karAra nana evaM tAderake saThika pathe AnaYana karArao nana|
munAphikaderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya prastuta raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti,
yArA muminadera parivarte kAphiraderake vandhu rUpe grahaNa kare| tArA ki tAdera kAche zakti kheA~je? samasta zakti to AllAharai kAche|

tini kitAve tomAdera prati ei nirdeza nAyila karechena ye, yakhana tomarA zunave AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karA hacche o tAke vidrUpa karA hacche, takhana tomarA tAdera sAthe vasave nA, ye paryanta nA tArA anya konao prasaGge lipta have| anyathAYa tomarAo tAdera mata haYe yAve| nizcaYai AllAha samasta munAphika o kAphirake jAhAnnAme ekatra karavena|

(he musalimagaNa! erA) sei sava loka, yArA tomAdera (azubha pariNAmera) apekSAYa thAke| sutarAM AllAhara pakSa theke tomAdera vijaYa arjita hale, tArA (tomAderake) vale, AmarA ki tomAdera sAthe chilAma nA| Ara yadi kAphiradera (vijaYa) nasIva haYa, tave (tAderake) vale, AmarA ki tomAderake vAge peYechilAma nA evaM (tA sattveo) AmarA ki musalimadera hAta theke tomAderake rakSA karini? sutarAM AllAhai kiYAmatera dina tomAdera o tAdera madhye phAYasAlA karavena evaM AllAha muminadera viruddhe kAphiradera (cUr3Anta vijaYera) konao patha rAkhavena nA|

e munAphikarA AllAhara sAthe dheA~kAvAjI kare, athaca AllAhai tAderake dheA~kAYa phele rekhechena| tArA yakhana sAlAte dA~r3AYa, takhana alasatAra sAthe dA~r3AYa| tArA mAnuSake dekhAYa Ara AllAhake alpai smaraNa kare|

tArA (ImAna o kupharera) mAjhakhAne dodulyamAna, nA (sampUrNarUpe) edera (musalimadera) dike, nA tAdera (kAphiradera) dike| vastuta AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra janya tumi kakhanai (hidAYAtera) konao patha pAve nA|
he muminagaNa! musalimadera cher3e kAphiraderake vandhu vAniYo nA| tomarA ki AllAhara kAche nijedera viruddhe (arthAt nijedera zAstiyogya haoYA samparke) suspaSTa pramANa dA~r3a karAte cAo?
nizcaYai munAphikarA jAhAnnAmera sarvanimna stare thAkave evaM tumi tAdera pakSe konao sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

tave yArA tAovA karave, nijederake saMzodhana kare phelave, AllAhara AzraYake zaktabhAve dhare rAkhave evaM nijedera dInake AllAhara janya khAlesa kare neve, tArA muminadera saGge zAmila haYe yAve| AllAha avazyai muminaderake mahA pratidAna dAna karavena|
tomarA yadi kRtajJa haYe yAo evaM (satyikArabhAve) ImAna Ana, tave AllAha tomAderake zAsti diYe kI karavena? AllAha guNagrAhI, sarvajJa|
prakAzye (kArao) doSa carcAke AllAha pachanda karena nA, tave kArao prati juluma haYe thAkale AlAdA kathA| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
tomarA yadi konao satkAja prakAzye kara vA gopane kara kiMvA konao manda AcaraNa kSamA kara, tave (tA uttama| kenanA) AllAha ati kSamAzIla, (yadio tini zAstidAne) sarvazaktimAna|

yArA AllAha o tAra rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye pArthakya karate cAYa o vale, AmarA kataka (rAsUla)-era prati to ImAna rAkhi evaM katakake asvIkAra kari, Ara (ebhAve) tArA (kuphara o ImAnera mAjhakhAne) mAjhAmAjhi ekaTi patha avalamvana karate cAYa
erUpa lokai satyikArera kAphira| Ara Ami kAphiradera janya lAJchanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUladera prati ImAna Anave evaM tAdera kArao madhye konao pArthakya karave nA, AllAha tAderake tAdera karmaphala dAna karavena| AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(he navI!) kitAvIgaNa tomAra kAche dAvI kare, tumi yena tAdera prati AsamAna theke kona kitAva avatIrNa kariYe dAo| (eTA konao natuna kathA naYa| kenanA) tArA to mUsAra kAche era ceYeo var3a dAvI jAniYechila| tArA (tAke) valechila, ‘AmAderake prakAzye AllAha dekhAo’| sutarAM tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe tAdera upara vajra AghAta henechila| ataHpara tAdera kAche ye suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha esechila, tAraparao tArA vAchurake (mAvuda) vAniYe niYechila| tathApi Ami tAderake kSamA kare dei| Ara mUsAke Ami dAna kari spaSTa kSamatA|

Ami tUra pAhAr3ake tAdera upara tule dhare tAdera theke pratizruti niYechilAma evaM Ami tAderake valechilAma, tomarA (nagarera) darajA diYe natazire praveza kara evaM tAderake valechilAma, tomarA zanivAre sImAlaMghana karo nA| Ara Ami tAdera theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra niYechilAma|

ataHpara (tAderake lAnata karechilAma) tAdera kartRka pratizruti bhaGga, AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra, navIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA evaM AmAdera antarera upara pardA lAgAno raYeche tAdera ei uktira kAraNe| athaca vAstavatA hala, tAdera kupharera kAraNe AllAha tAdera antare mohara kare diYechena| e janyai tArA alpa kichu viSaYa chAr3A (adhikAMza viSaYei) ImAna Ane nA|
evaM tAdera kupharI evaM mAraYAmera prati gurutara apavAda Aropa karAra kAraNe|

evaM tAdera ei uktira kAraNe ye, AmarA AllAhara rAsUla IsA ivane mAraYAmake hatyA karechi| athaca tArA tAke hatyA kareni evaM zUleo car3Ate pAreni; varaM tAdera vibhrama haYechila| prakRtapakSe yArA e samparke matabheda kareche, tArA e viSaYe saMzaYe nipatita (evaM) e viSaYe anumAnera anusaraNa chAr3A tAdera prakRta konao jJAna chila nA| satya kathA hacche tArA IsA (AlAihisa sAlAma)ke hatyA kareni|
varaM AllAha tAke nijera kAche tule niYechena| vastuta AllAha mahA kSamatAra adhikArI, ati prajJAvAna|
kitAvIdera madhye emana keu nei, ye nija mRtyura Age IsAra prati ImAna Anave nA| Ara kiYAmatera dina se tAdera viruddhe sAkSI have|

moTakathA, iYAhudIdera gurutara sImAlaMghanera kAraNe Ami tAdera prati emana kichu utkRSTa vastu hArAma kare dei, yA (pUrve) tAdera pakSe hAlAla karA haYechila evaM AllAhara pathe tAdera atyadhika vAdhAdAnera kAraNe|

evaM tAdera sudakhorira kAraNe, athaca tAderake tA khete niSedha karA haYechila evaM tAdera kartRka mAnuSera sampada anyAYabhAve grAsa karAra kAraNe| tAdera madhye yArA kAphira, Ami tAdera janya yantraNAmaYa zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

avazya tAdera (arthAt vanI isarAIlera) madhye yArA jJAne paripakka o mumina, tArA tomAra prati yA nAyila karA haYeche tAte ImAna rAkhe evaM tomAra pUrve yA nAyila karA haYechila tAteo| (sei sakala loka prazaMsAyogya), yArA sAlAta kAYemakArI, yAkAtadAtA evaM AllAha o AkhirAta divase vizvAsI| erAi tArA, yAderake Ami mahA pratidAna deva|

(he navI!) Ami tomAra prati ohI nAyila karechi, yebhAve nAyila karechi nUha o tAra paravartI navIgaNera prati evaM Ami ohI nAyila karechilAma ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva, (tAdera) vaMzadharagaNa, IsA, AiYuva, iunusa, hAruna o sulAimAnera prati| Ara dAUdake dAna karechilAma yAvUra|
Ara vahu rAsUla to emana, pUrve yAdera ghaTanAvalI Ami tomAke zuniYechi evaM vahu rAsUla raYeche, yAdera ghaTanAvalI tomAke zunAini| Ara musAra saGge to AllAha sarAsari kathA valachena|

e sakala rAsUla emana, yAderake (saoYAvera) susaMvAdadAtA o (jAhAnnAma samparke) satarkakArIrUpe pAThAno haYechila, yAte rAsUlagaNera (Agamanera) para AllAhara sAmane mAnuSera kona ajuhAta vAki nA thAke| Ara AllAha mahA kSamatAvAna, prajJAmaYa|

(kAphiragaNa svIkAra karuka vA nAi karuka), kintu AllAha tomAra prati yA nAyila karechena, se samparke tini svaYaM sAkSya dena ye, tini tA jenezune nAyila karechena evaM phirizatAgaNao sAkSya deYa| Ara (emanite to) AllAhara sAkSyai yatheSTa|
nizcaYai, yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM (mAnuSake) AllAhara pathe vAdhA diYeche, tArA (rAstA hAriYe) vibhrAntite vahu dUra cale geche|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM (anyaderake AllAhara pathe vAdhA diYe tAdera upara) juluma kareche, AllAha tAderake kSamA karAra nana evaM tAdera konao patha pradarzana karArao nana,
jAhAnnAmera patha chAr3A, yAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| Ara AllAhara pakSe eTA mAmuli vyApAra|

he mAnuSa! ei rAsUla tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera kAche satya niYe eseche| sutarAM tomarA (tAra prati) ImAna Ana| erai madhye tomAdera kalyANa| Ara (eraparao) yadi tomarA kupharera patha avalamvana kara, tave (jene rekha), AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache tA AllAharai evaM AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

he kitAvIgaNa! nijedera dIne sImAlaMghana karo nA evaM AllAha samparke satya chAr3A anya kathA valo nA| mAraYAmera putra IsA mAsIha to AllAhara rAsUla mAtra evaM AllAhara eka kAlimA, yA tini mAraYAmera kAche pAThiYechilena| Ara chilena eka rUha, yA tA~rai pakSa hate (sRSTi haYe) chila| sutarAM tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna Ana evaM valo nA (AllAha) ‘tina’| era theke nivRtta hao| erai madhye tomAdera kalyANa| AllAha to ekai mAvuda| tA~ra konao putra thAkave era theke tini sampUrNa pavitra| AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA tA~rai| (sakalera) tattvAvadhAnera janya AllAhai yatheSTa|

mAsIha kakhanao AllAhara vAndA haoYAke lajjAra viSaYa mane kare nA evaM nikaTatama phirizatAgaNao (ete lajjAvodha kare) nA| ye-keu AllAhara ivAdata-vandegIte lajjAvodha karave o ahamikA pradarzana karave (se bhAlo kare jene rAkhuka), AllAha tAdera sakalake tA~ra nikaTa ekatra karavena|

ataHpara yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAderake tAdera paripUrNa pratidAna devena evaM nija anugrahe (tAra thekeo) vezi devena| Ara yArA (ivAdata-vandegIte) lajjAvodha kareche o ahamikA pradarzana kareche tAderake yantraNAmaYa zAsti devena| Ara tArA nijedera janya AllAha chAr3A konao abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
he mAnuSa! tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate suspaSTa pramANa ese geche evaM Ami tomAdera kAche emana eka Alo pAThiYe diYechi, (yA pathake) sampUrNarUpe pariSkAra kare tole|

sutarAM yArA AllAhara prati ImAna eneche evaM tA~rai AzraYa A~kar3e dhareche, AllAha tAderake nija anugraha o rahamatera bhetara dAkhila karavena evaM nijera kAche peৗ~chAnora janya tAderake sarala pathe AnaYana karavena|

(he navI!) loke tomAra kAche (‘kAlAlA’ra) vidhAna jijJesa kare| vale dAo, AllAha tomAderake kAlAlA’ra vidhAna jAnAcchena keu yadi niHsantAna avasthAYa mArA yAYa Ara tAra eka vona thAke, tave se (vona) tAra parityakta sampattira ardhekera hakadAra have| Ara sei vonera yadi santAna-santati nA thAke, (Ara se mArA yAYa evaM bhAi jIvita thAke), tave se tAra (vonera) oYAriza have| vona yadi du’jana thAke, tave bhAiYera parityakta sampatti theke tArA dui-tRtIYAMzera hakadAra have| Ara yadi (mRta vyaktira) bhAi o vona ubhaYai thAke, tave eka bhAi pAve du’vonera aMzera samAna| AllAha tomAdera kAche spaSTarUpe varNanA karachena, yAte tomarA pathabhraSTa nA hao evaM AllAha sarva viSaYe paripUrNa jJAta|

he muminagaNa! tomarA aGgIkAra pUraNa karo| tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche catuSpada gavAdi pazu (o tadasadRza jantu), seiguli chAr3A yA tomAderake par3e zonAno have, tave tomarA yakhana iharAma avasthAYa thAkave, takhana zikAra karAke vaidha mane karo nA| AllAha yA icchA karena Adeza dAna karena|

he muminagaNa! avamAnanA karo nA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra, nA sammAnita mAsasamUhera, nA sei sakala prANIra yAderake kuravAnIra janya hArAme niYe yAoYA haYa, nA tAdera galAYa parAno mAlAra evaM nA sei sava lokera yArA tAdera pratipAlakera anugraha o santuSTi lAbhera uddezye pavitra gRha abhimukhe gamana kare| Ara tomarA yakhana iharAma khule phela, takhana zikAra karate pAra| tomAderake masajidula hArAme (praveza karate) vAdhA diYechila, ei kAraNe konao sampradAYera prati tomAdera zatrutA yena tomAderake (tAdera prati) sImAlaMghana karate prarocita nA kare| tomarA satkarma o tAkaoYAra kSetre eke anyake sahayogitA karave| gunAha o julumera kAje eke anyera sahayogitA karave nA| AllAhake bhaYa kare calo| nizcaYai AllAhara zAsti ati kaThina|

tomAdera prati hArAma karA haYeche mRta jantu, rakta, zUkarera gozata, sei pazu yAte AllAha chAr3A anya kArao nAma uccArita haYeche, zvAsarodhe mRta jantu, prahAre mRta jantu, upara hate patane mRta jantu, anya konao pazura ziMYera AghAte mRta jantu evaM hiMsra pazute kheYeche emana jantu, tave (marAra Age tomarA) yA yavAha karecha tA chAr3A evaM sei jantuo (hArAma), yAke (pratimAra janya) nivedanasthale (vedIte) vali deoYA haYa| evaM juYAra tIra dvArA (gozata ityAdi) vaNTana karAo (tomAdera janya hArAma)| esava viSaYa kaThina gunAhera kAja| Aja kAphiragaNa tomAdera dInera (parAsta haoYAra) vyApAre hatAza haYe geche| sutarAM tAderake bhaYa karo nA| AmAkei bhaYa karo| Aja Ami tomAdera janya tomAdera dInake pUrNAGga kare dilAma, tomAdera upara AmAra niYAmata paripUrNa karalAma evaM tomAdera janya dIna hiseve isalAmake (cira dinera janya) pachanda kare nilAma| (sutarAM e dInera vidhAnAvalI paripUrNabhAve pAlana karo)| hyA~, keu yadi kSudhAra tAr3anAYa vAdhya haYe yAYa (evaM se kAraNe kona hArAma vastu kheYe neYa) Ara gunAhera prati AkRSTa nA haYe, tave AllAha nizcaYai ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

loke tomAke jijJesa kare, tAdera janya kona jinisa hAlAla| vale dAo, tomAdera janya samasta upAdeYa jinisa hAlAla karA haYeche| Ara yei zikArI pazuke tomarA AllAhara zekhAno panthAYa zikhiYe zikhiYe (zikAra karAra janya) prazikSita kare tulecha, tArA ye jantu (zikAra kare) tomAdera janya dhare Ane, tA theke tomarA khete pAra| Ara tAte AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karo evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare calo| AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

Aja tomAdera janya upAdeYa vastusamUha hAlAla kare deoYA hala evaM (tomAdera pUrve) yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila, tAdera khAdyadravyao tomAdera janya hAlAla evaM tomAdera khAdyadravyao tAdera janya hAlAla| Ara muminadera madhyakAra saccaritrA nArI o tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila, tAdera madhyakAra saccaritrA nArIo (tomAdera pakSe hAlAla), yadi tomarA tAderake vivAhera hephAyate AnAra janya tAdera mAhara pradAna kara, (vivAha chAr3A) kevala indriYa-vAsanA caritArtha karAra vA gopana praNaYiNI vAnAnora icchA nA kara| ye-keu ImAna pratyAkhyAna karave, tAra yAvatIYa karma niSphala haYe yAve evaM AkherAte se kSatigrastadera madhye gaNya have|

he muminagaNa! tomarA yakhana nAmAyera janya uThave takhana nijedera cehArA o kanui paryanta nijedera hAta dhuYe nive, nijedera mAthAsamUha mAseha karave evaM TAkhanu paryanta nijedera pA (-o dhuYe neve)| tomarA yadi jAnAvata avasthAYa thAka tave nijedera deha (gosalera mAdhyame) bhAlobhAve pavitra kare neve| tomarA yadi pIr3ita hao vA saphare thAka kiMvA tomAdera madhye keu zaucasthAna theke Ase athavA tomarA strIdera sAthe daihika milana kare thAka evaM pAni nA pAo, tave pavitra mATi dvArA tAYAmmuma karave evaM tA (mATi) dvArA nijedera cehArA o hAta mAseha karave| AllAha tomAdera upara konao kaSTa cApAte cAna nA; varaM tini tomAderake pavitra karate cAna evaM tomAdera prati svIYa niYAmata paripUrNa karate cAna, yAte tomarA zukaragoyAra haYe yAo|

tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha evaM tA~ra sei pratizruti smaraNa kara, yAte tini tomAderake Avaddha karechena yakhana tomarA valechile, AmarA (AllAhara AdezasamUha) bhAlobhAve zunalAma o Anugatya svIkAra karalAma| evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare calo| nizcaYai AllAha antarera bheda samparke paripUrNabhAve avagata|

he muminagaNa! tomarA haYe yAo AllAhara (vidhAnAvalI pAlanera) janya sadAprastuta (evaM) inasAphera sAthe sAkSyadAnakArI evaM konao sampradAYera prati zatrutA yena tomAderake inasApha parityAge prarocita nA kare| inasApha avalamvana karo| e panthAi tAkaoYAra vezi nikaTavartI| evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare calo| nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera yAvatIYa kAja samparke sampUrNarUpe avagata|
yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, AllAha tAderake pratizruti diYechena ye, (AkhirAte) tAdera janya raYeche mAgaphirAta o mahA pratidAna|
Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche o AmAra nidarzanasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, tArA have jAhAnnAmavAsI|

he muminagaNa! tomAdera prati AllAhara ni‘Amata smaraNa kara| yakhana ekadala loka tomAdera viruddhe hAta vAr3Ate ceYechila, takhana AllAha tomAdera (kSatisAdhana karA) theke tAdera hAta nivRkta karechilena evaM (tAra kRtajJatA ei ye,) AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara muminadera to kevala AllAharai upara nirbhara karA ucita|

nizcaYai AllAha vanI isarAIla theke aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilena evaM tAdera madhya hate vArajana tattvAvadhAYaka niyukta karechilAma| AllAha valechilena, Ami tomAdera saGge Achi, yadi tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta AdAYa kara, AmAra rasUlagaNera prati ImAna Ana, tAdera saGge maryAdApUrNa AcaraNa kara evaM AllAhake uttama RNa pradAna kara, tave avazyai Ami tomAdera pAparAzi mocana karava evaM tomAdera emana udyAnarAjite dAkhila karava, yAra taladeze nahara pravahamAna thAkave| eraparao tomAdera madhya hate keu kuphara avalamvana karale, prakRtapakSe se sarala pathai hArAve|

ataHpara tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGgera kAraNei to Ami tAderake AmAra rahamata theke vitAr3ita kari o tAdera antara kaThina kare dei| tArA kathAsamUhake tAra Apana sthAna theke sariYe deYa evaM tAderake ye viSaYe upadeza deoYA haYechila tAra ekaTi var3a aMza bhule yAYa| (AgAmIte) tumi tAdera alpasaMkhyaka vyatIta sakalerai konao nA konao vizvAsaghAtakatAra kathA jAnate thAkave| sutarAM (ekhana) tAderake kSamA kara o tAderake pAza kATiYe cala| nizcaYai AllAha ihasAnakArIdera bhAlovAsena|

yArA valechila, AmarA nAsArA, tAdera thekeo pratizruti niYechilAma, ataHpara tAderake ye viSaYe upadeza deoYA haYechila, tAra ekaTi var3a aMza tArA bhule yAYa| phale Ami tAdera madhye kiYAmata paryanta (sthAYI) zatrutA o vidveSa sRSTi kare dei| acirei AllAha tAderake tArA yA kichu karata tA jAniYe devena|

he kitAvIgaNa! tomAdera nikaTa AmAra (ei) rAsUla ese par3eche, ye (tAorAta o inajIla) granthera emana vahu kathA tomAdera kAche prakAza kare, yA tomarA gopana kara evaM aneka viSaYa er3iYe yAYa| AllAhara pakSa hate tomAdera kAche eka jyoti evaM emana eka kitAva eseche, yA (satyake) suspaSTa kare|

yAra mAdhyame AllAha yArA tA~ra santuSTi anusandhAna kare, tAderake zAntira patha dekhAna evaM nija icchAYa tAderake andhakAra theke vera kare Alora dike niYe Asena evaM tAderake sarala pathera dizA dena|

yArA vale, mAraYAma tanaYa mAsIhai AllAha, tArA nizcita kAphira haYe giYeche| (he navI! tAderake) vale dAo, mAraYAma tanaYa mAsIha, tAra mA evaM pRthivIte yArA Ache tAdera sakalake yadi AllAha dhvaMsa karate cAna, tave ke Ache, ye AllAhara viparIte kichumAtra karAra kSamatA rAkhe? AkAzamaNDala, pRthivI o etadubhaYera mAjhakhAne yA-kichu Ache, se samudaYera mAlikAnA kevala AllAharai| tini yA-kichu cAna sRSTi karena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe paripUrNa kSamatAra adhikArI|

iYAhudI o khrisTAnagaNa vale, AmarA AllAhara santAna o tAra priYapAtra| (tAderake) vale dAo, tAhale AllAha tomAderake tomAdera pApera kAraNe zAsti dena kena? nA, varaM tomarA AllAhara sRSTa anyAnya mAnuSerai mata mAnuSa| tini yAke cAna kSamA karena evaM yAke cAna zAsti dena| AkAzamaNDala o pRthivI evaM etadubhaYera mAjhakhAne yA-kichu Ache, se samudaYera mAlikAnA kevala AllAharai evaM tA~rai dike (sakalera) pratyAvartana|

he kitAvIgaNa! tomAdera nikaTa emana eka samaYe AmAra rAsUla (dInera) vyAkhyA dAnera janya eseche, yakhana rAsUlagaNera Agamana-dhArA vandha chila, yAte tomarA valate nA pAra, AmAdera kAche (jAnnAtera) konao susaMvAdadAtA o (jAhAnnAma samparke) satarkakArI Aseni| evAra tomAdera kAche ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI ese geche| AllAha sarvaviSaYe paripUrNa kSamatAvAna|

evaM (sei samaYake smaraNa kara), yakhana mUsA nija sampradAYake valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara ni‘Amatera kathA smaraNa kara, yakhana tini tomAdera madhye vahu navI preraNa karechilena, tomAderake rAjakSamatAra adhikArI karechilena evaM vizva jagatera kAuke yA denani tomAderake tA dAna karechilena|
he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAha tomAdera janya yei pavitra bhUmi nirdiSTa karechena, tAte praveza kara evaM nijedera pazcAddike phire yeYo nA; tA hale tomarA ulTe giYe kSatigrasta haYe par3ave|

tArA valala, he mUsA! sekhAne to ati zaktimAna eka sampradAYa raYeche| yatakSaNa paryanta tArA sekhAna theke vera nA haYe yAYa, AmarA kichutei sekhAne praveza karava nA| hA~, tArA yadi sekhAna theke vera haYe yAYa tave avazyai AmarA (sekhAne) praveza karava|

yArA (AllAhake) bhaYa karata, tAdera madhye du’jana loka, yAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechilena, valala, tomarA tAdera upara car3Ao haYe (nagarera) darajA diYe praveza kara| tomarA yakhana tAte praveza karave, takhana tomarAi vijaYI have| AllAha tA‘AlAra uparai bharasA rekha, yadi tomarA prakRta mumina hao|

tArA valate lAgala, he mUsA! tArA yatakSaNa paryanta sekhAne (sei deze) avasthAnarata thAkave, tatakSaNa AmarA kichutei sekhAne praveza karava nA| Ara (tAdera sAthe yuddha karate hale) tumi o tomAra ravva cale yAo evaM tAdera sAthe yuddha kara| AmarA to ekhAnei vase thAkava|
mUsA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra nija sattA evaM AmAra bhAi chAr3A Ara kArao upara AmAra kartRtva nei| sutarAM Apani AmAdera o oi avAdhya sampradAYera madhye phAYasAlA kare dina|

AllAha valalena, tave se bhUmi tAdera janya calliza vachara kAla niSiddha kare deoYA hala| (e samaYa) tArA yamIne dikabhrAnta haYe ghurate thAkave| sutarAM (he mUsA!) tumi avAdhya sampradAYera janya duHkha karo nA|

evaM (he navI!) tAdera sAmane Adamera du’ putrera vRttAnta yathAyathabhAve par3e zonAo, yakhana tAdera pratyeke ekekaTi kuravAnI peza karechila evaM tAdera ekajanera kuravAnI kavula haYechila, anyajanera kavula haYani| se (dvitIYajana prathamajanake) valala, Ami tomAke hatyA kare phelava| prathamajana valala, AllAha to muttAkIdera pakSa hatei (kuravAnI) kavula karena|
tumi yadi AmAke hatyA karAra uddezye AmAra dike hAta vAr3Ao, tavuo Ami tomAke hatyA karAra uddezye tomAra dike hAta vAr3Ava nA| Ami to AllAha rAvvula AlAmInake bhaYa kari|
Ami cAi, tumi AmAra o tomAra ubhaYera pApabhAra vahana kara evaM jAhAnnAmIdera madhye gaNya hao| Ara eTAi jAlimadera zAsti|
parizeSe tAra mana tAke bhrAtR-hatyAYa prarocita karala, sutarAM se tAra bhAike hatyA kare phelala evaM akRtakAryadera antarbhukta haYe gela|

ataHpara AllAha ekaTi kAka pAThAlena, ye tAra bhAiYera lAza kibhAve gopana karave tA tAke dekhAnora lakSye mATi khanana karate lAgala| (eTA dekhe) se vale uThala, hAYa Aphasosa! Ami ki ei kAkaTira matao hate pAralAma nA, yAte AmAra bhAiYera lAza gopana karate pAri! ebhAve parizeSe se anutapta hala|

e kAraNei Ami vanI isarAIlera prati vidhAna diYechilAma, keu yadi kAuke hatyA kare evaM tA anya kAuke hatyA karAra kAraNe kiMvA pRthivIte azAnti vistArera kAraNe nA haYa, tave se yena samasta mAnuSake hatyA karala| Ara ye vyakti kArao prANa rakSA kare, se yena samasta mAnuSera prANarakSA karala| vastuta AmAra rAsUlagaNa tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe eseche, kintu tAraparao tAdera madhye vahu loka pRthivIte sImAlaMghanai kare yete thAke|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhe yuddha kare evaM pRthivIte vizRGkhalA sRSTi kare ver3AYa, tAdera zAsti eTAi ye, tAderake hatyA karA have athavA zUle car3Ano have athavA viparIta dika theke tAdera hAta-pA keTe deoYA have athavA tAderake deza theke dUra kare deoYA have| eTA to tAdera pArthiva lAJchanA| Ara AkherAte tAdera janya raYeche mahA zAsti|
tave sei sakala loka vyatikrama, yArA tomAdera AYattAdhIna AsAra Agei tAovA kare| erUpa kSetre jene rekha, AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tA~ra paryanta peৗ~chAra janya achilA sandhAna kara evaM tA~ra pathe jihAda kara| AzA karA yAYa tomarA saphalatA lAbha karave|

nizcaYai yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache savai yadi tAdera thAkata evaM tAra samaparimANa Arao thAkata, yAte kiYAmatera dina zAsti hate rakSA pAraoYAra janya muktipaNa hiseve tA peza karate pAre, tavuo tAdera theke tA gRhIta hata nA| tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAmaYa zAsti|
tArA Aguna theke vera hate cAive, athaca tArA tA theke vera hate pArave nA| tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI zAsti|
ye puruSa o ye nArI curi kare, tAdera ubhaYera hAta keTe dAo, yAte tArA nijedera kRtakarmera pratiphala pAYa (evaM) AllAhara pakSa hate dRSTAntamUlaka zAsti haYa| AllAha kSamatAvAna, prajJAmaYa|
ataHpara ye vyakti nija sImAlaMghanamUlaka kAryakrama theke tAovA karave evaM nijeke saMzodhana kare neve, AllAha tAra tAovA kavula karavena| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tumi ki jAna nA, AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra rAjatva kevala AllAharai? tini yAke cAna zAsti dena evaM yAke cAna kSamA karena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

he rAsUla! yArA kupharIra dike druta dhAvita hacche tArA yena tomAke duHkha nA deYa arthAt sei sava loka, yArA mukhe to vale, ImAna enechi, kintu tAdera antara ImAna Aneni evaM sei sakala loka, yArA (prakAzye) iYAhudI dharma avalamvana kareche| tArA atyadhika mithyA zravaNakArI (evaM tomAra kathAvArtA) emana eka dala lokera pakSe zone, yArA tomAra kAche Aseni, yArA (AllAhara kitAvera) zavdAvalIra sthAna sthira haYe yAoYAra parao tAte vikRti sAdhana kare| tArA vale, tomAderake ei hukuma deoYA hale tA grahaNa karo, Ara yadi eTA deoYA nA haYa, tave ve~ce theka| AllAha yAke phitanAYa phelAra icchA karena, tAke AllAha theke vA~cAnora janya tomAra konao kSamatA kakSano kAje Asave nA| erA tArA, (nApharamAnIra kAraNe) AllAha yAdera antara pavitra karAra icchA karenani| tAdera janya duniYAYa raYeche lAJchanA evaM tAdera janya AkhirAte Ache mahA zAsti|

tArA ati Agrahera sAthe mithyA zone evaM prANabhare hArAma khAYa| sutarAM yadi tomAra kAche Ase, tave (cAile) tAdera madhye phAYasAlA kara kiMvA (cAile) tAderake upekSA kara| tumi tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nile tArA tomAra konao kSati karate pArave nA| Ara yadi phAYasAlA kara, tave tAdera madhye inasAphera sAthe phAYasAlA karo| nizcaYai AllAha inasAphakArIdera bhAlovAsena|
tArA kibhAve tomAra theke phAYasAlA nite cAYa, yakhana tAdera kAche tAorAta raYeche, yAra bhetara AllAhara phAYasAlA lipivaddha Ache? ataHpara tArA mukha phiriYe neYa| prakRtapakSe tArA mumina naYa|

nizcaYai Ami tAorAta nAyila karechilAma; tAte chila hidAYAta o Alo| samasta navI, yArA chila (AllAhara) anugata, iYAhudIdera viSaYAvalIte sei anusArei phAYasAlA dita evaM samasta AllAhaoYAlA o AlemagaNao (tadAnusArei phAYasAlA karata)| kenanA tAderake AllAhara kitAvera rakSaka vAnAno haYechila evaM tArA chila tAra sAkSI| sutarAM (he iYAhudIgaNa!) tomarA mAnuSake bhaYa karo nA| AmAkei bhaYa karo evaM tuccha mUlya grahaNera khAtire AmAra AYAtasamUhake saodA vAniYo nA| yArA AllAhara nAyilakRta vidhAna anusAre phAYasAlA kare nA, tArAi kAphira|

evaM Ami tAte (tAorAte) tAdera janya vidhAna likhe diYechilAma ye, prANera vadale prANa, cokhera vadale cokha, nAkera vadale nAka, kAnera vadale kAna o dA~tera vadale dA~ta| Ara jakhameo (anurUpa) vadalA neoYA have| avazya ye vyakti tA (arthAt vadala) kSamA kare deve, tAra janya tA (gunAhera) kAphaphArA haYe yAve| yArA AllAhara nAyilakRta vidhAna anusAre vicAra kare nA, tArA jAlima|

Ami tAdera (navIgaNera) para mAraYAmera putra IsAke tAra pUrvavartI kitAva arthAt tAorAtera samarthakarUpe pAThiYechilAma evaM Ami tAke inajila diYechilAma, yAte chila hidAYAta o Alo evaM (tA diYechilAma) tAra pUrvavartI kitAva tAorAtera samarthaka evaM muttAkIdera janya hidAYAta o upadezarUpe|
inajIla anusArIgaNa yena AllAha tAte yA nAyila karechena, se anusAre vicAra kare| yArA AllAhara nAyilakRta vidhAna anusAre vicAra kare nA, tArAi phAsika|

evaM (he rAsUla muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYA sAllAma), Ami tomAra pratio satyasamvalita kitAva nAyila karechi, tAra pUrvera kitAvasamUhera samarthaka o saMrakSakarUpe| sutarAM tAdera madhye sei vidhAna anusArei vicAra kara, yA AllAha nAyila karechena| Ara tomAra nikaTa ye satya eseche tA cher3e tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa karo nA| tomAdera madhye pratyeka (ummata)-era janya Ami eka (pRthaka) zarIYata o patha nirdhAraNa karechi| AllAha cAile tomAdera sakalake ekai ummata vAniYe ditena| kintu (pRthaka zarIYata ejanya diYechena) yAte tini tomAderake yA-kichu diYechena, tA dvArA tomAderake parIkSA karate pArena| sutarAM tomarA satkarme pratiyogitA kara| tomAdera sakalake AllAharai dike phire yete have| ataHpara ye viSaYe tomarA matabheda karachile se samparke tini tomAderake avahita karavena|

evaM (Ami Adeza karachi ye,) tumi mAnuSera madhye sei vidhAna anusArei vicAra karave, yA AllAha nAyila karechena evaM tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa karave nA| tAdera vyApAre sAvadhAna theka, pAche tArA tomAke emana kona vidhAna theke vicyuta kare, yA AllAha tomAra prati nAyila karechena| yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave jene rekha, AllAha tAdera konao konao pApera kAraNe tAderake vipadApanna karAra icchA karechena| tAdera madhye anekei phAsika|
tave ki tArA jAhelI yugera phAYasAlA cAYa? yArA nizcita vizvAsa rAkhe, tAdera janya AllAha apekSA uttama phAYasAlA dAnakArI ke hate pAre?

he muminagaNa! iYAhudI o khrisTAnaderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA| tArA nijerAi eke anyera vandhu! tomAdera madhye ye vyakti tAderake vandhu vAnAve, se tAderai madhye gaNya have| nizcaYai AllAha jAlimaderake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

sutarAM yAdera antare (munAphekIra) vyAdhi Ache, tumi tAderake dekhate pAccha ye, tArA ati druta tAdera madhye Dhuke par3ache| tArA valache, AmAdera AzaGkA haYa, AmarA konao musivatera pAke par3e yAva| (kintu) eTA dUre naYa ye, AllAha (musalimaderake) vijaYa dAna karavena athavA nijera pakSa hate anya kichu ghaTAvena, phale takhana tArA nijedera antare yA gopana rekhechila, tajjanya anutapta have|

evaM (takhana) muminagaNa (paraspare) valave, erAi ki tArA, yArA joradArabhAve AllAhara nAme kasama kare valata ye, tArA avazyai tomAdera sAthe| tAdera karma niSphala haYe geche evaM tArA akRtakArya haYeche|

he muminagaNa! tomAdera madhya hate keu yadi nija dIna theke phire yAYa, tave AllAha emana loka sRSTi karavena, yAderake tini bhAlovAsavena evaM tArAo tAke bhAlovAsave| tArA muminadera prati komala evaM kAphiradera prati kaThora have| tArA AllAhara pathe jihAda karave evaM konao nindukera nindAke bhaYa karave nA| eTA AllAhara anugraha, yA tini yAke icchA karena dAna karena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
(he musalimagaNa!) tomAdera vandhu to kevala AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o muminagaNa, yArA (AllAhara sAmane) vinIta haYe sAlAta AdAYa kare o yAkAta deYa|
keu AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o muminagaNake vandhu vAnAle (se AllAhara dalabhukta haYe yAve) AllAhara dalai to vijaYI have|

he muminagaNa! tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche, tAdera madhye yArA tomAdera dInake kautuka o krIr3Ara vastu vAnAYa, tAderake o kApheraderake vandhu vAniYo nA| tomarA prakRta mumina hale AllAhakei bhaYa karo|
evaM tomarA yakhana (mAnuSake) nAmAyera janya DAka, takhana tArA tAke (se DAkake) kautuka o krIr3Ara lakSyavastu vAnAYa| esava (AcaraNa) e kAraNe ye, tArA emana eka sampradAYa, yAdera vodhazakti nei|

vala, he kitAvIgaNa! tomarA ki AmAdera kevala e viSaYaTAkei khArApa mane karacha ye, AmarA AllAhara prati evaM AmAdera upara yA nAyila karA haYeche evaM yA pUrve nAyila karA haYeche tAra prati ImAna enechi, yakhana tomAdera adhikAMzai avAdhya?

(he navI! tAderake) vala, Ami ki tomAderake jAniYe deva, (tomarA ye viSaYake khArApa mane karacha) AllAhara kAche tAra ceYe manda pariNAma kAra have? (tArA) oi sakala loka, yAdera prati AllAha abhisampAta karechena, yAdera prati krodha varSaNa karechena, yAdera madhye katakake vAnara o zUkara vAniYe diYechena evaM yArA zaYatAnera pUjA kareche| tArAi nikRSTa ThikAnAra adhikArI evaM tArA sarala patha theke atyadhika vicyuta|
tArA yakhana tomAdera kAche Ase takhana vale, AmarA ImAna enechi, athaca tArA kuphara niYei esechila evaM kuphara niYei vera haYe giYeche| tArA yA-kichu gopana karache AllAha tA bhAlo karei jAnena|
tAdera anekakei tumi dekhave, tArA pApa, juluma o avaidha bhakSaNera dike druta agrasara haYa| nizcaYai tArA yA-kichu karache tA ati manda|
tAdera mAzAYekha o ulAmA tAderake gunAhera kathA valate o hArAma khete niSedha karache nA kena? vastuta tAdera e karmapanthA ati manda!

iYAhudIgaNa vale, AllAhara hAta vA~dhA| hAta vA~dhA to tAderai| tArA ye kathA valeche, se kAraNe tAdera upara lAnata varSita haYeche| prakRtapakSe AllAhara ubhaYa hAta prasArita| tini yebhAve cAna vyaYa karena evaM (he navI!) tomAra prati tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate ye ohI nAyila karA haYeche, tA tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o kupharIte vRddhi sAdhana karavei evaM Ami tAdera madhye kiYAmata paryanta (sthAYI) zatrutA o vidveSa sRSTi kare diYechi| tArA yakhanai yuddhera Aguna jvAlAYa, AllAha tA nibhiYe dena| tArA pRthivIte azAnti vistAra kare ver3AYa, athaca AllAha azAnti vistArakArIderake pachanda karena nA|
kitAvIgaNa yadi ImAna Anata o tAkaoYA avalamvana karata, tave avazyai Ami tAdera pApakarmasamUha kSamA kare ditAma evaM avazyai tAderake sukhaNDazAntira udyAnasamUhe praveza karAtAma|

yadi tArA tAorAta, inajIla evaM (evAra) tAdera prati tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate ye kitAva nAyila karA haYeche, tAra yathAyatha anusaraNa karata, tave tArA tAdera upara o tAdera nica, sakala dika theke (AllAha pradatta riyika) khete peta| (yadio) tAdera madhye ekaTi dala sarala pathera anusArI| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai emana, yAdera kAryakalApa manda|

he rAsUla! tomAra prati tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate yA kichu nAyila karA haYeche, tA pracAra kara| yadi (tA) nA kara, tave (tAra artha have) tumi AllAhara vArtA peৗ~chAle nA| AllAha tomAke mAnuSera (Sar3ayantra) theke rakSA karavena| AllAha kAphira sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

vale dAo, he kitAvIgaNa! tomarA yatakSaNa paryanta tAorAta o inajIla evaM (ekhana) ye kitAva tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera upara nAyila karA haYeche, tAra yathAyatha anusaraNa nA karave, tatakSaNa tomAdera konao bhitti nei, (yAra upara tomarA dA~r3Ate pAra) evaM (he rAsUla!) tomAra prati tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate ye ohI nAyila karA haYeche, tA tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o avizvAsai vRddhi karave| sutarAM tumi kAphira sampradAYera janya duHkha karo nA|
satya kathA hacche musalima, iYAhudI, sAvI o khrisTAnadera madhye yArAi AllAha o zeSa divase ImAna Anave evaM satkarma karave, tAdera konao bhaYa thAkave nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|

Ami vanI isarAIlera nikaTa hate pratizruti niYechilAma evaM tAdera kAche rAsUla pAThiYechilAma| yakhanai konao rAsUla tAdera kAche emana konao viSaYa niYe Asata, yA tAdera manaHputa naYa, takhanai kataka (rAsUla)ke tArA mithyAvAdI valeche evaM katakake hatyA karate thekeche|

tArA mane karechila, konao zAsti have nA| phale tArA andha o vadhira haYe giYechila| ataHpara AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karechilena| punarAYa tAdera aneke andha o vadhira haYe geche| AllAha tAdera yAvatIYa kAja bhAlobhAvei dekhachena|

yArA vale, mAraYAmera putra mAsIhai AllAha; nizcaYai tArA kAphira haYe giYeche| athaca mAsIha valechila, he vanI isarAIla! AllAhara ivAdata kara, yini AmArao pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka| nizcaYai, ye vyakti AllAhara saGge (kAuke) zarIka kare, AllAha tAra janya jAnnAta hArAma kare diYechena| tAra ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| Ara jAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

evaM tArAo nizcaYa kAphira haYe giYeche, yArA vale, ‘AllAha tinajanera madhye tRtIYa jana|’ athaca eka ilAha vyatIta konao ilAha nei| tArA yadi tAdera e kathA theke virata nA haYa, tave tAdera madhye yArA kupharIte lipta haYeche, tAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAsti sparza karave|
tAraparao ki tArA kSamAra janya AllAhara dike ruju karave nA evaM tA~ra kAche kSamA prArthanA karave nA? athaca AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

mAsIha ivane mAraYAma to ekajana rAsUlai chilena, (tAra vezi kichu naYa)| tAra pUrveo vahu rAsUla gata haYeche| tAra mA chila siddIkA| tArA ubhaYe khAvAra kheta| dekha, Ami tAdera sAmane nidarzanAvalI kemana suspaSTarUpe varNanA karachi| tArapara eTAo dekha ye, tAderake ulTomukhe kothAYa niYe yAoYA hacche!

(he navI! tAderake) vale dAo, tomarA ki AllAha chAr3A emana sRSTira ivAdata karacha, yA tomAdera konao upakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM apakAra karArao nA, yakhana AllAhai savakichura zrotA o sakala viSaYera jJAtA?

(evaM tAderake eTAo) vale dAo ye, he kitAvIgaNa! nijedera dIna niYe anyAYa vAr3AvAr3i karo nA evaM emana sava lokera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa karo nA, pUrve yArA nijerAo pathabhraSTa haYeche evaM apara vahu lokakeo pathabhraSTa kareche evaM tArA sarala patha theke vicyuta haYeche|
vanI isarAIlera madhye yArA kuphurI karechila, tAdera prati dAUda o IsA ivane mAraYAmera yavAnIte lAnata varSita haYechila| tA e kAraNe ye, tArA avAdhyatA karechila evaM tArA sImAlaMghana karata|
tArA yesava asat kAja karata, tAte eke anyake niSedha karata nA| vastuta tAdera karmapanthA chila ati manda|

tumi tAdera anekakei dekhacha, kAphiraderake nijedera vandhurUpe grahaNa kare| nizcaYai tArA nijedera janya yA sAmane pAThiYeche, tA ati manda kenanA (se kAraNe) AllAha tAdera prati asantuSTa haYechena| tArA sarvadA zAstira bhetara thAkave|
tArA yadi AllAha, navI evaM tAra prati yA nAyila haYeche tAte ImAna rAkhata, tave tAderake (mUrtipUjArIderake) vandhu vAnAta nA| kintu (prakRta vyApAra hala) tAdera adhikAMzai avAdhya|

tumi avazyai musalimadera prati zatrutAYa mAnuSera madhye sarvApekSA kaThora pAve iYAhUdIderake evaM sei samasta lokake, yArA (prakAzye) ziraka kare evaM tumi mAnuSera madhye musalimadera sAthe vandhutve sarvApekSA nikaTavartI pAve tAderake, yArA nijederake nAsArA vale| era kAraNa ei ye, tAdera madhye aneka ilama-anurAgI evaM saMsAra-virAgI daraveza raYeche| Arao eka kAraNa hala ye, tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|

evaM rAsUlera prati ye kAlAma nAyila haYeche tArA yakhana tA zone, takhana dekhave tAdera cokhasamUhake tA theke azru pravAhita hacche yehetu tArA satya cine pheleche| tArA vale, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ImAna enechi| sutarAM sAkSyadAtAdera sAthe AmAdera nAmao likhe nina|
Ara AmarA AllAha evaM ye satya AmAdera prati nAyila haYeche, tAte kena ImAna Anava nA, athaca AmarA pratyAzA kari, AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAderake satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karavena?
sutarAM tAdera e kathAra kAraNe AllAha tAderake emana sava udyAna dAna karavena, yAra taladeze nahara pravahamAna thAkave| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| eTAi satkarmazIladera pratidAna|
Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche o AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche, tArA jAhAnnAmavAsI|
he muminagaNa! AllAha tomAdera janya ye sakala utkRSTa vastu hAlAla karechena, tAke hArAma sAvyasta karo nA evaM sImAlaMghana karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha sImAlaMghanakArIdera bhAlovAsena nA|
AllAha tomAderake ye riyaka diYechena, tA theke hAlAla, utkRSTa vastu khAo evaM yei AllAhara prati tomarA ImAna rAkha tAke bhaYa kare calo|

AllAha tomAderake tomAdera nirarthaka zapathera janya pAkar3Ao karavena nA| kintu tomarA ye zapatha paripakkabhAve kare thAka, sejanya tini tomAderake pAkar3Ao karavena| sutarAM tAra kAphaphArA hala, dazajana misakInake madhyama dharanera khAvAra deve, yA tomarA tomAdera parivAravargake khAiYe thAka| athavA tAderake vastra dAna karave kiMvA ekajana golAma AyAda karave| tave kArao kAche yadi (esava jinisera madhya hate kichui) nA thAke, se tina dina royA rAkhave| eTA tomAdera zapathera kAphaphArA yakhana tomarA zapatha karave (evaM tArapara tA bheGge phelave)| tomarA nijedera zapathake rakSA karo| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera sAmane nija AYAtasamUha spaSTabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA AdAYa kara|
he muminagaNa! nizcaYai mada, juYA, pratimAra vedi o juYAra tIra apavitra, zaYatAnI kAja| sutarAM esava parihAra kara, yAte tomarA saphalatA arjana kara|

zaYatAna to mada o juYA dvArA tomAdera madhye zatrutA o vidveSera vIjai vapaNa karate cAYa evaM cAYa tomAderake AllAhara yikira o nAmAya theke virata rAkhate| sutarAM, tomarA ki (osava jinisa theke) nivRtta have?

tomarA AllAhara Anugatya karo o rAsUlera Anugatya karo evaM (avAdhyatA) parihAra kare calo| tomarA yadi (e Adeza theke) vimukha hao, tave jene rekha, AmAra rAsUlera dAYitva kevala suspaSTarUpe (AllAhara hukuma) pracAra karA|

yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tArA (pUrve) yA-kichu kheYeche tAra kAraNe tAdera konao gunAha nei yadi tArA (AgAmIte gunAha hate) ve~ce thAke, ImAna rAkhe o satkarme rata thAke evaM (AgAmIte yesava jinisa niSedha karA haYa tA theke) ve~ce thAke o ImAne pratiSThita thAke, Ara tAraparao tAkaoYA o ihasAna avalamvana kare| AllAha ihasAna avalamvanakArIdera bhAlovAsena|

he muminagaNa! AllAha tomAderake tomAdera hAta o varzAra nAgAle AsA zikArera kichu prANI dvArA avazyai parIkSA karavena, yAte tini jene nena ye, ke tAke nA dekheo bhaYa kare| sutarAM eraparao keu sImAlaMghana karale se yantraNAmaYa zAstira upayukta have|

he muminagaNa! tomarA yakhana iharAma avasthAYa thAka takhana konao zikArake hatyA karo nA| tomAdera madhye keu icchAkRtabhAve tA hatyA karale tAra vinimaYa deoYA oYAjiva (yAra niYama ei ye,) se ye prANI hatyA kareche tAra samatulya gRhapAlita konao jantuke yAra phAYasAlA karave tomAdera madhye du’jana nyAYavAna loka, kAvAYa peৗ~chAno have kuravAnIrUpe| athavA (tAra mUlya parimANa) kAphaphArA AdAYa karA have misakInaderake khAnA khAoYAnora dvArA athavA tAra samasaMkhyaka royA rAkhate have| yena se vyakti tAra kRtakarmera phala bhoga kare| pUrve yA-kichu haYeche AllAha tA kSamA kare diYechena| ye vyakti punarAYa tA karave AllAha tAke zAsti dAna karavena| AllAha kSamatAvAna, zAstidAtA|

tomAdera janya samudrera zikAra o tAra khAdya hAlAla karA haYeche, yAte tA tomAdera o kAphelAra janya bhogera upakaraNa haYa| Ara tomarA yatakSaNa iharAma avasthAYa thAka, tomAdera janya sthalera zikAra hArAma karA haYeche evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare calo, yAra kAche tomAdera sakalake niYe ekatra karA have|

AllAha kAvAke yA ati maryAdApUrNa ghara, mAnuSera nirApattA pratiSThAra mAdhyama vAniYechena| tAchAr3A maryAdApUrNa mAsasamUha, najarAnAra pazu evaM (tAdera galAra) mAlAsamUhakeo (nirApattA pratiSThAra mAdhyama vAniYechena), tA ejanya yAte tomarA jAnate pAra AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache AllAha tA jAnena evaM AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|
jene rekha, AllAha zAsti dAne kaThora evaM eTAo jene rekha ye, tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tAvalIga (pracAra kArya) chAr3A rAsUlera anya konao dAYitva nei| Ara tomarA yA-kichu prakAzye kara evaM yA-kichu gopana kara, savai AllAha jAnena|

(he rAsUla! mAnuSake) vale dAo, apavitra o pavitra vastu samAna haYa nA, yadio apavitra vastura Adhikya tomAke mugdha kare| sutarAM he vodhasampanna vyaktivarga, AllAhake bhaYa kare calo, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao|

he muminagaNa! tomarA emana sava viSaYe prazna karo nA, yA prakAza karA hale tomAdera kAche aprItikara mane have| tomarA yadi emana samaYe se samparke jijJesa kara, yakhana kuraAna nAyila haYa, tave tA tomAdera kAche prakAza karA have| (avazya) AllAha itaHpUrve yA haYeche tA kSamA kare diYechena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomAdera pUrve ekaTi jAti e jAtIYa prazna karechila, ataHpara (tAra ye uttara deoYA haYeche,) tArA tA pratyAkhyAna kareche|

AllAha konao prANIke nA vAhIrA sAvyasta karechena, nA sAivA, nA oYAsIlA o nA hAmI, kintu yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare evaM tAdera adhikAMzei saThika vojhe nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, AllAha ye vANI nAyila karechena tAra dike o rAsUlera dike cale eso| takhana tArA vale, AmarA yAra (arthAt ye dInera) upara AmAdera vApa-dAdAdera peYechi, tAi AmAdera janya yatheSTa| AcchA! tAdera vApa-dAdA yadi emana haYa ye, tAdera konao jJAnao nei evaM hidAYAtao nei, tavu (tArA tAdera anugamana karate thAkave)?

he muminagaNa! tomarA nijedera cintA kara| tomarA saThika pathe thAkale yArA pathabhraSTa haYe geche, tArA tomAdera konao kSati karate pArave nA| AllAharai kAche tomAdera sakalake phire yete have| takhana tini tomAderake avahita karavena, tomarA kI kAja karate|

he muminagaNa! yakhana tomAdera kArao mRtyukSaNa upasthita haYa, takhana osiYata karAra samaYa tomAdera madhye sAkSI thAkave tomAdera madhya hate du’jana nyAYaniSTha loka athavA tomAdera chAr3A anyadera (arthAt amusalidera) madhya hate du’jana, yadi tomarA yamIne saphare thAka evaM se avasthAYa tomAdera mRtyura musivata ese yAYa| ataHpara tomAdera konao sandeha dekhA dile tomarA se du’janake nAmAyera para ATakAte pAra| tArA AllAhara nAme kasama kheYe valave, AmarA ei sAkSyera vinimaYe konao Arthika suvidhA grahaNa karate cAi nA, yadio se konao AtmIYa haYa evaM AmarA AllAhara sAkSya gopana karava nA| karale AmarA gunAhagAradera madhye gaNya hava|

tArapara yadi jAnA yAYa, tArA (mithyA vale) nizcita gunAhe lipta haYeche, tave yAdera viparIte ei prathama vyaktidvaYa gunAhe lipta haYeche, tAdera madhya hate du’ vyakti edera sthAne (sAkSyadAnera janya) dA~r3Ave| tArA AllAhara nAme kasama kare valave, oi prathama vyaktidvaYa apekSA AmAdera sAkSyai vezi satya evaM (ei sAkSyadAne) AmarA sImAlaMghana karini| tA karale AmarA jAlimadera madhye gaNya hava|

e paddhatite vezi AzA thAke ye, loke (prathamei) saThika sAkSya deve athavA bhaYa karave ye, (mithyA sAkSya dile) tAdera zapathera para punarAYa anya zapatha neoYA have (yA AmAdera rada karave) evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara (tAra pakSa hate yA-kichu valA haYeche, tA kavula karAra niYate) zona| AllAha avAdhyaderake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

(sei dinake smaraNa kara), ye dina AllAha rAsUlagaNake ekatra karavena evaM valavena, tomAderake kI javAva deoYA haYechila? tArA valave, AmAdera kichu jAnA nei| yAvatIYa gupta viSaYera paripUrNa jJAna to ApanArai kAche|

(eTA ghaTave sei dina) yakhana AllAha valavena, he mAraYAmera putra IsA! Ami tomAra o tomAra mAYera upara ye anugraha karechilAma, tA smaraNa kara yakhana Ami rUhula kudasera mAdhyame tomAra sAhAyya karechilAma| tumi dolanAYa (thAkA avasthAYa) mAnuSera sAthe kathA valate evaM pariNata vaYaseo evaM yakhana Ami tomAke kitAva o hikamata evaM tAorAta o inajIlera zikSA diYechilAma evaM yakhana AmAra hukume tumi kAdA dvArA pAkhira mata AkRti tairi karate, tArapara tAte phu~ dite, phale tA AmAra hukume (satyikArera) pAkhi haYe yeta evaM tumi janmAndha o kuSTha rogIke AmAra hukume nirAmaYa karate evaM yakhana AmAra hukume tumi mRtake (jIvitarUpe) vera kare Anate evaM yakhana Ami vanI isarAIlake tomAra theke nirasta karechilAma yakhana tumi tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe esechile, Ara tAdera madhye yArA kAphira chila tArA valechila eTA spaSTa yAdu chAr3A kichui naYa|
yakhana Ami hAoYArIderake preraNA dei ye, tomarA AmAra prati o AmAra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana, takhana tArA valala, AmarA ImAna AnalAma evaM Apani sAkSI thAkuna ye, AmarA anugata|

(evaM tAdera e ghaTanAra varNanAo zona ye,) yakhana hAoYArIgaNa valechila, he IsA ivane mAraYAma! ApanAra pratipAlaka ki AmAdera janya AsamAna theke (khAdyera) ekaTA khAJcA avatIrNa karate sakSama? IsA valala, AllAhake bhaYa kara yadi tomarA mumina hao|

tArA valala, AmarA cAi ye, tA theke khAva evaM AmAdera antara paripUrNa prazAnti lAbha karave evaM AmarA (pUrvApekSA adhika pratyaYera sAthe) jAnate pArava ye, Apani AmAderake yA-kichu valechena tA satya, Ara AmarA e viSaYe sAkSyadAtAdera antarbhukta hava|

(sutarAM) IsA ivane mAraYAma valala, he AllAha, AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera janya AsamAna theke ekaTi khAJcA avatIrNa karuna, yA have AmAdera evaM AmAdera pUrvavartI o paravartI sakalera janya Ananda udayApanera kAraNa evaM ApanAra pakSa hate ekaTi nidarzana| AmAderake (e ni‘Amata) avazyai pradAna karuna| nizcaYai Apani sarvazreSTha dAtA|
AllAha valalena, Ami avazyai tomAdera prati se khAJcA avatIrNa karava, kintu tArapara tomAdera madhye ye-keu kuphurI karave Ami tAke emana zAsti deva, ye zAsti vizva jagatera anya kAuke deva nA|

evaM (sei samaYera varNanAo zona,) yakhana AllAha valavena, he IsA ivane mAraYAma! tumii ki mAnuSake valechile ye, tomarA AllAha vyatIta AmAke o AmAra mA’ ke mAvudarUpe grahaNa kara? se valave, Ami to ApanAra sattAke (ziraka theke) pavitra mane kari| ye kathA valAra konao adhikAra nei, se kathA valAra sAdhya AmAra chila nA| Ami erUpa vale thAkale Apani avazyai tA jAnatena| AmAra antare yA gopana Ache Apani tA jAnena, kintu ApanAra gupta viSaYa Ami jAni nA| nizcaYai yAvatIYa gupta viSaYe Apani samyaka jJAta|

Apani AmAke ye viSaYera Adeza karechilena tA chAr3A anya kichu Ami tAderake valini| tA ei ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara, yini AmArao pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka evaM yata dina Ami tAdera madhye chilAma, tata dina Ami tAdera avasthA samparke avagata chilAma| tArapara Apani yakhana AmAke tule niYechena takhana Apani svaYaM tAdera tattvAvadhAYaka thekechena| vastuta Apani sava kichura sAkSI|
yadi Apani tAderake zAsti dena, tave tArA to ApanArai vAndA| Ara yadi tAderake kSamA karena, tave nizcaYai Apanii mahAparAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha valavena, eTA sei dina, ye dina satyavAdIderake tAdera satyatA upakRta karave| tAdera janya raYeche emana sava udyAna, yAra taladeze nahara pravahamAna| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa evaM tArAo AllAhara prati santuSTa| eTAi mahA sAphalya|
AkAzamaNDala o pRthivI evaM e duYera mAjhe yA kichu Ache, tAra rAjatva kevala AllAharai| tini savakichura upara paripUrNa kSamatAvAna|

samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AkAzamaNDala o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM andhakAra o Alo vAniYechena| tathApi yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArA (anyake) nija pratipAlakera samakakSa sAvyasta kare|

tinii sei sattA, yini tomAderake narama mATi dvArA sRSTi karechena, tArapara (tomAdera jIvanera) ekaTi meYAda sthira karechena evaM (punarAYa jIvita haoYAra) ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla raYeche tArai nikaTa| tAraparao tomarA sandehe par3e raYeche|
Ara AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte tinii AllAha| tini tomAdera gupta viSaYAdio jAnena evaM prakAzya avasthAsamUhao| Ara tomarA yA-kichu arjana karacha tAo tini avagata|
(kAphiradera avasthA ei ye,) tAdera kAche tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalI hate yakhanai konao nidarzana Ase, tArA tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa|
sutarAM yakhana tAdera nikaTa satya Asala takhana tArA tA pratyAkhyAna karala| sutarAM tArA ye viSaYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karache, zIghrai tAdera kAche tAra khavara peৗ~che yAve|

tArA ki dekheni, Ami tAdera pUrve kata jAtike dhvaMsa karechi? tAderake Ami pRthivIte emana kSamatA diYechilAma, yA tomAderake deini| Ami tAdera prati AkAza theke pracura vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma evaM tAdera taladeze nada-nadIke pravahamAna karechilAma| ataHpara tAdera pApAcArera kAraNe Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare dei evaM tAdera para apara mAnava goSThIke sRSTi kari|

evaM (oi kApheradera avasthA ei ye,) Ami yadi tomAra prati kAgaje likhita konao kitAva nAyila karatAma, ataHpara tArA tA nija hAte sparza kare dekhata, tavuo (tAdera madhye) yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArA valata, eTA spaSTa yAdu chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|

evaM tArA vale, tAra (arthAt navIra) prati konao phirizatA avatIrNa karA hala nA kena? athaca Ami kona phirizatA avatIrNa karale to (tAdera) viSaYe cUr3Anta phaYasAlA haYe yeta, tArapara Ara tAderake suyoga deoYA hata nA|
Ami yadi konao phirizatAke navI vAnAtAma, tave tAkeo to konao puruSa (-era AkRtite)-i vAnAtAma, Ara tAderake serUpa vibhramei phelatAma, yerUpa vibhrame tArA ekhana patita raYeche|

(he navI!) nizcaYai tomAra pUrveo vahu rAsUlake ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYeche, pariNAme tAdera madhye yArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karechila tAderake sei jinisai pariveSTana kare phele, yA niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
(kApheraderake) vala, pRthivIte bhramaNa kara, tArapara dekha (navIgaNake) asvIkArakArIdera pariNAma kI haYechila|

(tAderake) jijJesa kara, AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA Ache, tA kAra mAlikAnAdhIna? (tArapara tArA yadi uttara nA deYa tave nijei) vale dAo, AllAharai mAlikAnAdhIna| tini rahamatake nijera prati avazya kartavyarUpe sthira kare niYechena (tAi tAovA karale atItera samasta pApa kSamA kare dena|) kiYAmatera dina tini avazyai tomAdera sakalake ekatra karavena, ye vyApAre konao sandeha nei| (kintu) yArA (kuphara o pApAcAre lipta haYe) nijedera kSatisAdhana kareche, tArA (e satyera prati) ImAna Anave nA|
rAta o dine yata sRSTi vizrAma grahaNa kare, sava tArai adhikArabhukta| tini sava kichu zonena o sava kichu jAnena|

vale dAo, Ami ki AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karava? yini AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sraSTA evaM yini (sakalake) khAdya dAna karena, kArao theke khAdya grahaNa karena nA? vale dAo, AmAke Adeza karA haYeche yena AtmasamarpaNakArIdera madhye Amii prathama vyakti hai evaM (AmAke valA haYeche) tumi kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
vale dAo, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera avAdhyatA kari, tave AmAra eka mahA divasera zAstira bhaYa raYeche|
se dina ye vyakti hatei se zAsti dUrIbhUta karA have, tAra prati AllAha var3ai daYA karalena| Ara eTAi spaSTa saphalatA|
AllAha yadi tomAke kaSTa dAna karena, tave svaYaM tini chAr3A tA mocanakArI Ara keu nei| Ara tini yadi tomAra kalyANa karena, tave tini to sava viSaYe zaktimAna|
tini nija vAndAdera upara paripUrNa kSamatAvAna evaM tini prajJAmaYa, paripUrNabhAve avagata|

vala, (konao viSaYe) sAkSya dAnera janya sarvazreSTha jinisa kI? vala, AllAha! (evaM tinii) AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI| AmAra prati ohIrUpe ei kuraAna nAyila karA haYeche, yAte era mAdhyame Ami tomAderakeo satarka kari evaM yAdera nikaTa e kuraAna peৗ~chave tAderakeo| satyii ki tomarA ei sAkSya dite pAra ye, AllAhara sAthe anyAnya mAvudao Ache? vale dAo, Ami to (erUpa) sAkSya deva nA| vale dAo, tini to ekai mAvuda| tomarA ye sakala jinisake tA~ra zarIka sAvyasta kara, Ami tAdera theke vimukha|

yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi tArA tAke (arthAt zeSa navI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYA sAllAmake) seirUpa cene, yerUpa nijedera santAnaderake cene| (tathApi) yArA nijedera kSatisAdhana kareche, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
ye vyakti AllAha samparke mithyA raTanA kare athavA tAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kare, tAra ceYe var3a jAlima Ara ke hate pAre? nizcita (jena), jAlimagaNa saphalatA lAbha karate pAre nA|

sei dina (-ke smaraNa kara), yakhana Ami tAdera sakalake ekatra karava, ataHpara yArA ziraka kareche tAderake jijJesa karava, tomAdera sei mAvudagaNa kothAYa, yAdera samparke tomarA dAvI karate (‘tArA AllAhara aMzIdAra’)?
se dina tAdera e chAr3A konao ajuhAta thAkave nA ye, tArA valave, AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAhara zapatha, AmarA to muzarika chilAma nA|
dekha, tArA nijedera samparke kirUpa mithyA vale| Ara tArA ye mithyA (mAvuda) udbhAvana karechila, tA tAdera theke niruddeza haYe yAve|

tAdera madhye kataka loka emana, yArA tomAra kathA kAna pete zone, (kintu se zonATA yehetu satya-sandhAnera janya naYa; varaM nijedera jeda dhare rAkhAra lakSye haYe thAke, tAi) Ami tAdera antare pardA phele diYechi| phale tArA tA vojhe nA; tAdera kAne vadhiratA sRSTi kare diYechi evaM (eka-eka kare) samasta nidarzana pratyakSa karaleo tArA ImAna Anave nA| emanaki tArA yakhana vitarke lipta haoYAra janya tomAra kAche Ase takhana kApheragaNa vale, eTA (kuraAna) pUrvavartI lokadera upAkhyAna chAr3A kichui naYa|

tArA (anyakeo) era (arthAt kuraAnera) theke virata rAkhe evaM nijerAo era theke dUre thAke evaM (ebhAve) tArA nijerA nijedera chAr3A anya kAuke dhvaMse nikSepa karache nA| kintu tArA (tA) upalavdhi kare nA|

evaM (seTA var3a bhaYAnaka dRzya have) yadi tumi sei samaYa dekhate pAo, yakhana tAderake jAhAnnAmera pAze dA~r3a karAno have evaM tArA valave, hAYa! AmAderake yadi (duniYAYa) pherata pAThAno hata, tave AmarA evAra AmAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karatAma nA evaM AmarA muminadera madhye gaNya hatAma|

(athaca tAdera e AkAGkSAo pUraNa have nA), varaM pUrve tArA yA gopana karata, tA tAdera sAmane prakAza peYe geche (tAi nirupAYa haYe tArA e dAvI karave, nacet) satyii yadi tAderake pherata pAThAno haYa, tave punarAYa tArA se savai karave, yA theke tAderake vAraNa karA haYeche| nizcaYai tArA ghora mithyAvAdI|
tArA vale, yA-kichu Ache tA kevala AmAdera ei pArthiva jIvanai| (mRtyura para) AmarA punarjIvita haoYArai nai|

tumi yadi sei samaYa dekhate pAo, yakhana tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane dA~r3a karAno have| tini valavena, eTA (arthAt ei dvitIYa jIvana) ki satya naYa? tArA valave, AmAdera pratipAlakera zapatha! nizcaYai, AllAha valavena, tave tomarA zAstira svAda grahaNa kara| yehetu tomarA kuphara karate|

yArA AllAhara sAthe milita haoYAke asvIkAra kareche, nizcaYai tArA ati kSatigrasta haYeche| avazeSe kiYAmata yakhana akasmAt tAdera sAmane ese par3ave takhana tArA valave, hAYa Aphasosa! AmarA e (kiYAmata) samparke var3a avahelA karechi evaM tArA (takhana) tAdera piThe nijedera pApera vojhA vahana karave| sAvadhAna! tArA yA vahana karave tA ati nikRSTa|
pArthiva jIvana to krIr3A-kautuka chAr3A kichu naYa| yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare AkhirAtera nivAsai tAdera janya zreYa| (etaTuku kathAo ki) tomarA vujhate pAra nA?
(he rAsUla!) Ami bhAlo karei jAni, tArA yA vale tAte tomAra kaSTa haYa| kenanA tArA Asale tomAke mithyAvAdI valache nA; varaM jAlimagaNa AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karache|

vastuta tomAra pUrve vahu rAsUlake mithyAvAdI valA haYechila, kintu tAderake ye mithyAvAdI valA haYeche o kaSTa dAna karA haYeche, tAte tArA dhairya dhAraNa karechila, ye paryanta nA tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya peৗ~cheche| emana keu nei, ye AllAhara kathA parivartana karate pAre| (pUrvavartI) rAsUlagaNera kichu ghaTanA ApanAra kAche to peৗ~chechei|

yadi tAdera upekSA tomAra kAche vezi pIr3AdAYaka haYa, tave pArale tumi bhUgarbhe (yAoYAra janya) konao sur3aGga athavA AkAze (oThAra janya) konao si~r3i sandhAna kara, ataHpara tAdera kAche (tAdera pharamAYezI) kona nidarzana niYe eso| AllAha cAile tAdera sakalake hidAYAtera upara ekatra karatena| sutarAM tumi kichutei ajJadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
kathA to kevala tArAi mAnate pAre, yArA (satyera AkAksakSI haYe) zone| Ara mRtadera viSaYaTA ei ye, AllAhai tAderake kavara theke uThAvena, ataHpara tA~rai kAche tArA pratyAnIta have|

tArA vale, (ini yadi navI hana, tave) tAra prati tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate konao nidarzana avatIrNa karA hala nA kena? tumi (tAderake) vala, nizcaYai AllAha ye konao nidarzana avatIrNa karate sakSama, kintu tAdera adhikAMza loka (era pariNAma) jAne nA|

bhUpRSThe yata jIva vicaraNa kare, yata pAkhi tAdera DAnAra sAhAyye ur3e, tArA sakale tomAderai mata sRSTira vibhinna prakAra| Ami kitAva (lAohe mAhaphuja)-e kichumAtra truTi rAkhini| ataHpara tAdera sakalake tAdera pratipAlakera kAche ekatra karA have|

yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche, tArA andhakAre (udbhrAnta theke) vadhira o mUka haYe geche| AllAha yAke cAna tAke (tAra haThakAritAra kAraNe) gomarAhIte nikSepa karena Ara yAke cAna tAke sarala pathe sthApita karena|
(kApheraderake) vala, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao, tave vala dekhi, tomAdera upara AllAhara zAsti Apatita hale athavA tomAdera nikaTa kiYAmata upasthita hale tomarA ki AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke DAkave?
varaM tAkei DAkave| ataHpara ye durdazAra janya tAke DAka, tini cAile tA dUra karavena; Ara yAderake (devatAderake) tomarA (AllAhara) zarIka sAvyasta karacha, (takhana) tAderake bhule yAve|
(he navI!) tomAra pUrveo vahu jAtira nikaTa Ami rAsUla pAThiYechi| ataHpara Ami (tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe) tAderake artha-saMkaTa o duHkha-kaSTe AkrAnta karechi, yAte tArA anunaYa-vinaYa kare|

ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra (pakSa hate) saMkaTa Asala, takhana tArA kena anunaYa-vinaYa karala nA? varaM tAdera antara Arao kaThina haYe gela evaM tArA yA karachila, zaYatAna tAke tAdera kAche zobhanIYa kare dila|

tAderake ye upadeza deoYA haYechila tArA yakhana tA bhule gela, takhana Ami tAdera janya samasta kichura duYAra khule dilAma| avazeSe tAderake yA deoYA haYechila yakhana tAte tArA ullasita hala, takhana Ami akasmAt tAderake dharalAma| phale tArA sampUrNa nirAza haYe gela|
ebhAve yArA juluma karechila tAdera mUloccheda karA hala evaM samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|

(he navI! tAderake) vala, tomarA vala to, AllAha yadi tomAdera zravaNazakti evaM tomAdera dRSTizakti ker3e nena evaM tomAdera antare mohara kare dena, tave AllAha chAr3A kon mAvuda Ache, ye tomAderake egulo phiriYe deve? dekha, Ami kibhAve vibhinna panthAYa nidarzanAvalI vivRta kari| tA sattveo tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
vala, tomarA vala to, AllAhara zAsti yadi tomAdera upara akasmAt ese par3e athavA ghoSaNA diYe, (ubhaYa avasthAYa) jAlimadera chAr3A anya kAuke dhvaMsa karA have ki?

Ami rAsUlagaNake to kevala (sat karmera kSetre puraskArera) susaMvAdadAtA evaM (avAdhyatAra kSetre AllAhara AyAva samparke) bhIti pradarzanakArIrUpei pAThiYe thAki| sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane o nijeke saMzodhana kare, tAdera kona bhaYa thAkave nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
Ara yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kare, tAdera niravacchinna avAdhyatAra kAraNe tAdera upara avazyai zAsti Apatita have|

(he navI! tAderake) vala, Ami tomAderake vali nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara dhana bhANDAra Ache| adRzya samparkeo Ami (paripUrNa) jJAna rAkhi nA evaM Ami tomAderake ekathAo vali nA ye, Ami phirizatA| Ami to kevala sei ohIrai anusaraNa kari, yA AmAra prati avatIrNa haYa| vala, andha o cakSuSmAna ki samAna hate pAre? tomarA ki cintA kara nA?

evaM (he navI!) tumi ei ohIra dvArA tAderake satarka kare dAo, yArA bhaYa kare ye, tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa emana avasthAYa samaveta karA have ye, tini chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA evaM nA konao supArizakArI, yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

yArA tAdera pratipAlakera santuSTi lAbhera uddezye sakAla o sandhyAYa tAke DAke, tAderake tumi tAr3iYe diYo nA| tAdera hisAva(-era antarbhukta karmasamUha) theke konaoTira dAYa tomAra upara naYa evaM tomAra hisAva (-era antarbhukta karmasamUha) theke konaoTirao dAYa tAdera upara naYa, ye kAraNe tumi tAderake vera kare deve evaM jAlimadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|

ebhAvei Ami tAdera kataka loka dvArA katakake parIkSAYa phelechi, yAte tArA (tAdera samparke) vale, erAi ki sei loka, AmAdera sakalake rekhe AllAha yAderake anugraha karAra janya veche niYechena? (ye sakala kAphera e kathA valache, tAdera dhAraNAYa) AllAha ki tA~ra kRtajJa vAndAdera samparke (anyadera theke) vezi jAnena nA?

yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna rAkhe, tArA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase, (takhana tAderake) vala, tomAdera prati zAnti varSita hoka| tomAdera pratipAlaka nijera upara rahamatake avadhArita kare niYechena; tomAdera madhye keu yadi ajJatAvazata konao manda kAja kare, tArapara tAovA kare evaM nijeke saMzodhana kare, tave AllAha to ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ebhAve Ami nidarzanAvalI vizadabhAve varNanA kari (yAte sarala pathao spaSTa haYe yAYa) evaM ete aparAdhIdera pathao pariSkAra haYe yAYa|

(he navI! tAderake) vala, tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAderake (mithyA upAsyaderake) DAka, AmAke tAdera ivAdata karate niSedha karA haYeche| vala, Ami tomAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa karate pAri nA| karale Ami vipathagAmI haYe yAva evaM Ami satpathaprAptadera madhye gaNya hava nA|

vala, Ami AmAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke eka spaSTa pramANera upara pratiSThita Achi, athaca tomarA tA pratyAkhyAna karecha| tomarA yA tAr3AtAr3i cAccha, tA AmAra kAche nei| hukuma AllAha chAr3A Ara kArao cale nA| tini satya varNanA karena evaM tinii sarvazreSTha phAYasAlAkArI|
vala, tomarA ye jinisa satvara cAccha tA yadi AmAra kAche thAkata, tave AmAra o tomAdera madhye phAYasAlA haYe yeta| AllAha jAlimadera samparke samyaka jJAta|

Ara tA~rai kAche Ache adRzyera kuJji| tini chAr3A anya keu tA jAne nA| sthale o jale yA-kichu Ache, se samparke tini avahita| (konao gAchera) emana konao pAtA jhare nA, ye samparke tini jJAta nana| mATira andhakAre konao zasyadAnA athavA Ardra vA zuSka emana konao jinisa nei yA eka unmukta kitAve lipivaddha nei|
