tinii sei sattA, yini rAtera velA (ghumera bhetara) tomAdera AtmA (mAtrA vizeSe) kavjA kare nena evaM dinera velA tomarA yA-kichu kara tA tini jAnena| tArapara (natuna) dine tomAderake natuna jIvana dAna karena, yAte (tomAdera jIvanera) nirdhArita kAla pUrNa hate pAre| ataHpara tAra dikei tomAdera pratyAvartana karate have| takhana tomarA yA karate tA tomAderake avahita karavena|

tinii nija vAndAdera upara paripUrNa kSamatA rAkhena evaM tomAdera janya rakSaka (phirizatA) preraNa karena| avazeSe yakhana tomAdera kArao mRtyukAla ese par3e, takhana AmAra prerita phirizatAgaNa tAke paripUrNarUpe usula kare neYa evaM tArA vindumAtra truTi kare nA|
ataHpara tAdera sakalake tAdera prakRta maniva AllAhara kAche phiriYe neoYA haYa| smaraNa rekha, hukuma kevala tArai cale| tini sarvApekSA druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

vala, sthala o samudrera andhakAre sei samaYa ke tomAderake rakSA karena, yakhana tomarA minati sahakAre o cupisAre tAkei DAka (evaM vala ye,) tini yadi ei masivata theke AmAderake uddhAra karena, tave avazyai AmarA kRtajJadera antarbhukta haYe yAva?
vala, AllAhai tomAderake rakSA karena ei masivata theke evaM samasta duHkha-kaSTa hate| tA sattveo tomarA ziraka kara|

vala, tini e viSaYe sampUrNa sakSama ye, tomAdera prati konao zAsti pAThAvena tomAdera upara dika theke athavA tomAdera padatala theke athavA tomAderake vibhinna dale vibhakta kare eka dalake parasparera mukhomukhi kare devena evaM eka dalake apara dalera zaktira svAda grahaNa karAvena| dekha, Ami kibhAve vibhinna panthAYa svIYa nidarzanAvalI vivRta karachi, yAte tArA vujhate sakSama haYa|
(he navI!) tomAra sampradAYa eke (kuraAnake) mithyA valeche, athaca eTA sampUrNa satya| tumi vale dAo, Ami tomAdera karmavidhAYaka nai|
pratyeka ghaTanAra ekaTA nirdhArita samaYa Ache evaM zIghrai tomarA (sava) jAnate pArave|

yArA AmAra AYAtera samAlocanAYa rata thAke, tAderake yakhana dekhave takhana tAdera theke dUre sare yAve, yatakSaNa nA tArA anya viSaYe pravRtta haYa| yadi zaYatAna kakhanao tomAke (eTA) bhuliYe deYa, tave smaraNa haoYAra para jAlima lokadera sAthe vasave nA|
tAdera hisAva (-era antarbhukta karmasamUha) hate kona kichura dAYa muttAkIdera upara vartAYa nA| avazya upadeza deoYA (tAdera kAja)| haYata tArAo (erUpa viSaYa theke) sAvadhAnatA avalamvana karave|

yArA nijedera dInake krIr3A-kautukera viSaYa vAniYeche evaM pArthiva jIvana yAderake dheA~kAra madhye pheleche, tumi tAderake parityAga kara evaM era (arthAt kuraAnera) mAdhyame (mAnuSake) upadeza dite thAka, yAte keu nija kRtakarmera kAraNe grephatAra nA haYa yakhana AllAha (-era zAsti) hate vA~cAnora janya tAra konao abhibhAvaka o supArizakArI thAkave nA| Ara se yadi (nija muktira janya) sava rakamera muktipaNao peza karate cAYa, tave tAra pakSa hate tA gRhIta have nA| erAi (arthAt yArA dInake krIr3A-kautukera viSaYa vAniYeche, tArA) nijedera kRtakarmera kAraNe dharA par3e geche| kuphare rata thAkAra kAraNe tAdera janya raYeche ati garama pAnIYa o yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

(he navI! tAderake) vala, AmarA ki AllAhake cher3e emana sava jinisera ivAdata karava, yArA AmAdera konao upakArao karate pAre nA evaM konao apakArao karate pAre nA? AllAha AmAderake hidAYAta deoYAra para AmarA ki sei vyaktira mata ulTo dike phire yAva, yAke zaYatAna dheA~kA diYe marubhUmite niYe geche, phale se udbhrAnta haYe ghure ver3AYa? tAra kichu saGgI Ache, yArA tAke hidAYAtera dike DAka deYa ye, AmAdera kAche eso| vala, AllAha pradatta hidAYAtai satyikArera hidAYAta| AmAderake Adeza karA haYeche, yena AmarA rAvvula AlAmInera sAmane nati svIkAra kari|
evaM (ei hukumao deoYA haYeche ye,) sAlAta kAYema kara evaM tAke bhaYa kare cala| tinii sei sattA, yAra kAche tomAderake samaveta karA have|

tinii sei sattA, yini AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIke sRSTi karechena yathocita evaM ye dina tini (kiYAmatake) valavena, ‘haYe yAo’, tA haYe yAve| tAra kathA satyai| ye dina ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have, se dina rAjatva have tA~rai| tini adRzya o dRzya sava kichui jAnena| tinii mahA prAjJa o sarva viSaYe avahita|

evaM (sei samaYera vRttAnta zona) yakhana ivarAhIma tAra pitA Ayarake valechila, Apani ki mUrtiderake mAvuda vAniYe niYechena? Ami to dekhachi, Apani o ApanAra sampradAYa spaSTa gomarAhIte lipta raYechena|
Ara ebhAvei Ami ivarAhImake AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra rAjatva pradarzana karAi| Ara uddezya chila, se yena paripUrNa vizvAsa sthApanakArIdera antarbhukta haYe yAYa|
sutarAM yakhana tAra upara rAta cheYe gela, takhana se ekaTi nakSatra dekhe valala, ‘ei AmAra pratipAlaka’| ataHpara seTi yakhana Duve gela, se valala, yA kichu Duve yAYa Ami tA pachanda kari nA|

ataHpara yakhana se cA~dake ujjvalarUpe udita hate dekhala takhana valala, ‘ei AmAra ravva’| kintu yakhana seTio Duve gela, takhana valate lAgala, AmAra ravva AmAke hidAYAta nA dile Ami avazyai pathabhraSTa lokadera dalabhukta haYe yAva|

tArapara yakhana se sUryake samujjvalarUpe udita hate dekhala, takhana valala, ei AmAra ravva| eTi vezi var3a| tArapara yakhana seTio Duve gela, takhana se valala, he AmAra kaoma! tomarA ye sakala jinisake (AllAhara saGge) zarIka kara, tAdera sAthe AmAra konao samparka nei|
Ami sampUrNa ekaniSThabhAve sei sattAra dike nijera mukha pherAlAma, yini AkAzamaNDala o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM Ami zirakakArIdera antarbhukta nai|

evaM (tArapara ei ghaTala ye,) tAra sampradAYa tAra sAthe hujjata zuru kare dila| ivarAhIma (tAderake) valala, tomarA ki AllAha samparke AmAra saGge hujjata karacha, athaca tini AmAke hidAYAta dAna karechena? tomarA ye sakala jinisake (AllAhara) zarIka sAvyasta karacha, (tArA AmAra kona kSati sAdhana karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA| tAi) Ami tAderake bhaYa kari nA| avazya AmAra pratipAlaka yadi (AmAra) kona (kSati sAdhana) karate cAna (tave sarvAvasthAYai tA sAdhita have)| AmAra pratipAlakera jJAna savakichu pariveSTana kare rekheche| etadasattveo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

tomarA ye sakala jinisake (AllAhara) zarIka vAniYe niYecha, Ami kibhAvei vA tAderake bhaYa karate pAri, yakhana tomarA oi sakala jinisake AllAhara zarIka vAnAte bhaYa karacha nA, yAdera viSaYe tini tomAdera prati konao pramANa avatIrNa karenani? sutarAM tomAdera kAche yadi kichu jJAna thAke, tave (vala,) dui dalera madhye kona dala nirbhaYe thAkAra vezi upayukta?
(prakRtapakSe) yArA ImAna eneche evaM nijedera ImAnake julumera sAthe mizrita kareni, nirApattA o svasti to kevala tAderai adhikAra evaM tArAi saThika pathe peৗ~che geche|
eTA chila AmAra phalaprasU dalIla, yA Ami ivarAhImake tAra kaomera viparIte dAna karechilAma| Ami yAke icchA ucca maryAdA dAna kari| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

Ami ivarAhImake dAna karechilAma isahAka (-era mata putra) o iYAkuva (-era mata pautra)| tAdera pratyekake Ami hidAYAta dAna karechilAma| Ara nUhake Ami Agei hidAYAta diYechilAma evaM tAra vaMzadharadera madhye dAUda, sulAYamAna, Aiuva, iusupha, mUsA o hArunakeo| ebhAvei Ami satkarmazIladerake pratidAna diYe thAki|
evaM yAkAriYA, iYAhaiYA, IsA o iliYAsakeo (hidAYAta dAna karechilAma)| erA sakale puNyavAnadera antarbhukta chila|
evaM isamAIla, iYAsA, iunusa o lutakeo| tAdera sakalake Ami vizvera sakala mAnuSera upara zreSThatva diYechilAma|
tAdera vApa-dAdA, santAnavarga o tAdera bhAidera madhya hateo vahu lokake| Ami tAderake manonIta karechilAma o tAderake sarala patha paryanta peৗ~chiYe diYechilAma|
eTA AllAha pradatta hidAYAta, yAra mAdhyame tini vAndAdera madhya hate yAke cAna sarala pathe peৗ~chiYe dena| tArA yadi ziraka karata, tave tAdera samasta (sat) karma niSphala haYe yeta|

tArA chila emana loka, yAderake Ami kitAva, hikamata o navuoYAta dAna karechilAma| sutarAM esava loka (makkAra muzarikagaNa) yadi eTA (navuoYAta) pratyAkhyAna kare, tave (tAra konao paraoYA karo nA| kenanA) era (anusaraNera) janya Ami emana loka nirdiSTa karechi, yArA era asvIkArakArI naYa|

(upare yAdera kathA ullekha karA hala) tArA chila emana loka, AllAha yAderake (viruddhAcArIdera AcAra-AcaraNe savara karAra) hidAYAta karechilena| sutarAM (he navI!) tumio tAdera pathe calo| (viruddhavAdIdera) vale dAo, Ami era (arthAt dAoYAtera) janya tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA| eTA to vizvajagatera janya eka upadeza mAtra|

tArA (kAphiragaNa) AllAhara yathArtha maryAdA upalavdhi kareni, yakhana tArA valeche, AllAha konao mAnuSera prati kichu nAyila karenani| (tAderake) vala, mUsA ye kitAva niYe esechila tA ke nAyila karechila, yA mAnuSera janya Alo o hidAYAta chila evaM yA tomarA vibhinna pRSThA AkAre rekhe diYechile, yA(-ra madhya hate kichu) tomarA prakAza kara evaM yAra anekAMza tomarA gopana kara evaM (yAra mAdhyame) tomAderake emana sava viSaYa zikSA deoYA haYechila, yA tomarA jAnate nA evaM tomAdera vApa-dAdAgaNao naYa| (he navI!) tumi nijei (e praznera uttare) vale dAo, se kitAva nAyila karechilena) AllAha| tArapara tAderake cher3e dAo, tArA tAdera vehudA kathAvArtAYa lipta theke Ananda-phUrti karate thAkuka|

evaM eTA eka varakatamaYa kitAva, yA Ami nAyila karechi, yA tAra pUrvavartI AsamAnI hidAYAtasamUhera samarthaka, Ara yAte tumi era mAdhyame janapadasamUhera kendra (makkA) o tAra AzapAzera lokaderake satarka kara| yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa rAkhe, tArA era pratio vizvAsa rAkhe evaM tArA tAdera nAmAyera paripUrNa rakSaNAvekSaNa kare|

sei vyakti apekSA var3a jAlima Ara ke hate pAre, ye AllAha samvandhe mithyA racanA kare kiMvA vale, AmAra prati ohI nAyila karA haYeche, athaca tAra prati konao ohI nAyila karA haYani evaM ye vale, AllAha ye kAlAma nAyila karechena, Amio anurUpa nAyila karava? tumi yadi sei samaYa dekha (tave var3a bhaYAla dRzya dekhate pAve) yakhana jAlimagaNa mRtyu yantraNAYa AkrAnta have evaM phirizatAgaNa tAdera hAta vAr3iYe (valate thAkave), nijedera prANa vera kara, Aja tomAderake lAJchanAkara zAsti deoYA have, yehetu tomarA AllAhara prati mithyA kathA Aropa karate evaM yehetu tomarA tAra nidarzanAvalIra viparIte auddhatya prakAza karate|

(kiYAmatera dina AllAha tAAlA tAderake valavena,) tomarA AmAra kAche niHsaGga avasthAYa esecha, yemana Ami prathame tomAderake sRSTi karechilAma| Ara Ami tomAderake yA-kichu dAna karechilAma, tA tomAdera pechane phele esecha| Ami tomAdera sAthe tomAdera sei supArizakArIgaNake dekhachi nA, yAdera samparke tomAdera dAvI chila, tArA tomAdera vyApAre (AmAra) zarIka| prakRtapakSe tAdera sAthe tomAdera samasta samparka chinna haYe geche evaM yAdera (arthAt ye devatAdera) samparke tomAdera dhAraNA chila (ye, tArA tomAdera sAhAyya karave), tArA sakale tomAdera theke hAriYe geche|

nizcaYa AllAhai zasyavIja o A~Ti vidIrNakArI| tini prANahIna vastu hate prANavAna vastu nirgata karena evaM tinii prANavAna vastu hate niSprANa vastura nirgatakArI| he mAnuSa! tinii AllAha| sutarAM tomAderake vibhrAnta kare kothAYa niYe yAoYA hacche?
(tinii) bhorera udaghATaka| tinii rAtake vAniYechena vizrAmera samaYa evaM sUrya o candrake karechena eka hisAvera anuvartI| e samasta mahAparAkramazAlI, sarvajJa sattAra parikalpanA|

tinii tomAdera janya nakSatrasamUha sRSTi karechena, yAte tAra mAdhyame tomarA sthala o samudrera andhakAre patha jAnate pAra| Ami nidarzanAvalI spaSTa kare diYechi, sei sakala lokera janya, yArA jJAnake kAje lAgAYa|

tinii sei sattA, yini tomAdera sakalake ekai vyakti hate sRSTi karechena| ataHpara (pratyekera raYeche) eka avasthAnasthala o eka AmAnata sthala| Ami nidarzanasamUha spaSTa kare diYechi, sei sakala lokera janya, yArA vujha-samajha rAkhe|

Ara AllAha tinii, yini (tomAdera janya) AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena, tArapara Ami tA dvArA sarvaprakAra udbhidera cArA udagata karechi, tArapara tA theke savuja gAchapAlA janmiYechi, yA theke Ami thare thare vinyasta zasyadAnA utpanna kari evaM khejura gAchera cumari theke (phala-bhAre) jhulanta kA~di nirgata kari evaM Ami AGgura vAgAna udagata karechi evaM yAYatuna o AnArao| tAra ekaTi anyaTira sadRza o visadRzao| yakhana se vRkSa phala deYa, takhana tAra phalera prati o tAra pAkAra avasthAra prati gabhIrabhAve lakSya kara| esavera madhye sei sakala lokera janya nidarzana raYeche, yArA ImAna Ane|

loke jinaderake AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta kareche, athaca AllAhai tAderake sRSTi karechena evaM tArA ajJatAvazata tA~ra janya putra-kanyA gar3e niYeche, athaca tArA (AllAhara samparke) yA-kichu vale, tini tA theke pavitra o vahu Urdhve|
(tini) AsamAna o yamInera sraSTA| tAra konao santAna have ki kare, yakhana tAra konao strI nei? tinii sakala vastu sRSTi karechena| tini sakala vastu samparke paripUrNa jJAna rAkhena|
tinii AllAha, yini tomAdera pratipAlaka| tini chAr3A konao mAvuda nei| tini yAvatIYa vastura sraSTA| sutarAM tA~rai ivAdata kara| tini sava kichura tattvAvadhAYaka|
dRSTisamUha tA~ke dharate pAre nA, kintu dRSTisamUha tAra AYattAdhIna| tA~ra sattA ati sUkSma evaM tini sarva viSaYe avagata|

(he navI! tAderake vala,) tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate jJAna-vartikA ese geche| sutarAM ye vyakti cokha khule dekhave se nijerai kalyANa karave, Ara ye vyakti andha haYe thAkave se nijerai kSati karave| Ara Ami tomAdera rakSaNAvekSaNera dAYitvazIla nai|

ebhAvei Ami nidarzanAvalI vibhinna prakAre vivRta kare thAki, (yAte tumi tA mAnuSera kAche peৗ~chAo) evaM parizeSe tArA vale, tumi (kArao kAche) zikSA lAbha karecha; Ara yArA jJAnake kAje lAgAYa, tAdera janya Ami satyake suspaSTa kare dei|
(he navI!) tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAra prati ye ohI pAThAno haYeche, tumi tArai anusaraNa kara| tini chAr3A konao mAvuda nei| yArA (AllAhara saGge) ziraka kare, tAdera agrAhya kara|
AllAha cAile tArA ziraka karata nA| Ami tomAke tAdera rakSaka niyukta karini evaM tumi tAdera (kAja-karmera) yimmAdArao nao|

(he musalimagaNa!) tArA AllAhara parivarte yAderake (bhrAnta mAvudaderake) DAke, tomarA tAderake gAlamanda karo nA| kenanA pariNAme tArA ajJAtavazata sImAlaMghana kare AllAhakeo gAlamanda karave| (e duniYAYa to) Ami ebhAvei pratyeka jAtira dRSTite tAdera kAryakalApake suzobhana kare diYechi| ataHpara tAderake nija pratipAlakera kAchei phire yete have| takhana tini tAderake tArA yA-kichu karata se samvandhe avahita karavena|

tArA AllAhara nAme ati jorAlo kasama kheYe vale, tAdera kAche yadi satyai kona nidarzana (arthAt tAdera kAGkhita mujiyA) Ase, tave tArA avazyai tAte ImAna Anave| (tAderake) vale dAo, samasta nidarzana AllAhara hAte evaM (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA kibhAve jAnave, prakRtapakSe tA (arthAt tAdera kAGkhita mujiyA) Asaleo tArA ImAna Anave nA|

tArA yemana prathamavAra era (arthAt kuraAnera mata mujiyAra) prati ImAna Aneni, temani Ami, (tAra pratiphalasvarUpa) tAdera antara o dRSTi anya dike phiriYe deva evaM tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAra madhye udbhrAnta haYe ghure ver3Ate deva|

Ami yadi tAdera kAche phirizatA pAThiYeo ditAma evaM mRta vyaktirA tAdera sAthe kathAo valata evaM (tAdera pharamAYezI) sakala jinisa tAdera cokhera sAmane hAjira kare ditAma, tavuo tArA ImAna AnavAra chila nA| avazya AllAha yadi cAitena (ye, tAderake jorapUrvaka ImAna Anate vAdhya karavena, tave seTA chila bhinna kathA, kintu erUpa ImAna kAmya o dhartavya naYa)| kintu tAdera madhye adhikAMza loka ajJatAsulabha kathA vale|

evaM (tArA yemana AmAra navIra sAthe zatrutA karache) ebhAvei Ami (pUrvavartI) pratyeka navIra janya konao nA konao zatrura janma diYechi arthAt mAnava o jinadera madhya hate zaYatAna kisimera lokaderake, yArA dheA~kA deoYAra uddezye eke anyake var3a camatkAra kathA zekhAta| AllAha cAile tArA erUpa karate pArata nA| sutarAM tAderake tAdera mithyA racanAra kAje par3e thAkate dAo|

evaM (navIdera zatrurA camatkAra-camatkAra kathA vale) ejanya yAte AkhirAte yArA ImAna rAkhe nA, tAdera antara se dike AkRSTa haYa evaM tArA tAte magna thAke Ara tArA ye sava apakarma karAra tA karate thAke|

(he navI! tAderake vala,) Ami ki AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke sAlisa vAnAva, athaca tinii tomAdera prati e kitAva nAyila karechena vistArita vivaraNarUpe? (pUrve) yAderake Ami kitAva diYechilAma, tArA nizcitabhAve jAne, eTA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke satya niYe avatIrNa haYeche| sutarAM kichutei tumi sandihAnadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
tomAra pratipAlakera vANI satya o nyAYera dika theke paripUrNa| tA~ra kathAra konao parivartanakArI nei| tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

tumi yadi pRthivIra adhikAMza vAsindAra pechane cala, tave tArA tomAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karave| tArA to dhAraNA o anumAna chAr3A anya kichura anugamana kare nA| evaM tArA kevala anumAnabhittika kathAi valA|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka bhAlo kare jAnena, ke tAra patha theke vicyuta haYa evaM tinii bhAlo kare jAnena, kArA satpathe Ache|
sutarAM emana sava (hAlAla) pazu theke khAo, yAte AllAhara nAma neoYA haYeche yadi tomarA satyii tAra nidarzanAvalIte ImAna rAkha|

tomAdera janya emana kI vAdhA Ache, yaddaruna tomarA ye sakala pazute AllAhara nAma neoYA haYeche tA theke khAo nA? athaca tini tomAdera janya (sAdhAraNa avasthAYa) yA-kichu hArAma karechena tA tini tomAderake vizadabhAve jAniYe diYechena, tave tomarA yA khete vAdhya haYe yAo (tAra kathA bhinna| hArAma haoYA sattveo takhana tA khAoYAra anumati thAke)| vahu loka konao rakamera jJAna chAr3A (kevala) nijedera kheYAla-khuzIra bhittite (anyaderake) vipathagAmI kare| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka sImAlaMghanakArIdera samparke savizeSa avahita|
tomarA prakAzya o gupta ubhaYa prakAra pApa cher3e dAo| nizcaYai yArA pApa kAmAi kare, tAderake zIghrai sei samasta aparAdhera zAsti deoYA have, yAte tArA lipta haYa|

ye pazute AllAhara nAma neoYA haYani, tA theke kheo nA| erUpa karA kaThina gunAha| (he musalimagaNa!) zaYatAnerA tAdera vandhuderake tomAdera sAthe vitarka karAra janya prarocanA dite thAke| tomarA yadi tAdera kathA mata cala tave tomarA avazyai muzarika haYe yAve|

ekaTu vala to, ye vyakti chila mRta, ataHpara Ami tAke jIvana diYechi evaM tAra janya eka Alora vyavasthA karechi, yAra sAhAyye se mAnuSera madhye calApherA kare, se ki oi vyaktira mata hate pAre, yAra avasthA ei ye, se andhakAra dvArA pariveSTita, yA theke se kakhanao vera hate pArave nA? ebhAvei kApheradera dRSTite tAdera kRtakarmake AkarSaNIYa kare tolA haYeche|

ebhAvei Ami pratyeka janapade aparAdhIdera pradhAnaderake (musalimadera viruddhe) cakrAnta karAra avakAza diYechi| tArA ye cakrAnta kare, (prakRtapakSe) tA anya kArao naYa; varaM tAdera nijederai viruddhe yAYa, kintu tArA tA upalavdhi kare nA|

yakhana tAdera (arthAt makkAvAsIdera) kAche (kuraAnera) kona AYAta Ase, takhana vale, AllAhara rAsUlagaNake yA deoYA haYechila, se rakama jinisa AmAderake yatakSaNa paryanta nA deoYA have, tatakSaNa paryanta AmarA kichutei ImAna Anava nA| athaca AllAhai bhAlo jAnena, tini tA~ra risAlAta kAra upara nyasta karavena| yArA (e jAtIYa) anyAYa ukti kareche, tAderake tAdera Sar3ayantrera pratiphala hiseve AllAhara kAche (giYe) lAJchanA o kaThina zAstira sammukhIna hate have|

AllAha yAke hidAYAta dAnera icchA karena, tAra vakSa isalAmera janya khule dena; Ara yAke (tAra haThakAritAra kAraNe) pathabhraSTa karAra icchA karena, tAra vakSa atizaYa saMkIrNa kare dena (phale ImAna AnaYana tAra pakSe emana kaThina haYe yAYa), yena tAke javaradastimUlakabhAve AkAze car3ate hacche| yArA ImAna Ane nA, AllAha ebhAvei tAdera upara (kupharera) kAlimA lepana karena|
evaM eTA (arthAt isalAma) tomAra pratipAlakera (deoYA) sarala patha| upadeza grahaNa kare emana sampradAYera janya (e pathera) nidarzanAvalI spaSTarUpe varNanA kare diYechi|
tAdera janyai tAdera pratipAlakera kAche raYeche sukhaNDazAntira nivAsa| Ara tArA yA-kichu kare tAra daruNa tinii tAdera rakSAkartA|

(sei dinera kathA mane rekha) ye dina AllAha tAdera sakalake ekatra karavena (evaM duSTa jinaderake valavena), he jina sampradAYa! tomarA vipula saMkhyaka mAnuSake pathabhraSTa karecha| mAnuSera madhye yArA tAdera vandhu, tArA valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA eke anyera dvArA Ananda upabhoga karechi evaM ekhana AmarA AmAdera sei samaYe upanIta haYechi, yA Apani AmAdera janya nirdhAraNa karechilena| AllAha valavena, (ekhana) Agunai tomAdera ThikAnA, yAte tomarA sarvadA thAkave yadi nA AllAha anya rakama icchA karena| nizcaYai tomAdera pratipAlaka hikamataoYAlA, sarvajJa|
ebhAvei Ami jAlemadera katakake katakera upara tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe Adhipatya dAna kare thAki|

he jina o mAnava jAti! tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera nijedera madhya hate emana rAsUla Aseni, yArA tomAderake AmAra AYAta par3e zonAta evaM tomAderake e dinera sammukhIna haoYAra vyApAre satarka karata, ye dine Aja tomarA upanIta haYecha? tArA valave, (Aja) AmarA nijerAi nijedera viruddhe sAkSya dilAma (ye, satyii AmAdera kAche navI-rAsUla esechilena, kintu AmarA tAderake pratyAkhyAna karechilAma)| (prakRtapakSe) pArthiva jIvana tAderake dheA~kAYa nikSepa karechila| Ara Aja tArA nijedera viruddhe sAkSya dila ye, tArA kAphera chila|
eTA (arthAt navI preraNera dhArA) chila ejanya ye, konao janapadake sImAlaMghanera kAraNe e avasthAYa dhvaMsa karA tomAra pratipAlakera pachanda chila nA ye, tAra adhivAsIgaNa anavahita thAkave|
sava dharanera lokera janya tAdera kRtakarma anusAre vibhinna stara raYeche| tArA yA-kichui kare se samvandhe tomAra pratipAlaka udAsIna nana|

tomAra pratipAlaka veniYAya, daYAzIlao vaTe| tini icchA karale tomAdera sakalake (pRthivI theke) apasAraNa karate evaM tomAdera pare tomAdera sthAne yAke cAna AnaYana karate pArena yemana tomAderake tini anya eka sampradAYera vaMza hate sRSTi karechena|
nizcaYai tomAderake ye jinisera oYAdA deoYA hacche, tAra Agamana avadhArita evaM tomarA (AllAhake) akSama karate pArave nA|

(he navI! oi sakala lokake) vala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA Apana sthAne (nijedera niYama anusAre) kAja karate thAka, Amio (nija niYama anusAre) kAja karachi| zIghrai jAnate pArave, e duniYAra pariNAma kAra anukUle yAYa| (Apana sthAne) eTA nizcita satya ye, jAlemagaNa kRtakArya haYa nA|

AllAha ye zasya o gavAdi pazu sRSTi karechena, tArA tAra madhye AllAhara janya ekaTi aMza nirdiSTa kareche| sutarAM tArA nija dhAraNA anuyAYI vale, e aMza AllAhara evaM eTA AmAdera zarIkadera (arthAt deva-devIdera)| ataHpara ye aMza tAdera zarIkadera janya, tA (kakhanao) AllAhara kAche peৗ~che nA, Ara ye aMza AllAhara janya, tA tAdera zarIkadera kAche peৗ~che| tArA yA sthira kare niYeche tA katai nA nikRSTa!

emanibhAve vahu muzarikake tAdera zarIkagaNa vujhiYe rekhechila ye, nija santAnake hatyA karA var3a bhAlo kAja, yAte tArA tAderake (arthAt muzarikaderake) sampUrNa dhvaMsa karate pAre evaM tAdera kAche tAdera dInake vibhrAntipUrNa kare dite pAre| AllAha cAile tArA erUpa karate pArata nA| sutarAM tAderake tAdera mithyAcArera madhye par3e thAkate dAo|

tArA vale, ei sava gavAdi pazu o zasyate niSedhAjJA Aropita Ache| tAdera dhAraNA ei ye, AmarA yAderake icchA karava tArA chAr3A anya keu esava khete pArave nA evaM kataka gavAdi pazu emana, yAdera piThake niSiddha karA haYeche evaM kichu pazu emana, yAra yavAhakAle AllAhara nAma neYa nA (esavai tArA kare) tA~ra (arthAt AllAhara) prati mithyAropa kare| tArA ye mithyAcAra karache, AllAha zIghrai tAra pratiphala tAderake devena|

tArA Arao vale, ei vizeSa gavAdi pazugulira garbhe ye vAccA Ache, tA AmAdera puruSadera janya nirdiSTa evaM AmAdera nArIdera janya hArAma| Ara tA yadi mRta haYa, tave tAte (nArI-puruSa) sakale aMzIdAra hata| tArA ye sava kathA tairi karache zIghrai AllAha tAderake tAra pratiphala devena| nizcaYai AllAha prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

prakRtapakSe yArA kona jJAnagata bhitti chAr3A nichaka nirvuddhitAvazata nijedera santAna hatyA kareche evaM AllAha pradatta riyakake AllAhara prati mithyAropa karataH hArAma sAvyasta kareche, tArA avazyai kSatigrasta haYeche| nizcaYai tArA gomarAha haYeche evaM tArA kakhanao hidAYAtaprApta chila nA|

AllAha tini, yini udyAnasamUha sRSTi karechena, (yAra madhye) kataka (latAyukta, yA) mAcA Azrita evaM kataka mAcA Azrita naYa| evaM khejura gAcha, vibhinna svAdera khAdyazasya, yAYatuna o AnAra (sRSTi karechena) yA paraspara sAdRzyapUrNa evaM sAdRzyavihInao| yakhana esava gAcha phala deYa takhana tAra phala theke khAve evaM phala kATAra dina AllAhara haka AdAYa karave evaM apacaYa karave nA| (mane rekha,) tini apacaYakArIdera pachanda karena nA|

tini gavAdi pazura madhye kataka (sRSTi karechena), bhAravAhIrUpe evaM katakake mATira sAthe| AllAha tomAderake ye riyaka diYechena, tA theke khAo evaM zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA| nizcaYai, se tomAdera eka prakAzya zatru|

AllAha (gavAdi pazura) moTa ATa prakAra (sRSTi karechena)| du’ prakAra (nara o mAdI) bher3AYa o du’ prakAra chAgale| (tAderake) jijJesa kara to, tini ki nara du’Tokei hArAma karechena, nA mAdI du’Toke? nA ki emana pratyeka vAccAke, yA (ubhaYa zreNIra) mAdI du’Tira garbhe Ache? tomarA satyavAdI hale konao jJAnera bhittite AmAke jAnAo|

emanibhAve uTerao du’Ti prakAra (nara o mAdI) (sRSTi karechena) evaM garurao du’Ti| (tAderake) vala, nara du’Tokei ki AllAha hArAma karechena, nA mAdI du’Tike? nA ki emana pratyeka vAccAke, yA (ubhaYa zreNIra) mAdI du’Tira garbhe Ache| AllAha yakhana esava nirdeza dAna karena, takhana ki tomarA upasthita chile? (yadi tA nA thAka evaM nizcaYai chile nA,) tave sei vyakti apekSA var3a jAlema Ara ke have, ye konao jJAnera bhitti chAr3Ai mAnuSake vibhrAnta karAra lakSye AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare? prakRtapakSe AllAha jAlema lokaderake satpathe peৗ~chAna nA|

(he navI! tAderake) vala, AmAra prati ye ohI nAyila karA haYeche, tAte Ami emana konao jinisa pAi nA, yA konao AhArakArIra janya hArAma, tave yadi tA mRta jantu vA vahamAna rakta kiMvA zUkarera gozata haYa (tA hArAma)| kenanA tA nApAka| athavA yadi haYa emana gunAhera pazu, yAke AllAha chAr3A anya kArao nAme yavAha karA haYeche| hA~ ye vyakti (esava vastura madhye konaoTi khete) vAdhya haYe yAYa, Ara tAra uddezya majA loTA nA haYa evaM praYojanera sImA atikrama nA kare, tave nizcaYai tomAra ravva (AllAha) ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ami iYAhudIdera janya nakharaviziSTa sakala jantu hArAma karechilAma evaM garu o chAgala theke tAdera janya hArAma karechilAma tAdera carvi, tave ye carvi tAdera piTha vA antre lege thAke vA yA kona asthite thAke (tA vyatikrama chila)| ei zAsti Ami tAderake diYechilAma tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe| nizcaYai Ami satyavAdI|
tAraparao yadi tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa) tomAke asvIkAra kare, tave vale dAo, tomAdera pratipAlaka sarvavyApI daYAra mAlika evaM aparAdhIdera theke tAra zAsti TalAno yAYa nA|

yArA ziraka avalamvana kareche, tArA valave, AllAha cAile AmarA ziraka karatAma nA evaM AmAdera vApa-dAdArAo nA; Ara nA AmarA konao vastuke hArAma sAvyasta karatAma| tAdera pUrvavartI lokeo (rAsUlagaNake) ebhAvei asvIkAra karechila, parizeSe tArA AmAra zAsti bhoga karechila| tumi (tAderake) vala, tomAdera kAche ki emana konao jJAna Ache, yA AmAra sAmane vera karate pAra? tomarA kevala kalpanArai anusaraNa kara evaM zudhu AnumAnika kathAi vala|
(he navI! tAderake) vala, cUr3Anta pramANa to AllAharai Ache, sutarAM tini cAile tomAdera sakalake (jorapUrvaka) hidAYAtera upara niYe Asatena|

(tAderake) vala, tomarA tomAdera sei sakala sAkSIke upasthita kara, yArA sAkSya deve ye, AllAha esava hArAma karechena| yadi tArA sAkSya deYao, tavuo tumi tAdera saGge sAkSya diYo nA| Ara tumi sei sakala lokera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa karo nA, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche, yArA AkhirAtera upara ImAna rAkhe nA evaM yArA (anyaderake) tAdera pratipAlakera samakakSa gaNya kare|

(tAderake) vala, eso, tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera prati yA-kichu hArAma karechena, Ami tA (tomAderake) par3e zonAi| tA ei ye, tomarA tAra saGge kAuke zarIka karo nA, pitA-mAtAra saGge sadvyavahAra karo, dAridryera bhaYe tomarA nija santAnaderake hatyA karo nA, Ami tomAderakeo riyaka dei evaM tAderakeo| Ara tomarA prakAzya o gopana konao rakama azlIla kAjera nikaTeo yeYo nA Ara AllAha ye prANake maryAdA dAna karechena, tAke yathArtha kAraNa chAr3A hatyA karo nA| ei sava viSaYe, AllAha tomAderake Adeza karechena, yAte tomarA upalavdhi kara|

iYAtIma paripakka vaYase nA peৗ~chA paryanta tAra sampadera nikaTeo yeYo nA, tave emana panthAYa (yAve, tAra pakSe) yA uttama haYa evaM parimApa o ojana nyAYAnugabhAve paripUrNa karave| Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyAtIta kaSTa dei nA| evaM yakhana (konao kathA) valave, takhana nyAyya valave, yadio nikaTAtmIYera viSaYe haYa| Ara AllAhara pratizruti pUrNa karave| AllAha esava viSaYe tomAderake gurutvera sAthe Adeza karechena, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

(he navI! tAderake) Arao vala, eTA AmAra sarala-saThika patha| sutarAM era anusaraNa kara, anya konao pathera anusaraNa karo nA, karale tA tomAderake AllAhara patha theke vicchinna kare deve| esava viSaYe AllAha tomAderake gurutvera sAthe Adeza karechena, yAte tomarA muttAkI hate pAra|

evaM mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma satkarmazIladera prati (AllAha ni‘Amatera) pUrNatA, sava kichura vizada vivaraNa, (mAnuSera janya) patha nirdeza o rahamatasvarUpa, yAte tArA (AkhirAte) tAdera pratipAlakera sAkSAta samparke ImAna Ane|
(emanibhAve) eTA eka varakatapUrNa kitAva, yA Ami nAyila karachi| sutarAM era anusaraNa kara o tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, yAte tomAdera prati rahamata varSaNa haYa|

(Ami e kitAva nAyila karechi ejanya ye,) pAche tomarA kakhanao vala, kitAva to nAyila karA haYechila AmAdera pUrvera du’Ti sampradAYa (iYAhudI o khrisTAna)-era prati| AmarA tAra pATha samparke vilakula ajJAta chilAma|

kiMvA tomarA vala, AmAdera prati kitAva nAyila karA hale AmarA avazyai tAdera (arthAt iYAhudI o khrisTAnadera) ceYe vezi hidAYAtaprApta hatAma| kAjei tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka ujjvala pramANa evaM hidAYAta o rahamata ese geche| ataHpara ye-keu AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karave o tA theke mukha phiriYe neve, tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke have? yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha theke mukha phiriYe nicche, Ami tAderake tAdera satyavimukhatAra kAraNe nikRSTa zAsti deva|

tArA ki (ImAna AnAra janya) kevala erai apekSA karache ye, tAdera kAche phirizatA Asave vA tomAra pratipAlaka nije Asavena athavA tomAra pratipAlakera kichu nidarzana Asave? (athaca) ye dina tomAra pratipAlakera konao nidarzana ese yAve, se dina emana vyaktira ImAna tAra kona kAje Asave nA, ye vyakti pUrve ImAna Aneni kiMvA nija ImAnera sAthe kona satkarma arjana kareni| (sutarAM tAderake) vale dAo, tomarA apekSA kara, AmarAo apekSAYa Achi|

(he navI!) nizcaYai yArA nijedera dInera madhye vibheda sRSTi kareche evaM vibhinna dale vibhakta haYe par3eche, tAdera sAthe tomAra konao samparka nei| tAdera viSaYa to AllAharai upara nyasta| ataHpara tArA yA-kichu karache, tini tAderake tA jAnAvena|

ye vyakti konao puNya niYe Asave, tAra janya anurUpa tAra dazaguNa (saoYAva) raYeche| Ara ye vyakti konao asatkarma niYe Asave, tAke kevala tArai samAna pratiphala deoYA have| Ara tAdera prati konao juluma karA have nA|

(he navI!) vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke ekaTi sarala pathe paricAlita karechena, yA supratiSThita dIna; ivarAhImera millAta, ye ekaniSThabhAve nijeke AllAhaabhimukhI kare rekhechila; Ara se chila nA zirakakArIdera antarbhukta|
vale dAo, nizcaYai AmAra nAmAya, AmAra ivAdata o AmAra jIvana-maraNa savai AllAhara janya, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
tA~ra konao zarIka nei| AmAke erai hukuma deoYA haYeche evaM Anugatya svIkArakArIdera madhye Amii prathama|

vale dAo, Ami ki AllAha chAr3A anya konao pratipAlaka sandhAna karava, athaca tini pratiTi jinisera mAlika? pratyeka vyakti yA-kichu kare, tAra lAbha-kSati anya kArao upara naYa, svaYaM tAra uparai vartAYa evaM konao bhAra-vahanakArI anya kArao bhAra vahana karave nA| parizeSe tomAra pratipAlakera kAchei tomAdera sakalake phire yete have| tomarA ye sava viSaYe matabheda karate, takhana tini se samparke tomAderake avahita karavena|

evaM tinii sei sattA, yini pRthivIte tomAdera katakake katakera sthalAbhiSikta karechena evaM katakake katakera upara maryAdAYa unnIta karechena, yAte tini tomAderake yA kichu diYechena se samvandhe tomAderake parIkSA karate pArena| nizcaYa, tomAra pratipAlaka druta zAstidAtA evaM nizcaYai, tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Alipha-lAma-mIma-sAda|

(he navI! eTi) ekakhAni kitAva, yA tomAra prati avatIrNa karA haYeche, yAte tumi era dvArA (mAnuSake) satarka kara| sutarAM era kAraNe tomAra antare yena kona kuNThA dekhA nA deYa evaM eTA muminadera janya eka upadezavANI|

(he mAnuSa!) tomAdera prati tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate ye kitAva nAyila karA haYeche, tAra anusaraNa kara evaM nijedera pratipAlakake cher3e anya (managar3A) abhibhAvakadera anusaraNa karo nA| (kintu) tomarA upadeza kamai grahaNa kara|
kata janapadakei Ami dhvaMsa karechi| AmAra zAsti tAdera kAche ese par3echila rAtera velA athavA dupure yakhana tArA vizrAma karachila|
yakhana AmAra zAsti tAdera upara Apatita haYechila, takhana tAdera to valAra kichui chila nA kevala tAdera ei kathA chAr3A ye, vAstavikai AmarA jAlema chilAma|
ataHpara yAdera nikaTa rAsUla pAThAno haYechila, Ami avazyai tAderake jijJAsAvAda karava evaM Ami rAsUlagaNakeo jijJesa karava (ye, tArA ki vArtA peৗ~chiYechila evaM tArA kI javAva peYechila?)|
ataHpara Ami svaYaM tAdera sAmane nija jJAnera bhittite (yAvatIYa ghaTanA) varNanA karava| (kenanA) Ami to (se sava ghaTanAkAle) anupasthita chilAma nA|
evaM se dina (AmalasamUhera) ojana (karAra viSaYaTi) ekaTi akATya satya| sutarAM yAdera pAllA bhArI have, tArAi have kRtakArya|
Ara yAdera pAllA hAlakA have, tArAi to sei sava loka, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera vyApAre sImAlaMghana kare nijederakei kSatigrasta kareche|
Ami to pRthivIte tomAderake thAkAra jAYagA diYechi evaM tAte tomAdera janya jIvikAra vyavasthAo karechi| tathApi tomarA alpai kRtajJatA AdAYa kara|

evaM Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi, tArapara tomAdera AkRti gaThana karechi, tArapara phirizatAderake valechi, Adamake sijadA kara| sutarAM sakale sijadA karala, ivalIsa chAr3A| se sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hala nA|

AllAha valalena, Ami yakhana toke Adeza karalAma takhana kise toke sijadA karA hate virata rAkhala? se valala, Ami tAra ceYe uttama| tumi AmAke Aguna dvArA sRSTi karecha, Ara tAke sRSTi karecha mATi dvArA|
AllAha valalena, tAhale tui ekhAna theke neme yA| kenanA tora ei adhikAra nei ye, ekhAne (theke) ahaMkAra karavi| sutarAM vera haYe yA| tui hInadera antarbhukta|
se valala, ye dina mAnuSake (kavara theke) jIvita kare tolA have, sei dina paryanta AmAke (jIvita thAkAra) suyoga dAo|
AllAha valalena, toke suyoga deoYA hala|
se valala, tumi yehetu AmAke pathabhraSTa karecha, tAi Amio zapatha karachi ye, Ami tAdera (arthAt mAnuSera) janya tomAra sarala pathe OMt pete vase thAkava|

tArapara Ami (cArao dika theke) tAdera upara hAmalA karava, tAdera sammukha theke, tAdera pichana theke, tAdera DAna dika theke evaM tAdera vAma dika thekeo| Ara tumi tAdera adhikAMzakei kRtajJa pAve nA|
AllAha valalena, ekhAna theke dhikRta o vitAr3ita haYe vera haYe yA| tAdera madhye yArA tora pichane calave (tArAo tora saGgI have), Ami todera sakalake diYe jAhAnnAma bharava|

evaM he Adama! tumi o tomAra strI ubhaYe jAnnAte vAsa kara evaM yekhAna theke (ye vastu) icchA haYa khAo, tave ei (vizeSa) gAchaTira kAcheo yeYo nA| gele tomarA (du’jana) sImAlaMghanakArIdera antarbhukta have|

ataHpara (ei ghaTala ye,) zaYatAna tAdera antare kumantraNA dila, yAte tAdera lajjAsthAna, yA tAdera theke gopana rAkhA haYechila, tAdera parasparera sAmane prakAza karate pAre| se valate lAgala, tomAdera pratipAlaka anya konao kAraNe naYa; varaM kevala e kAraNei ei gAcha theke tomAderake vAraNa karechilena, pAche tomarA phirizatA haYe yAo kiMvA tomarA sthAYI jIvana lAbha kara|
se tAdera sAmane kasama kheYe valala, vizvAsa kara, Ami tomAdera kalyANakAmIdera ekajana|

ebhAve se ubhaYake dheA~kA diYe nice nAmiYe dila| sutarAM yakhana tArA se gAchera svAda grahaNa karala, takhana tAdera ubhaYera lajjAsthAna ubhaYera kAche prakAza haYe gela| anantara tArA jAnnAtera kichu pAtA (jor3A diYe) nijedera zarIre jar3Ate lAgala| takhana tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake Deke valalena, Ami ki tomAderake e gAcha theke vAraNa karini evaM tomAderake valini, zaYatAna tomAdera prakAzya zatru?

tArA valala, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA nija sattAra upara juluma kare phelechi| Apani yadi AmAderake kSamA nA karena o AmAdera prati rahama nA karena, tave AmarA avazyai akRtakAryadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|
AllAha (Adama, tAra strI o ivalIsake) valalena, tomarA sakale ekhAna theke neme yAo, eke anyera zatrurUpe| Ara pRthivIte tomAdera janya raYeche ekaTA kAla paryanta avasthAna o kSANikaTA bhoga|
tini valalena, sekhAnei (pRthivIte) jIvana yApana karave, sekhAnei tomAdera mRtyu have evaM sekhAna thekei tomAderake punarAYa (jIvita kare) oThAno have|

he Adamera santAna-santati! Ami tomAdera janya pozAkera vyavasthA karechi, yA tomAdera dehera ye aMza prakAza karA dUSaNIYa tA AvRta kare evaM tA zobhAsvarUpa| vastuta tAkaoYAra ye pozAka, seTAi sarveAttama| esava AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra anyatama, yAte mAnuSa upadeza grahaNa kare|

he Adamera santAna-santatigaNa! zaYatAna yena kichutei tomAderake pratArita karate nA pAre, yemana se tomAdera pitA-mAtAke jAnnAta theke vera karechila| se tAderake tAdera parasparera lajjAsthAna dekhAnora uddezye tAdera deha theke tAdera pozAka apasAraNa kariYechila| se o tAra dala emana sthAna theke tomAderake dekhe, yekhAna theke tomarA tAderake dekhate pAo nA| yArA ImAna Ane nA, Ami zaYatAnake tAdera vandhu vAniYe diYechi|

tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa) yakhana kona azlIla kAja kare, takhana vale, AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake erUpai karate dekhechi evaM AllAha AmAderake erai Adeza karechena| tumi (tAderake) vala, AllAha azlIlatAra Adeza karena nA| tomarA ki AllAhara samparke emana kathA valacha yA tomarA jAna nA?

vala, AmAra pratipAlaka to inasApha karAra hukuma diYechena evaM (Arao Adeza karechena ye,) yakhana (kothAo) sijadA karave, takhana nija rokha Thika rAkhave evaM tAke DAkave ei vizvAsera sAthe ye, Anugatya kevala tA~rai prApya| tini yebhAve prathame tomAderake sRSTi karechena, tomarA sebhAvei phire Asave|

(tomAdera madhye) ekaTi dalake AllAha hidAYAta dAna karechena evaM ekaTi dala emana, yAdera prati pathabhraSTatA avadhArita haYe geche| kenanA tArA AllAhake cher3e zaYatAnaderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kareche, Ara tArA mane karache ye, tArA sarala pathe pratiSThita Ache|

he Adamera santAna-santatigaNa! yakhanai tomarA konao masajide Asave, takhana nijedera zobhAra vastu (arthAt zarIrera pozAka) niYe Asave evaM khAo o pAna kara, kintu apavyaYa karo nA| AllAha apavyaYakArIderake pachanda karena nA|

vala, AllAha nija vAndAdera janya ye zobhAra upakaraNa sRSTi karechena, ke tA hArAma kareche? evaM (emanibhAve) utkRSTa jIvikAra vastusamUha? vala, esava pArthiva jIvane muminadera janya (evaM) kiYAmatera dine vizeSabhAve (tAderai)| yArA jJAnake kAje lAgAYa, tAdera janya ebhAvei Ami AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta kari|

vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlaka to hArAma karechena azlIla kAjasamUha prakAzya hoka vA gopana evaM sarvaprakAra gunAha, anyAYabhAve (kArao prati) sImAlaMghana, AllAha ye samparke konao pramANa avatIrNa karenani, emana jinisake AllAhara zarIka sAvyastakaraNa evaM AllAha samvandhe emana kathA valAke, ye samparke tomAdera vindumAtra jJAna nei|
pratyeka sampradAYera janya eka nirdiSTa samaYa Ache| yakhana tAdera sei nirdiSTa samaYa ese par3e, takhana tArA eka muhUrtao vilamva karate pAre nA evaM tvarAo karate pAre nA|

(mAnuSake sRSTi karAra samaYai AllAha tAAlA satarka kare diYechilena ye,) he vanI Adama! tomAdera kAche yadi tomAderai madhya hate kona rAsUla ese AmAra AYAtasamUha tomAderake par3e zonAYa, tave takhana yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave o nijederake saMzodhana karave, tAdera konao bhaYa dekhA deve nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche o ahaMkAravaze tA theke mukha phiriYe niYeche, tArA have jAhAnnAmavAsI| tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave|

sutarAM (vala), tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke have, ye AllAha samvandhe mithyA racanA kare athavA tAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kare? erUpa lokadera bhAgye (riyakera) yataTuku aMza lekhA Ache, tA tAdera nikaTa (duniYAra jIvane) peৗ~chavei| avazeSe yakhana AmAra prerita phirizatAgaNa tAdera rUha kavaja karAra janya tAdera nikaTa Asave takhana tArA valave, tArA kothAYa, AllAhara parivarte yAderake tomarA DAkate? tArA valave, tArA AmAdera theke antarhita haYeche evaM tArA nijerA nijedera viruddhe sAkSya deve ye, AmarA kAphera chilAma|

AllAha valavena, tomAdera pUrve jina o mAnuSadera yesava dala gata haYeche, tAdera sAthe tomarAo jAhAnnAme praveza kara| (ebhAve) yakhanai konao dala (jAhAnnAme) praveza karave, tArA apara dalake abhisampAta karave| emanaki yakhana ekera para eka sakale tAte giYe ekatra have, takhana tAdera paravartIgaNa pUrvavartIdera samparke valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! erAi AmAderake bhrAnta pathe paricAlita karechila| sutarAM ederake Aguna dvArA dviguNa zAsti dAo| AllAha valavena, pratyekera janyai dviguNa zAsti raYeche| kintu tomarA (ekhanao paryanta) jAna nA|
Ara tAdera pUrvavartIgaNa paravartIgaNake valave, AmAdera upara tomAdera konao zreSThatva nei| sutarAM tomarA tomAdera nija kRtakarmera kAraNe zAsti bhoga kara|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche evaM ahaMkArera sAthe tA theke mukha phiriYe niYeche, tAdera janya AkAzera darajAsamUha kholA have nA evaM tArA jAnnAte praveza karate pArave nA yatakSaNa nA su~iYera chidra diYe uTa praveza kare| ebhAvei Ami aparAdhIderake (tAdera kRtakarmera) vadalA dei|
tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmerai vichAnA evaM upara dika theke tArai AcchAdana| ebhAvei Ami jAlemaderake (tAdera kRtakarmera) pratiphala diYe thAki|
Ara yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche Ara (mane rAkhate have) Ami kArao prati tAra sAdhyera vezi bhAra arpaNa kari nA, tArAi have jAnnAtavAsI| tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave|

Ara (ihajIvane) tAdera vukera bhetara (pArasparika) kona kaSTa thAkale Ami tA vera kare deva| tAdera taladeze nahara vahamAna thAkave| Ara tArA valave, samasta zokara AllAhara, yini AmAderake ei sthAne peৗ~chiYechena| AllAha AmAderake nA peৗ~chAle AmarA kakhanai (e sthale) peৗ~chate pAratAma nA| vAstavikai AmAdera pratipAlakera rAsUlagaNa AmAdera kAche sampUrNa satya kathAi niYe esechilena| Ara tAderake Deke valA have, he mAnuSa! ei hala jAnnAta, tomarA ye Amala karate tArai bhittite tomAderake era uttarAdhikArI vAniYe deoYA haYeche|

Ara jAnnAtavAsIgaNa jAhAnnAmIderake Deke valave, AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAderake ye pratizruti diYechilena, AmarA to tA satya peYechi| evAra (tomarA vala), tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAderake ye pratizruti diYechilena, tomarAo ki tAke satya peYecha? tArA uttare valave, hA~| emanai samaYa tAdera madhye eka ghoSaka ghoSaNA karave, AllAhara lAnata jAlemadera prati-
yArA AllAhara pathe (mAnuSake) vAdhA dita evaM tAte vakratA sandhAna karata evaM yArA AkhirAtake asvIkAra karata|

evaM (jAnnAtavAsI o jAhAnnAmavAsI ei) ubhaYa dalera madhye ekaTi Ar3Ala thAkave| Ara ArApha-e (arthAt sei Ar3Alera uccatAYa) kichu loka thAkave, yArA pratyeka dalera lokake tAdera cihna dvArA cinate pArave| tArA jAnnAtavAsIderake Deke valave, tomAdera prati sAlAma| tArA (arthAt ArAphavAsI) takhanao paryanta jAnnAte praveza kareni, kintu tArA sAgrahe (tAra) AzAvAdI have|
Ara yakhana tAdera dRSTi jAhAnnAmavAsIdera prati phiriYe deoYA have, takhana tArA valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake oi jAlemadera saGge rekha nA|
ArAphavAsIgaNa ekadala lokake, yAderake tArA tAdera cihna dvArA cinave, DAka diYe valave, tomAdera saMgRhIta saJcaYa tomAdera konao kAje Asala nA evaM tomarA yAderake var3a mane karate tArAo nA|

(ataHpara jAnnAtavAsIdera prati izArA kare valave,) erAi ki tArA, yAdera samparke tomarA zapatha kare valate, AllAha tAderake nija rahamatera konao aMza devena nA? (tAderake to vale deoYA haYeche,) tomarA jAnnAte praveza kara| tomAdera konao bhaYa nei evaM tomarA konao duHkherao sammukhIna have nA|

Ara jAhAnnAmavAsIgaNa jAnnAtavAsIderake Deke valave, AmAdera upara sAmAnya kichu pAnii Dhele dAo athavA AllAha tomAderake ye niYAmata diYechena tAra kichu aMza (AmAdera kAche peৗ~che dAo)| tArA uttara deve, AllAha e du’To jinisa oi kApheradera janya hArAma kare diYechena-

yArA nijedera dInake krIr3A-kautukera vastute pariNata karechila evaM yAderake pArthiva jIvana dheA~kAYa phele rekhechila| sutarAM Aja Ami tAderake vismRta hava, yebhAve tArA bhule giYechila ye, tAderake ei dinera sammukhIna hate have evaM yebhAve tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake prakAzye asvIkAra karata|
vastuta Ami tAdera kAche emana eka kitAva upasthita karechi, yAra bhetara Ami (AmAra) jJAnera bhittite (pratiTi viSaYera) vizada vyAkhyA karechi| yArA ImAna Ane, tAdera pakSe eTA hidAYAta o rahamata|

kAphiragaNa ki ei kitAve varNita zeSa pariNAmerai apekSA karache? (athaca) ei kitAvera varNita zeSa pariNAma ye dina Asave se dina, yArA pUrve se pariNAmera kathA bhule giYechila tArA valave, vAstavikai AmAdera pratipAlakera rAsUlagaNa satyavANI niYei esechilena| ekhana AmAdera ki emana kona supArizakArI lAbha have, yArA AmAdera pakSe supAriza karave? athavA AmAderake ki punarAYa (duniYAYa) pherata pAThAno have, yAte AmarA ye (manda) kAja karatAma tAra viparIta kAja karate pAri? vastuta tArA nijerAi nijedera lokasAne pheleche evaM tArA yA-kichu gar3e rekhechila (arthAt tAdera devatAgaNa), tArA tAdera theke antarhita haYeche|

nizcaYai tomAdera pratipAlaka sei AllAha, yini samasta AsamAna o yamIna chaYa dine sRSTi karena| tArapara tini Araze istioYA grahaNa karena| tini dinake rAtera dvArA Dheke dena, yA drutagatite dhAvita haYe tAke dhare phele| evaM sUrya, candra o tArakArAji (sRSTi karechena), yA savai tA~rai AjJAdhIna| smaraNa rekha, sRSTi o Adeza dAna tA~rai kAja| AllAha ati varakatamaYa, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
tomarA vinItabhAve o cupisAre nijedera pratipAlakake DAka| nizcaYai tini sImAlaMghana- kArIderake pachanda karena nA|
evaM pRthivIte zAnti pratiSThAra para tAte azAnti vistAra karo nA evaM (antare tA~ra) bhaYa o AzA rekhe tA~ra ivAdata kara| nizcaYai AllAhara rahamata satkarmazIladera nikaTavartI|

evaM tinii (sei sattA), yini nija rahamatera (arthAt vRSTira) pUrvakSaNe (vRSTira) susaMvAdavAhIrUpe vAYu preraNa karena| yakhana tA bhArI meghamAlAke vaYe niYe yAYa, takhana Ami tAke kona mRta bhUkhaNDera dike cAliYe niYe yAi, tArapara sekhAne pAni varSaNa kari evaM tA dvArA sarvaprakAra phala utpanna kari| ebhAvei Ami mRtaderakeo jIvita kare tulava| haYata (esava viSaYe cintA kare) tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave|

Ara ye bhUmi utkRSTa, tAra phasala tAra pratipAlakera hukume utpanna haYa evaM ye bhUmi naSTa haYe geche, tAte manda phasala chAr3A kichui utpanna haYa nA| ebhAvei Ami nidarzanasamUha vibhinnabhAve vivRti kari, sei sava lokera janya yArA mUlyAYana kare|

Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, he AmAra sampradAYera loka! AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| nizcaYai Ami AzaMkA kari, tomAdera upara eka mahA dinera zAsti Apatita have|
tAra sampradAYera netRvarga valala, AmarA to nizcitarUpei dekhachi, tumi spaSTa vibhrAntite lipta raYecha|
nUha uttara dila, he AmAra sampradAYa! konao vibhrAnti AmAke sparza kareni| prakRtapakSe Ami rAvvula AlAmInera prerita rAsUla|
Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra pratipAlakera vANI peৗ~chAi o tomAdera kalyANa kAmanA kari| AllAhara pakSa hate Ami emana viSaYa jAni, yA tomarA jAna nA|

tave ki tomarA ei kAraNe vismaYavodha karacha ye, tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera upadeza peৗ~cheche tomAderai madhyakAra ekajana lokera mAdhyame, yAte se tomAderake satarka kare evaM tomarA (manda kAja theke) ve~ce thAka, Ara yAte tomAdera prati (AllAhara) rahamata haYa?

tathApi tArA nUhake mithyAvAdI valala| sutarAM Ami tAke o tAra saGge yArA naukAYa chila tAderake rakSA kari Ara, yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna karechila tAderake nimajjita kari| nizcaYai tArA chila andha loka|
Ara Ada jAtira nikaTa Ami tAdera bhAi hudake (pAThAi)| se valala, he AmAra kaoma! AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| tavuo ki tomarA (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?
tAra sampradAYera ye sardAragaNa kuphara avalamvana karechila, tArA valala, AmarA to nizcitabhAve tomAke nirvuddhitAra bhetara dekhachi evaM nizcaYai AmAdera dhAraNA, tumi ekajana mithyuka loka|
huda valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra konao nirvuddhitA dekhA deYani| varaM Ami rAvvula AlAmInera pakSa hate prerita rAsUla|
Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra pratipAlakera vArtAsamUha peৗ~chiYe thAki evaM Ami tomAdera eka vizvasta kalyANakAmI|

tave ki tomarA e kAraNe vismaYavodha karacha ye, tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera upadeza peৗ~cheche tomAderai madhyakAra ekajana lokera mAdhyame, yAte se tomAderake satarka kare? tomarA sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana tini nUhera sampradAYera para tomAderake (tAdera) sthalAbhiSikta karechena evaM zArIrikabhAve tomAderake (anyadera apekSA) vAr3a-vAr3anta rekhechena| sutarAM tomarA tA~ra niYAmatasamUha smaraNa kara, yAte tomarA saphalatA lAbha kara|

tArA valala, tumi ki ejanyai AmAdera kAche esecha ye, AmarA yena zudhu AllAharai ivAdata kari evaM AmAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa yAdera (ye mUrtidera) ivAdata karata, tAderake tyAga kari? Thika Ache, tumi yadi satyavAdI hao, tave tumi AmAderake ye zAstira bhaYa dekhAccha, tA AmAdera sAmane upasthita kara|

huda valala, tomAdera prati tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate zAsti o krodha avadhArita haYe geche| tomarA ki AmAra sAthe vitarke lipta haccha emana katagulo (mUrtira) nAma samvandhe, yA tomarA o tomAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa rekhe diYecha, yAra samarthane AllAha konao pramANa avatIrNa karenani? sutarAM tomarA apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSA karachi|
sutarAM Ami tAke (huda AlAihisa sAlAmake) o tAra saGgIderake nija daYAYa rakSA karalAma; Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna karechila o yArA mumina chila nA, tAderake nirmUla karalAma|

Ara chAmuda jAtira kAche tAdera bhAi sAlihake (pAThAi)| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera konao mAvuda nei| tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka ujjvala pramANa ese geche| eTA AllAhara uTanI, yA tomAdera janya ekaTi nidarzanasvarUpa| sutarAM tomarA eTike svAdhInabhAve AllAhara jamite (care) khete dAo evaM eke kona manda icchAYa sparza karo nA| pAche konao yantraNAdAYaka zAsti tomAdera pAkar3Ao kare|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ada jAtira para tini tomAderake (tAdera) sthalAbhiSikta karena evaM yamIne tomAderake ebhAve pratiSThA dAna karena ye, tomarA samatala bhUmite prAsAda nirmANa karacha o pAhAr3a keTe gRhera mata tairi karacha| sutarAM AllAhara niYAmatasamUha smaraNa kara evaM pRthivIte azAnti vistAra kare ver3iYo nA|

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika netRvarga, ye sakala durvala loka ImAna enechila, tAderake jijJesa karala, tomarA ki eTA vizvAsa kara ye, sAliha nija pratipAlakera pakSa hate prerita rAsUla? tArA valala, nizcaYai AmarA to tA~ra mAdhyame prerita vAnIte ImAna rAkhi|
sei dAmbhika lokerA valala, tomarA ye vANIte ImAna enecha AmarA to tA pratyAkhyAna kari|

sutarAM tArA uTanITi mere phelala o tAdera pratipAlakera hukuma amAnya karala evaM valala, sAliha! satyii tumi navI haYe thAkale AmAderake yAra (ye zAstira) bhaYa dekhAccha, tA AmAdera kAche niYe eso|
pariNAme tArA bhUmikampe AkrAnta hala evaM tArA nija-nija vAr3ite adhaHmukhe par3e thAkala|

ataHpara sAliha tAdera theke mukha phiriYe cale gela evaM valate lAgala, he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra pratipAlakera vANI peৗ~chiYechilAma evaM tomAdera kalyANa kAmanA karechilAma, kintu (Aphasosa!) tomarA kalyANakAmIderake pachanda kara nA|
evaM lutake (pAThAlAma)| yakhana se nija sampradAYake valala, tomarA ki emana azlIla kAja karacha, yA tomAdera Age sArA vizve keu kareni?
tomarA kAmecchA pUraNera janya nArIderake cher3e puruSera kAche giYe thAka (Ara eTA to konao Akasmika vyApAra naYa;) varaM tomarA eka sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|
tAra sampradAYera uttara chila kevala ei valA ye, ‘ederake tomAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo| erA to emana loka, yArA var3a pavitra thAkate cAYa|

pariNAme Ami tAke (arthAt luta AlAihisa sAlAmake) o tAra parivAravargake (janapada theke vera kare) rakSA karalAma, tave tAra strI chAr3A| se avaziSTa lokadera madhye zAmila thAkala (yArA AyAvera lakSyavastute pariNata haYa)|
Ara Ami tAdera upara (pAtharera) pracaNDa vRSTi varSaNa karalAma| sutarAM dekha, se aparAdhIdera pariNAma kemana (bhaYAvaha) haYechila|

Ara mAdaYAnera kAche tAdera bhAi zuAivake (pAThAlAma)| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate spaSTa pramANa ese geche| sutarAM mApa o ojana ThikabhAve dive o mAnuSera mAlikAnAdhIna vastusamUhe tAdera adhikAra kharva karave nA Ara duniYAYa zAnti sthApanera para azAnti vistAra karave nA| eTAi tomAdera pakSe kalyANakara patha yadi tomarA (AmAra kathA) mene nAo|

(mAnuSake) dhamakAnora janya evaM yArA AllAhara prati ImAna eneche tAderake AllAhara pathe vAdhA dAna o tAte vakratA sandhAnera uddezye pathe-ghATe vase thAkave nA| smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA alpa chile, ataHpara AllAha tomAdera samRddhi dilena evaM lakSya kara, azAnti sRSTikArIdera pariNAma kI haYeche|

AmAra mAdhyame yA pAThAno haYeche, tAte yadi tomAdera eka dala ImAna Ane evaM anya dala ImAna nA Ane, tave savara kara, yatakSaNa nA AllAha AmAdera madhye phAYasAlA kare dena| Ara tini zreSThatama phAYasAlAkArI|

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika sardAragaNa valala, he zuAiva! AmarA avazyai tomAke o tomAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche tAderake AmAdera janapada theke vera kare deva, anyathAYa tomAdera (sakalake) avazyai AmAdera dIne phire Asate have| zuAiva valala, AmarA yadi (tomAdera dInake) ghRNA kari tavuo ki?

AmarA yadi tomAdera dIne phire yAi, yakhana AllAha AmAderake tA theke mukti diYechena, tave to AmarA AllAhara prati ati var3a mithyAropa karava| vastuta tAte phire yAoYA AmAdera pakSe kakhanao sambhava naYa hA~ AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAha icchA karale (seTA bhinna kathA)| AmAdera pratipAlaka nija jJAna dvArA savakichu veSTana kare rekhechena| AmarA AllAharai prati nirbhara karechi| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera o AmAdera sampradAYera madhye nyAyyabhAve phAYasAlA kare dina| Apanii sarvApekSA zreSTha phAYasAlAkArI|

tAra sampradAYera sardAragaNa yArA kupharakei dhare rekhechila, (sampradAYera sAdhAraNa lokaderake) valala, tomarA yadi zuAivera anusaraNa kara, tave (mane rekha), tomarA takhana mArAtmakabhAve kSatigrasta have|
ataHpara tArA bhUmikampe AkrAnta hala evaM prabhAtakAle tArA nijedera vAr3ite adhaHmukhe par3e thAkala|
yArA zuAivake pratyAkhyAna karechila, tArA (emana haYe gela), yena sekhAne kakhanao vasavAsai kareni| yArA zuAivake pratyAkhyAna karechila, zeSa paryanta tArAi kSatigrasta hala|

sutarAM se (zuAiva AlAihisa sAlAma) tAdera theke mukha phiriYe cale gela evaM valate lAgala, he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra ravera vANIsamUha peৗ~che diYechilAma evaM tomAdera kalyANa kAmanA karechilAma| (kintu) ye sampradAYa chila akRtajJa, Ami tAdera janya kibhAve AkSepa kari!
Ami ye-konao janapade navI pAThiYechi, tAra adhivAsIderake avazyai artha-saMkaTa o duHkha-kaSTe AkrAnta karechi, yAte tArA vinaYa avalamvana kare|

tArapara Ami avasthA vadale dUrAvasthAra sthAne sukhaNDasAcchandya diYechi, emanaki tArA samRddhazAlI haYe oThe evaM valate zuru kare, duHkha o sukha to AmAdera vApa-dAdAderakeo sparza kareche| ataHpara Ami akasmAt tAderake ebhAve pAkar3Ao kari ye, tArA (Age theke kichui) Tera karate pAreni|

yadi se sakala janapadavAsI ImAna Anata o tAkaoYA avalamvana karata, tave Ami tAdera janya AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI theke kalyANadhArA mukta kare ditAma| kintu tArA (satya) pratyAkhyAna karala| sutarAM tArA kramAgata yA kare yAcchila, tAra pariNAme Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao kari|
tave ki janapadavAsIrA e viSaYa hate sampUrNa nirbhaYa haYe geche ye, konao rAte tAdera upara AmAra zAsti Apatita have, yakhana tArA thAkave ghumanta?
esava janapadavAsI ki era theke nirbhaYa haYe geche ye, tAdera upara AmAra zAsti Apatita have pUrvAhne, yakhana tArA khelAdhulAYa mete thAkave?

tave ki tArA AllAha pradatta avakAza (-era pariNAma) samparke nizcinta haYe geche? (yadi tAi haYa) tave (tArA yena smaraNa rAkhe), AllAha pradatta avakAza samparke nizcinta thAke kevala sei sava loka, yArA zeSa paryanta kSatigrasta haYa|

yArA kona bhUkhaNDera vAsindAdera (dhvaMsaprAptira) para tAra uttarAdhikArI haYa, tAdera ki ei zikSA lAbha haYani ye, Ami cAile tAderakeo tAdera gunAhera kAraNe zAsti dAna karate pAri? evaM (haThakAritAvazata e zikSA grahaNa nA karAra kAraNe) Ami tAdera antare mohara kare dite pAri, phale tArA (konao kathA) zunate pAve nA?

ei hacche sei sava janapada, yAra vRttAnta tomAke zonAcchi| vastuta tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa spaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechila, kintu tArA pUrve yA pratyAkhyAna karechila, tAte ImAna AnAra janya kakhanao prastuta chila nA| yArA kuphara avalamvana kare, AllAha tAdera antare ebhAvei mohara kare dena|
Ami tAdera adhikAMzera bhetarai aGgIkAra niSThA pAini| prakRtapakSe Ami tAdera adhikAMzakei peYechi avAdhya|

ataHpara Ami tAdera sakalera para mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalIsaha phira‘Auna o tAra pAriSadavargera kAche pAThAlAma| tArAo era (arthAt nidarzanAvalIra) prati avicAra karala| sutarAM dekha, viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNAma kemana haYeche|
mUsA valechila, he phira‘Auna! nizcaYai Ami rAvvula AlAmInera pakSa hate ekajana rAsUla|

eTA AmAra avazya kartavya ye, Ami AllAhara sAthe sampRkta kare satya chAr3A valava nA| Ami tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka spaSTa pramANa niYe esechi| ataeva vanI isarAIlake AmAra sAthe yete dAo|
se valala, tumi kona nidarzana ene thAkale tA peza kara yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|
takhana mUsA nija lAThi nikSepa karala evaM tatkSaNAt tA eka sAkSAt ajagare pariNata hala|
evaM nija hAta (vagala theke) Tene Anala, sahasA tA darzakadera sAmane camakAte lAgala|
phira‘Aunera kaomera sardAragaNa (eke anyake) valate lAgala, nizcaYai e ekajana dakSa yAdukara|
se tomAderake tomAdera deza theke vera kare dite cAYa| ekhana (vala), tomarA kI parAmarza dAo?
tArA valala, tAke o tAra bhAike kiJcit avakAza dina evaM nagare nagare saMgrAhaka pAThAna|
yAte tArA sakala dakSa yAdukarake ApanAra kAche niYe Ase|
(sutarAM tAi karA hala) evaM yAdukaragaNa phira‘Aunera kAche cale Asala (evaM) tArA valala, AmarA yadi (mUsAra viruddhe) jaYI hai, tave AmarA avazyai puraskAra lAbha karava to?
phira‘Auna valala, hA~ evaM tomarA (AmAra) ghaniSTha lokadera madhye gaNya have|
tArA (mUsA AlAihisa sAlAmake) valala, he mUsA! cAile tumi (yA nikSepera icchA rAkha tA) nikSepa kara, naYata AmarA (AmAdera yAdura vastu) nikSepa kari?
mUsA valala, tomarAi nikSepa kara| sutarAM tArA yakhana (tAdera razi o lAThi) nikSepa karala, takhana tArA lokera cokhe yAdu karala, tAderake AtaGkita karala evaM virATa yAdu pradarzana karala|
Ara Ami ohIra mAdhyame mUsAke Adeza karalAma, tumi nija lAThi nikSepa kara| (se tAi karala), amani seTA tArA ye bhojavAji dekhAcchila tA grAsa karate lAgala|
ebhAve satya pratiSThita haYe gela evaM tArA yA-kichu karachila tA mithyA sAvyasta hala|
sekhAne tArA parAjita hala o (pratidvandvitA hate) lAJchita haYe phire gela|
Ara e ghaTanA yAdukaragaNake (tAdera acintite) sijadAYa phele dila|
tArA vale uThala, AmarA ImAna AnalAma rAvvula AlAmInera prati
yini mUsA o hArUnera pratipAlaka|

phira‘Auna valala, Ami tomAderake anumati deoYAra Agei tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anale? nizcaYai eTA kona cakrAnta| tomarA zahare ei cakrAnta karecha, yAte tomarA era vAsindAderake ekhAna theke vahiSkAra karate pAra| AcchA, tomarA zIghrai jAnate pArave|
Ami avazyai tomAdera hAta-pA viparIta dika theke keTe phelava, tArapara tomAdera sakalake zUle car3iYe chAr3ava|
tArA valala, (mRtyura para) AmarA avazyai AmAdera pratipAlakera kAche phire yAva|

tumi ki ruSTa haccha kevala AmAdera e kAjera daruNai ye, yakhana AmAdera kAche AmAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalI ese gela takhana AmarA tAte ImAna enechi? he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera upara savara Dhele dAo evaM (tomAra) tAvedArarUpe AmAdera mRtyu dAna kara|

phira‘Aunera kaomera netRvarga (phira‘Aunake) valala, Apani ki mUsA o tAra sampradAYake cher3e divena, yAte tArA (avAdhe) pRthivIte azAnti vistAra karate evaM ApanAke o ApanAra upAsyaderake varjana karate pAre? se valala, AmarA tAdera putraderake hatyA karava evaM tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhava, Ara tAdera upara to AmAdera paripUrNa kSamatA Achei|

mUsA nija sampradAYake valala, AllAhara kAche sAhAyya cAo o dhairya dhAraNa kara| vizvAsa rAkha, yamIna AllAhara| tini nija vAndAdera madhye yAke cAna era uttarAdhikArI vAniYe dena, Ara zeSa pariNAma muttAkIderai anukUle thAke|

tArA valala, AmAderake to ApanAra Agamanera Ageo utpIr3ana karA haYeche evaM ApanAra Agamanera pareo (utpIr3ana karA hacche)| mUsA valala, AzA karA yAYa, tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera duzamanake dhvaMsa karavena evaM yamIne tomAderake (tAdera) sthalAbhiSikta karavena| tArapara dekhavena, tomarA kIrUpa kAja kara|
Ami phira‘Aunera sampradAYake durbhikSa o phasalAdira kSatite AkrAnta karalAma, yAte tArA satarka haYa|

(kintu phala hala ei ye), yakhana tAdera sukhera dina Asata takhana valata, eTA to AmAdera prApya chila| Ara yakhana kona vipada dekhA dita, takhana tAke mUsA o tAra saGgIdera azubhatA sAvyasta karata| zona, (eTA to) tAderai azubhatA (chila evaM yA) AllAhara jJAne chila, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAnata nA|
evaM tArA (mUsAke) valata, AmAderake yAdu karAra janya tumi AmAdera sAmane ye-konao nidarzanai upasthita kara nA kena, AmarA tomAra prati ImAna AnAra nai|
sutarAM Ami tAdera upara pRthaka-pRthaka nidarzanarUpe cher3e dei plAvana, paGgapAla, ghuNapokA, vyAGa o rakta| tathApi tArA ahaMkAra pradarzana kare| vastuta tArA chila eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|

yakhana tAdera upara zAsti Asata tArA valata, he mUsA! tomAra sAthe tomAra pratipAlakera ye oYAdA raYeche, tAra achilAYa AmAdera janya tomAra pratipAlakera kAche doYA kara (yAte tini e AyAva dUra kare dena)| tumi AmAdera theke ei AyAva apasAraNa karale AmarA tomAra kathA mene neva evaM vanI isarAIlake avazyai tomAra saGge yete deva|
ataHpara yei Ami tAdera upara theke eka meYAdakAla paryanta AyAva dUra karatAma, ye paryanta tAdera peৗ~chA avadhArita chila, amani tArA tAdera pratizruti theke phire yeta|
sutarAM Ami tAdera theke vadalA nilAma evaM tAderake sAgare nimajjita karalAma| kenanA tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna karechila evaM tA theke vilakula gAphela haYe giYechila|

Ara yAderake durvala mane karA hata, Ami tAderake sei dezera pUrva o pazcimera uttarAdhikArI vAnAlAma, yethAYa Ami varakata nAyila karechilAma evaM vanI isarAIlera vyApAre tomAra pratipAlakera zubha vANI pUrNa hala, yehetu tArA savara karechila; Ara phira‘Auna o tAra sampradAYa yA-kichu vAnAta o yA kichu car3Ata, tA sava Ami dhvaMsa kare dilAma|

Ami vanI isarAIlake sAgara pAra kariYe dilAma| ataHpara tArA emana kichu lokera nikaTa upasthita hala, yArA tAdera mUrtipUjAYa rata chila| vanI isarAIla valala, he mUsA! edera yemana devatA Ache, temani AmAdera janyao kona devatA vAniYe dAo| mUsA valala, tomarA emana (Ajava) loka ye, mUrkhatAsulabha kathA valacha|
nizcaYai esava loka ye dhAndhAYa lege Ache, sava dhvaMsa haYe yAve evaM tArA yA-kichu karache sava bhrAnta|
(evaM) se valala, tomAdera janya ki AllAha chAr3A anya kona upAsya khu~je Anava? athaca tinii tomAderake vizvajagatera samasta mAnuSera upara zreSThatva diYechena|

evaM (AllAha valachena smaraNa kara), Ami tomAderake phira‘Aunera lokadera theke mukti diYechi, yArA tomAderake nikRSTatama zAsti dita tomAdera putraderake hatyA karata evaM tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| e viSaYera madhye tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate chila eka mahA parIkSA|

Ami mUsAra janya triza rAtera meYAda sthira karechilAma (ye, e rAtasamUhe tUra pAhAr3e ese itikApha karave)| tArapara Arao daza dvArA tA pUrNa kari| ebhAve tAra pratipAlakera nirdhArita meYAda calliza rAta haYe gela evaM mUsA tAra bhAi hArunake valala, AmAra anupasthitite tumi AmAra sampradAYera madhye AmAra pratinidhitva karave, savakichu ThikaThAka rAkhave evaM azAnti sRSTikArIdera anusaraNa karave nA|

mUsA yakhana AmAra nirdhArita samaYe ese peৗ~chala evaM tAra pratipAlaka tA~ra sAthe kathA valalena, takhana se valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke dekhA dina, Ami ApanAke dekhava| tini valalena, tumi AmAke kichutei dekhate pAve nA| tumi varaM pAhAr3era prati dRSTipAta kara| tA yadi Apana sthAne sthira thAke, tave tumi AmAke dekhate pArave| ataHpara yakhana tAra pratipAlaka pAhAr3e tAjAllI phelalena (jyoti prakAza karalena), takhana tA pAhAr3ake cUrNa-vicUrNa kare phelala evaM mUsA saMjJAhIna haYe par3e gela| pare yakhana tAra saMjJA phire Asala, takhana se valala, ApanAra sattA pavitra| Ami ApanAra daravAre tAovA karachi evaM (duniYAYa keu ApanAke dekhate sakSama naYa e viSaYera prati) Ami savAra Age ImAna Anachi|
valalena, he mUsA! Ami AmAra risAlAta o vAkyAlApa dvArA mAnuSera madhye tomAke zreSThatva diYechi| sutarAM Ami tomAke yA-kichu dilAma tA grahaNa kara evaM kRtajJa vyaktidera antarbhukta haYe yAo|

evaM Ami phalakasamUhe tAra janya sarvaviSaYe upadeza evaM savakichura vistArita vyAkhyA likhe diYechi| (evaM Adeza karechi) evAra egulo zaktabhAve dhara evaM nija sampradAYake hukuma dAo, era uttama vidhAnAvalI yena mene cale| Ami zIghrai tomAderake avAdhyadera vAsasthAna dekhAva|

pRthivIte yArA anyAYabhAve ahaMkAra prakAza kare, tAderake Ami AmAra nidarzanAvalI hate vimukha kare rAkhava| tArA sava rakamera nidarzana dekhaleo tAte ImAna Anave nA| tArA yadi hidAYAtera sarala patha dekhate pAYa, tave tAke nijera patha hiseve grahaNa karave nA, Ara yadi gomarAhIra patha dekhate pAYa, tAke nijera patha vAnAve| kAraNa tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche evaM tA theke vilakula gAphela haYe geche|
yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha o AkhirAtera sammukhIna haoYAke asvIkAra kareche, tAdera karmasamUha niSphala haYe geche| tAderake to kevala tArA yA kichu karata tArai vadalA deoYA have|

Ara mUsAra sampradAYa tAra anupasthitite tAdera alaMkAra dvArA ekaTi vAchura vAnAla, (vAchuraTi kemana chila?), ekaTi (prANahIna) deha, yA theke garura mata DAka vera hacchila| tArA ki etaTukuo dekhala nA ye, tA nA tAdera sAthe kathA valate pAre Ara nA tAderake konao patha dekhAte pAre? (kintu) tArA seTike (upAsya) vAniYe nila evaM (nijedera pratii) julumakArI haYe gela|

tArA yakhana (nija kRtakarmera kAraNe) anutapta hala evaM upalavdhi karala ye, tArA vipathagAmI haYe geche, takhana valate lAgala, AllAha yadi AmAdera prati daYA nA karena o AmAderake kSamA nA karena, tave nizcaYai AmarA varavAda haYe yAva|

evaM mUsA yakhana kruddha o vyathita haYe nija sampradAYera kAche phire Asala, takhana se valala, tomarA AmAra anupasthitite AmAra katainA nikRSTa pratinidhitva karecha! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera Adezera apekSA nA kare tAr3Ahur3A karale? evaM (ei vale) se phalakaguli phele dila evaM nija bhAi (hAruna AlAihisa sAlAma)-era mAthA dhare tAke nijera dike TAnachila| se valala, he AmAra mAYera putra! vizvAsa kara, lokajana AmAke durvala mane karechila evaM AmAke prAYa hatyA karei phelechila| tumi zatruderake AmAra prati hAsAra suyoga diYo nA evaM AmAke jAlemadera madhye gaNya karo nA|
mUsA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke o AmAra bhAike kSamA kara evaM AmAderake tomAra daYAra bhetara dAkhila kara| tumi zreSThatama daYAlu|

(AllAha valalena), yArA vAchurake (upAsya) vAniYeche, tAdera upara zIghrai tAdera pratipAlakera krodha evaM pArthiva jIvanei lAJchanA Apatita have| yArA mithyA racanA kare, Ami ebhAvei tAderake zAsti diYe thAki|
Ara yArA manda kAja kare phele tArapara tAovA kare neYa o ImAna Ane, tomAra pratipAlaka sei tAovAra para (tAdera pakSe) ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara yakhana mUsAra rAga theme gela, takhana se phalakagulo tule nila, Ara tAte yA lekhA chila tA chila sei sakala lokera pakSe hidAYAta o rahamata, yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare|

mUsA tAra sampradAYa hate sattara jana lokake AmAra sthirIkRta samaYe (tUra pAhAr3e) AnAra janya manonIta karala| ataHpara yakhana tAderake bhUmikampa AkrAnta karala takhana mUsA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! Apani cAile pUrvei to tAderake evaM AmAkeo dhvaMsa karate pAratena| AmAdera madhyakAra kichu nirveAdha lokera karmakANDera kAraNe ki AmAdera sakalake dhvaMsa karavena? (valAvAhulya, Apani tA karavena nA| sutarAM vojhA gela) e ghaTanA ApanAra pakSa hate kevala eka parIkSA, yAra mAdhyame Apani yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karavena evaM yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karavena| Apanii AmAdera abhibhAvaka| sutarAM AmAderake kSamA kare dina o AmAdera prati rahama karuna| nizcaYai Apani kSamAzIladera madhye zreSThatama kSamAzIla|

AmAdera janya e duniYAteo kalyANa likhe dina evaM AkhirAteo| (etaduddezye) AmarA ApanArai dike ruju karachi| AllAha valalena, Ami AmAra zAsti yAke icchAkari diYe thAki Ara AmAra daYA se to pratyeka vastute vyApta| sutarAM Ami e rahamata (paripUrNabhAve) sei sava lokera janya likhava, yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, yAkAta deYa evaM yArA AmAra AYAta samUhe ImAna rAkhe

yArA ei rAsUlera arthAt ummI navIra anusaraNa kare, yAra kathA tArA tAorAta o inajIle, yA tAdera nikaTa Ache, lipivaddha pAve, ye tAderake satkAjera Adeza karave o manda kAje niSedha karave evaM tAdera janya utkRSTa vastu hAlAla karave o nikRSTa vastu hArAma karave evaM tAdera theke bhAra o galAra ver3i nAmAve, yA tAdera upara cApAno chila| sutarAM yArA tAra (arthAt navIra) prati ImAna Anave, tAke sammAna karave, tAra sAhAyya karave evaM tAra saGge ye nUra avatIrNa karA haYeche tAra anusaraNa karave, tArAi have saphalakAma|

(he rAsUla! tAderake) vala, he mAnuSa! Ami tomAdera sakalera prati sei AllAhara prerita rAsUla, yAra AYatte AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra rAjatva| tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tini jIvana o mRtyu dAna karena| sutarAM tomarA AllAha o tA~ra sei rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana, yini ummI navI evaM yini AllAha o tAra vANIsamUhe vizvAsa rAkhena evaM tomarA tAra anusaraNa kara, yAte tomarA hidAYAta lAbha kara|
mUsAra sampradAYera madhye emana ekaTi dalao Ache, yArA (mAnuSake) satyera patha dekhAYa evaM sei (satya) anusAre inasApha kare|

Ami tAderake (arthAt vanI isarAIlake) pRthaka-pRthaka dalarUpe vAraTi khAndAne vibhakta kare diYechilAma| yakhana mUsAra kaoma tAra kAche pAni cAila, takhana Ami ohI mAraphata tAke hukuma dilAma, tomAra lAThi dvArA amuka pAthare AghAta kara| sutarAM se pAthara theke vAraTi prasravaNa utsArita hala| pratyeka khAndAna nija-nija pAni pAnera sthAna jAnate pArala| Ara Ami tAderake meghera chAYA dilAma evaM tAdera upara mAnna o sAlaoYA avatIrNa karalAma (o valalAma,) Ami tomAderake ye uttama riyaka dAna karechi tA khAo| (etadasattveo tArA AmAra ye akRtajJatA karala, tAte) tArA AmAra kona kSati kareni; varaM tArA tAdera nijedera pratii juluma kareche|

evaM (sei samaYake smaraNa kara) yakhana tAderake valA haYechila, ei janapade vAsa kara evaM tAra yekhAna theke icchA khAo| Ara valate thAka, (he AllAha!) AmarA tomAra kAche kSamA prArthanA kari| Ara (janapadaTira) pravezadvAra diYe natazire praveza kara| Ami tomAdera aparAdhasamUha kSamA karava (evaM) satkarmazIladerake Arao vezi (saoYAva) deva|

kintu tAderake ye kathA valA haYechila, tAdera madhyakAra jAlemagaNa tA parivartana kare anya kathA tairi kare nila| sutarAM tAdera kramAgata sImAlaMghanera kAraNe Ami tAdera upara AsamAna theke zAsti pAThAlAma|

evaM tAdera kAche sAgara-tIre avasthita janapadavAsIdera samparke jijJesa kara yakhana tArA zanivArera vyApAre sImAlaMghana karata, yakhana tAdera (sAgarera) mAcha zanivAra dina to pAnite bhese bhese tAdera sAmane Asata; Ara yakhana tArA zanivAra udayApana karata nA, (arthAt anyAnya dine) tA Asata nA| ebhAve Ami tAderake tAdera uparyupari avAdhyatAra kAraNe parIkSA karechilAma|

evaM (tAderake sei samaYera kathA smaraNa kariYe dAo) yakhana tAderai ekaTi dala (anya dalake) valechila, tomarA emana sava lokake kena upadeza diccha, yAderake AllAha dhvaMsa kare phelavena kiMvA kaThora zAsti divena? tArA valala, (AmarA eTA karachi) tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa dAYitvamukta haoYAra janya evaM (e upadeza dvArA) hate pAre, tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave|

tAderake ye upadeza deoYA haYechila, tA yakhana tArA bhule gela, takhana asat kAje yArA vAdhA dicchila tAderake to Ami rakSA kari| kintu yArA sImAlaMghana karechila, uparyupari avAdhyatAra kAraNe tAderake eka kaThora zAsti dvArA AkrAnta kari|
sutarAM tAderake ye kAja karate niSedha karA haYechila, tArA yakhana tAra viparIte auddhatya prakAza karala, takhana Ami tAderake valalAma, ghRNita vAnara haYe yAo|

evaM (sei samaYera kathA smaraNa kara) yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka ghoSaNA karalena, tini kiYAmata divasa paryanta tAdera upara emana lokaderake kartRtva dAna karate thAkavena, yArA tAderake nikRSTa rakamera zAsti deve| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka druta zAstidAnakArI evaM nizcaYai tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAluo vaTe|

evaM Ami pRthivIte tAderake vibhinna dale vibhakta kare dei| tAdera madhye kataka chila satkarmazIla evaM kataka anya rakama| Ami tAderake bhAlo o manda avasthA dvArA parIkSA karechi, yAte tArA (saThika pathera dike) phire Ase|

ataHpara tAdera para tAdera sthalAbhiSikta haYe kitAva (arthAt tAorAta)-era uttarAdhikArI hala emana sava uttarapuruSa, yArA ei tuccha duniYAra sAmagrI (ghuSarUpe) grahaNa karata evaM valata, ‘AmAderake kSamA karA have’| kintu tAra anurUpa sAmagrI tAdera kAche punarAYa Asale tArA (ghuSarUpe) tAo niYe nita| tAdera theke ki kitAve varNita ei sudRr3ha pratizruti neoYA haYani ye, tArA AllAhara prati satya chAr3A kona kathA Aropa karave nA? evaM tAte (sei kitAve) yA-kichu (lekhA) chila tArA tA yathArIti par3eochila| yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tAdera janya AkhirAtera nivAsa zreSThatara| (he iYAhudIgaNa!) tAraparao ki tomarA vuddhike kAje lAgAve nA?
Ara yArA kitAvake majavutabhAve dhare rAkhe o nAmAya kAYema kare, Ami erUpa saMzodhanakArIdera karmaphala naSTa kari nA|

evaM (smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami pAhAr3ake tAdera upara ebhAve tule dharechilAma, yena seTi ekakhAni zAmiYAnA, evaM tArA mane karechila seTi tAdera upara patita have| (takhana Ami hukuma diYechilAma) Ami tomAderake ye kitAva diYechi, tA A~kar3e dhara, o tAte varNita viSaYasamUha smaraNa rAkha, yAte tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karate pAra|

evaM (he rAsUla! mAnuSake sei samaYera kathA smaraNa kariYe dAo) yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka Adama santAnadera pRSThadeza theke tAdera santAnaderake vera karechilena evaM tAderake tAdera nijedera samparke sAkSI vAniYechilena (Ara jijJesa karechilena ye,) Ami ki tomAdera ravva nai? sakale uttara diYechila, kena naYa? AmarA sakale (e viSaYe) sAkSya dicchi (evaM e svIkArokti Ami ejanya niYechilAma) yAte kiYAmatera dina tomarA valate nA pAra ye, ‘AmarA to e viSaYe anavahita chilAma|’

kiMvA erUpa nA vala ye, ziraka (-era sUcanA) to (vahu) pUrve AmAdera vApa-dAdAgaNai karechila| Ara AmarA chilAma tAderai paravartI vaMzadhara| tave ki vibhrAnta lokadera kRtakarmera kAraNe Apani AmAderake dhvaMsa karavena?
ebhAvei Ami nidarzanAvalI vizadabhAve vivRta kare thAki, yAte mAnuSa (satyera dike) phire Ase|

evaM (he rAsUla!) tAderake sei vyaktira ghaTanA par3e zonAo, yAke Ami AmAra nidarzanAvalI diYechilAma, kintu se tA sampUrNa varjana kare| phale zaYatAna tAra pichu neYa| pariNAme se pathabhraSTadera antarbhukta haYe yAYa|

Ami icchA karale sei AYAtasamUhera vadaulate tAke ucca maryAdA dAna karatAma| kintu se to duniYAra dikei jhu~ke par3ala evaM nija pravRttira anusaraNa karala| sutarAM tAra dRSTAnta oi kukurera mata, yAra upara tumi hAmalA karaleo se jihvA vera kare hA~pAte thAkave, Ara tAke (tAra avasthAYa) cher3e dileo jihvA vera kare hA~pAve| ei hala ye sava loka AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kare tAdera dRSTAnta| sutarAM tumi (tAderake) esava ghaTanA zonAte thAka, yAte tArA cintA kare|
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kare o nijedera prati juluma kare, tAdera dRSTAnta kata manda!
AllAha yAke hidAYAta dAna karena, kevala se-i hidAYAtaprApta haYa, Ara AllAha yAderake vipathagAmI karena, tArAi kSatigrasta|

Ami jina o mAnuSera madhya hate vahujanake jAhAnnAmera janya sRSTi karechi| tAdera antara Ache, kintu tA dvArA tArA anudhAvana kare nA, tAdera cokha Ache, kintu tA dvArA dekhe nA evaM tAdera kAna Ache, kintu tA dvArA zone nA| tArA catuSpada jantura mata; varaM tAra ceYeo vezi vibhrAnta| erAi gAphela|
uttama nAmasamUha AllAharai| sutarAM tAke sei sava nAmei DAkave| yArA tAra nAmera vyApAre vakra patha avalamvana kare, tAderake varjana kara| tArA yA-kichu karache, tAderake tAra vadalA deoYA have|
Ami yAderake sRSTi karechi tAdera madhye emana ekaTi dala Ache, yArA (mAnuSake) satyera patha dekhAYa evaM sei (satya) anuyAYI inasApha pratiSThA kare|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche, Ami tAdera emanabhAve paryAYakrame pAkar3Ao karava ye, tArA jAnatei pArave nA|
evaM Ami tAderake avakAza diYe thAki| nizcaYai AmAra gupta kauzala var3a majavuta|
tave ki tArA cintA kareni ye, tAdera ei sahacara (arthAt muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYA sAllAma)-era madhye unmAdagrastatAra kichu nei| se to kevala eka suspaSTa satarkakArI|

tArA ki lakSya kareni AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatve evaM AllAha ye sakala jinisa sRSTi karechena tAra prati evaM era pratio ye, sambhavata tAdera nirdhArita samaYa kAchei ese par3eche? sutarAM era para Ara kona kathAYa tArA ImAna Anave?
AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena, tAke keu hidAYAta dite pAre nA; Ara AllAha tAderake (asahAYabhAve) cher3e dena tAdera avAdhyatAra bhetara udbhrAnta haYe ghure ver3Ate|

(he rAsUla!) loke tomAke kiYAmata samvandhe jijJesa kare, tA kakhana ghaTave? vale dAo, e viSaYera jJAna kevala AmAra pratipAlakerai Ache| tinii tA yathAsamaYe prakAza kare dekhAvena, anya keu naYa| AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte tA ati bhArI viSaYa| tomAdera kAche tA Asave haThAt karei| tArA tomAke emanabhAve jijJesa kare, yena tumi tA sampUrNarUpe jene rekhecha| vale dAo, tAra jJAna kevala AllAharai kAche raYeche| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (e viSaYe) jAne nA|

vala, yatakSaNa paryanta AllAha icchA nA karena, Ami AmAra nijerao kona upakAra o apakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhi nA| AmAra yadi gAYeva samparke jAnA thAkata, tave bhAlo-bhAlo jinisa pracura parimANe saMgraha kare nitAma evaM konao rakama kaSTa AmAke sparza karata nA| Ami to kevala ekajana satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA sei sakala lokera janya, yArA (AmAra kathA) mAne|

AllAha tini, yini tomAderake eka vyakti hate sRSTi karechena evaM tAra thekei tAra strIke vAniYechena, yAte se tAra kAche ese zAnti lAbha karate pAre| tArapara puruSa yakhana strIke Acchanna karala, takhana strI (garbhera) hAlakA eka vojhA vahana karala, yA niYe se calApherA karate thAkala| ataHpara se yakhana bhArI haYe gela, takhana (svAmI-strI) ubhaYe tAdera pratipAlaka AllAhara kAche doYA karala, tumi yadi AmAderake sustha santAna dAna kara tave AmarA avazyai tomAra kRtajJatA AdAYa karava|

kintu AllAha yakhana tAderake ekaTi sustha santAna dAna karalena, takhana tArA AllAha pradatta niYAmate AllAhara saGge anyaderake zarIka karala, athaca AllAha tAdera aMzIvAdIsulabha viSaYAdi hate vahu Urdhve|
tArA ki emana sava jinisake (AllAhara sAthe) zarIka mAne, yArA konao vastu sRSTi karate pAre nA; varaM khoda tAderakei sRSTi karA haYa?
evaM yArA tAdera konao sAhAyya karate pAre nA evaM khoda nijederao sAhAyya karate pAre nA|
tomarA yadi tAderake saThika pathera dike DAka, tave tArA tomAdera kathA mAnave nA; (varaM) tomarA tAderake DAka vA cupa thAka, ubhaYa tAdera janya samAna|

nizcaYai tomarA AllAhake cher3e yAderake DAka, tArA tomAderai mata (AllAhara) vAndA| sutarAM tomarA tAdera kAche prArthanA kara, ataHpara tArA tomAdera prArthanA maJjura karuka yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

tAdera ki pA’ Ache, yA diYe tArA calave? athavA tAdera ki hAta Ache, yA diYe tArA dharave? athavA tAdera ki cakSu Ache, yA diYe dekhave? athavA tAdera ki kAna Ache, yA dvArA tArA zunave? (tAdera) vale dAo, tomarA ye sakala devatAderake AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta karecha, tAderake DAka tArapara AmAra viruddhe kona cakrAnta kara evaM AmAke ekaTuo avakAza diYo nA|
AmAra abhibhAvaka to AllAha, yini kitAva nAyila karechena, Ara tini puNyavAnadera abhibhAvakatva karena|
tomarA tAke cher3e yAderake DAka, tArA tomAdera konao sAhAyya karate sakSama naYa evaM khoda nijederao konao sAhAyya karate pAre nA|
tumi yadi tAderake saThika pathera dike DAka tave tArA tA zunaveo nA| tumi tAderake dekhave, yena tomAra dike tAkiYe Ache| prakRtapakSe tArA kichui dekhe nA|
(he navI!) tumi kSamAparAYaNatA avalamvana kara evaM (mAnuSake) satkAjera Adeza dAo Ara ajJadera agrAhya karo|
yadi zaYatAnera pakSa hate tomAke konao kumantraNA deoYA haYa, tave AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA kara| nizcaYai tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche, tAderake yakhana zaYatAnera pakSa hate konao kumantraNA sparza kare, takhana tArA (AllAhake) smaraNa kare| phale tatkSaNAt tAdera cokha khule yAYa|
Ara yArA zaYatAnera bhAi, zaYatAnagaNa tAderake vibhrAntira dike Tene niYe yAYa| phale tArA (vibhrAnti hate) phire Ase nA|

evaM (he navI!) tumi yadi tAdera sAmane (tAdera pharamAYezI) mujiyA upasthita nA kara, tave tArA vale, tumi nije vAchAi kare e mujiyA peza karale nA kena? vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlaka ohIra mAdhyame AmAke ye viSaYe Adeza karena, Ami to kevala tArai anusaraNa kari| e kuraAna tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate jJAna-tattvera samaSTi evaM yArA ImAna Ane tAdera janya hidAYAta o rahamata|
yakhana kuraAna par3A haYa takhana tA manoyoga diYe zona evaM cupa thAka, yAte tomAdera prati rahamata haYa|
evaM sakAle o sandhyAYa nija pratipAlakake smaraNa kara vinaYa o bhItira sAthe, mane mane evaM anuccasvare mukheo| yArA gAphalatite nimajjita, tAdera antarbhukta haYo nA|
