smaraNa rekha, yArA (arthAt phirizatAgaNa) tomAra ravera sAnnidhye Ache, tArA tA~ra ivAdata theke ahaMkAre mukha pherAYa nA evaM tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kare evaM tA~rai sammukhe sijadAvanata haYa|

(he navI!) loke tomAke yuddhalavdha sampada samparke jijJesa kare| vale dAo, yuddhalavdha sampada (samparke siddhAnta dAna)-era ekhatiYAra AllAha o rAsUlera| sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tomAdera pArasparika samparka zudhare nAo| evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yadi tomarA prakRta mumina hao|

mumina to tArAi, (yAdera sAmane) AllAhake smaraNa karA hale tAdera hRdaYa bhIta haYa, yakhana tAdera sAmane tA~ra AYAtasamUha par3A haYa, takhana tA tAdera ImAnera unnati sAdhana kare evaM tArA tAdera pratipAlakera upara bharasA kare|
yArA nAmAya kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi, tA theke (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare|
erAi prakRta mumina| tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera kAche raYeche ucca maryAdA, kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyaka|
(ganImata vaNTanera e viSaYaTA sei rakama), yemana tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke satyera janya nija ghara theke vera karechilena, athaca muminadera ekaTi dalera kAche e viSaYaTA apachanda chila|
satya spaSTa haYe yAoYAra parao tArA tomAra sAthe se viSaYe emanabhAve vitarka karache, yena tAderake mRtyura dike tAr3iYe neoYA hacche evaM tArA tA nija cokhe dekhate pAcche|

(sei samaYake smaraNa kara), yakhana AllAha tomAderake pratizruti diYechilena ye, du’Ti dalera madhye kona ekadala tomAdera AYatte Asave| Ara tomAdera kAmanA chila, niSkaNTaka dalaTi tomAdera AotAdhIna hoka| AllAha cAcchilena, nija vidhAnAvalI dvArA satyake satye pariNata kare dekhAvena evaM kApheradera mUloccheda karavena|
ebhAve tini satyake satya o asatyake asatyarUpe pramANa karate cAna, tAte aparAdhIdera (eTA) yatai apachanda hoka|

(smaraNa kara), yakhana tomarA nija pratipAlakera kAche phariYAda karechile, takhana tini tomAdera phariYAde sAr3A diYe (valalena), Ami tomAdera sAhAyyArthe eka hAjAra phirizatAra ekaTi vAhinI pAThAcchi, yArA ekera para eka Asave|

e pratizruti AllAha kevala ejanyai diYechena, yAte eTA tomAdera janya susaMvAda haYa evaM yAte era dvArA tomAdera antara prazAnti lAbha kare, Ara sAhAyya to kevala AllAhara pakSa thekei Ase| nizcaYai AllAha mahA kSamatAvAna, prajJAmaYa|

(smaraNa kara), yakhana tini nijera pakSa hate svastira janya tomAderake tandrAcchanna karachilena evaM AkAza theke tomAdera upara pAni varSaNa karachilena, tA dvArA tomAderake pavitra karAra janya, tomAdera theke zaYatAnera AvilatA dUra karAra janya, tomAdera antare dRr3hatA vA~dhAra janya evaM tAra mAdhyame (tomAdera) pA sthira rAkhAra janya|

(smaraNa kara), yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka phirizatAderake ohIra mAdhyame hukuma dilena ye, Ami tomAdera saGge Achi| kAjei tomarA muminadera pA sthira rAkha, Ami kApheradera mane bhIti saJcAra karava| sutarAM tomarA tAdera ghAr3era upara AghAta kara evaM tAdera AGgulera jor3AsamUheo AghAta kara|
eTA ei kAraNe ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitAYa lipta haYeche| nizcaYai keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitAYa lipta hale, AllAhara AyAva to sukaThina|
sutarAM esavera majA bhoga kara| tAchAr3A kAphedera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera (Asala) zAsti|
he muminagaNa! yakhana tomarA hAnAdAra kAphiradera mukhomukhi hao, takhana tAderake pRSThapradarzana karo nA|

ye vyakti sedina tAderake pRSThapradarzana karave, yuddhera janya kauzala avalamvana athavA nija dale sthAnagrahaNera uddezya chAr3A, se AllAhara pakSa theke krodha niYe phirave evaM tAra ThikAnA jAhAnnAma, Ara tA ati manda ThikAnA|

sutarAM (he musalimagaNa! prakRtapakSe) tomarA tAderake (arthAt kApheraderake) hatyA karani; varaM AllAhai tAderake hatyA karechilena evaM (he navI!) tumi yakhana (tAdera upara mATi) nikSepa karechile, takhana tA tumi nikSepa karani; varaM AllAhai nikSepa karechilena Ara (tA tomAdera hAta dvArA kariYechilena) tAra mAdhyame muminaderake uttama pratidAna deoYAra janya| nizcaYai AllAha sakala kichura zrotA o savakichura jJAtA|
tA to raYechei, tadupari AllAha kApheradera cakrAnta durvala karAra chilena|

(he kApheragaNa!) tomarA yadi mImAMsAi ceYe thAka, tave mImAMsA to tomAdera sAmane esei geche| ekhana yadi tomarA nivRtta hao, tave tA tomAderai pakSe kalyANakara have| Ara yadi punarAYa (sei kAjai) kara (yA e yAvat karachile), tave AmarAo punarAYa (tAi) karava (yemanaTA sadya karalAma) evaM takhana tomAdera dala tomAdera konao kAje Asave nA, tAra saMkhyA yata vezii hoka| smaraNa rekha, AllAha muminadera saGge Achena|
he muminagaNa! AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara evaM era theke (arthAt Anugatya theke) mukha phiriYe niYo nA, yakhana tomarA (AllAha o rAsUlera nirdezAvalI) zunacha|
evaM tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA vale, AmarA zunalAma kintu prakRtapakSe tArA zone nA|
nizcaYai AllAhara kAche nikRSTatama jIva sei vadhira o vovA loka, yArA vuddhi kAje lAgAYa nA|

AllAhara yadi jAnA thAkata tAdera madhye kona kalyANa Ache, tave tini tAderake avazyai zonAra tAophIka ditena, kintu (tAdera madhye yehetu kona kalyANa nei, tAi) tAdera zonAra tAophIka dileo tArA mukha phiriYe pAlAve|

he muminagaNa! AllAha o rAsUlera dAoYAta kavula kara, yakhana tini (rAsUla) tomAderake emana viSaYera dike DAkena, yA tomAderake jIvana dAna kare| jene rekha, AllAha mAnuSa o tAra antarera madhye prativandhaka haYe yAna| Ara tomAdera sakalake tArai kAche (niYe) jamA karA have|
evaM sei viparyaYake bhaYa kara, yA vizeSabhAve tomAdera madhye yArA juluma kare kevala tAderakei AkrAnta karave nA| jene rekha, AllAhara AyAva sukaThina|

evaM sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA saMkhyAYa alpa chile, loke tomAderake tomAdera deze dAviYe rekhechila| tomarA bhaYa karate, pAche loke tomAderake akasmAt tule niYe yAYa| ataHpara AllAha tomAderake AzraYa dilena, tomAderake nija sAhAyya dvArA zaktizAlI karalena evaM tomAderake utkRSTa jinisasamUhera riyaka dAna karalena, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA AdAYa kara|
he muminagaNa! AllAha o rAsUlera saGge vizvAsaghAtakatA karo nA evaM jene-zune nijedera AmAnatera kheYAnata karo nA|
jene rekha, tomAdera sampada o tomAdera santAna-santati tomAdera janya eka parIkSA| Ara mahA puraskAra raYeche AllAharai kAche|

he muminagaNa! tomarA yadi AllAhara saGge tAkaoYAra nIti avalamvana kara, tave tini tomAderake (satya o mithyAra madhye) pArthakya karAra zakti devena, tomAdera pApa mocana karavena evaM tomAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha mahA anugrahera mAlika|

(he navI! sei samaYake smaraNa kara), yakhana kApheragaNa tomAke vandI karA athavA tomAke hatyA karA kiMvA tomAke (deza theke) vahiSkAra karAra janya tomAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karachila| tArA to nijedera Sar3ayantra pAkAcchila Ara AllAhao nija kauzala praYoga karachilena| vastuta AllAha sarvApekSA zreSTha kauzalakArI|

tAdera sAmane yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa, takhana tArA vale, (AcchA) zunalAma to! icchA karale AmarAo erUpa kathA valate pAri| eTA (kuraAna) pUrvavartI lokadera kalpakAhinI chAr3A kichu naYa|

(ekaTA samaYa chila) yakhana tArA valechila, he AllAha! ei kuraAnai yadi ApanAra pakSa hate Agata satya haYe thAke, tave AmAdera prati AkAza theke pAthara-vRSTi varSaNa karuna athavA AmAdera prati kona marmantuda zAsti nikSepa karuna|
evaM (he navI!) AllAha emana nana ye, tumi tAdera madhye vartamAna thAkA avasthAYa tAderake zAsti devena evaM tini emanao nana ye, tArA istigaphAre rata thAkA avasthAYa tAderake zAsti devena|

Ara tAdera kI-vA guNa Ache ye, AllAha tAderake zAsti devena nA, athaca tArA (mAnuSake) masajidula hArAme yete vAdhA deYa, yadio tArA tAra mutAoYAllI naYa| muttAkIgaNa chAr3A anya konao loka tAra mutAoYAllI hateo pAre nA| kintu tAdera adhikAMza loka (e kathA) jAne nA|
vAitullAhara nikaTa tAdera nAmAya zisa deoYA o tAli vAjAno chAr3A kichui naYa| sutarAM (he kApheragaNa!) tomarA ye kupharI karate, tajjanya ekhana zAsti bhoga kara|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA AllAhara pathe (mAnuSake) vA~dhA deoYAra janya nijedera artha-sampada vyaYa kare| era pariNAma have ei ye, tArA artha-sampada vyaYa karate thAkave, ataHpara sesava tAdera manastApera kAraNa haYe yAve evaM zeSa paryanta tArA parAbhUta have| Ara yArA kupharI kare, tAderake (AkhirAte) jAhAnnAme niYe ekatra karA have|

Ara tA ei janya ye, AllAha apavitra (lokadera)ke pavitra (lokadera) theke pRthaka kare devena evaM eka apavitrake apara apavitrera upara rekhe tAdera sakalake stUpIkRta karavena, ataHpara sei stUpake jAhAnnAme nikSepa karavena| erAi sampUrNa kSatigrasta|

(he navI!) yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tAderake vale dAo, tArA yadi nivRtta haYa, tave atIte yA-kichu haYeche tAderake tA kSamA kare deoYA have| kintu tArA yadi punarAYa (se kAjai) kare, tave pUrvavartI lokadera sAthe ye AcaraNa karA haYeche tA to (tAdera sAmane) gata haYechei|

(he musalimagaNa!) tomarA kApheradera viruddhe saMgrAma karate thAka, yAvat nA phitanA dUrIbhUta haYa evaM dIna sampUrNarUpe AllAhara haYe yAYa| ataHpara tArA yadi nivRtta haYa, tave AllAha to tAdera kAryAvalI samyaka dekhachena|
tArA yadi mukha phiriYe rAkhe, tave jene rekha, AllAhai tomAdera abhibhAvaka kata uttama abhibhAvaka tini evaM kata uttama sAhAyyakArI|

(he musalimagaNa!) jene rAkha, tomarA yA-kichu ganImata arjana kara, tAra eka-paJcamAMza AllAha, rAsUla, (tA~ra) AtmIYavarga, iYAtIma, misakIna o musAphiradera prApya (yA AdAYa karA tomAdera avazya kartavya)yadi tomarA AllAhara prati o sei viSaYera prati ImAna rAkha, yA Ami nija vAndAra upara mImAMsAra dina avatIrNa karechi ye dina du’ dala parasparera sammukhIna haYechila| AllAha sarva viSaYe zaktimAna|

(smaraNa kara), yakhana tomarA (upatyakAra) nikaTavartI prAnte chile evaM tArA chila dUravartI prAnte, Ara kAphelA chila tomAdera apekSA nicera dike| tomarA yadi (Age thekei) pArasparika AlocanAkrame (yuddhera) samaYa nirdhAraNa karate cAite, tave samaYa nirdhAraNera vyApAre tomAdera madhye avazyai matabheda dekhA dita| kintu (pUrva siddhAnta vyatireke ejanya ghaTeche), yAte ye viSaYaTA ghaTavAra chila AllAha tA sampanna kare dekhAna| phale yAra dhvaMsa haoYAra, se suspaSTa pramANa dekhei dhvaMsa haYa Ara yAra jIvita thAkAra, seo suspaSTa pramANa dekhei jIvita thAke|, AllAha savakichura zrotA o sava kichura jJAtA|

(he navI! smaraNa kara), yakhana AllAha tomAke svapne tAdera (arthAt zatrudera) saMkhyA kama dekhAcchilena| tomAke yadi tAdera saMkhyA vezi dekhAtena, tave (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA sAhasa hArAte evaM e viSaYe tomAdera madhye virodha sRSTi hata, kintu AllAha (tomAderake tA theke) rakSA karalena| nizcaYai tini antarera gupta kathAsamUhao bhAlobhAve jAnena|

evaM (sei samaYake smaraNa kara), yakhana tomarA eke aparera mukhomukhi haYechile, takhana AllAha tomAdera cokhe tAdera saMkhyA alpa dekhAcchilena evaM tAdera cokhe tomAderake alpa dekhAcchilena, yAte ye kAja saMghaTita haoYAra chila, AllAha tA sampanna kare dekhAna| yAvatIYa viSaYa AllAharai dike phiriYe deoYA haYa|
he muminagaNa! yakhana tomarA kona dalera sammukhIna have, takhana avicalita thAkave evaM AllAhake vezi parimANe smaraNa karave, yAte tomarA saphalatA arjana kara|

evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave evaM paraspare kalaha karave nA, anyathAYa tomarA durvala haYe par3ave evaM tomAdera hAoYA (prabhAva) vilupta have| Ara dhairya dhAraNa karave| nizcaYai AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe|

tomarA tAdera mata have nA, yArA nija gRha theke dambhabhare evaM mAnuSake (nijedera ThATavATa) dekhAte dekhAte vera haYechila evaM tArA (anyaderake) AllAhara pathe vAdhA dita| AllAha mAnuSera samasta karma (nija jJAna dvArA) pariveSTana kare Achena|

evaM (sei samaYao ullekhayogya) yakhana zaYatAna tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) kAjakarmake tAdera dRSTite zobhanIYa kare tulechila evaM valechila, Aja mAnuSera madhye emana keu nei, ye tomAdera upara vijaYI hate pAre| Ara Amii tomAdera rakSaka| ataHpara yakhana ubhaYa dala paraspara mukhomukhi hala, takhana se pichana dike sare par3ala evaM valala, tomAdera sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei| Ami emana kichu dekhachi yA tomarA dekhate pAccha nA| Ami AllAhake bhaYa karachi evaM AllAhara zAsti ati kaThora|

(smaraNa kara), munAphika o yAdera antare vyAdhi chila, tArA yakhana valachila, tAdera (arthAt musalimadera) dIna tAderake vibhrAnta kareche| athaca keu AllAhara upara bharasA karale, AllAha to parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|

tumi yadi dekhate, phirizatAgaNa kApheradera cehArA o piThe AghAta kare kare tAdera prANa haraNa karachila (Ara valachila), evAra tomarA jvalAra majAo bhoga kara (tAhale camatkAra dRzya dekhate pete)|
esava, tomarA nija hAte yA sAmane pAThiYechile tAra pratiphala| Ara AllAha vAndAdera prati julumakArI nana|

(tAdera avasthA Thika sei rakamai haYeche) yemana phira‘Aunera sampradAYa o tAdera pUrvavartI lokadera avasthA haYechila| tArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna karechila| phale AllAha tAdera pApAcArera kAraNe tAderake pAkar3Ao karena| nizcaYai AllAha ati zaktimAna evaM tAra zAsti ati kaThora|

tA e kAraNe ye, AllAha konao sampradAYake ye niYAmata dAna karena, tA tatakSaNa paryanta parivartana karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA nijerA nijedera avasthA parivartana kare phele| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

(e viSaYeo tAdera avasthA) phira‘Aunera sampradAYa o tAdera pUrvavartI lokadera avasthAra mata| tArA tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna karechila, phale tAdera pApAcArera kAraNe tAderake dhvaMsa kare dei evaM phira‘Aunera sampradAYake kari nimajjita| tArA sakalei chila jAlema|
nizcaYai (bhU-pRSThe vicaraNakArI prANIdera madhye) AllAhara kAche sarvApekSA nikRSTa jIva hala tArA yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, ye kAraNe tArA ImAna AnaYana karache nA|
(tArA) sei sakala loka, yAdera theke tumi pratizruti niYechile| tA sattveo tArA prativAra nija pratizruti bhaGga kare evaM tArA vindumAtra bhaYakare nA|
sutarAM yuddhakAle yadi tumi tAderake nAgAle pAo, tave (tAderake dRSTAntamUlaka zAsti diYe) tAdera mAdhyame tAdera pazcAdvartIderakeo vikSipta kare phelave, yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|

tumi yadi konao sampradAYera pakSa hate vizvAsaghAtakatAra AzaGkA kara, tave tumio (se cukti) sarAsaribhAve tAdera dike chu~r3e mAra| smaraNa rekha, AllAha vizvAsa bhaGgakArIderake pachanda karena nA|
kApheragaNa yena kichutei mane nA kare ye, tArA paritrANa peYe geche| eTA to nizcita kathA ye, tArA (AllAhake) vyartha karate pArave nA|

(he musalimagaNa!) tomarA tAdera (mukAvilAra) janya yathAsAdhya zakti o azva-chAuni prastuta kara, yA dvArA tomarA AllAhara zatru o nijedera (vartamAna) zatruderake santrasta kare rAkhave evaM tAdera chAr3A sei sava lokakeo, yAderake tomarA ekhanao jAna nA; (kintu) AllAha tAderake jAnena| tomarA AllAhara pathe yA-kichu vyaYa karave, tA tomAderake paripUrNarUpe deoYA have evaM tomAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
Ara tArA yadi sandhira dike jhu~ke par3e, tave tumio se dike jhu~ke par3ave evaM AllAhara upara nirbhara karave| nizcaYai tini sakala kathA zonena, sakala kichu jAnena|
tArA yadi tomAke dheA~kA dite cAYa, tave AllAhai tomAra janya yatheSTa| tinii tomAke zaktizAlI karechena nija sAhAyye evaM muminadera dvArA|

evaM tini tAdera hRdaYe parasparera prati samprIti sRSTi karechena| tumi yadi pRthivIra yAvatIYa sampadao vyaYa karate, tave tAdera hRdaYe samprIti sRSTi karate pArate nA| kintu tini tAdera antarasamUhe prIti sthApana karechena| nizcaYai tini parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|
he navI! tomAra janya AllAha evaM ye sakala mumina tomAra anusaraNa kareche tArAi yatheSTa|

he navI! muminaderake yuddhera janya udvuddha kara| tomAdera madhye yadi vizajana dhairyazIla loka thAke, tave tArA du’za janera upara jaYI have| tomAdera yadi ekaza’ jana thAke, tave tArA eka hAjAra kApherera upara jaYI have| kenanA tArA emana eka sampradAYa, yArA vujha-samajha rAkhe nA|

ekhana AllAha tomAdera bhAra lAghava karalena| tini jAnena, tomAdera madhye kichu durvalatA Ache| sutarAM (ekhana vidhAna ei ye,) tomAdera madhye yadi ekaza’ jana dhairyazIla thAke, tave tArA du’za janera upara jaYI have; Ara yadi tomAdera madhye eka hAjAra jana thAke, tave tArA AllAhara hukume du’ hAjAra janera upara jaYI have| AllAha dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|

konao navIra pakSe eTA zobhanIYa naYa ye, se yamIne yatakSaNa paryanta (zatrudera) rakta vyApakabhAve pravAhita nA karave (yAte tAdera prabhAva sampUrNarUpe khatama haYe yAYa), tatakSaNa paryanta tAra kAche kaYedI thAkave| tomarA duniYAra sampada kAmanA kara Ara AllAha (tomAdera janya) AkhirAta (-era kalyANa) cAna| AllAha parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|
yadi AllAhara pakSa theke likhita eka vidhAna pUrve nA thAkata, tave tomarA ye patha avalamvana karecha se kAraNe tomAdera upara var3a kona zAsti Apatita hata|
sutarAM tomarA ye ganImata arjana karecha, tA bhoga kara vaidha uttama sampadarUpe evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare calo| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he navI! tomAdera hAte ye sakala vandI Ache (evaM yArA isalAma grahaNera icchA prakAza kareche), tAderake vale dAo, AllAha tomAdera antare bhAlo kichu dekhale tomAdera theke ye sampada (phidaYArUpe) neoYA haYeche, tomAderake tA apekSA uttama kichu dAna karavena evaM tomAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(he navI!) tArA yadi tomAra saGge vizvAsa bhaGgera icchA kare thAke, tave tArA to itaHpUrve AllAhara saGgeo vizvAsa bhaGga kareche, yAra pariNAme AllAha tAderake (tomAdera) AYattAdhIna karechena| vastuta AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche evaM nijedera mAla o jAna dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche evaM yArA (tAderake madInAYa) AzraYa diYeche o (tAdera) sAhAyya kareche, tArA paraspare eke anyera ali-oYAriza| Ara yArA ImAna eneche kintu hijarata kareni, hijarata nA karA paryanta tAdera sAthe tomAdera uttarAdhikArera konao samparka nei| hA~ dInera kAraNe tArA tomAdera sAhAyya cAile (tAderake) sAhAyya karA tomAdera avazya kartavya, avazya (se sAhAyya) yadi emana konao sampradAYera viruddhe haYa, yAdera saGge tomAdera kona cukti Ache, (tave naYa)| tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha tA bhAlobhAve dekhena|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA paraspare eke anyera ali-oYAriza| tomarA yadi erUpa nA kara, tave pRthivIte phitanA o mahA viparyaYa dekhA deve|

yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche Ara yArA (tAderake) AzraYa diYeche o (tAdera) sAhAyya kareche, tArAi prakRta mumina| tAdera janya raYeche mAgaphirAta o (jAnnAtera) sammAnajanaka riyika|

yArA pare ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche o tomAdera sAthe jihAda kareche, tArAo tomAdera antarbhukta| Ara (tAdera madhye) yArA (purAno muhAjiradera) AtmIYa, AllAhara kitAve tArA eke-anyera (mIrAchera vyApAre anyadera apekSA) vezi hakadAra| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe paripUrNa jJAna rAkhena|
(he musalimagaNa! eTA) AllAha o tAra rAsUlera pakSa theka samparkacchedera ghoSaNA sei sakala muzarikadera sAthe, yAdera sAthe tomarA cuktivaddha haYechile|

sutarAM (he muzarikagaNa! Aravera) bhUmite cAra mAsa paryanta tomarA (svAdhInabhAve) vicaraNa karate pAra| jene rekha, tomarA AllAhake vyartha karate pArave nA evaM eTAo (jene rekha) ye, AllAha kApheraderake lAJchita kare chAr3avena|

var3a hajjera dina AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa hate samasta mAnuSera janya ghoSaNA karA yAcche ye, AllAha muzarikadera sAthe samparkaccheda karechena evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| sutarAM (he muzarikagaNa!) tomarA yadi tAovA kara, tave tA tomAdera pakSe kalyANakara have| Ara yadi (ekhanao) tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave smaraNa rekha, tomarA AllAhake akSama karate pArave nA evaM kApheraderake yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda zonAo|

tave (he musalimagaNa!) ye muzarikadera sAthe tomarA cukti sampanna karecha o pare tArA tomAdera cukti rakSAYa konao truTi kareni evaM tomAdera viruddhe kAuke sahayogitAo kareni, tAdera saGge kRta cuktira meYAda pUrNa karave| nizcaYai AllAha sAvadhAnatA avalamvanakArIdera pachanda karena|

ataHpara sammAnita mAsasamUha ativAhita hale muzarikaderake (yArA tomAdera cukti bhaGga karechila) yekhAnei pAve hatyA karave| tAderake grephatAra karave, avarodha karave evaM tAderake dharAra janya pratyeka ghA~Tite OMt pete vase thAkave| avazya tArA yadi tAovA kare, nAmAya kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa, tave tAdera patha cher3e deve| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

muzarikadera madhye keu yadi tomAra kAche AzraYa prArthanA kare, tave tAke AzraYa deve, yAte se AllAhara vANI zunate pAre| tArapara tAke tAra nirApada sthAne peৗ~chiYe deve| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA emana loka, yAdera jJAna nei|

muzarikadera janya AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera kAche kona cukti ki kare valavat thAkate pAre? tave masajidula hArAmera nikaTe tomarA yAdera sAthe cukti sampanna karecha, tArA yatakSaNa tomAdera sAthe sojA thAkave, tomarAo tAdera sAthe sojA thAkave| nizcaYai AllAha muttAkIderake pachanda karena|

(kintu anya muzarikadera sAthe) kemana kare (cukti valavat thAkave), yakhana (tAdera avasthA hala), tArA kakhanao tomAdera upara vijaYI hale tomAdera vyApAre konaorUpa AtmIYatAra maryAdA deYa nA evaM aGgIkArerao nA| tArA mukhe tomAderake santuSTa rAkhate cAYa, athaca tAdera antara tA asvIkAra kare| tAdera adhikAMzai avAdhya|
tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhera vinimaYe (duniYAra) tuccha mUlya grahaNakei pachanda kareche evaM tAra phale (mAnuSake) AllAhara patha theke nivRtta kare| vastuta tArA yA kichu kare tA ati nikRSTa|
tArA konao muminera kSetrei konao AtmIYatAra maryAdA deYa nA evaM aGgIkArerao naYa evaM tArAi sImAlaMghanakArI|
sutarAM yadi tArA tAovA kare, nAmAya kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa, tave tArA tomAdera dvInI bhAi haYe yAve| yArA jAnate AgrahI, tAdera janya vidhAnAvalI (ebhAve) vizada varNanA kari|

tArA yadi cukti sampanna karAra para nijedera pratizruti bhaGga kare evaM tomAdera dvInera nindA kare, tave kupharera e sakala netRvargera saGge ei AzAYa yuddha kara ye, tArA haYata nirasta have| vastuta erA emana loka, yAdera pratizrutira konao mUlya nei|

tomarA ki sei sakala lokera sAthe yuddha karave nA, yArA nijedera pratizruti bhaGga kareche evaM rAsUlake (deza theke) vahiSkArera icchA kareche evaM tArAi tomAdera viruddhe (uskAnI dAna o utyaktakaraNera kAja) prathama kareche| tomarA ki tAderake bhaYa kara? (yadi tAi haYa) tave to AllAhai e viSaYera vezi hakadAra ye, tomarA tAke bhaYa karave yadi tomarA mumina hao|
tAdera sAthe yuddha kara, yAte AllAha tomAdera hAte tAderake zAsti dAna karena, tAderake lAJchita karena, tAdera viruddhe tomAderake sAhAyya karena evaM muminadera antara jur3iYe dena|
evaM tAdera manera kSobha dUra karena| AllAha yAra prati icchA tAra tAovA kavula karena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA ki mane karecha tomAderake emani cher3e deoYA have, athaca AllAha ekhanao dekhe nenani tomAdera madhye kArA jihAda kare evaM AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla evaM muminadera chAr3A anya kAuke antaraGga vandhu vAnAYa nA? tomarA yA-kichu kara, AllAha tA paripUrNarUpe jAnena|

AllAhara masajidasamUha AvAda karAra kona upayuktatA muzarikadera nei, yakhana tArA nijerAi nijedera kupharera sAkSI| tAdera samasta karmai niSphala haYe geche evaM tArA jAhAnnAmei sthAYIbhAve thAkave|

AllAhara masajida to AvAda kare tArAi, yArA AllAha o parakAle ImAna eneche evaM nAmAya kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM AllAha chAr3A kAuke bhaYa kare nA| erUpa lokadera samparkei AzA Ache ye, tArA saThika patha avalamvanakArIdera antarbhukta have|

tomarA ki hAjIderake pAni pAna karAno o masajidula hArAmake AvAda karAra kAjake sei vyaktira (kAryAvalIra) samAna mane kara, ye AllAha o parakAle ImAna eneche evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche? AllAhara kAche erA samatulya naYa| AllAha jAlema sampradAYake lakSyasthale peৗ~chAna nA|
yArA ImAna eneche, AllAhara pathe hijarata kareche evaM nijedera jAna-mAla dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche, tArA AllAhara kAche maryAdAYa aneka zreSTha evaM tArAi saphalakAma|
tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake nijera pakSa theke rahamata, santuSTi o emana udyAnasamUhera susaMvAda dicchena, yAra bhetara tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI ni‘Amata|
tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave| nizcaYai AllAharai kAche Ache mahA-pratidAna|
he muminagaNa! tomAdera pitA o bhAiYerA yadi ImAnera viparIte kupharake zreSThatva deYa, tave tAderake nijedera abhibhAvaka vAnio nA| tomAdera madhye yArA tAderake abhibhAvaka vAnAve, tArAi jAlema|

(he navI! musalimaderake) vala, tomAdera kAche yadi AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla evaM tA~ra pathe jihAda karA apekSA vezi priYa haYa tomAdera pitA, tomAdera putra, tomAdera bhAi, tomAdera strI, tomAdera khAndAna, tomAdera sei sampada yA tomarA arjana karecha, tomAdera sei vyavasA, yAra mandA par3Ara AzaGkA kara evaM vasavAsera sei ghara, yA tomarA bhAlovAsa, tave apekSA kara, ye paryanta nA AllAha nija phAYasAlA prakAza karena| AllAha avAdhya lokaderake lakSyasthale peৗ~chAna nA|

vastuta AllAha vahu kSetre tomAdera sAhAyya karechena evaM (vizeSa kare) hunAYanera dina, yakhana tomAdera saMkhyAdhikya tomAderake AtmaprasAde lipta karechila| kintu se saMkhyAdhikya tomAdera konao kAje Aseni evaM yamIna tAra prazastatA sattveo tomAdera janya saMkIrNa haYe giYechila| ataHpara tomarA pRSTha pradarzana kare (yuddhakSetra hate) palAYaNa karechile|

ataHpara AllAha nijera pakSa theke tA~ra rAsUla o muminadera prati prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM emana eka vAhinI avatIrNa karalena, yA tomarA dekhate pAoni| Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila, AllAha tAderake zAsti dilena| Ara eTAi kAphiradera karmaphala|
ataHpara AllAha yAke icchA karena tAovAra suyoga dAna karena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he muminagaNa! muzarikarA to ApAdamastaka apavitra| sutarAM e vacharera para yena tArA masajidula hArAmera nikaTeo nA Ase evaM (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA yadi dAridryera bhaYa kara, tave (jene rekha), AllAha cAile nija anugrahe tomAderake (muzarikadera theke) veniYAya kare devena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

kitAvIdera madhye yArA AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhe nA evaM parakAleo naYa evaM AllAha o tAra rAsUla yA-kichu hArAma karechena tAke hArAma mane kare nA evaM satya dvInake nijera dvIna vale svIkAra kare nA, tAdera saGge yuddha kara, yAvat nA tArA heYa haYe nija hAte jiyiYA AdAYa kare|

iYAhudIrA vale, uyAYara AllAhara putra Ara nAsArAgaNa vale, mAsIha AllAhara putra| esavai tAdera mukhera tairi kathA| erA tAdera pUrve yArA kAphera haYe giYechila, tAderai mata kathA vale| tAderake AllAha dhvaMsa karuna! tArA vibhrAnta haYe kona dike ulTe yAcche?

tArA AllAhara parivarte nijedera AhavAra (arthAt iYAhudI dharmaguru) evaM rAhiva (khrisTAna vairAgI)ke khodA vAniYe niYeche evaM mAsIha ivane mAraYAmakeo| athaca tAderake eka AllAha chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karAra hukuma deoYA haYani| tini vyatIta kona mAvuda nei| tAdera aMzIvAdIsulabha kathAvArtA hate tini sampUrNa pavitra|
tArA AllAhara nUrake tAdera mukhera (phu~) dvArA nibhiYe dite cAYa, athaca AllAha tAra nUrera pUrNa udbhAsana chAr3A Ara kichutei sammata nana, tAte kApheragaNa eTAke yatai aprItikara mane karuka|
AllAhai to hidAYAta o satya dvInasaha nija rAsUlake preraNa karechena, yAte tini anya sava dvInera upara tAke jaYayukta karena, tAte muzarikagaNa eTAke yatai aprItikara mane karuka|

he muminagaNa! (iYAhudI) AhavAra o (khrisTAna) rAhivadera madhye emana anekei Ache, yArA anyAYabhAve mAnuSera sampada bhoga kare evaM (anyaderake) AllAhara patha theke nivRtta kare| yArA sonA-rupA puJjIbhUta kare evaM tA AllAhara pathe vyaYa kare nA, tAderake yantraNAmaYa zAstira ‘susaMvAda’ dAo|

ye dina se dhana-sampada jAhAnnAmera Agune uttapta karA have, tArapara tA dvArA tAdera kapAla, tAdera pA~jara o piThe dAga deoYA have (evaM valA have) ei hacche sei sampada, yA tomarA nijedera janya puJjIbhUta karate| sutarAM tomarA ye sampada puJjIbhUta karate, tAra majA bhoga kara|

prakRtapakSe AllAhara kAche AllAhara kitAve (arthAt lAohe mAhphUje) mAsera saMkhyA vAraTi, sei dina theke, ye dina AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechilena| era madhye cAraTi mAsa maryAdApUrNa| eTAi sahaja-sarala dvIna (-era dAvI)| sutarAM tomarA e mAsasamUhera vyApAre nijedera prati juluma karo nA evaM tomarA sakale mile muzarikadera sAthe lar3Ai kara, yemana tArA sakale mile tomAdera sAthe lar3Ai kare| ekIna rekho nizcaYai AllAha muttAkIdera saGge Achena|

ei nAsI (arthAt mAsake pichiYe neoYA) to kupharakei vRddhi karA, yA dvArA kApheraderake vibhrAnta karA haYa| tArA e kAjake eka vachara hAlAla kare neYa o eka vachara hArAma sAvyasta kare, yAte AllAha ye mAsake niSiddha karechena tAra gaNanA pUraNa karate pAre evaM (ebhAve) AllAha yA hArAma sAvyasta karechilena, tAke hAlAla karate pAre| tAdera kukarmake tAdera dRSTite zobhanIYa kare deoYA haYeche| Ara AllAha erUpa kApheraderake hidAYAtaprApta karena nA|

he muminagaNa! tomAdera ki hala ye, yakhana tomAderake valA haYa AllAhara pathe abhiyAne vera hao, takhana tomarA bhArAkrAnta haYe mATira sAthe mize yAo? tomarA ki AkhirAtera parivarte pArthiva jIvana niYei santuSTa haYe gecha? (tAi yadi haYa) tave (smaraNa rekha), AkhirAtera viparIte pArthiva jIvanera Ananda ati sAmAnya|

tomarA yadi abhiyAne vera nA hao, tave AllAha tomAderake yantraNAmaYa zAsti devena evaM tomAdera sthAne anya konao jAtike AnaYana karavena evaM tomarA tA~ra kichumAtra kSati karate pArave nA| AllAha sarva viSaYe paripUrNa kSamatA rAkhena|

tomarA yadi tAra (arthAt navI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYA sAllAmera) sAhAyya nA kara, tave (tAte tAra konao kSati nei| kenanA) AllAha to sei samaYao tAra sAhAyya karechilena, yakhana kApheragaNa tAke (makkA theke) vera kare diYechila evaM takhana se chila duijanera dvitIYajana, yakhana tArA ubhaYe guhAra madhye chila, takhana se tAra saGgIke valechila, cintA karo nA, AllAha AmAdera sAthe Achena| sutarAM AllAha tAra prati nijera pakSa theke prazAnti varSaNa karalena evaM emana vAhinI dvArA tAra sAhAyya karalena, yA tomarA dekhani evaM kApheradera kathAke heYa kare dilena| vastuta AllAhara kathAi samucca| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

(jihAdera janya) vera haYe par3a, tomarA hAlakA avasthAYa thAka vA bhArI avasthAYa evaM nijedera jAna-mAla diYe AllAhara pathe jihAda kara| tomarA yadi vujha-samajha rAkha, tave eTAi tomAdera pakSe uttama|

yadi pArthiva sAmagrI Azu labhya evaM sapharao mAjhAmAjhi rakamera hata, tave tArA (arthAt munAphikagaNa) avazyai tomAra anugAmI hata| kintu tAdera pakSe ei kaThina patha aneka dUravartI mane hala| ekhana tArA AllAhara nAme kasama kare valave, AmAdera sAmarthya thAkale avazyai tomAdera sAthe vera hatAma| tArA nijerA nijederakei dhvaMsa karache evaM AllAha jAnena, tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
(he navI!) AllAha tomAke kSamA kare diYechena| kArA satyavAdI tomAra kAche tA spaSTa haoYA evaM kArA mithyAvAdI tA nA jAnA paryanta tumi tAderake (jihAde zarIka nA haoYAra) anumati kena dile?
yArA AllAha o zeSa divase ImAna rAkhe, tArA nijedera jAna-mAla dvArA jihAda nA karAra anumati tomAra kAche cAYa nA| AllAha muttAkIdera samparke bhAlobhAve jAnena|
tomAra kAche (jihAda nA karAra) anumati cAYa to tArA, yArA AllAha o zeSa divase ImAna rAkhe nA evaM tAdera antara sandehe nipatita evaM tArA nijedera sandehera bhetara dodulyamAna|

yadi vera haoYAra icchAi tAdera thAkata, tave tAra janya kichu nA kichu prastuti grahaNa karata| kintu tAdera abhiyAtrA AllAhara pachanda chila nA| tAi tAderake Alasye par3e thAkate dilena evaM vale deoYA hala, yArA (paGgutvera kAraNe) vase Ache tAdera sAthe tomarAo vase thAka|

tArA tomAdera sAthe vera hale tomAdera madhye vizRGkhalA sRSTi chAr3A anya kichu vRddhi karata nA evaM tomAdera madhye phitanA sRSTira ceSTAYa tomAdera sArisamUhera madhye choTAchuTi karata| Ara tomAdera madhye emana loka raYeche, yArA tAdera (matalavera) kathA veza zune thAke| AllAha jAlemadera samparke bhAlobhAve jAnena|

tArA era Ageo phitanA sRSTira ceSTA karechila| tomAra kSati karAra lakSye tArA viSaYAvalIke olaTa-pAlaTa kare yAcchila| avazeSe satya Asala evaM AllAhara hukuma vijaYI hala athaca tArA tA apachanda karachila|

Ara tAdera madhyei sei vyaktio Ache, ye vale, AmAke avyAhati dina evaM AmAke phitanAYa phelavena nA| ohe! phitanAYa to tArA par3ei raYeche| vizvAsa rAkha, jAhAnnAma kApheraderake veSTana kare rAkhavei|

tomAra kona kalyANa lAbha hale tAdera duHkha haYa Ara yadi tomAra kona musivata dekhA deYa, tave vale, AmarA to Agei AtmarakSAra vyavasthA kare niYechilAma, Ara (ekathA vale) tArA var3a khuzI mane saTake par3e|

vale dAo, AllAha AmAdera janya (tAkadIre) yA likhe rekhechena, tA chAr3A anya kona kaSTa AmAderake kichutei sparza karave nA| tinii AmAdera abhibhAvaka| Ara AllAharai upara muminadera bharasA karA ucita|

vale dAo, tomarA AmAdera janya ki du’Ti maGgalera ye-kona ekaTira apekSAi karacha, (yA AmarA lAbha karava?) Ara AmarA tomAdera vyApAre ei apekSAYa Achi ye, AllAha nijera pakSa hate athavA AmAdera hAte tomAderake zAsti dAna karavena| sutarAM tomarA apekSA kara, AmarAo tomAdera sAthe apekSAYa Achi|
vale dAo, tomarA (nijedera sampada theke) khuzI mane cA~dA dAo athavA asantoSera sAthe, tomAdera pakSa hate tA kichutei kavula karA have nA| nizcaYai tomarA kramAgata avAdhyatAkArI sampradAYa|

tAdera cA~dA kavula haoYAra pakSe vAdhA e chAr3A Ara kichui naYa ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera kupharI kareche evaM tArA sAlAte Asale gar3imasi karei Ase evaM (konao satkAje artha) vyaYa karale tA kare asantoSera sAthe|

tAdera artha-sampada o santAna-santati (-era Adhikya) dekhe tomAra vismita haoYA ucita naYa| AllAha to cAna duniYAra jIvane tAderake esava jinisa dvArAi zAsti dite| Ara yAte kAphira avasthAYai tAdera prANa vera haYa|
tArA AllAhara kasama kare vale ye, tArA tomAderai antarbhukta, athaca tArA tomAdera antarbhukta naYa| prakRtapakSe tArA eka bhIru sampradAYa|
tArA yadi konao AzraYasthala, konao giri-guhA kiMvA kona pravezasthala peYe yAYa, tave lAgAmahInabhAve se dikei dhAvita haYa|

tAdera (arthAt munAphikadera) madhye emana lokao Ache, yArA sadakA (vaNTana) samparke tomAke doSAropa kare| sadakA theke tAderake (tAdera mana mata) deoYA hale tArA khuzI haYe yAYa Ara tAderake yadi tA theke nA deoYA haYa, amani tArA kSuvdha haYa|

kata bhAlo hata AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tAderake yA-i diYechena tAte yadi tArA khuzI thAkata evaM valata, AllAhai AmAdera janya yatheSTa, bhaviSyate AllAha AmAderake nija anugraha dAna karavena evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| AmarA to AllAharai kAche AzAvAdI|

prakRtapakSe sadakA phakIra o misakInadera haka evaM sei sakala karmacArIdera, yArA sadakA usUlera kAje niYojita evaM yAdera manoraJjana karA uddezya tAdera| tAchAr3A dAsamuktite, RNagrastera RNa parizodhe evaM AllAhara pathe o musAphiradera sAhAyyeo (tA vyaYa karA have)| eTA AllAhara pakSa hate pradatta vidhAna| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tAdera (arthAt munAphikadera) madhye emana lokao Ache, yArA navIke kaSTa deYa evaM (tA~ra samparke) vale, ‘se to ApAdamastaka kAna’| vale dAo, tomAdera pakSe yA maGgalajanaka, se tArai janya kAna| se AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhe evaM muminadera kathA vizvAsa kare| tomAdera madhye yArA (vAhyikabhAve) ImAna eneche, tAdera janya se rahamata (sulabha AcaraNakArI)| yArA AllAhara rAsUlake kaSTa deYa, tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta raYeche|

(he musalimagaNa!) tArA tomAderake khuzI karAra janya tomAdera kAche AllAhara nAme zapatha kare, athaca tArA satyikArera mumina hale to AllAha o tAra rAsUlai e viSaYera vezi hakadAra ye, tArA tAderakei khuzI karave|
tArA ki jAne nA, keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA karale tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna, yAte se sarvadA thAkave? eTA to carama lAJchanA!

munAphikagaNa bhaYa pAYa ye, pAche musalimadera prati emana konao sUrA nAyila haYa, yA tAderake tAdera (arthAt munAphikadera) manera kathA jAniYe dive| vale dAo, tomarA ThATTA karate thAka| tomarA yA bhaYa kara AllAha tA prakAza karei divena|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara, tArA avazyai valave, AmarA to hAsi-tAmAzA o phUrti karachilAma| vala, tomarA ki AllAha, AllAhara AYAta o tA~ra rAsUlake niYe phUrti karachile?
ajuhAta dekhio nA| tomarA ImAna jAhira karAra para kupharIte lipta haYecha| Ami tomAdera madhye eka dalake kSamA karaleo, anya dalake avazyai zAsti diva| kenanA tArA aparAdhI|

munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArI sakalei eke anyera mata| tArA manda kAjera Adeza kare o bhAlo kAje vAdhA deYa evaM tArA nijedera hAta vandha kare rAkhe| tArA AllAhake bhule geche| AllAhao tAderake bhule gechena| niHsandehe munAphikagaNa ghora avAdhya|

AllAha munAphika puruSa, munAphika nArI evaM samasta kApherake jAhAnnAmera Agunera pratizruti diYechena| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| tAi tAdera janya yatheSTa| AllAha tAdera prati abhisampAta varSaNa karechena Ara tAdera janya Ache sthAYI zAsti|

(he munAphikagaNa!) tomAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche, (tomarA) tAderai mata| tArA zaktite tomAdera apekSA pravala evaM dhane-jane tomAdera apekSA aneka vezi chila| tArA tAdera bhAgera majA luTe niYechila, tArapara tomarAo tomAdera bhAgera majA luTacha, yebhAve tomAdera pUrvavartIgaNa nijedera bhAgera majA luTechila evaM tomarAo vehudA kathAvArtAYa lipta haYechila, yemana tArA lipta haYechila| tArAi emana loka, yAdera karma duniYA o AkhirAte niSphala haYeche evaM tArAi emana loka, yArA (vyavasAYa) kSatigrasta haYeche|

tAdera (arthAt munAphikadera) kAche ki tAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche tAdera saMvAda peৗ~cheni? nUhera kaoma, Ada, chAmuda, ivarAhImera kaoma, mAdaYAnavAsI evaM sei sakala janapada, yA ulTiYe deoYA haYeche! tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa dalIla-pramANa niYe esechila| ataHpara AllAha emana nana ye, tAdera upara juluma karavena; vastuta tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karechila|

mumina nara o mumina nArI paraspare eke anyera sahayogI| tArA satkAjera Adeza kare, asat kAje vAdhA deYa, nAmAya kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare| tArA emana loka, yAdera prati AllAha nija rahamata varSaNa karavena| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha mumina nara o mumina nArIderake pratizruti diYechena emana udyAnarAjira, yAra taladeze nahara vahamAna thAkave| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave evaM emana utkRSTa vAsasthAnera, yA raYeche satata sajIva jAnnAte| Ara AllAhara santuSTii sarvazreSTha, (yA jAnnAtavAsIgaNa lAbha karave)| eTAi mahA sAphalya|
he navI! kAphera o munAphikadera sAthe jihAda kara evaM tAdera prati kaThora hao| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma Ara tA ati manda ThikAnA|

tArA AllAhara kasama kare ye, tArA kichu valeni| athaca tArA kupharI kathA valeche evaM tArA nijedera isalAma grahaNera para kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM tArA emana kAja karAra icchA karechila, yAte tArA saphalatA lAbha karate pAreni| AllAha o tAra rAsUla ye tAderake nija anugrahe vittavAna karechilena, tArA tArai vadalA diYeche| ekhana tArA tAovA karale tA tAdera pakSe maGgala have| Ara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave AllAha tAderake duniYA o AkhirAte yantraNAmaYa zAsti divena evaM bhUpRSThe tAdera kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|

tAdera madhye emana lokao Ache, yArA AllAhara saGge aGgIkAra karechila ye, tini yadi nija anugrahe AmAderake dAna karena, tave AmarA avazyai sadakA karava evaM niHsandehe AmarA satlokadera antarbhukta hava|
kintu AllAha yakhana tAderake nija anugrahe dAna karalena, takhana tArA tAte kArpaNya karala evaM mukha phiriYe cale gela|

sutarAM AllAha zAsti hiseve tAdera antare kapaTatA sthita kare dilena sei dina paryanta, ye dina tArA AllAhara saGge milita have| kenanA tArA AllAhara saGge ye oYAdA karechila, tA rakSA karala nA evaM tArA mithyA valata|
tAdera ki jAnA chila nA ye, AllAha tAdera (samasta) gupta viSaYa evaM tAdera kAnAkAni samparke avagata evaM AllAh adRzyera yAvatIYa viSaYa samparke paripUrNa jJAta?

(esava munAphika to emana), yArA mu’minadera madhye svataHsphUrtabhAve sadakAkArIderake doSAropa kare evaM tAderakeo, yArA nija zrama (lavdha artha) chAr3A kichui pAYa nA| e kAraNe tArA tAderake upahAsa kare| AllAhao tAdera upahAsa karena| tAdera janya yantraNAmaYa zAsti prastuta raYeche|

(he navI!) tumi tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara vA nA kara ekai kathA| tumi yadi tAdera janya sattara vArao kSamA prArthanA kara, tavu AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA| tA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe kupharI kareche| AllAha avAdhya lokaderake hidAYAtaprApta karena nA|

yAderake (tAvuka yuddha hate) pichane thAkate deoYA haYechila, tArA rAsUlullAhara yAoYAra para (nija gRhe) vase thAkAte Ananda lAbha karala| Ara AllAhara pathe nijedera jAna-mAla dvArA jihAda karA tAdera kAche nApachanda chila| tArA valechila, ei garame vera haYo nA| vala, uttApe jAhAnnAmera Aguna tIvratara| yadi tArA vujhata!
sutarAM tArA (duniYAYa) kiJcit hese nika| ataHpara tArA (AkhirAte) aneka kA~dave, tArA yA-kichu arjana kareche tAra pratiphalasvarUpa|

(he navI!) erapara AllAha tomAke tAdera konao dalera kAche phiriYe Anale evaM tArA tomAra kAche (anya konao jihAde) vera haoYAra anumati cAile tAderake vale deve, ‘tomarA Ara kakhanao AmAra saGge vera hate pArave nA’ evaM AmAra sAthe mile kakhanao konao zatrura saGge yuddha karate pArave nA| tomarA to prathamavAra vase thAkate pachanda karechile| sutarAM ekhanao tAdera saGge vase thAka, yArA (konao ojarera kAraNe) pichane thAke|

(he navI!) tAdera (arthAt munAphikadera) madhya hate keu mArA gele tumi tAra prati (jAnAyAra) nAmAya par3ave nA evaM tAra kavarera pAze dA~r3Aveo nA| tArA to AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe kupharI kareche evaM tArA pApiSTha avasthAYa mArA geche|

tAdera artha-sampada o santAna-santati (-era prAcurya) dekhe tomAra vismita haoYA ucita naYa| AllAha to esava jinisa dvArA tAderake pArthiva jIvane zAsti dite cAna evaM (Arao cAna) yena kAphira avasthAYai tAdera prANapAta haYa|

‘AllAhara prati ImAna Ana o tA~ra rAsUlera saGgI haYe jihAda kara’e marme yakhana kona sUrA nAyila haYa, takhana tAdera (arthAt munAphikadera) madhye yAdera sAmarthya Ache, tArA tomAra kAche avyAhati cAYa evaM vale, yArA (ghare) vase Ache, AmAderakeo tAdera saGge thAkate dina|
tArA pechane theke yAoYA nArIdera saGge thAkAtei Ananda vodha kare| tAdera antare mohara kare deoYA haYeche| phale tArA anudhAvana kare nA (ye, tArA Asale kI karache!)|
kintu rAsUla evaM ye sakala loka tAra saGge ImAna eneche, tArA nijedera jAna-mAla dvArA jihAda kareche| tAderai janya sarvaprakAra kalyANa evaM tArAi kRtakArya|
AllAha tAdera janya emana sava udyAna tairi kare rekhechena, yAra taladeze nahara vahamAna, yAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| tAi mahAsAphalya|

Ara dehAtIdera madhya thekeo ajuhAta pradarzanakArIrA Asala, yena tAderake (jihAda theke) avyAhati deoYA haYa| Ara (ebhAve) yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera saGge mithyA valechila, tArA vase thAkala| tAdera madhye yArA (sampUrNarUpe) kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera janya yantraNAmaYa zAsti raYeche|

durvala lokadera (jihAde nA yAoYAte) konao gunAha nei evaM pIr3ita o sei sakala lokerao naYa, yAdera kAche kharaca karAra mata kichu nei, yadi tArA AllAha o tAra rAsUlera prati akRtrima thAke| sat lokadera samparke konao abhiyoga nei| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

sei sakala lokerao (konao gunAha) nei, yAdera avasthA ei ye, tumi tAdera janya kona vAhanera vyavasthA karave yakhana ei AzAYa tArA tomAra kAche Asala Ara tumi valale, AmAra kAche to tomAderake deoYAra mata kona vAhana nei, takhana tAdera kAche kharaca karAra mata kichu nA thAkAra duHkhe tArA ebhAve phire gela ye, tAdera cokha theke azru jharachila|

abhiyoga to Ache tAdera samparke, yArA dhanavAna haoYA sattveo tomAra kAche avyAhati cAYa| pechane avasthAnakArI nArIdera saGge thAkAte tArA khuzI| AllAha tAdera antare mohara kare diYechena| phale tArA (prakRta satya) jAne nA|

(he musalimagaNa!) tomarA yakhana (tAvuka theke) tAdera kAche phire yAve, takhana tArA tomAdera kAche (nAnA rakama) ajuhAta peza karave| (he navI! tAderake) vale diYo, tomarA ajuhAta peza karo nA, AmarA kichutei tomAdera kathA vizvAsa karava nA| AllAha tomAdera avasthA samparke AmAderake bhAlobhAve avagata karechena| Ara bhaviSyate AllAhao tomAdera kAjakarma dekhavena evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| ataHpara tomAderake sei sattAra sAmane phiriYe neoYA have, yini gupta o prakAzya yAvatIYa viSaYa samparke savizeSa jJAta| ataHpara tomarA yA-kichu karachile se samparke tini tomAderake avahita karavena|

tomarA yakhana tAdera kAche phire yAve, takhana tArA tomAdera sAmane AllAhara kasama karave, yAte tomarA tAderake upekSA kara| sutarAM tomarA tAderake upekSA karo| nizcaYai tArA (Apadamastaka) apavitra| Ara tArA yA arjana karache tajjanya tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma|
tomarA yAte tAdera prati khuzI haYe yAo sejanya tArA tomAdera sAmane kasama karave, athaca tomarA tAdera prati khuzI haleo AllAha (erUpa) avAdhya lokadera prati khuzI havena nA|

dehAtI (munAphika)-gaNa kuphara o kapaTatAYa kaThoratara evaM (anyadera apekSA) tArA e viSaYera vezi upayukta ye, AllAha tA~ra rAsUlera prati ye dIna avatIrNa karechena tAra vidhAnAvalI samparke ajJa thAkave| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

sei dehAtIdera madhye emana lokao Ache, yArA (AllAhara nAme) vyaYita arthake eka jarimAnA gaNya kare evaM tomAdera vyApAre kAlacakrera apekSA kare, (athaca prakRta vyApAra hala,) nikRSTatama kAlacakra tAderai upara gar3iYeche| AllAha sakala kathA zonena, savakichu jAnena|

oi dehAtIdera madhye emana lokao Ache, yArA AllAha o AkhirAtera prati ImAna rAkhe evaM (AllAhara nAme) yA-kichu vyaYa kare, tAke AllAhara naikaTya o rAsUlera doYA lAbhera mAdhyama mane kare| nizcaYai, eTA tAdera janya naikaTya lAbhera mAdhyama| AllAha tAderake nija rahamatera bhetara dAkhila karavena| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

muhAjira o AnasAradera madhye yArA ImAne prathame agragAmI haYeche evaM yArA niSThAra sAthe tAdera anusaraNa kareche, AllAha tAdera sakalera prati santuSTa haYechena evaM tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa haYeche| AllAha tAdera janya emana udyAnarAji tairi kare rekhechena, yAra taladeze nahara vahamAna| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| eTAi mahA sAphalya|

tomAdera AzepAze ye sakala dehAtI Ache, tAdera madhyeo munAphika Ache evaM madInAvAsIdera madhyeo, tArA munAphikIte (etaTA) siddha (ye,) tumi tAderake jAna nA, Ami tAderake jAni| Ami tAderake du’vAra zAsti deva| ataHpara tAderake eka mahA zAstira dike tAr3iYe neoYA have|

apara kichu loka emana, yArA nijedera doSa svIkAra kareche| tArA eka satkAjera sAthe anya asatkAja miliYe pheleche| AzA karA yAYa AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karavena| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(he navI!) tAdera sampada theke sadakA grahaNa kara, yAra mAdhyame tumi tAderake pavitra o varakatapUrNa karave evaM tAdera janya doYA kara| nizcaYai tomAra doYA tAdera pakSe prazAntidAYaka| AllAha sava kathA zonena, savakichu jAnena|
tAdera ki jAnA nei ye, AllAhai to nija vAndAdera tAovA kavula karena evaM sadakAo grahaNa karena evaM AllAhai ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu?

evaM (tAderake) vala, tomarA Amala karate thAka| AllAha tomAdera Amala dekhavena evaM tA~ra rAsUla o (anyAnya) muminagaNao| ataHpara tomAderake sei sattAra kAche phiriYe neoYA have, yini gupta o prakAzya savakichu jAnena| tArapara tini tomarA yA karate tA tomAderake avahita karavena|

evaM apara kichu loka raYeche, yAdera samparke phAYasAlA mulatavi rAkhA haYeche AllAhara hukumera janya| AllAha haYata tAderake zAsti devena athavA tAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha sarvajJa prajJAmaYa|

evaM (kichu loka emana), yArA masajida nirmANa kareche (musalimadera) kSatisAdhana karA, kupharI kathAvArtA valA, muminadera madhye vibheda sRSTi karA evaM pUrva theke AllAha o tAra rAsUlera saGge ye vyakti yuddha kareche, tAra janya ekaTi ghA~Tira vyavasthA karAra uddezye| tArA avazyai kasama karave ye, AmarA saduddezyei eTA karechi| kintu AllAha sAkSya dena ye, nizcaYai tArA mithyuka|

(he navI!) tumi tAte (arthAt tathAkathita oi masajide) kakhanao (nAmAyera janya) dA~r3Ave nA| ye masajidera bhitti prathama dina thekei tAkaoYAra upara sthApita haYeche, seTAi tomAra dA~r3Anora vezi upayukta| tAte emana loka Ache, yArA pAka-pavitratAke vezi pachanda kare| AllAha pAka-pavitra lokadera pachanda karena|

AcchA, sei vyakti uttama, ye AllAha bhIti o tA~ra santuSTira upara nija gRhera bhitti sthApana kareche, nA sei vyakti, ye tAra gRhera bhitti sthApana kare eka khAdera patanonmukha kinArAYa, phale seTi tAke niYe jAhAnnAmera Agune patita haYa? AllAha jAlema sampradAYake hidAYAtaprApta karena nA|

tArA ye imArata tairi karechila, tA tAdera antare nirantara sandeha haYe thAkave, ye paryanta nA tAdera antara chinna-bhinna haYe yAYa| AllAha paripUrNa jJAnera adhikArI, paripUrNa hikamatera adhikArI|

vastuta AllAha muminadera kAcha theke tAdera jIvana o tAdera sampada kharida kare niYechena, tAdera janya jAnnAta Ache-era vinimaYe| tArA AllAhara pathe yuddha kare| phale hatyA kare o nihatao haYa| eTA eka satya pratizruti, yAra dAYitva AllAha tAorAta o inajIleo niYechena evaM kuraAneo| AllAha apekSA vezi pratizruti rakSAkArI Ara ke Ache? sutarAM tomarA AllAhara saGge ye saodA karecha, sei saodAra janya tomarA Anandita hao evaM eTAi mahA sAphalya|

(yArA ei saphala saodA kareche, tArA kArA? tArA) tAovAkArI, (AllAhara) ivAdatakArI, tA~ra prazaMsAkArI, saoma pAlanakArI, ruku o sijadAkArI, satkAjera AdezadAtA o anyAYa kAje vAdhAdAnakArI evaM AllAhara nirdhArita sImArekhA saMrakSaNakArI| (he navI!) erUpa muminaderake susaMvAda dAo|
eTA navI o muminadera pakSe zobhanIYa naYa ye, tArA muzarikadera janya kSamA prArthanA karave, tAte tArA AtmIYa-svajanai hoka nA kena, yakhana eTA suspaSTa haYe giYeche ye, tArA jAhAnnAmI|

Ara ivarAhIma nija pitAra janya ye mAgaphirAtera doYA karechilena, tAra kAraNa echAr3A Ara kichui chila nA ye, se tAke (pitAke) era pratizruti diYechila| pare yakhana tAra kAche spaSTa haYe gela ye, se AllAhara duzamana, takhana se tAra sAthe samparka chinna karala| ivarAhIma to atyadhika uh-AhakArI o var3a sahanazIla chila|

AllAha emana nana ye, konao sampradAYake hidAYAta karAra para gomarAha kare devena, yAvat nA tAdera kAche spaSTa kare dena ye, tArA kona kona viSaYa theke ve~ce thAkave| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe jJAta|
nizcaYai AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra rAjatva AllAharai adhikAre| tinii jIvana o mRtyu dAna karena| Ara AllAha chAr3A tomAdera konao abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI nei|

nizcaYai AllAha sadaYa dRSTi diYechena navIra prati evaM muhAjira o AnasAradera prati, yArA kaThina muhUrte navIra saGge thekechila, yakhana tAdera ekaTi dalera antara Tale yAoYAra upakrama karechila| ataHpara AllAha tAdera prati sadaYa halena| nizcaYai tini tAdera prati meheravAna, parama daYAlu|

evaM sei tina janera pratio (AllAha sadaYa halena), yAdera samparke siddhAnta mUlatavi rAkhA haYechila| ye paryanta nA e pRthivI vistRta haoYA sattveo tAdera janya saMkIrNa haYe gela, tAdera jIvana tAdera janya durviSaha haYe uThala evaM tArA upalavdhi karala, AllAhara (dharA) theke khoda tA~ra AzraYa chAr3A kothAo AzraYa pAoYA yAve nA, pare AllAha tAdera prati daYAparavaza halena, yAte tArA tArai dike ruju kare| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tomarA satyavAdIdera saGge thAka|

madInAvAsI o tAdera AzapAzera dehAtIdera pakSe eTA jAYeya chila nA ye, tArA AllAhara rAsUlera (anugAmI haoYA) theke pichiYe thAkave evaM eTAo jAYeya chila nA ye, tArA nijedera jIvanake priYa mane kare tAra (arthAt rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYA sAllAmera) jIvana samparke cintAmukta haYe vase thAkave| eTA e kAraNe ye, AllAhara pathe tAdera (arthAt mujAhidadera) ye pipAsA, klAnti o kSudhAra kaSTa dekhA deYa athavA tArA kApheradera krodha saJcAra kare emana ye padakSepa grahaNa kare kiMvA zatrura viruddhe tArA ye saphalatA arjana kare, tAte tAdera janya (tAdera AmalanAmAYa) avazyai satkarma lekhA haYa| nizcaYai AllAha satkarmazIladera zramaphala naSTa karena nA|

tAchAr3A tArA (AllAhara pathe) yA kichu vyaYa kare, se vyaYa alpa hoka vA vezi evaM tArA ye-kona upatyakAi atikrama kare, tA savai (tAdera AmalanAmAYa puNya hiseve) lekhA haYa, yAte AllAha tAderake (erUpa pratiTi Amalera vinimaYe) emana pratidAna dite pArena, yA tAdera utkRSTa Amalera janya nirdhArita Ache|

musalimadera pakSe eTAo samIcIna naYa ye, tArA (sarvadA) sakale eka saGge (jihAde) vera haYe yAve| sutarAM tAdera pratiTi var3a dala theke ekaTi aMza kena (jihAde) vera haYa nA, yAte (yArA jihAde yAYani) tArA dInera upalavdhi arjanera ceSTA kare evaM satarka kare tAdera kaoma (-era sei sava loka)ke, lokake (yArA jihAde giYeche,) yakhana tArA tAdera kAche phire Asave, phale tArA (gunAha theke) satarka thAkave|
he muminagaNa! kApheradera madhye yArA tomAdera nikaTavartI, tomarA tAdera saGge yuddha kara| tArA yena tomAdera madhye kaThoratA dekhate pAYa| jene rAkha, nizcaYai AllAha muttAkIdera saGge Achena|

yakhanai kona sUrA avatIrNa haYa, takhana tAdera (arthAt munAphikadera) keu keu vale, e sUrATi tomAdera madhye kAra kAra ImAna vRddhi kareche? yArA (satyikArera) ImAna eneche, e sUrA vAstavikai tAdera ImAna vRddhi kare evaM tArA (ete) Anandita haYa|
Ara yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache, e sUrA tAdera kaluSera sAthe Arao kaluSa yukta kare evaM tAdera mRtyuo ghaTe kAphera avasthAYa
tArA ki lakSya kare nA, prati vachara tArA du’-ekavAra parIkSAra sammukhIna haYa? tathApi tArA tAovA kare nA evaM tArA upadezao grahaNa kare nA|

evaM yakhanai konao sUrA nAyila haYa, takhana tArA eke anyera dike tAkAYa (evaM izArAYa eke anyake vale), tomAderake keu dekhache nA to? tArapara tArA (sekhAna theke) saTake par3e| AllAha tAdera antara ghuriYe diYechena, yehetu tArA anudhAvana kare nA|

(he mAnuSa!) tomAdera nijedera madhya thekei tomAdera kAche eka rAsUla eseche| tomAdera ye-konao kaSTa tAra janya ati pIr3AdAYaka| se satata tomAdera kalyANakAmI, muminadera prati atyanta sadaYa, parama daYAlu|
tAraparao yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave (he rAsUla! tAderake) vale dAo, AmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| tini chAr3A konao mAvuda nei| tArai upara Ami bharasA karechi evaM tini mahA Arazera mAlika|
Alipha-lAma-rA| esava hikamatapUrNa kitAvera AYAta|

mAnuSera janya ki eTA vismaYera vyApAra ye, Ami tAderai eka vyaktira prati ohI nAyila karechi ye, mAnuSake (AllAhara hukuma amAnya karAra pariNAma samparke) satarka kara evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa tAdera janya Ache satyikArera uccamaryAdA| (kintu se yakhana tAderake ei vArtA dila, takhana) kApheragaNa valala, eto eka suspaSTa yAdukara|

nizcaYai tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAha, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| tArapara tini Araze ‘isatioYA’ grahaNa karena| tini sakala kichu paricAlanA karena| tA~ra anumati chAr3A keu (tA~ra kAche) kArao pakSe supAriza karAra nei| tinii AllAha tomAdera pratipAlaka| sutarAM tA~ra ivAdata kara| tavuo ki tomarA anudhyAna karave nA?

tA~rai dike tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana| eTA AllAhara satya pratizruti| nizcaYai samasta mAkhaluka prathamavArao tinii sRSTi karena evaM punarvArao tinii sRSTi karavena, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAderake inasAphera sAthe pratidAna deoYAra janya| Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera janya Ache uttapta pAnira pAnIYa o yantraNAdAYaka zAsti, yehetu tArA satya pratyAkhyAna karata|

tinii AllAha, yini sUryake razmimaYa o candrake jyotirpUrNa karechena evaM tA~ra (paribhramaNera) janya vibhinna ‘manayila’ nirdhAraNa karechena, yAte tomarA vacharera gaNanA o (mAsasamUhera) hisAva jAnate pAra| AllAha esava yathArtha uddezya vyatireke sRSTi karenani| ye sakala loka jJAna-vuddhi rAkhe, tAdera janya tini esava nidarzana suspaSTarUpe varNanA karena|
nizcaYai dina-rAtera ekera para eka Agamane evaM AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu sRSTi karechena tAte sei sakala lokera janya vahu nidarzana raYeche, yAdera antare AllAhara bhaYa Ache|
nizcaYai yArA (AkhirAte) AmAra saGge sakSAta karAra AzA rAkhe nA evaM pArthiva jIvana niYei santuSTa o tAtei nizcinta haYe geche evaM yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalI samparke udAsIna-
nijedera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma|

(aparadike) yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tAdera ImAnera kAraNe tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake emana sthAne peৗ~chAvena ye, prAcuryamaYa udyAnarAjite tAdera taladeza diYe nahara vahamAna thAkave|

tAte (pravezakAle) tAdera dhvani have ei ye, he AllAha! sakala doSa-truTi theke tumi pavitra evaM sekhAne tAdera abhivAdana have sAlAma| Ara tAdera zeSa dhvani have ei ye, samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|

AllAha yadi mAnuSera (arthAt oisava kAphirera) janya aniSTake (arthAt zAstike) tvarAnvita karatena, yemanaTA tvarA kalyANa prArthanAra kSetre tArA kare thAke, tave tAdera avakAza khatama kare deoYA hata| (kintu erUpa tAr3Ahur3A AmAra hikamata-viruddha)| sutarAM yArA (AkherAte) AmAra sAthe milita haoYAra AzA rAkhe nA tAderake Ami tAdera Apana avasthAYa cher3e dei, yAte tArA tAdera avAdhyatAra bhetara itastata ghurate thAke|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana se zuYe, vase o dA~r3iYe (sarvAvasthAYa) AmAke DAke| tArapara Ami yakhana tAra kaSTa dUra kare dei, takhana se emanabhAve patha cale yena se kakhanao tAke sparza karA konao vipadera janya AmAke DAkeini! yArA sImAlaMghana kare tAdera kAche nijedera kRtakarmake ebhAvei manorama kare tolA haYeche|

tomAderara pUrve Ami vahu jAtike, yakhana tArA julume lipta haYeche, dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tAdera rAsUlagaNa tAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechila| athaca tArA ImAna Aneni| aparAdhI sampradAYake Ami ebhAvei vadalA diYe thAki|
ataHpara pRthivIte Ami tomAderake tAdera para sthalAbhiSikta karechi, tomarA kirUpa kAja kara tA dekhAra janya|

yArA (AkherAte) AmAra sAthe milita haoYAra AzA rAkhe nA, tAdera sAmane yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha suspaSTarUpe pATha karA haYa, takhana tArA vale, eTA naYa, anya konao kuraAna niYe eso athavA ete parivartana Ana| (he navI!) tAderake vale dAo, AmAra e adhikAra nei ye, nijera pakSa theke ete kona parivartana Anava| Ami to anya kichura naYa; kevala sei ohIrai anusaraNa kari, yA AmAra prati nAyila karA haYa| Ami yadi kakhanao AmAra pratipAlakera nApharamAnI kare vasi, tave AmAra eka mahA divasera zAstira bhaYa raYeche|

vale dAo, AllAha cAile Ami e kuraAna tomAdera sAmane par3atAma nA evaM AllAha tomAderake e samparke avagata karatena nA| Ami to era Ageo ekaTA vaYasa tomAdera madhye kATiYechi| tAraparao ki tomarA anudhAvana karave nA?
oi vyakti apekSA var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre, ye AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare kiMvA tAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kare? vizvAsa kara aparAdhIrA kRtakArya haYa nA|

tArA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura (arthAt managar3A upAsyadera) ivAdata kare, yArA tAdera konao kSati karate pAre nA evaM tAdera kona upakArao karate pAre nA| tArA vale, erA AllAhara nikaTa AmAdera supArizakArI| (he navI! tAderake) vala, tomarA ki AllAhake emana viSaYa samparke avahita karacha, yAra kona astitva tA~ra jJAne nei, nA AkAzamaNDalIte evaM nA pRthivIte? vastuta tArA ye ziraka kare tA theke tini sampUrNa pavitra o vahu urdhve|

(prathame) samasta mAnuSa kevala ekai dInera anusArI chila| tArapara tArA (paraspare matabhede lipta haYe) AlAdA-AlAdA haYe yAYa| tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke pUrva thekei ekaTA kathA sthirIkRta nA thAkale tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karache (duniYAtei) tAra mImAMsA kare deoYA hata|

tArA vale, e navIra prati tAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke konao nidarzana kena avatIrNa karA hala nA? (he navI! uttare) tumi vale dAo, adRzyera viSaYasamUha to kevala AllAharai ekhatiYAre| sutarAM tomarA apekSA kara| Amio tomAdera saGge apekSA karachi|

Ami yakhana mAnuSake rahamata AsvAdana karAi tAderake duHkha-kaSTa sparza karAra para, takhana sahasAi tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhera vyApAre cAlAki zuru kare deYa| vale dAo, AllAha Arao druta konao cAla dekhAte pArena| nizcaYai AmAra phirizatAgaNa tomAdera samasta cAlAki lipivaddha karache|

tini to AllAhai, yini tomAderake sthaleo bhramaNa karAna evaM sAgareo| ebhAve tomarA yakhana naukAYa saoYAra hao Ara naukAgulo mAnuSake niYe anukUla vAtAse pAnira upara vaYe cale evaM tArA tAte Ananda-magna haYe par3e, takhana haThAt tAra upara Apatita haYa tIvra vAYu evaM sava dika theke tAdera dike chuTe Ase taraGga evaM tArA mane kare sava dika theke tArA pariveSTita haYe par3eche, takhana tArA khA~Ti mane kevala AllAhara prati vizvAsI haYe zudhu tA~kei DAke (evaM vale, he AllAha!) tumi yadi era (arthAt ei vipada) theke AmAderake mukti dAo, tave AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava|

kintu AllAha yakhana tAderake mukti dAna karena, amani tArA yamIne anyAYabhAve avAdhyatA pradarzana kare| he mAnuSa! prakRtapakSe tomAdera e avAdhyatA khoda tomAderai viruddhe yAcche| sutarAM tomarA pArthiva jIvanera majA luTe nAo| zeSa paryanta AmArai nikaTa tomAdera phirate have| takhana Ami tomAderake tomarA yA-kichu karacha tA avahita karava|

pArthiva jIvanera dRSTAnta to kichuTA e rakama, yemana Ami AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karalAma, yaddaruNa bhUmija sei sava udbhida nivir3a ghana haYe janmAla, yA mAnuSa o gavAdi pazu kheYe thAke| avazeSe bhUmi yakhana nija zobhA dhAraNa kare o naYanAbhirAma haYe oThe evaM tAra mAlikagaNa mane kare ekhana tA sampUrNarUpe tAdera AYattAdhIna, takhana konao eka dine vA rAte tAte AmAra nirdeza ese par3e (ei marme ye, tAra upara kona duryeAga Apatita hoka) evaM Ami tAke kartita phasalera emana zUnya bhUmite pariNata kari, yena gatakAla tAra astitvai chila nA| ye sakala loka cintA kare tAdera janya ebhAvei nidarzanAvalI suspaSTarUpe varNanA kari|
AllAha mAnuSake zAntira AvAsera dike DAkena evaM yAke cAna sarala-pathaprApta karena|

yArA utkRSTa kAja kareche tAdera janya raYeche utkRSTa avasthA evaM vezi Arao kichu| tAdera mukhamaNDalake konao kAlimA Acchanna karave nA evaM lAJchanAo naYa| tArA have jAnnAtavAsI| tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave|

Ara yArA manda kAja kareche, (tAdera) manda kAjera vadalA anurUpa mandai have| lAJchanA tAderake Acchanna karave| AllAha (-era AyAva) hate tAdera kona rakSAkartA thAkave nA| mane have yena tAdera mukhamaNDala andhakAra rAtera TukarA dvArA AcchAdita karA haYeche| tArA have jAhAnnAmavAsI| tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave|

evaM (smaraNa rekha) ye dina Ami tAdera sakalake ekatra karava, tArapara yArA ziraka karechila tAderake valava, nija-nija sthAne avasthAna kara tomarAo evaM tomarA yAderake AllAhara zarIka menechile tArAo! ataHpara tAdera madhye (upAsaka o upAsyera) ye samparka chila, Ami tA ghuciYe deva evaM tAdera zarIkagaNa valave, tomarA to AmAdera ivAdata karate nA|
AmAdera o tomAdera madhye sAkSIrUpe AllAhai yatheSTa (ye,) AmarA tomAdera ivAdata samparke sampUrNa anavahita chilAma|

pratyeke atIte yA-kichu kareche, sei samaYe se nijei tA yAcAi kare neve| sakalakei tAdera prakRta mAlika AllAhara kAche phiriYe neoYA have evaM tArA ye mithyA racanA karechila, tA tAdera theke niruddheza haYe yAve|

(he navI! muzarikaderake) vale dAo, ke tomAderake AsamAna o yamIna theke riyaka saravarAha karena? athavA ke zravaNa o dRSTizaktira mAlika? evaM ke mRta hate jIvitake evaM jIvita theke mRtake vera karena? evaM ke yAvatIYa viSaYa niYantraNa karena? tArA valave, AllAha! vala, tavuo ki tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karave nA?
he mAnuSa! tinii AllAha, yini tomAdera satyikArera mAlika| satya spaSTa haYe yAoYAra para vibhrAnti chAr3A Ara kI avaziSTa thAke? etadasattveo tomAderake ulTo ke kothAYa niYe yAcche?
ebhAvei yArA avAdhyatAra nIti avalamvana kareche, tAdera samparke AllAhara e vANI satye pariNata haYeche ye, tArA ImAna Anave nA|

vala, tomarA yAderake AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta kara, tAdera madhye ki emana keu Ache, ye sRSTirAjike prathamavAra astitva dAna kare, ataHpara (tAdera mRtyura para) tAderake punarAYa astitva dAna kare? vala, AllAhai sRSTirAjike prathamavAra astitva dAna karena ataHpara (tAdera mRtyura para) tAderake punarAYa astitva dAna karavena| etadasattveo tomAderake ulTo ke kothAYa niYe yAcche?

vala, tomarA yAderake AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta kara, tAdera madhye emana keu ki Ache, ye satyera patha dekhAYa? vala, AllAhai satyera patha dekhAna| vala, yini satyera patha dekhAna tinii ki era vezi hakadAra ye, tA~ra Anugatya karA have, nA sei (vezi hakadAra) ye nije patha pAYa nA, yatakSaNa nA anya keu tAke patha dekhAYa? tA tomAdera kI haYeche? tomarA ki rakamera siddhAnta grahaNa kara?

evaM (prakRtapakSe) tAdera (arthAt muzarikadera) madhye adhikAMza kevala anumAnerai anusaraNa kare thAke, Ara eTA to nizcita ye, satyera viparIte anumAna konao kAje Ase nA| nizcaYai tArA yA-kichu kare AllAha tA bhAlobhAve jAnena|

e kuraAna emana naYa ye, eTA AllAha chAr3A anya kArao pakSa hate racanA karA have varaM eTA (ohIra) sei sava viSaYera samarthana kare, yA era pUrve nAyila haYeche evaM AllAha (lAohe mAhaphUje) yesava viSaYa likhe rekhechena eTA tAra vyAkhyA kare| ete konao sandeha nei ye, eTA jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera pakSa hate|

tAraparao ki tArA vale, rAsUla nijera pakSa hate eTA racanA kareche? vala, tave tomarA era mata ekaTi sUrAi (racanA kare) niYe eso evaM (e kAje sAhAyya grahaNera janya) AllAha chAr3A anya yAke pAra Deke nAo- yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

Asala kathA hacche, tArA mithyA sAvyasta karache sei viSaYake yAra jJAna tArA AYatta karate pAreni, evaM ekhanao tAra pariNAma tAdera sAmane Aseni| tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArAo ebhAvei (tAdera navIgaNake) asvIkAra karechila| sutarAM dekha se jAlemadera pariNAma kI haYeche|
tAdera madhye kataka to emana, yArA era (arthAt kuraAnera) prati ImAna Anave evaM kataka emana, yArA era prati ImAna Anave nA| tomAra pratipAlaka azAnti vistArakArIderake bhAlo karei jAnena|

(he navI!) tArA yadi tomAke mithyAvAdI vale, tave (tAderake) vale dAo AmAra karma AmAra janya evaM tomAdera karma tomAdera janya| Ami ye kAja karachi tAra dAYa theke tomarA mukta evaM tomarA yA karacha, tAra dAYa thekeo Ami mukta|

tAdera madhye katipaYa emanao Ache, yArA tomAra kathA (prakAzye) kAna pete zone, (kintu antare satyera konao anusandhitsA nei| se kAraNe prakRtapakSe tArA vadhira) tave ki tumi vadhirake zonAve, yadio tArA nA vojhe?
tAdera madhye kataka emana, yArA tomAra dike tAkiYe thAke (kintu antare nyAYaniSThatA nA thAkAra kAraNe tArA andhatulya)| tumi ki andhake patha dekhAve yadio tArA kichui upalavdhi kare nA?
prakRtapakSe AllAha mAnuSera prati vindumAtra juluma karena nA| kintu mAnuSa nijei nijera prati juluma kare|

ye dina AllAha tAderake (hAzarera mAThe) ekatra karavena, se dina tAdera mane have ye, yena tArA (duniYAYa vA kavare) dinera eka muhUrtera vezi avasthAna kareni| (e kAraNei) tArA paraspare eke anyake cinate pArave| vastuta yArA (AkherAte) AllAhara saGge milita haoYAke asvIkAra kareche evaM hidAYAtaprApta haYani, tArA avazyai lokasAnagrasta haYeche|

(he navI!) Ami tAderake (arthAt kApheraderake) yesava viSaYe bhIti pradarzana karechi, tAra konao viSaYa Ami tomAke (tomAra jIvaddazAYa) dekhiYe dei athavA (tAra Age) tomAra rUha kavaya kare nei, sarvAvasthAYai to tAderake zeSa paryanta AmAra kAchei phirate have| ataHpara (eTA to suspaSTa ye,) tArA yA-kichu karache, AllAha tA samyaka pratyakSa karachena (sutarAM takhana tini era zAsti devena)|
pratyeka ummatera janya ekajana rAsUla pAThAno haYeche| yakhana tAdera rAsUla ese geche takhana nyAYavicArera sAthe tAdera mImAMsA karA haYeche| tAdera upara konao juluma karA haYani|
tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa musalimaderake upahAsa karAra janya) vale, tomarA satyavAdI hale (vala AllAhara pakSa theke zAstidAnera) pratizruti kave pUraNa karA have?

(he navI! tAderake) vale dAo, Ami to AmAra nijerao konao upakAra karAra ekhatiYAra rAkhi nA evaM konao apakAra karArao nA, tave AllAha yataTuku cAna tA bhinna| pratyeka ummatera eka nirdiSTa samaYa Ache, yakhana tAdera se samaYa Ase, takhana tArA tA theke eka muhUrta pechaneo yete pAre nA evaM eka muhUrta Ageo nA|

tAderake vala, tomarA AmAke vala to, AllAhara AyAva yadi tomAdera upara rAtera velA ese par3e kiMvA dinera velA, tave aparAdhIrA tAra madhye emana kI (AkAGkSAyogya vastu Ache, yAke) tvarAnvita karate cAYa?
yakhana se zAsti esei par3ave takhana ki tomarA tA vizvAsa karave? (takhana to tomAderake valA have ye,) ekhana vizvAsa karacha? athaca tomarAi eTA (avizvAsa kare) tAr3AtAr3i cAcchile|
ataHpara jAlemaderake valA have, evAra sthAYI zAstira majA bhoga kara| tomAderake anya kichura naYa; varaM tomarA yA-kichu (pApAcAra) karate tArai pratiphala deoYA hacche|
tArA tomAke jijJesa kare, eTA (arthAt AkherAtera AyAva) ki vAstavika satya? vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlakera zapatha! eTA vilakula satya evaM tomarA (AllAhake) akSama karate pArave nA|

ye vyaktii julume lipta haYeche, tAra yadi pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache savai haYe yAYa, tave se nija muktira vinimaYe tA diYe deve evaM tArA yakhana zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana nija anutApa lukAte cAve| nyAYavicArera sAthe tAdera mImAMsA have evaM tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
smaraNa rekha, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA AllAharai| smaraNa rekha, AllAhara oYAdA satya, kintu adhikAMza loka jAne nA|
tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM tinii mRtyu ghaTAna| tA~rai kAche tomAdera sakalake phiriYe neoYA have|
he mAnuSa! tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke eseche eka upadeza, antarera roga-vyAdhira upazama evaM muminadera pakSe hidAYAta o rahamata|
(he navI!) vala, esava AllAhara anugraha o tA~ra rahamatei haYeche| sutarAM ete tAdera Anandita haoYA ucita| tArA yA-kichu puJjIbhUta kare, tA apekSA eTA zreYa!

vala, cintA kare dekha to, AllAha tomAdera janya ye riyaka nAyila karechilena, tArapara tomarA nijedera pakSa theke tAra kichu hAlAla o kichu hArAma sAvyasta karecha! jijJesa kara, AllAhai ki tomAderake era anumati diYechilena, nA tomarA AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda diccha?
yArA AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda deYa kiYAmata divasa samparke tAdera dhAraNA kI? nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera saGge sadaYa AcaraNakArI| kintu tAdera adhikAMzei kRtajJatA AdAYa kare nA|

(he navI!) tumi ye-avasthAYai thAka evaM kuraAnera ye-aMzai tilAoYAta kara evaM (he mAnuSa!) tomarA ye-kAjai kara, tomarA yakhana tAte lipta thAka, takhana Ami tomAdera dekhate thAki| tomAra pratipAlakera kAche aNu-parimANa jinisao gopana thAke nA nA pRthivIte, nA AkAze evaM tAra ceYe choTa evaM tAra ceYe var3a emana kichu nei, yA eka spaSTa kitAve lipivaddha nei|
smaraNa rekha, yArA AllAhara vandhu tAdera konao bhaYa thAkave nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
tArA sei sava loka, yArA ImAna eneche evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche|
tAdera duniYAra jIvaneo susaMvAda Ache evaM AkherAteo| AllAhara kathAYa konao parivartana haYa nA| eTAi mahAsAphalya|
(he navI!) tAdera kathA yena tomAke duHkha nA deYa| nizcaYai samasta zaktii AllAhara| tini sava kathAra zrotA sava kichura jJAtA|

smaraNa rekha, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yata prANI Ache, sava AllAharai mAlikAnAdhIna| yArA AllAha chAr3A anyake DAke, tArA AllAhara (prakRta) konao zarIkera anusaraNa kare nA| tArA kevala dhAraNArai anusaraNa kare| Ara tAdera kAja kevala AnumAnika kathA valA|

tinii AllAha, yini tomAdera janya rAta sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA tAte vizrAma grahaNa karate pAra| Ara dinake tomAdera dekhAra upayogI kare vAniYechena| nizcaYai ete sei sava lokera janya vahu nidarzana Ache, yArA lakSya kare zone|

(kichu loke) vale, AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena| tA~ra sattA pavitra! tini konao kichura mukhApekSI nana| AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA tA~rai| tomAdera kAche era sapakSe konao pramANa nei| tomarA ki AllAha samvandhe emana kathA valacha, yAra konao jJAna tomAdera nei?
vale dAo, yArA AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda Aropa kare, tArA kRtakArya have nA|

(tAdera janya) duniYAYa sAmAnya kichu Ananda-upabhoga Ache| tArapara AmArai kAche tAderake phire Asate have| tArapara tArA ye kuphurI karmapanthA avalamvana karechila, tAra vinimaYe Ami tAderake kaThina zAstira svAda grahaNa karAva|

(he navI!) tAdera sAmane nUhera ghaTanA par3e zonAo, yakhana se nija kaomake valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera madhye AmAra avasthAna evaM AllAhara AYAtasamUhera mAdhyame tomAderake satarka karATA yadi tomAdera pakSe duHsaha haYa, tave Ami to AllAharai upara bharasA karechi| sutarAM tomarA tomAdera zarIkaderake saGge niYe (AmAra viruddhe) tomAdera kauzala pAkApokta kare nAo, tArapara tomarA ye kauzala avalamvana karave tA yena tomAdera antare kona dvidhA-dvandvera kAraNa nA haYa; varaM AmAra viruddhe tomAdera siddhAnta (Anandacitte) kAryakara kare phela evaM AmAke ekadama samaYa dio nA|

tathApi tomarA yadi mukha phiriYe nAo, tave era (arthAt ei pracAra kAryera) vinimaYe Ami to tomAdera kAche konao pArizramika cAini| AmAra pArizramika anya keu naYa; kevala AllAhai nija dAYitve rekhechena| Ara AmAke hukuma deoYA haYeche, Ami yena anugata lokadera madhye zAmila thAki|

kintu tArA nUhake mithyAvAdI valala evaM pariNAme Ami nUhake o yArA naukAYa tAra saGge chila tAderake rakSA karalAma evaM tAderake kApheradera sthalAbhiSikta karalAma| Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake pratyAkhyAna karechila tAderake (plAvanera bhetara) nimajjita karalAma| sutarAM dekha, yAderake satarka karA haYechila tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche|

tArapare Ami vibhinna navIke tAdera sva-sva jAtira kAche preraNa karechi| tArA tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe esechila, kintu tArA prathamavAra yA pratyAkhyAna karechila tA Ara mAnatei prastuta hala nA| yArA sImAlaMghana kare tAdera antare Ami ebhAve mohara kare dei|
ataHpara Ami tAdera para mUsA o hArUnake phira‘Auna o tAra amAtyadera kAche AmAra nidarzanAvalIsaha preraNa kari| kintu tArA ahamikA pradarzana karala evaM tArA chila aparAdhI sampradAYa|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra pakSa hate satya Asala, takhana tArA valate lAgala, nizcaYai eTA suspaSTa yAdu|
mUsA valala, satya yakhana tomAdera kAche Asala takhana tomarA tAra samparke erUpa kathA valacha? eTA ki yAdu? yAdukaragaNa to kakhanao saphalakAma haYa nA!

tArA valala, tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanyai esecha ye, AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake ye rIti-nItira upara peYechi, tumi AmAderake tA theke vicyuta karave evaM yAte e deze tomAdera du’janera pratipatti kAYema haYe yAYa se janya? AmarA to tomAdera kathA mAnavAra nai!
phirAuna (tAra karmacArIderake) valala, yata dakSa yAdukara Ache, tAdera sakalake AmAra kAche niYe eso|
sutarAM yakhana yAdukaragaNa ese gela| mUsA tAderake valala, tomAdera yA-kichu nikSepa karavAra tA nikSepa kara|

tArapara tArA yakhana (tAdera lAThi o razi) nikSepa karala (evaM seguloke sApera mata choTAchuTi karate dekhA gela) takhana mUsA valala, tomarA ei yA-kichu pradarzana karale tA yAdu| AllAha ekhanai tA niSkriYa kare dicchena| AllAha phAsAda sRSTikArIdera kAja saphala hate dena nA|
AllAha nija hukume satyake satya kare dekhAna, yadio aparAdhIgaNa tA apachanda kare|

ataHpara ei ghaTala ye, mUsAra prati anya keu to naYa, tAra sampradAYerai katipaYa yuvaka phira‘Auna o tAdera netRvarga niryAtana karate pAre e AzaGkA sattveo ImAna Anala| nizcaYai deze phira‘Auna ati parAkramazAlI chila evaM se chila sImAlaMghanakArIdera antarbhukta|
mUsA valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA satyii AllAhara prati ImAna ene thAkale, kevala tA~rai upara nirbhara kara, yadi tomarA AtmasamarpaNakArI haYe thAka|
tArA valala, AmarA AllAharai upara nirbhara karalAma| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake oi jAlema sampradAYera parIkSAra pAtra vAnio nA|
evaM nija rahamate AmAderake kAphera sampradAYa hate nAjAta dAo|

Ami mUsA o tAra bhAiYera prati ohI pAThAlAma ye, tomarA tomAdera sampradAYake misarera ghara-vAr3itei thAkate dAo evaM tomAdera gharasamUhake nAmAyera sthAna vAnAo evaM (ebhAve) nAmAya kAYema kara o ImAna AnaYanakArIderake susaMvAda dAo|

mUsA valala, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Apani phira‘Auna o tAra amAtyaderake pArthiva jIvane vipula zobhA o dhana-daulata dAna karechena| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tAra phala hacche ei ye, tArA mAnuSake ApanAra patha theke vicyuta karache| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tAdera dhana-daulata dhvaMsa kare dina evaM tAdera antara emana zakta kare dina, yAte marmantuda zAsti pratyakSa nA karA paryanta tArA ImAna nA Ane|
AllAha valalena, tomAdera duA kavula karA hala| sutarAM tomarA dRr3hapada thAka evaM yArA satya samparke ajJa kichutei tAdera anusaraNa karo nA|

Ami vanI isarAIlake sAgara pAra kariYe dilAma| takhana phira‘Auna o tAra vAhinI juluma o sImAlaMghanera uddezye tAdera pazcAddhAvana karala| parizeSe yakhana se Duve mArA yAcchila, takhana valate lAgala, Ami svIkAra karalAma, vanI isarAIla yei AllAhara prati ImAna eneche tini chAr3A konao mAvuda nei evaM Amio AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta|
(uttara deoYA hala) ekhana (ImAna Anacha)? athaca era Age avAdhyatA karecha evaM kramAgata azAnti sRSTi karate thekecha|
sutarAM Aja Ami tomAra (kevala) dehaTi vA~cAva, yAte tumi tomAra paravartI kAlera mAnuSera janya nidarzana haYe thAka| (kenanA) AmAra nidarzana samparke vahu loka gAphela haYe Ache|

Ami vanI isarAIlake yathArthabhAve vasavAsera upayukta eka sthAne vasavAsa karAlAma evaM tAderake uttama riyaka dAna karalAma| ataHpara tArA (satya dIna samparke) tatakSaNa paryanta matabheda sRSTi kareni, yatakSaNa nA tAdera kAche jJAna ese peৗ~cheche| nizcaYai tArA yesava viSaYe matabheda karata kiYAmatera dina tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera madhye tAra mImAMsA kare divena|

(he navI!) Ami tomAra prati ye vANI nAyila karechi se samvandhe tomAra yadi vindumAtra sandeha thAke (yadio tA thAkA kakhanao sambhava naYa), tave tomAra pUrvera (AsamAnI) kitAva yArA pATha kare tAderake jijJesa kara| nizcaYai tomAra kAche tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate satyai eseche| sutarAM tumi kakhanao sandeha poSaNakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|
evaM tumi sei sakala lokerao antarbhukta haYo nA, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche, anyathAYa tumi lokasAnagrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|
nizcaYai yAdera samparke tomAra pratipAlakera vANI sAvyasta haYe geche| tArA ImAna Anave nA|
yadio tAdera sAmane sarva prakAra nidarzana ese yAYa, yAvat nA tArA yantraNAmaYa zAsti pratyakSa karave|

tave kona janapada emana kena hala nA ye, tArA emana eka samaYa ImAna Anata, yakhana ImAna tAdera upakAra karate pArata? avazya iunusera kaoma e rakama chila| tArA yakhana ImAna Anala takhana pArthiva jIvane lAJchanAkara zAsti tAdera theke tule nilAma evaM tAderake kichukAla paryanta jIvana bhoga karate dilAma|
AllAha icchA karale bhU-pRSThe vasavAsakArI sakalei ImAna Anata| tave ki tumi mAnuSera upara cApa praYoga karave, yAte tArA sakale mumina haYe yAYa?
eTA kArao pakSei sambhava naYa ye, AllAhara icchA vyatireke mumina haYe yAve| yArA tAdera vuddhi kAje lAgAYa nA AllAha tAdera upara kaluSa cApiYe dena|

(he navI!) tAderake vala, lakSa kare dekha AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIte ki ki jinisa Ache? kintu ye sava loka ImAna AnAra naYa, (AsamAna o yamIne virAjamAna) nidarzanAvalI o satarkakArI (navI)gaNa tAdera konao kAje Ase nA|
tave ki (ImAna AnAra janya) tArA tAdera pUrvera loke ye rakama dina pratyakSa karechila, se rakama dinera apekSA karache? vale dAo, tAhale tomarA apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera saGge apekSArata Achi|
ataHpara (yakhana AyAva Ase) Ami AmAra rAsUlagaNake evaM yArA ImAna Ane tAderake rakSA kari| ebhAvei Ami AmAra dAYitve rekhechi ye, Ami (aparApara) muminagaNake rakSA karava|

(he navI!) tAderake vala, he mAnuSa! tomarA yadi AmAra dIna samparke konao sandehe thAka, tave (zune rAkha) tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAdera ivAdata kara Ami tAdera ivAdata kari nA; varaM Ami AllAhara ivAdata kari, yini tomAdera prANa saMhAra karena| Ara AmAke hukuma deoYA haYeche, Ami yena muminadera antarbhukta thAki|
evaM (AmAke) ei (valA haYeche) ye, tumi ekaniSThabhAve nija cehArAke ei dInera dikei kAYema rAkhave evaM kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta have nA|

AllAha tAAlAke cher3e emana kAuke (arthAt managar3A mAvudake) DAkave nA, yA tomAra konao upakArao karate pAre nA evaM kSatio karate pAre nA| tAraparao yadi tumi erUpa kara (yadio tomAra pakSe tA karA asambhava), tave tumi jAlemadera madhye gaNya have|

AllAha yadi tomAke konao kaSTa dAna karena, tave tini chAr3A emana keu nei, ye tA dUra karave evaM tini yadi tomAra konao maGgala karAra icchA karena, tave emana keu nei, ye tAra anugraha rada karave| tini nija vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA anugraha dAna karena| tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(he navI!) vale dAo, he loka sakala! tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke satya ese geche| sutarAM ye vyakti hidAYAtera patha avalamvana karave, se tA avalamvana karave nijerai maGgalera janya Ara ye vyakti pathabhraSTatA avalamvana karave, tAra pathabhraSTatAra kSati tAra nijerai bhoga karate have| Ami tomAdera kAryAvalIra yimmAdAra nai|
tomAra kAche ye ohI pAThAno hacche, tumi tAra anusaraNa karo evaM dhairyadhAraNa karo, ye paryanta nA AllAha mImAMsA kare dena evaM tinii zreSTha mImAMsAkArI|

Alipha-lAma-rA| eTi emana eka kitAva, yAra AYAtasamUhake (dalIla-pramANa dvArA) sudRr3ha karA haYeche| ataHpara emana eka sattAra pakSa hate vizadabhAve varNanA karA haYeche, yini prajJAmaYa, sarvaviSaYe avahita|
(e kitAva navIke nirdeza deYa mAnuSake ei kathA valate) ye, AllAha chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karo nA| nizcaYai Ami tA~ra pakSa hate tomAdera janya satarkakArI evaM susaMvAdadAtA|

evaM ei (pathanirdeza deYa) ye, tomAdera pratipAlakera kAche gunAhera kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara tA~ra abhimukhI hao| tini tomAderake eka nirdhArita kAla paryanta uttama jIvana upabhoga karate divena evaM ye-keu vezi Amala karave tAke nijera pakSa theke vezi pratidAna divena| Ara tomarA yadi mukha phiriYe nAo, tave Ami tomAdera janya eka mahA divasera zAstira AzaGkA kari|
AllAharai kAche tomAderake phire yete have evaM tini sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

dekha, tArA (kApheragaNa) tA~ra theke lukAnora janya nijedera vuka du’bhA~ja kare rAkhe| smaraNa rekha, tArA yakhana nijedera gAYe kApar3a jar3AYa, takhana tArA yesava kathA gopana kare tAo AllAha jAnena evaM tArA yA prakAzye kare tAo| nizcaYai tini antaryAmI|
bhU-pRSThe vicaraNakArI emana konao prANI nei, yAra riyaka AllAha nija dAYitve rAkhenani| tini tAdera sthAYI ThikAnAo jAnena evaM sAmaYika ThikAnAo| sava kichui suspaSTa kitAve lipivaddha Ache|
