tinii AkAzamaNDala o pRthivI chaYa dine sRSTi karechena, yakhana tA~ra Araza chila pAnira upara, tomAdera madhye kAje ke zreSTha tA parIkSA karAra janya| tumi yadi (mAnuSake) vala ye, mRtyura para tomAderake phera jIvita karA have, tave yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA avazyai valave, eTA suspaSTa yAdu chAr3A kichui naYa|

Ami kichu kAlera janya yadi tAdera zAsti sthagita rAkhi, tave tArA nizcaYai valave, kona jinisa tA (arthAt sei zAsti) ATake rekheche? sAvadhAna! ye dina se zAsti ese yAve se dina tA tAdera theke TalAno yAve nA| tArA yA niYe ThATTA karache tA tAderake cAradika theke veSTana kare phelave|
yakhana Ami mAnuSake AmAra nikaTa hate anugraha AsvAdana karAi o pare tAra theke tA pratyAhAra kare nei takhana se hatAza (o) akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
AvAra yakhana konao duHkha-kaSTa tAke sparza karAra para tAke ni‘AmatarAji AsvAdana karAi, takhana se vale, AmAra sava amaGgala keTe geche| (Ara takhana) se haYa ullasita, garvita|
tave yArA dhairya dhAraNa kare o satkarma kare, tArA e rakama naYa| tArA mAgaphirAta o mahA pratidAna lAbha karave|

(he navI!) tave ki tomAra prati ye ohI nAyila karA hacche tAra kichu aMza cher3e dive? evaM tArA ye vale, tAra (arthAt muhAmmada sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAmera) prati konao dhana-bhAnDAra avatIrNa hala nA kena kiMvA tAra sAthe konao pherezatA Asala nA kena? e kAraNe sambhavata tomAra antara saGkucita hacche| tumi to ekajana satarkakArI mAtra! AllAha tAAlAi pratiTi viSaYe paripUrNa ekhatiYAra rAkhena|

tave ki tArA vale, se (navI) nijera pakSa theke ei ohI racanA kareche? (he navI! tAderake) vale dAo, tAhale tomarAo era mata dazaTi svaracita sUrA ene upasthita kara evaM (e kAje sAhAyyera janya) AllAha chAr3A yAke DAkate pAra Deke nAo- yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

eraparao yadi tArA tomAra kathA grahaNa nA kare tave (he mAnuSa!) jene rekha e ohI kevala AllAhara ilama hate avatIrNa haYeche evaM AllAha chAr3A ivAdatera upayukta Ara keu nei| sutarAM tomarA ki AtmasamarpaNakArI have?
yArA (kevala) pArthiva jIvana o tAra ThATavATa cAYa, Ami tAderake tAdera karmera pUrNa phala e duniYAYai bhoga karate deva evaM ekhAne tAdera prApya kichu kama deoYA have nA|
erAi tArA, yAdera janya AkherAte jAhAnnAma chAr3A kichui nei evaM yA-kichu kAjakarma tArA karechila, AkherAte tA niSphala haYe yAve Ara tArA ye Amala karache (AkherAtera hiseve) tA nA karArai mata|

AcchA vala to, sei vyakti (tAdera mata kI kare hate pAre) ye nija pratipAlakera pakSa hate Agata ujjvala hidAYAta (arthAt kuraAna)-era upara pratiSThita Ache, yAra satyatAra eka pramANa khoda tAra madhyei tAra anugAmI haYeche evaM tAra pUrve mUsAra kitAvao (tAra satyatAra pramANa vahana kare), yA mAnuSera janya anusaraNIYa o rahamatasvarUpa chila| erUpa loka era (arthAt kuraAnera) prati ImAna rAkhe| Ara oisava dalera madhye ye vyakti eke asvIkAra kare, jAhAnnAmai tAra nirdhArita sthAna| sutarAM era (arthAt kuraAnera) vyApAre konao sandehe patita haYo nA| nizcaYai eTA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate Agata satya| kintu adhikAMza loka ImAna Ane nA|

sei vyakti apekSA var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre, ye AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda deYa? erUpa lokaderake tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane upasthita karA have evaM sAkSyadAtAgaNa valave, erAi tArA, yArA tAdera pratipAlakera prati mithyA Aropa karata| sakale zune nika, oi jAlemadera upara AllAhara lAnata-
yArA AllAhara patha theke anyaderake nivRtta rAkhata o tAte vakratA tAlAza karata Ara AkherAtake tArA vilakula asvIkAra karata|

erUpa loka pRthivIte kothAo AllAha hate nijederake rakSA karate sakSama have nA evaM AllAha chAr3A tAdera konao vandhu o sAhAyyakArI lAbha hate pAre nA| tAderake dviguNa zAsti deoYA have| tArA (ghRNA o vidveSera kAraNe satya kathA) zunate pArata nA evaM tArA (satya) dekhateo pArata nA|
tArAi sei sava loka, yArA nijedera janya lokasAnera saodA karechila evaM tArA ye mAvuda gar3e niYechila, tA tAdera theke antarhita have|
nizcaYai AkherAte tArAi sarvApekSA vezi kSatigrasta have|
(anya dike) yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche evaM nijedera pratipAlakera sAmane vinIta prazAnta haYe geche, tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI| tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave|
e dala du’Tira upamA andha o vadhira evaM cakSuSmAna o zravaNazaktisampannera mata| tulanAYa erA ubhaYe ki samAna hate pAre? tathApi ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?
Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche ei vArtA diYe pAThAlAma ye, Ami tomAdera janya e viSaYera suspaSTa satarkakArI-
ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karo nA| nizcaYai Ami tomAdera vyApAre eka marmantuda divasera zAstira bhaYa kari|

tAra sampradAYera yei netRvarga kuphara avalamvana karechila, tArA valate lAgala, AmarA to tomAke AmAdera matai mAnuSa dekhachi, era vezi kichu naYa| AmarA Arao dekhachi tomAra anusaraNa karache kevala sei sava loka, yArA AmAdera madhye sarvApekSA gurutvahIna evaM tAo bhAsA-bhAsA cintAra bhittite evaM AmarA to AmAdera upara tomAdera kona zreSThatva dekhate pAcchi nA; varaM AmAdera dhAraNA tomarA sakale mithyAvAdI|

nUha valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAke ekaTu vala to, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke Agata eka ujjvala hidAYAtera upara pratiSThita thAki evaM tini vizeSabhAve nijera pakSa theke eka rahamata (arthAt navuoYAta) dAna karena kintu tomAdera tA upalavdhite nA Ase, tave ki Ami tomAdera upara tA javaradastimUlakabhAve cApiYe deva, yakhana tomarA tA apachanda kara?

evaM he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami era (arthAt ei tAvalIgera) vinimaYe tomAdera kAche konao sampada cAi nA| AmAra pArizramikera dAYitva AllAha chAr3A anya kArao upara naYa| yArA ImAna eneche tAderake Ami tAr3iYe dite pAri nA| nizcaYai tArA tAdera pratipAlakera saGge sAkSAta karave| kintu Ami to dekhachi tomarA ajJatAsulabha kathA valacha|
evaM he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami yadi tAderake tAr3iYe dei, tave AmAke AllAhara (dharA) theke ke rakSA karave? tavuo ki tomarA anudhyAna karave nA?

Ami tomAderake valachi nA ye, AmAra hAte AllAhara dhana-bhANDAra Ache, evaM eTAo naYa ye, Ami gAYeva jAni evaM Ami ekathAo valachi nA ye, Ami konao pherezatA| tomAdera dRSTite yArA heYa, tAdera samparke Ami ekathA valate pAri nA ye, AllAha tAderake konao maGgala dAna karavena nA| tAdera antare yA-kichu Ache, tA AllAhai sarvApekSA vezi jAnena| Ami tAdera samparke erUpa kathA valale nizcaYai Ami jAlimadera madhye gaNya hava|

tArA valala, he nUha! tumi AmAdera sAthe hujjata karecha evaM AmAdera sAthe var3a vezi hujjata karecha| ekhana tumi yadi satyavAdI hao, tave tumi AmAderake yAra (arthAt ye zAstira) humaki diccha, tA hAjira kara|
nUha valala, tA to AllAhai hAjira karavena, yadi tini icchA karena| Ara tomarA tAke akSama karate pArave nA|

Ami tomAdera kalyANa kAmanA karate cAileo AmAra upadeza tomAdera konao kAje Asate pAre nA, yadi (tomAdera jeda o haThakAritAra kAraNe) AllAhai tomAderake vibhrAnta karate cAna| tinii tomAdera pratipAlaka evaM tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|

AcchA tArA (arthAt Aravera esava kAphera) vale nA ki ye, se (arthAt muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) e kuraAna nijera pakSa theke racanA kareche? (he navI!) vale dAo, Ami eTA racanA kare thAkale AmAra aparAdhera dAYa AmAra nijera uparai vartAve| Ara tomarA ye aparAdha karacha Ami se janya dAYI nai|
evaM nUhera kAche ohI pAThAno hala ye, e paryanta tomAra sampradAYera ye sakala loka ImAna eneche tArA chAr3A Ara keu ImAna Anave nA| sutarAM tArA yA-kichu karache se janya tumi duHkha karo nA|
evaM AmAra tattvAvadhAne o AmAra ohIra sAhAyye tumi naukA tairi kara| Ara yArA jAlema haYe geche tAdera samparke tumi AmAra saGge kona kathA valo nA| evAra tArA avazyai nimajjita have|

sutarAM tini naukA vAnAte zuru karalena| yakhanai tAra sampradAYera kataka sardAra tA~ra kAcha diYe yeta, takhana tArA tAke niYe upahAsa karata| nUha valala, tomarA yadi AmAke niYe upahAsa kara, tave tomarA yemana upahAsa karacha, temani AmarAo tomAdera niYe upahAsa karachi|
evaM zIghrai tomarA Tera pAve kAra upara emana zAsti Apatita haYa, yA tAke lAJchita kare chAr3ave evaM kAra upara avatIrNa haYa sthAYI zAsti|

parizeSe yakhana AmAra hukuma ese gela evaM tAnnUra uthale uThala, takhana Ami (nUhake) valalAma, oi naukAYa pratyeka prakAra prANI hate du’Ti kare yugala tule lao evaM tomAra parivAravargakeo, tave tAdera madhye yAdera samparke pUrve valA haYeche (ye, tArA kupharIra kAraNe nimajjita have) tArA vyatIta evaM (tule nAo) yArA ImAna eneche tAderakeo| vastuta alpa saMkhyaka lokai tAra saGge ImAna enechila|
nUha (tAdera sakalake) valala, tomarA e naukAYa ArohaNa kara| era calAo AllAhara nAme evaM noGgara karAo| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

se naukA parvata-pramANa taraGgarAzira madhye tAdera niYe vaYe calachila| nUha tAra ye putra sakalera theke pRthaka chila, tAke Deke valala, vAchA! AmAdera sAthe ArohaNa kara evaM kApheradera sAthe theka nA|

se valala, Ami ekhanai emana eka pAhAr3e AzraYa neva, yA AmAke pAni theke rakSA karave| nUha valala, Aja AllAhara hukuma theke kAuke rakSA karAra keu nei, kevala sei chAr3A yAra prati AllAha daYA karavena| ataHpara Dheu tAderake vicchinna kare dila evaM seo nimajjitadera antarbhukta hala|

evaM hukuma deoYA hala, he bhUmi! tumi nija pAni grAsa kare nAo evaM he AkAza! tumi kSAnta hao| sutarAM pAni neme gela evaM viSaYaTi cukiYe deoYA hala| Ara naukA judI pAhAr3e ese theme gela evaM vale deoYA hala, dhvaMsa sei sampradAYera janya, yArA jAlima!
nUha tAra pratipAlakake DAka diYe valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra putra to AmAra parivArerai ekajana! evaM nizcaYai tomAra oYAdA satya evaM tumi sakala vicArakera zreSTha vicAraka!

AllAha valalena, he nUha! jene rekha, se tomAra parivAravargera antarbhukta naYa| se to asat karme kaluSita| sutarAM tumi AmAra kAche emana kichu ceo nA, ye samparke tomAra konao jJAna nei| Ami tomAke upadeza dicchi tumi ajJadera antarbhukta haYo nA|

nUha valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! ye viSaYe AmAra jJAna nei, bhaviSyate ApanAra kAche tA cAoYA hate Ami ApanAra AzraYa cAi| Apani yadi AmAke kSamA nA karena o AmAra prati daYA nA karena, tave Amio kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|

valA hala, he nUha! evAra (naukA theke) neme yAo AmAra pakSa hate sei zAnti o varakatasaha, yA tomAra janyao evaM tomAra saGge ye ‘sampradAYasamUha’ Ache tAdera janyao| Ara kichu sampradAYa emana raYeche, yAderake Ami (duniYAYa) jIvana upabhoga karate deva, tArapara AmAra pakSa hate tAderake eka yantraNAmaYa zAsti sparza karave|

(he navI!) egulo gAYevera kichu vRttAnta, yA Ami ohIra mAdhyame tomAke jAnAcchi| esava vRttAnta tumio itaHpUrve jAnate nA evaM tomAra sampradAYao nA| sutarAM dhairya dhAraNa kara| zeSa pariNAma muttAkIderai anukUle thAkave|

Ara Ada jAtira kAche Ami tAdera bhAi hudake navI vAniYe pAThAlAma| se valala, he AmAra kaoma! AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera anya konao mAvuda nei| prakRtapakSe tomarA mithyA racanAkArI vai nao|

he AmAra kaoma! Ami era (arthAt ei pracAra kAryera) vinimaYe tomAdera kAche konao pArizramika cAi nA| AmAra pAritoSika to anya keu naYa; varaM sei sattAi nija dAYitve rekhechena, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| tAraparao ki tomarA vuddhike kAje lAgAve nA?

he AmAra kaoma! nijedera pratipAlakera kAche gunAhera janya kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara tArai dike ruju hao| tini tomAdera prati AkAza theke muSaladhAre vRSTi varSaNa karavena evaM tomAdera vartamAna zaktira sAthe vAr3ati Arao zakti yogAvena| sutarAM tomarA aparAdhI haYe mukha phiriYe nio nA|

tArA valala, he huda! tumi AmAdera kAche konao ujjvala nidarzana niYe Asani evaM AmarA kevala tomAra kathAYa AmAdera upAsyaderake parityAga karavAra nai evaM AmarA tomAra kathAYa ImAnao Anate pAri nA|

AmarA to e chAr3A Ara kichui valate pAri nA ye, AmAdera upAsyadera madhye keu tomAke amaGgale AkrAnta kareche| huda valala, Ami AllAhake sAkSI rAkhachi evaM tomarAo sAkSI thAka ye, tomarA yAderake AllAhara zarIka kara, tAdera sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei-
AllAha chAr3A| sutarAM tomarA sakale mile AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra A~Ta evaM AmAke ekaTuo avakAza dio nA|

Ami to AllAhara upara bharasA karechi, yini AmAra pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka| bhUmite vicaraNakArI emana konao prANI nei, yAra jhu~Ti tA~ra muThoYa naYa| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka sarala pathe raYechena|

tathApi yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave AmAke ye vArtA diYe pAThAno haYechila Ami to tA peৗ~chiYe diYechi| Ara AmAra pratipAlaka (tomAdera kupharera kAraNe) tomAdera sthAne anya konao sampradAYake sthApita karavena| takhana tomarA tAra kichu kSati karate pArave nA| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka savakichu rakSaNAvekSaNa karena|
(parizeSe) yakhana AmAra hukuma ese gela, takhana Ami nija rahamate hudake evaM tAra sAthe yArA ImAna enechila tAderake vA~cAlAma evaM tAderake rakSA karalAma eka kaThina zAsti hate|

ei chila Ada jAti, yArA tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra karechila, tA~ra rAsUlagaNera avAdhyatA karechila evaM emana sava vyaktira Anugatya karechila, yArA chila carama spardhita o satyera ghora duzamana|

Ara (era phala hala ei ye,) e duniYAYao abhisampAtake tAdera anugAmI kare deoYA hala evaM kiYAmata divaseo| smaraNa rekha, Ada jAti nija pratipAlakera saGge kupharIra AcaraNa karechila| smaraNa rekha, Ada jAtii dhvaMsa haYeche, yA chila hudera sampradAYa|

evaM chAmuda jAtira kAche tAdera bhAi sAlihake navI kare pAThAlAma| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| tinii tomAderake bhUmi hate sRSTi karechena evaM tAte tomAderake vasavAsa kariYechena| sutarAM tA~ra kAche nijedera gunAhera janya kSamA prArthanA kara tArapara tA~ra abhimukhI hao| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka (tomAdera) nikaTavartI o du‘A kavulakArIo|

tArA valala, he sAliha! itaHpUrve tumi AmAdera madhye emana chile ye, tomAke niYe aneka AzA chila| AmAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa yAdera (arthAt ye sakala pratimAra) upAsanA karata, tumi AmAderake tAdera upAsanA karate niSedha karacha? tumi ye viSaYera dike DAkacha, tAte AmAdera etaTA sandeha raYeche ye, tA AmAderake asthiratAra bhetara phele diYeche|

sAliha valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AmAke vala to, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke Agata eka ujjvala hidAYAtera upara pratiSThita thAki evaM tini vizeSabhAve tA~ra nijera kAcha theke AmAke eka rahamata (arthAt navuoYAta) dAna kare thAkena, Ara tAraparao Ami tAra nApharamAnI kari, tave emana ke Ache, ye AmAke tA~ra (zAsti) theke rakSA karave? sutarAM tomarA (AmAra kartavya kAje vAdhA diYe) kSatigrasta karA chAr3A AmAke Ara kI diccha?

evaM he AmAra sampradAYa! eTA AllAhara eka uTanI, tomAdera janya ekaTi nidarzanarUpe eseche| sutarAM eTike AllAhara bhUmite svAdhInabhAve care khete dAo| eke asudaddezye sparzao karave nA, pAche Azu zAsti tomAderake pAkar3Ao kare|

ataHpara ghaTala ei ye, tArA seTike mere phelala| sutarAM sAliha tAderake valala, tomarA nijedera ghara-vAr3ite tina dina phUrti kare nAo (tArapara zAsti Asave Ara) eTA emana eka pratizruti, yAke keu mithyA vAnAte pArave nA|

ataHpara yakhana AmAra hukuma ese gela, takhana Ami sAlihake evaM tAra saGge yArA ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra vizeSa rahamate rakSA karalAma evaM se dinera lAJchanA theke vA~cAlAma| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka atyanta zaktizAlI, sarvamaYa kSamatAra mAlika|
Ara yArA julumera patha avalamvana karechila, tAderake AghAta hAnala mahA garjana| phale tArA tAdera ghara-vAr3ite ebhAve adhaHmukhe par3e thAkala
yena tArA kakhanao sekhAne vasavAsai kareni| smaraNa rekha, chAmuda jAti nija pratipAlakera saGge kupharIra AracaraNa karechila| smaraNa rekha, chAmuda jAtii dhvaMsa haYechila|

Ara AmAra phirizatAgaNa (mAnuSera veze) ivarAhImera kAche susaMvAda niYe Asala (ye, tAra putra santAna janma neve)| tArA sAlAma valala| ivarAhImao sAlAma valala| ataHpara se avilamve (tAdera AtitheYatAra janya) ekaTi bhunA karA vAchura niYe Asala|

kintu yakhana dekhala tAdera hAta se dike (arthAt vAchurera dike) vAr3ache nA, takhana tAdera vyApAre tAra khaTakA lAgala evaM tAdera dika theke antare zaGkA vodha karala| phirizatAgaNa valala, bhaYa karavena nA| AmAderake pAThAno haYeche (ApanAke putra santAna janmera susaMvAda deoYAra janya evaM pAThAno haYeche) lUtera sampradAYera kAche|
Ara ivarAhImera strI dA~r3Ano chila| se hese dila| Ami tAke (punarAYa) isahAkera evaM isahAkera para iYAkUvera janmera susaMvAda dilAma|
se valate lAgala, hAYa! Ami e avasthAYa santAna janmAva, yakhana Ami vRddhA evaM ei AmAra svAmI, ye nijeo vArdhakye upanIta? vAstavikai eTA var3a Azcarya vyApAra|

pherezatAgaNa valala, Apani ki AllAhara hukuma samvandhe vismaYavodha karachena? ApanAdera mata sammAnita parivAravargera upara raYeche AllAhara rahamata o prabhUta varakata| nizcaYai tini sarvamaYa prazaMsAra hakadAra, ati maryAdAvAna|
ataHpara yakhana ivarAhImera bhIti dUra hala evaM se susaMvAda lAbha karala, takhana se lUtera sampradAYa samparke AmAra saGge (AvadArera bhaGgite) jhagar3A zuru kare dila|
vastuta ivarAhIma atyanta sahanazIla, (AllAhara smaraNe) atyadhika Ah-uhkArI (evaM) sarvadA AmAra prati abhiniviSTa chila|
(Ami tAke valalAma), he ivarAhIma! e viSaYaTA yete dAo| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlakera hukuma ese par3eche evaM tAdera upara emana zAsti Asavei, yA keu pratihata karate pArave nA|
yakhana AmAra phirizatAgaNa lUtera kAche peৗ~chala, se tAdera kAraNe ghAvar3e gela, tAra antare udvega dekhA dila evaM se valate lAgala, Ajakera e dinaTi var3a kaThina|

tAra sampradAYera loka tAra dike chuTe Asala| tArA pUrva thekei kukarme lipta chila| lUta valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! ei AmAra kanyAgaNa upasthita raYeche| erA tomAdera pakSe Dhera pavitra! sutarAM AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra mehamAnadera vyApAre tomarA AmAke heYa karo nA| tomAdera madhye ki ekajanao bhAlo loka nei?
tArA valala, tomAra jAnA Ache tomAra kanyAdera prati AmAdera kona Agraha nei| tumi bhAlo karei jAna AmarA kI cAi|
lUta valala, hAYa! tomAdera mukAvelA karAra kona zakti yadi AmAra thAkata athavA Ami yadi grahaNa karate pAratAma kona zaktizAlI AzraYa!

(avazeSe) phirizatAgaNa (lutake) valala, AmarA ApanAra pratipAlakera prerita phirizatA| tArA kichutei ApanAra paryanta peৗ~chute pArave nA| Apani rAtera kona aMze ApanAra parivAravarga niYe janapada theke vera haYe par3una| ApanAdera madhya hate keu yena pechane phireo nA tAkAYa, tave ApanAra strI chAr3A (se ApanAdera sAthe yAve nA)| tAra uparao sei vipada Asave, yA anyadera upara Asache| nizcaYai, tAdera (upara zAsti nAyilera) janya prabhAtakAla sthirIkRta| prabhAtakAla ki khuva kAche naYa?
ataHpara yakhana AmAra hukuma ese gela, takhana Ami se janapadera upara dikake nicera dike ulTiYe dilAma evaM tAdera upara thAke thAke pAkA mATira pAthara varSaNa karalAma-
yA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate cihnita chila| se janapada (makkAra ei) jAlemadera theke dUre naYa|

Ara mAdaYAne tAdera bhAi zuAivake navI kare pAThAi| se (tAderake) valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei evaM ojana o parimApe kama dio nA| Ami tomAderake samRddhazAlI dekhachi| Ami tomAdera prati emana eka dinera zAstira AzaGkA karachi, yA tomAderake cArao dika theke veSTana kare phelave|
he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA parimANa o ojana nyAYasaGgatabhAve pUrNa karave| mAnuSake tAdera dravyAdi kama deve nA evaM pRthivIte azAnti vistAra kare ver3Ave nA|

tomarA yadi AmAra kathA mAna, tave (mAnuSera nyAyya haka AdAYa karAra para) AllAha-pradatta yA-kichu avaziSTa thAkave, tomAdera pakSe tAi zreYa| Ara (yadi nA mAna, tave) Ami tomAdera upara pAhArAdAra niyukta haini|

tArA valala, he zuAiva! tomAra nAmAya ki tomAke ei Adeza karache ye, AmAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa yAdera ivAdata karata, AmarA tAderake parityAga karava evaM nijedera artha-sampade yA icchA haYa tA karava nA? tumi to var3a vuddhimAna o sadAcArI loka!

zuAiva valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AmAke vala to, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka spaSTa pramANera upara pratiSThita thAki evaM tini vizeSabhAve nijera pakSa theke AmAke uttama riyaka dAna kare thAkena (tave tA sattveo Ami tomAdera bhrAnta pathe kena calava?)| AmAra emana kona icchA nei ye, Ami ye sava viSaYe tomAderake niSedha kari, tomAdera pichane giYe nijei tA karate thAkava| nija sAdhyamata saMskAra karA chAr3A anya kona uddezya AmAra nei| Ara Ami yA-kichu karate pAri, tA kevala AllAhara sAhAyyei pAri| Ami tArai upara nirbhara karechi evaM tArai dike (pratiTi viSaYe) rujU hai|

he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra sAthe tomAdera virodha yena tomAderake emana pariNatite nA peৗ~chAYa ye, nUhera sampradAYa vA hudera sampradAYa kiMvA sAlihera sampradAYera upara yemana musivata avatIrNa haYechila, tomAdera uparao se rakama musivata avatIrNa haYe yAYa| Ara lUtera sampradAYa to tomAdera theke vezi dUreo naYa|
tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera kAche kSamA prArthanA kara| tArapara tA~rai dike rujU hao| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka parama daYAlu, premamaYa|

tArA valala, he zuAiva! tomAra aneka kathA AmAdera vujhei Ase nA| AmarA dekhachi, AmAdera madhye tumi ekajana durvala loka| tomAra khAndAna nA thAkale AmarA tomAke pAthara mere dhvaMsa karatAma| AmAdera viparIte tumi kichu zaktimAna nao|

zuAiva valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera upara ki AllAha apekSA AmAra khAndAnera cApai vezi? tomarA tA~ke sampUrNarUpe tomAdera pichana dike rekhe diYecha? jene rekha, tomarA yA-kichu karacha, AmAra pratipAlaka tA savai paripUrNarUpe veSTana kare rekhechena|

evaM he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA Apana avasthAYa theke (yA icchA haYa) kAja karate thAka, Amio (nija niYama anusAre) kAja karachi| zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave kAra upara emana zAsti avatIrNa haYa, yA tAke lAJchita kare chAr3ave Ara ke mithyAvAdI? tomarA apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSArata Achi|

evaM (parizeSe) yakhana AmAra hukuma ese gela, Ami zuAivake evaM yArA tAra sAthe ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra vizeSa rahamate rakSA kari Ara yArA juluma karechila tAderake eka pracaNDa ninAda ese pAkar3Ao karala| phale tArA nijedera ghara-vAr3ite emanabhAve mukha thuvar3e par3e thAkala-
yena tArA kakhanao sekhAne vasavAsai kareni| smaraNa rekha, mAdaYAnerao seibhAve vinAza ghaTala, yebhAve vinAza haYechila chAmuda jAti|
evaM Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI o suspaSTa pramANasaha pAThAlAma-
phirAuna o tAra amAtyadera kAche| tArA phira‘Aunera karmakANDerai anusaraNa karala, athaca phira‘Aunera karmakANDa yathocita chila nA|
kiYAmatera dina se nija sampradAYera agrabhAge thAkave evaM tAdera sakalake niYe jAhAnnAme nAmAve Ara tA kata nikRSTa ghATa, yAte tArA nAmave|
ei duniYAYao lAnatake tAdera pichane lAgiYe deoYA haYeche evaM kiYAmatera dineo| eTA kata nikRSTa puraskAra, yA tAderake deoYA have|
eTA sei sava janapadera vRttAnta, yA Ami tomAke zonAcchi| tAra madhye kataka (janapada) ekhanao Apana sthAne vidyamAna Ache evaM kataka kartita phasala (-era mata nizcihna) haYe geche|

Ami tAdera upara konao juluma karini; varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera upara juluma karechila, pariNAme yakhana tomAra pratipAlakera hukuma Asala, takhana AllAhara parivarte ye sakala mAvudake tArA DAkata, tArA tAdera kichumAtra kAje Asala nA evaM tArA dhvaMsa chAr3A tAdera janya kichu vRddhi karala nA|
ye sakala janapada julume lipta haYa, tomAra pratipAlaka yakhana tAdera dharena, takhana tA~ra dharA emanai haYe thAke| vAstavikai tA~ra dharA ati marmantuda, ati kaThina|

ye vyakti AkherAtera zAstike bhaYa kare, tAra janya esava viSaYera madhye virATa zikSA raYeche| tA emana dina, yAra janya samasta mAnuSake ekatra karA have evaM tA emana dina, yA have (sakalera kAche) dRzyamAna|
Ami tA sthagita rekhechi ganA-guNati kichu kAlera janya|
yakhana se dina Asave, takhana AllAhara anumati chAr3A keu kathA valate pArave nA| tAdera madhye keu have durgatigrasta evaM keu have sadagatisampanna|
sutarAM yArA durgatigrasta have, tArA thAkave jAhAnnAme, yekhAne tAdera citkAra o ArtanAda zonA yAve|

tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave yatadina AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI vidyamAna thAkave yadi nA tomAra pratipAlaka anya kichu icchA karena| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka yA icchA karena, tA uttamarUpe sAdhita karena|

Ara yArA sadagatisampanna have, tArA thAkave jAnnAte, tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave- yatadina AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI vidyamAna thAkave, yadi nA tomAra pratipAlaka anya kichu icchA karena| eTA have eka niravacchinna dAna|

sutarAM (he navI!) tArA (arthAt muzarikagaNa) yAdera (arthAt pratimAdera) ivAdata kare, tAdera vyApAre vindumAtra sandehe theka nA| pUrve tAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa yebhAve ivAdata karata erA to sebhAvei ivAdata karache| nizcaYai Ami tAderake tAdera aMza paripUrNabhAve AdAYa kare deva, yAte kichumAtra kama karA have nA|

Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataHpara tAteo matabheda sRSTi karA haYechila| tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke pUrvei yadi ekaTi kathA (arthAt tAderake paripUrNa zAsti deoYA have AkherAte ei kathA) sthirIkRta nA thAkata, tave (duniYAtei) tAdera mImAMsA haYe yeta| vastuta tArA (ekhanao paryanta) e viSaYe kaThina sandehe nipatita|
nizcaYai sakalera vyApAre eTAi niYama ye, tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera karmaphala puropuri divena| nizcaYai tini tAdera yAvatIYa karma samparke paripUrNarUpe avagata|

sutarAM (he navI!) tomAke yebhAve hukuma karA haYeche, se anuyAYI tumi nijeo sarala pathe sthira thAka evaM yArA tAovA kare tomAra saGge Ache tArAo| Ara sImAlaMghana karo nA| nizcaYai tomarA yA-kichui kara, tini tA bhAlobhAve dekhena|

evaM (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA oi jAlemadera dike ekaTuo jhu~kave nA, anyathAYa jAhAnnAmera Aguna tomAderakeo sparza karave evaM AllAha chAr3A tomAdera konao rakamera vandhu lAbha have nA Ara takhana keu tomAdera sAhAyyao karave nA|
evaM (he navI!) dinera ubhaYa prAnte evaM rAtera kichu aMze nAmAya kAYema kara| nizcaYai puNyarAji pAparAzike miTiYe deYa| yArA upadeza mAne tAdera janya eTA eka upadeza|
evaM savara avalamvana kara| kenanA AllAha satkarmazIladera pratidAna naSTa karena nA|

tomAdera Age yesava ummata gata haYeche, tAdera madhye jJAna-vuddhira avazeSa Ache emana kichu loka kena hala nA, yArA pRthivIte azAnti vistAra karA theke mAnuSake nivRtta karata? avazya alpa kichu loka chila, yAderake Ami tAdera madhya hate (zAsti theke) rakSA karechilAma| Ara jAlemagaNa ye bhoga-vilAsera madhye chila, tArai pichane lege thAkala evaM tArA chila aparAdhI|
tomAra pratipAlaka emana nana ye, tini janapadasamUha anyAYabhAve dhvaMsa kare devena, athaca tAra vAsindAgaNa saThika pathe calache|

tomAra pratipAlaka cAile samasta mAnuSake ekai pathera anusArI vAniYe ditena kintu (kAuke jorapUrvaka konao dIna mAnate vAdhya karATA tA~ra hikamatera paripanthI| tAi tAderake tAdera icchAkrame ye-konao patha avalamvanera suyoga deoYA haYeche, sutarAM) tArA vibhinna pathei calate thAkave|

avazya tomAra pratipAlaka yAdera prati daYA karavena, tAdera kathA bhinna (AllAha tAderake saThika pathe pratiSThita rAkhavena)| Ara erai (arthAt ei parIkSArai) janya tAderake sRSTi karechena| tomAra pratipAlakera ei kathA pUrNa havei, yA tini valechilena ye, Ami jina o inasAna ubhaYera dvArA jAhAnnAma bhare phelava|

(he navI!) Ami tomAke vigata navIgaNera emana sava ghaTanA zonAcchi, yA dvArA Ami tomAra antare zakti yogAi| Ara esava ghaTanAra bhitara diYe tomAra kAche ye vANI eseche tA satya evaM muminadera janya upadeza o smArakao|
yArA ImAna Anache nA tAderake vala, tomarA nijedera vartamAna avasthA anuyAYI kAja karate thAka, AmarAo (nijedera niYama anusAre) kAja karachi|
evaM tomarAo (AllAhara pakSa hate phAYasAlAra) apekSA kara, AmarAo apekSA karachi|

AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yata gupta rahasya Ache, tAra savai AllAhara jJAne raYeche evaM tA~rai dike yAvatIYa viSaYa pratyAnIta have| sutarAM (he navI!) tA~ra ivAdata kara evaM tA~ra upara nirbhara kara| tomarA yA-kichu kara, tomAra pratipAlaka se samparke anavahita nana|
Alipha-lAma-rA| egulo satyake parisphuTanakArI kitAvera AYAta|
Ami eke AravI bhASAra kuraAnarUpe avatIrNa karechi, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

(he navI!) Ami ohI mAraphata ei ye kuraAna tomAra kAche pAThiYechi, era mAdhyame tomAke eka utkRSTatama ghaTanA zonAcchi, yadio tumi era Age e samparke (arthAt e ghaTanA samparke) vilakula anavahita chile|

(eTA sei samaYera kathA,) yakhana iusupha nija pitA (iYAkuva AlAihisa sAlAma) ke valechila, AvvAjI! Ami (svapnayoge) egAraTi nakSatra evaM sUrya o candrake dekhechi| Ami dekhechi tArA sakale AmAke sijadA karache|
se valala, vAchA! nijera e svapna tomAra bhAidera kAche varNanA karo nA, pAche tArA tomAra viruddhe kona Sar3ayantra kare| kenanA zaYatAna mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|

Ara ebhAvei tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke (navuoYAtera janya) manonIta karavena evaM tomAke sakala kathAra saThika marmeAddhAra zikSA devena (svapnera tAvIra jAnAo tAra antarbhukta) evaM tomAra prati o iYAkuvera santAnadera prati nija anugraha pUrNa karavena, yebhAve itaHpUrve tini pUrNa karechilena tomAra pitRdvaYa- ivarAhIma o isahAkera prati| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
prakRtapakSe yArA (tomAra kAche e ghaTanA) jijJesa karache, tAdera janya iusupha o tA~ra bhAidera ghaTanAYa Ache vahu nidarzana|

(eTA sei samaYera ghaTanA) yakhana iusuphera (sat) bhAigaNa (paraspare) valechila, nizcaYai AmAdera pitAra kAche AmAdera tulanAYa iusupha o tAra (sahodara) bhAi (vinaiYAmInai) vezi priYa, athaca AmarA (tAra pakSe) ekaTi susaMhata dala| AmAdera vizvAsa ye, AmAdera pitA suspaSTa konao vibhrAntite nipatita|

(sutarAM era samAdhAna ei ye,) tomarA iusuphake hatyA kare phela athavA tAke anya konao sthAne phele Asa, yAte tomAdera pitAra savaTA manoyoga kevala tomAderai dike cale Ase| Ara esava karAra para tomarA (tAovA kare) bhAlo loka haYe yAve|
tAdera madhye ekajana valala, iusuphake hatyA karo nA| varaM tomarA yadi kichu karatei cAo, tave tAke konao gabhIra kuYAYa phele dAo, yAte kona kAphelA tAke tule niYe yAYa|
(sutarAM) tArA (tAdera pitAke) valala, AvvA! ApanAra kI hala ye, Apani iusuphera vyApAre AmAdera upara vizvAsa rAkhena nA? athaca ete konao sandeha nei ye, AmarA tAra parama zubhAkAksakSI?
AgAmIkAla tAke AmAdera sAthe (ver3Ate) pAThAna| se khAve-dAve evaM kSANikaTA khelAdhulA karave| vizvAsa karuna, AmarA tAke hephAjata karava|
iYAkuva valala, tomarA tAke niYe gele AmAra (virahajanita) kaSTa have evaM AmAra ei bhaYao Ache ye, kakhanao tAra prati tomarA amanoyogI hale nekar3e vAgha tAke kheYe phelave|
tArA valala, AmarA ekaTi susaMhata dala haoYA sattveo yadi nekar3e vAgha tAke kheYe phele, tave to AmarA vilakula zeSa haYe gechi|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAke sAthe niYe gela Ara tArA to siddhAnta sthira karechila tAke gabhIra kuYAYa nikSepa karave (semate tArA nikSepao karala), takhana Ami iusuphera kAche ohI pAThAlAma, (ekaTA samaYa Asave, yakhana) tumi tAderake avazyai jAnAve ye, tArA ei kAja karechila Ara takhana tArA vujhatei pArave nA (ye, tumi ke?)|
rAte tArA kA~date kA~date tAdera pitAra kAche Asala|

valate lAgala, AvvAjI! vizvAsa karuna, AmarA daur3a-pratiyogitAYa cale giYechilAma Ara iusuphake AmAdera mAlapatrera kAche rekhe giYechilAma| ei avakAze nekar3e vAgha tAke kheYe pheleche| kintu Apani to AmAdera kathA vizvAsa karavena nA, tAte AmarA yatai satyavAdI hai|

Ara tArA iusuphera jAmAYa meki raktao mAkhiYe enechila| tAdera pitA valala, (eTA satya naYa) varaM tomAdera mana nijera pakSa theke ekaTA galpa vAniYe niYeche| sutarAM AmAra janya dhairyai zreYa| Ara tomarA yesava kathA tairi karacha se vyApAre AllAharai sAhAyya prArthanA kari|

evaM (anya dike tArA iusuphake yekhAne kuYAYa phelechila, sekhAne) ekaTi yAtrIdala Asala| tArA tAdera ekajana lokake pAni Anate pAThAla| se (kuYAYa) nija vAlati phelala| (tAra bhetara iusupha AlAihisa sAlAmake dekhe) se vale uThala, tomarA susaMvAda zona, e ye ekaTi vAlaka| ataHpara yAtrIdalera loka tAke ekaTi paNya mane kare lukiYe rAkhala| Ara tArA yA-kichu karachila se viSaYe AllAha savizeSa avahita chilena|
evaM (tArapara) tArA iusuphake ati alpa dAme vikri kare dila- yA chila mAtra kaYeka dirahAma| vastuta iusuphera prati tAdera vizeSa Agraha chila nA|

misarera ye vyakti tAke kraYa karechila, se tAra strIke valala, eke sammAnajanakabhAve rAkhave| AmAra mane haYa se AmAdera upakAre Asave athavA AmarA eke putra vAniYe neva| ebhAve Ami iusuphake se deze pratiSThA dAna karalAma, tAke kathAvArtAra saThika marma zekhAnora janya| nija kAje AllAha pUrNa kSamatAvAna, kintu vahu loka jAne nA|
iusupha yakhana pUrNa yauvane upanIta hala, takhana Ami tAke hikamata o ilama dAna karalAma| yArA satkarma kare, ebhAvei Ami tAderake pratidAna diYe thAki|

ye nArIra ghare se thAkata, se tAke phusalAnora ceSTA karala evaM savagulo darajA vandha kare dila o valala, ese par3a| iusupha valala, AllAha pAnAha! tini AmAra maniva| tini AmAke bhAlobhAve rekhechena| satya kathA hacche, yArA juluma kare tArA kRtakArya haYa nA|

strIlokaTi to spaSTabhAvei iusuphera sAthe (asat karma) kAmanA karechila Ara iusuphera maneo strIlokaTira prati icchA jAgrata haYei yAcchila yadi nA se nija pratipAlakera pramANa dekhate peta| Ami tAra theke asat karma o azlIlatAke ghuriYe deoYAra janyai erUpa karechilAma| nizcaYai se AmAra manonIta vAndAdera antarbhukta chila|

evaM tArA ekajanera pechane Arekajana daur3e darajAra dike gela evaM (ei TAnA-he~car3Ara bhetara) strIlokaTi tAra jAmA pechana dika theke chi~r3e phelala| e avasthAYa tArA strIlokaTira svAmIke darajAYa dA~r3Ano pela| strIlokaTi tatkSaNAt (kecchA phA~dAra lakSye svAmIke) valala, ye vyakti tomAra strIra sAthe manda kAjera icchA kare, tAra zAsti kArAruddha karA vA anya kona kaThina zAsti deoYA chAr3A Ara kI hate pAre?
iusupha valala, se nijei to AmAke phusalAcchila| strIlokaTira parivArera ekajana sAkSya dila, iusuphera jAmAra sammukha dika theke chi~r3e thAkale strIlokaTii satya valeche Ara se mithyAvAdI|
Ara yadi tAra jAmA pechana dika theke chi~r3e thAke, tave strIlokaTi mithyA valeche evaM se satyavAdI|
ataHpara svAmI yakhana dekhala tAra jAmA pechana theke chi~r3eche, takhana se valala, eTA tomAdera nArIdera chalanA, vastuta tomAdera chalanA var3ai kaThina|
iusupha! tumi e viSaYaTAke ekadama pAttA dio nA| Ara he nArI! tumi nija aparAdhera janya kSamA cAo| nizcaYa tumii aparAdhI chile|
nagare katipaYa nArI valAvali karala, ‘AyIyera strI tAra taruNa golAmake phusalAcche| taruNaTira bhAlovAsA tAke vibhora kare pheleche| AmAdera dhAraNA se nizcaYai suspaSTa vibhrAntite lipta raYeche|

sutarAM yakhana se (arthAt, AyIyera strI) sei nArIdera Sar3ayantrera kathA zunala, takhana se vArtA pAThiYe tAderake (nija gRhe) Deke Anala evaM tAdera janya tAkiYA-viziSTa ekaTi jalasAra vyavasthA karala evaM tAdera pratyekera hAte ekaTi kare churi dila evaM (iusuphake) valala, ekaTu vera haYe tAdera sAmane Asa| ataHpara sei nArIrA yei nA iusuphake dekhala, tAke vismaYakara (rakamera rUpavAna) pela evaM (tArA tAra aparUpa rUpe hatabhamva haYe) nija-nija hAta keTe phelala| Ara tArA vale uThala, AllAha pAnAha! e vyakti kona mAnuSa naYa| e sammAnita pherezatA chAr3A kichui hate pAre nA|

se (arthAt) AyIyera strI valala, evAra dekha, ei hacche sei vyakti, yAra vyApAre tomarA AmAra nindA karecha| ekathA satyai ye, Ami AmAra uddezya caritArtha karAra janya tAke phusalAni diYechilAma, kintu se nijeke rakSA kareche| se yadi AmAra kathA nA zone, tave tAke avazyai kArAruddha karA have evaM se nirghAta lAJchita have|

iusupha du‘A karala, he pratipAlaka! ei nArIgaNa AmAke ye kAjera dike DAkache, tA apekSA kArAgArai AmAra vezi pachanda| tumi yadi AmAke tAdera chalanA theke rakSA nA kara, tave AmAra antara tAdera dike AkRSTa have evaM yArA ajJatAsulabha kAja kare Amio tAdera antarbhukta haYe yAva|
sutarAM iusuphera pratipAlaka tA~ra du‘A kavula karalena evaM sei nArIdera chalanA theke tAke rakSA karalena| nizcaYa tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
ataHpara (iusuphera pavitratAra) vahu nidarzana dekhA sattveo tArA eTAi samIcIna mane karala ye, tAke kichu kAlera janya kArAgAre pAThAvei|

iusuphera sAthe Arao du’jana yuvaka kArAgAre praveza karala| tAdera ekajana (ekadina iusuphake) valala, Ami (svapne) nijeke dekhalAma, mada niMr3Acchi| Ara dvitIYajana valala, Ami (svapne) dekhalAma ye, nija mAthAYa ruTi vahana karachi evaM pAkhi tA theke khAcche| tumi AmAderake era vyAkhyA vale dAo| AmarA tomAke ekajana bhAlo mAnuSa dekhachi|

iusupha valala, (kArAgAre) tomAderake ye khAvAra deoYA haYa, tA AsAra Agei Ami tomAderake era rahasya vale deva| eTA sei jJAnera aMza, yA AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke dAna karechena| (kintu tAra Age tomarA AmAra ekaTA kathA zona)| vyApAra ei ye, yArA AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhe nA o yArA AkherAte avizvAsI, Ami tAdera dIna parityAga karechi|

Ami AmAra vApa-dAdA ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYAkuvera dIna anusaraNa karechi| AmAdera e adhikAra nei ye, AllAhara saGge konao jinisake zarIka karava| eTA (arthAt tAohIdera AkIdA) AmAdera prati o samasta mAnuSera prati AllAhara anugraherai aMza| kintu adhikAMza loka (e ni‘Amatera) zokara AdAYa kare nA|
he AmAra kArA-saMgIdvaYa! bhinna-bhinna vahu pratipAlaka zreYa, nA sei eka AllAha, yAra kSamatA sarvavyApI?

tA~ke cher3e tomarA yAra ivAdata karacha, tAra sAravattA katagulo nAmera vezi kichu naYa, yA tomarA o tomAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa rekhe diYecha| AllAha tAra pakSe konao dalIla nAyila karenani| hukuma dAnera kSamatA AllAha chAr3A anya kArao nei| tinii e hukuma diYechena ye, tomarA tAra bhinna anya kArao ivAdata karo nA| eTAi sarala-sojA patha| kintu adhikAMza loka jAne nA|

he AmAra kArA saGgIdvaYa! (ekhana tomAdera svapnera vyAkhyA zune nAo) tomAdera ekajanera vyApAra ei ye, (vandI dazA theke mukti peYe) se nija manivake mada pAna karAve| Ara thAkala aparajana| tA tAke zUle car3Ano have| phale pAkhirA tAra mAthA (Thukare Thukare) khAve| tomarA ye viSaYe jijJesa karachile tAra phAYasAlA (ebhAve) haYe geche|

sei du’janera madhye yAra samparke tAra dhAraNA chila ye, se mukti pAve, iusupha tAke valala, nija prabhura kAche AmAra kathAo valo| kintu zaYatAna tAke nija prabhura kAche iusuphera viSaYe valAra kathA bhuliYe dila| sutarAM se kaYeka vachara kArAgAre thAkala|

(kaYeka vachara para misarera) vAdazAha (tAra pAriSadavargake) valala, Ami (svapne) dekhalAma sAtaTi moTAtAjA gAbhI, yAderake sAtaTi rogA-paTakA gAbhI kheYe phelache| Arao dekhalAma sAtaTi savuja-sajIva zISa evaM Arao sAtaTi zukano| he pAriSadavarga! tomarA svapnera vyAkhyA jAnale AmAra ei svapnera vyAkhyA vale dAo|
tArA valala, (mane hacche) eTA duzcintAprasUta kalpanA| Ara AmarA svapna-vyAkhyAra ilamadAra (-o) nai|

sei dui kaYedIra madhye ye mukti peYechila evaM dIrghakAla para yAra (iusuphera kathA) smaraNa haYechila, se valala, Ami ApanAderake e svapnera vyAkhyA jAniYe dicchi| sutarAM ApanArA AmAke (kArAgAre iusuphera kAche) pAThiYe dina|

(sutarAM se kArAgAre giYe iusuphake valala) iusupha! ohe sei vyakti, yAra sava kathA satya haYa! tumi AmAderake ei svapnera vyAkhyA vale dAo ye, sAtaTi moTAtAjA gAbhI, yAderake sAtaTi rogA-paTakA gAbhI kheYe phelache Ara sAtaTi savuja-sajIva zISa evaM Arao sAtaTi Ache, yA zukano, yAte Ami lokadera kAche phire yete pAri evaM (tAderake svapnera vyAkhyA jAnAte pAri) yAte tArA prakRta viSaYa avagata hate pAre|

iusupha valala, tomarA ekAdhAre sAta vachara zasya utpanna karave| e samaYera bhetara tomarA ye zasya saMgraha karave tA tAra zISasaha rekhe dio, avazya ye sAmAnya parimANa tomAdera khAoYAra kAje lAgave (tAra kathA AlAdA)|

erapara tomAdera sAmane Asave emana sAtaTi vachara, yA atyanta kaThina have| tomarA ei sAta vacharera janya yA saJcaYa kare rAkhave, tA khete thAkave, avazya ye sAmAnya parimANa tomarA saMrakSaNa karave (kevala tAi avaziSTa thAkave)|
tArapara Asave emana ekaTi vachara yakhana mAnuSera janya pracura vRSTipAta have evaM takhana tArA AGgurera rasa niMr3Ave|

vAdazAha valala, tAke (arthAt iusuphake) AmAra kAche niYe eso| semate yakhana tAra kAche dUta upasthita hala, se valala, nija prabhura kAche phire yAo evaM tAke jijJesa kara, ye nArIgaNa nijedera hAta keTe phelechila tAdera avasthA kI? AmAra pratipAlaka tAdera chalanA samparke veza avagata|

vAdazAha (sei nArIdera DAkiYe ene tAderake) valala, tomarA yakhana iusuphake phusalAcchile takhana tomAdera avasthA kI haYechila? tArA valala, AllAha pAnAha! AmarA tAra madhye vindumAtrao doSa pAini| AyIyera strI valala, evAra satya kathA sakalera kAche spaSTa haYe geche| Amii tAke phusalAnora ceSTA karechilAma| prakRtapakSe se sampUrNa satyavAdI|

(kArAgAre iusupha yakhana esava kathA jAnate pArala takhana se valala) Ami esava karechi ejanya, yAte AyIya nizcitarUpe jAnate pAre Ami tAra anupasthitite tAra prati kona vizvAsaghAtakatA karini evaM AllAha vizvAsaghAtakadera Sar3ayantra saphala hate dena nA|

Ami e dAvI kari nA ye, AmAra mana sampUrNa pAka pavitra| vastuta mana sarvadA manda kAjerai Adeza kare| avazya AmAra ravva yadi daYA karena seTA bhinna kathA (se avasthAYa manera kona cAturya cale nA)| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

vAdazAha valala, tAke AmAra kAche niYe eso| Ami tAke AmAra ekAnta (sahayogI) vAnAva| sutarAM yakhana (iusupha vAdazAhara kAche Asala evaM) vAdazAha tAra sAthe kathA valala, takhana vAdazAha valala, Aja theke tumi AmAdera kAche atyanta maryAdAvAna hale, tomAra prati paripUrNa AsthA rAkhA have|
iusupha valala, Apani AmAke dezera artha-sampadera (vyavasthApanA) kArye niyukta karuna| nizcita thAkuna Ami rakSaNAvekSaNa veza bhAlo pAri evaM Ami (e kAjera) pUrNa jJAna rAkhi|

evaM ebhAve Ami iusuphake se deze emana kSamatA dAna karalAma ye, se se dezera yekhAne icchA avasthAna karate pArata| Ami yAke cAi nija rahamata dAna kari evaM Ami puNyavAnadera karmaphala naSTa kari nA|
yArA ImAna Ane o tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janya AkherAtera pratidAnai zreYa|
(yakhana durbhikSa dekhA dila) iusuphera bhAiYerA Asala evaM tArA tAra kAche upasthita hala| iusupha to tAderake cine phelala, kintu tArA tAke cinala nA|

iusupha yakhana tAdera sAmagrIra vyavasthA kare dila, takhana se tAderake valala, (AgAmIte) tomarA tomAdera vaimAtreYa bhAikeo AmAra kAche niYe eso| tomarA ki dekhacha nA Ami parimApa-pAtra bhare bhare dei evaM Ami uttama atithiparAYaNao vaTe?
tomarA yadi tAke AmAra kAche niYe nA Asa tave AmAra kAche tomAdera janya kona rasada thAkave nA| takhana tomarA AmAra kAcheo Asave nA|
tArA valala, AmarA tAra viSaYe tAra pitAke sammata karAra ceSTA karava, (yAte tAke AmAdera sAthe pAThAna) Ara AmarA eTA avazyai karava|

iusupha tAra bhRtyaderake vale dila, tArA yena tAdera (arthAt bhAidera) paNyamUlya (yAra vinimaYe tArA khAdya kineche) tAdera mAlapatrera madhye rekhe deYa, yAte tArA nijedera parivAravargera kAche phire yAoYAra para tAdera paNyamUlya cinate pAre| haYata (ei anugrahera kAraNe) tArA punarAYa Asave|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAdera pitAra kAche phire Asala, takhana tArA valala, AvvAjI! AgAmIte AmAderake khAdya dite asvIkAra karA haYeche| sutarAM Apani AmAdera sAthe AmAdera bhAi (vinaiYAmIna)ke pAThAna, yAte AmarA khAdya Anate pAri| nizcita thAkuna AmarA tAra paripUrNa rakSaNAvekSaNa karava|

pitA valala, Ami ki tAra vyApAre tomAdera upara sei rakama nirbhara karava, ye rakama nirbhara itaHpUrve tAra bhAi (iusupha)-era vyApAre karechilAma? AcchA! AllAhai sarvApekSA zreSTha rakSAkartA evaM tini sarvApekSA zreSTha daYAlu|

yakhana tArA tAdera mAlapatra khulala, takhana dekhala, tAdera paNyamUlyao pherata deoYA haYeche| tArA vale uThala, AvvAjI! AmAdera Ara kI cAi? ei ye AmAdera paNyamUlyao AmAderake pherata deoYA haYeche evaM (evAra) AmarA AmAdera parivAravargera janya (Arao) khAdya-sAmagrI niYe Asava, AmAdera bhAike hephAjata karava evaM atirikta eka uTera vojhAo niYe Asava| (ebhAve) ei atirikta khAdya ati sahaja|

pitA valala, Ami tAke (vina iYAmInake) tomAdera saGge kichutei pAThAva nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA AllAhara nAme AmAke pratizruti dAo ye, tAke avazyai AmAra kAche phiriYe Anave, tave tomarA yadi (vAstavikai) nirupAYa haYe yAo (seTA bhinna kathA)| avazeSe tArA yakhana pitAke sei pratizruti dila, takhana pitA valala, AmarA yA valachi AllAha tAra tattvAvadhAYaka|

evaM (sei saGge ekathAo) valala ye, he AmAra putragaNa! tomarA (nagare) sakale eka darajA diYe praveza karave nA; varaM bhinna-bhinna darajA diYe praveza karave| Ami tomAderake AllAhara icchA hate rakSA karate pArava nA| AllAha chAr3A kArao hukuma kAryakara haYa nA, Ami tA~rai upara nirbhara karechi| Ara yArA nirbhara karate cAYa tAdera ucita tA~rai upara nirbhara karA|

tArA (bhAigaNa!) yakhana tAdera pitAra Adeza mata (nagare) praveza karala, takhana tAdera se kauzala AllAhara icchA hate tAderake Adau rakSA karAra chila nA| tave iYAkuvera antare ekaTA abhiprAYa chila, yA se pUrNa karala| nizcaYai se AmAra zekhAno jJAnera dhAraka chila| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (prakRta viSaYa) jAne nA|

yakhana tArA iusuphera nikaTa upasthita hala, takhana se tAra (sahodara) bhAi (vinaiYAmIna)ke nijera kAche vizeSa sthAna dila| (evaM tAke) valala, Ami tomAra bhAi| ataeva tArA (anya bhAiYerA) yA karata tAra janya duHkha karo nA|

ataHpara iusupha yakhana tAdera rasadera vyavasthA kare dila, takhana pAni pAna karAra peYAlA nija (sahodara) bhAiYera mAlapatrera madhye rekhe dila| tArapara eka ghoSaka cItkAra kare valala, ohe yAtrIdala! tomarA nizcaYai cora|
tArA tAdera dike ghure jijJesa karala, tomarA kI vastu hAriYecha?
tArA valala, AmarA vAdazAhara pAnapAtra pAcchi nA| ye vyakti seTi ene deve, se eka uTera vojhA (puraskAra) pAve| Ami tAra (puraskAra prAptira) jAmina|
tArA (bhAiYerA) valala, AllAhara kasama! ApanArA jAnena, AmarA deze phAsAda vistAra karAra janya Asini evaM AmarA corao nai|
tArA valala, tomarA yadi mithyAvAdI (pramANita) hao, tave tAra zAsti kI have?
tArA valala, tAra zAsti ei ye, yAra mAlapatrera madhye seTi (peYAlATi) pAoYA yAve zAsti svarUpa sei dhRta have| yArA juluma kare, AmarA tAderake e rakamai zAsti diYe thAki|

tArapara iusupha tAra (sahodara) bhAiYera thali tallAzira Age anya bhAidera thali tallAzi zuru karala| tArapara peYAlATi nija (sahodara) bhAiYera thali theke vera kare Anala| ebhAve Ami iusuphera janya kauzala karalAma| AllAhara ei icchA nA hale vAdazAhara Aina anuyAYI iusuphera pakSe tAra bhAike nijera kAche rAkhA sambhava chila nA| Ami yAke icchA kari tAra maryAdA u~cu kari| Ara yata jJAnI Ache, tAdera sakalera upara Achena ekajana sarvajJAnI|

bhAiYerA valala, yadi se (vina iYAmIna) curi kare tave (Azcaryera kichu nei| kenanA) era Age tAra bhAio curi karechila| takhana iusupha tAdera kAche prakAza nA kare cupisAre (mane mane) valala, e vyApAre tomarA to Dhera vezi manda Ara tomarA yA valacha tAra prakRta avasthA AllAha samyaka jJAta|

(evAra) tArA valate lAgala, he AyIya! era atizaYa vRddha eka pitA Achena| kAjei tAra parivarte AmAdera madhya hate kAuke ApanAra kAche rekhe dina| yArA sadaYa AcaraNa kare AmarA ApanAke tAdera ekajana mane kari|

iusupha valala, era theke (arthAt ei ve-inasAphI theke) Ami AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA kari ye, ye vyaktira kAche AmAdera mAla pAoYA geche tAra parivarte anya kAuke pAkar3Ao karava| AmarA erUpa karale nizcitabhAvei AmarA jAlima haYe yAva|

tArA yakhana iusuphera dika theke sampUrNa hatAza haYe gela, takhana nirjane giYe cupisAre parAmarza karate lAgala| tAdera madhye ye sakalera var3a chila se valala, tomAdera ki jAnA nei tomAdera pitA tomAdera theke AllAhara nAme pratizruti niYechilena? evaM era Age iusuphera vyApAre tomarA ye truTi karechile (tAo tomAdera jAnA Ache)| sutarAM Ami to e deza tyAga karava nA, yAvat nA AmAra pitA AmAke anumati dena kiMvA AllAhai AmAra vyApAre konao phAYasAlA kare dena| tinii sarvApekSA uttama phAYasAlAkArI|

tomarA tomAdera pitAra kAche phire yAo evaM tAke vala, AvvAjI! ApanAra putra curi karechila Ara AmarA se kathAi valalAma, yA AmarA jAnate perechi| gAYevera khavara rAkhA to AmAdera pakSe sambhava chila nA|
AmarA ye janapade chilAma tAke jijJesa karuna evaM AmarA ye yAtrI dalera sAthe esechi tAdera theke yAcAi kare nina| nizcaYai AmarA satyavAdI|

(sutarAM bhAiYerA iYAkuva AlAihisa sAlAmera kAche gela evaM var3a bhAi yA zikhiYe diYechila se kathAi tAke valala)| iYAkuva (tA zune) valala, nA, varaM tomAdera mana nijera tarapha theke ekaTi kathA vAniYe niYeche| sutarAM AmAra pakSe savarai zreYa| kichu asambhava naYa ye, AllAha tAdera sakalake AmAra kAche ene devena| nizcaYai tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
evaM (ekathA vale) se mukha phiriYe nila evaM valate lAgala, AhA iusupha! Ara tAra cokha du’Ti duHkhe (kA~date kA~date) sAdA haYe giYechila evaM tAra hRdaYa cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe yAcchila|
tAra putragaNa valate lAgala, AllAhara kasama! Apani to iusuphake bhulavena nA, yatakSaNa nA Apani sampUrNa jarAjIrNa havena kiMvA mArAi yAvena|
iYAkuva valala, Ami AmAra duHkha o vedanAra abhiyoga (tomAdera kAche naYa) kevala AllAharai kAche karachi| Ara AllAha samparke Ami yataTA jAni, tomarA jAna nA|
ohe AmAra putragaNa! tomarA yAo evaM iusupha o tAra bhAiYera sandhAna cAlAo| tomarA AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYo nA, jene rekha AllAhara rahamata theke kevala tArAi nirAza haYa, yArA kAphera|

sutarAM tArA yakhana iusuphera kAche peৗ~chala, takhana tArA (iusuphake) valala, he AyIya! AmarA o AmAdera parivAravarga kaThina musivate AkrAnta haYechi| AmarA sAmAnya kichu pu~ji niYe esechi| Apani AmAderake paripUrNa rasada dAna karuna evaM AllAhara oYAste AmAdera prati anugraha karuna| nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra uddezye anugrahakArIderake mahA puraskAra diYe thAkena|
iusupha valala, tomAdera ki khavara Ache tomarA yakhana ajJatAra zikAra chile takhana iusupha o tAra bhAYera sAthe kI AcaraNa karechile?

(ekathA zune) tArA vale uThala, tave ki tumii iusupha? iusupha valala, Ami iusupha evaM ei AmAra bhAi| AllAha AmAdera prati var3ai anugraha karechena| prakRtapakSe ye vyakti tAkaoYA avalamvana o dhairya dhAraNa kare, AllAha serUpa satkarmazIladera pratidAna naSTa karena nA|
tArA valala, AllAhara kasama! AllAha AmAdera upara tomAke zreSThatva diYechena evaM AmarA nizcaYai aparAdhI chilAma|
iusupha valala, Aja tomAdera viruddhe konao abhiyoga AnA have nA| AllAha tomAdera kSamA karuna| tini sakala daYAlu apekSA zreSTha daYAlu|
AmAra ei jAmA niYe yAo evaM eTA AmAra pitAra cehArAra upara rekhe dio| era phale tAra dRSTizakti phire Asave| Ara tomAdera parivArera sakalake AmAra kAche niYe eso|

yakhana e yAtrIdala (misara theke kinaAnera dike) raoYAnA hala, takhana (kinaAne) tAdera pitA (AzepAzera lokaderake) valala, tomarA yadi AmAke nA vala ye, vur3o aprakRtistha haYe par3eche, tave vali, Ami iusuphera ghrANa pAcchi|
tArA (upasthita lokajana) valala, AllAhara kasama! Apani ekhanao paryanta ApanAra purAno bhula dhAraNAra madhyei Achena|

tArapara yakhana susaMvAdavAhI ese se (iusuphera) jAmA tAra cehArAra upara phele dila, amani tAra dRSTizakti phire Asala| se (tAra putraderake) valala, Ami ki tomAderake valini, AllAha samparke Ami yataTA jAni tomarA jAna nA?
tArA valala, AvvAjI! Apani AmAdera pAparAzira kSamAra janya du‘A karuna| AmarA nizcaYai gurutara aparAdhI chilAma|
iYAkuva valala, Ami sattvara AmAra pratipAlakera kAche tomAdera kSamAra janya du‘A karava| nizcaYai tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tArapara tArA sakale yakhana iusuphera kAche upasthita hala, se tAra pitA-mAtAke nijera kAche sthAna dila evaM sakalake valala, ApanArA sakale misare praveza karuna inazAAllAha ApanArA ekhAne svastite thAkavena|

se tAra pitA-mAtAke siMhAsane vasAla Ara tArA sakale tAra sAmane sijadAYa par3e gela| iusupha valala, AvvAjI! ei hala AmAra svapnera vyAkhyA, yA AmAra pratipAlaka satye pariNata karechena| tini AmAra prati var3ai anugraha karechena ye, AmAke kArAgAra theke mukti diYechena evaM ApanAderake dehAta theke ekhAne niYe esechena| athaca itaHpUrve AmAra o AmAra bhAidera madhye zaYatAna anartha sRSTi karechila| vastuta AmAra pratipAlaka yA icchA karena, tAra janya ati sUkSma vyavasthA karena| nizcaYai tinii sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke rAjatveo aMza diYecha evaM dAna karecha svapna-vyAkhyAra jJAna| he AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sraSTA! duniYA o AkherAte tumii AmAra abhibhAvaka| tumi duniYA theke AmAke emana avasthAYa tule nio, yakhana Ami thAki tomAra anugata| Ara AmAke puNyavAnadera antarbhukta karo|

(he navI!) esava ghaTanA gAYevera saMvAdarAjira ekaTA aMza, yA ohIra mAdhyame Ami tomAke jAnAcchi| tumi sei samaYa tAdera (arthAt iusuphera bhAidera) kAche upasthita chile nA, yakhana tArA Sar3ayantra kare nijedera siddhAnta sthira kare phelechila (ye, tArA iusuphake kuYAYa phele deve)|
etadasattveo adhikAMza loka ImAna AnAra naYa, tAte tomAra antara yatai kAmanA karuka nA kena|
athaca era vinimaYe (arthAt pracAra kAryera vinimaYe) tumi tAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAo nA| eTA to nikhila vizvera sakalera janya eka upadeza-vArtA|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte kata nidarzana raYeche, yAra upara diYe tAdera vicaraNa haYa, kintu tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
tAdera madhye adhikAMza lokai emana ye, tArA AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhaleo tA ebhAve ye, tA~ra saGge zarIka kare|
tave ki tArA e viSaYera ekaTuo bhaYa rAkhe nA ye, tAdera upara AllAhara AyAvera kona musivata ese par3ave athavA sahasA tAdera upara tAdera ajJAtasAre kiYAmata Apatita have?

(he navI!) vale dAo, ei AmAra patha, Ami paripUrNa upalavdhira sAthe AllAhara dike DAki evaM yArA AmAra anusaraNa kare tArAo| AllAha (sava rakama) ziraka theke pavitra| yArA AllAhara saGge kAuke zarIka kare, Ami tAdera antarbhukta nai|

Ami tomAra Age yata rAsUla pAThiYechi, tArA sakale vibhinna janapade vasavAsakArI mAnuSai chila, yAdera prati Ami ohI nAyila karatAma tArA ki pRthivIte vicaraNa kare dekheni tAdera pUrvavartI jAtisamUhera pariNAma kI haYeche? yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tAdera janya AkherAtera nivAsa katai nA zreYa! tavuo ki tomarA vuddhike kAje lAgAve nA?

(pUrvavartI navIdera kSetreo emanai haYechila ye, tAdera sampradAYera upara AyAva Asate kichuTA samaYa legechila) parizeSe yakhana navIgaNa mAnuSera vyApAre nirAza haYe gela evaM kApheragaNa mane karate lAgala tAderake mithyA humaki deoYA haYechila, takhana navIdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya peৗ~chala (arthAt kApheradera upara AyAva Ase) evaM Ami yAke icchA karechilAma tAke rakSA karalAma| aparAdhI sampradAYa hate AmAra zAsti TalAno yAYa nA|

nizcaYai tAdera ghaTanAYa vodhasampanna vyaktidera janya zikSA grahaNera upAdAna Ache| eTA emana konao vANI naYa, yA michAmichi gar3e neoYA haYeche| varaM eTA era pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhera samarthaka, savakichura vizada vivaraNa evaM yArA ImAna Ane tAdera janya hidAYAta o rahamatera upakaraNa|
Alipha-lApha-mIma-rA| egulo (AllAhara) kitAvera AYAta, (he navI!) tomAra prati tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke yA-kichu nAyila karA haYeche, tA satya kintu adhikAMza loka ImAna Anache nA|

tinii AllAha, yini AkAzamaNDalIke u~cute sthApana karechena emana stambha chAr3A, yA tomarA dekhate pAve| ataHpara tini Araze ‘isatioYA’ grahaNa karena| evaM sUrya o candrake kAje niYojita karechena| pratiTi vastu eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta Avartana kare| tini yAvatIYa viSaYa niYantraNa karena| tini esava nidarzana suspaSTarUpe varNanA karena, yAte tomarA nizcita vizvAsa karate pAra ye, (ekadina) tomAderake svIYa pratipAlakera saGge milita hate have|

tinii sei sattA, yini pRthivIke vistRta karechena, tAte pAhAr3a o nada-nadI sRSTi karechena evaM tAte pratyeka prakAra phala jor3AYa-jor3AYa sRSTi karechena| tini dinake rAtera cAdare AvRta karena| nizcaYai esava viSaYera madhye sei sakala lokera janya nidarzana Ache, yArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|

Ara pRthivIte Ache vibhinna bhUkhaNDa, yA pAzApAzi avasthita| Ara Ache AGgurera vAgAna zasya kSetra o khejura gAcha, yAra madhye kataka ekAdhika kA-viziSTa evaM kataka eka kA-viziSTa| sava ekai pAni dvArA siJcita haYa| Ami svAde tAra katakake katakera upara zreSThatva diYe thAki| nizcaYai esava viSaYera madhye sei sakala lokera janya nidarzana Ache, yArA vuddhike kAje lAgAYa|

(oi kApheradera upara) yadi tumi vismita hao, tave tAdera e ukti (vAstavikai) vismaYera vyApAra ye, AmarA mATite pariNata haoYAra parao ki satyi satyii natunabhAve jIvana lAbha karava? erAi tArA, yArA nijedera pratipAlaka (era zakti)ke asvIkAra kare evaM erAi tArA, yAdera galadeze lAgAno raYeche ver3i| tArA jAhAnnAmavAsI, yAte tArA sarvadA thAkave|

tArA bhAlo avasthAra (kAla zeSa haoYAra) Age manda avasthAra janya tAr3Ahur3A karache| athaca tAdera pUrve erUpa lAJchanAkara zAstira vahu ghaTanA gata haYeche| prakRtapakSe mAnuSera sImAlaMghana sattveo tAdera prati tomAra pratipAlaka kSamApravaNa evaM eTAo satya ye, tAra zAsti var3a kaThina|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArA vale, AcchA! tAra upara (arthAt navI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAmera upara) tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate kona mujiyA kena avatIrNa karA hala nA? (he navI!) prakRta vyApAra ei ye, tumi to kevala (vipada samparke) satarkakArI| pratyeka jAtira janyai hidAYAtera patha dekhAnora keu nA keu chila|
pratyeka nArI ye garbha dhAraNa kare AllAha tA jAnena evaM mAtRgarbhe yA kame o vAr3e tAo evaM tAra nikaTa pratyeka jinisera eka nirdiSTa parimANa Ache|
tini adRzya o dRzyamAna sava kichui jAnena| tA~ra sattA aneka var3a, tA~ra maryAdA ati ucca|
tomAdera madhye keu cupisAre kathA valuka vA uccasvare, keu rAtera velA Atmagopana karuka vA dinera velA calApherA karuka, tArA sakale (AllAhara jJAne) samAna|

pratyekera sAmane pichane emana praharI (pherezatA) niyukta Ache, yArA AllAhara nirdeze pAlAkrame tAra hephAjata kare| jene rekha, AllAha konao jAtira avasthA tatakSaNa paryanta parivartana karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA nijerA nijedera avasthA parivartana kare| AllAha yakhana kona jAtira upara kona vipada AnAra icchA karena, takhana tA rada karA sambhava naYa| Ara tini chAr3A tAdera kona rakSAkartA thAkate pAre nA|
tinii sei sattA, yini tomAderake vijalIra camaka dekhAna, yA dvArA tomAdera (vajrapAtera) bhIti dekhA deYa evaM (vRSTira) AzAo saJcAra haYa evaM tinii pAnivAhI megha sRSTi karena|

vajra tA~rai tAsavIha o hAmada jJApana kare evaM tA~ra bhaYe pherezatAgaNao (tAsavIharata raYeche)| tinii garjamAna vijalI pAThAna tArapara yAra upara icchA tAke vipadarUpe patita karena| Ara tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) avasthA ei ye, tArA AllAha samvandhei tarka-vitarka karache, athaca tA~ra zakti ati pracaNDa|

tA~rai kAche du‘A karA yathArtha| tArA tA~ke cher3e yAderake (arthAt yei deva-devIderake) DAke tArA tAdera du‘Ara konao javAva deYa nA| tAdera dRSTAnta sei vyaktira mata, ye pAnira dike du’hAta vAr3iYe AzA kare tA Apanii tAra mukhe peৗ~che yAve, athaca tA kakhanao nije-nije tAra mukhe peৗ~chate pAre nA| Ara (deva-devIdera kAche) kApheradera du‘A karAra phala e chAr3A Ara kichui naYa ye, tA zudhu vRthAi yAve|
Ara AllAhakei sijadA kare AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra samasta sRSTi, keu to svecchAYa evaM keu vAdhya haYe| tAdera chAYAo sakAla o sandhyAYa tA~ra sAmane sijadAYa luTAYa|

(he navI! kApheraderake) vala, ke tini, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra pratipAlana karena? vala, AllAha! vala, tavuo tomarA tA~ke cher3e emana sava abhibhAvaka grahaNa karale, yAdera khoda nijederao kona upakAra sAdhanera kSamatA nei evaM apakAra sAdhanerao nA? vala, andha o cakSuSmAna ki samAna hate pAre? athavA andhakAra o Alo ki ekai rakama hate pAre? nA-ki tArA AllAhara emana sava zarIka sAvyasta kareche, yArA AllAha yemana sRSTi karena se rakama kichu sRSTi kareche, phale tAdera kAche ubhaYera sRSTikArya ekai rakama mane hacche? (keu yadi e vibhrAntira zikAra haYe thAke, tave tAke) vale dAo, kevala AllAhai savakichura sraSTA evaM tini ekAi emana ye, tA~ra kSamatA savakichute vyApta|

tinii AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena, phale nadInAlA Apana-Apana sAmarthya anuyAYI plAvita haYeche, tArapara pAnira dhArA sphIta phenAsamUha uparibhAge tule eneche| e rakamera phenA sei samaYao oThe, yakhana loke alaMkAra vA pAtra tairira uddezye Agune dhAtu uttapta kare| AllAha ebhAvei satya o mithyAra dRSTAnta varNanA karachena ye, (ubhaYa prakAre) yA phenA, tA to vAire par3e niHzeSa haYe yAYa Ara yA mAnuSera upakAre Ase tA jamite theke yAYa| e rakamerai dRSTAnta AllAha varNanA kare thAkena|

maGgala tAderai janya, yArA tAdera pratipAlakera DAke sAr3A diYeche| Ara yArA tAra DAke sAr3A deYani, tAdera kAche yadi duniYAra samasta jinisao thAke evaM tAra samaparimANa Arao, tave tArA (kiYAmatera dina) nijedera prANa rakSArthe tA savai dite prastuta haYe yAve| tAdera janya raYeche kaThina hisAva evaM tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma; tA var3a manda ThikAnA|

ye vyakti nizcita vizvAsa rAkhe ye, tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAra prati yA nAyila haYeche tA satya, se ki oi vyaktira mata hate pAre, ye andha? vastuta upadeza kevala tArAi grahaNa kare, yArA vodha-vuddhira adhikArI,
(arthAt) sei sakala loka, yArA AllAhake pradatta aGgIkAra rakSA kare evaM cuktira viparIta kAja kare nA|
evaM AllAha ye samparka vajAYa rAkhate Adeza karechena, tArA tA vajAYa rAkhe, nijedera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare evaM bhaYa rAkhe kaThina hisAvera|

evaM tArA sei sakala loka, yArA nija pratipAlakera santuSTividhAnera uddezye savara avalamvana kareche, nAmAya kAYema kareche evaM Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tA theke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare evaM tArA durvyavahArake pratirodha kare sadvyavahAra dvArA| prakRta nivAse utkRSTa pariNAma tAderai janya|

(arthAt) sthAYIbhAve avasthAnera sei udyAnasamUha, yAra bhetara tArA nijerAo praveza karave evaM tAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa, strIgaNa o santAnadera madhye yArA nekakAra have, tArAo| Ara (tAdera abhyarthanAra janya) pherezatAgaNa tAdera nikaTa pratyeka darajA diYe praveza karave (Ara valate thAkave-)
tomarA (duniYAYa) ye savara avalamvana karechile, tAra vadaulate ekhana tomAdera prati kevala zAntii varSita have evaM (tomAdera) prakRta nivAse eTA katai nA utkRSTa pariNAma|

(apara dike) yArA AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAre dRr3habhAve Avaddha haoYAra para tA bhaGga kare, AllAha ye samparka vajAYa rAkhAra hukuma diYechena tA chinna kare evaM yamIne azAnti vistAra kare, tAdera janya raYeche lAnata evaM prakRta nivAse nikRSTa pariNAma tAderai janya|

AllAha yAra janya icchA karena tAra riyaka prazasta kare dena evaM (yAra janya icchA) saMkIrNa kare dena| tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa) pArthiva jIvanei magna, athaca AkherAtera tulanAYa pArthiva jIvana mAmuli pu~jira vezi kichu naYa|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArA vale, tAra prati (arthAt muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAmera prati) tAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke kona nidarzana avatIrNa karA hala nA kena? vale dAo, AllAha yAke cAna pathabhraSTa karena Ara tini tA~ra pathe kevala tAderakei AnaYana karena, yArA tA~ra dike ruju haYa|
erA sei sava loka, yAra ImAna eneche evaM yAdera antara AllAhara yikire prazAnti lAbha kare| smaraNa rekha, kevala AllAhara yikirei antare prazAnti lAbha haYa|
(moTakathA) yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkarma kareche tAdera janya raYeche maGgalamaYatA evaM utkRSTa pariNAma|

(he navI! yemana anya navIgaNake pAThAno haYechila) temani Ami tomAke emana eka jAtira kAche rAsUla vAniYe pAThiYechi, yAra pUrve vahu jAti gata haYeche, yAte Ami tomAra prati ohIra mAdhyame ye kitAva nAyila karechi tA par3e tAderake zonAo| athaca tArA emana eka sattAra akRtajJatA kare yini sakalera prati daYAvAna| vale dAo, tini AmAra pratipAlaka| tini chAr3A keu ivAdatera upayukta naYa| tA~rai upara Ami nirbhara karechi evaM tA~rai kAche AmAke phire yete have|

yadi emana konao kuraAnao nAyila hata, yA dvArA pAhAr3ake Apana sthAna theke sariYe deoYA yeta vA tAra dvArA pRthivIke vidIrNa karA yeta (phale tA theke nadI pravAhita hata) kiMvA tAra mAdhyame mRtera sAthe kathA valA sambhava hata (tavuo erA ImAna Anata nA)| prakRtapakSe esava kichui AllAhara ekhatiYArAdhIna| tavuo ki muminagaNa ekathA cintA kare nijedera manake bhAramukta karala nA ye, AllAha cAile samasta mAnuSake (jorapUrvaka) satpathe paricAlita karatena? yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tAdera upara tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe sarvadA konao nA konao garjamAna vipada patita hate thAkave athavA tA nipatita hate thAkave tAdera vasatira AzepAze kothAo, yAvata nA (ekadina) AllAhara pratizruti ese pUrNa haYe yAYa| nizcaYai AllAha pratizrutira vyatikrama karena nA|

(he navI!) vastuta tomAra pUrvera navIgaNakeo ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYechila evaM erUpa kApheraderakeo Ami avakAza diYechilAma, kintu kichukAla para Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao kari| sutarAM dekhe nAo kemana chila AmAra zAsti!

AcchA vala to, ekadike raYechena sei sattA, yini pratyekera pratiTi kAja paryavekSaNa karena Ara anyadike tArA ki nA AllAhara sAthe zarIka sAvyasta kareche? vala, ekaTu tAdera (arthAt AllAhara zarIkadera) nAma vala to| (yadi kona nAma vala) tave ki AllAhake emana kona astitva samparke avahita karave, yA sArA pRthivIra kothAo Ache vale tini jAnena nA? nA ki kevala mukhei emana nAma valave Asale yAra kona vAstavatA nei? prakRtapakSe kApheradera kAche tAdera chalanAmUlaka AcaraNa var3a camatkAra mane haYa| Ara (ebhAve) tAdera hidAYAtera pathe prativandhaka sRSTi haYe geche| mUlata AllAha yAke vibhrAntira bhetara phele rAkhena, se emana kAuke pAve nA, ye tAke satpathe AnaYana karave|
tAdera janya duniYAra jIvaneo zAsti raYeche Ara AkherAtera zAsti niHsandehe aneka vezi kaThina have| emana keu nei, ye tAderake AllAha (-era zAsti) theke vA~cAte pArave|

(apara dike) muttAkIdera janya ye jAnnAtera oYAdA karA haYeche tAra taladeze nahara pravAhita raYeche, tAra phala satata sajIva evaM tAra chAYAo| eTA sei sakala lokera pariNAma, yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche| Ara kApheradera pariNAma to jAhAnnAmera Aguna|

(he navI!) Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi, tArA tomAra prati ye kAlAma nAyila karA haYeche, tA zune Anandita haYa| AvAra tAderai kona kona dala emana, yArA era kichu kathA mAnate asvIkAra kare| vala, AmAke to ei Adeza karA haYeche ye, Ami AllAhara ivAdata karava evaM prabhutve tA~ra sAthe kAuke zarIka karava nA| e kathArai Ami dAoYAta diYe thAki Ara tArai (arthAt AllAharai) dike AmAke phire yete have|

Ara ebhAvei Ami eke (arthAt kuraAnake) AravI bhASAYa eka nirdezapatra rUpe nAyila karechi| (he navI!) tomAra nikaTa ye jJAna eseche, tAraparao yadi tumi tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kara, tave AllAhara viparIte tomAra konao sAhAyyakArI o rakSaka thAkave nA|

vastuta tomAra Ageo Ami vahu rAsUla pAThiYechi evaM tAderake strI o santAnAdi diYechi| konao rAsUlerai e ekhatiYAra chila nA ye, se AllAhara hukuma chAr3A ekaTi mAtra AYAtao hAjira karave| pratyeka kAlera janya pRthaka kitAva deoYA haYeche|
AllAha yA cAna (arthAt ye vidhAnake icchA karena) rahita kare dena evaM yA cAna valavat rAkhena| samasta kitAvera yA mUla, tA tA~rai kAche|

Ami tAderake (arthAt kApheraderake) ye viSaYera zAsAni dei, tAra aMzavizeSa Ami tomAke (tomAra jIvaddazAYai) dekhiYe dei athavA (tAra Agei) tomAke duniYA theke tule nei, sarvAvasthAYa tomAra dAYitva to kevala vArtA peৗ~chAno| Ara hisAva grahaNera dAYitva AmAra|

tArA ki e viSaYaTA lakSya kare nA ye, Ami tAdera bhUmi cAradika theke saMkIrNa kare Anachi? pratiTi Adeza AllAhai dAna karena| emana keu nei ye, tAra Adeza rada karate pAre| tini druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

tAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche, tArAo cAla celechila, kintu AllAharai yata cAla kAryakara haYa| pratyeka vyakti yA-kichu kare, savai tini jAnena| kApheragaNa zIghrai jAnate pArave prakRta nivAsera utkRSTa pariNAma kAra bhAge par3e|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArA vale, tumi rAsUla nao| vale dAo, AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSIrUpe AllAha evaM pratyeka oi vyakti yatheSTa, yAra kAche kitAvera jJAna Ache|

Alipha, lAma, rA (he navI!) eTi eka kitAva, yA tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi, yAte tumi mAnuSake tAdera pratipAlakera nirdezakrame andhakAra hate vera kare Alora bhetara niYe Asate pAra| arthAt, sei sattAra pathe, yAra kSamatA sakalera upara pravala evaM yini samasta prazaMsAra upayukta|
sei AllAha, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra bhetara yA-kichu Ache savai yAra mAlikAnAYa| var3ai durgati kApheradera janya arthAt zAsti|
yArA AkherAtera viparIte duniYAra jIvanakei pachanda kare, anyaderake AllAhara pathe Asate vAdhA deYa evaM se pathe vakratA sandhAna kare, tArA carama vibhrAntite lipta|

Ami yakhanai kona rAsUla pAThiYechi, tAke tAra svajAtira bhASAbhASI kare pAThiYechi, yAte se tAdera sAmane satyake suspaSTabhAve tule dharate pAre| tArapara AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena, yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena| tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI diYe pAThiYechilAma| valechilAma ye, nija sampradAYake andhakAra theke vera kare Alote niYe eso evaM AllAha (vibhinna mAnuSake bhAlo avasthA o manda avasthAra) ye dinasamUha dekhiYechena, tAra kathA vale tAderake upadeza dAo| vastuta ye-keu savara o zokare abhyasta, tAra janya esava ghaTanAra bhetara vahu nidarzana Ache|

sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechila| AllAha tomAdera prati yesava anugraha karechena tA smaraNa kara yakhana tini phira‘Aunera lokadera kavala theke tomAderake mukti diYechilena, yArA tomAderake nikRSTatama zAsti dita, tomAdera putraderake yavAha karata o tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| Ara esava ghaTanAra bhetara tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera janya kaThina parIkSA chila|

evaM sei samaYaTAo smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAdera pratipAlaka ghoSaNA karechilena, tomarA satyikArera kRtajJatA prakAza karale Ami tomAderake Arao vezi deva, Ara yadi akRtajJatA kara, tave jene rekha AmAra zAsti ati kaThina|
evaM mUsA valechila, tomarA evaM pRthivIte vasavAsakArI sakalei yadi akRtajJatA kara, tave (AllAhara konao kSati nei| kenanA) AllAha ati veniYAya, tini Apanii prazaMsAra upayukta|

(he makkAra kApheragaNa!) tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche tAdera saMvAda peৗ~cheni nUhera sampradAYera evaM Ada, chAmuda o tAdera paravartI sampradAYasamUhera, yAdera samparke AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA? tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa dalIla-pramANa niYe esechila| kintu tArA tAdera mukhe hAta rekhe diYechila evaM valechila, ye vArtA diYe tomAderake pAThAno haYeche, AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna karechi Ara tomarA ye viSaYera dAoYAta diccha, se samparke AmAdera gabhIra sandeha Ache|

tAdera rAsUlagaNa tAderake valechila, AllAha samvandhei ki tomAdera sandeha, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sraSTA? tini tomAderake DAkachena tomAdera khAtire tomAdera pAparAzi kSamA karAra evaM sthirIkRta eka meYAda paryanta tomAderake avakAza deoYAra janya| tArA valechila, tomarA to AmAderai mata mAnuSa mAtra| tomarA cAccha AmAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa yAdera ivAdata karata, tAdera theke AmAderake virata rAkhate| tAhale tomarA AmAdera kAche suspaSTa kona mujiyA upasthita kara|

tAdera navIgaNa tAderake valechila, vAstavikai AmarA tomAdera mata mAnuSa| kintu AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA vizeSa anugraha karena| Ara AllAhara hukuma chAr3A tomAderake kona mujiyA dekhAnora ekhatiYAra AmAdera nei| muminadera to kevala AllAhara upara nirbhara karA ucita|

kenaivA AmarA AllAhara upara nirbhara karava nA, yakhana tini AmAdera sei patha pradarzana karechena, ye pathe AmAdera calA ucita? tomarA AmAderake ye kaSTa diccha AmarA tAte avazyai savara karava| yArA nirbhara karate cAYa, tArA yena AllAharai upara nirbhara kare|

yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila, tArA tAdera navIgaNake valechila, AmarA tomAderake AmAdera deza theke vera kare chAr3ava| athavA tomAderake AmAdera dIne phire Asate have| ataHpara tAdera pratipAlaka tAdera prati ohI pAThAlena, Ami avazyai e jAlemaderake dhvaMsa karava|
evaM tAdera para yamIne tomAderakei pratiSThita karava| eTA pratyeka oi vyaktira puraskAra, ye AmAra sAmane dA~r3Anora bhaYa rAkhe evaM bhaYa rAkhe AmAra satarkavANIra|
evaM kApheragaNa nijerAi mImAMsA prArthanA karechila, (Ara tAra pariNAma haYechila ei ye,) pratyeka uddhyata haThakArI akRtakArya haYe gela|
tAra sAmane raYeche jAhAnnAma evaM (sekhAne) tAke pAna karAno have galita pu~ja|

se tA Dhoka gile gile pAna karave, mane have yena se tA galA theke nAmAte pArache nA| mRtyu tAra dike cAradika theke ese par3ave, kintu se marave nA evaM tAra sAmane (sarvadA) thAkave eka kaThina zAsti|

yArA nija pratipAlakera sAthe kupharI karmapanthA avalamvana kareche tAdera avasthA ei ye, tAdera karma sei chAiYera mata, pracaNDa jhar3era dine tIvra vAtAsa yA ur3iYe niYe yAYa| tArA yA kichu upArjana kare, tAra kichui tAdera hastagata have nA| eTAi to carama vibhrAnti|

eTA ki tomAra dRSTigocara haYa nA ye, AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIke yathAyatha uddezye sRSTi karechena? tini icchA karale tomAdera sakalake dhvaMsa kare dite pArena evaM eka natuna sRSTi astitve Anate pArena|
Ara eTA AllAhara pakSe kichu kaThina naYa|

evaM samasta mAnuSa AllAhara sAmane upasthita have| yArA (duniYAYa) durvala chila, tArA var3atva pradarzanakArIderake valave, AmarA to tomAderai anugAmI chilAma| ekhana ki tomarA AmAderake AllAhara AyAva theke ekaTu vA~cAve? tArA valave, AllAha yadi AmAderake hidAYAta dAna kare thAkatena, tave AmarAo tomAderake hidAYAta ditAma| ekhana AmarA citkAra kari vA savara kari ubhaYa avasthAi AmAdera janya samAna| AmAdera niSkRti lAbhera kona upAYa nei|

yakhana savakichura mImAMsA haYe yAve, takhana zaYatAna (tAra anusArIderake) valave, vastuta AllAha tomAderake satya pratizruti diYechilena Ara Amio tomAderake pratizruti diYechilAma, kintu Ami tomAdera sAthe tA rakSA karini| tomAdera upara AmAra era vezi kichu kSamatA chila nA ye, Ami tomAderake (AllAhara avAdhyatA karAra) dAoYAta diYechilAma Ara tomarA AmAra kathA zunechile| sutarAM ekhana AmAke doSAropa karo nA, varaM nijederai doSAropa kara| nA tomAdera vipada muktite Ami tomAdera kona sAhAyya karate pAri Ara nA AmAra vipada muktite tomarA AmAra kona sAhAyya karate pAra| era Age tomarA ye AmAke AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta karechile (Aja) Ami tA pratyAkhyAna karalAma| yArA e sImAlaMghana karechila Aja tAdera janya raYeche marmantuda zAsti|

Ara yArA ImAna enechila o satkarma karechila, tAderake emana udyAnarAjite dAkhila karA have, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| nija pratipAlakera hukume tArA sarvadA tAte (udyAnarAjite) thAkave| tAte tAdera pArasparika abhivAdana have sAlAma|
tumi ki dekhani AllAha kAlemA tAYyivAra kemana dRSTAnta diYechena? tA eka pavitra vRkSera mata, yAra mUla (bhUmite) sudRr3habhAve sthita Ara tAra zAkhA-prazAkhA AkAze vistRta|
tA nija pratipAlakera nirdeze prati muhUrte phala deYa| AllAha (e jAtIYa) dRSTAnta dena, yAte mAnuSa upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ara apavitra kAlimAra dRSTAnta eka manda vRkSa, yA bhUmira uparibhAga thekei upar3e phelA yAYa| tAra ekaTuo sthAYitva nei|

yArA ImAna eneche AllAha tAderake e sudRr3ha kathAra upara sthiti dAna karena duniYAra jIvaneo evaM AkherAteo| Ara AllAha jAlemaderake karena vibhrAnta| AllAha (nija hikamata anuyAYI) yA cAna, tAi karena|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA AllAhara ni‘Amatake kuphara dvArA parivartana kare pheleche evaM nija sampradAYake dhvaMsa-nivAse peৗ~che diYeche-
jAhAnnAme? tArA tAte dagdha have Ara tA ati manda ThikAnA|

Ara tArA AllAhara sAthe (tA~ra prabhutve) katipaYa zarIka sAvyasta kareche, yAte mAnuSake tAra patha theke vicyuta karate pAre| tAderake vala, (alpa kichu) bhoga kare nAo| zeSa paryanta tomAderake jAhAnnAmei yete have|

AmAra ye vAndAgaNa ImAna eneche tAderake vala, yena nAmAya kAYema kare, Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi, tA theke gopane o prakAzye (satkAje) vyaYa kare (evaM e kAja) sei dina AsAra Age-Agei (kare), ye dina kona vecAkenA thAkave nA evaM kona vandhutvao kAje Asave nA|

AllAha tini, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena, tArapara tA dvArA tomAdera jIvikAra janya phala utpAdana karechena evaM jalayAnasamUhake tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena, yAte tA tA~ra nirdeze sAgare calAcala kare Ara nada-nadIkeo tomAdera sevAYa niYojita karechena|
sUrya o candrake tomAdera kAje niYojita karechena, yA avirAma paribhramaNarata raYeche| Ara tomAdera janya rAta o dinakeo kAje lAgiYe rekhechena|

tomarA yA-kichu ceYecha, tini tAra madhya hate (yA tomAdera janya maGgalajanaka tA) tomAderake dAna karechena| tomarA AllAhara ni‘AmatasamUha guNate zuru karale, tA guNate sakSama have nA| vastuta mAnuSa ati anyAYAcArI, ghora akRtajJa|

evaM sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana ivarAhIma (AllAha tAAlAra kAche du‘A karachila Ara tAte) valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! e nagarake zAntipUrNa vAniYe dina evaM AmAke o AmAra putrake mUrtipUjA karA hate rakSA karuna|

he AmAra pratipAlaka! oisava pratimA vipula saMkhyaka mAnuSake pathabhraSTa kareche| sutarAM ye-keu AmAra anusaraNa karave, se AmAra dalabhukta Ara keu AmAke amAnya karale (tAra viSaYaTA Ami ApanAra upara cher3e dicchi), Apani ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami AmAra katipaYa santAnake ApanAra sammAnita gharera AzepAze emana eka upatyakAYa ene vasavAsa kariYechi, yekhAne kona kSeta-khAmAra nei| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! (eTA Ami ejanya karechi) yAte tArA nAmAya kAYema kare| sutarAM mAnuSera antare tAdera prati anurAga sRSTi kare dina evaM tAderake phalamUlera jIvikA dAna karuna, yAte tArA kRtajJatA jJApana kare|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ye kAja lukiYe kari tAo Apani jAnena evaM ye kAja prakAzye kari tAo| pRthivIte yA Ache tAra kichui AllAhara kAche gopana thAke nA evaM AkAze yA kichu Ache tAo nA|
samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAke vRddha vaYase isamAIla o isahAka (-era mata putra) diYechena| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka atyadhika du‘A zravaNakArI|

he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAkeo nAmAya kAYemakArI vAniYe dina evaM AmAra AolAdera madhya hateo (emana loka sRSTi karuna, yArA nAmAya kAYema karave)| he AmAra pratipAlaka! evaM AmAra du‘A kavula kare nina|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! ye dina hisAva pratiSThita have, se dina AmAke, AmAra pitA-mAtA o sakala ImAnadArake kSamA karuna|
tumi kichutei mane karo nA jAlimagaNa yA-kichu karache AllAha se samparke vekhavara| tini to tAderake sei dina paryanta avakAza dicchena, ye dina cakSusamUha thAkave visphArita|
tArA mAthA upara dike tule daur3Ate thAkave| tAdera dRSTi palaka phelAra janya phire Asave nA| Ara (bhIti vihvalatAra kAraNe) tAdera prANa ur3e yAoYAra upakrama karave|

evaM (he navI!) tumi mAnuSake sei dina samparke satarka kara, yedina tAdera upara AyAva Apatita have Ara takhana jAlemagaNa valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake alpakAlera janya suyoga dina, tAhale AmarA ApanAra DAke sAr3A deva evaM rAsUlagaNera anusaraNa karava| (takhana tAderake valA have) Are, tomarA ki kasama kare valani tomAdera kona laYa nei?

yArA nijedera prati juluma karechila, tAdera vAsabhUmite tomarA thekechile evaM tAdera saGge Ami ki AcaraNa karechi tAo tomAdera kAche prakAza peYechila Ara tomAdera sAmane dRSTAntao peza karechilAma|
tArA tAdera sava rakama cAla celechila, kintu AllAhara kAche tAdera samasta cAla vyartha karArao vyavasthA chila, hoka nA tAdera cAlasamUha emana (zaktizAlI), yAte pAhAr3ao Tale yAYa|
sutarAM AllAha samparke kakhanao emana dhAraNA mane Asate deve nA ye, tini nija rAsUladerake deoYA oYAdAra viparIta karavena| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, (evaM) zAstidAtA|
sei dina, ye dina e pRthivIke anya eka pRthivI dvArA vadale deoYA have evaM AkAzamaNDalIkeo (vadale deoYA have) evaM sakalei eka parAkramazAlI AllAhara sAmane upasthita have|
evaM se dina tumi aparAdhIderake zikale kaSe vA~dhA avasthAYa dekhave|
tAdera jAmA have AlakAtarAra evaM Aguna tAdera mukhamaNDala Acchanna karave-
eijanya ye, AllAha pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pratiphala devena| AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

eTA samasta mAnuSera janya eka vArtA evaM eTA ei janya deoYA hacche, yAte era mAdhyame tAderake satarka karA haYa evaM yAte tArA jAnate pAre satya mAvuda kevala ekajanai evaM yAte vodhasampanna vyaktigaNa upadeza grahaNa kare|
Alipha-lAma-rA| egulo (AllAhara) kitAva o suspaSTa kuraAnera AYAta|
ekaTA samaYa Asave, yakhana kApheragaNa AkAGkSA vyakta karave, tArA yadi musalima haYe yeta!
(he navI!) tAderake tAdera hAle cher3e dAo- tArA kheYe nika, phurti or3Aka evaM asAra AzA tAderake udAsIna kare rAkhuka| zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave (prakRta satya kI chila)|
Ami ye janapadakei dhvaMsa karechi, tAra janya ekaTA nirdiSTa kAla lekhA chila|
kona sampradAYa tAra nirdiSTa kAlera Age dhvaMsa haYa nA evaM se kAlake atikramao karate pAre nA|
tArA vale, he oi vyakti, yAra prati ei upadezavANI (arthAt kuraAna) avatIrNa karA haYeche, tumi nizcitarUpei unmAda|
vAstavikai yadi tumi satyavAdI hao, tave AmAdera kAche phirizatA niYe Asa nA kena?
Ami to phirizatA avatIrNa kari kevala yathArtha mImAMsA diYe Ara takhana tAderake kona suyoga deoYA haYa nA|
vastuta e upadeza vANI (kuraAna) Amii avatIrNa karechi evaM Amii era rakSAkartA|
(he navI!) tomAra pUrveo Ami vibhinna sampradAYera kAche AmAra rAsUla pAThiYechi|
tAdera kAche emana konao rAsUla Aseni, yAke niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa nA kareche|
Ami aparAdhIdera antare e viSaYaTA ebhAvei DhukiYe dei-
ye, tArA era prati ImAna Anave nA| pUrvavartI lokadera rItio e rakamai cale eseche|
evaM Ami yadi (kathAra kathA) tAdera janya AsamAnera kona darajA khule dei evaM tArA dinera Alote tAte car3ate zuru kare-
tavuo tArA ekathAi valave ye, AmAdera dRSTi sammohita karA haYeche, varaM AmarA eka yAdugrasta sampradAYa|
Ami AsamAne vahu ‘vurUja’ tairi karechi evaM darzakadera janya tAte zobhA dAna karechi|
evaM tAke pratyeka vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke saMrakSita kare rekhechi|
tave keu curi kare kichu zonAra ceSTA karale eka ujjvala zikhA tAke dhAoYA kare|
evaM Ami pRthivIke vistRta karechi evaM (tAke sthita rAkhAra janya) tAte pAhAr3a sthApita karechi| Ara tAte sarvaprakAra vastu parimitabhAve udagata karechi|
Ara tAte jIvikAra upakaraNa sRSTi karechi tomAdera janya evaM tAdera (arthAt sei sakala mAkhalukera) janyao yAdera riyaka tomarA dAo nA|
evaM emana kona (praYojanIYa) vastu nei, yAra bhANDAra AmAra kAche nei, kintu Ami tA avatIrNa kari sunirdiSTa parimANei|

evaM pAThiYechi sei vAYu, yA meghamAlAke kare pAnipUrNa, tArapara Ami AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechi, tArapara Ami tA dvArA tomAdera tRSNA nivAraNa kari| tomAdera sAdhya nei ye, tA saJcaYa kare rAkhave|
Amii jIvana dei evaM Amii mRtyu ghaTAi Ara Amii sakalera oYAriza|
