yArA tomAdera Age cale geche, Ami tAderakeo jAni evaM yArA pechane raYe geche tAderakeo jAni|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlakai tAderake hAzare ekatra karavena| nizcaYai tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
Ami mAnuSake sRSTi karechi pacA kAdAra zukano ThanaThane mATi hate
evaM tAra Age jinaderake sRSTi karechilAma lu’ra Aguna dvArA|
sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka pherezatAderake valechilena, Ami zukano kAdAra ThanaThane mATi dvArA eka mAnava sRSTi karate cAi|
tAke yakhana paripUrNa rUpa dAna karava evaM tAte rUha saJcAra karava, takhana tomarA sakale tAra sAmane sijadAYa par3e yeo|
sutarAM samasta pherezatA sijadA karala-
ivalisa vyatIta| se sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hate asvIkAra karala|
AllAha valalena, he ivalisa! tomAra ki hala ye, sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hale nA?
se valala, Ami emana (tuccha) nai ye, ekajana mAnuSake sijadA karava, yAke Apani pacA kAdAra zukano ThanaThane mATi hate sRSTi karechena|
AllAha valalena, tave tui ekhAna theke vera haYe yA| kenanA tui maradUda haYe gechisa|
kiYAmatakAla paryanta tomAra upara abhizApa par3ate thAkave|
se valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAhale AmAke sei dina paryanta (jIvita thAkAra) suyoga dina, yakhana mAnuSake punarutthita karA have|
AllAha valalena, AcchA yA, toke avakAza deoYA hala-
emana eka kAla paryanta, yA AmAra jAnA Ache|

se valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! yehetu Apani AmAke pathabhraSTa karalena, tAi Ami kasama karachi ye, Ami mAnuSera janya duniYAra bhetara AkarSaNa sRSTi karava evaM tAdera sakalake vipathagAmI karava|
tave ApanAra sei vAndAderake naYa, yAderake Apani nijera janya vizuddhacitta vAniYe niYechena|
AllAha valalena, eTAi sei sarala patha, yA AmAra paryanta peৗ~che|
jene rAkhisa, yArA AmAra vAndA, tAdera upara tora konao kSamatA calave nA| tave yArA tora anugAmI have sei vibhrAntadera kathA bhinna|
erUpa sakalerai nirdhArita ThikAnA hala jAhAnnAma|
tAra sAtaTi darajA| pratyeka darajAra janya tAdera (arthAt jAhAnnAmIdera) ekekaTi dalake bhAga kare deoYA haYeche|
(anya dike) muttAkIgaNa thAkave udyAnarAji o prasravaNera mAjhe|
(tAderake valA have-) tomarA ete (arthAt udyAnasamUhe) praveza kara nirApade o nirbhaYe|
tAdera antare ye duHkha-vedanA thAkave tA dUra kare deva| tArA bhAi-bhAi rUpe mukhomukhi haYe u~cu Asane AsIna have|
sekhAne tAderake kona klAnti sparza karave nA evaM tAderake sekhAna theke vera kareo deoYA have nA|
AmAra vAndAderake jAniYe dAo, nizcaYa Amii ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
evaM eTAo jAniYe dAo ye, AmAra zAstii marmantuda zAsti|
evaM tAderake ivarAhImera atithidera kathA zuniYe dAo|
sei samaYera kathA, yakhana tArA tAra kAche upasthita hala o sAlAma karala| ivarAhIma valala, AmarA to tomAdera Agamane bhIta|
tArA valala, bhaYa pAvena nA, AmarA ApanAke eka jJAnI putra (-era janmagrahaNa) era susaMvAda dicchi|
ivarAhIma valala, tomarA AmAke ei susaMvAda diccha, yakhana vArdhakya AmAke Acchanna kareche? tomarA kisera bhittite AmAke susaMvAda diccha?
tArA valala, AmarA ApanAke satya susaMvAda diYechi| sutarAM yArA nirAza haYa, Apani tAdera antarbhukta havena nA|
ivarAhIma valala, pathabhraSTagaNa chAr3A Ara ke nija pratipAlakera rahamata theke nirAza haYa?
(tArapara) tini jijJesa karalena, he AllAhara prerita phirizatAgaNa! ApanAdera paravartI vizeSa kAja kI?
tArA valala, AmAderake eka aparAdhI sampradAYera viruddhe pAThAno haYeche (tAdera prati AyAva nAyila karAra janya)-
tave lutera parivAravarga chAr3A| tAdera sakalake AmarA rakSA karava|
kintu tAra strIke naYa| AmarA sthira karechi, (zAstira lakSyavastu haoYAra janya) yArA pechane theke yAve seo tAdera antarbhukta have|
sutarAM phirizatAgaNa yakhana lutera parivAravargera kAche Asala-
takhana lUta valala, ApanAderake aparicita mane hacche!
tArA valala, nA; varaM tArA ye (AyAva) samparke sandeha poSaNa karata, AmarA ApanAra kAche seTAi niYe esechi|
AmarA ApanAra kAche anar3a phAYasAlA niYe esechi evaM nizcita thAkuna, AmarA satyavAdI|

sutarAM Apani rAtera konao eka aMze nija parivAravargake niYe vera haYe par3una evaM nije tAdera pichane pichane caluna| ApanAdera madhye keu yena pichane phire nA dekhe evaM ApanAderake yekhAne yAoYAra hukuma deoYA haYeche, sekhAnakAra uddezye calate thAkuna|
evaM (ebhAve) Ami lUtera kAche AmAra ei phAYasAlA peৗ~chiYe dilAma ye, bhora haoYA mAtra tAderake nirmUla kare phelA have|
nagaravAsIgaNa Anande utphulla haYe (lUtera kAche) cale Asala|
lUta (tAderake) valala, erA AmAra atithi| sutarAM AmAke veijjata karo nA|
evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara AmAke heYa karo nA|
tArA valala, AmarA ki ApanAke Agei duniYAzuddha lokake mehamAna vAnAte niSedha kare deini?
lUta valala, tomarA yadi AmAra kathA anuyAYI kAja kara, tave ei ye AmAra kanyAgaNa (tomAdera vivAhAdhIna) raYeche|
(he navI!) tomAra jIvanera zapatha! prakRtapakSe oi sava loka nijedera mattatAYa vu~da haYe giYechila|
sutarAM sUryeAdaYa haoYA mAtrai mahAnAda tAderake AghAta karala|
anantara Ami se bhUkhaNDaTike ulTiYe upara-nica kare dilAma evaM tAdera upara pAkA mATira pAthara-dhArA varSaNa karalAma|
vastuta esava ghaTanAra bhetara vahu nidarzana Ache tAdera janya, yArA zekhAra dRSTi diYe dekhe|
e janapadaTi emana eka pathera upara avasthita, yAte sarvadA loka calAcala raYeche|
nizcaYai era madhye muminadera janya nidarzana Ache|
AYakAra vAsindAgaNa (-o) var3a jAlema chila|
phale Ami tAdera thekeo pratizodha niYechi| ubhaYa sampradAYera vAsabhUmi prakAzya rAjapathera pAze avasthita|
hijaravAsIgaNao rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila|
Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI diYechilAma, kintu tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe rekhechila|
tArA pAhAr3a keTe gRha nirmANa karata nirApada vAsera janya|
parizeSe bhoravelA eka mahAnAda tAderake AghAta karala|
pariNAma hala ei, tArA ye zilpakarma dvArA rojagAra karata, tA tAdera konao kAje Asala nA|

Ami AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI evaM era mAjhakhAne yA-kichu Ache, tA yathAyatha uddezya chAr3A sRSTi karini evaM kiYAmata avazyambhAvI| sutarAM (he navI! tAdera AcAra-AcaraNake) upekSA kara saundaryamaNDita upekSAYa|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlakai sakalera sraSTA, sava kichura jJAtA|
Ami tomAke emana sAtaTi AYAta diYechi, yA vAravAra par3A haYa evaM diYechi maryAdApUrNa kuraAna|

Ami tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) vibhinna lokake majA loTAra ye upakaraNa diYechi, tumi tAra dike cokha tule tAkio nA evaM tAdera prati manokSunna haYo nA| Ara yArA ImAna eneche tAdera janya tomAra (vAtsalyera) DAnA nAmiYe dAo|
evaM (yArA kuphare lipta tAderake) vale dAo, Ami to kevala eka spaSTabhASI satarkakArI|
(kuraAna mAjIdera mAdhyame e satarkavANI Ami nAyila karechi sebhAvei,) yemana nAyila karechilAma sei vibhaktakArIdera prati-
yArA (tAdera) pAThya kitAvake khanDa-vikhaNDa karechila|
sutarAM tomAra pratipAlakera kasama! Ami eka-eka kare tAdera sakalake prazna karava-
tArA yA-kichu karata se samparke,
sutarAM tomAke ye viSaYe Adeza karA hacche, tA prakAzye mAnuSake zuniYe dAo| (tathApi) yArA ziraka karave tAdera paraoYA karo nA|
nizcaYa Amii tomAra pakSa hate vidrUpakArIdera sAthe niSpattira janya yatheSTa-
yArA AllAhara sAthe anya kona mAvuda pratiSThA kareche| sutarAM zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave|
nizcaYai Ami jAni tArA ye sava kathA vale tAte tomAra antara saGkucita haYa|
(tAra pratikAra ei ye,) tumi tomAra pratipAlakera prazaMsAra sAthe tAra tAsavIha pATha karate thAka evaM sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta thAka|
evaM nija pratipAlakera ivAdata karate thAka yAvata nA yAra Agamana sunizcita tomAra kAche tA ese yAYa|
AllAhara hukuma ese geche| kAjei tAra janya tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| tArA ye ziraka karache, tini tA theke pavitra o samucca|

tini nija vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA nija hukume rUha (arthAt prANa saJcAraka ohI) saha phirizatA avatIrNa karena, ei marme satarka karAra janya ye, Ami chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| sutarAM tomarA AmAkei bhaYa kara (anya kAuke naYa)|
tini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIke yathArtha uddezye sRSTi karechena| tArA ye ziraka kare tA theke tini vahu urdhve|
tini mAnuSake zukravindu hate sRSTi karechena| tArapara sahasA se prakAzya vitaNDAra janya prastuta haYe geche|
tinii catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechena, yAra madhye tomAdera janya zIta theke vA~cAra upakaraNa evaM tA chAr3A Arao vahu upakAra raYeche evaM tA thekei tomarA kheYeo thAka|
tomarA sandhyAkAle yakhana seguloke vAr3ite phiriYe Ana evaM bhoravelA yakhana seguloke cAraNabhUmite niYe yAo, takhana tAra bhetara tomAdera janya dRSTinandana zobhAo raYeche|
evaM tArA tomAdera bhAra vaYe niYe yAYa emana nagare, yekhAne prANAntakara kaSTa chAr3A tomarA peৗ~chate pArate nA| prakRtapakSe tomAdera pratipAlaka ati mamatAmaYa, parama daYAlu|
evaM ghor3A, khaccara o gAdhA tinii sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA tAte ArohaNa karate pAra evaM tA tomAdera zobhA haYa| tini sRSTi karena emana vahu jinisa, yA tomarA jAna nA|
sarala patha dekhAnora dAYitva AllAha tAAlAra| Ara Ache vahu vA~kA patha| tini cAile tomAdera sakalake sarala pathe paricAlita karatena|
tinii sei sattA, yini AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena, yA theke tomAdera pAnIYa lAbha haYa evaM tA thekei janmAYa udbhida, yAte tomarA pazu carAo|
tA dvArAi tini tomAdera janya phasala, yAYatuna, khejura gAcha, AGgura o sarvaprakAra phala utpAdana karena| nizcaYai yArA cintA kare, tAdera janya esava viSaYera madhye nidarzana Ache|

tini dina-rAta o candra-sUryake tomAdera sevAYa niYojita karechena| nakSatrarAjio tA~ra nirdeze karmarata raYeche| nizcaYai era bhetara vahu nidarzana Ache sei sakala lokera janya, yArA vuddhi kAje lAgAYa|

emanibhAve tini tomAdera janya raGa-veraGera ye vasturAji pRthivIte char3iYe diYechena, tAo tA~ra nirdeze karmarata Ache| nizcaYai yArA zikSAgrahaNa kare, sei sava lokera janya era madhye nidarzana Ache|

tinii sei sattA, yini samudrake kAje niYojita karechena, yAte tomarA tA theke tAjA gozata khete pAra evaM tA theke AharaNa karate pAra alaMkAra, yA tomarA paridhAna kara evaM tomarA dekhate pAo tAte pAni keTe keTe nauyAna calAcala kare, yAte tomarA sandhAna karate pAra AllAhara anugraha evaM yAte tomarA zokara gojAra haYe yAo|
evaM tini pRthivIte pAhAr3era bhAra sthApana karechena, yAte tA tomAdera niYe dola nA khAYa evaM nada-nadI o patha tairi karechena, yAte tomarA gantavyasthale peৗ~chate pAra|
evaM (patha cenAra suvidhArthe) vahu AlAmata tairi karechena, tAchAr3A mAnuSa nakSatra dvArA patha cine neYa|
sutarAM vala, yei sattA (etasava vastu) sRSTi karena, tini ki tAra samAna hate pArena, ye kichui sRSTi kare nA? tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?
tomarA yadi AllAhara ni‘AmatasamUha guNate zuru kara, tave tA guNe zeSa karate pArave nA| vastuta AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomarA yA gopane kara tA AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA yA prakAzye kara tAo|
tArA AllAhake cher3e yAderake (arthAt ye sava deva-devIke) DAke, tArA kichui sRSTi karate pAre nA| tAdera nijederai to sRSTi karA haYa|
tArA niSprANa| tAdera bhetara jIvana nei| tAderake kakhana jIvita kare uThAno have se viSaYeo tAdera kona cetanA nei|
tomAdera mAvuda ekai mAvuda| sutarAM yArA AkherAte ImAna rAkhe nA tAdera antare avizvAsa vaddhamUla haYe geche evaM tArA ahamikAYa lipta|
eTA sunizcita ye, tArA yA gopane kare tA AllAha jAnena evaM tArA yA prakAzye kare tAo| nizcaYai tini ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, tomAdera pratipAlaka kI viSaYa avatIrNa karechena? tArA vale vigatadera galpa!

(esavera) pariNAma hala ei ye, kiYAmatera dina tArA nijedera (kRta gunAhera) paripUrNa bhArao vahana karave evaM tAderao bhArera ekaTA aMza, yAderake tArA konarUpa jJAna vyatireke vipathagAmI karache| smaraNa rekha, tArA yA vahana karache tA ati manda|

tAdera pUrvavartI lokeo cakrAnta karechila| pariNAme tArA ye (Sar3ayantrera) imArata nirmANa karechila, AllAha tAra bhittimUla upar3e phelalena phale upara theke chAdao tAdera upara dhvase par3ala| Ara emana sthAna theke tAdera upara AyAva Apatita hala, yA tArA Tera karatei pArachila nA|

tArapara kiYAmatera dina AllAha tAderake lAJchita karavena evaM tAderake jijJesa karavena, AmAra sei zarIkagaNa kothAYa, yAderake niYe tomarA (musalimadera sAthe) vitaNDA karate? yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche, tArA (se dina) valave, Aja var3a lAJchanA o durdazA cepeche sei kApheradera upara

phirizatAgaNa yAdera rUha ei avasthAYa saMhAra kareche, yakhana tArA (kupharIte lipta theke) nija sattAra upara juluma karachila| e samaYa kApheragaNa AtmasamarpaNa kare valave ye, AmarA to kona manda kAja karatAma nA| (tAdera valA have) Alavat karate! tomarA yA-kichu karate sava AllAha jAnena|
sutarAM ekhana sthAYIbhAve jAhAnnAma vAsera janya tAra darajA diYe praveza kara| ahaMkArIdera e ThikAnA katai nA manda!

(anya dike) muttAkIdera jijJesa karA hala, tomAdera pratipAlaka kI nAyila karechena? tArA valala, samUha kalyANai nAyila karechena| (ebhAve) yArA puNyera karmapanthA avalamvana kareche tAdera janya ihakAleo maGgala Ache, Ara AkherAtera nivAsa to AgAgor3A maGgalai| muttAkIdera nivAsa katai nA uttama
sthAYI vasavAsera sei udyAna, yAte tArA praveza karave, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave evaM tArA sekhAne yA-kichu cAve tAi pAve| AllAha e rakamai puraskAra diYe thAkena muttAkIderake

tArA oi sakala loka, phirizatAgaNa yAdera rUha kavaja kare tAdera pAka-pavitra thAkA avasthAYa| tArA (tAderake) vale, tomAdera prati zAnti varSita hoka| tomarA ye Amala karate, tAra phale jAnnAte praveza kara|

tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa ImAna AnAra vyApAre) ki kevala erai pratIkSAYa Ache ye, tAdera kAche phirizatA ese upasthita have athavA tomAra pratipAlakera hukuma (AyAva vA kiYAmatarUpe) ese par3ave? yesava jAti tAdera pUrve gata haYeche, tArAo erUpai karechila| AllAha tAdera prati kona juluma karenani, kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karachila|
sutarAM tAdera upara tAdera manda kAjera kuphala Apatita haYechila evaM tArA ye jinisa niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata, tAi ese tAderake pariveSTana karechila|

yArA ziraka avalamvana kareche, tArA vale, AllAha cAile AmarA tAke chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karatAma nA nA AmarA evaM nA AmAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa evaM AmarA tAra hukuma chAr3A kona jinisa hArAmao sAvyasta karatAma nA| tAdera pUrve ye sakala jAti gata haYeche tArAo e rakamai karechila| kintu spaSTabhAve vArtA peৗ~chAno chAr3A rAsUlagaNera Ara kona dAYitva nei|

nizcaYai Ami pratyeka ummatera bhetara konao nA konao rAsUla pAThiYechi ei pathanirdeza diYe ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara evaM tAgUtake parihAra kara| tArapara tAdera madhye kataka to emana chila, yAderake AllAha hidAYAta dAna karechena Ara kataka chila emana, yAdera upara vipathagAmitA avadhArita haYe geche| sutarAM tomarA pRthivIte ekaTu paribhramaNa kare dekha, (navIderake) asvIkArakArIdera pariNati kI haYeche?

(he navI!) tAdera hidAYAtaprAptira lobha yadi tomAra thAke, tave vAstavatA hala, AllAha yAderake (tAdera ekarokhAmira kAraNe) pathabhraSTa karena tAderake hidAYAte upanIta karena nA evaM erUpa lokera kona rakamera sAhAyyakArIo lAbha haYa nA|

tArA atyanta dRr3hatAra sAthe AllAhara nAme zapatha kare vale, yArA mArA yAYa AllAha tAderake punarAYa jIvita karavena nA| kena karavena nA? eTA to eka pratizruti, yAke satye pariNata karAra dAYitva AllAhara, kintu adhikAMza loka jAne nA|
(AllAha punarjIvita karAra pratizruti karechena) mAnuSa ye viSaYe matavirodha karache, tA tAdera sAmane spaSTa kare deoYAra janya evaM yAte kApheragaNa jAnate pAre ye, tArA mithyAvAdI chila|
Ami yakhana kona jinisa sRSTi karAra icchA kari, takhana AmAra pakSa theke kevala etaTuku kathAi haYa ye, Ami tAke vali, ‘haYe yAo’, amani tA haYe yAYa|

yArA niryAtita haoYAra para AllAhara santuSTira lakSe hijarata kareche nizcita theka Ami duniYAYao tAderake uttama nivAsa dAna karava Ara AkherAtera pratidAna to niHsandehe sarvazreSTha| hAYa! tArA yadi jAnata|
tArA oi sava loka, yArA savara avalamvana kare evaM nija pratipAlakera upara bharasA rAkhe|

(he navI!) tomAra pUrveo Ami anya kAuke naYa, kevala puruSa mAnuSakei rAsUla vAniYe pAThiYechilAma, yAdera prati Ami ohI nAyila karatAma| (he avizvAsIgaNa!) yadi e viSaYe tomAdera jAnA nA thAke, tave jJAnIderake jijJesa kare nAo|

se rAsUladerake ujjvala nidarzana o AsamAnI kitAva diYe pAThAno haYechila| (he navI!) Ami tomAra pratio ei kitAva nAyila karechi, yAte tumi mAnuSera sAmane sei sava viSaYera vyAkhyA kare dAo, yA tAdera prati nAyila karA haYeche evaM yAte tArA cintA kare|

tave ki yArA nikRSTa Sar3ayantre lipta raYeche tArA e viSaYa theke nijederake nirApada vodha karache ye, AllAha tAderake bhUgarbhe dhasiYe devena vA tAdera upara emana sthAna theke zAsti Asave, yA tArA dhAraNAi karate pArave nA
athavA tAderake calApherA karA avasthAYai dhRta karavena? tArA to tAke vyartha karate pArave nA|
athavA tini tAderake ebhAve pAkar3Ao karavena ye, tArA kramaza kSaYaprApta hate thAkave| kenanA tomAra pratipAlaka ati mamatAmaYa, parama daYAlu|
tArA ki dekheni, AllAha yA-kichu sRSTi karechena, tAra chAYA AllAhara prati sijadArata theke DAne-vAme Dhale par3e evaM tArA sakale thAke vinaYAvanata?
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yata prANI Ache tArA evaM samasta pherezatA AllAhakei sijadA kare evaM tArA moTei ahaMkAra kare nA|
tArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare, yini tAdera upare evaM tArA sei kAjai kare, yAra Adeza tAderake karA haYa|
AllAha valena, tomarA du’-du’jana mAvuda grahaNa karo nA| tini to ekai mAvuda| sutarAM tomarA AmAkei bhaYa kara|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA tA~rai| sarvAvasthAYa tA~rai Anugatya karA aparihArya| tavuo ki tomarA AllAha chAr3A anyake bhaYa karacha?
tomAdera ye ni‘Amatai arjita haYa, AllAharai pakSa hate haYa| AvAra yakhana kona duHkha-kaSTa tomAderake sparza kare, takhana tomarA tA~rai kAche sAhAyya cAo|
tArapara tini yakhana tomAdera kaSTa dUra karena, amani tomAdera madhya hate ekaTi dala nija pratipAlakera sAthe ziraka zuru kare deYa
Ami tAderake ye ni‘Amata diYechi tAra akRtajJatA prakAzera janya| Thika Ache, kichuTA bhoga-vilAsa kare nAo| acirei tomarA jAnate pArave|

Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi, tAte tArA ekaTA aMza nirdhAraNa kare tAdera (arthAt pratimAdera) janya, yAdera svarUpa tArA nijerAi jAne nA| AllAhara kasama! tomarA ye mithyA udbhAvana karate, se samparke tomAderake avazyai jijJAsAvAda karA have|
tArA to AllAhara janya kanyA santAna sthira karache| suvahAnAllAha! athaca nijedera janya (prArthanA kare) tAi (arthAt putra santAna) yA tAdera abhilASa motAveka haYa|
yakhana tAdera kAuke kanyA santAna (janmagrahaNa)-era susaMvAda deoYA haYa, takhana tAra cehArA malina haYe yAYa evaM se mane mane duHkha-kliSTa haYa|

se e susaMvAdake khArApa mane kare mAnuSa theke lukiYe ver3AYa (evaM cintA kare), hInatA svIkAra kare tAke nijera kAche rekhe deve, nAki tAke mATite pu~te phelave| jene rekha, tArA ye siddhAnta sthira kare tA ati manda!
yata sava manda viSaYa tAderai madhye, yArA AkherAte ImAna rAkhe nA| Ara sarveAcca paryAYera guNAvalI AllAha tAAlArai Ache| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha mAnuSake tAdera julumera kAraNe (sahasA) dhRta karale bhUpRSThe konao prANIke rehAi ditena nA| kintu tini tAderake ekaTA nirdiSTa kAla paryanta avakAza dena| tArapara yakhana tAdera nirdiSTa kAla ese par3ave, takhana tArA muhUrtakAlao pechane yete pAre nA evaM sAmaneo yete pAre nA|

tArA AllAhara janya emana jinisa nirdhAraNa kare, yA nijerA apachanda kare| tAraparao tAdera jihvA (nijedera) mithyA prazaMsA kare ye, samasta maGgala tAderai janya| eTA sunizcita (erUpa AcaraNera kAraNe) tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAma evaM tAderake tAtei nipatita rAkhA have|

(he navI!) AllAhara kasama! tomAra pUrve yesava jAti gata haYeche, Ami tAdera kAche rAsUla pAThiYechilAma| ataHpara zaYatAna tAdera karmakANDake tAdera sAmane camatkAra rUpe tule dharechila| sutarAM se-i (arthAt zaYatAna) Aja tAdera abhibhAvaka evaM (e kAraNe) tAdera janya Ache yantraNAmaYa zAsti|

Ami tomAra upara e kitAva ejanyai nAyila karechi, yAte tArA ye sava viSaYe vibhinna patha grahaNa kareche, tAdera sAmane tA suspaSTarUpe varNanA kara evaM yAte eTA ImAna AnaYanakArIdera janya hidAYAta o rahamatera avalamvana haYa|
AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karalena evaM bhUmira mRtyura para tAte prANa saJcAra karalena| nizcaYai ete nidarzana Ache seisava lokera janya, yArA kathA zone|

nizcaYai gavAdi pazura bhetara tomAdera janya cintA-bhAvanA karAra upakaraNa Ache| tAra peTe ye govara o rakta Ache, tAra mAjhakhAna theke Ami tomAderake emana vizuddha dudha pAna karAi, yA pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu haYe thAke|

evaM khejurera phala o AGgura thekeo (Ami tomAderake pAnIYa dAna kari), yA dvArA tomarA mada vAnAo evaM uttama khAdyao| nizcaYai era bhetarao sei sava lokera janya nidarzana Ache, yArA vuddhike kAje lAgAYa|
tomAra pratipAlaka maumAchira antare ei nirdeza saJcAra karena ye, pAhAr3e, gAche evaM mAnuSa ye mAcAna tairi kare tAte nija ghara tairi kara|

tArapara sava rakama phala theke nija khAdya AharaNa kara| tArapara tomAra pratipAlaka tomAra janya ye patha sahaja kare diYechena, sei pathe cala| (ebhAve) tAra peTa theke vibhinna varNera pAnIYa vera haYa, yAra bhetara mAnuSera janya Ache zephA| nizcaYai esavera madhye nidarzana Ache sei sakala lokera janya, yArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|

AllAhai tomAderake sRSTi karechena, tArapara tini tomAdera rUha kavaja karena| tomAdera madhye kataka emana haYa, yAderake vaYasera sarvApekSA akarmaNya stare peৗ~chAno haYa, yekhAne peৗ~chAra para tArA savakichu jAnAra parao kichui jAne nA| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

AllAha riyakera kSetre tomAdera kAuke kArao upara zreSThatva diYechena| yAderake zreSThatva deoYA haYeche, tArA tAdera riyaka nija dAsa-dAsIke ebhAve dAna kare nA, yAte tArA sakale samAna haYe yAYa| tave ki tArA AllAhara ni‘Amatake asvIkAra kare?

AllAha tomAderai madhya hate tomAdera janya strI sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera strIdera theke tomAdera janya putra o pautrAdi sRSTi karechena| Ara bhAlo-bhAlo jinisera theke riyakera vyavasthA karechena| tavuo ki tArA bhittihIna jinisera prati ImAna rAkhave Ara AllAhara ni‘AmatasamUhera akRtajJatA karave?
tArA AllAha chAr3A emana sava jinisera ivAdata kare yArA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI theke tAderake konaobhAve riyaka deoYAra kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM tA rAkhate sakSamao naYa|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhara janya dRSTAnta tairi karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|

AllAha ekaTi dRSTAnta dicchena- ekadike eka golAma, ye kArao mAlikAnAdhIna Ache| konao vastura madhye tAra kichumAtra kSamatA nei| Ara anyadike emana eka vyakti, yAke Ami AmAra pakSa hate utkRSTa riyaka diYechi evaM se tA theke gopane o prakAzye kharaca kare| ei du’jana ki samAna hate pAre? samasta prazaMsA AllAhara| kintu tAdera adhikAMzei (emana pariSkAra kathAo) jAne nA|

AllAha ArekaTi dRSTAnta dicchena- du’jana loka, tAdera ekajana vovA| se konao kAja karate pAre nA, varaM se tAra manivera janya ekaTA vojhA| maniva tAke yekhAnei pAThAYa, se bhAlo kichu kare Ane nA| erUpa vyakti ki oi vyaktira samAna hate pAre, ye anyaderakeo nyAYera Adeza deYa evaM nijeo sarala pathe pratiSThita thAke?
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sakala rahasya AllAhara muThoYa| kiYAmatera viSaYaTi kevala cokhera palakatulya; varaM tAra ceYeo druta| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|
AllAha tomAderake tomAdera mAtRgarbha theke emana avasthAYa vera karechena ye, tomarA kichui jAnate nA| tini tomAdera janya kAna, cokha o antakaraNa sRSTi karechena| yAte tomarA zokara AdAYa kara|

tArA ki pAkhidera prati lakSya kareni, yArA AkAzera zUnyamaNDale AllAhara AjJAdhIna? tAderake AllAha chAr3A anya keu sthira rAkhache nA| nizcaYai ete vahu nidarzana Ache, tAdera janya yArA ImAna rAkhe|

tini tomAdera gRhake tomAdera janya AvAsasthala vAniYechena evaM pazura cAmar3A dvArA tomAdera janya emana ghara vAniYechena, yA bhramaNe yAoYAra samaYa evaM kothAo avasthAna grahaNakAle tomAdera kAche veza hAlakA-pAtalA mane haYa| Ara tAdera pazama, loma o keza dvArA gRha-sAmagrI o emana sava jinisa tairi karena, yA kichu kAla tomAdera upakAre Ase|

evaM AllAhai nija sRSTa vastusamUha hate tomAdera janya chAYAra vyavasthA karechena, pAhAr3a-parvate tomAdera janya AzraYasthala vAniYechena, Ara tomAdera janya vAniYechena emana pozAka, yA tomAderake tApa theke rakSA kare evaM emana pozAka, yA yuddhakAle tomAderake rakSA kare| ebhAve tini tomAdera prati nija anugraha pUrNa karena, yAte tomarA anugata haYe yAo|
tAraparao yadi tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa) mukha phiriYe neYa, tave (he navI!) tomAra dAYitva to zudhu spaSTabhAve vArtA peৗ~chAno|
tArA AllAhara ni‘AmatasamUha cene, tavuo tA asvIkAra kare evaM tAdera adhikAMzai akRtajJa|

evaM sei dinake smaraNa rekha, yakhana Ami pratyeka ummata theke ekajana sAkSI dA~r3a karAva, tArapara yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila, tAderake (ajuhAta dekhAnora) anumati deoYA have nA evaM tAderake tAovA karAra janyao pharamAYeza karA have nA|
jAlemagaNa yakhana zAsti dekhate pAve, takhana tAdera zAsti hAlakA karA have nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deoYA have nA|

yArA AllAhara saGge zarIka karechila, tArA yakhana tAdera (nijedera gar3A) zarIkaderake dekhave, takhana valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! erAi sei zarIka, tomAra parivarte yAderake AmarA DAkatAma| e samaYa tArA (arthAt managar3A zarIkagaNa) tAdera dike kathA chu~r3e mArave ye, tomarA vilakula mithyuka!
se dina AllAhara sAmane tArA AnugatyamUlaka kathA valave| Ara tArA ye mithyA udbhAvana karata, se dina tAra kona hadisai tArA pAve nA|
yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila evaM AllAhara pathe anyaderake vAdhA dita, Ami tAdera zAstira upara zAsti vRddhi karate thAkava| kAraNa tArA azAnti vistAra karata|

sei dinakeo smaraNa rekha, yedina pratyeka ummatera madhye, tAdera nijedera theke, tAdera viruddhe ekajana sAkSI dA~r3a karAva Ara (he navI!) Ami tomAke edera viruddhe sAkSya deoYAra janya upasthita karava| Ami tomAra prati e kitAva nAyila karechi, yAte eTA pratiTi viSaYa suspaSTarUpe varNanA kare deYa evaM musalimadera janya haYa hidAYAta, rahamata o susaMvAda|

nizcaYai AllAha inasApha, daYA evaM AtmIYa-svajanake (tAdera haka) pradAnera hukuma dena Ara azlIlatA, manda kAja o juluma karate niSedha karena| tini tomAderake upadeza dena, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

tomarA yakhana kona aGgIkAra kara, takhana AllAhara saGge kRta aGgIkAra pUrNa kara| zapathake dRr3ha karAra para tA bhaGga karo nA yakhana tomarA AllAhake nijedera upara sAkSI vAniYe niYecha| tomarA yA-kichu kara, AllAha nizcaYa tA jAnena|

ye nArI tAra sUtA majavuta kare pAkAnora para pAka khule tA reA~YA-reA~YA kare phelechila, tomarA tAra mata haYo nA| phale tomarAo nijedera zapathake (bheGge) parasparera madhye anartha sRSTira mAdhyama vAnAve, kevala ekadala apara ekadala apekSA vezi lAbhavAna haoYAra janya| AllAha to era dvArA tomAdera parIkSA kare thAkena| tomarA ye viSaYe matabheda kara, kiYAmatera dina tini tomAdera sAmane tA spaSTa kare divena|

AllAha icchA karale tomAdera sakalake ekai ummata (arthAt ekai dInera anusArI) vAnAte pAratena| kintu tini yAke icchA (tAra jedI AcaraNera kAraNe) vibhrAntite nikSepa karena evaM yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena| tomarA yA-kichu kara, se samparke tomAderake avazyai jijJAsAvAda karA have|

tomarA nijedera zapathake parasparera madhye anartha sRSTira kAje vyavahAra karo nA| pariNAme (kArao) pA sthita haoYAra para pichale yAve| ataHpara (tAke) AllAhara patha theke virata rAkhAra kAraNe tomAderake kaThina zAstira AsvAda grahaNa karate have Ara (sekSetre) tomAdera janya thAkave mahAzAsti|
AllAhara saGge kRta aGgIkAra tuccha mUlye vikri karo nA| tomarA yadi prakRta satya upalavdhi kara, tave AllAhara kAche ye pratidAna Ache tomAdera pakSe tAi zreYa|
tomAdera kAche yA-kichu Ache tA niHzeSa haYe yAve Ara AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA sthAYI| yArA savara kare, Ami tAdera utkRSTa kAja anuyAYI avazyai tAdera pratidAna deva|

ye vyaktii mumina thAkA avasthAYa satkarma karave, se puruSa hoka vA nArI, Ami avazyai tAke uttama jIvana yApana karAva evaM tAderake tAdera utkRSTa karma anuyAYI tAdera pratidAna avazyai pradAna karava|
sutarAM Apani yakhana kuraAna par3ave, takhana vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke AllAhara AzraYa grahaNa karavena|
yArA ImAna eneche evaM nija pratipAlakera upara bharasA rAkhe, tAdera upara tAra kona Adhipatya cale nA|
tAra Adhipatya cale kevala emana sava lokera upara yArA tAke vandhurUpe grahaNa kareche evaM yArA AllAhara zarIka sAvyastakArI|

Ami yakhana eka AYAtake anya AYAta dvArA parivartana kari Ara AllAhai bhAlo jAne tini kI nAyila karavena, takhana tArA (kApheragaNa) vale, tumi to AllAhara prati apavAda diccha| athaca tAdera adhikAMzei prakRta viSaYa jAne nA|

vale dAo, eTA (arthAt kuraAna mAjIda) to rUhula kudasa (jivarAIla AlAihisa sAlAma) tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke yathAyathabhAve niYe eseche, ImAnadAraderake dRr3hapada rAkhAra janya evaM musalimadera pakSe hidAYAta o susaMvAdasvarUpa|

(he navI!) AmAra jAnA Ache ye, tArA (tomAra samparke) vale, tAke to ekajana mAnuSa zikSA deYa| (athaca) tArA yAra prati eTA Aropa kare tAra bhASA AravI naYa| Ara eTA (arthAt kuraAnera bhASA) spaSTa AravI bhASA|
yArA AllAhara AYAtera upara ImAna rAkhe nA, AllAha tAderake hidAYAta dAna karena nA| tAdera janya Ache, yantraNAmaYa zAsti|
AllAhara prati apavAda Aropa to (navI naYa, varaM) tArAi kare, yArA AllAhara AYAtera upara ImAna rAkhe nA| prakRtapakSe tArAi mithyAvAdI|

ye vyakti AllAhara prati ImAna AnAra para tA~ra kupharIte lipta haYa avazya yAke (kupharIra janya) vAdhya karA haYeche, kintu tAra antara ImAne sthira se naYa; varaM ye kupharIra janya nija hRdaYa khule diYeche, erUpa lokera upara AllAhara pakSa theke gayava evaM tAdera janya Ache mahAzAsti|
tA ejanya ye, tArA AkherAtera viparIte duniYAra jIvanakei vezi bhAloveseche evaM ejanya ye, AllAha erUpa akRtajJa lokaderake hidAYAte upanIta karena nA|
tArA emana loka, AllAha yAdera antara, kAna o cokhe mohara kare diYechena evaM tArAi emana loka, yArA (nija pariNAma samparke) sampUrNa gAphela|
eTA sunizcita ye, erAi AkherAte sarvApekSA vezi kSatigrasta have|
yArA phitanAYa AkrAnta haoYAra para hijarata kareche, tArapara jihAda kareche o savara avalamvana kareche, tomAra pratipAlaka esava viSaYera para avazyai ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tA sei dina, ye dina pratyeka vyakti AtmarakSAmUlaka kathA valate valate upasthita have evaM pratyekake tAra samasta karmera paripUrNa pratiphala deoYA have evaM tAdera prati kona juluma karA have nA|

AllAha eka janavasatira dRSTAnta dicchena, yA chila nirApada o zAntipUrNa| caturdika theke tAra jIvikA cale Asata paryApta parimANe| ataHpara tA AllAhara ni‘Amatera akRtajJatA zuru kare dila| phale AllAha tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAderake kSudhA o bhItira pozAka AsvAdana karAlena|
tAdera kAche tAderai madhya hate ekajana rAsUla esechila, kintu tArA tAke asvIkAra karala| sutarAM tArA yakhana julume lipta hala takhana zAsti tAderake grAsa karala|
AllAha tomAderake riyaka hiseve ye hAlAla, pavitra vastu diYechena, tA khAo evaM AllAhara ni‘AmatasamUhera zokara AdAYa kara yadi tomarA satyii tA~ra ivAdata kare thAka|

tini to tomAdera janya kevala mRta jantu, rakta, zUkarera gozata evaM sei pazu hArAma karechena, yAte AllAha chAr3A anya kArao nAma neoYA haYeche| tave ye kSudhAYa atiSTha haYe yAve evaM majA luTAra janya nA khAve Ara (praYojanera) sImA atikramao nA karave, (tAra pakSe) to AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

ye sava vastu samparke tomAdera jihvA mithyA racanA kare, se samparke valo nA- eTA hAlAla evaM eTA hArAma| kenanA tAra artha have tomarA AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda diccha| jene rekha, yArA AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda deYa, tArA saphalakAma haYa nA|
(duniYAYa) tAdera ArAma-AYeza ati sAmAnya| tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAmaYa zAsti|
iYAhudIdera janya Ami hArAma karechilAma sei sava jinisa, yA Ami pUrvei tomAra nikaTa ullekha karechi| Ami tAdera upara kona juluma karini; varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karachila|
tA sattveo tomAra pratipAlaka emana ye, yArA ajJatAvazata manda kAja kare evaM tArapara tAovA kare o nijederake zudhariYe neYa, tomAra pratipAlaka tAraparao tAdera janya ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai ivarAhIma chila eka AdarzapuruSa AllAhara anugata, ekaniSTha evaM yArA AllAhara saGge kAuke zarIka kare se tAdera antarbhukta chila nA|
se AllAhara ni‘Amatera kRtajJatA AdAYakArI chila| AllAha tAke manonIta karechilena evaM tAke sarala pathe paricAlita karechilena|
Ami tAke duniYAYao kalyANa diYechilAma evaM AkherAteo se nizcaYai sAlehInera antarbhukta thAkave|

ataHpara (he navI!) Ami ohIra mAdhyame tomAra pratio ei hukuma nAyila karechi ye, tumi ivarAhImera dIna anusaraNa kara, ye nijeke AllAharai abhimukhI kare rekhechila evaM yArA AllAhara saGge zarIka kare se tAdera antarbhukta chila nA|

zanivAra samparkita vidhAna to kevala tAdera uparai vAdhyatAmUlaka karA haYechila, yArA e samparke matabheda karata| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka tArA yesava viSaYe matabheda kare kiYAmatera dina se samparke mImAMsA karavena|

tumi nija pratipAlakera pathe mAnuSake DAkave hikamata o sadupadezera mAdhyame Ara (yadi kakhanao vitarkera darakAra par3e, tave) tAdera sAthe vitarka karave utkRSTa panthAYa| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka yArA tAra patha theke vicyuta haYeche, tAdera samparke bhAlobhAvei jAnena evaM tini tAdera samparkeo paripUrNa jJAta, yArA satpathe pratiSThita|
tomarA yadi (kona julumera) pratizodha nAo, tave Thika tataTukui neve, yataTuku juluma tomAdera upara karA haYeche Ara yadi savara kara, tave nizcaYai savara avalamvanakArIdera pakSe tAi zreYa|
evaM (he navI!) tumi savara avalamvana kara| tomAra savara to AllAharai sAhAyye have| tumi kApheradera janya duHkha karo nA evaM tArA ye Sar3ayantra kare tAra kAraNe kuNThita haYo nA|
nizcaYai AllAha tAderai sAthI, yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM yArA ihasAnera adhikArI haYa|

pavitra sei sattA, yini nija vAndAke rAtArAti masajidula hArAma theke masajidula AkasAYa niYe yAna, yAra cArapAzake Ami varakatamaYa karechi, tAke AmAra kichu nidarzana dekhAnora janya| nizcaYai tini sava kichura zrotA evaM sava kichura jJAtA|
evaM Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma evaM tAke vanI isarAIlera janya hidAYAtera mAdhyama vAniYechilAma| Adeza karechilAma, tomarA AmAra parivarte anya kAuke karmavidhAYakarUpe grahaNa karo nA|
he oi sakala lokera vaMzadharagaNa! yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe naukAYa ArohaNa kariYechilAma| se chila khuvai zokara gojAra vAndA|
Ami kitAve mImAMsA dAna kare vanI isarAIlake avahita karechilAma, tomarA pRthivIte du’vAra viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM ghora ahaMkAra pradarzana karave|

sutarAM yakhana sei ghaTanA du’Tira prathamaTi samupasthita hala, takhana Ami tomAdera upara AmAra emana vAndAderake Adhipatya dAna karalAma, yArA chila pracaNDa lar3Aku| tArA tomAdera nagare praveza kare char3iYe par3ala| eTA chila emana eka pratizruti, yA kAryakara haoYArai chila|

tArapara Ami tomAderake ghure dA~r3iYe tAdera upara Adhipatya vistArera suyoga dilAma evaM tomAdera dhana-daulata o santAna-santatite vRddhi sAdhana karalAma| Ara tomAdera lokasaMkhyA Agera tulanAYa vRddhi karalAma|

tomarA satkarma karale tA nijederai kalyANArthe karave Ara yadi manda kAja kara, tAteo nijederai akalyANa have| ataHpara yakhana dvitIYa ghaTanAra nirdhArita kAla Asala, (takhana Ami tomAdera upara apara zatru cApiYe dilAma,) yAte tArA tomAdera cehArA vikRta kare deYa evaM yAte Agera vAra tArA yebhAve praveza karechila, evArao sebhAve masajide praveza kare evaM yA-kichura upara tAdera Adhipatya pratiSThita haYa tA misamAra kare deYa|

yatheSTa sambhAvanA Ache, tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera prati daYA karavena, kintu tomarA yadi ekai kAjera punarAvRtti kara, tave Amio punarAvRtti karava| Ara Ami to jAhAnnAmake kApheradera janya kArAgAra vAniYei rekhechi|
vastuta e kuraAna sei patha dekhAYa, yA sarvApekSA sarala Ara yArA (era prati) ImAna ene satkarma kare, tAderake susaMvAda deYa ye, tAdera janya Ache mahA pratidAna|
Ara (satarka kare deYa ye,) yArA AkherAte vizvAsa rAkhe nA tAdera janya Ami yantraNAmaYa zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
mAnuSa seibhAvei amaGgala prArthanA kare, yebhAve tAra maGgala prArthanA karA ucita| vastuta mAnuSa var3a vyastamati|

Ami rAta o dinake du’Ti nidarzanarUpe sRSTi karechi, ataHpara rAtera nidarzanake andhakAra karechi Ara dinera nidarzanake karechi Alokita, yAte tomarA nija pratipAlakera anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA vachara-saMkhyA o (mAsera) hisAva jAnate pAra| Ami savakichu pRthaka-pRthakabhAve spaSTa kare diYechi|
Ami pratyeka mAnuSera (kAjera) pariNAma tAra galadeze se~Te diYechi evaM kiYAmatera dina Ami (tAra AmalanAmA) lipivaddharUpe tAra sAmane vera kare deva, yA se unmukta pAve|
(valA have) tumi nija AmalanAmA par3a| Aja tumi nijei nijera hisAva neoYAra janya yatheSTa|

ye vyakti sarala pathe cale, se to sarala pathe cale nija maGgalera janyai Ara ye vyakti bhrAnta patha avalamvana kare, se nijera kSatira janyai tA avalamvana kare| konao bhAra vahanakArI anya kArao bhAra vahana karave nA| Ami kakhanao kAuke zAsti dei nA, yatakSaNa nA (tAra kAche) kona rAsUla pAThAi|

yakhana kona janapadake dhvaMsa karAra icchA kari takhana tAdera vittavAna lokaderake (ImAna o Anugatyera) hukuma dei, kintu tArA tAte nApharamAnI kare, phale tAdera samparke kathA cUr3Anta haYe yAYa evaM Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare pheli|
Ami nUhera para kata mAnavagoSThIkei dhvaMsa karechi! tomAra pratipAlaka nija vAndAdera pAparAzi samparke paripUrNa avagata, tini savakichu dekhachena|

keu duniYAra nagada lAbha kAmanA karale Ami yAke icchA, yataTuku icchA, ekhAnei tAke tA nagada diYe dei| tArapara Ami tAra janya jAhAnnAma rekhe diYechi, yAte se lAJchita o vitAr3itarUpe praveza karave|
Ara ye vyakti AkherAta (-era lAbha) cAYa evaM sejanya yathocitabhAve ceSTA kare, se yadi mumina haYa, tave erUpa lokera ceSTAra paripUrNa maryAdA deoYA have|
(he navI! duniYAYa) tomAra pratipAlakera dAnera ye vyApAraTA, Ami tA dvArA ederakeo dhanya kari evaM oderakeo| (duniYAYa) tomAra pratipAlakera dAna kArao janyai ruddha naYa|
lakSya kara, Ami kibhAve tAdera katakake katakera upara zreSThatva diYechi| nizcita jena, AkherAta maryAdAra dika thekeo mahattara evaM mAhAtmyera dika thekeo zreSThatara|
AllAhara saGge anya kAuke mAvuda vAnio nA| anyathAYa tumi nindAyogya (o) niHsahAYa haYe par3ave|

tomAra pratipAlaka nirdeza diYechena ye, tAke chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karo nA, pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadvyavahAra karo, pitA-mAtAra konao ekajana kiMvA ubhaYe yadi tomAra kAche vArdhakye upanIta haYa, tave tAderake uph paryanta valo nA evaM tAderake dhamaka dio nA; varaM tAdera sAthe sammAnajanaka kathA valo|

evaM tAdera prati mamatApUrNa AcaraNera sAthe tAdera sAmane nijeke vinaYAvanata karo evaM du‘A karo, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tArA yebhAve AmAra zaizave AmAke lAlana-pAlana kareche, temani Apanio tAdera prati rahamatera AcaraNa karuna|
tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera antare ki Ache tA bhAlo jAnena| tomarA yadi nekakAra haYe yAo, tave yArA vezi vezi tAra dike ruju haYa tini tAdera bhula-truTi kSamA karena|
AtmIYa-svajanake tAdera haka AdAYa karo evaM abhAvagrasta o musAphirakeo (tAdera haka pradAna karo)| Ara nijedera artha-sampada apraYojanIYa kAje ur3Ave nA|
jene rekha, yArA apraYojanIYa kAje artha ur3AYa, tArA zaYatAnera bhAi| Ara zaYatAna nija pratipAlakera ghora akRtajJa|

yadi kakhanao tAdera (arthAt AtmIYa-svajana, abhAvagrasta o musAphiradera) theke e kAraNe tomAra mukha pherAnora darakAra haYa ye, tumi tomAra pratipAlakera rahamatera pratyAzAYa raYecha, tave se kSetreo tAdera sAthe namratAra sAthe kathA valo|
(kRpaNatAvaze) nijera hAta ghAr3era sAthe ve~dhe rekha nA evaM (apavyaYI haYe) tA sampUrNarUpe khule rekha nA, yaddaruNa tomAke nindAyoge o niHsva haYe vase par3ate have|

vastuta tomAra pratipAlaka yAra janya icchA karena jIvikA prazasta kare dena evaM (yAra janya icchA) saMkucita kare dena| jene rekha, tini nija vAndAdera avasthAdi samparke samyaka avagata evaM tAderake tini bhAlobhAve dekhachena|
dAridryera bhaYe nija santAnaderake hatyA karo nA| Ami tAderakeo riyaka dei evaM tomAderakeo| nizcaYai tAderake hatyA karA gurutara aparAdha|
evaM vyabhicArera kAcheo yeo nA| nizcaYai tA azlIlatA o vipathagAmitA|

AllAha yei prANake maryAdA dAna karechena tAke hatyA karo nA, tave (zarIYata anuyAYI) tomarA tAra adhikAra lAbha karale bhinna kathA| yAke anyAYabhAve hatyA karA haYa,Ami tAra alike (kisAsa grahaNera) adhikAra diYechi| sutarAM se yena hatyAkArye sImAlaMghana nA kare| nizcaYai se era upayukta ye, tAra sAhAyya karA have|

evaM iYAtIma yatakSaNa nA paripakkatAYa upanIta haYa, tAra sampadera kAcheo yeo nA, tave emana panthAYa yA (tAra pakSe) uttama| Ara aGgIkAra pUraNa karo| nizcaYai aGgIkAra samparke (tomAdera) jijJAsAvAda karA have|
yakhana parimApa pAtra dvArA kAuke kona jinisa mepe dAo, takhana paripUrNa mApe dio Ara ojana karAra janya saThika dA~r3ipAllA vyavahAra karo| e panthAi saThika evaM erai pariNAma utkRSTa|
ye viSaYe tomAra nizcita jJAna nei (tAke satya mane kare) tAra pichane par3o nA| jene rekha, kAna, cokha o antara era pratiTi samparke (tomAderake) jijJesa karA have|
bhUpRSThe dambhabhare calo nA| tumi to bhUmike phATiYe phelate pArave nA evaM uccatAYa pAhAr3a paryanta peৗ~chate pArave nA|
e savai emana manda kAja, yA tomAra pratipAlakera kAche ghRNya|

(he navI!) egulo emana hikamatera kathA, yA tomAra pratipAlaka ohIra mAdhyame tomAra kAche peৗ~chiYechena evaM (he mAnuSa!) AllAhara sAthe anya kAuke mAvuda vAnio nA, anyathAYa tumi nindita o dhikRta haYe jAhAnnAme nikSipta have|
tomAdera pratipAlaka putra santAna deoYAra janya tomAderake veche niYechena Ara nijera janya vujhi pherezatAderake kanyArUpe grahaNa karechena? prakRtapakSe tomarA var3a gurutara kathA valacha|
Ami e kuraAne vibhinnabhAve vyAkhyAdAna karechi, yAte mAnuSa sacetana haYa, kintu ete tAdera palAYanaparatAi vRddhi pAcche|
vale dAo, AllAhara saGge yadi Arao ilAha thAkata, yemana tomarA valacha tave tArA Araza-adhipati (prakRta ilAhera)-era upara prabhAva vistArera kona patha khu~jata|
vastuta tArA yesava kathA vale, tA~ra sattA tA theke sampUrNa pavitra o samucca|

sAta AsamAna o yamIna evaM edera antarbhukta samasta sRSTi tA~ra pavitratA varNanA kare, emana kona jinisa nei, yA tA~ra saprazaMsa tAsavIha pATha kare nA| kintu tomarA tAdera tAsavIha vujhate pAra nA| vastuta tini parama sahiSNu, ati kSamAzIla|
(he navI!) tumi yakhana kuraAna par3a, takhana Ami tomAra evaM yArA AkherAte ImAna rAkhe nA tAdera madhye eka adRzya pardA rekhe dei|

Ara Ami tAdera antarera upara AcchAdana rekhe diYechi, yAte tArA tA vujhate nA pAre evaM tAdera kAne vadhiratA sRSTi kare dei| Ara tumi yakhana kuraAne tomAra ekamAtra pratipAlakera ullekha kara, takhana tArA vitRSNAbhare pichana phiriYe cale yAYa|

tArA yakhana tomAra kathA kAna pete zone, takhana kena zone tA Ami bhAlo kare jAni evaM yakhana tArA paraspare kAnAkAni kare, yakhana jAlemagaNa (tAdera svagotrIYa musalimaderake) vale, tomarA to kevala ekajana yAdugrasta lokera anusaraNa karacha (takhana tAdera se kathAo Ami bhAlobhAve jAni)|
lakSya kara, tArA tomAra prati kemana (parihAsamUlaka) dRSTAnta Aropa karache| tArA patha hAriYeche sutarAM tArA Ara pathe Asate pArave nA|
tArA vale, AmarA yakhana asthite pariNata hava evaM cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe yAva, tAraparao ki AmarA natuna sRSTirUpe punarutthita hava?
vale dAo, tomarA pAthara vA lohA haYe yAo!

athavA emana kona sRSTi haYe yAo, ye samparke tomAdera manera bhAvanA hala ye, tA (jIvita karA) Arao kaThina| (tavuo tomAderake Thikai jIvita karA have)| ataHpara tArA valave, ke AmAderake punarAYa jIvita karave? vale dio, tinii jIvita karavena, yini tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechilena| tArapara tArA tomAdera sAmane mAthA ner3e-ner3e valave, erUpa kakhana have? vale dio, sambhavata se samaYaTi kAchei ese geche|
ye dina tini tomAderake DAkavena, tomarA tA~ra prazaMsArata haYe tA~ra hukuma pAlana karave evaM tomAdera mane have (duniYAYa) tomarA alpa kichukAlai avasthAna karechile|
AmAra (mumina) vAndAdera vale dAo, tArA yena emana kathAi vale, yA uttama| nizcaYai zaYatAna mAnuSera madhye phAsAda sRSTi kare| nizcaYai zaYatAna mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|
tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAderake bhAlobhAvei jAnena| tini cAile tomAdera prati daYA karena evaM cAile tomAderake zAsti dena| (he navI!) Ami tomAke tAdera kAjakarmera yimmAdAra vAniYe pAThAini|
yArA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte Ache, tomAra pratipAlaka tAderake bhAlobhAve jAnena| Ami kataka navIke kataka navIra upara zreSThatva diYechi| Ara Ami dAUdake yAvUra diYechilAma|

(yArA AllAha chAr3A anya mAvuda mAne, tAderake) vale dAo, tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAderake mAvuda mane karecha, tAderake DAka diYe dekha| tArA tomAdera kona kaSTa dUra karate pArave nA evaM tA parivartanao karate pArave nA|

tArA yAderake DAke, tArA nijerAi to ei lakSe tAdera pratipAlaka paryanta peৗ~chAra achilA sandhAna kare ye, tAdera madhye ke AllAhara vezi nikaTavartI hate pAre evaM tArA tA~ra rahamatera AzA kare o tA~ra AyAvake bhaYa kare| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlakera AyAva emana, yAke bhaYa karAi ucita|
emana kona janapada nei, yAke Ami kiYAmatera Age dhvaMsa karava nA athavA tAke anya kona kaThina zAsti deva nA| ekathA (tAkadIrera) kitAve lipivaddha Ache|

(kApheradera pharamAYezI nidarzana) pAThAno hate AmAke kevala e viSaYaTAi virata rekheche ye, pUrvavartIgaNa erUpa nidarzana (dekhAra parao tA) asvIkAra karechila| Ami chAmuda jAtike uSTrI diYechilAma, yA cokha kholAra janya yatheSTa chila, kintu tArA tAra prati juluma karechila| Ami nidarzana pAThAi bhaYa dekhAnorai janya|

(he navI!) sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami valechilAma, tomAra pratipAlaka (nija jJAna dvArA) samasta mAnuSake pariveSTana kare Achena| Ara Ami tomAke ye dRzya dekhiYechi, tAke kApheradera janya kevala parIkSAra viSaYai vAniYechi evaM kuraAne varNita abhizapta vRkSaTikeo| Ami tAderake bhIti pradarzana kare yAcchi, kintu tAte tAdera ghora avAdhyatAi vRddhi pAcche|

evaM sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valechilAma, Adamake sijadA kara| takhana tArA sijadA karala, kintu ivalIsa karala nA| se valala, Ami ki tAke sijadA karava, yAke Apani mATi dvArA sRSTi karechena?

se valate lAgala, valuna to, ei ki sei sRSTi, yAke Apani AmAra upara maryAdA dAna karechena! Apani yadi kiYAmatera dina paryanta AmAke avakAza dena, tave Ami tAra vaMzadharadera madhye alpasaMkhyaka chAr3A vAki sakalera coYAle lAgAma pariYe deva|
AllAha valalena, yAo, tAdera madhye ye-keu tomAra anugAmI have, jAhAnnAmai have tomAdera sakalera zAstiparipUrNa zAsti|

tAdera madhye yAra upara tomAra kSamatA cale nija DAka dvArA vibhrAnta kara, tomAra azvArohI o padAtika vAhinI dvArA tAdera upara car3Ao hao, tAdera sampada o santAna-santatite aMzIdAra haYe yAo evaM tAderake yata pAra pratizruti dAo| vastuta zaYatAna tAderake ye pratizruti deYa tA dheA~kA chAr3A kichui naYa|
nizcaYai AmAra yArA vAndA, tAdera upara tomAra kona kSamatA calave nA| (tAdera) rakSakarUpe tomAra pratipAlakai yatheSTa|
tinii tomAdera pratipAlaka, yini sAgare tomAdera janya nauyAna cAlAna, yAte tomarA tAra anugraha sandhAna kara| tini tomAdera prati parama daYAlu|

sAgare yakhana tomAdera kona vipada dekhA deYa, takhana tomarA yAderake (arthAt yei devatAderake) DAka tArA antarhita haYe yAYa, saGge thAkena kevala AllAha| tini yakhana tomAderake uddhAra kare sthale peৗ~chiYe dena, amani tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo| mAnuSa ghora akRtajJa|

tave ki tomarA era theke nizcinta haYe gecha ye, AllAha sthalerai kothAo tomAderake dhasiYe dite pArena athavA tomAdera prati pAtharavarSI jhar3a pAThAte pArena, takhana Ara tomarA nijedera kona rakSAkartA pAve nA?

nA ki tomarA era thekeo nizcinta haYe gecha ye, tini tomAderake AvAra tAtei (arthAt sAgare) niYe yete pArena, tArapara tomAdera prati pravala jhaJjhAvAYu pAThiYe akRtajJatAra zAsti-svarUpa tomAderake DuviYe devena, yakhana tomarA emana kAuke pAve nA, ye e vyApAre AmAra pichane lAgate pAre|

vAstavikapakSe Ami Adama santAnake maryAdA dAna karechi evaM sthale o jale tAdera janya vAhanera vyavasthA karechi, tAderake uttama riyaka dAna karechi evaM AmAra vahu mAkhalukera upara tAderake zreSThatva dAna karechi|

sei dinake smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami samasta mAnuSake tAdera AmalanAmAsaha DAkava| tArapara yAderake tAdera AmalanAmA deoYA have DAna hAte, tArA tAdera AmalanAmA par3ave evaM tAdera prati sutA parimANao juluma karA have nA|
Ara ye vyakti duniYAYa andha haYe thekeche se AkherAteo andha evaM adhikatara pathabhraSTa thAkave|

(he navI!) Ami tomAra kAche ye ohI pAThiYechi, kApheragaNa tomAke tA theke vicyuta karAra upakrama karachila, yAte tumi era parivarte anya kona kathA racanA kare AmAra nAme peza kara| sekSetre tArA tomAke avazyai nijedera parama vandhu vAniYe nita|
Ami yadi tomAke avicalita nA rAkhatAma, tave tumio tAdera dike khAnikaTA jhu~ke par3Ara upakrama karate|
Ara tA hale Ami duniYAYao tomAke dviguNa zAsti ditAma evaM mRtyura parao dviguNa| ataHpara AmAra viruddhe tumi kona sAhAyyakArI pete nA|
tAchAr3A tArA ei bhUmi (makkA) theke tomAderake uccheda karAra phikire Ache, yAte tomAderake ekhAna theke vera kare dite pAre| Ara se rakama hale tomAra para tArAo ekhAne vezi dina thAkate pArave nA|
eTA AmAra niYama, yA Ami tomAra pUrve AmAra ye rAsUlagaNake pAThiYechilAma, tAdera kSetre avalamvana karechilAma| tumi AmAra niYame kona parivartana pAve nA|
(he navI!) sUrya helAra samaYa theke rAtera andhakAra paryanta nAmAya kAYema kara evaM phajarera samaYa kuraAna pAThe yatnavAna thAka| smaraNa rekha, phajarera tilAoYAte ghaTe thAke samAveza|
rAtera kichu aMze tAhAjjuda par3ave, yA tomAra janya eka atirikta ivAdata| AzA karA yAYa tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke ‘mAkAme mAhamuda’-e peৗ~chAvena|

evaM du‘A kara ‘he pratipAlaka! AmAke yekhAne praveza karAve, kalyANera sAthe praveza kario evaM yekhAna theke vera karave kalyANera sAthe vera karo evaM AmAke tomAra nikaTa theke vizeSabhAve emana kSamatA dAna karo, yAra sAthe (tomAra) sAhAyya thAkave|
evaM vala, satya ese geche evaM mithyA vilupta haYeche, nizcaYai mithyA emana jinisa, yA vilupta haoYArai|
Ami nAyila karachi emana kuraAna, yA muminadera pakSe zephA o rahamata| tave jAlemadera kSetre era dvArA kSati chAr3A anya kichu vRddhi haYa nA|
Ami mAnuSake yakhana kona ni‘Amata dei, takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa o pAza kATiYe yAYa| Ara yadi kona aniSTa tAke sparza kare tave se sampUrNa hatAza haYe par3e|
vale dAo, pratyeke nija-nija panthAYa kAja karache, ke vezi saThika pathe tA tomAra pratipAlakai bhAlo jAnena|
(he navI!) tArA tomAke rUha samparke jijJesa kare| vale dAo, rUha AmAra pratipAlakera hukumaghaTita| tomAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche sAmAnyamAtra|
Ami icchA karale tomAra kAche ye ohI pAThiYechi, tA savai pratyAhAra karate pAratAma, tArapara tumi tA phiriYe neoYAra janya AmAra viruddhe kona sAhAyyakArIo pete nA|
kintu tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate eTA eka rahamata (ye, ohIra dhArA cAlu Ache)| vastuta tomAra prati tA~ra anugraha suvipula|
vale dAo, ei kuraAnera mata vANI tairi kare AnAra janya yadi samasta mAnuSa o jina ekatra haYe yAYa, tavuo tArA e rakama kichu Anate pArave nA, tAte tArA eke anyera yatai sAhAyya karuka|
Ami mAnuSera kalyANArthe e kuraAne sarvaprakAra zikSaNIYa viSaYa nAnAbhAve varNanA karechi, tA sattveo adhikAMza loka asvIkRti chAr3A anya kichute rAji naYa|
tArA vale, AmarA tatakSaNa paryanta tomAra prati ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi bhUmi theke AmAdera janya eka prasravaNa vera kare deve|
athavA tomAra janya khejura o AGgurera ekaTi vAgAna haYe yAve evaM tumi tAra phA~ke-phA~ke mATi pher3e nadI-nAlA pravAhita kare deve|
athavA tumi yemana dAvI kare thAka, AkAzake khaNDa-vikhaNDa kare AmAdera upara phele deve kiMvA AllAha o phirizatAgaNake AmAdera sAmanA-sAmani niYe Asave|

athavA tomAra janya ekaTi sonAra ghara haYe yAve athavA tumi AkAze ArohaNa karave, kintu AmarA tomAra AkAze ArohaNakeo tatakSaNa paryanta vizvAsa karava nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera prati emana eka kitAva avatIrNa karave, yA AmarA par3ate pArava| (he navI!) vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlaka pavitra| Ami to ekajana mAnuSa mAtra, yAke rAsUla kare pAThAno haYeche|
yakhana tAdera kAche hidAYAtera vArtA Asala takhana tAderake kevala e viSaYaTAi ImAna Anate vAdhA diYechila ye, tArA valata, AllAha ki ekajana mAnuSake rAsUla kare pAThiYechena?
vale dAo, pRthivIte yadi phirizatAgaNa nizcinte vicaraNa karata, tave Ami nizcaYai kona phirizatAke tAdera kAche rAsUla kare pAThAtAma|
vala, AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI haoYAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| nizcaYai tini nija vAndAdera samparke paripUrNarUpe avagata, tini savakichu dekhachena|

AllAha yAke hidAYAta dAna karena sei saThika pathaprApta haYe thAke| Ara yAke tini vipathagAmI karena, tAra janya tumi kichutei tAke chAr3A anya kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA| kiYAmatera dina tAderake andha, vovA o vadhirarUpe mukhe bhara diYe calA avasthAYa samaveta karava| tAdera ThikAnA have jAhAnnAma| yakhanai tAra Aguna stimita hate zuru karave amani Ami tA Arao vezi uttapta kare deva|

eTAi tAdera zAsti| kenanA tArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karechila evaM valechila, AmarA yakhana (mare) asthite pariNata hava o cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe yAva, tAraparao AmAderake natunabhAve jIvita kare oThAno have?

tArA ki vujhate pArala nA ye, yei AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena tini tAdera mata mAnuSa punarAYa sRSTi karateo sakSama? tini tAdera janya sthira kare rekhechena emana eka kAla, yAra (AsAra) madhye vindumAtra sandeha nei| tathApi jAlemagaNa asvIkRti chAr3A anya kichute sammata naYa|

(he navI! kApheraderake) vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlakera rahamatera bhANDAra yadi tomAdera ekhatiYArAdhIna thAkata, tave kharaca haYe yAoYAra bhaYe tomarA avazyai hAta vandha kare rAkhate| mAnuSa var3ai saMkIrNamanA|

Ami mUsAke naYaTi spaSTa nidarzana diYechilAma| vanI isarAIlake jijJesa kare dekha, se yakhana tAdera kAche Asala, takhana phira‘Auna tAke valechila, he mUsA! tomAra samparke to AmAra dhAraNA keu tomAke yAdu kareche|

mUsA valala, tumi bhAlo karei jAna, esava nidarzana anya keu naYa; varaM AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra pratipAlakai suspaSTa upalavdhi sRSTira janya avatIrNa karechena| Ara he phira‘Auna! tomAra samparke to AmAra dhAraNA tomAra dhvaMsa Asanna|
tArapara phira‘Auna saMkalpa karechila, tAderake (arthAt vanI isarAIlake) se deza theke uccheda karave, kintu Ami tAke evaM saGgIgaNake sakalake nimajjita karalAma|
tArapara vanI isarAIlake valalAma, tomarA bhU-pRSThe vasavAsa kara, tArapara yakhana AkherAtera oYAdA pUraNera samaYa ese yAve, takhana Ami tomAdera sakalake ekatra kare upasthita karava|
Ami e kuraAnake satyasahai nAyala karechi evaM satyasahai eTA avatIrNa haYeche| (he navI!) Ami tomAke kevala ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpei pAThiYechi|
Ami kuraAnake AlAdA AlAdA aMza kare diYechi, yAte tumi tA mAnuSera sAmane theme theme par3ate pAra Ara Ami eTA nAyila karechi alpa-alpa kare|
(kApheraderake) vale dAo, tomarA ete ImAna Ana vA nAi Ana, yAderake era Age jJAna deoYA haYechila, tAdera sAmane yakhana (kuraAna) par3A haYa takhana tArA thutani phele sijadAYa par3e yAYa|
evaM vale, AmAdera pratipAlaka pavitra, nizcaYai AmAdera pratipAlakera oYAdA vAstavAYita haYei thAke|
evaM tArA kA~date kA~date thutanira upara luTiYe par3e evaM eTA (arthAt kuraAna) tAdera antarera vinaYa Arao vRddhi kare|

vale dAo, tomarA AllAhake DAka vA rahamAnake DAka, ye nAmei tomarA (AllAhake) DAka, (ekai kathA| kenanA) samasta sundara nAma to tA~rai| tumi nijera nAmAya vezi u~cu svare par3ave nA evaM ati nicu svareo naYa; varaM ubhaYera mAjhAmAjhi panthA avalamvana karave|

vala, samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini kona santAna grahaNa karenani, tA~ra rAjatve kona aMzIdAra nei evaM akSamatA hate rakSAra janya tA~ra kona abhibhAvakera praYojana nei| tA~ra mahimA varNanA kara, Thika yebhAve tA~ra mahimA varNanA karA ucita|
samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini nija vAndAra prati kitAva nAyila karechena evaM tAte konao rakamera vakratA rAkhenani|

nAyila karechena eka sarala-saThika grantharUpe, mAnuSake nijera pakSa theke eka kaThina zAsti samparke satarka karAra evaM yesakala mumina satkarma kare, tAderake ei susaMvAda deoYAra janya ye, tAdera janya raYeche utkRSTa pratidAna|
yAte tArA sarvadA thAkave|
evaM sei sakala lokake satarka karAra janya, yArA vale, AllAha kona santAna grahaNa karechena|

e viSaYe kona jJAnagata pramANa nA tAdera nijedera kAche Ache Ara nA tAdera vApa-dAdAdera kAche chila| eTA ati gurutara kathA, yA tAdera mukha theke vera hacche| tArA yA valache tA mithyA chAr3A kichui naYa|
(he navI! avasthA dRSTe mane haYa) tArA (kuraAnera) e vANIra prati ImAna nA Anale yena tumi AkSepa kare kare tAdera pechane nijera prANanAza kare vasave|
nizcita jena, bhUpRSThe yA-kichu Ache Ami seguloke tAra janya zobhAkara vAniYechi, mAnuSake e viSaYe parIkSA karAra janya ye, ke tAdera madhye vezi bhAlo kAja kare|
nizcaYai Ami bhUpRSThe yA-kichu Ache, ekadina tA samatala prAntare pariNata karava|
tumi ki mane kara guhA o rAkImavAsIrA AmAra nidarzanAvalIra madhye (vezi) vismaYakara chila?

eTA sei samaYera kathA, yakhana yuvaka dalaTi guhAYa AzraYa niYechila evaM (AllAha tAAlAra kAche du‘A kare) valechila, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera prati ApanAra nikaTa theke vizeSa rahamata nAyila karuna evaM AmAdera e paristhitite AmAdera janya kalyANakara pathera vyavasthA kare dina|
sutarAM Ami tAdera kAne cApar3a mere kaYeka vachara guhAra bhetara rAkhalAma|
tArapara tAderake jAgiYe dilAma, eTA lakSya karAra janya ye, tAdera dui dalera madhye kona dala nijedera ghume thAkAra meYAdakAla saThikabhAve nirNaYa karate pAre|
Ami tomAra kAche tAdera ghaTanA yathAyathabhAve varNanA karachi| tArA chila ekadala yuvaka, yArA nija pratipAlakera prati ImAna enechila evaM Ami tAderake hidAYAte prabhUta utkarSa dAna karechilAma|

Ami tAdera antara sudRr3ha kare diYechilAma| eTA sei samaYera kathA, yakhana tArA (rAjAra sAmanei) dA~r3Ala evaM valala, AmAdera pratipAlaka tinii, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra mAlika| AmarA tAke chAr3A anya kAuke mAvuda vale kakhanai DAkava nA| tAhale to AmarA carama avAstava kathAi valava|

ei AmAdera sampradAYera lokajana tA~ra parivarte Arao vahu mAvuda vAniYe niYeche| (tAdera vizvAsa satya hale) tArA nija mAvudadera sapakSe spaSTa kona pramANa upasthita kare nA kena? ye vyakti AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre?

(sAthI vandhurA!) tomarA yakhana vicchinna haYe gele tAdera theke evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdata kare tAdera thekeo, takhana calo, oi guhAYa AzraYa grahaNa kara| tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera janya nija rahamata vistAra kare devena evaM tomAdera viSaYaTA yAte sahaja haYa sei vyavasthA kare devena|

(se guhATi emana chila ye,) tumi sUryake tAra udaYakAle dekhate pete tA tAdera guhAra DAna dika theke sare cale yAYa evaM astakAle vA dika theke tAra pAza keTe yAYa| Ara tArA chila guhAra prazasta aMze (zAYita)| esava AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra antarbhukta| AllAha yAke hidAYAta dena, se-i hidAYAtaprApta haYa Ara yAke tini pathabhraSTa karena tumi kakhanai tAra emana kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA, ye tAke satpathe Anave|

(tAdera dekhale) tomAra mane hata tArA jAgrata, athaca tArA chila nidrita| Ami tAderake pArzva parivartana karAcchilAma DAne o vAme| Ara tAdera kukura guhAmukhe sAmanera pA du’Ti char3iYe (vasA) chila| tumi yadi tAderake u~ki mere dekhate, tave tumi tAdera theke pRSTha pradarzana kare pAlAte evaM tAdera bhaYe paripUrNarUpe bhIta haYe par3ate|

Ami (tAderake yemana nidrAcchanna karechilAma) ebhAvei tAderake jAgiYe dilAma, yAte tArA paraspare eke anyake jijJAsAvAda kare| tAdera madhye ekajana valala, tomarA e avasthAYa katakAla thekecha? keu keu valala, AmarA ekadina vA tAra kichu kama (ghume) theke thAkava| anyarA valala, tomAdera pratipAlakai bhAlo jAnena tomarA e avasthAYa katakAla thekecha| ekhana nijedera kona ekajanake rUpAra mudrA diYe nagare pAThAo| se giYe dekhuka tAra kona elAkAYa bhAlo khAdya Ache evaM sekhAna theke tomAdera janya kichu khAvAra niYe Asuka| se yena satarkatAra sAthe kAja kare evaM se yena tomAdera samparke kAuke avahita hate nA deYa|

kenanA tArA (zaharavAsI) yadi tomAdera sandhAna peYe yAYa, tave tArA tomAderake pAthara mere hatyA karave athavA tomAderake tAdera dharme phire yete vAdhya karave| Ara tAhale tomarA kakhanao saphalatA lAbha karate pArave nA|

ebhAve Ami mAnuSera kAne tAdera saMvAda peৗ~chiYe dilAma, yAte tArA nizcitabhAve jAnate pAre AllAhara oYAdA satya evaM eTAo ye, kiYAmata avazyambhAvI, tAte kona sandeha nei| (ataHpara sei samaYao Asala) yakhana loke tAdera samparke nijedera madhye vitarka karachila| kichu loka valala, tAdera upara saudha nirmANa kara| tAdera pratipAlakai tAdera viSaYe bhAlo jAnena| (zeSa paryanta) tAdera viSaYe yAdera mata pravala hala, tArA valala, AmarA avazyai tAdera upara ekaTi masajida nirmANa karava|

kichu loka valave, tArA chila tinajana Ara caturthaTi tAdera kukura| kichu loka valave, tArA chila pA~cajana Ara SaSThaTi tAdera kukura| esavai tAdera andhakAre Dhila cheA~r3A jAtIYa kathA| kichu loka valave, tArA chila sAtajana, Ara aSTamaTi chila tAdera kukura| vale dAo AmAra pratipAlakai tAdera prakRta saMkhyA bhAlo jAnena| alpa kichu loka chAr3A keu tAdera samparke puropuri jAne nA| sutarAM tAdera samparke sAdAmAThA kathAvArtAra vezi kichu AlocanA karo nA evaM tAdera samvandhe kAuke jijJAsAvAdao karo nA|
(he navI!) kona kAja samparkei kakhanao valo nA ‘Ami e kAja AgAmIkAla karava’|

tave (valo) AllAha yadi cAna (tave karava)| Ara kakhanao bhule gele nija pratipAlakake smaraNa kara evaM vala, Ami AzA kari AmAra pratipAlaka emana konao viSaYera prati AmAke pathanirdeza karavena, yA era ceYeo hidAYAtera vezi nikaTavartI have|
tArA (arthAt AsahAve kAhapha) tAdera guhAYa tinaza’ vachara evaM atirikta naYa vachara (nidrita avasthAYa) chila|

(keu yadi e niYe vitarke lipta haYa, tave) vala, AllAhai bhAlo jAnena, tArA katakAla (ghumiYe) chila| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra yAvatIYa gupta jJAna tA~rai Ache| tini kata uttama draSTA! kata uttama zrotA! tini vyatIta tAdera Ara kona abhibhAvaka nei| tini nija kartRtve kAuke zarIka karena nA|

(he navI!) tomAra kAche tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke ye ohI pAThAno haYeche, tA par3e zonAo| emana keu nei ye tA~ra vANI parivartana karate pAre evaM tumi tA~ke chAr3A anya konao AzraYasthala pAve nA kakhanai|

dhairya-sthairyera sAthe nijeke sei sakala lokera saMsarge rAkha yArA sakAla o sandhyAYa nijedera pratipAlakake e kAraNe DAke ye, tArA tA~ra santuSTi kAmanA kare| pArthiva jIvanera saundarya kAmanAYa tomAra dRSTi yena tAdera theke sare nA yAYa| emana kona vyaktira kathA mAnave nA, yAra antarake Ami AmAra smaraNa theke gAphela kare rekhechi, ye nija kheYAla-khuzIra pechane par3e raYeche evaM yAra kAryakalApa sImA chAr3iYe geche|

vale dAo, tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke to satya ese geche| ekhana yAra icchA ImAna Anuka evaM yAra icchA kuphara avalamvana karuka| Ami jAlemadera janya Aguna prastuta kare rekhechi, yAra prAcIra tAderake veSTana kare rAkhave| tArA pAni cAile tAderake telera talAnI sadRza pAnIYa deoYA have, yA tAdera cehArA jhalase deve| katai nA manda se pAnIYa evaM katai nA nikRSTa vizrAmasthala!
tave yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tArA nizcita thAkuka, Ami satkarmazIladera karmaphala naSTa kari nA|

tAderai janya raYeche sthAYIbhAve thAkAra udyAna, tAdera nice nahara pravahamAna thAkave| tAderake sekhAne svarNakaGkane alaMkRta karA have| Ara tArA ucca Asane helAna deoYA avasthAYa mihi o puru savuja rezamI kApar3a parihita thAkave| katai nA utkRSTa pratidAna evaM kata sundara vizrAmasthala|

(he navI!) tAdera sAmane sei dui vyaktira upamA peza kara, yAdera ekajanake Ami AGgurera du’Ti vAgAna diYechilAma evaM se du’Tike khejura gAcha dvArA gherAo diYe rekhechilAma Ara vAgAna du’Tira mAjhakhAnake zasyakSetra vAniYechilAma|
ubhaYa vAgAna paripUrNa phala dAna karata evaM tAte kona truTi karata nA| Ami vAgAna du’Tira mAjhakhAne ekaTi nahara pravAhita karechilAma|
sei vyaktira pracura dhana-sampada arjita hala| ataHpara se kathAcchale tAra saGgIke valala, AmAra artha-sampadao tomAra ceYe vezi evaM AmAra dalavalao tomAra ceYe zaktizAlI|
nija sattAra prati se juluma karachila Ara e avasthAYa se tAra vAgAne praveza karala| se valala, Ami mane kari nA e vAgAna kakhanao dhvaMsa have|
AmAra dhAraNA kiYAmata kakhanai have nA| Ara AmAke AmAra pratipAlakera kAche yadi phiriYe neoYA haYa, tave Ami nizcita (sekhAne) Ami era ceYeo utkRSTa sthAna pAva|

tAra sAthI kathAcchale tAke valala, tumi ki sei sattAra sAthe kupharI AcaraNa karacha, yini tomAke sRSTi karechena mATi hate, tArapara zukra hate evaM tArapara tomAke ekajana sustha-savala mAnuSe pariNata karechena?
AmAra vyApAre to ei ye, Ami vizvAsa kari AllAhai AmAra pratipAlaka evaM Ami AmAra pratipAlakera sAthe kAuke zarIka mAni nA|

tumi yakhana nija vAgAne praveza karachile, takhana tumi kena valale nA ‘mA-zA-AllAha, lA-kuuoYAtA illA villAha (AllAha yA cAna tAi haYa| AllAhara tAophIka chAr3A kArao kona kSamatA nei)| tomAra dRSTite yadi AmAra sampada o santAna tomA apekSA kama haYe thAke,

tave AmAra pratipAlakera pakSe asambhava naYa ye, tini AmAke tomAra vAgAna apekSA utkRSTa jinisa dAna karavena evaM tomAra vAgAne AsamAna theke kona vAlA pAThAvena, phale tA taruhIna prAntare pariNata have|
athavA tAra pAni bhUgarbhe neme yAve, ataHpara tumi tAra sandhAna lAbhe sakSama have nA|

(ataHpara ei ghaTala ye,) tAra samudaYa sampada AyAvaveSTita haYe gela evaM tAra bhora hala emana avasthAYa ye, vAgAne yA-kichu vyaYa karechila tajjanya zudhu AkSepa karate lAgala yakhana tAra vAgAna mAcAnasaha bhUmisAt haYechila| se valachila, hAYa! Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera sAthe kAuke zarIka nA karatAma!
Ara AllAha chAr3A tAra emana kona dalavala milala nA, yArA tAke sAhAyya karate pAre Ara se nijeo nijeke rakSA karate samartha chila nA|
erUpa paristhitite (mAnuSa upalavdhi karate pAre) sAhAyya karAra kSamatA kevala parama satya AllAharai Ache| tinii uttama puraskAra dAna karena evaM uttama pariNAma pradarzana karena|

tAdera kAche pArthiva jIvanera ei upamAo peza kara ye, tA pAnira mata, yA Ami AkAza theke varSaNa kari, phale bhUmija udbhida nivir3a ghana haYe yAYa, tArapara tA emana cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe yAYa, yA vAtAsa ur3iYe niYe yAYa| AllAha sarva viSaYe paripUrNa kSamatA rAkhena|
sampada o santAna pArthiva jIvanera zobhA| tave ye satkarma sthAYI, tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa tA saoYAvera dika thekeo utkRSTa evaM AzA poSaNera dika thekeo utkRSTa|
evaM (sei dinakeo smaraNa rAkha) ye dina Ami parvatasamUha saJcAlita karava evaM tumi pRthivIke dekhave unmukta par3e Ache evaM Ami tAdera sakalake ekatra karava, tAdera kAuke chAr3ava nA|

sakalake tomAra pratipAlakera sAmane sArivaddhabhAve upasthita karA have| (tAderake valA have) tomAderake Ami prathamavAra yebhAve sRSTi karechilAma, parizeSe sebhAvei tomarA AmAra kAche cale esecha| athaca tomAdera dAvI chila Ami tomAdera janya (ei) nirdhArita kAla kakhanai upasthita karava nA|

Ara ‘AmalanAmA’ sAmane rekhe deoYA have| takhana tumi aparAdhIderake dekhave, tAte yA (lekhA) Ache, tAra kAraNe tArA AtaGkita evaM tArA valache, hAYa! AmAdera durbheAga! eTA kemana kitAva, yA AmAdera choTa-var3a yata karma Ache, savai puGkhAnupuGkha hisAva kare rekheche, tArA tAdera samasta kRtakarma sAmane upasthita pAve| tomAra pratipAlaka kArao prati kona juluma karavena nA|

sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valechilAma, Adamera sAmane sijadA kara| takhana sakalei sijadA karala eka ivalIsa chAr3A| se chila jinadera ekajana| se tAra pratipAlakera hukuma amAnya karala| tAraparao ki tomarA AmAra parivarte tAke o tAra vaMzadharaderake nijedera abhibhAvaka vAnAccha, athaca tArA tomAdera zatru? jAlimadera janya (eTA) katai nA nikRSTa vadala!
Ami AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikAleo tAderake hAjira karini Ara khoda tAderake sRSTi karAra samaYao nA| Ami emana nai ye, pathabhraSTakArIderake nijera sahayogI vAnAva|

evaM sei dinake smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha (muzarikaderake) valavena, tomarA yAderake AmAra prabhutvera zarIka mane karacha tAderake DAka| sutarAM tArA DAkave| kintu tArA tAderake kona sAr3A deve nA| Ami tAdera mAjhakhAne rekhe deva eka dhvaMsakara antarAla|
aparAdhIrA Aguna dekhe vujhate pArave, tAderake tAte patita hate have| tArA tA theke paritrANera kona patha pAve nA|
Ami mAnuSera upakArArthe ei kuraAne sava rakama viSaYavastu vibhinnabhAve vivRta karechi, kintu mAnuSa sarvApekSA vezi tarkapriYa|

mAnuSera kAche yakhana hidAYAta ese geche, takhana ImAna AnaYana o nijedera pratipAlakera kAche kSamA prArthanA hate tAderake e chAr3A (arthAt, ei dAvI chAr3A) anya kichui virata rAkhache nA ye, tAdera kSetreo pUrvavartIdera anurUpa ghaTanA ghaTuka athavA AyAva tAdera ekevAre sAmane ese yAka|

Ami rAsUlagaNake to pAThAi kevala (muminadera janya) susaMvAdadAtA evaM (kAphiradera janya) satarkakArIrUpe| yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA mithyAke AzraYa kare vitaNDAYa lipta haYa tAra dvArA satyake TaliYe deoYAra lakSye| tArA AmAra AYAtasamUha evaM ye samparke tAderake satarka karA haYeche tAke ThATTAra viSaYa vAniYe niYeche|

sei vyakti apekSA var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre, yAke tAra pratipAlakera AYAtasamUhera mAdhyame upadeza deoYA hale se tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa evaM nija kRtakarmasamUha bhule yAYa? vastuta Ami (tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe) tAdera antarera upara gherATopa lAgiYe diYechi, yaddaruNa tArA e kuraAna vujhate pAre nA evaM tAdera kAne chipi e~Te diYechi| sutarAM tumi tAderake hidAYAtera dike DAkaleo tArA kakhanao satpathe Asave nA|

tomAra pratipAlaka ati kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa| tini yadi tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera janya pAkar3Ao karate cAitena, tave tAderake acirei zAsti ditena, kintu tAdera janya raYeche eka sthirIkRta samaYa, yA theke niSkRti lAbhera janya tArA kona AzraYasthala pAve nA|
oisava janapada (yA tomAdera sAmane raYeche) Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare dei, yakhana tArA juluma avalamvana karala| tAdera dhvaMsera janya (-o) Ami ekaTi samaYa sthira karechilAma|
evaM (sei samaYera vRttAnta zona) yakhana mUsA tAra yuvaka (ziSya)ke valechila, Ami dui sAgarera saGgamasthale nA peৗ~chA paryanta calatei thAkava athavA Ami calate thAkava vacharera para vachara|
sutarAM tArA yakhana dui sAgarera saGgamasthale peৗ~chala, takhana ubhaYei tAdera mAchera kathA bhule gela| seTi sAgarera bhetara sur3aGgera mata patha tairi kare nila|
tArapara tArA yakhana se sthAna atikrama kare gela, takhana mUsA tAra (saGgI) yuvakake valala, AmAdera nAzatA lao| satyi valate ki, e saphare AmarA var3a klAnta haYe par3echi|

se valala, Apani ki jAnena (kI Ajava kANDa ghaTeche?) AmarA yakhana pAtharera cA~iYera upara vizrAma karachilAma, takhana mAchaTira kathA (ApanAke valate) bhule giYechilAma| seTira kathA valate zaYatAnai AmAke bhuliYe diYechila| Ara seTi (arthAt mAchaTi) atyanta AzcaryajanakabhAve sAgare nijera patha kare niYechila|
mUsA valala, AmarA to eTAi sandhAna karachilAma| ataeva tArA tAdera padacihna dhare phire calala|
anantara tArA AmAra vAndAdera madhya hate eka vAndAra sAkSAta pela, yAke Ami AmAra vizeSa rahamata dAna karechilAma evaM AmAra pakSa hate zikSA diYechilAma eka vizeSa jJAna|
mUsA tAke valala, Ami ki ei lakSe ApanAra anugamana karate pAri ye, ApanAke ye kalyANakara jJAna deoYA haYeche tA theke khAnikaTA AmAke zekhAvena?
se valala, Ami nizcita AmAra saGge thAkAra dhairya Apani rakSA karate pAravena nA|
Ara ye viSaYe Apani paripUrNa jJAta nana, tAte Apani dhairya rAkhavenai vA kibhAve|
mUsA valala, inazAAllAha Apani AmAke dhairyazIlai pAvena evaM Ami ApanAra kona hukuma amAnya karava nA|
se valala, AcchA! Apani yadi AmAra saGge calena, tave yatakSaNa nA Ami nije kona viSaYa ApanAke khule vali, tatakSaNa paryanta se viSaYe Apani AmAke kona prazna karavena nA|

tArapara tArA calate zuru karala| eka paryAYe tArA yakhana ekaTi naukAYa car3ala, takhana se naukATi phu~To kare dila| mUsA valala, Are! Apani eTi phu~To kare dilena era yAtrIderake DuviYe deoYAra janya? Apani to ekaTA vipajjanaka kAja karalena?
se valala, Ami ki valini AmAra saGge theke Apani dhairya rAkhate pAravena nA?
mUsA valala, AmAra dvArA ye bhula haYe geche, tAra janya AmAke dharavena nA evaM AmAra kAjake vezi kaThina karavena nA|

ataHpara tArA AvAra calate zuru karala| calate calate yakhana ekaTi vAlakera saGge tAdera sAkSAta hala takhana vAlakaTike se hatyA kare phelala| mUsA valala, Apani ki ekaTA nirdeASa jIvana nAza karalena, ye kinA kArao jIvana nAza kareni? Apani khuvai anyAYa kAja karechena!
se valala, Ami ki ApanAke valini, Apani AmAra sAthe thAkAra dhairya rAkhate pAravena nA?
mUsA valala, erapara yadi ApanAke kona kathA jijJesa kari, tave Apani AmAke Ara sAthe rAkhavena nA| nizcaYai Apani AmAra dika theke ojarera zeSa sImAYa peৗ~che gechena|

ataHpara tArA calate thAkala| calate calate yakhana eka janapadavAsIra kAche peৗ~chala, takhana tAdera kAche khAvAra cAila| kintu janapadavAsI tAdera mehamAnadArI karate asvIkAra karala| ataHpara tArA sekhAne patanonmukha prAcIra dekhate pela| prAcIraTi se khAr3A kare dila| mUsA valala, Apani icchA karale e kAjera janya kichu pArizramika nite pAratena|
se valala, evAra AmAra o ApanAra madhye vicchedera samaYa ese geche| sutarAM yesava viSaYe Apani dhairya dharate pArenani, ekhana Ami ApanAke tAra rahasya vale dicchi|

naukATira vyApAra to ei, seTi chila kaYekajana garIva lokera, yArA sAgare kAja karata| Ami seTike truTiyukta kare dite cAilAma| (kenanA) tAdera sAmane chila eka rAjA, ye valapraYoge sava (bhAlo) naukA ker3e nita|
Ara vAlakaTira vyApAra ei, tAra pitA-mAtA chila mumina| AmAra AzaGkA hala, se kinA tAderake avAdhyatA o kupharIte phA~siYe deYa|
tAi Ami cAilAma tAdera pratipAlaka yena tAdera ei vAlakaTira parivarte emana eka santAna dAna karena, ye pavitratAYa era ceYe utkRSTa evaM sadAcaraNeo vezi agragAmI have|

vAki thAkala prAcIraTi| to eTi chila ei zahare vasavAsakArI dui iYAtImera| era nice tAdera guptadhana chila evaM tAdera pitA chila ekajana satloka| sutarAM ApanAra pratipAlaka cAilena chele du’To prAptavaYase upanIta hoka evaM nijedera guptadhana vera kare nika| esava ApanAra pratipAlakera rahamatei ghaTeche| Ami kona kAjai managar3AbhAve karini| Apani yesava vyApAre dhairya dhAraNa karate pArenani, ei hala tAra vyAkhyA|
tArA tomAke yulakAranAina samparke jijJesa kare| vale dAo, ‘Ami tAra kichuTA vRttAnta tomAderake par3e zonAcchi|
nizcaYai Ami pRthivIte tAke kSamatA dAna karechilAma evaM tAke savakichura upakaraNa diYechilAma|
phale se ekaTi pathera anugAmI hala|

yete yete yakhana sUryAstera sthAne peৗ~chala, takhana se dekhate pela, seTi eka kardamAkta (kAlo) jalAdhAre asta yAcche evaM sekhAne se ekaTi sampradAYera sAkSAta pela| Ami valalAma, he yulakAranAina! (tomAra sAmane duTi patha Ache|) haYa tumi tAderake zAsti deve, naYata tAdera vyApAre uttama vyavasthA grahaNa karave|
se valala, tAdera madhye ye-keu sImAlaMghana karave tAke Ami zAsti deva| tArapara tAke tAra pratipAlakera kAche peৗ~chAno have evaM tini tAke kaThina zAsti devena|
tave ye ImAna Anave o satkAja karave, se uttama pratidAnera upayukta have evaM Amio Adeza dAna kAle tAke sahaja kathA valava|
tArapara se Areka patha dhare calala|

calate calate yakhana sUryeAdaYera sthAne peৗ~chala, takhana se dekhala seTi udaYa hacche emana eka jAtira upara, yAdera janya Ami tA theke (arthAt tAra roda theke) vA~cAra kona antarAlera vyavasthA karini|
ghaTanA emanai ghaTala| yulakAranAinera kAche yA-kichu (upakaraNa) chila se samparke Ami pUrNa avagata chilAma|
tArapara se Areka patha dhare calala|
calate calate yakhana du’Ti pAhAr3era madhyavartI sthAne peৗ~chala, takhana se pAhAr3era kAche emana eka jAtira sAkSAta pela, yArA tAra kona kathA yena vujhate pArachila nA|

tArA valala, he yulakAranAina! iYAjuja o mAjuja e deze viparyaYa sRSTi kare ver3AYa| AmarA ki ApanAke kichu kara deva, yAra vinimaYe Apani AmAdera o tAdera mAjhakhAne ekaTi prAcIra nirmANa kare devena?

yulakAranAina valala, AllAha AmAke ye kSamatA diYechena seTAi (AmAra janya) zreYa| sutarAM tomarA (tomAdera hAta-pAYera) zakti dvArA AmAke sahayogitA kara| Ami tomAdera o tAdera madhye ekaTi majavuta prAcIra gar3e deva|

tomarA AmAke lohAra piNDa ene dAo| avazeSe se yakhana (mAjhakhAnera phA~kA pUrNa kare) ubhaYa pAhAr3era cUr3A paraspara varAvara kare miliYe dila, takhana valala, evAra Agune hAoYA dAo| yakhana seTike (prAcIra) jvalanta kaYalAYa pariNata karala, takhana valala, tomarA galita tAmA niYe eso| Ami tA era upara Dhele deva|
(ebhAve prAcIraTi nirmita haYe gela) phale iYAjuja mAjuja nA tAte car3ate sakSama hacchila Ara nA tAte phokara vAnAte pArachila|

yulakAranAina valala, eTA AmAra ravera rahamata (ye, tini e rakama ekaTA prAcIra vAnAnora tAophIka diYechena)| ataHpara AmAra ravera pratizruta samaYa yakhana Asave, takhana tini e prAcIraTi dhvaMsa kare mATira sAthe miziYe devena| AmAra pratipAlakera pratizruti nizcita satya|
se dina Ami tAdera avasthA emana kare deva ye, tArA taraGgera mata eke anyera upara Achar3e par3ave evaM ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have| ataHpara Ami tAdera sakalake ekatra karava|
se dina Ami jAhAnnAmake kApheradera sAmane sarAsaribhAve upasthita karava
(duniYAYa) yAdera cokhe AmAra nidarzana samvandhe pardA par3e raYechila evaM yArA zunateo sakSama chila nA|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA ki eraparao mane kare ye, tArA AmAra parivarte AmArai vAndAderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karave? nizcaYai Ami erUpa kApheradera ApyAYanera janya jAhAnnAma prastuta rekhechi|
vale dAo, Ami ki tomAderake vale deva, karme kArA sarvApekSA vezi kSatigrasta?
tArA sei sava loka, pArthiva jIvane yAdera samasta daur3a-jhA~pa sarala patha theke vicyuta haYeche, athaca tArA mane kare tArA khuvai bhAlo kAja karache|

erAi sei sava loka, yArA nija pratipAlakera AYAtasamUha o tA~ra sAmane upasthitira viSaYaTike asvIkAra kare| phale tAdera yAvatIYa karma niSphala haYe geche| Ami kiYAmatera dina tAdera kona ojana gaNya karava nA|
jAhAnnAmarUpe eTAi tAdera zAsti| kenanA tArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha o AmAra rAsUlagaNake parihAsera vastu vAniYeche|
(apara dike) yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAdera ApyAYanera janya avazyai phiradAusera udyAna raYeche|
tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave (evaM) tArA sekhAna theke anya kothAo yete cAive nA|

(he navI! mAnuSake) vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlakera kathA lekhAra janya yadi sAgara kAli haYe yAYa, tave AmAra pratipAlakera kathA zeSa haoYAra Agei sAgara niHzeSa haYe yAve, tAte sAhAyyarUpe anurUpa Arao sAgara niYe Asi nA kena!

vale dAo, Ami to tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSai| (tave) AmAra prati ei ohI Ase ye, tomAdera mAvuda kevala ekai mAvuda| sutarAM ye-keu nija mAlikera sAthe milita haoYAra AzA rAkhe, se yena satkarma kare evaM nija mAlikera ivAdate anya kAuke zarIka nA kare|
kApha-hA-iYA-‘Aina-sAda|
eTA sei rahamatera varNanA, yA tomAra pratipAlaka nija vAndA yAkAriYAra prati karechilena|
yakhana se nija pratipAlakake Dekechila cupisAre|

se valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra asthirAji paryanta jIrNa haYe geche, mAthA vArdhakyajanita zubhratAYa ujjvalita haYe uTheche evaM he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami tomAra kAche prArthanA kare kakhanao vyarthakAma haini|
Ami AmAra para AmAra cAcAta bhAidera vyApAre zaGkA vodha karachi evaM AmAra strI vandhyA| sutarAM Apani ApanAra nikaTa theke AmAke emana eka uttarAdhikArI dAna karuna
ye AmArao uttarAdhikArI have evaM iYAkuva (AlAihisa sAlAma)-era uttarAdhikArao lAbha karave evaM he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAke emana vAnAna, ye (ApanAra nijerao) santuSTiprApta have|
(uttara Asala) he yAkAriYA! Ami tomAke ekaTi chelera susaMvAda dicchi, tAra nAma iYAhaiYA! Ami Age tAra samanAmadhArI kAuke sRSTi karini|
yAkAriYA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra kibhAve putra-santAna janma neve, yakhana AmAra strI vandhyA evaM Ami emana vArdhakye upanIta haYechi ye, AmAra deha zukiYe geche?
tini valalena, ebhAvei have| tomAra pratipAlaka valechena, eTA to AmAra pakSe mAmuli vyApAra| tAchAr3A era Age to Ami tomAkeo sRSTi karechi, yakhana tumi kichui chile nA|

yAkAriYA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra janya kona nidarzana sthira kare dina| tini valalena, tomAra nidarzana hala tumi sustha thAkA sattveo tina rAta paryanta mAnuSera sAthe kathA valate pArave nA|
sutarAM se ivAdatakhAnA theke vera haYe nija sampradAYera sAmane Asala evaM tAderake izArAYa hukuma dila, tomarA sakAla o sandhyAYa AllAhara tAsavIha (pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA) kara|

(ataHpara yakhana iYAhaiYA janmagrahaNa karala evaM se var3ao haYe gela, takhana Ami tAke valalAma) he iYAhaiYA! (AllAhara) kitAvake dRr3habhAve Akar3e dhara| Ami tAke tAra zaizavei jJAnavattA dAna karechilAma
evaM vizeSabhAve AmAra nijera pakSa theke hRdaYera komalatA o pavitratAo| Ara se chila var3ai parahejagAra|
evaM nija pitA-mAtAra khedamatagAra| se ahaMkArI o avAdhya chila nA|
evaM (AllAha tAAlAra pakSa hate) tAra prati sAlAma ye dina se janmagrahaNa kareche, ye dina tAra mRtyu have evaM ye dina se jIvita avasthAYa punarutthita have|
e kitAve mAraYAmera vRttAntao vivRta kara| sei samaYera vRttAnta, yakhana se tAra parivAravarga theke pRthaka haYe pUrva dikera eka sthAne cale gela|
tArapara se tAdera o nijera mAjhakhAne ekaTi pardA phele dila| e samaYa Ami tAra kAche AmAra rUha (arthAt ekajana phirizatA) pAThAlAma, ye tAra sAmane eka pUrNa mAnavAkRtite AtmaprakAza karala|
mAraYAma valala, Ami tomAra theke daYAmaYa AllAhara AzraYa grahaNa karachi yadi tumi AllAhake bhaYa kara (tave ekhAna theke sare yAo)|
phirizatA valala, Ami to tomAra pratipAlakera prerita (phirizatA Ara Ami esechi) tomAke eka pavitra putra dAna karAra janya|
mAraYAma valala, AmAra putra have kemana kare, yakhana AmAke kona puruSa sparza kareni evaM Ami nai kona vyabhicAriNI nArI?
