phirizatA valala, ebhAvei have| tomAra ravva valechena, AmAra pakSe eTA ekaTA mAmuli kAja| Ami eTA karava ejanya ye, tAke vAnAva mAnuSera janya (AmAra kudaratera) eka nidarzana o AmAra nikaTa hate rahamata| eTA sampUrNarUpe sthirIkRta haYe geche|
ataHpara ei ghaTala ye, mAraYAma sei zizuke garbhe dhAraNa karala (evaM yakhana janmera samaYa kAche ese gela) takhana se tAke niYe dUre eka nibhRta sthAne cale gela|
tArapara prasava-vedanA tAke ekaTi khejura gAchera kAche niYe gela| se valate lAgala, hAYa! Ami yadi era Agei mArA yetAma evaM sampUrNa vismRta-vilupta haYe yetAma!
takhana phirizatA tAra nice eka sthAna theke tAke DAka diYe valala, tumi duHkha karo nA, tomAra pratipAlaka tomAra nice ekaTi utsa sRSTi karechena|
evaM khejura gAchera DAlAke nijera dike nAr3A dAo, tA theke pAkA tAjA khejura tomAra upara jhare par3ave|

tArapara khAo o pAna kara evaM cokha jur3Ao, mAnuSera madhye kAuke Asate dekhale (izArAYa) vale dio, Aja Ami daYAmaYa AllAhara uddezye ekaTi rojA mAnata karechi| sutarAM Aja Ami kona mAnuSera sAthe kathA valava nA|
tArapara se zizuTi niYe nija sampradAYera kAche Asala| tArA vale uThala, mAraYAma! tumi to var3a khataranAka kAja karecha!
ohe hArUnera vona! tomAra pitAo kona khArApa loka chila nA evaM tomAra mAo chila nA asatI nArI|
takhana mAraYAma zizuTira dike izArA karalena| tArA valala, AmarA ei dolanAra zizura sAthe kibhAve kathA valava?
amani zizuTi vale uThala, Ami AllAhara vAndA| tini AmAke kitAva diYechena evaM navI vAniYechena|
evaM Ami yekhAnei thAki nA kena AmAke varakatamaYa karechena evaM yata dina jIvita thAki AmAke nAmAya o yAkAta AdAYera hukuma diYechena|
evaM AmAke AmAra mAYera prati anugata vAniYechena| AmAke uddhata o rUr3ha vAnAnani|
evaM (AllAha tAAlAra pakSa hate) AmAra prati sAlAma ye dina Ami janmagrahaNa karechi, ye dina AmAra mRtyu have evaM ye dina AmAke punarAYa jIvita kare oThAno have|
ei hala mAraYAmera putra IsA| tAra (prakRta avasthA) samparke eTAi satya kathA, ye samparke tArA tarka-vitarka karache|
eTA AllAhara zAna naYa ye, tini kona putra grahaNa karavena| tA~ra sattA pavitra| tini yakhana kona viSaYe siddhAnta sthira karena, takhana kevala valena, ‘haYe yAo’| amani tA haYe yAYa|
(he navI! mAnuSake) vale dAo, nizcaYai AllAha AmAra pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka| sutarAM tomarA tA~ra ivAdata kara| eTAi sarala patha|
tA sattveo tAdera vibhinna dala vibhinna mata sRSTi kareche| sutarAM yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche mahAdivasa pratyakSa karAra dina tAdera janya raYeche dhvaMsa|
ye dina tArA AmAra kAche Asave se dina tArA katainA zunave evaM katainA dekhave! kintu jAlemagaNa Aja spaSTa gomarAhIte nipatita|
(he navI!) tAderake AkSepera dina samparke satarka karuna, ye dina sakala viSaYe cUr3Anta phAYasAlA haYe yAve, athaca mAnuSa gAphalatite par3e Ache evaM tArA ImAna Anache nA|
nizcaYai pRthivI evaM era upara yArA Ache, sakalera oYAriza hava Amii evaM AmArai kAche tAdera sakalake phiriYe AnA have|
e kitAve ivarAhImera vRttAntao vivRta kara| nizcaYai se chila satyaniSTha navI|
smaraNa kara, yakhana se nija pitAke valechila, AvvAjI! Apani emana jinisera ivAdata kena karena, yA kichu zone nA, dekhe nA evaM ApanAra kona kAjao karate pAre nA?
AvvAjI! AmAra nikaTa emana eka jJAna eseche yA ApanAra kAche Aseni| kAjei Apani AmAra kathA zununa, Ami ApanAke sarala patha vAtale deva|
AvvAjI! zaYatAnera ivAdata karavena nA| nizcaYai zaYatAna daYAmaYera avAdhya|
AvvAjI! AmAra AzaGkA daYAmaYera pakSa hate kona zAsti ApanAke sparza karave| phale Apani zaYatAnera saGgI haYe yAvena|

tAra pitA valala, ivarAhIma! tumi ki AmAra upAsyadera theke vimukha? tumi yadi era theke nivRtta nA hao, tave Ami avazyai tomAra upara pAthara nikSepa karava| Ara ekhana tumi ciradinera janya AmAra theke dUra haYe yAo|
ivarAhIma valala, ApanAra prati (vidAYI) sAlAma| Ami AmAra pratipAlakera kAche ApanAra mAgaphirAtera janya du‘A karava| niHsandehe tini AmAra prati atyanta daYAlu|

Ami ApanAdera thekeo pRthaka haYe yAcchi evaM ApanArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdata karena tAdera thekeo| Ami AmAra pratipAlakake DAkate thAkava| Ami paripUrNa AzAvAdI ye, Ami AmAra pratipAlakake Deke vyarthakAma hava nA|

sutarAM yakhana se tAdera theke evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAderake (arthAt yei pratimAderake) DAkata tAdera theke pRthaka haYe gela, takhana Ami tAke isahAka o iYAkuva (-era mata santAna) dAna karalAma evaM tAdera pratyekake navI vAnAlAma|
evaM tAderake dAna karalAma AmAra rahamata Ara tAdera dilAma samucca sukhyAti|
e kitAve mUsAra vRttAntao vivRta kara| nizcaYai se chila AllAhara manonIta vAndA evaM (tA~ra) rAsUla o navI|
Ami tAke tUra pAhAr3era DAna dika theke DAka dilAma evaM tAke AmAra antaraGgarUpe naikaTya dAna karalAma|
Ara Ami nija rahamate tAke dAna karalAma tAra bhAi hArUnake navIrUpe|
evaM e kitAve isamAIlera vRttAntao vivRta kara| nizcaYai se chila pratizrutira kSetre satyavAdI evaM rAsUla o navI|
se nija parivAravargake sAlAta o yAkAta AdAYera hukuma karata evaM se chila nija pratipAlakera santoSabhAjana|
e kitAve idarIsera vRttAntao vivRta kara| nizcaYai se chila ekajana satyaniSTha navI!
Ami tAke eka ucca maryAdAYa unnIta karechilAma|

Adamera vaMzadharadera madhye erAi sei sakala navI, yAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechena| edera katipaYa sei sava lokera vaMzadhara, yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe (naukAYa) ArohaNa kariYechilAma evaM katipaYa ivarAhIma o isarAIla (arthAt hayarata iYAkuva AlAihisa sAlAma)-era vaMzadhara| Ami yAderake hidAYAta diYechilAma o (AmAra dInera janya) manonIta karechilAma, erA tAdera antarbhukta| tAdera sAmane yakhana daYAmaYa AllAhara AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA hata, takhana tArA kA~date kA~date sijadAYa luTiYe par3ata|
tArapara tAdera sthalAbhiSikta hala emana loka, yArA nAmAya naSTa karala evaM indriYa-cAhidAra anugAmI hala| sutarAM tArA acirei tAdera pathabhraSTatAra sAkSAta pAve|
avazya yArA tAovA kareche, ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tArA jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera prati vindumAtra juluma karA have nA|
(tArA praveza karave) emana sthAYI udyAnarAjite, daYAmaYa AllAha nija vAndAderake yAra pratizruti diYechena tAdera alakSye| nizcaYai tA~ra pratizruti emana ye, tArA se paryanta avazyai peৗ~chave|
tArA sekhAne zAntimUlaka kathA chAr3A kona vehudA kathA zunave nA evaM tArA sekhAne sakAla-sandhyAYa jIvikA lAbha karave|
eTAi sei jAnnAta yAra oYAriza vAnAva AmAra vAndAdera madhye yArA muttAkI tAderake|

(evaM pherezatAgaNa tomAke vale,) AmarA ApanAra pratipAlakera hukuma chAr3A avataraNa kari nA| yA-kichu AmAdera sAmane, yA-kichu AmAdera pichane evaM yA-kichu e du’Yera mAjhakhAne Ache, tA sava tA~rai mAlikAnAdhIna| tomAra pratipAlaka bhule yAoYAra nana|
tini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra mAlika evaM e du’Yera mAjhakhAne yA Ache tArao| sutarAM tumi tA~ra ivAdata kara evaM tA~ra ivAdate avicalita thAka| tomAra jAnA mate tA~ra samaguNasampanna keu Ache ki?
Ara mAnuSa (arthAt kApheragaNa) vale, AmAra yakhana mRtyu haYe yAve, takhana vAstavikai ki AmAke AvAra jIvitarUpe uThAno have?
mAnuSera ki smaraNa par3e nA ye, Ami tAke pUrve sRSTi karechi, yakhana se kichui chila nA?
sutarAM zapatha tomAra pratipAlakera| Ami tAderake tAdera zaYatAnaderasaha avazyai samaveta karava tArapara avazyai tAderake jAhAnnAmera AzepAze natajAnu avasthAYa upasthita karava|
tArapara tAdera pratyeka dalera madhye yArA daYAmaYa AllAhara avAdhyatAYa pracaNDatama, tAderake Tene vera karava|
Ara sei sakala loka samparke Amii bhAlo jAni, yArA jAhAnnAme peৗ~chAra vezi upayukta|
tomAdera madhye emana keu nei, ye tA (arthAt jAhAnnAma) atikrama karave nA| eTA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSe eka cUr3Anta siddhAnta|
ataHpara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche tAderake Ami niSkRti deva Ara jAlimaderake tAte (jAhAnnAme) mukha thuvar3Ano avasthAYa phele rAkhava|

tAdera sAmane yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa, takhana kApheragaNa muminaderake vale, vala, AmAdera e dui dalera madhye kona dala maryAdAYa zreSThatara evaM majalisa hiseve utkRSTa?
(tArA ki dekhe nA) tAdera Age Ami kata mAnavagoSThIke dhvaMsa karechi, yArA nijedera AsavAva-upakaraNa o vAhya Ar3amvare tAdera apekSA unnata chila|

vale dAo, yArA vibhrAntite patita, tAdera janya eTAi samIcIna ye, daYAmaYa AllAha tAderake pracura Dhila dite thAkavena| parizeSe tAderake ye viSaYe satarka karA hacche tA yakhana nijerA dekhe neve, tA zAsti hoka vA kiYAmata, takhana tArA jAnate pArave ke maryAdAYa nikRSTa evaM ke vAhinIra dika diYe vezi durvala|

Ara yArA sarala patha avalamvana kareche, AllAha tAderake hidAYAtera kSetre adhikatara utkarSa dAna karena evaM ye satkarma sthAYI, tomAra pratipAlakera kAche tA pratidAne utkRSTa evaM pariNAmeo zreSThatara|
tumi ki sei vyaktike dekhecha, ye AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare evaM vale (AkherAteo) AmAke avazyai sampada o santAna deoYA have|
tave ki se adRzya jagate u~ki mere dekheche, nA ki se daYAmaYa AllAhara theke kona pratizruti grahaNa kareche?
kakhanao naYa| se yA kichu valache Ami tAo likhe rAkhava evaM tAra zAsti Arao vRddhi kare deva|
evaM se yAra kathA valache, tAra (arthAt sei dhana o janera) oYAriza Amii hava| Ara se ekAkIi AmAra kAche Asave|
tArA AllAha chAr3A anyAnya mAvuda grahaNa kareche ejanya, yAte tArA tAdera sahAYaka hate pAre|
esava tAdera bhrAnta dhAraNA| tArA to tAdera ivAdatakei asvIkAra karave evaM ulTo tAdera virodhI haYe yAve|
(he navI!) tumi ki jJAta nao Ami kApheradera prati zaYatAnaderake cher3e diYechi, yArA tAderake avirata prarocanA deYa?
sutarAM tumi tAdera vyApAre tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| Ami to tAdera janya dinakSaNa guNachi|
(sei dinake bhulo nA) ye dina Ami muttAkIgaNake atithirUpe daYAmaYa (AllAha)-era kAche ekatra karava|
Ara aparAdhIderake pipAsArta avasthAYa hA~kiYe jAhAnnAmera dike niYe yAva|
mAnuSa kArao janya supAriza karAra kSamatA rAkhave nA, tArA chAr3A, yArA daYAmaYa (AllAha)-era nikaTa theke anumati lAbha kareche|
tArA vale, daYAmaYera putra Ache|
tomarA (yArA erUpa kathA valacha, tArA) prakRtapakSe ati gurutara kathAra avatAraNA karecha|
asambhava naYa era kAraNe AkAza pheTe yAve, bhUmi vidIrNa have evaM pAhAr3a bheGge-cure par3ave|
yehetu tArA daYAmaYera santAna Ache vale dAvI kare|
athaca eTA daYAmaYera zAna naYa ye, tAra santAna thAkave|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte emana keu nei, ye daYAmaYera daravAre vAndArUpe upasthita have nA|
nizcaYai tini sakalake veSTana kare rekhechena evaM tAderake bhAlobhAve guNe rekhechena|
kiYAmatera dina tAdera pratyeke tAra kAche ekAkI upasthita have|
(tave) yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche nizcaYai daYAmaYa (AllAha) tAdera janya sRSTi karavena bhAlovAsA|
sutarAM (he navI!) Ami e kuraAnake tomAra bhASAYa sahaja kare diYechi, yAte tumi era mAdhyame muttAkIderake susaMvAda dAo evaM era mAdhyamei vitaNDApravaNa lokaderake satarka kara|
tAdera Age Ami kata mAnava-goSThIkei dhvaMsa karechi| tumi ki hAtar3iYeo tAdera kArao sandhAna pAo kiMvA tumi ki tAdera kona sAr3A-zavda zunate pAo?
toYA-hA|
Ami tomAra prati kuraAna ejanya nAyila karini ye, tumi kaSTa bhoga karave|
varaM eTA sei vyaktira janya nasIhata, ye bhaYa kare
eTA sei sattAra pakSa hate alpa-alpa kare nAyila karA hacche, yini pRthivI o samucca AkAzamaNDalI sRSTi karechena|
tini ati daYAmaYa, Araze ‘isatiYAoYA’ grahaNa karechena|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, yA-kichu Ache e duYera mAjhakhAne| Ara yA-kichu bhU-garbhe Ache sava tA~rai mAlikAnAdhIna|
tomarA yadi kona kathA uccasvare vala (vA nimnasvare), tave tini to gupta o guptatama savai jAnena|
tinii AllAha, yini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| samasta uttama nAma tA~rai|
(he navI!) mUsAra vRttAnta ki tomAra kAche peৗ~cheche?

yakhana se eka Aguna dekhate peYe tAra parivAravargake valechila, tomarA ekhAne thAka| Ami eka Aguna dekhechi| sambhavata Ami tA theke tomAdera kAche kichu jvalanta aMgAra niYe Asate pArava kiMvA se Agunera kAche Ami pathera kona dizA peYe yAva|
yakhana se Agunera kAche peৗ~chala, DAka deoYA hala he mUsA!
nizcaYa Amii tomAra pratipAlaka| sutarAM tomAra jutA khule phela| kenanA tumi ekhana pavitra ‘tuoYA’ upatyakAYa raYecho|
Ami tomAke (navuoYAtera janya) manonIta karechi| sutarAM ohIra mAdhyame tomAke yA valA hacche manoyoga diYe zona|
nizcaYa Amii AllAha| Ami chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| sutarAM AmAra ivAdata kara evaM AmAra smaraNArthe nAmAya kAYema kara|
nizcaYai kiYAmata avazyai Asave| Ami tA (arthAt tAra samaYa) gopana rAkhate cAi| yAte pratyekei tAra kRtakarmera pratiphala lAbha kare|
sutarAM kiYAmate vizvAsa kare nA o nija pravRttira anusaraNa kare emana kona vyakti yena tomAke tA hate gAphela karate nA pAre| tA hale tumi dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
he mUsA! tomAra DAna hAte oTA kI?
mUsA valala, eTA AmAra lAThi| Ami ete bhara kari, era dvArA AmAra meSapAlera janya (gAcha theke) pAtA jhAr3i evaM era dvArA AmAra anyAnya praYojanao samAdhA haYa|
tini valalena, he mUsA! oTA nice phele dAo|
mUsA seTi phele dila| amani seTA dhAvamAna sApa haYe gela|
AllAha valalena, oTA dhara| bhaYa karo nA| Ami ekhanai oTA pUrvAvasthAYa phiriYe dicchi|
Ara tomAra hAta nija vagale rAkha| tA konarUpa roga chAr3A zubhra ujjvala haYe vera have| eTA have (tomAra navuoYAtera) Areka nidarzana|
(eTA karachi) AmAra var3a var3a nidarzana theke kichu tomAke dekhiYe deoYAra janya|
evAra phira‘Aunera kAche yAo| se avAdhyatAYa sImAlaMghana kareche|
mUsA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra vakSa khule dina|
evaM AmAra kAja sahaja kare dina|
evaM AmAra jihvA theke jar3atA dUra kare dina|
yAte mAnuSa AmAra kathA vujhate pAre|
AmAra svajanadera madhya hate ekajanake AmAra sahayogI vAniYe dina|
AmAra bhAi hArUnake|
tAra mAdhyame AmAra zakti dRr3ha karuna|
evaM tAke AmAra kAje zarIka vAniYe dina|
yAte AmarA vezi parimANe ApanAra tAsavIha karate pAri|
evaM vezi parimANe ApanAra yikira karate pAri|
niHsandehe Apani AmAdera samyaka draSTA|
AllAha valalena, he mUsA! tumi yA-kichu ceYecha tA tomAke deoYA hala|
evaM Ami to tomAra prati Arao ekavAra anugraha karechilAma|
yakhana Ami tomAra mAke ohIra mAdhyame valechilAma sei kathA, yA ekhana ohIra mAdhyame (tomAke) jAnAno hacche

tumi e (zizu)ke sindukera madhye rAkha| tArapara sindukaTi dariYAYa phele dAo| tArapara dariYA se sindukaTike tIre niYe phele deve| tAke tule neve AmAra eka zatru evaM tArao zatru| Ami AmAra pakSa hate tomAra prati bhAlovAsA varSaNa karechilAma Ara esava karechilAma ejanya, yAte tumi AmAra tattvAvadhAne pratipAlita hao|

sei samaYera kathA cintA kara, yakhana tomAra vona ghara theke vera haYe calache tArapara (phirAunera karmacArIderake) valache, Ami ki tomAderake emana kAro sandhAna deva, ye eke lAlana-pAlana karave? ebhAve Ami tomAke tomAra mAYera kAche phiriYe dilAma, yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa evaM se cintita nA thAke| tumi eka vyaktike mere phelechile| tArapara Ami tomAke se saMkaTa theke uddhAra kari| Ara Ami tomAke vibhinnabhAve parIkSA kari| tArapara tumi kaYeka vachara mAdaYAnavAsIdera madhye avasthAna karale| tArapara he mUsA! emana eka samaYa ekhAne Asale, yA pUrva thekei nirdhArita chila|
evaM Ami tomAke vizeSabhAve AmAra janya tairi karechi|
tumi o tomAra bhAi AmAra nidarzanasamUha niYe yAo evaM AmAra yikire zaithilya karo nA|
ubhaYe phira‘Aunera kAche yAo| se sImAlaMghana kareche|
tomarA giYe tAra sAthe namra kathA valave| haYata se upadeza grahaNa karave athavA (AllAhake) bhaYa karave|
tArA valala, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA AzaGkA kari se kinA AmAdera upara atyAcAra kare athavA sImAlaMghana karate udyata haYa|
AllAha valalena, bhaYa karo nA| Ami tomAdera saGge Achi| Ami zuni o dekhi|

sutarAM tomarA tAra kAche yAo evaM vala, AmarA tomAra pratipAlakera rAsUla| kAjei vanI isarAIlake AmAdera sAthe yete dAo evaM tAderake zAsti dio nA| AmarA tomAra kAche tomAra pratipAlakera nidarzana niYe esechi| Ara zAnti to tAderai prati, yArA hidAYAta anusaraNa kare|
AmAdera prati ohI nAyila karA haYeche ye, zAsti have sei vyaktira upara, ye (satyake) asvIkAra kare o mukha phiriYe neYa|
(esava kathA zune) phira‘Auna valala, he mUsA! tomAdera ravva ke?
mUsA valala, AmAdera ravva to tini, yini pratyekake tAra upayukta AkRti diYechena, tArapara tAra patha pradarzanao karechena|
phirAuna valala, tAhale pUrve yesava jAti gata haYeche tAdera avasthA kI?
mUsA valala, tAdera jJAna AmAra pratipAlakera kAche eka kitAve saMrakSita Ache| AmAra ravvera kona vibhrAnti dekhA deYa nA evaM tini bhuleo yAna nA|

tini sei sattA, yini pRthivIke tomAdera janya vichAnA vAniYechena, tAte tomAdera janya calAra patha diYechena evaM AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karechena| tArapara Ami tA dvArA vibhinna prakAra udbhida utpanna karechi|
tomarA nijerAo tA khAo evaM tomAdera gavAdi pazukeo carAo| nizcaYai esava viSaYera madhye vuddhimAnadera janya nidarzana Ache|
Ami tomAderake e mATi hatei sRSTi karechi, era madhye tomAderake phiriYe neva evaM punarAYa tomAderake erai madhya hate vera karava|
vastuta Ami tAke (arthAt phira‘Aunake) AmAra samasta nidarzana dekhiYechilAma, kintu se kevala asvIkArai kareche o amAnya kareche|
se valala, he mUsA! tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanyai esecha ye, tomAra yAdu dvArA AmAderake AmAdera bhUmi theke vera kare deve?

Thika Ache, AmarAo tomAra sAmane avazyai anurUpa yAdu upasthita karava| sutarAM AmAdera o tomAra madhye kona unmukta sthAne paraspare mukAvelA karAra janya ekaTA samaYa nirdiSTa kara, yAra vyatikrama AmarAo karava nA evaM tumio nA|
mUsA valala, ye dina Ananda udayApana karA haYa, tomAdera sAthe se dinai sthirIkRta raila evaM eTA sthira thAkala ye, dina car3e oThA mAtrai mAnuSake samaveta karA have|
ataHpara phira‘Auna (nija jAYagAYa) cale gela evaM se nija kauzalasamUha ekATTA karala| tArapara (mukAvelAra janya) upasthita hala|

mUsA tAderake (arthAt yAdukaraderake) valala, Aphasosa tomAdera prati! tomarA AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa karo nA| tA karale tini tomAderake kaThina zAsti dvArA nirmUla kare phelavena| Ara ye-keu mithyA Aropa kare, se nizcitabhAve vyarthakAma haYa|
era phale tAdera madhye nijedera karaNIYa viSaYe virodha dekhA dila| tArA cupisAre parAmarza karate lAgala|
(parizeSe) tArA valala, nizcaYai e du’jana (arthAt mUsA o hArUna) yAdukara| tArA cAYa tomAderake tomAdera bhUmi theke utkhAta karate evaM tomAdera utkRSTa (dharma) vyavasthAra vilopa ghaTAte|
sutarAM tomarA tomAdera kauzala saMhata kare nAo, tArapara sArivaddha haYe ese yAo| nizcita jena, Aja ye jaYI have sei saphalatA lAbha karave|
yAdukaragaNa valala, he mUsA! haYa tumi Age (nija lAThi) nikSepa kara athavA prathame AmarAi nikSepa kari|
mUsA valala, varaM tomarAi nikSepa kara| ataHpara tAdera yAdu kriYAYa haThAt mUsAra mane haYa, tAdera razi o lAThigulo choTAchuTi karache|
phale mUsA tAra antare kichuTA bhIti anubhava karala|
Ami valalAma, bhaYa karo nA| nizcita thAka tumii upare thAkave|

tomAra DAna hAte yA (arthAt ye lAThi) Ache, tA (mATite) nikSepa kara| seTi tArA ye kArasAji kareche tA grAsa kare phelave| tAdera yAvatIYa kArasAji to yAdukarera bhelki mAtra| yAdukara yekhAnei yAka, saphalakAma have nA|
sutarAM (tAi hala evaM) samasta yAdukarake sijadAYa pAtita karA hala| tArA valate lAgala AmarA hArUna o mUsAra pratipAlakera prati ImAna AnalAma|

phirAuna valala, Ami tomAderake anumati deoYAra Agei tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anale! AmAra vizvAsa sei (arthAt mUsA) tomAdera dalapati, ye tomAderake yAdu zikSA diYeche| sutarAM Amio saMkalpa sthira karechi tomAdera hAta-pA viparIta dika theke keTe phelava evaM tomAderake khejura gAchera kA-e zUle car3Ava| tomarA nizcitabhAve jAnate pArave AmAdera du’janera madhye kAra zAsti vezi kaThina o vezi sthAYI|

yAdukaragaNa valala, yini AmAderake sRSTi karechena sei sattAra kasama! AmAdera kAche ye ujjvala nidarzanAvalI eseche tAra upara AmarA tomAke kichutei prAdhAnya dite pArava nA| sutarAM tumi yA karate cAo kara| tumi yAi kara nA kena tA ei pArthiva jIvanei have|
AmarA to AmAdera pratipAlakera upara ImAna enechi, yAte tini kSamA kare dena AmAdera gunAhasamUha evaM tumi AmAderake ye yAdu karate vAdhya karecha tAo| AllAhai sarvazreSTha evaM cirasthAYI|
vastuta ye vyakti nija pratipAlakera kAche aparAdhI haYe Asave, tAra janya Ache jAhAnnAma, yAra bhetara se maraveo nA, vA~caveo nA|
ye vyakti tAra nikaTa mumina haYe Asave evaM se satkarmao kare thAkave, erUpa lokadera janyai raYeche samucca maryAdA
sthAYI udyAnarAji, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave| eTA ye pavitratA avalamvana kareche tAra puraskAra|

Ami mUsAra prati ohI nAyila karechilAma, tumi AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAtera velA raoYAnA haYe yAo| tArapara tAdera janya sAgarera bhetara emanabhAve zukano patha tairi kara, yAte pechana theke (zatru ese) tomAke dhare phelAra AzaGkA nA thAke evaM anya kona bhaYao nA thAke|
ataHpara phira‘Auna nija senAvAhinIsaha tAra pazcAddhAvana karale sAgarera ye (bhaYAla) jinisa tAke Acchanna karAra tA tAke Acchanna karala|
vastuta phira‘Auna tAra jAtike vipathagAmI karechila| se tAderake saThika patha dekhAYani|
he vanI isarAIla! Ami tomAderake tomAdera zatru theke mukti diYechilAma evaM tomAderake tUra pAhAr3era DAna pAze AsAra pratizruti diYechilAma| Ara tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechilAma mAnna o sAlaoYA|

ye pavitra riyaka Ami tomAderake diYechi tA hate khAo| tAte sImAlaMghana karo nA| tA karale tomAdera upara AmAra krodha varSita have| Ara AmAra krodha yAra upara varSita haYa se anivAryabhAve dhvaMsaprApta haYa|
Ara eTAo satya ye, ye vyakti ImAna Ane, satkarma kare ataHpara sarala pathe pratiSThita thAke Ami tAra pakSe parama kSamAzIla|
evaM (mUsA yakhana saGgera lokajanera Agei tUra pAhAr3e cale Asalena, takhana AllAha tAAlA tAke valalena,) he mUsA! tumi tAr3Ahur3A kare tomAra sampradAYera Age Age kena Asale?
se valala, oi to tArA AmAra pichanei Asala vale| he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami ApanAra kAche tAr3AtAr3i esechi ejanya, yAte Apani khuzI hana|
AllAha valalena, tomAra cale AsAra para Ami tomAra sampradAYake phitanAYa phelechi Ara sAmerI tAderake pathabhraSTa kare pheleche|

sutarAM mUsA kruddha o kSuvdha haYe nija sampradAYera kAche phire Asala| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera pratipAlaka ki tomAderake ekaTi uttama pratizruti denani? tArapara ki tomAdera upara diYe dIrghakAla atikrAnta haYeche? nA ki tomarA cAcchile tomAdera upara tomAdera pratipAlakera krodha varSita hoka Ara se kAraNe tomarA AmAra sAthe oYAdA bhaGga karecha?

tArA valala, AmarA ApanAra sAthe svecchAYa oYAdA bhaGga karini| varaM vyApAra ei ye, AmAdera upara mAnuSera alaMkArera vojhA cApAno chila| AmarA tA phele dei| tArapara ekaibhAve sAmerIo (kichu) phele|
tArapara se tAdera janya vera karala ekaTi vAchura ekaTi dehakAThAmo yAra chila hAmvA dhvani| tArA valala, ei to tomAdera mAvuda evaM mUsArao mAvuda, kintu mUsA bhule giYeche|
tave ki tAdera najare Aseni ye, tA tAdera kathAYa sAr3A deYa nA evaM tAdera kona apakAra vA upakAra karArao kSamatA rAkhe nA?

hArUna tAderake Agei valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAderake era (arthAt ei vAchuraTira) dvArA parIkSAYa phelA haYeche| prakRtapakSe tomAdera ravva to rahamAna| sutarAM tomarA AmAra anusaraNa kara evaM AmAra Adeza mene cala|
tArA valala, yatakSaNa paryanta mUsA phire nA Ase, AmarA era pUjAYa rata thAkava|
mUsA (phire ese) valala, he hArUna! tumi yakhana dekhale tArA vipathagAmI haYe geche, takhana kona jinisa tomAke nivRtta rekhechila
ye, tumi AmAra anusaraNa karale nA? tave ki tumi AmAra Adeza amAnya karale?

hArUna valala, ohe AmAra mAYera putra! AmAra dAr3i dharo nA evaM AmAra mAthAo naYa| Asale Ami AzaGkA karachilAma tumi valave, ‘tumi vanI isarAIlera madhye vibheda sRSTi karecha evaM AmAra kathA Amale nAoni|
mUsA valala, tA he sAmerI! tomAra vyApAra kI?

se valala, Ami emana ekaTA jinisa dekhechilAma, yA anyadera najare par3eni| tAi Ami rAsUlera padacihna theke ekamuTho tule niYechilAma| seTAi Ami (vAchurera mukhe) phele dei| AmAra mana AmAke emanai kichu vujhiYechila|

mUsA valala, tumi cale yAo| jIvanabhara tomAra kAja have mAnuSake ei valate thAkA ye, ‘AmAke chu~Yo nA’| (tAchAr3A) tomAra janya Ache eka pratizruta kAla, yA tomAra theke TalAno yAve nA| tumi tomAra ei (alIka) mAvudake dekha, yAra pUjAYa tumi jame vasechile, AmarA eke jvAliYe deva| tArapara eke gu~r3o kare sAgare chiTiYe deva|
prakRtapakSe tomAdera sakalera mAvuda to kevala eka AllAhai, yini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tA~ra jJAna sava kichuke veSTana kare Ache|
(he navI!) Ami ebhAve atIte yA ghaTeche tAra kichu saMvAda tomAke avahita kari Ara Ami tomAke AmAra nikaTa theke dAna karechi eka upadezavANI|
yArA era theke mukha phiriYe neve kiYAmatera dina tArA vahana karave masta vojhA|
yAra (zAstira) bhetara tArA sarvadA thAkave| kiYAmatera dina tAdera janya eTA have nikRSTatara vojhA,
yedina ziGgAYa phuka deoYA have evaM Ami aparAdhIdera samaveta karava nIlavarNarUpe|
tAdera nijedera madhye cupisAre valAvali karave, tomarA (kavare vA duniYAYa) daza dinera vezi thAkani|
tArA ye viSaYe valAvali karave tAra prakRta avasthA AmAra bhAlobhAve jAnA Ache, yakhana tAdera madhye ye sarvApekSA bhAlo pathe chila se valave, tomarA eka dinera vezi avasthAna karani|
loke tomAke parvatasamUha samparke jijJesa kare (ye, kiYAmate tAra kI avasthA have?) vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlaka tA cUrNa-vicUrNa kare dhulAra mata ur3iYe divena|
Ara tAke pariNata karavena samatala prAntare
yAte tumi nA kona vakratA dekhate pAve nA kona uccatA|

se dina sakale AhvAnakArIra anusaraNa karave emanabhAve ye, tAra kAche kona vakratA paridRSTa have nA evaM daYAmaYa AllAhara sAmane sava AoYAja stavdha haYe yAve| phale tumi pAYera mRdu AoYAja chAr3A kichui zunate pAve nA|
se dina kArao supAriza kona kAje Asave nA, sei vyakti (era supAriza) chAr3A, yAke daYAmaYa AllAha anumati divena o yAra kathA tini pachanda karavena|
tini mAnuSera agra-pazcAt savakichui jAnena| kintu tArA tAke jJAnAYatta karate pAre nA|
Ala-hAYyula kAYyUmera (arthAt ciraJjIva, niYantraka, sei sattAra) sAmane sakala cehArA nata haYe thAkave| Ara ye-keu julumera bhAra vahana karave, se-i vyarthakAma have|
Ara ye-keu satkarma karave, se yadi mumina haYa, tave tAra kona julumera bhaYa thAkave nA evaM adhikAra kharverao nA|
ebhAvei Ami eke eka AravI kuraAnarUpe nAyila karechi evaM ete satarkavANI varNanA karechi vibhinnabhAve, yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare athavA tA tAdera bhetara kichuTA sacetanatA utpAdana kare|

sutarAM AllAha samucca, yini prakRta adhipati| (he navI!) ohIra mAdhyame yakhana kuraAna nAyila haYa, takhana tA zeSa haoYAra Age kuraAna pAThe tAr3Ahur3A karo nA evaM vala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! jJAne AmAke Arao unnati dAna kara|
Ami itaHpUrve Adamake ekaTA viSaYe Adeza karechilAma, kintu se tA bhule gela evaM Ami tAra madhye pAini pratijJA|
sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valechilAma, Adamake sijadA kara| takhana sakalei sijadA karala, ivalIsa chAr3A| se asvIkAra karala|
sutarAM Ami valalAma, he Adama! e tomAra o tomAra strIra zatru| kAjei se yena tomAderake jAnnAta theke vera kare nA deYa| tAhale tumi kaSTe par3e yAve|
ekhAne tomAra ei suvidhA Ache ye, tumi kSudhArta have nA evaM vivastrao nA|
Ara nA ekhAne tRSNArta have, nA rodera tApa bhugave|
ataHpara zaYatAna tAra antare kumantraNA dila| se valala, he Adama! tomAke ki emana ekaTA gAchera sandhAna deva, yA dvArA ananta jIvana o emana rAjatva lAbha haYa, yA kakhanao kSaYaprApta haYa nA?

ataHpara tArA se gAcha theke kichu kheYe phelala| phale tAdera lajjAsthAnasamUha tAdera sAmane prakAza haYe gela| takhana tArA jAnnAtera pAtA nijedera upara jur3ate lAgala| Ara (ebhAve) Adama nija pratipAlakera hukuma amAnya karala o vibhrAnta hala|
ataHpara tAra pratipAlaka tAke manonIta karalena| sutarAM tAra tAovA kavula karalena o tA~ke patha dekhAlena|

AllAha valalena, tomarA ubhaYe ekhAna theke nice neme yAo| tomarA eke anyera zatru| ataHpara tomAdera kAche AmAra pakSa hate yadi kona hidAYAta peৗ~che, tave ye AmAra hidAYAta anusaraNa karave se vipathagAmI have nA evaM duHkhagrasta have nA|
Ara ye AmAra upadeza theke mukha phiriYe neve, tAra jIvana have var3a saMkaTamaYa| Ara kiYAmatera dina Ami tAke andha kare uThAva|
se valave, he ravva! tumi AmAke andha kare uThAle kena? Ami to cakSuSmAna chilAma!
AllAha valavena, ebhAvei tomAra kAche AmAra AYAta samUha esechila, kintu tumi tA bhule giYechile| Aja sebhAvei tomAke bhule yAoYA have|
ye vyakti sImAlaMghana kare o nija pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalIte ImAna Ane nA, tAke Ami ebhAvei zAsti dei| Ara AkherAtera AyAva vAstavikai vezi kaThina o adhikatara sthAYI|

ataHpara e viSaYaTio ki tAderake hidAYAtera kona savaka dila nA ye, Ami tAdera Age kata mAnavagoSThIke dhvaMsa karechi, yAdera AvAsabhUmite erA calApherA kare thAke? nizcaYai yArA vivekasampanna, tAdera janya e viSaYera madhye zikSA grahaNera vahu upAdAna Ache|

tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate pUrva thekei yadi ekaTA kathA sthirIkRta nA thAkata evaM (tAra bhittite zAstira janya) ekaTA kAla nirdhArita nA thAkata, tave avazyambhAvI zAsti (tAderake) lepaTe dharata|

sutarAM (he navI!) tArA yesava kathA vale, tAte savara kara evaM sUryeAdaYera Age o sUryAstera Age nija pratipAlakera tAsavIha o hAmade rata thAka evaM rAtera muhUrtaguloteo tAsavIhate rata thAka evaM dinera prAntasamUheo, yAte tumi santuSTa haYe yAo|

tumi pArthiva jIvanera oi cAkacikyera dike cokha tule tAkio nA, yA Ami tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) vibhinna zreNIke majA loTAra janya diYe rekhechi, tA dvArA tAderake parIkSA karAra janya| vastuta tomAra ravvera riyaka sarvApekSA uttama o sarvAdhika sthAYI|
evaM nija parivAravargake nAmAyera Adeza kara evaM nijeo tAte avicalita thAka| Ami tomAra kAche riyaka cAi nA| riyaka to Amii deva| Ara zubha pariNAma to tAkaoYArai|
tArA vale, se (arthAt navI!) AmAdera kAche tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate kona nidarzana niYe Ase nA kena? tave ki tAdera kAche pUrvavartI (AsamAnI) sahIphAsamUhe varNita viSaYavastura sAkSya Aseni?

Ami yadi tAderake era Age (arthAt kuraAna nAyilera Age) kona zAsti dvArA dhvaMsa karatAma, tave tArA avazyai valata, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Apani AmAdera kAche ekajana rAsUla pAThAlena nA kena, tAhale to AmarA lAJchita o apamAnita haoYAra Age ApanAra AYAtasamUha anusaraNa karate pAratAma?
(he navI! tAderake) vale dAo, (AmAdera) sakalei pratIkSA karache| sutarAM tomarAo pratIkSA kara| kenanA tomarA acirei jAnate pArave kArA sarala pathera anusArI evaM kArA hidAYAtaprApta?
mAnuSera janya tAdera hisAvera samaYa kAche ese geche| athaca tArA udAsInatAYa vimukha haYe Ache|
yakhanai tAdera nikaTa tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke natuna kona upadeza Ase, takhana tArA tAmAzArata haYe tA emanabhAve zone ye,

tAdera antara phajula kAje magna thAke| jAlemagaNa cupisAre (eke anyera sAthe) kAnAkAni kare ye, ei vyakti (arthAt muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) ki tomAdera mata mAnuSa chAr3A Ara kichu? tAraparao ki tomarA dekhe zune yAdura kathAi zune yAve?
(uttare) navI valala, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra yAvatIYa kathAi AmAra pratipAlaka jAnena| tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

etaTukui naYa; varaM tArA ekathAo vale ye, eTA (arthAt kuraAna) asaMlagna svapna sambhAra; varaM se nije eTA racanA kareche| kiMvA se ekajana kavi| tA se AmAdera sAmane kona nidarzana niYe Asuka nA, yemana pUrvavartI navIgaNa (nidarzanasaha) prerita haYechila!
athaca tAdera pUrve Ami yata janapada dhvaMsa karechi, tArA ImAna Aneni| tave ki erA ImAna Anave?

(he navI!) Ami tomAra Age kevala puruSa mAnuSakei rAsUla kare pAThiYechilAma, yAdera prati ohI nAyila karatAma| sutarAM (kApheraderake vala) tomarA nijerA yadi nA jAna tave upadeza samparke jJAtaderake jijJesa kara|
evaM Ami tAdera (arthAt rAsUladera)-ke emana dehaviziSTa vAnAini, yArA khAvAra khAve nA| Ara tArA cirajIvIo chila nA|

ataHpara Ami tAderake ye pratizruti diYechilAma tA satye pariNata kari, arthAt Ami tAderakeo rakSA kari evaM (tAdera chAr3A anya) yAderake icchA karechilAma tAderakeo| Ara yArA sImAlaMghana karechila tAderake kari dhvaMsa|
(parizeSe) Ami tomAdera prati nAyila karechi emana eka kitAva, yAra bhetara tomAdera janya upadeza raYeche| tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?
Ami kata janapada piSTa karechi, yArA chila jAlema! tAdera para Ami anyAnya jAti sRSTi karechi|
ataHpara tArA yakhana AmAra zAstira pUrvAbhASa pela, takhana tArA druta sekhAna theke pAlAte lAgala|
(tAderake valA haYechila) pAlio nA| varaM phire eso tomAdera sei ghara-vAr3i o bhoga-vilAsera upakaraNera dike, yAra majA tomarA luTachile| haYata tomAderake e viSaYe jijJesa karA have|
tArA valala, hAYa AmAdera durbhAgya! prakRtapakSe AmarAi jAlema chilAma|
tAdera ei citkArai calate thAke yatakSaNa nA Ami tAderake kare pheli kartita zasya, nirvApita Agunatulya|
Ami AkAza, pRthivI o e duYera mAjhakhAne yA-kichu Ache, tA khelAcchale sRSTi karini|
Ami yadi kona khelAra vyavasthA karate cAitAma, tave Ami nijera kAcha thekei tAra kona vyavasthA kare nitAma ekAnta yadi AmAra tA karatei hata|
varaM Ami satyake mithyAra upara nikSepa kari, yA mithyAra mAthA gu~r3o kare deYa evaM tatkSaNAt tA sampUrNa nizcihna haYe yAYa| tomarA ye sava kathA valacha, tAra janya durbheAga raYeche tomAderai|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yArAi Ache, sakalei AllAhara| Ara yArA (arthAt ye sakala pherezatA) tA~ra kAche Ache, tArA ahaMkAravazata tA~ra ivAdata theke vimukha haYa nA evaM tArA klAntio vodha kare nA|
tArA rAta-dina tAra tAsavIhate lipta thAke, kakhanao avasanna haYa nA|
tave ki tArA yamIna theke emana mAvuda vAniYeche, yArA natuna jIvana dite pAre?
yadi AsamAna o yamIne AllAha chAr3A anya mAvuda thAkata, tave ubhaYai dhvaMsa haYe yeta| sutarAM tArA yA valache, Arazera mAlika AllAha tA theke sampUrNarUpe pavitra|
tini yA-kichu karena, sejanya kArao kAche tA~ra javAvadihi karate have nA, kintu sakalakei tA~ra kAche javAvadihi karate have|

tave ki tArA tAke cher3e anya sava mAvuda grahaNa kareche? (he navI!) tAderake vala, nijedera dalIla peza kara| ei to (vartamAna) raYeche (kuraAna, yA) AmAra saGge yArA Ache tAdera janya upadezavANI evaM raYeche (pUrvavartI kitAvasamUha, yA) AmAra pUrve yArA chila tAdera upadezavANI| kintu vAstavatA hala, tAdera adhikAMzei satye vizvAsa kare nA, phale tArA mukha phiriYe rekheche|
Ami tomAra pUrve emana kona rAsUla pAThAini, yAra prati Ami ei ohI nAyila karini ye, ‘Ami chAr3A anya kona mAvuda nei| sutarAM AmArai ivAdata kara’|
tArA vale, rahamAna (AllAha) santAna grahaNa karechena (Ara tA~ra santAna hala phirizatAgaNa)| suvahAnAllAha! tArA to tA~ra sammAnita vAndA|
tArA tA~ke DiGiYe kona kathA vale nA evaM tArA tA~ra Adeza matai kAja kare|
tini tAdera sammukha o pichanera savakichu jAnena| tArA kArao janya supAriza karate pAre nA, kevala tAdera chAr3A, yAdera janya AllAhara pachanda haYa| tArA tA~ra bhaYe thAke bhIta|
tAdera madhye keu yadi emana kathA valeo (yadio seTA asambhava) ye, ‘AllAha chAr3A Amio ekajana mAvuda’, tave Ami tAke jAhAnnAmera zAsti deva| erUpa jAlemaderake Ami ebhAvei zAsti dei|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA ki jAne nA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI ruddha chila, tArapara Ami tA unmukta kari evaM pAni hate prANavAna savakichu sRSTi kari? tavuo ki tArA ImAna Anave nA?
Ami pRthivIte dRr3habhAve sthApita pAhAr3a sRSTi karechi, yAte tAderake niYe tA dola nA khAYa evaM tAte tairi karechi prazasta rAstA, yAte tArA gantavyasthale peৗ~chate pAre|
evaM Ami AkAzake karechi eka surakSita chAda| kintu tArA AkAzera nidarzanasamUha theke mukha phiriYe rekheche|
evaM tinii sei sattA, yini rAta, dina, sUrya o candra sRSTi karechena| pratyekei konao nA konao kakSapathe sA~tAra kATache|
(he navI!) Ami tomAra Ageo kona mAnuSera janya ciradina ve~ce thAkAra phAYasAlA karini| sutarAM tomAra mRtyu hale tArA ki cirajIvI haYe thAkave?
jIvamAtrakei mRtyura svAda grahaNa karate have| Ami parIkSA karAra janya tomAderake manda o bhAlote lipta kari, evaM tomAdera sakalake AmArai kAche phiriYe AnA have|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana tAdera kAja haYa kevala tomAke niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karA| (tArA vale,) ei lokai ki sei, ye tomAdera upAsyadera samAlocanA kare (arthAt vale, edera kona bhitti nei)| athaca tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) avasthA hala, tArA ‘rahamAna’-era ullekha karAra virodhI|
mAnuSake sRSTi karA haYeche tvarApravaNa kare| Ami acirei tomAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI dekhAva| sutarAM tomarA AmAra kAche tvarA ceo nA|
tArA (musalimaderake) vale, tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tave vala, (zAstira) e dhamaki kave pUrNa have?
hAYa! kAphiragaNa yadi sei samaYera kathA jAnata, yakhana tArA tAdera cehArA theke Aguna pherAte pArave nA evaM tAdera piTha thekeo naYa evaM tArA kona sAhAyyao lAbha karave nA|
varaM tA (arthAt jAhAnnAmera Aguna) tAdera kAche Asave atarkitabhAve evaM tAderake hatabhamva kare deve, phale nA tArA tA haTAte pArave evaM nA tAderake kichumAtra avakAza deoYA have|
(he navI!) tomAra pUrveo rAsUlagaNake ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYechila| parizeSe tArA tAderake yA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata, seTAi tAderake pariveSTana kare phele|
vala, rAte o dine ke tomAderake rahamAna (-era AyAva) theke rakSA karave| varaM tArA nija pratipAlakera smaraNa theke vimukha|

tave ki tAdera janya Ami chAr3A emana kona mAvudao Ache, ye tAderake rakSA karate pAre? tArA to nijederai kona sAhAyya karate pAre nA evaM AmAra mukAvilAYa keu tAdera sahayogitA karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA|

prakRta vyApAra hala, Ami tAderake evaM tAdera vApa-dAdAderake bhoga-sambhAra diYechilAma, emanaki (e avasthAYai) tAdera AYuSkAla haYe yAYa dIrgha, tave ki tArA dekhate pAcche nA Ami bhUmike tAra caturdika theke saGkucita kare Anachi?
vale dAo, Ami to kevala ohI dvArAi tomAderake satarka kari, kintu yArA vadhira, tAderake yakhana satarka karA haYa, takhana tArA kona DAka zone nA|
tomAra pratipAlakera zAstira ekaTA jhApaTAo yadi tAdera lAgata, tave tArA vale oThata, hAYa AmAdera durbheAga! vAstavikai AmarA jAlema chilAma|

kiYAmatera dina Ami nyAYAnuga tulAdaNDa sthApana karava| phale kArao prati kona juluma karA have nA| yadi kona karma tila parimANao haYa, tave tAo Ami upasthita karava| hisAva grahaNera janya Amii yatheSTa|
Ami mUsA o hArUnake diYechilAma satya o mithyAra eka mAnadaNDa, (hidAYAtera) Alo o muttAkIdera janya upadeza,
yArA nija pratipAlakake nA dekheo bhaYa kare evaM kiYAmata samparke yArA bhIta|
eTA (arthAt ei kuraAna) varakatamaYa upadezavANI, yA Ami nAyila karechi, tavuo ki tomarA eke asvIkAra kara|
era Age Ami ivarAhImake diYechilAma tAra (upayukta) vuddhimattA| Ami tAra samparke paripUrNa avagata chilAma|
sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana se nija pitA o nija sampradAYake valechila, ei mUrtiguli kI, yAra sAmane tomarA dharnA diYe vase thAka?
tArA valala, AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake edera pUjA karate dekhechi|
ivarAhIma valala, prakRtapakSe tomarA nijerA evaM tomAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa spaSTa vibhrAntite lipta raYeche|
tArA valala, tumi ki AmAdera kAche satya niYe esecha, nA AmAdera sAthe parihAsa karacha?
ivarAhIma valala, nA tomAdera pratipAlaka to tinii, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra mAlika, yini ederake sRSTi karechena evaM Ami e viSaYe sAkSya dAna karachi|
AllAhara kasama! tomarA yakhana pichana phire cale yAve, takhana tomAdera mUrtidera upara (emana) kauzala khATAva (yA dvArA tAdera svarUpa unmocana haYe yAve)|
sutarAM savagulo mUrti cUrNa-vicUrNa kare phelala tAdera pradhAnaTi chAr3A, yAte tArA tAra kAche rujU karate pAre|
tArA valala, AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe erUpa AcaraNa ke karala? nizcaYai se ghora jAlema|
kichu loka valala, AmarA eka yuvakake tAdera samAlocanA karate zunechi| tAke ‘ivarAhIma’ valA haYa|
tArA valala, tave tAke janasamakSe hAjira kara, yAte sakale sAkSI haYe yAYa|
(tArapara yakhana ivarAhImake niYe AsA hala, takhana) tArA valala he ivarAhIma! AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe eTA ki tumii karecha?
ivarAhIma valala, varaM eTA kareche tAdera ei var3aTi| ei pratimAderakei jijJesa kara nA- yadi tArA kathA valate pAre|
e kathAYa tArA Apana mane cintA karate lAgala evaM (svagatabhAve) valate lAgala, prakRtapakSe tomarA nijerAi jAlema|
ataHpara tArA tAdera mAthA nuiYe dila evaM valala, tumi to jAnai tArA kathA valate pAre nA|
se valala, tave ki tomarA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura upAsanA karacha, yA tomAdera kichu upakArao karate pAre nA evaM tomAdera kSatio karate pAre nA?
Aphasosa tomAdera prati evaM AllAhake cher3e yAdera ivAdata karacha tAderao prati| tomAdera ki etaTuku vodhao nei?
tArA (eke anyake) valate lAgala, tomarA tAke Agune jvAliYe dAo evaM nijedera devatAderake sAhAyya kara, yadi tomAdera kichu karAra thAke|
(sutarAM tArA ivarAhImake Agune nikSepa karala) evaM Ami valalAma, he Aguna! ThANDA haYe yAo evaM ivarAhImera pakSe zAntidAYaka haYe yAo|
tArA ivarAhImera viruddhe eka durabhisandhi A~Tala, kintu Ami tAderakei karalAma mahA kSatigrasta|
evaM Ami tAke o lUtake uddhAra kare emana eka bhUmite niYe gelAma, yekhAne Ami samagra vizvavAsIra janya varakata rekhechi|
evaM Ami puraskAra svarUpa tAke dAna karechilAma isahAka o iYAkuva| Ami tAdera pratyekake vAniYechilAma nekakAra|

Ami tAderake karechilAma netA, yArA AmAra hukume mAnuSake patha dekhAta| Ami ohIra mAdhyame tAderake satkarma karate, nAmAya kAYema karate o yAkAta AdAYa karate nirdeza diYechilAma| tArA AmArai ivAdatagojAra chila|
Ami lUtake hikamata o ilama diYechilAma evaM emana eka janapada theke tAke mukti diYechilAma, yAra adhivAsIrA eka kadarya kAja karata| vastuta tArA chila atyanta nikRSTa, nApharamAna sampradAYa|
evaM Ami lUtake AmAra rahamatera antarbhukta kare nei| nizcaYai se chila neka lokadera ekajana|

evaM nUhakeo (hikamata o ilama diYechilAma)| sei samaYake smaraNa kara, (e ghaTanAra) Age yakhana se AmAke Dekechila, Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma evaM tAke o tAra saGgIderake mahA vipada theke uddhAra karechilAma|
evaM ye sampradAYa AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra karechila, tAdera viruddhe Ami tAke sAhAyya karechilAma| vastuta tArA chila ati manda loka| tAi Ami tAdera sakalake nimajjita kari|

evaM dAUda o sulAYamAnakeo (hikamata o ilama diYechilAma), yakhana tArA ekaTi zasya kSetrera vyApAre vicAra karachila| tAte rAtera velA ekadala lokera meSapAla praveza karechila| tAdera phAYasAlA Ami nije pratyakSa karachilAma|

Ami sulAYamAnake se phAYasAlAra viSaYaTi vujhiYe diYechilAma evaM (emanite to) Ami ubhaYakei hikamata o ilama dAna karechilAma| Ami parvatasamUhake dAUdera adhIna kare diYechilAma, yAte tArA pAkhiderake sAthe niYe tAsavIharata thAke| esava kichura kartA chilAma Amii|
tomAdera kalyANArthe tAke zikSA diYechilAma sAmarika pozAka (varma) tairira kArigari, yAte yuddhakAle tA tomAderake pArasparika AkramaNa theke rakSA kare| evAra vala, tomarA kRtajJa have ki?
evaM Ami jhar3o hAoYAke sulAYamAnera vazIbhUta kare diYechilAma, yA tAra hukume emana bhUmira dike pravAhita hata, yekhAne Ami varakata rekhechi| Ami pratiTi viSaYe samyaka jJAta|
evaM kataka duSTa jinakeo Ami tAra vazIbhUta kare diYechilAma, yArA tAra janya Duvurira kAja karata evaM tAchAr3A anya kAjao karata| Ara Amii tAdera sakalera dekhAzonA karachilAma|
evaM AYyUvake dekha, yakhana se nija pratipAlakake Deke valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra ei kaSTa dekhA diYeche evaM tumi to daYAludera madhye zreSTha daYAlu|

ataHpara Ami tAra du‘A kavula karalAma evaM se ye kaSTe AkrAnta chila tA dUra kare dilAma| Ara tAke tAra parivAra-parijana phiriYe dilAma evaM tAdera samaparimANa Arao, yAte AmAra pakSa hate rahamatera prakAza ghaTe evaM ivAdatakArIdera lAbha haYa smaraNIYa zikSA|
evaM isamAIla, idarIsa o yulakiphalake dekha, tArA sakalei chila dhairyazIladera antarbhukta|
Ami tAderake AmAra rahamatera antarbhukta karechilAma| nizcaYai tArA neka lokadera madhye gaNya chila|

evaM mAchera sAthe samparkita vyakti (navI iunusa AlAihisa sAlAma)ke dekha, yakhana se kSuvdha haYe cale giYechila evaM mane karechila, Ami tAke pAkar3Ao karava nA| ataHpara se andhakAra theke DAka diYechila, (he AllAha!) tumi chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tumi sakala truTi theke pavitra| nizcaYai Ami aparAdhI|
takhana Ami tAra du‘A kavula karalAma evaM tAke saMkaTa theke mukti diYechilAma| ebhAvei Ami ImAnadAraderake mukti diYe thAki|
evaM yAkAriYAke dekha, yakhana se nija pratipAlakake Deke valechila, he AmAra ravva! AmAke ekA rekhe dio nA, Ara tumii zreSTha uttarAdhikArI|

sutarAM Ami tAra du‘A kavula karalAma evaM tAke iYAhaiYA (-era mata putra) dAna karalAma| Ara tAra janya tAra strIke (santAna dhAraNera) upayukta kare dilAma| nizcaYai tArA satkAje drutagamana karata evaM AzA o bhItira sAthe AmAke DAkata Ara tAdera antara chila AmAra sAmane vinIta|
evaM dekha sei nArIke, ye nija satItva rakSA karechila, tArapara Ami tAra bhetara AmAra rUha phu~ke diYechilAma evaM tAke o tAra putrake samagra jagatavAsIra janya eka nidarzana vAniYechilAma|
(he mAnuSa!) nizcaYai eTAi tomAdera dIna, yA ekai dIna (samasta navI-rAsUla yAra dAoYAta dita) evaM Ami tomAdera pratipAlaka| sutarAM tomarA AmAra ivAdata kara|
kintu mAnuSa tAdera dInake nijedera madhye khaNDa khaNDa kare bhAga kareche| sakalakei (ekadina) AmAra kAche phire Asate have|
sutarAM ye vyakti mumina haYe satkAja karave, tAra praceSTAke agrAhya karA have nA evaM Ami se praceSTA likhe rAkhi|
Ara Ami ye janapada (-era mAnuSa)-ke dhvaMsa karechi, tAra pakSe eTA asambhava ye, tArA (arthAt tAra vAsindAgaNa) AvAra (duniYAYa) phire Asave|
parizeSe yakhana iYAjuja o mAjujake khule deoYA have evaM tAderake pratiTi u~cu bhUmi theke pichale nAmate dekhA yAve|

evaM satya oYAdA pUraNa haoYAra kAla samAsanna have, takhana akasmAt yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila, tAdera cokha visphArita haYe yAve (evaM tArA valave) hAYa AmAdera durbhAgya| AmarA e viSaYe sampUrNa udAsIna chilAma varaM AmarA var3ai anyAYa karechilAma|
(he muzarikagaNa!) nizcita jene rekha, tomarA evaM AllAhake cher3e tomarA yAdera ivAdata kara, sakalei jAhAnnAmera jvAlAni have| tomAderake se jAhAnnAmei giYe nAmate have|
tArA vAstavika mAvuda hale tAte (arthAt jAhAnnAme) yeta nA| tArA sakalei tAte sarvadA thAkave|
sekhAne thAkave tAdera ArtanAda| tArA sekhAne kichui zunate pAve nA|
avazya yAdera janya pUrva thekei AmAra pakSa hate kalyANa lekhA haYeche (arthAt yArA neka o mumina) tAderake tA (arthAt jAhAnnAma) theke dUre rAkhA have|
tArA tAra mRdu zavdao zunate pAve nA| tArA sarvadA tAdera manera kAGkhita vasturAjira madhye thAkave|
tAderake (kiYAmatera) mahAbhIti duzcintAgrasta karave nA evaM phirizatAgaNa tAderake (ei vale) abhyarthanA jAnAve ye, eTAi tomAdera sei dina, yAra oYAdA tomAdera saGge karA hata|

sei dinake smaraNa rAkha, yakhana Ami AkAzamaNDalIke guTiYe phelava, kAgajera velane lekhAsamUha guTAnora mata| Ami punarAYa tAke sRSTi karava, yebhAve prathamavAra sRSTira sUcanA karechilAma| eTA eka pratizruti, yA pUraNa karAra dAYa AmAra| Ami tA avazyai karava|
Ami yAvure upadezera para likhe diYechilAma, bhUmira uttarAdhikArI have AmAra neka vAndAgaNa|
nizcaYai ete (arthAt kuraAne) ivAdataniSThadera janya yatheSTa vArtA raYeche|
(he navI!) Ami tomAke vizva jagatera janya kevala rahamata karei pAThiYechi|
vale dAo, AmAra prati ei ohIi avatIrNa haYa ye, tomAdera prabhu ekai prabhu| sutarAM tomarA Anugatya svIkAra karave ki?
tavuo yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave vale dAo, Ami tomAderake prakAzye jAniYe diYechi| Ami jAni nA tomAderake ye viSaYera (arthAt ye zAstira) pratizruti deoYA haYeche tA nikaTavartI, nA dUre|
nizcaYai AllAha jAnena yA uccasvare valA haYa evaM tini jAnena yA tomarA gopana kara|
Ami jAni nA haYata eTA (arthAt zAstike vilamvita karA) tomAdera janya eka parIkSA evaM nirdiSTa ekaTA samaYa paryanta bhogera avakAza|
(parizeSe) rAsUla valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! Apani satyera phAYasAlA kare dina| AmAdera pratipAlaka ati daYAvAna, tomarA yesava kathA valacha tAra viparIte tinii sAhAyya prArthanAra sthala|
he mAnuSa! nija pratipAlakera (krodhake) bhaYa kara| jene rekha, kiYAmatera prakampana eka sAMghAtika jinisa|

ye dina tomarA tA dekhate pAve, se dina pratyeka stanyadAtrI sei zizuke (paryanta) bhule yAve, yAke se dudha pAna kariYeche evaM pratyeka garbhavatI tAra garbhapAta ghaTiYe phelave Ara mAnuSake tumi emana dekhave, yena tArA nezAgrasta, athaca tArA nezAgrasta naYa; varaM (se dina) AllAhara zAsti have ati kaThora|
mAnuSera madhye kataka emana Ache, yArA AllAha samparke nA jene-nA vujhe jhagar3A kare evaM anugamana kare sei avAdhya zaYatAnera
yAra niYatite likhe deoYA haYeche, ye-keu tAke vandhu vAnAve, tAke se vipathagAmI kare chAr3ave evaM tAke niYe yAve prajjvalita jAhAnnAmera zAstira dike|

he mAnuSa! punarAYa jIvita haoYA samparke tomAdera yadi kona sandeha thAke, tave (ekaTu cintA kara) Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi mATi hate, tArapara zukravindu theke, tArapara jamATa rakta theke, tArapara eka mAMsapi- theke, yA (kakhanao) pUrNAkRti haYa evaM (kakhanao) pUrNAkRti haYa nA, tomAdera kAche (tomAdera) prakRta avasthA suspaSTarUpe vyakta karAra janya| Ara Ami (tomAderake) yata kAla icchA mAtRgarbhe rAkhi eka nirdiSTa kAlera janya| tArapara tomAderake zizurUpe vera kari| tArapara (tomAderake pratipAlana kari) yAte tomarA pariNata vaYase upanIta hao| tomAdera katakake (Agei) duniYA theke tule neoYA haYa evaM tomAdera katakake phiriYe deoYA haYa hInatama vaYase (arthAt carama vArdhakye), emanaki takhana se sava kichu jAnAra parao kichui jAne nA| tumi bhUmike dekha zuSka, tArapara yakhana Ami tAte vAri varSaNa kari, takhana tA Andolita o vAr3a-vAr3anta haYe oThe evaM tA utpanna kare sarvaprakAra naYanAbhirAma udbhida|
esava ejanya ye, AllAhara astitvai satya evaM tinii prANahInera bhetara prANa saJcAra karena evaM tini sarvaviSaYe paripUrNa kSamatAvAna|
evaM ejanya ye, kiYAmata avazyambhAvI| tAte kona sandeha nei evaM ejanya ye, yArA kavare Ache AllAha tAdera sakalake punarujjIvita karavena|
mAnuSera madhye keu Ache, ye AllAha samparke tarka-vitarka kare, athaca tAra nA Ache jJAna, nA hidAYAta, Ara nA Ache kona dIptidAYaka kitAva|

se (ahaMkAre) nija pArzvadeza vA~kiYe rAkhe, yAte anyaderakeo AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karate pAre| erUpa vyaktira janyai duniYAYa raYeche lAJchanA evaM kiYAmatera dina Ami tAke jvalanta Agunera svAda grahaNa karAva|
(valA have,) eTA tomAra sei kRtakarmera phala, yA tumi nija hAte sAmane pAThiYechile| Ara eTA sthirIkRta viSaYa ye, AllAha vAndAdera prati juluma karena nA|

mAnuSera madhye keu keu emanao Ache, ye AllAhara ivAdata kare eka prAnte theke| yadi (duniYAYa) tAra kona kalyANa lAbha haYa, tave tAte se Azvasta haYe yAYa Ara yadi se kona parIkSAra sammukhIna haYa, tave se mukha phiriYe (kuphurera dike) cale yAYa| erUpa vyakti duniYAo hArAYa evaM AkherAtao| eTAi to suspaSTa kSati|
se AllAhake cher3e emana kichuke DAke, yA tAra kona kSati karate pAre nA evaM tAra kona upakArao karate pAre nA| eTAi to carama pathabhraSTatA|
se DAke emana kAuke (alIka prabhuke) yAra kSati tAra upakAra apekSA vezi nikaTavartI| kata manda ei abhibhAvaka evaM kata manda e sahacara!
yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche AllAha avazyai tAderake dAkhila karavena emana udyAnarAjite, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| nizcaYai AllAha karena yA cAna|

ye vyakti mane karata AllAha duniYA o AkherAte tAke (arthAt navIke) sAhAyya karavena nA, se AkAza paryanta ekaTi razi TAniYe samparka chinna karuka tArapara dekhuka tAra praceSTA tAra Akroza dUra kare ki nA!
Ami ebhAvei eke (arthAt kuraAnake) suspaSTa nidarzanarUpe avatIrNa karechi| Ara AllAha yAke cAna hidAYAta dAna karena|

nizcaYai yArA mumina, yArA iYAhudI, sAvI, khrisTAna o mAjusI evaM yArA ziraka avalamvana kareche, kiYAmatera dina AllAha tAdera sakalera madhye phAYasAlA kare divena| nizcaYai AllAha pratiTi viSaYera sAkSI|

tumi ki dekhani AllAhara sammukhe sijadA kare yA-kichu Ache AkAzamaNDalIte, yA-kichu Ache pRthivIte evaM sUrya, candra, nakSatrarAji, pAhAr3a, vRkSa, jIvajantu o vahu mAnuSa? AvAra emanao aneka Ache, yAdera prati zAsti avadhArita haYe Ache| AllAha yAke lAJchita karena tAra kona sammAnadAtA nei| nizcaYai AllAha karena yA tini cAna|

erA (mumina o kAphera) du’Ti pakSa, yArA nija pratipAlaka samparke vivAda karache| sutarAM (era mImAMsA have ebhAve ye,) yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera janya tairi karA have Agunera pozAka| tAdera mAthAra upara Dhele deoYA have phuTanta pAni|
yA dvArA tAdera udarastha savakichu evaM cAmar3A galiYe deoYA have|
Ara tAdera janya thAkave lohAra hAtur3i|
yakhanai tArA yantraNAYa atiSTha haYe tA theke vera hate cAve, takhanai tAderake tAra bhetara phiriYe deoYA have| (valA have), jvalanta Agunera zAsti AsvAdana kara|

(apara dike) yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| sekhAne tAderake sajjita karA have sonAra kA~kana o maNi-muktA dvArA| Ara sekhAne tAdera pozAka have rezamera|
evaM (tAra kAraNa ei ye,) tAderake pavitra kAlimAYa (arthAt kAlimAYe tAohIde) upanIta karA haYechila evaM tAderake peৗ~chAno haYechila AllAhara pathe, yini samasta prazaMsAra upayukta|

nizcaYai (sei sava loka zAstira upayukta) yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM anyaderake vAdhA dicche AllAhara patha o masajidula hArAma theke, yAke Ami samasta mAnuSera janya samAna karechi tAra sthAnIYa vAsindA hoka vA vahirAgata| Ara ye-keu ekhAne julume rata haYe vA~kA pathera icchA karave Ami tAke marmantuda zAstira svAda grahaNa karAva|

evaM sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami ivarAhImake sei ghara (arthAt kAvAgRha)-era sthAna jAniYe diYechilAma| (evaM tAke hukuma diYechilAma) AmAra sAthe kAuke zarIka karo nA evaM AmAra gharake sei sakala lokera janya pavitra rekha, yArA (ekhAne) tAoYApha kare, ivAdatera janya dA~r3AYa evaM rukU-sijadA AdAYa kare|
evaM mAnuSera madhye hajjera ghoSaNA dAo| tArA tomAra kAche Asave padayoge evaM dUra-dUrAntera patha atikramakArI uTera piThe saoYAra haYe yegulo (dIrgha sapharera kAraNe) rogA haYe geche|

yAte tArA tAdera janya sthApita kalyANasamUha pratyakSa kare evaM nirdiSTa dinasamUhe AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare sei sakala pazute yA tini tAderake diYechena| sutarAM (he musalimagaNa!) sei pazuguli theke tomarA nijerAo khAo evaM duHstha, abhAvagrastakeo khAoYAo|
ataHpara (yArA hajja kare) tArA yena tAdera malinatA dUra kare o nijedera mAnata pUraNa kare evaM AtIka gRhera tAoYApha kare|

esava kathA smaraNa rekha| Ara ye vyakti AllAha yesava jinisake maryAdA diYechena tAra maryAdA rakSA karave, tAra pakSe tAra pratipAlakera kAche e kAja ati uttama| sava catuSpada jantu tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche, sei pazugulo chAr3A yA vistAritabhAve tomAdera par3e zonAno haYeche| sutarAM tomarA pratimAdera kaluSa parihAra kara evaM mithyA kathA theke ve~ce thAka,

ekaniSThabhAve AllAhara abhimukhI haYe, tA~ra sAthe kAuke zarIka nA kare| ye-keu AllAha sAthe kAuke zarIka kare, se yena AkAza theke patita hala, tArapara pAkhi tAke cheA~ mere niYe gela athavA vAtAsa tAke dUravartI sthAne nikSepa karala|
esava viSaYa smaraNa rekha| Ara keu AllAhara ‘zAAira’-ke sammAna karale eTA to antarastha tAkaoYA thekei arjita haYa|
ete raYeche eka nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta tomAdera nAnArakama upakAra| ataHpara tAdera hAlAla haoYAra sthAna sei prAcIna gRha (kAvA gRha)-era AzepAze|

Ami pratyeka ummatera janya kuravAnIra niYama kare diYechi yAte AllAha tAderake ye catuSpada jantusamUha diYechena tAte tArA AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare| tomAdera mAvuda ekai mAvuda| sutarAM tomarA tA~rai Anugatya karave| Ara susaMvAda dAo vinItaderake|

yAdera sAmane AllAhake smaraNa karA hale tAdera antara bhIta-kampita haYa, ye-kona vipada-Apade AkrAnta hale dhairyazIla thAke evaM yArA sAlAta kAYema kare o Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tA theke (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare|

kuravAnIra uTa (o garu)ke tomAdera janya AllAhara ‘zAAira’-era antarbhukta karechi| tomAdera pakSe tAte Ache kalyANa| sutarAM yakhana tA sArivaddha avasthAYa dA~r3Ano thAke, tomarA tAra upara AllAhara nAma neve| tArapara yakhana (yaveha haYe yAoYAra para) tA kAta haYe mATite par3e yAYa, takhana tAra gozata theke nijerAo khAo evaM dhairyazIla abhAvagrastakeo khAoYAo evaM tAkeo, ye nija abhAva prakAza kare| ebhAvei Ami esava pazuke tomAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechi yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

AllAhara kAche tAdera gozata peৗ~che nA Ara tAdera raktao nA, varaM tA~ra kAche tomAdera tAkaoYAi peৗ~che| ebhAvei tini esava pazuke tomAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena, yAte tomarA AllAhara mahimA ghoSaNA kara, tini tomAderake hidAYAta dAna karechena vale| yArA sucArurUpe satkarma kare tAderake susaMvAda dAo|
nizcaYai AllAha tAdera pratirakSA karena, yArA ImAna eneche| jene rekha, AllAha kona vizvAsaghAtaka, akRtajJake pachanda karena nA|

yAdera saGge yuddha karA hacche, tAderake anumati deoYA yAcche (tArA nijedera pratirakSArthe yuddha karate pAre)| yehetu tAdera prati juluma karA haYeche| nizcaYai AllAha tAderake jaYayukta karate paripUrNa sakSama|

yAderake tAdera ghara-vAr3i hate anyAYabhAve kevala e kAraNe vera karA haYeche ye, tArA valechila, AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAha| AllAha yadi mAnava jAtira eka dala (-era aniSTa)ke anya dalera mAdhyame pratihata nA karatena, tave dhvaMsa kare deoYA hata khAnakAha, girjA, ivAdatakhAnA o masajidasamUha yAte AllAhara yikira karA vezi| AllAha avazyai tAdera sAhAyya karavena, yArA tAra (dInera) sAhAyya karave| nizcaYai AllAha sarvazaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

tArA emana ye, Ami yadi duniYAYa tAderake kSamatA dAna kari, tave tArA nAmAya kAYema karave, yAkAta AdAYa karave, mAnuSake satkAjera Adeza karave o anyAYa kAje vAdhA deve| sava kAje pariNati AllAharai hAte|
(he navI!) tArA yadi tomAke asvIkAra kare, tave tAdera pUrve nUhera sampradAYa evaM Ada o chAmudera sampradAYao to (nija-nija navIke) asvIkAra karechila|
evaM ivarAhImera sampradAYa o lutera sampradAYa
evaM mAdaYAnavAsIrAo| tAchAr3A mUsAkeo asvIkAra karA haYechila| sutarAM Ami se kApheraderake kichuTA avakAza diYechilAma| tArapara tAderake pAkar3Ao kari| evAra dekha AmAra dharA kemana chila!

moddAkathA Ami kata janapadakei dhvaMsa karechi, yakhana tArA julume rata chila! phale tA chAdera upara dhase par3eche, kata kuYA haYeche parityakta evaM kata pAkA mahala (dhvaMsAvazeSe pariNata haYeche)!

tave ki tArA bhUmite calApherA kareni, yA dvArA tAdera emana antakaraNa lAbha hata, yA dvArA tArA (satya) upalavdhi karata kiMvA emana kAna lAbha hata, yA dvArA tA zunate peta| prakRtapakSe cokha andha haYa nA, varaM andha haYa sei hRdaYa, yA vakSadeze virAja kare|
tArA tomAke tAr3AtAr3i zAsti ene dite vale, athaca AllAha kakhanai nija oYAdA bhaGga karena nA| nizcita jene rekha, tomAra pratipAlakera kAche eka dina tomAdera gaNanAra hAjAra vacharera samAna|
Ami kata janapadakei to avakAza diYechilAma, yA chila julumarata| avazeSe Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao kari| Ara zeSa paryanta sakalake AmArai kAche phirate have|
(he navI!) vale dAo, Ami to tomAdera janya eka suspaSTa satarkakArI|
sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAdera janya Ache mAgaphirAta o sammAnajanaka riyaka|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake vyartha pramANera janya daur3a-jhA~pa kare, tArA have jAhAnnAmavAsI|

(he navI!) tomAra pUrve yakhanai Ami kona rAsUla vA navI pAThiYechi, tAra kSetre avazyai e ghaTanA ghaTeche ye, yakhana se (AllAhara vANI) par3eche zaYatAna tAra par3Ara saGge-saGge (kApheradera antare) kona prativandha phele diYeche| ataHpara zaYatAna ye prativandha phele AllAha tA apasAraNa karena tArapara nija AYAtasamUha sudRr3ha kare dena| vastuta AllAha prabhUta jJAna o prabhUta hikamatera mAlika|

tA ejanya ye, zaYatAna ye prativandha phele, AllAha tAke yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache evaM yAdera antara zakta, tAdera janya phitanAYa pariNata karena| nizcaYai jAlemagaNa virodhitAYa vahu dUra peৗ~che geche|

Ara yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche tArA yena jene neYa eTAi (arthAt e kAlAmai) satya, yA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke eseche ataHpara tArA yena tAte ImAna Ane evaM tAdera antara tAra prati jhu~ke par3e| nizcaYai AllAha muminadera janya sarala pathera hidAYAtadAtA|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA e samparke (arthAt kuraAna samparke) avyAhatabhAve sandehe patita thAkave, yAvat nA tAdera upara akasmAt kiYAmata upasthita haYa athavA tAdera upara emana eka divasera zAsti ese par3e yA (tAdera janya) konao rakamera kalyANaprasU naYa|
se dina rAjatva have kevala AllAhara| tini tAdera madhye phAYasAlA karavena| sutarAM yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche tArA thAkave ni‘Amata-AkIrNa jAnnAte|
Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche o AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche, tAdera janya thAkave lAJchanAkara zAsti|
yArA AllAhara pathe hijarata kareche, tArapara tAderake hatyA karA haYeche vA tAdera intikAla haYeche, AllAha avazyai tAderake uttama riyaka dAna karavena, nizcaYai AllAhai sarvazreSTha riyikadAtA|
tini tAderake avazyai emana sthAne peৗ~chAvena, yA peYe tArA khuzI haYe yAve| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJAta, parama sahanazIla|

esava sthirIkRta viSaYa evaM (Arao jene rekha) konao vyakti pratizodha nite giYe yadi Thika tataTuku kaSTa deYa, yataTuku kaSTa tAke deoYA haYechila, ataHpara phera tAra prati atyAcAra karA haYa, tave AllAha avazyai tAke sAhAyya karavena| nizcaYai AllAha ati mArjanAkArI, parama kSamAzIla|
tA ejanya ye, AllAha (tAAlAra zakti vipula| tini) rAtake dinera madhye praviSTa karAna evaM dinake rAtera madhye praviSTa karAna evaM ejanya ye, AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|
tA ejanya ye, AllAhai satya| Ara tArA tA~ke cher3e yesava jinisera ivAdata kare tA savai mithyA| Ara AllAhai sei sattA, yAra mahimA, samucca, maryAdA vipula|
tumi ki dekhani AllAha AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karena, yA dvArA bhUmi savuja-sajIva haYe oThe? vastuta AllAha azeSa daYAvAna, sarva viSaYe avahita|
yA-kichu Ache AkAzamaNDalIte evaM yA-kichu Ache pRthivIte sava tA~rai| nizcita jena, AllAhai sei sattA, yini sakalera theke anapekSa, prazaMsArha|

tumi ki dekhani AllAha bhUmistha sava kichuke tomAdera sevAYa niYojita kare rekhechena evaM jalayAnasamUhakeo, yA tAra Adeze sAgare calAcala kare? evaM tini AkAzake ebhAve dhAraNa kare rekhechena ye, tA tAra anumati chAr3A pRthivIra upara patita have nA| vastuta AllAha mAnuSera prati mamatAmaYa parama daYAlu|
tinii sei sattA, yini tomAderake jIvana dAna karechena, tArapara tinii tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, tArapara punarAYa tomAderake jIvita karavena| satyii mAnuSa var3a akRtajJa|

Ami pratyeka ummatera janya ivAdatera eka paddhati nirdiSTa karechi, ye anusAre tArA ivAdata kare| sutarAM (he navI!) e viSaYe tomAra saGge yena tArA vitarke lipta nA haYa| tumi nija pratipAlakera dike dAoYAta dite thAka| nizcaYai tumi sarala pathe Acha|
tArA tomAra saGge vitarke lipta hale vale dAo, tomarA yA-kichu karacha AllAha tA bhAlobhAve jAnena|
ye sava viSaYe tomarA vitarka karacha, AllAha kiYAmatera dina tomAdera madhye se viSaYe mImAMsA kare divena|
tumi ki jAna nA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra savakichu samparke AllAha tAAlA jAnena? esava viSaYa ekaTi kitAve saMrakSita Ache| nizcaYai tA AllAha tAAlAra pakSe ati sahaja|

tArA AllAhake cher3e emana jinisera ivAdata kare yAra (mAvuda haoYA) samparke AllAha kona pramANa avatIrNa karenani evaM emana jinisera (ivAdata kare) ye samparke tAdera kona jJAna nei| (AkherAte) e rakama jAlemadera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|

tAderake yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha par3e zonAno haYa, takhana tumi kApheradera cehArAYa vitRSNA bhAva dekhate pAo| yena tAderake yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha par3e zonAYa tAdera upara AkramaNa cAlAve| vala, he mAnuSa! Ami ki tomAderake era ceYe vezi apachandanIYa viSaYa samparke avagata karava? tA hala Aguna| AllAha kApheraderake tAra pratizruti diYechena| tA ati manda ThikAnA|

he mAnuSa! ekaTi upamA deoYA hacche| manoyoga diYe zona| tomarA du‘Ara janya AllAhake cher3e yAderake DAka, tArA ekaTi mAchio sRSTi karate pAre nA, yadio e kAjera janya tArA sakale ekatra haYe yAYa| emanaki mAchi yadi tAdera theke kona jinisa chiniYe niYe yAYa, tAo tArA tAra theke uddhAra karate pAre nA| erUpa du‘AkArIo var3a durvala evaM yAra kAche du‘A karA haYa seo|
tArA AllAhara yathAyatha maryAdA upalavdhi kareni| prakRtapakSe AllAha zaktimAna, parAkrAnta|
AllAha pherezatAdera madhya hate tA~ra vArtAvAhaka manonIta karena evaM mAnuSera madhya hateo| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|
tini tAdera sAmanera o pichanera yAvatIYa viSaYa jAnena| vastuta AllAharai kAche yAvatIYa viSaYa phiriYe neoYA have|
he muminagaNa! ruku kara, sijadA kara, tomAdera pratipAlakera ivAdata kara evaM satkarma kara, yAte tomarA saphalatA arjana karate pAra|*

evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kara, yebhAve jihAda karA ucita| tini tomAderake (tA~ra dInera janya) manonIta karechena| tini dInera vyApAre tomAdera prati kona saMkIrNatA Aropa karenani| nijedera pitA ivarAhImera dInake dRr3habhAve Akar3e dhara| tinii pUrveo tomAdera nAma rekhechilena musalima evaM e kitAveo (arthAt kuraAneo), yAte ei rAsUla tomAdera janya sAkSI hate pAre Ara tomarA sAkSI hate pAra anyAnya mAnuSera janya| sutarAM nAmAya kAYema kara, yAkAta AdAYa kara evaM AllAhake majavutabhAve Akar3e dhara| tini tomAdera abhibhAvaka| dekha kata uttama abhibhAvaka tini evaM kata uttama sAhAyyakArI|
nizcaYai saphalatA arjana kareche muminagaNa
yArA tAdera nAmAye AntarikabhAve vinIta|
yArA ahetuka viSaYa theke virata thAke|
yArA yAkAta sampAdAnakArI
yArA nija lajjAsthAna saMrakSaNa kare
nijedera strI o tAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsIdera chAr3A anya sakalera theke, kenanA ete tArA nindanIYa have nA|
tave keu e chAr3A anya kichu kAmanA karale tArAi have sImAlaGghanakArI|
evaM yArA tAdera AmAnata o pratizruti rakSA kare|
evaM yArA nijedera nAmAyera paripUrNa rakSaNAvekSaNa kare
erAi hala sei oYAriza,
yArA jAnnAtula phiradAusera mIrAsa lAbha karave| tArA tAte sarvadA thAkave|
Ami mAnuSake sRSTi karechi mATira sArAMza dvArA|
tArapara tAke skhalita vindurUpe eka saMrakSita sthAne rAkhi|

tArapara Ami sei vinduke jamATa rakte pariNata kari| tArapara sei jamATa raktake gozatapiNDa vAniYe dei| tArapara sei gozatapiNDake asthite rUpAntarita kari| tArapara asthirAjite gozatera AcchAdana lAgiYe dei| tArapara tAke anya eka sRSTirUpe gar3e tuli| vastuta sakala kArigarera zreSTha kArigara AllAha kata mahAna!
ataHpara esavera para avazyai tomAdera mRtyu ghaTave|
tArapara kiYAmatera dina avazyai tomAderake punarutthita karA have|
Ami tomAdera upara sRSTi karechi sAta staraviziSTa patha| Ara sRSTi samvandhe Ami udAsIna nai|
Ami AkAza theke parimitabhAve vAri varSaNa kari, tArapara tA bhUmite saMrakSaNa kari| nizcaYai Ami tA apasAraNa karateo sakSama|
tArapara Ami tA dvArA tomAdera janya khejura o AGgurera vAgAna utpanna kari, yA dvArA tomAdera pracura phala arjita haYa evaM tA thekei tomarA khAo|
evaM sRSTi kari sei vRkSao, yA sinAi parvate janma neYa evaM yA AhArakArIdera janya tela o vyaJjanasaha utpanna haYa|

nizcaYai tomAdera janya gavAdi pazute Ache zikSA| tAra udare yA Ache tA (arthAt dudha) theke Ami tomAderake pAna karAi evaM tAra madhye tomAdera janya Ache vahu upakAritA Ara tA theke tomarA khAdya grahaNa kara|
evaM tAte o nauyAne tomAderake saoYArao karAno haYe thAke|

Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma| sutarAM se (tAra sampradAYake) valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| tavuo ki tomarA bhaYa karave nA?

takhana tAra sampradAYera kAphera pradhAnagaNa (eke aparake) valala, ei vyakti tomAderai mata ekajana mAnuSa chAr3A to kichu naYa| se tomAdera upara zreSThatva lAbha karate cAYa| AllAha cAile kona pherezatAi nAyila karatena| AmarA to emana kathA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera madhye kakhanao zunini|
(prakRtapakSe e lokaTira vyApAra ei ye,) se emanai eka loka, yAra unmattatA dekhA diYeche| sutarAM tAra vyApAre tomarA kichukAla apekSA kare dekha (haYata tAra svAbhAvika avasthA phire Asave)|
nUha valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tArA ye AmAke mithyuka sAvyasta kareche, tAte tumii AmAke sAhAyya kara|

sutarAM Ami tAra kAche ohI pAThAlAma, tumi AmAra tattvAvadhAne o AmAra ohI anusAre nauyAna nirmANa kara| tArapara yakhana AmAra hukuma Asave evaM tAnnura uthale uThave takhana pratyeka jIva theke eka-eka jor3A niYe tA sei nauyAne tule nio evaM nija parivAravargakeo, tave yAdera viruddhe Agei siddhAnta sthira haYe geche tAderake naYa| Ara se jAlemadera samvandhe AmAra saGge kona kathA valave nA| nizcaYai tAderake nimajjita karA have|
tArapara yakhana tumi evaM tomAra saGgIgaNa nauyAne ThikaThAka haYe vase yAve, takhana valave, zukara AllAhara, yini AmAderake jAlema sampradAYa theke mukti diYechena|
evaM valave, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke avataraNa karAo varakatamaYa avatAraNe| Ara tumii zreSTha avatAraNakArI|
nizcaYai ete Ache vahu nidarzana| Ara Ami to tomAderake parIkSA karArai chilAma|
ataHpara Ami tAdera para anya mAnavagoSThI sRSTi karalAma|
evaM tAdera madhye tAderai ekajanake rAsUla kare pAThAlAma, se valechila, tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| tavuo ki tomarA bhaYa karave nA?

tAra sampradAYera pradhAnagaNa, yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila o AkherAtera sAkSAtkArake asvIkAra karechila evaM yAderake Ami pArthiva jIvane pracura bhoga-sAmagrI diYechilAma, tArA eke anyake) valala, ei vyakti to tomAderai mata ekajana mAnuSa| tomarA yA khAo se tAi khAYa evaM tomarA yA pAna kara seo tAi pAna kare|
tomarA yadi tomAderai mata ekajana mAnuSera Anugatya kare vasa, tave tomarA nizcita kSatigrasta have|
se ki tomAderake ei bhaYa dekhAYa ye, tomarA yakhana mArA yAve evaM mATi o asthite pariNata have, takhana tomAderake punarAYa (mATi theke) vera karA have?
tomAderake ye viSaYera bhaYa dekhAna hacche, seTA to sampUrNa asambhava o akalpanIYa vyApAra|
jIvana to ei ihajIvanai, Ara kichu naYa| (ekhAnei) AmarA mari o vA~ci| AmAderake phera jIvita karA yAve nA|
(Ara ei ye vyakti) e to emanai eka loka, ye AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda diYeche| AmarA era prati ImAna AnAra nai|
navI valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tArA ye AmAke mithyuka ThAoriYeche, se vyApAre tumii AmAke sAhAyya kara|
AllAha valalena, alpakAlera bhetarai tArA nizcita anutapta have|
sutarAM satyii tAderake eka mahAnAda AkrAnta kare evaM Ami tAderake AvarjanAYa pariNata kari| sutarAM erUpa jAlema sampradAYera prati abhizApa|
ataHpara Ami tAdera para anyAnya mAnavagoSThI sRSTi kari|
kona jAtii tAra nirdhArita kAlera Ageo yete pAre nA evaM tAra pareo thAkate pAre nA|

ataHpara Ami AmAra rAsUlagaNake pAThAte thAki ekera para eka| yakhanai kona sampradAYera kAche tAdera rAsUla eseche, tArA avazyai tAke mithyAvAdI valeche| sutarAM Amio tAdera ekera para ekake dhvaMsa kare dei evaM tAderake pariNata kari kissA-kAhinIte| ataeva abhizApa sei sampradAYera prati, yArA ImAna Ane nA|
ataHpara Ami mUsA o tAra bhAi hArUnake AmAra nidarzanAvalI o suspaSTa pramANasaha
phira‘Auna o tAra saradAradera kAche pAThAlAma| kintu tArA ahaMkAra pradarzana karala| vastuta tArA chila eka dAmbhika sampradAYa|
ataHpara tArA valala, AmarA ki AmAderai mata du’jana mAnuSera prati ImAna Anava, athaca tAdera sampradAYa AmAdera dAsatva karache?
ebhAve tArA tAderake asvIkAra karala evaM zeSa paryanta tArAo dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta hala|
Ara Ami mUsAke diYechilAma kitAva, yAte tArA hedAYAta lAbha kare|

evaM Ami mAraYAmera putra o tAra mAke (arthAt hayarata IsA o mAraYAma AlAihimAsa sAlAmake) vAniYechilAma eka nidarzana evaM tAderake emana eka uccabhUmite AzraYa diYechilAma, yA chila zAntipUrNa evaM yekhAne pravAhita chila svaccha pAni|
he rAsUlagaNa! tomarA pavitra vastusamUha hate (yA icchA) khAo o satkarma kara| tomarA yA kara nizcaYai Ami se samparke pUrNa avagata|
vastuta eTAi tomAdera dIna, (sakalera janya) ekai dIna! Ara Ami tomAdera pratipAlaka| sutarAM AmAke bhaYa kara|
kintu tArA nijedera madhye (vivAda-visamvAde lipta haYe) tAdera dInake vahu khaNDe vibhakta kare phelala| pratiTi dala nijedera bhAvanA mate ye panthA avalamvana kareche tA niYei utphulla|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tAderake nirdiSTa eka kAla paryanta nijedera ajJatAra bhetara nimajjita thAkate dAo|
tArA ki mane kare Ami tAderake ye dhana-sampada o santAna-santati diYe yAcchi
tA dvArA tAdera kalyANa sAdhane tvarA dekhAcchi? nA, varaM (prakRta avasthA samparke) tAdera kona anubhUti nei|
nizcaYai yArA nija pratipAlakera bhaYe bhIta
evaM yArA nija pratipAlakera AYAtasamUhe ImAna rAkhe
evaM yArA nija pratipAlakera sAthe kAuke zarIka kare nA
evaM yArA ye-kona kAjai kare, tA karAra samaYa tAdera antara ei bhaYe bhIta thAke ye, tAderake nija pratipAlakera kAche phire yete have,
tArAi kalyANArjane tatparatA pradarzana karache evaM tArAi se dike agrasara hacche drutagatite|
Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyAtIta kAjera dAYitva dei nA| AmAra kAche Ache eka kitAva, yA (sakalera avasthA) yathAyathabhAve vale deve evaM tAdera prati kona juluma karA have nA|
kintu tAdera antara e viSaYe udAsInatAYa nimajjita| echAr3A tAdera Arao vahu duSkarma Ache, yA tArA kare thAke|
avazeSe Ami yakhana tAdera aizvaryazAlI vyaktiderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karava, takhana tArA ArtanAda kare uThave|
ekhana ArtanAda karo nA| AmAra pakSa hate tomarA kona sAhAyya pAve nA|
AmAra AYAtasamUha tomAderake par3e zonAno hata| kintu tomarA pichana phire sare par3ate
atyanta ahamikAra sAthe e samparke (arthAt kuraAna samparke) rAtera velA vehudA galpa-gujava karate|
tave ki tArA e vANIra bhetara cintA kareni nAki tAdera kAche emana kichu eseche, yA tAdera pUrvapuruSadera kAche Aseni?
nAki tArA tAdera rAsUlake (Age theke) cinata nA, phale tAke asvIkAra karache?
nAki tArA vale, se (arthAt rAsUla) unmAdagrasta? nA, varaM (prakRta vyApAra hala) se tAdera kAche satya niYe eseche evaM tAdera adhikAMza satya pachanda kare nA|

satya yadi tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anugAmI hata, tave AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI evaM ete vasavAsakArI savakichui viparyasta haYe yeta| prakRtapakSe Ami tAdera kAche tAdera upadezavANI niYe esechi, kintu tArA nijedera upadezavANI theke mukha phiriYe rekheche|
nAki (tAdera asvIkRtira kAraNa ei ye,) tumi tAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAo? kintu (eTAo to galada| kenanA) tomAra pratipAlaka pradatta pratidAnai (tomAra pakSe) utkRSTa| tini zreSThatama riyikadAtA|
vastuta tumi tAderake DAkacha sarala pathera dike|
yArA AkherAte vizvAsa rAkhe nA, tArA to patha theke sampUrNa vicyuta|
Ami yadi tAdera prati daYA kari evaM tArA ye duHkha-kaSTe AkrAnta Ache tA dUra kare dei, tavuo tArA vibhrAnta haYe nijedera avAdhyatAYa geA~ dhare thAke|
Ami to tAderake (ekavAra) zAstite dhRta karechilAma| takhanao tArA nija pratipAlakera sAmane nata haYani evaM tArA to kona rakama anunaYa-vinaYa kare nA|
avazeSe yakhana Ami tAdera janya kaThina zAstira duYAra khule deva, takhana sahasA tArA tAte hatAza haYe par3ave|
AllAhai to sei sattA, yini tomAdera janya kAna, cokha o antara sRSTi karechena, (kintu) tomarA var3a kamai zukara AdAYa kara|
tinii to tomAderake pRthivIte char3iYe diYechena evaM tArai kAche tomAderake ekatra karA have|
tinii jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| rAta o dinera parivartana tA~rai niYantraNe| tavuo ki tomarA vuddhi kAje lAgAve nA?
varaM tArAo se rakama kathAi vale, yemana valechila pUrvekAra loke|
tArA vale, AmarA yakhana mArA yAva evaM mATi o asthite pariNata hava, takhanao ki AmAderake punarjIvita kare tolA have?
ei pratizrutii deoYA haYeche AmAderake evaM pUrve AmAdera vApa-dAdAderakeo| vastuta eTA pUrvavartIdera tairi karA upakathA chAr3A kichui naYa|
(he rAsUla! tAderake) vala, ei pRthivI evaM ete yArA vAsa karache tArA kAra mAlikAnAYa, yadi tomarA jAna?
tArA avazyai valave, AllAhara| vala, tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?
vala, ke sAta AkAzera mAlika evaM mahA Arazera mAlika?
tArA avazyai valave, esava AllAhara| vala, tavuo ki tomarA (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?
vala, ke tini, yAra hAte savakichura pUrNa kartRtva evaM yini AzraYa dAna karena evaM tAra viparIte keu kAuke AzraYa dite pAre nA (vala) yadi jAna?
tArA avazyai valave, (samasta kartRtva) AllAhara| vala, tave kothA hate tomarA yAdugrasta haccha?
nA, (eTA upakathA naYa); varaM Ami tAdera kAche satya peৗ~chiYechi| kintu tArA to mithyAvAdI|

AllAha kona santAna grahaNa karenani evaM tAra saGge nei anya kona mAvuda| se rakama hale pratyeka mAvuda nija mAkhaluka niYe pRthaka haYe yeta, tArapara tArA eke anyera upara Adhipatya vistAra karata| tArA yA vale, tA hate AllAha pavitra,
(sei AllAha), yini yAvatIYa gupta o prakAzya viSaYe paripUrNa jJAta| sutarAM tini tAdera ziraka theke vahu urdhve|
(he rAsUla!) vala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAderake (arthAt kApheraderake) ye AyAvera dhamaki deoYA hacche, Apani yadi AmAra cokhera sAmanei tA niYe Asena
tave he AmAra pratipAlaka! Apani AmAke oi jAlema sampradAYera antarbhukta karavena nA|
Ami tAderake ye viSaYe dhamaka dicchi, tA tomAra cokhera sAmanei ghaTAte Ami avazyai sakSama|
(kintu yatakSaNa paryanta se samaYa nA Asache) tumi mandake pratihata karave emana panthAYa, yA have utkRSTa| tArA yesava kathA valache, tA Ami bhAlobhAve jAni|
evaM doYA kara, he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami zaYatAnadera prarocanA hate ApanAra AzraYa cAi|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami ApanAra kAche AzraYa cAi yAte tArA AmAra kAcheo Asate nA pAre|
parizeSe yakhana tAdera kArao mRtyu upasthita haYe yAve, takhana tArA valave, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke oYApasa pAThiYe dina

yAte Ami yA (arthAt ye duniYA) cher3e esechi sekhAne giYe satkAja karate pAri| kakhanao nA| eTA ekaTA kathAra kathA, yA se mukhe valache mAtra| tAdera (arthAt mRtadera) sAmane raYeche ‘varayakha’ yA tAderake punarutthita karAra dina paryanta vidyamAna thAkave|
ataHpara yakhana ziGgAYa phu~ deoYA have, takhana tAdera madhyakAra kona AtmIYatA vAki thAkave nA evaM keu kAuke kichu jijJesao karave nA|
takhana yAdera pAllA bhArI have tArAi saphalakAma have|
Ara yAdera pAllA hAlakA have, tArAi emana, yArA nijedera janya lokasAnera vyavasA karechila| tArA sadA-sarvadA jAhAnnAme thAkave|
Aguna tAdera cehArA jhalase deve evaM tAte tAdera AkRti vikRta haYe yAve|
(tAderake valA have) tomAderake ki AmAra AYAtasamUha par3e zonAno hata nA? kintu tomarA tA avizvAsa karate|
tArA valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera upara AmAdera durbhAgya cheYe giYechila evaM AmarA chilAma vipathagAmI sampradAYa|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake ekhAna theke uddhAra karuna| ataHpara punarAYa yadi AmarA sei kAjai kari, tave avazyai AmarA jAlema hava|
AllAha valavena, erai madhye tomarA hIna avasthAYa par3e thAka evaM AmAra sAthe kathA valo nA|
AmAra vAndAdera ekaTi dala doYA karata, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ImAna enechi| sutarAM AmAderake kSamA kare dina evaM AmAdera prati daYA karuna| Apani daYAludera madhye zreSTha daYAlu|

tomarA takhana tAderake niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karechile| emanaki tA (arthAt tAderake uttyaktakaraNa) tomAderake AmAra smaraNa paryanta bhuliYe diYechila| Ara tomarA tAderake niYe hAsi-ThATTAYa lipta thAkate|
tArA ye savara karechila se kAraNe Aja Ami tAderake emana pratidAna dilAma ye, tArAi haYe gela kRtakArya|
(tArapara) AllAha (jAhAnnAmIderake) valavena, tomarA pRthivIte vacharera gaNanAYa kata kAla thekecha?
tArA valave, AmarA eka dina vA eka dinerao kama thekechi| (AmAdera bhAlo mane nei) kAjei yArA (samaYa) guneche tAderake jijJesa karuna|
AllAha valavena, tomarA alpakAlai thekechile| katai nA bhAlo hata yadi e viSaYaTA tomarA (Agei) vujhate!
tave ki tomarA mane karechile ye, Ami tomAderake ahetuka sRSTi karechi evaM tomAderake AmAra kAche phiriYe AnA have nA?
ati mahimamaYa AllAha, yini prakRta vAdazAha| tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tini sammAnita Arazera mAlika|
ye vyakti AllAha chAr3A anya kona mAvudake DAke, ye samparke tAra kAche kona rakama dalIla-pramANa nei, tAra hisAva tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache| jene rekha, kApheragaNa saphalakAma hate pAre nA|
(he rAsUla!) vala, he AmAra pratipAlaka, AmAra truTisamUha kSamA kara o daYA kara| tumi daYAludera madhye zreSTha daYAlu|
eTi ekaTi sUrA, yA Ami nAyila karechi evaM yA (arthAt yAra vidhAnAvalI) Ami pharaya karechi evaM ete Ami nAyila karechi suspaSTa AYAtasamUha yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

vyabhicAriNI o vyabhicArI tAdera pratyekake ekazata cAvuka mArave| tomarA yadi AllAha o parakAle ImAna rAkha, tave AllAhara dInera vyApAre tAdera prati karuNAvodha yena tomAderake prabhAvita nA kare| Ara muminadera ekaTi dala yena tAdera zAsti pratyakSa kare|
vyabhicArI kevala vyabhicAriNI vA muzarika nArIkei vivAha kare| Ara vyabhicAriNIke vivAha kare kevala sei puruSa ye nije vyabhicArakArI vA muzarika| muminadera janya eTA niSiddha karA haYeche|
yArA satI-sAdhvI nArIke apavAda deYa, tArapara cArajana sAkSI upasthita kare nA| tAderake AziTi cAvuka mArave evaM tAdera sAkSya kakhanao grahaNa karave nA| tArA nijerAi to phAseka|
avazya yArA tArapara tAovA kare evaM nijeke saMzodhana kare, (tAdera janya) to AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yArA nijedera strIderake apavAda deYa, Ara nijerA chAr3A tAdera kona sAkSI thAke nA, erUpa kona vyaktira sAkSya ei ye, se cAravAra AllAhara kasama kare valave, se (strIke deoYA abhiyogera vyApAre) avazyai satyavAdI|
evaM paJcamavAra se valave, se yadi (tAra deoYA abhiyoge) mithyuka haYa, tave tAra prati AllAhara lAnata|
Ara nArITi hate (vyabhicArera) zAsti rada karAra upAYa ei ye, se cAravAra AllAhara kasama kare sAkSya deve, (kathita abhiyoge) tAra svAmI mithyAvAdI|
Ara paJcamavAra se valave, se (arthAt svAmI) satyavAdI hale tAra nijera prati AllAhara gayava par3uka|
tomAdera prati AllAhara phayala o tA~ra rahamata nA hale evaM AllAha ye atyadhika tAovA kavulakArI o hikamatera mAlika eTA nA hale (cintA kare dekha tomAdera dazA kI hata)|

nizcaYai, yArA ei mithyA apavAda racanA kare eneche tArA tomAderai madhyakAra ekaTi dala| tomarA eke tomAdera janya aniSTakara mane karo nA; varaM eTA tomAdera janya kalyANakara| tAdera pratyekera bhAge raYeche nija kRtakarmera gunAha| tAdera madhye ye vyakti era (arthAt e apavAdera) vyApAre pradhAna bhUmikA niYeche, tAra janya Ache kaThina zAsti|
yakhana tomarA tA zunale, takhana kena mumina puruSa o mumina nArIgaNa nijedera samparke sudhAraNA poSaNa karale nA evaM valale nA eTA suspaSTa mithyA?
