tArA (arthAt apavAdadAtAgaNa) e viSaYe kena cArajana sAkSI upasthita karala nA? sutarAM tArA yakhana sAkSI upasthita karala nA, takhana AllAhara nikaTa tArAi mithyuka|
duniYA o AkherAte tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA hale tomarA ye viSaYe jar3iYe par3echile tajjanya tomAderake sparza karata kaThina zAsti,

yakhana tomarA nija rasanA dvArA tA eke anyera theke pracAra karachile evaM nija mukhe emana kathA valachile, ye samparke tomAdera kichu jAnA nei Ara tomarA e vyApAraTAke mAmuli mane karachile, athaca AllAhara kAche eTA chila gurutara|
tomarA yakhana ekathA zunechile takhanai kena vale dile nA ‘ekathA mukhe AnAra kona adhikAra AmAdera nei; he AllAha! tumi pavitra| eTA to mArAtmaka apavAda|’
AllAha tomAderake upadeza dicchena, e rakama Ara kakhanao yena nA kara yadi tomarA mumina haYe thAka|
AllAha tomAdera sAmane hedAYAtera vANI suspaSTarUpe varNanA karachena| AllAha jJAnerao mAlika, hekamaterao mAlika|
smaraNa rekha, yArA muminadera madhye azlIlatAra prasAra hoka eTA kAmanA kare, tAdera janya duniYA o AkherAte Ache yantraNAmaYa zAsti evaM AllAha jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|
yadi nA tomAdera prati AllAhara phayala o rahamata thAkata evaM nA hatena AllAha ati mamatAzIla, parama daYAlu (tave rakSA pete nA tomarAo)|

he muminagaNa! tomarA zaYatAnera anugAmI haYo nA| keu zaYatAnera anugAmI hale zaYatAna to sarvadA azlIla o anyAYa kAjerai nirdeza deve| tomAdera prati AllAhara phayala o rahamata nA hale tomAdera madhye keu kakhanao pAka-pavitra hate pArata nA| kintu AllAha yAke cAna pavitra kare dena evaM AllAha sakala kathA zonena o sakala viSaYa jAnena|

tomAdera madhye yArA sampada o svacchalatAra adhikArI, tArA yena erUpa kasama nA kare ye, AtmIYa-svajana, abhAvagrasta o AllAhara pathe hijaratakArIderake kichu deve nA| tArA yena kSamA kare o audArya pradarzana kare| tomarA ki kAmanA kara nA AllAha tomAdera truTi-vicyuti kSamA karuna? AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
smaraNa rekha, yArA caritravatI, saralamatI mumina nArIdera prati apavAda Aropa kare, tArA duniYA o AkherAte abhizapta haYeche Ara tAdera janya raYeche bhaYAnaka zAsti|
ye dina tAdera kRtakarma samparke tAdera viruddhe tAdera jihvA, tAdera hAta o tAdera pA sAkSya deve
se dina AllAha tAderake tAdera upayukta pratidAna puropuri dAna karavena evaM tArA jAnate pArave AllAhai satya, tinii yAvatIYa viSaYa suspaSTakArI|

apavitra nArIgaNa apavitra puruSadera upayukta evaM apavitra puruSagaNa apavitra nArIdera upayukta| pavitra nArIgaNa pavitra puruSadera upayukta evaM pavitra puruSagaNa pavitra nArIdera upayukta| tArA (arthAt pavitra nArI-puruSa) loke yA raTanA kare tA theke sampUrNa mukta| tAdera (arthAt pavitradera) janya raYeche mAgaphirAta o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
he muminagaNa! nija gRha chAr3A anyera gRhe praveza karo nA, yatakSaNa nA anumati grahaNa kara o tAra vAsindAderake sAlAma dAo| e panthAi tomAdera janya zreYa| AzA karA yAYa, tomarA lakSa rAkhave|

tomarA yadi tAte kAuke nA pAo, tavuo yatakSaNa paryanta tomAderake anumati deoYA nA haYa, tAte praveza karo nA| tomAderake yadi valA haYa, ‘phire yAo’ tave phire yeo| eTAi tomAdera pakSe zuddhatara| tomarA yA-kichui kara, AllAha se samparke paripUrNa jJAta|

ye ghare keu vAsa kare nA evaM tAra bhetara tomAdera kona upakAra (vA praYojana) Ache, tAte tomAdera (anumati chAr3A) praveze kona gunAha nei| tomarA ye kAja prakAzye kara evaM yA gopane kara AllAha tA jAnena|
mumina puruSadera vala, tArA yena tAdera dRSTi avanata rAkhe evaM tAdera lajjAsthAnera hephAjata kare| eTAi tAdera janya zuddhatara| tArA yA-kichu kare AllAha se samparke paripUrNa avagata|

evaM mumina nArIdera vala, tArA yena tAdera dRSTi avanata rAkhe evaM tAdera lajjAsthAnera hephAjata kare evaM nijedera bhUSaNa anyadera kAche prakAza nA kare, yA Apanii prakAza pAYa tA chAr3A evaM tArA yena tAdera or3anAra A~cala nija vakSadeze nAmiYe deYa evaM nijedera bhUSaNa yena svAmI, pitA, zvazura, putra, svAmIra putra, bhAi, bhAtijA, bhAgineYa, Apana nArIgaNa, yArA nija mAlikAnAdhIna, yaunakAmanA nei emana puruSa khedamatagAra evaM nArIdera gopanIYa aGga samparke ajJa vAlaka chAr3A Ara kArao sAmane prakAza nA kare| musalima nArIdera ucita bhUmite ebhAve padakSepa nA karA, yAte tAdera gupta sAja jAnA haYe yAYa| he muminagaNa! tomarA sakale AllAhara kAche tAovA kara, yAte tomarA saphalatA arjana kara|

tomAdera madhye yArA avivAhita (tArA puruSa hoka vA nArI) tAdera vivAha sampAdana kara evaM tomAdera golAma o vA~dIdera madhye yArA vivAhera upayukta, tAderao| tArA abhAvagrasta hale AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake abhAvamukta kare divena| AllAha ati prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

yAdera vivAha karAra sAmarthya nei, tArA saMyama avalamvana karave, yatakSaNa nA AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake abhAvamukta karena| tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsa-dAsIdera madhye yArA ‘mukAtAvA’ karate cAYa, tomarA tAdera saGge mukAtAvA karave yadi tAdera madhye bhAlo kichu dekha evaM (he musalimagaNa!) AllAha tomAderake ye sampada diYechena tA theke tAderakeo dAo evaM tomarA nija dAsIderake duniYAra dhana-sampada arjanera janya vyabhicAre vAdhya karo nA yadi tArA putapavitra thAkate cAYa| keu tAderake vAdhya karale, tAderake vAdhya karAra para (tArA kSamAra AzA rAkhate pAre| kenanA) AllAha to ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ami tomAdera prati nAyila karechi pratiTi viSaYera spaSTakAraka AYAta, tomAdera pUrvavartI jAtisamUhera dRSTAnta evaM muttAkIdera janya upakArI upadeza|

AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra nUra| tA~ra nUrera dRSTAnta yena eka tAka, yAte Ache eka pradIpa| pradIpaTi ekaTi kAcera AvaraNera bhetara| yena tA (arthAt kAca) nakSatra, muktAra mata ujjvala| pradIpaTi prajvalita varakatapUrNa yaYatuna vRkSera tela dvArA, yA (kevala) puverao naYa, (kevala) pazcimera naYa| mane haYa, yena Agunera cheA~YA nA lAgaleo tA emanii Alo deve| nUrera upara nUra| AllAha yAke cAna tAke nija nUre upanIta karena| AllAha mAnuSera kalyANArthe dRSTAnta varNanA karena| AllAha pratiTi viSaYe samyaka jJAta|
AllAha ye gharagulike uccamaryAdA dite evaM tAte tA~ra nAma uccAraNa karate Adeza karechena, tAte sakAla o sandhyAYa tAsavIha pATha kare
emana loka, yAderake vyavasA-vANijya o vecAkenA AllAhara smaraNa, nAmAya kAYema o yAkAta AdAYa theke gAphela karate pAre nA| tArA bhaYa kare sei dinake, ye dina antara o dRSTi olaTa-pAlaTa haYe yAve|
phale AllAha tAderake tAdera kAjera uttama vinimaYa dAna karavena evaM nija anugrahe atirikta Arao kichu divena| AllAha yAke cAna, tAke dAna karena aparimita|

evaM (anyadike) yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tAdera kAryAvalI yena marubhUmira marIcikA, yAke pipAsArta loka mane kare pAni, avazeSe yakhana se tAra kAche peৗ~che, takhana vujhate pAre tA kichui naYa| sekhAne se pAYa AllAhake| AllAha tAra hisAva paripUrNarUpe cukiYe dena| AllAha ati druta hisAva grahItA|

athavA (tAdera kAryAvalI) yena gabhIra samudre vistRta andhakAra, yAke Acchanna kare taraGga, yAra upara Areka taraGga evaM tAra upara megharAzi| starera upara stare vinyasta AdhArapuJja| keu yakhana nija hAta vera kare, tAo dekhate pAYa nA| vastuta AllAha yAke Alo nA dena, tAra nasIve kona Alo nei|

tumi ki dekhani AsamAna o yamIne yA-kichu Ache, tArA AllAharai tAsavIha pATha kare evaM pAkhirAo, yArA pAkhA vistAra kare ur3ache| pratyekerai nija-nija nAmAya o tAsavIhera paddhati jAnA Ache| AllAha tAdera yAvatIYa kAja samparke puropuri jJAta|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra rAjatva AllAharai evaM AllAharai dike (sakalera) phire yete have|

tomarA ki dekhani AllAha meghamAlA hA~kiYe nena, tArapara tAke paraspara jur3e dena, tArapara tAke puJjIbhUta ghanaghaTAYa pariNata karena| tArapara tomarA tAra bhetara theke vRSTi nirgata hate dekha| tini AkAze (megharUpe) ye parvatamAlA Ache, tA theke zilA varSaNa karena| tArapara tA dvArA yAke cAna vipanna karena evaM yAra theke icchA haYa, tA anya dike phiriYe dena| tAra vidyutera jhalaka dRSTizakti ker3e neoYAra upakrama kare|
AllAha rAta o dinake parivartita karena| nizcaYai era madhye cakSuSmAnadera janya zikSA Ache|

AllAha bhUmite vicaraNakArI pratiTi jIva sRSTi karechena pAni dvArA| tAra madhye kataka emana, yArA peTe bhara kare cale, kataka emana, yArA du’ pAYe bhara kare cale evaM kataka emana, yArA cAra pAYe bhara kare cale| AllAha yA cAna tAi sRSTi karena| nizcaYai AllAha savaviSaYe sakSama|
nizcaYai Ami (satya) parisphuTanakArI AYAtasamUha nAyila karechi| AllAha yAke cAna sarala pathe peৗ~che dena|

tArA (arthAt munAphikagaNa) vale, AmarA AllAhara prati o rAsUlera prati ImAna enechi evaM AmarA anugata haYechi| ataHpara tAdera ekaTi dala eraparao mukha phiriYe neYa| (prakRtapakSe) tArA mumina naYa|
tAderake yakhana AllAha o tAra rAsUlera dike DAkA haYa, yAte rAsUla tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dena, takhana sahasA tAdera ekaTi dala mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ara yadi tAdera haka usula karAra thAke, tave atyanta vAdhyagata haYe rAsUlera kAche cale Ase|
tave ki tAdera antare kona vyAdhi Ache, nA ki tArA sandehe nipatita, nA tArA AzaGkAvodha kare ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tAdera prati juluma karavena? nA, varaM tArA nijerAi julumakArI|

muminaderake yakhana AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera dike DAkA haYa, yAte rAsUla tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dena, takhana tAdera kathA kevala eTAi haYa ye, tArA vale AmarA (hukuma) zunalAma evaM mene nilAma| Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare, AllAhake bhaYa kare o tAra avAdhyatA parihAra kare cale, tArAi kRtakArya haYa|

tArA (arthAt munAphikagaNa)| atyanta jorAlobhAve AllAhara nAme zapatha kare ye, (he navI!) tumi nirdeza dile tArA avazyai vera have| (tAderake) vale dAo, tomarA zapatha karo nA| (tomAdera) Anugatya sakalera jAnA| tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha nizcaYai tAra puropuri khavara rAkhena|

(tAderake) vale dAo, AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM Anugatya kara rAsUlera| tathApi yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe rAkha, tave rAsUlera dAYa tataTukui, yataTukura dAYitva tAra upara arpaNa karA haYeche| Ara tomAdera upara ye bhAra arpita haYeche, tAra dAYa tomAderai upara| tomarA tA~ra Anugatya karale hedAYAta peYe yAve| rAsUlera dAYitva to kevala pariSkArabhAve peৗ~che deoYA|

tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, AllAha tAderake pratizruti diYechena ye, tini avazyai tAderake pRthivIte nija khalIphA vAnAvena, yemana khalIphA vAniYechilena tAdera pUrvavartIderake evaM tAdera janya tini sei dInake avazyai pratiSThA dAna karavena, ye dInake tAdera janya manonIta karechena evaM tArA ye bhaYa-bhItira madhye Ache, tAra parivarte tAderake avazyai nirApattA dAna karavena| tArA AmAra ivAdata karave| AmAra sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karave nA| eraparao yArA akRtajJatA karave, tArAi avAdhya sAvyasta have|
nAmAya kAYema kara, yAkAta AdAYa kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yAte tomAdera prati daYA karA haYa|
yArA kupharera patha avalamvana kareche tumi kichutei tAderake mane karo nA pRthivIte (kothAo pAliYe giYe) tArA AmAke akSama kare deve| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| nizcaYai tA ati manda ThikAnA|

he muminagaNa! tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsa-dAsIgaNa evaM tomAdera madhye yArA ekhanao sAvAlakatve peৗ~cheni sei zizugaNa yena tinaTi samaYe (tomAdera kAche AsAra janya) anumati grahaNa kare phajarera nAmAyera Age, dupura velA yakhana tomarA pozAka khule rAkha evaM izAra nAmAyera para| e tinaTi tomAdera gopanIYatA avalamvanera samaYa| e chAr3A anya samaYe tomAdera o tAdera prati kona kaThoratA nei| tomAdera parasparera madhye to sArvakSaNika yAtAYAta thAkei| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera kAche AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAve varNanA kare thAkena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

evaM tomAdera zizurA sAvAlakatve upanIta hale tArAo yena anumati grahaNa kare, yemana tAdera Age vaYaHprAptagaNa anumati grahaNa kare Asache| ebhAvei AllAha nija AYAtasamUha tomAdera kAche spaSTabhAve varNanA kare thAkena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

ye vRddhA nArIdera vivAhera kona AzA nei, tAdera janya ete kona gunAha nei ye, tArA nijedera (vAr3ati) kApar3a (vahirvAsa, gAYare mAharAma puruSadera sAmane) khule rAkhave, saundarya pradarzanera icchA vyatireke| Ara yadi tArA sAvadhAnatA avalamvana kare, tave seTAi tAdera pakSe zreYa| AllAha savakichu zonena o sakala viSaYa jAnena|

andhera janya gunAha nei, khor3A vyaktira janya gunAha nei, asustha vyaktira janya gunAha nei evaM nei tomAdera nijedera janyao, tomAdera nijedera ghare AhAra karAte vA tomAdera vApa-dAdAra ghare, tomAdera mAYedera ghare, tomAdera bhAidera ghare, tomAdera vonadera ghare, tomAdera cAcAdera ghare, tomAdera phuphudera ghare, tomAdera mAmAdera ghare, tomAdera khAlAdera ghare vA emana kona ghare yAra cAvi tomAdera kartRtvAdhIna kiMvA tomAdera vandhudera ghare| tomarA ekatre khAo vA pRthaka-pRthaka tAteo tomAdera kona gunAha nei| yakhana tomarA ghare Dhukave nijedera lokaderake sAlAma karave kAraNa eTA sAkSAtera janya AllAhara pakSa hate pradatta varakatapUrNa o pavitra doYA| ebhAvei AllAha AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

mumina to kevala tArAi, yArA AllAha o tAra rAsUlake AntarikabhAve mAne evaM yakhana rAsUlera sAthe samaSTigata kona kAje zarIka haYa, takhana tAra anumati chAr3A kothAo yAYa nA| (he navI!) yArA tomAra anumati neYa, tArAi AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake satyikArabhAve mAne| sutarAM tArA yakhana tAdera kona kAjera janya tomAra kAche anumati cAYa, takhana tAdera madhye yAke icchA haYa anumati dio evaM tAdera janya AllAhara kAche mAgaphirAtera doYA kara| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(he mAnuSa!) tomarA nijedera madhye rAsUlera DAkake tomAdera pArasparika DAkera mata (mAmuli) mane karo nA; tomAdera madhye yArA eke anyera Ar3Ala niYe cupisAre sare par3e AllAha tAderake bhAlo kare jAnena| sutarAM yArA tA~ra Adezera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tAdera bhaYa karA ucita nA jAni tAdera upara kona vipada Apatita haYa athavA yantraNAdAYaka kona zAsti tAderake AkrAnta kare|

smaraNa rekha, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache sava AllAharai mAlikAnAdhIna| tomarA ye avasthAYai thAka, AllAha tA bhAlobhAve jAnena| ye dina sakalake tAra kAche phiriYe neoYA have, se dina tini tAderake tArA yA-kichu karata tA jAniYe devena| AllAha pratiTi viSaYa samparke samyaka jJAta|
mahimamaYa sei sattA, yini nija vAndAra prati satya o mithyAra madhye mImAMsAkArI kitAva nAyila karechena, yAte tA vizvavAsIra janya haYa satarkakArI|

sei sattA, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatvera ekamAtra mAlika| yini kona putra grahaNa karenani evaM rAjatve nei tA~ra kona aMzIdAra| Ara yini pratiTi vastuke sRSTi kare tAke dAna karechena eka sunirdiSTa parimiti|

Ara mAnuSa tAke cher3e emana sava mAvuda grahaNa kare niYeche, yArA kona kichu sRSTi karate pAre nA; varaM khoda tAderakei sRSTi karA haYa| tAdera nei khoda nijederao kona kSati vA upakAra karAra kSamatA| Ara nA Ache kArao mRtyu o jIvana dAna kiMvA kAuke punarujjIvita karAra kSamatA|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA vale, eTA (arthAt kuraAna) eka managar3A jinisa chAr3A kichui naYa, yA se nije racanA kareche evaM apara eka goSThI tAke e kAje sAhAyya kareche| ebhAve (e mantavya kare) tArA ghora juluma o prakAzya mithyAcAre lipta haYeche|
evaM tArA vale, eTA to pUrvavartI lokadera lekhA AkhyAna, yA se likhiYe niYeche| sakAla-sandhyAYa seTAi tAra sAmane par3e zonAno haYa|
vale dAo, eTA (ei vANI) to nAyila karechena sei sattA, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra yAvatIYa gupta rahasya jAnena| nizcaYai tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
evaM tArA vale, e kemana rAsUla, ye khAvAra khAYa evaM hATe-vAjAreo calApherA kare? tAra kAche kona phirizatA avatIrNa karA hala nA kena, ye tAra saGge thAkata ekajana satarkakArIrUpe?
athavA tAke kona dhanabhANDArai deoYA hata kiMvA tAra thAkata kona vAgAna, yA theke se khete pArata? jAlemagaNa (musalimaderake) Arao vale, tomarA to ekajana yAdugrasta vyaktirai anusaraNa karacha|
(he navI!) dekha, tArA tomAra samparke kemana sava upamA peza karache! phale tArA emanai vibhrAnta haYeche ye, saThika pathe AsA tAdera pakSe sambhavai naYa|

mahimamaYa sei sattA, yini icchA karale tomAke tAra ceYe utkRSTa jinisa dite pArena| (kevala ekaTi naYa) dite pArena emana vahu vAgAna, yAra nice vahamAna thAkave nada-nadI evaM tomAke vAnAte pArena vahu aTTAlikAra mAlika|
prakRta vyApAra hala, tArA kiYAmatake mithyA sAvyasta kareche, Ara ye-keu kiYAmatake mithyA sAvyasta kare Ami tAra janya prajvalita Aguna tairi kare rekhechi|
tA yakhana dUra theke tAderake dekhave, takhana tArA zunate pAve tAra pheA~sa-pheA~sAni o garjanadhvani|
yakhana tAderake bhAlobhAve ve~dhe tAra kona eka saMkIrNa sthAne nikSepa karA have, takhana tArA mRtyuke DAkave|
(takhana tAderake valA have,) Aja tomarA mRtyuke kevala ekavAra Deka nA; varaM mRtyuke DAkate thAka vAravAra|
vala, ei pariNAma zreYa, nA sthAYIbhAve thAkAra jAnnAta, yAra pratizruti muttAkIderake deoYA haYeche? tA have tAdera puraskAra o tAdera zeSa pariNAma|
tArA sekhAne sthAYIbhAve vasavAsarata theke yA cAve tAi pAve| eTA emana eka dAYitvapUrNa pratizruti, yA tomAra pratipAlaka nijera prati avadhArita karechena|

evaM (tAderake sei dinera kathA smaraNa kariYe dAo) ye dina AllAha (hAzarera maYadAne) ekatra karavena tAderake evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdata karata tAderakeo| tArapara tini tAdera (sei mAvudaderake) valavena, tomarAi ki AmAra oi vAndAderake vipathagAmI karechile, nA tArA nijerAi vipathagAmI haYechila?

tArA valave, ApanAra sattA sakala doSa-truTi theke pavitra! AmarA ApanAra parivarte anyAnya abhibhAvaka grahaNa karate pAri nA| kintu vyApAra hala, Apani tAderake o tAdera vApa-dAdAderake duniYAra bhoga-sambhAra diYechilena, pariNAme tArA upadeza bhule giYechila| Ara (ebhAve) tArA haYe giYechila eka dhvaMsaprApta jAti|

dekha, (he kApheragaNa!) tomarA yA valacha, se vyApAre to tArA tomAderake mithyuka sAvyasta karala| sutarAM (zAsti) TalAnora vA sAhAyya lAbhera sAdhya tomAdera nei| tomAdera madhye ye-keu julumera kAje jar3ita, tAke Ami kaThina zAstira svAda grahaNa karAva|

(he navI!) tomAra pUrve yata rAsUlai pAThiYechi, tArA sakale khAvAra kheta o vAjAre calApherA karata| Ami tomAdera ekajanake anyajanera janya parIkSAsvarUpa karechi| vala, tomarA ki savara karave? tomAra pratipAlaka savakichui dekhachena|

yArA AmAra saGge sAkSAtera AzAi kare nA, tArA vale, AmAdera prati phirizatA avatIrNa karA haYa nA kena? kiMvA AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakake dekhate pAi nA kena? vastuta tArA Apana mane nijederake aneka var3a gaNya kare evaM tArA gurutara avAdhyatAYa lipta raYeche|
ye dina tArA phirizatAdera dekhate pAve, se dina aparAdhIdera Ananda karAra kona suyoga thAkave nA| varaM tArA valate thAkave, (he AllAha!) AmAderake dAo, ‘eka alaGghanIYa antarAYa’|
tArA (duniYAYa) yA-kichu Amala kareche, Ami tAra phAYasAlA karate Asava evaM seguloke zUnye vikSipta dhulovAli (-era mata mUlyahIna) kare deva|
se dina jAnnAtavAsIdera vAsasthAna have utkRSTa evaM vizrAmasthala have manorama|
ye dina AkAza vidIrNa haYe eka meghake patha kare deve evaM phirizatAderake avatIrNa karA have lAgAtAra|
se dina satyikArera rAjatva have daYAmaYa (AllAha)-era Ara se dinaTi kApheradera janya have ati kaThina|
evaM ye dina jAlema vyakti (manastApe) nijera hAta kAmar3Ave evaM valave, hAYa! Ami yadi rAsUlera sAthe patha dharatAma!
hAYa AmAra durbheAga! Ami yadi amuka vyaktike vandhurUpe grahaNa nA karatAma!
AmAra kAche to upadeza ese giYechila, kintu se (oi vandhu) AmAke tA theke dUre sariYe diYechila| Ara zaYatAna to (emanai caritrera ye, samaYakAle se) mAnuSake asahAYa avasthAYa phele cale yAYa|
Ara rAsUla (sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) valave, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra sampradAYa e kuraAnake vilakula parityAga karechila|
ebhAvei Ami pratyeka navIra zatru vAniYechilAma aparAdhIderake| tomAra pratipAlakai hedAYAtakArI o sAhAyyakArI hiseve yatheSTa|

kApheragaNa vale, tAra prati sampUrNa kuraAna ekavArei nAyila karA hala nA kena? (he navI!) Ami erUpa karechi era mAdhyame tomAra antara majavuta rAkhAra janya| Ara Ami to eTA pATha kariYechi theme theme|
yakhanai tArA tomAra kAche kona samasyA niYe hAjira haYa, Ami tomAke dAna kari (tAra) yathAyatha samAdhAna o sundara vyAkhyA|
yAderake ekatra kare mukhe bhara diYe calA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike niYe yAoYA have, tAderai sthAna ati nikRSTa evaM patha sarvApekSA bhrAnta|
nizcaYai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma evaM tAra sAthe tAra bhAi hArUnake sahayogI vAniYechilAma|
Ami valechilAma, ye sampradAYa AmAra nidarzanAvalI pratyAkhyAna kareche, tomarA tAdera kAche yAo| parizeSe Ami tAderake sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa kare phelalAma|

evaM nUhera sampradAYa yakhana rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karala, takhana Ami tAderake nimajjita karalAma evaM tAderake mAnuSera janya dRSTAnta vAniYe dilAma| Ami se jAlemadera janya yantraNAmaYa zAsti prastuta rekhechi|
ebhAvei Ami Ada, chAmuda o AsahAvura rAsas evaM tAdera mAjhakhAne vahu sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi|
tAdera pratyekake vojhAnora janya Ami dRSTAnta diYechilAma| Ara (tArA yakhana mAneni takhana) pratyekakei Ami piSTa kare pheli|

tArA (arthAt makkAra kApheragaNa) sei janapadera upara diYe yAtAYAta kareche, yAra upara varSaNa karA haYechila manda (pAtharera) vRSTi| tArA ki se janapadaTike dekhate peta nA? (tA sattveo tAdera zikSAlAbha haYani); varaM punarutthita haoYAra AzaGkAi tArA karata nA|
(he rAsUla!) tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana tArA kevala tomAke ThATTA-vidrUperai pAtra vAnAYa| tArA vale, ei vujhi sei, yAke AllAha navI vAniYe pAThiYechena?

AmarA nija devatAdera prati (bhakti-vizvAse) avicalita nA thAkale se to AmAderake prAYa vibhrAnta kare phelachilai| (yArA esava kathA vale,) tArA yakhana zAsti pratyakSa karave, takhana tArA jAnate pArave ke saThika patha theke sampUrNa vicyuta chila|
AcchA vala to ye vyakti nijera kupravRttike Apana mAvuda vAniYe niYeche, (he navI!) tumi ki tAra dAYa-dAYitva nite pArave|
nAki tumi mane kara tAdera adhikAMze zone athavA vojhe? nA, tArA to catuSpada jantura mata; varaM tArA tAra ceYeo vezi vipathagAmI|

tumi ki nija pratipAlakera (kudaratera) prati lakSa karani ye, tini kibhAve chAYAke samprasArita karena? tini icchA karale tA sthira rAkhate pAratena| ataHpara Ami sUryake tAra pathanirdezaka vAniYe diYechi|
ataHpara Ami alpa-alpa kare tAke nijera dike guTiYe Ani|
tinii rAtake tomAdera janya karechena pozAka-svarUpa evaM ghumake zAntimaYa| Ara dinake phera uThe dA~r3Anora mAdhyama vAniYechena|
tinii nija rahamata (arthAt vRSTi)-era Age vAYu pAThAna (vRSTira) susaMvAdavAhIrUpe evaM Ami AkAza theke varSaNa kari pavitra pAni
tA dvArA mRta bhUmike saJjIvita karA evaM AmAra sRSTa vahu jIvajantu o mAnuSake tA pAna karAnora janya|
Ami mAnuSera kalyANArthe tAke (arthAt pAnike) AvartamAna kare rekhechi, yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare, kintu adhikAMza loka akRtajJatA chAr3A kona kichute sammata naYa|
Ami icchA karale pratiTi janapade eka svatantra satarkakArI (navI) pAThAte pAratAma|
sutarAM (he navI!) tumi kApheradera kathA zuno nA; varaM e kuraAnera mAdhyame tAdera viruddhe sarvazaktite saMgrAma cAliYe yAo|
tinii dui nadIke militabhAve pravAhita karechena, yAra ekaTi miSTi, tRptikara evaM ekaTi lonA, atyanta kaTu| ubhaYera mAjhakhAne rekhe diYechena eka Ar3Ala o alaMghanIYa prativandhaka|
tinii pAni dvArA mAnuSake sRSTi karechena, tArapara tAke vaMzagata o vaivAhika AtmIYatA dAna karechena| tomAra pratipAlaka sarvazaktimAna|
tArA AllAhara parivarte emana sava vastura ivAdata karache, yA tAdera kona upakAra karate pAre nA evaM apakArao naYa| vastuta kAphera vyakti nija pratipAlakera ghora virodhi|
(he navI!) Ami to tomAke kevala ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpei pAThiYechi|
vale dAo, Ami e kAjera janya tomAdera theke kona pArizramika cAi nA| tave ye icchA kare, se tAra pratipAlakera kAche peৗ~chAra patha avalamvana karuka (seTAi have AmAra pratidAna)|
tumi nirbhara kara sei sattAra upara, yini ciraJjIva yAra mRtyu nei evaM tA~rai prazaMsAra sAthe tAsavIha AdAYa karate thAka| nija vAndAdera gunAhera khavara rAkhAra janya tinii yatheSTa|
yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena chaYa dine, tArapara tini Araze ‘isatioYA’ grahaNa karechena| tini ‘rahamAna’| tA~ra (mahimA) samparke jijJesa kara kona jJAtajanake|
tAderake yakhana valA haYa, ‘rahamAna’ke sijadA kara, tArA vale rahamAna kI? tumi ye-kAuke sijadA karate valalei ki AmarA tAke sijadA karava? ete tArA Arao vezi vimukha haYe par3e|
mahimamaYa sei sattA, yini AkAze ‘vurUja’ vAniYechena evaM tAte eka ujjvala pradIpa o Alo vistArakArI cA~da sRSTi karechena|

evaM tinii sei sattA, yini rAta o dinake parasparera anugAmI kare sRSTi karechena (kintu esava viSaYa upakAre Ase kevala) sei vyaktira janya, ye upadeza grahaNera icchA rAkhe kiMvA kRtajJatA jJApana karate cAYa|
rahamAnera vAndA tArA, yArA bhUmite namrabhAve calApherA kare evaM ajJaloka yakhana tAderake lakSya kare (ajJatAsulabha) kathA vale, takhana tArA zAntipUrNa kathA vale|
evaM yArA rAta ativAhita kare nija pratipAlakera sAmane (kakhanao) sijadArata avasthAYa evaM (kakhanao) daNDAYamAna avasthAYa|
evaM yArA vale, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! jAhAnnAmera AyAva AmAdera theke dUre rAkhuna| nizcaYai tAra AyAva sadA saMlagna haYe thAke|
nizcaYai avasthAnasthala o vAsasthAna hiseve tA ati nikRSTa|
evaM yArA vyaYa karAra samaYa nA kare apavyaYa evaM nA kare kArpaNya; varaM tA haYa ubhaYera mAjhakhAne bhArasAmyamAna|

evaM yArA AllAhara saGge anya kona mAvudera ivAdata kare nA evaM AllAha ye prANake maryAdA dAna karechena, tAke anyAYabhAve vadha kare nA evaM tArA vyabhicAra kare nA| ye vyaktii erUpa karave tAke tAra gunAhera (zAstira) sammukhIna hate have|
kiYAmatera dina tAra zAsti vRddhi kare dviguNa karA have evaM se lAJchita avasthAYa tAte sadA-sarvadA thAkave|
tave keu tAovA karale, ImAna Anale evaM satkarma karale, AllAha erUpa lokadera pAparAzike puNya dvArA parivartita kare devena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
evaM ye vyakti tAovA kare o satkarma kare, se mUlata AllAhara dike yathAyathabhAve phire Ase|
evaM (rahamAnera vAndA tArA) yArA anyAYa kAje zAmila haYa nA evaM yakhana kona vehudA kAryakalApera nikaTa diYe yAYa, takhana AtmasammAna vA~ciYe yAYa|
evaM yakhana tAdera pratipAlakera AYAta dvArA tAderake upadeza deoYA haYa, takhana tArA vadhira o andharUpe tAra upara patita haYa nA|
evaM yArA (ei) vale (doYA kare ye), he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake AmAdera strI o santAnadera pakSa hate dAna kara naYanaprIti evaM AmAderake muttAkIdera netA vAnAo|
erAi tArA, yAderake tAdera savarera pratidAne jAnnAtera suucca prAsAda deoYA have evaM sekhAne zubhecchA o sAlAmera sAthe tAdera abhyarthanA karA have|
tArA tAte sthAYI jIvana lAbha karave| avasthAnasthala o vAsasthAna hiseve tA ati uttama|

(he rAsUla! mAnuSake) vale dAo, tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakake nA DAkale tAra kichui Ase yAYa nA| Ara (he kApheragaNa!) tomarA to satya pratyAkhyAna karecha| acirei e pratyAkhyAna tomAdera galalagna haYe yAve|
tva-sIna-mIma|
eguli satyake suspaSTakArI kitAvera AYAta|
(he rAsUla!) tArA ImAna (kena) Anache nA, ei duHkhe haYata tumi AtmavinAzI haYe yAve!
Ami icchA karale AkAza theke kona nidarzana avatIrNa karatAma, phale tAra sAmane tAdera ghAr3a nuYe yeta|
(tAdera avasthA to ei ye,) tAdera sAmane daYAmaYa AllAhara pakSa hate yakhanai natuna kona upadeza Ase, takhanai tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
ebhAve tArA to satya pratyAkhyAna kareche| sutarAM tArA ye viSaYa niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata, acirei tAra prakRta saMvAda tAdera kAche ese yAve|
tArA ki bhUmira prati lakSya kareni, Ami tAte sarvaprakAra utkRSTa vastu hate kata kichu utpanna karechi?
nizcaYai era madhye Ache nidarzana| tathApi tAdera adhikAMzei ImAna Ane nA|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka tinii parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
(sei samaYera vRttAnta zona), yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka mUsAke Deke valechilena, tumi oi jAlema sampradAYera kAche yAo
pherAunera sampradAYera kAche| tArA ki AllAhake bhaYa kare nA?
mUsA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra AzaGkA tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valave|
AmAra antara saGkucita haYe yAcche evaM AmAra jihvAo svacchande cale nA| sutarAM hArUnera kAcheo (navuoYAtera) vArtA pAThAna
Ara AmAra viruddhe to tAdera ekaTA abhiyogao Ache| tAi AmAra bhaYa, tArA AmAke hatyA karave|
AllAha valalena, kakhanao naYa| tomarA AmAra nidarzanAvalI niYe yAo| nizcaYai Ami tomAdera saGge Achi, savakichu zunate thAkava|
sutarAM tomarA phira‘Aunera kAche yAo evaM vala, AmarA rAvvula AlAmInera rAsUla|
(AmarA ei vArtA niYe esechi ye,) tumi vanI isarAIlake AmAdera saGge yete dAo|
pherAuna (ekathAra uttare hayarata mUsA AlAihisa sAlAmake) valala, AmarA ki tomAke tomAra zizukAle AmAdera madhye lAlana-pAlana karini? tumi to tomAra jIvanera vahu vachara AmAdera mAjhei kATiYecha|
Ara tomAra ye kANDa tumi karechile se to karechai| vastuta tumi ekajana akRtajJa loka|
mUsA valala, Ami se kAjaTi emana avasthAYa karechilAma yakhana Ami chilAma ajJa|
ataHpara Ami yakhana tomAderake bhaYa karalAma, takhana tomAdera theke pAliYe gelAma| tArapara AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke hekamata dAna karalena evaM AmAke rAsUladera antarbhukta karalena|
AmAra prati tomAra ye anugrahera kheA~TA diccha, tAra svarUpa to ei ye, tumi vanI isarAIlake dAsa vAniYe rekhecha|
pherAuna valala, rAvvula AlAmIna AvAra kI?
mUsA valala, tini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o e duYera madhyavartI savakichura pratipAlaka yadi tomAdera vAstavikai vizvAsa karAra thAke|
pherAuna tAra AzapAzera lokaderake valala, tomarA zunacha ki nA?
mUsA valala, tini tomAdera pratipAlaka evaM tomAdera pUrvapuruSaderao pratipAlaka|
pherAuna valala, tomAdera ei rAsUla, yAke tomAdera kAche pAThAno haYeche, ekevArei unmAda!
mUsA valala, tini prAcya o pratIcyera pratipAlaka evaM e duYera antarvartI samasta kichurao yadi tomarA vuddhira sadvyavahAra kara|
se valala, (mane rekha) tumi yadi AmAke chAr3A anya kAuke mAvuda vale grahaNa kara, tave Ami tomAke avazyai yArA jele par3e Ache, tAdera antarbhukta karava|
mUsA valala, Ami yadi (satyake) parisphuTakArI kona jinisa tomAra nikaTa upasthita kari, tavuo ki?
pherAuna valala, Accha, tumi satyavAdI haYe thAkale tA upasthita kara|
sutarAM mUsA tAra lAThi nikSepa karala, tatkSaNAt tA sAkSAt ajagara haYe gela|
evaM se tAra hAta (vagalera bhetara theke) Tene vera karala, amani tA darzakadera sAmane sAdA haYe gela|
pherAuna tAra AzapAzera netRvargake valala, nizcaYai se ekajana sudakSa yAdukara|
se tAra yAduvale tomAderake tomAdera deza theke utkhAta karate cAYa| evAra vala, tomAdera abhimata kI?
tArA valala, tAke o tAra bhAike kichuTA samaYa dina evaM nagare-nagare saMvAdavAhaka pAThiYe dina
yArA yata sudakSa yAdukara Ache, tAderake ApanAra kAche niYe Asave (tArapara mUsA o tAdera madhye pratidvandvitA hoka)|
sutarAM nirdhArita eka dina sunirdiSTa samaYe yAdukaradera ekatra karA hala|
evaM mAnuSake valA hala, tomarA samaveta haccha to?
haYata AmarA yAdukaradera anugAmI hate pArava yadi tArAi jaYI haYa|
tArapara yakhana yAdukaragaNa Asala, takhana tArA phira‘Aunake valala, eTA to nizcita ye, AmarA vijaYI hale AmAdera janya kona puraskAra thAkave?
phira‘Auna valala, hA~ evaM takhana tomarA avazyai AmAra ghaniSTajanadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|
musA yAdukaraderake valala, tomAdera yA nikSepa karAra tA nikSepa kara|
takhana tArA tAdera razi o lAThi mATite phele dila evaM valala, phira‘Aunera ijjatera zapatha! AmarAi vijaYI hava|
ataHpara musA nija lAThi mATite nikSepa karala| amani tA (ajagara haYe) tArA michAmichi yA tairi karechila tA grAsa karate lAgala|
anantara yAdukaraderake sijadAYa pAtita karA hala|
tArA valate lAgala, AmarA ImAna AnalAma rAvvula AlAmInera prati
yini musA o hArUnera pratipAlaka|

pherAuna valala, Ami anumati deoYAra Agei tomarA mUsAra prati ImAna Anale? nizcaYai se tomAdera sakalera guru, ye tomAderake yAdu zikSA diYeche| AcchA, tomarA ekhanai jAnate pArave| Ami avazyai tomAdera sakalera eka dikera hAta o anya dikera pA keTe phelava evaM tomAdera sakalake zUle car3iYe chAr3ava|
yAdukaragaNa valala, AmAdera kona kSati nei| AmarA vizvAsa kari, AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera kAche phire yAva|
AmarA AzA kari, AmAdera pratipAlaka e kAraNe AmAdera pAparAzi kSamA karavena ye, AmarA sakalera Age ImAna enechi|
Ami mUsAra kAche ohI pAThAlAma, AmAra vAndAderake niYe tumi rAtArAti raoYAnA haYe yAo| tomAdera kintu avazyai pazcAddhAvana karA have|
ataHpara phira‘Auna zahare zahare saMvAdavAhaka pAThiYe dila
(ei vale ye,) tArA (arthAt vanI isarAIla) choTTa ekaTA dalera alpakichu loka|
nizcaYai tArA AmAdera pracaNDabhAve kruddha kare tuleche!
Ara AmarA satarka (sazastra) ekaTi var3a dala (sutarAM sakale sammilitabhAve tAdera pazcAddhAvana kara)|
ebhAve Ami tAderake vera kare AnalAma udyAnarAji o prasravaNa hate
evaM dhanabhANDAra o maryAdApUrNa sthAnasamUha theke|
e rakamai haYechila tAdera vyApAra| Ara (anya dike) Ami vanI isarAIlake vAniYe dilAma tAra uttarAdhikArI|
sArakathA sUryeAdaYa mAtrai tArA tAdera pazcAddhAvanera uddezye vera haYe par3ala|
tArapara yakhana ubhaYa dala eke anyake dekhate pela, takhana musAra saGgIgaNa valala, ekhana AmarA nirghAta dharA par3ava|
musA valala, kakhanao naYa| AmAra saGge nizcitabhAvei AmAra pratipAlaka Achena| tini AmAke patha dekhAvena|
sutarAM Ami mUsAra kAche ohI pAThAlAma, tumi tomAra lAThi dvArA sAgare AghAta kara| phale sAgara vidIrNa hala evaM pratyeka bhAga var3a pAhAr3era mata u~cu haYe gela|
anya dalaTikeo Ami sethAYa upanIta karalAma|
evaM mUsA o tAra saGgI sakalake rakSA karalAma|
tArapara anyaderake karalAma nimajjita|
nizcaYa era madhye zikSAra viSaYa raYeche| tA sattveo tAdera adhikAMzei ImAna Ane nA|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu
(he navI!) tAderake zonAo ivarAhImera vRttAnta|
yakhana se tAra pitA o sampradAYake valala, tomarA kisera ivAdata kara|
tArA valala, AmarA pratimAdera ivAdata kari evaM tAderai sAmane dharNA diYe thAki|
ivarAhIma valala, tomarA yakhana tAderake DAka, takhana tArA ki tomAdera kathA zone?
kiMvA tArA ki tomAdera kona upakAra vA kSati karate pAre?
tArA valala, Asala kathA hala, AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake emanai karate dekhechi|
ivarAhIma valala, tomarA ki kakhanao gabhIrabhAve lakSya kare dekhacha tomarA kisera ivAdata karacha?
tomarA evaM tomAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSagaNa?
erA sava AmAra zatru eka rAvvula AlAmIna chAr3A|
yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| tArapara tinii AmAra pathapradarzana karena|
evaM AmAke khAoYAna o pAna karAna|
evaM Ami yakhana pIr3ita hai, AmAke zephA dAna karena|
evaM yini AmAra mRtyu ghaTAvena, phera AmAke jIvita karavena|
evaM yAra kAche Ami AzA rAkhi, hisAva-nikAzera dina tini AmAra aparAdhasamUha kSamA karavena|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke hekamata dAna karuna evaM AmAke nekakAra lokadera antarbhukta karuna|
evaM paravartIkAlIna lokadera madhye AmAra pakSe emana rasanA sRSTi karuna, yA AmAra satatAra sAkSya deve|
evaM AmAke sei sakala lokera antarbhukta karuna, yArA have ni‘AmatapUrNa jAnnAtera adhikArI|
evaM AmAra pitAke kSamA karuna| nizcaYai tini pathabhraSTadera ekajana|
evaM AmAke sei dina lAJchita karavena nA, ye dina mAnuSake punarAYa jIvita karA have|
ye dina kona artha-sampada kAje Asave nA evaM santAna-santatio nA|
tave ye vyakti AllAhara kAche upasthita have sustha mana niYe (se mukti pAve)|
jAnnAtake muttAkIdera kAche niYe AsA have|
evaM jAhAnnAmake pathabhraSTadera sAmane unmukta karA have|
evaM tAderake valA have, tomarA yAdera ivAdata karate tArA kothAYa?
AllAhake cher3e tArA ki tomAdera sAhAyya karate pArave kiMvA pArave ki tArA AtmarakSA karate?
ataHpara tAderake o pathabhraSTaderake adhomukhI kare nikSepa karA have jAhAnnAme
evaM ivalIsera samasta vAhinIkeo|
sekhAne tArA paraspara vivAde lipta haYe (tAdera upAsyaderake) valave
AllAhara kasama! AmarA to sei samaYa spaSTa vibhrAntite lipta chilAma
yakhana AmarA tomAderake ‘rAvvula AlAmInera’ samakakSa gaNya karatAma|
AmAderake to var3a var3a aparAdhIrAi vibhrAnta karechila|
pariNAme AmAdera nA Ache kona rakama supArizakArI|
Ara nA emana kona sahRdaYa vandhu|
hAYa! AmAdera yadi ekavAra (duniYAYa) phire yAoYAra suyoga lAbha hata, tave AmarA avazyai mumina haYe yetAma|
nizcaYai era madhye zikSAra viSaYa Ache| tA sattveo tAdera adhikAMze ImAna Ane nA|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nUhera sampradAYa rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila
yakhana tAdera bhAi nUha tAderake valechila, tomarA ki AllAhake bhaYa kara nA?
nizcaYai Ami tomadera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla|

Ami e kAjera vinimaYe tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna vizvajagatera pratipAlaka nija dAYitve rekhechena|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra kathA mAna|
tArA valala, AmarA ki tomAra prati ImAna Anava, athaca tomAra anusaraNa karache kevala nimnastarera lokajana?
nUha valala, tArA kI kAja kare tAra Ami ki jAni?
tAdera hisAva neoYA anya kArao naYa, kevala AmAra pratipAlakerai kAja| hAYa! tomarA yadi vujhate!
Ami muminaderake AmAra kAcha theke tAr3iYe dite pAri nA|
Ami to ekajana satarkakArI mAtra, ye (tomAdera sAmane) satya suspaSTa kare dicche|
tArA valala, he nUha! tumi yadi kSAnta nA hao, tave pAtharera AghAte nihatadera antarbhukta have|
nUha valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra sampradAYa AmAke mithyAvAdI ThAoriYeche|
sutarAM Apani AmAra o tAdera madhye suspaSTa phAYasAlA kare dina evaM AmAke o AmAra mumina saGgIderake rakSA karuna|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra saGgIderake vojhAi naukAYa rakSA karalAma|
tArapara avaziSTa sakalake nimajjita karalAma|
nizcaYai era madhye Ache zikSAra viSaYa| tA sattveo tAdera adhikAMzei ImAna Ane nA|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ada jAti rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila|
tAdera bhAi huda yakhana tAderake valala, tomarA ki AllAhake bhaYa kara nA?
nizcaYai Ami tomAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAke mAna|
Ami e kAjera vinimaYe tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna to vizvajagatera pratipAlaka nija dAYitve rekhechena|
tomarA ki pratiTi u~cu sthAne smRtistambha nirmANa karAra ahetuka kAja karacha|
Ara tomarA emana zilpamaNDita imArata nirmANa karacha, yena tomarA cirajIvI haYe thAkave|
Ara yakhana kAuke dhRta kara, takhana tAke dhRta kara kaThora atyAcArIrUpe|
ekhana tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
evaM bhaYa kara tA~ke, yini emana sava jinisa dvArA tomAdera zaktivRddhi karechena yA tomarA jAna|
tini tomAderake diYechena gavAdi pazu o santAna-santati|
evaM udyAnarAji o prasravaNa|
prakRtapakSe Ami tomAdera vyApAre bhaYa kari eka mahA divasera zAstira|
tArA valala, tumi upadeza dAo vA nA dAo AmAdera janya ubhaYai samAna|
eTA to sei viSaYai, yAte pUrvavartIgaNa abhyasta chila|
AmarA Adau zAstiprApta haoYAra nai|
moTakathA tArA hudake asvIkAra kare| phale Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare dei| nizcaYai era bhetara Ache zikSAra viSaYa| tA sattveo tAdera adhikAMzei ImAna Ane nA|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
chAmuda jAti rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi sAleha tAderake valala, tomarA ki AllAhake bhaYa kara nA?
nizcaYai Ami tomAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami e kAjera janya tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna to vizvajagatera pratipAlaka nija dAYitve rekhechena|
ekhAne yesava ni‘Amata Ache, tomAderake ki tAra bhetara sarvadA nirApade rekhe deoYA have?
udyAnarAji o prasravaNasamUhera bhetara?
evaM kSeta-khAmAra o emana khejura vAgAnera bhetara, yAra guccha paraspara sanniviSTa?
tomarA ki (sarvadA) jA~kajamakera sAthe pAhAr3a keTe gRha nirmANa karate thAkave?
evAra AllAhake bhaYa kara o AmAke mene cala|
sImAlaGghanakArIdera kathA mata calo nA
yArA yamIne azAnti vistAra kare evaM saMzodhanamUlaka kAja kare nA|
tArA valala, nizcaYai yAdera upara kaThina yAdu karA haYeche, tumi tAderai ekajana|
tomAra svarUpa to e chAr3A kichui naYa ye, tumi AmAderai mata ekajana mAnuSa| sutarAM tumi satyavAdI hale kona nidarzana hAjira kara|
sAleha valala, (nAo) ei ye eka uTanI| era janya thAkave pAni pAnera pAlA Ara tomAdera janya thAkave pAni pAnera pAlA eka nirdhArita dine|
Ara kona asaduddezye eke sparza karo nA| anyathAYa eka mahAdivasera zAsti tomAderake pAkar3Ao karave|
ataHpara (ei ghaTala ye) tArA uTanITira pAYera raga keTe phelala| tArapara tArA anutapta hala|

lUtera sampradAYa rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila|

Ami e kAjera janya tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna to vizvajagatera pratipAlaka nija dAYitve rekhechena|
vizvajagatera samasta mAnuSera madhye tomarAi ki emana, yArA puruSe upagamana kara|
Ara varjana kare thAka tomAdera strIgaNake, yAderake tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena? prakRtapakSe tomarA eka sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|
tArA valala, he lUta! tumi yadi kSAnta nA hao, tave janapada theke yAderake vahiSkAra karA haYa, tumio tAdera ekajana haYe yAve|
lUta valala, jene rekha, yArA tomAdera e kAjake ghRNA kare, Ami tAderai ekajana|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! tArA ye kAryakalApa karache AmAke o AmAra parivAravargake tA theke rakSA karuna|

eka vRddhAke chAr3A, ye pechane avasthAnakArIdera madhye theke gela|
tArapara avaziSTa sakalake Ami dhvaMsa kare dilAma|
tAdera upara varSaNa karalAma eka mArAtmaka vRSTi| yAderake bhaYa dekhAno haYechila tAdera janya tA chila ati manda vRSTi|
nizcaYai era madhye Ache zikSA| tA sattveo tAdera adhikAMzei ImAna Ane nA|
jene rekha, tomAra pratipAlaka parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
AYakAvAsIgaNa rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila|
yakhana zuAiva tAderake valala, tomarA ki AllAhake bhaYa kara nA?
nizcaYai Ami tomAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra kathA mAna|
Ami e kAjera vinimaYe tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna to jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka nija dAYitve rekhechena|
tomarA mApe puropuri dio| yArA mApe ghATati kare tAdera antarbhukta haYo nA|
ojana karo saThika dA~r3ipAllAYa|
mAnuSake tAdera mAlAmAla kamiYe dio nA evaM yamIne azAnti vistAra kare ver3io nA|
evaM sei sattAke bhaYa karo yini tomAderakeo sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera pUrvavartI prajanmakeo|
tArA valala, nizcaYai yAdera upara kaThina yAdu karA haYeche tumi tAderai ekajana|
tumi to AmAdera mata ekajana mAnuSai| tomAra samparke AmAdera vizvAsa eTAi ye, tumi mithyAvAdIdera ekajana|
tumi satyavAdI haYe thAkale AmAdera upara AkAzera ekaTi khaNDa phele dAo|
zuAiva valala, AmAra pratipAlaka bhAlobhAve jAnena tomarA yA karacha|
moTakathA tArA tAke pratyAkhyAna karala| pariNAme meghAcchanna dinera zAsti tAderake AkrAnta karala| nizcaYai tA chila eka bhaYAnaka dinera zAsti|
nizcaYai era bhetara Ache zikSA| tA sattveo tAdera adhikAMzei ImAna Ane nA|
jene rekha, tomAra pratipAlaka parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai e kuraAna rAvvula AlAmInera pakSa hate avatIrNa|
rUhula-AmIna tA niYe avataraNa kareche|
(he navI!) tomAra antare avatIrNa haYeche, yAte tumi satarkakArIdera (arthAt navIdera) antarbhukta haYe yAo|
nAyila haYeche emana AravI bhASAYa, yA vANIke suspaSTa kare deYa|
pUrvavartI (AsamAnI) kitAvasamUheo era (arthAt ei kuraAnera) ullekha raYeche|
vanI isarAIlera ulAmA e samparke avagata Ache eTA ki tAdera janya ekaTA pramANa naYa?
Ami yadi e kitAva kona AyamI vyaktira upara avatIrNa karatAma
Ara se tAdera sAmane tA par3e dita, tavuo tArA tAte ImAna Anata nA|
ebhAvei Ami aparAdhIdera antare tA DhukiYe diYechi|
tArA tAte ImAna Anave nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA yantraNAmaYa zAsti dekhate pAve|
evaM tA tAdera sAmane emana AkasmikabhAve ese par3ave ye, tArA vujhatei pArave nA|
takhana tArA vale uThave, AmAderake kichuTA avakAza deoYA have ki?
tArA ki AmAra zAstira janya tar3ighar3i karache?
AcchA vala to, Ami yadi ekaTAnA kaYeka vachara tAderake bhoga-vilAsera upakaraNa dite thAki|
tArapara tAderake ye zAstira bhaYa dekhAno hacche tA tAdera nikaTa ese par3e
tave bhoga-vilAsera ye upakaraNa tAderake deoYA hacchila, takhana (arthAt zAstira samaYa) tA tAdera kona upakAre Asave ki?
Ami kona janapadake dhvaMsa karini, e vyatireke ye, (pUrve) tAdera janya chila satarkakArI|
yAte tArA tAderake upadeza dAna kare| Ami to jAlima nai|
Ara e kuraAna niYe zaYatAnagaNa avataraNa kareni|
eTA tAdera janya saMgata naYa evaM tArA era kSamatAo rAkhe nA|
tAderake to (ohI) zonA thekeo dUre rAkhA haYeche|
sutarAM AllAhara saGge anya kAuke mAvuda mAnave nA, pAche tumio tAdera antarbhukta hao, yArA have zAstiprApta|
evaM (he navI!) tumi tomAra nikaTatama khAndAnake satarka kare dAo|
Ara ye muminagaNa tomAra anusaraNa kare, tAdera janya vinaYera sAthe mamatAra DAnA nuiYe dAo|
Ara tArA yadi tomAra avAdhyatA kare tave vale dAo, tomarA yA-kichu karacha tAra sAthe AmAra kona samvandha nei|
Ara bharasA rAkha mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu, (AllAha)-era prati
yini tomAke dekhena yakhana tumi (ivAdatera janya) dA~r3Ao|
evaM dekhena sijadAkArIdera madhye tomAra yAtAYAtakeo|
nizcaYai tinii sava kathA zonena, sakala viSaYa jAnena|
Ami ki tomAderake vale deva zaYatAnerA kAra kAche avataraNa kare?
avataraNa kare pratyeka emana vyaktira kAche, ye carama mithyuka, ghora pApiSTha|
tArA zonAkathA tAdera dike chu~r3e deYa evaM tAdera adhikAMzai mithyAvAdI|
Ara kavigaNa tAdera anugAmI haYa to yatasava vipathagAmI loka|
tumi dekhani tArA pratyeka upatyakAYa udabhrAnta haYe ghure ver3AYa?
Ara tArA emana kathA vale yA nijerA kare nA|

tave sei sakala loka vyatikrama, yArA ImAna eneche, satkarma kareche, AllAhake vezi parimANe smaraNa kareche evaM nijerA niryAtita haoYAra para pratizodha grahaNa kareche| yArA juluma kareche tArA acirei jAnate pArave kona pariNAmera dike phire yAcche|
toYA-sIna-| egulo kuraAna o emana eka kitAvera AYAta, yA satyake suspaSTa kare|
eTA hedAYAta o susaMvAdarUpe eseche muminadera janya
yArA nAmAya kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa Ara tArAi AkherAte dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe|
vastuta yArA AkherAte ImAna rAkhe nA, Ami tAdera kAryakalApake tAdera dRSTite manorama vAniYe diYechi| phale tArA udabhrAnta haYe ghure ver3Acche|
tArAi emana loka, yAdera janya Ache nikRSTa zAsti evaM tArAi AkherAte sarvApekSA vezi kSatigrasta have|
evaM (he navI!) nizcaYai e kuraAna tomAke deoYA haYeche sei sattAra pakSa hate yini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra parivAravargake valechila, Ami eka Aguna dekhate peYechi| Ami zIghrai sekhAna theke tomAdera kAche kona saMvAda niYe Asachi kiMvA tomAdera kAche jvalanta aGgAra niYe Asava, yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra|

sutarAM yakhana se sei Agunera kAche peৗ~chala, tAke DAka diYe valA hala, varakata hoka ye Agunera bhetara Ache tAra prati evaM ye tAra AzapAze Ache tAra pratio| AllAha pavitra, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
he mUsA! kathA hacche, Amii AllAha, ati parAkramazAlI, ati hekamataoYAlA|

tomAra lAThi nice phele dAo| anantara se yakhana dekhala seTi emanabhAve nar3Acar3A karache, yena seTi ekaTi sApa, amani se pechana dike pAlAte lAgala, Ara phire tAkAla nA| (valA hala) he mUsA bhaYa peo nA| yAke navI vAnAno haYa, AmAra nikaTe tAra kona bhaYa thAke nA|
tave keu kona sImAlaGghana karale, tArapara manda kAjera para tAra vadale bhAlo kAja karale, Ami to ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

evaM tomAra hAta nija jAYava (jAmAra sAmanera phokara)-era bhetara DhokAo, tA zubhra haYe vera have kona roga chAr3A| e du’Ti sei nava-nidarzanera antarbhukta, yA (tomAra mAdhyame) phira‘Auna o tAra sampradAYera kAche pAThAno hacche| vastuta tArA avAdhya sampradAYa|
tArapara yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra nidarzanasamUha peৗ~chala, yA chila dRSTi unmocanakArI, takhana tArA valala, eTA to suspaSTa yAdu|
tArA sImAlaGghana o ahamikAvazata tA sava asvIkAra karala, yadio tAdera antara segulo (satya vale) vizvAsa kare niYechila| sutarAM dekhe nAo phAsAdakArIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila!
Ami dAUda o sulAimAnake jJAna diYechilAma| tArA valechila, samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAderake tAra vahu mumina vAndAra upara zreSThatva diYechena|

sulAimAna dAUdera uttarAdhikAra lAbha karala evaM se valala, he mAnuSa! AmAderake pAkhidera vuli zekhAno haYeche evaM AmAderake samasta (praYojanIYa) jinisa deoYA haYeche| nizcaYai eTA (AllAha tAAlAra) suspaSTa anugraha|
sulAimAnera janya tAra samasta sainya samaveta karA haYechila yA chila jinna, mAnuSa o pAkhi-samvalita| tAderake rAkhA hata niYantraNe|
ekadina yakhana tArA pi~par3era upatyakAYa peৗ~chala, takhana eka pi~par3e valala, ohe pi~par3erA! nija ghare Dhuke par3a, pAche sulAimAna o tAra sainyarA tAdera ajJAtasAre tomAderake piSe phele|

tAra kathAYa sulAimAna smitha hese dila evaM vale uThala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke tAophIka dAo, yena zukara AdAYa karate pAri sei sakala ni‘Amatera, yA tumi dAna karecha AmAke o AmAra pitA-mAtAke evaM karate pAri emana satkAja, yA tumi pachanda kara Ara nija rahamate tumi AmAke neka vAndAdera antarbhukta kara|
evaM se (ekavAra) pAkhidera sandhAna nila| valala, kI vyApAra! hudahudake dekhachi nA ye? se ki anupasthita nA ki?
Ami tAke kaThina zAsti diva athavA tAke yavAha kare phelava yadi nA se AmAra kAche spaSTa kona kAraNa darzAYa|
tArapara hudahuda vezi deri karala nA evaM (ese) valala, Ami emana viSaYa jenechi, yA ApanAra jAnA nei| Ami ApanAra kAche sAvA deza theke nizcita saMvAda niYe esechi|
Ami sekhAne eka nArIke sekhAnakAra lokadera upara rAjatva karate dekhechi| tAke sarvaprakAra AsavAva- upakaraNa deoYA haYeche| Ara tAra ekaTi virATa siMhAsanao Ache|

Ami sei nArI o tAra sampradAYake dekhechi AllAhara parivarte sUryera sijadA karache| zaYatAna tAdera kAche, tAdera kAryakalApake zobhanIYa kare dekhiYeche| ebhAve se tAderake saThika patha theke nivRtta rekheche, phale tArA hedAYAta pAcche nA|
(se tAderake nivRtta rekheche), yAte tArA sijadA nA kare AllAhake, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra gupta viSaYAvalI prakAza karena evaM tomarA yA gopana kara o yA prakAza kara savai jAnena|
AllAha tini, yini chAr3A keu ivAdatera upayukta naYa, tini mahA Arazera adhipati|*
sulAimAna valala, Ami ekhanai dekhachi tumi satya valecha, nAki tumi mithyAvAdIdera ekajana haYe gecha|
AmAra e ciThi niYe yAo| eTi tAdera sAmane phele deve tArapara tAdera theke sare yAve evaM lakSya karave tArA era javAve kI kare|
(sutarAM hudahuda tAi karala| tArapara) rANI (tAra daravArera lokaderake) valala, he jAtira netRvarga! AmAra sAmane ekaTi maryAdAsampanna ciThi phelA haYeche|
tA eseche sulAimAnera pakSa theke| tA zuru karA haYeche AllAhara nAme, yini rahamAna o rAhIma|
(tAte se likheche) AmAra upara ahamikA dekhio nA| vazyatA svIkAra kare AmAra kAche cale eso|

rANI valala, ohe jAtira netRvRnda! ye samasyATi AmAra sAmane dekhA diYeche, e viSaYe tomarA AmAke siddhAntamUlaka parAmarza dAo| Ami kona viSaYe cUr3Anta siddhAnta grahaNa kari nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA AmAra kAche upasthita thAka|
tArA valala, AmarA zaktizAlI loka evaM pracaNDa lar3Aku| tave siddhAnta grahaNera ekhatiYAra ApanAra| sutarAM bheve dekhuna ki hukuma devena|
rANI valala, prakRta vyApAra hala, rAjA-vAdazAgaNa yakhana kona janapade Dhuke par3e, takhana tAke yeravAra kare phele evaM tAra maryAdAvAna vAsindAderake lAJchita kare chAr3e| erAo to tAi karave|
varaM Ami tAdera kAche upaDhaukana pAThAva| tArapara dekhava dUterA kI uttara niYe phere|

tArapara dUta yakhana sulAimAnera kAche upasthita hala, se valala, tomarA ki artha dvArA AmAra sAhAyya karate cAo? vastuta AllAha AmAke yA diYechena, tA tomAderake yA diYechena tAra ceYe utkRSTa, athaca tomarA tomAdera upahAra-sAmagrI niYe utphulla|

phire yAo tAdera kAche| Ami tAdera kAche emana eka senAdala niYe Asava, yAra mokAvelA karAra zakti tAdera nei evaM Ami tAderake sekhAna theke lAJchitabhAve vera kare deva Ara tArA haYe yAve avanamita|
sulAimAna valala, ohe daravArIgaNa! ke Ache tomAdera madhye, ye tArA vazyatA svIkAra kare AsAra Agei AmAra kAche tAra siMhAsana niYe Asave?
eka valiSThadehI jIna valala, Apani ApanAra sthAna theke oThAra Agei Ami seTi ApanAra kAche niYe Asava| nizcaYai Ami e kAje sakSama, (evaM Ami) vizvastao vaTe|

yAra kAche chila kitAvera ilama, se valala, Ami ApanAra cokhera palaka phelAra Agei tA ApanAra sAmane ene deva| anantara sulAimAna yakhana siMhAsanaTi nijera sAmane rAkhA avasthAYa dekhala, takhana vale uThala, eTA AmAra pratipAlakera anugraha| tini AmAke parIkSA karate cAna ye, Ami kRtajJatA AdAYa kari, nA akRtajJatA kari? ye-keu kRtajJatA AdAYa kare, se to kRtajJatA AdAYa kare nijerai upakArArthe| Ara keu akRtajJatA karale AmAra pratipAlaka to aizvaryazAlI, mahAnubhava|
sulAimAna (tA~ra anucaraderake) valala, tomarA rANIra siMhAsanaTike tAra pakSe acenA vAniYe dAo, dekhi se era dizA pAYa, nA ki se yArA satye upanIta hate pAre nA tAdera antarbhukta?

parizeSe se yakhana Asala, jijJesa karA hala, tomAra siMhAsanaTi ki e rakama? se valala, yena eTi seTii| AmAderake to era Agei (ApanAra satyatA samparke) jJAna deoYA haYechila evaM ApanAra Anugatyao svIkAra karechilAma|
se AllAhara parivarte yAra pUjA karata tAi tAke (ImAna AnA hate) nivRtta rekhechila evaM se chila eka kAphera sampradAYera sAthe sampRkta|

tAke valA hala, ei mahale praveza kara| yakhana se tA dekhala, tAke jalAzaYa mane karala| tAi se (kApar3a u~ciYe) nija gochA khule phelala| sulAimAna valala, eTA to svaccha zizAra DhAlAikRta mahala| rANI valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! vastuta (e paryanta) Ami AmAra nijera prati juluma karechi| ekSaNe Ami sulAimAnera sAthe AllAha rAvvula AlAmInera Anugatya svIkAra kare nilAma|
Ami chAmuda jAtira kAche tAdera bhAi sAlehake vArtA diYe pAThAlAma ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara| amani tArA du’dale vibhakta haYe paraspare vitarke lipta hala|
sAleha valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA bhAlora Age mandake kena tAr3AtAr3i cAccha? tomarA AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karacha nA kena, yAte tomAdera prati daYA karA haYa?
tArA valala, AmarA to tomAke evaM tomAra saGgIraderake azubha mane kari| sAleha valala, tomAdera azubhatA AllAhara hAte| vastuta tomarA emanai eka sampradAYa, yAdera parIkSA karA hacche|
evaM nagare naYajana loka chila emana, yArA yamIne vizRGkhalA sRSTi kare ver3Ata, isalAhera kAja karata nA|

tArA (ekatra haYe eke anyake) valala, sakale zapatha kara, AmarA rAtera velA sAleha o tAra parivAravargera upara hAmalA cAlAva, tArapara tAra oYArizake valava, AmarA tAra parivAravargera hatyAkANDera samaYa upasthitai chilAma nA| vizvAsa kara AmarA sampUrNa satyavAdI|
tArA to ei cAla cAlala Ara Amio eka cAla cAlalAma kintu tArA Terao pela nA|
sutarAM lakSya kara tAdera cAlAkira pariNAma kemana hala| Ami tAderake o tAdera goTA jAtike dhvaMsa kare phelalAma|
oi to tAdera ghara-vAr3i, yA tAdera julumera kAraNe parityakta avasthAYa par3e Ache| nizcaYai yArA tAdera jJAna-vuddhike kAje lAgAYa, tAdera janya ete Ache zikSA|
Ara yArA ImAna enechila o tAkaoYA avalamvana karechila, tAderake Ami rakSA karechi|
evaM Ami lUtake (navI vAniYe pAThAlAma)| yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valala, tomarA ki cAkSuSa dekheo azlIla kAja karacha?
eTA ki vizvAsayogya ye, tomarA kAmacAhidA pUraNera janya nArIdera cher3e puruSadera kAche yAo? vastuta tomarA ati mUrkhatAsulabha kAja karacha|
tAra sampradAYera uttara chila kevala ei ye, tArA valala, lUtera parivAravargake tomAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo| tArA emana loka, yArA var3a pavitratA jAhira karache|
tArapara ei ghaTala ye, Ami luta o tAra parivAravargake rakSA karalAma, tave tAra strIke naYa, yAra samparke Ami sthira karechilAma, se yArA pichane theke yAve tAdera antarbhukta thAkave|
Ara Ami tAdera upara varSaNa karalAma eka mArAtmaka vRSTi| yAderake Age thekei satarka karA haYechila tAdera prati varSita se vRSTi chila katai nA manda!

(he navI!) vala, samasta prazaMsA AllAharai evaM sAlAma tA~ra sei vAndAdera prati yAderake tini manonIta karechena| vala to, AllAha zreSTha, nAki yAderake tArA (AllAhara prabhutve) aMzIdAra vAniYeche tArA?

tave ke tini, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janya AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena? tArapara Ami se pAni dvArA udagata karechi manorama udyAnarAji| tAra vRkSarAji udagata karA tomAdera pakSe sambhava chila nA| (tavuo ki tomarA valacha,) AllAhara saGge anya kona prabhu Ache? nA; varaM tArA (satyapatha theke) mukha phiriYe rAkhe|

tave ke tini, yini pRthivIke vAniYechena avasthAnera jAYagA, tAra mAjhe-mAjhe sRSTi karechena nada-nadI, tAra (sthitira) janya (parvatamAlAra) kIlaka ger3e diYechena evaM tini dui sAgarera mAjhakhAne sthApana karechena eka antarAYa? (tavuo ki tomarA valacha) AllAhara saGge anya kona prabhu Ache? nA, varaM tAdera adhikAMzei (prakRta satya) jAne nA|

tave ke tini, yini kona Arta yakhana tAke DAke, tAra DAke sAr3A dena o tAra kaSTa dUra kare dena evaM yini tomAderake pRthivIra khalIphA vAnAna? (tavuo ki tomarA valacha) AllAhara saGge anya prabhu Achena? tomarA ati alpai upadeza grahaNa kara|

tave ke tini, yini sthala o samudrera andhakAre tomAderake patha dekhAna evaM yini nija rahamatera (vRSTira) Age (vRSTira) susaMvAdavAhIrUpe vAtAsa pAThAna? (tavuo ki tomarA valacha) AllAhara saGge anya prabhu Ache? (nA, varaM) tArA yAke zarIka kare AllAha tA theke vahu Urdhve|

tave ke tini, yini samasta mAkhalukake prathamavAra sRSTi karena, tArapara tAderake punarAYa sRSTi karavena evaM yini AsamAna o yamIna theke tomAdera riyaka saravarAha karena? (tavuo ki tomarA valacha,) AllAhara sAthe anya kona prabhu Achena? vala, tomarA tomAdera pramANa upasthita kara yadi satyavAdI hao|
vale dAo, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte AllAha chAr3A keu gAYeva jAne nA| evaM mAnuSa jAne nA tAderake kakhana punarjIvita karA have|
varaM AkherAta samparke tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) jJAna sampUrNa apAraga haYe geche; varaM tArA se samvandhe sandehe nipatita; varaM tArA se samparke andha|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArA vale, AmarA o AmAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa yakhana mATi haYe yAva, takhanao ki AmAderake satyi satyii (kavara theke) vera karA have?
AmAderake o AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake e rakamera pratizruti Ageo zonAno haYechila, (kintu) prakRtapakSe esava pUrvavartIdera kissA-kAhinI chAr3A kichui naYa|
vale dAo, pRthivIte bhramaNa kare dekha aparAdhIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila?
(he navI!) tumi tAdera prati duHkha karo nA| Ara tArA ye cakrAnta karache, tAra janya kuNThAvodha karo nA|
tArA (tomAke) vale, tomarA satyavAdI hale (vala,) e oYAdA pUraNa have kakhana?
vale dAo, asambhava naYa tomarA ye AyAva tAr3AtAr3i cAccha, tAra kataka tomAdera ekadama kAchei|
vastuta tomAra pratipAlaka mAnuSera prati ati anugrahazIla kintu tAdera adhikAMzei zukara AdAYa kare nA|
evaM nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera antara yA-kichu gopana rAkhe tAo jAnena evaM tArA yA-kichu prakAza kare tAo|
AsamAna o yamIne emana kona gupta viSaYa nei, yA eka suspaSTa kitAve lipivaddha naYa|
vastuta e kuraAna vanI isarAIlera sAmane (yathArtharUpe) vivRta kare deYa tArA yesava viSaYe matabheda kare tAra adhikAMza|
nizcaYai eTA ImAnadAradera janya hedAYAta o rahamata|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera madhye nija siddhAnta anuyAYI phAYasAlA karavena| tini ati kSamatAvAna, sarvajJa|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi AllAhara upara bharasA rAkha| nizcaYai tumi suspaSTa satyera upara pratiSThita|
smaraNa rekha, tumi mRtaderake (tomAra kathA) zonAte pArave nA evaM vadhirakeo pArave nA DAka zonAte, yakhana tArA pechana phire cale yAYa|

Ara tumi andhaderakeo tAdera pathabhraSTatA hate mukta kare saThika pathe Anate pArave nA| tumi to kathA zonAte pArave kevala tAderakei yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna Ane ataHpara tArAi have Anugatya svIkArakArI|

yakhana tAdera sAmane AmAra kathA pUrNa haoYAra samaYa ese par3ave, takhana tAdera janya bhUmi theke eka jantu vera karava, yA tAdera sAthe kathA valave, yehetu mAnuSa AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna Anachila nA|
evaM sei dinake bhulo nA, yakhana Ami pratyeka ummata theke ekekaTi dalake samaveta karava, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karata| tArapara tAderake zreNIvaddha karA have|
parizeSe yakhana sakalei ese peৗ~chave, takhana AllAha valavena, tomarA ki bhAlobhAve nA jenei AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karechile kiMvA tomarA Asale kI karachile?
tArA juluma karechila, se kAraNe tAdera prati zAstivANI kAryakara haYe yAve| phale tArA kichui valate pArave nA|

tArA ki dekheni Ami rAta sRSTi karechi, yAte tArA takhana vizrAma nite pAre Ara dina sRSTi karechi emanabhAve, yAte takhana savakichu dRSTigocara haYa| nizcaYai ye sakala loka ImAna Ane tAdera janya era bhetara vahu nidarzana Ache|
ye dina ziGgAYa phu~ deoYA have, se dina AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yArA Ache sakalei ghAvar3e yAve, AllAha yAdera vyApAre icchA karavena tArA chAr3A evaM sakalei Anata haYe tAra sAmane upasthita have|

tomarA (Aja) pAhAr3ake dekhe mane kara tA Apana sthAne acala, athaca (se dina) tA saJcaraNa karave, yemana saJcaraNa kare meghamAlA| esavai AllAhara karma-kuzalatA, yini sakala vastu sudRr3habhAve sRSTi karechena| nizcaYai tomarA yA-kichu kara tini tA samyaka avahita|
ye-keu satkarmasaha Asave, se tadapekSA utkRSTa pratiphala pAve| tArA se dina sarvaprakAra bhaYa-bhIti hate nirApada thAkave|
Ara ye-keu mandakarma niYe Asave, tAderake ulTo-mukho kare Agune nikSepa karA have| tomAderake to kevala tomarA yA karate tArai zAsti deoYA have|

(he rAsUla! tAderake vale dAo) AmAke to kevala e hukumai deoYA haYeche ye, Ami yena ei nagarera pratipAlakera ivAdata kari, yini e nagarake maryAdA dAna karechena| tinii savakichura mAlika evaM AmAke Adeza karA haYeche, yena Ami AnugatyakArIdera antarbhukta thAki|

evaM Ami yena kuraAna tilAoYAta kari| ye vyakti hedAYAtera pathe Asave, se hedAYAtera pathe Asave nijerai kalyANArthe| Ara keu pathabhraSTatA avalamvana karale vale dAo, Ami to satarkakArIderai ekajana|
evaM vale dAo, samasta prazaMsA AllAhara| tini tomAderake nija nidarzanasamUha dekhAvena| ataHpara tomarA tA cinateo pArave| tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera kAryAvalI samparke anavahita nana|
toYA-sIna-mIma|
egulo (satyake) parisphuTakArI kitAvera AYAta|
Ami ye sakala loka ImAna Ane tAdera kalyANArthe mUsA o phira‘Aonera kichu vRttAnta tomAke yathAyathabhAve par3e zonAcchi|

vastuta phira‘Aona bhUmite auddhatya prakAza karechila evaM se tAra adhivAsIderake pRthaka-pRthaka dale vibhakta karechila| tAdera ekaTi zreNIke se atyanta durvala kare rAkhachila, yAdera putraderake se yavAha karata o tAdera nArIderake jIvita cher3e dita| prakRtapakSe se chila phAsAda vistArakArIdera ekajana|
Ara Ami cAcchilAma sedeze yAderake durvala kare rAkhA haYechila, tAdera prati anugraha karate, tAderake netA vAnAte evaM tAderakei (se dezera bhUmi o sampadera) uttarAdhikArI vAnAte|
evaM se deze tAderake kSamatAsIna karate Ara phira‘Aona, hAmAna o tAdera sainyaderake sei jinisa dekhiYe dite, yAra AzaGkA tArA tAdera (arthAt vanI isarAIlera) dika theke karachila|

Ami mUsAra mAYera prati ilahAma karalAma, tumi tAke dudha pAna karAte thAka| yakhana tAra vyApAre kona AzaGkA vodha karave takhana tAke nadIte phele dio| Ara bhaYa peo nA o duHkha karo nA| vizvAsa rekha, Ami avazyai tAke tomAra kAche phiriYe deva evaM tAke rAsUlagaNera madhya hate ekajana rAsUla vAniYe deva|

ataHpara phira‘Aonera lokajana tAke (arthAt zizu mUsA AlAihisa sAlAmake) tule nila| era pariNAma to chila ei ye, se have tAdera zatru o tAdera duHkhera kAraNa| nizcaYai phira‘Aona, hAmAna o tAdera sainyarA var3ai bhulera upara chila|

pherAunera strI (phira‘Aonake) valala, e zizu AmAra o tomAra pakSe naYanaprItikara| eke hatyA karo nA haYata se AmAdera upakAre Asave athavA AmarA eke putrao vAnAte pAri| Ara (e siddhAnta grahaNakAle) tArA pariNAma vujhate pArachila nA|
edike mUsAra mAYera mana vyAkula haYe par3echila| se to rahasya phA~sa karei dicchila yadi nA Ami tAra antarake saMyata rAkhatAma (AmAra oYAdAra prati) dRr3ha vizvAsI thAkAra janya|
se mUsAra vonake valala, zizuTira ekaTu kheA~ja nAo| se tAke dUra theke emanabhAve dekhachila ye, tArA Tera pAcchila nA|

Ami pUrva thekei dhAtrIdugdha grahaNe tAra prati nirodha Aropa kare diYechilAma| zeSe mUsAra vona valala, Ami ki tomAderake emana eka parivArera sandhAna deva, yArA tomAdera pakSa hate e zizura lAlana-pAlana karave evaM tArA have tAra kalyANakAmI?
ebhAve Ami mUsAke tA~ra mAYera kAche phiriYe dilAma, yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa evaM se cintita nA thAke evaM yAte se bhAlobhAve jAnate pAre AllAhara oYAdA satya, kintu adhikAMza loka jAne nA|
yakhana mUsA valavattAYa upanIta hala o haYe gela pUrNa yuvA, takhana Ami tAke dAna karalAma hikamata o ilama| Ami satkarmazIladerake ebhAvei puraskRta kare thAki|

evaM (ekadA) se nagare emana eka samaYa praveza karala, yakhana tAra vAsindAgaNa chila asatarka| se dekhala sekhAne du’jana loka mArAmAri karache| ekajana to tAra nija dalera evaM Arekajana tAra zatrupakSera| ye vyakti chila tAra nija dalera, se tAra zatrupakSera lokaTira viruddhe tAke sAhAyyera janya DAkala| takhana mUsA tAke ekaTi ghuSi mArala Ara tA tAra karma sAvAr3a kare dila| (tArapara) se (AkSepa kare) valala, eTA zaYatAnera kANDa| mUlata se eka prakAzya zatru, yAra kAjai bhula pathe niYe yAoYA|
valate lAgala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami nija sattAra prati juluma karechi| Apani AmAke kSamA kare dina| sutarAM AllAha tAke kSamA kare dilena| nizcaYai tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
mUsA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! Apani yehetu AmAra prati anugraha karechena, tAi bhaviSyate Ami kakhanao aparAdhIdera sAhAyyakArI hava nA|

ataHpara se sakAla velA bhItAvasthAYa nagarera paristhiti paryavekSaNa karate lAgala| haThAt se dekhate pela gatakAla ye vyakti tAra kAche sAhAyya ceYechila, sei vyaktii tAke phera sAhAyyera janya DAkache| mUsA tAke valala, vojhA gela tumi eka prakAzya duSTa loka|

ataHpara ye (pherAunI) vyakti tAdera ubhaYera zatru mUsA yakhana tAke dharate udyata hala, takhana se (arthAt isarAIlI vyakti) valala, he mUsA! gatakAla tumi yemana eka vyaktike hatyA karecha, AmAkeo ki tumi sebhAve hatyA karate cAo? tomAra uddezya to echAr3A kichui naYa ye, tumi bhUmite nija kSamatA pratiSThA karate cAo Ara tumi zAnti pratiSThAkArIdera antarbhukta hate cAo nA|

(tAraparera vRttAnta ei ye,) nagarera vilakula dUra prAnta hate eka vyakti chuTe Asala o valala, he mUsA! netRvarga tomAke hatyA karAra janya parAmarza karache| sutarAM tumi ekhAna theke vera haYe yAo| vizvAsa kara, Ami tomAra kalyANakAmIdera ekajana|
sutarAM mUsA bhItAvasthAYa paristhitira prati najara rekhe nagara theke vera haYe par3ala| valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke jAlema sampradAYera theke rakSA kara|
yakhana se mAdaiYAna abhimukhe yAtrA karala, takhana valala, AmAra pUrNa AzA Ache, AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke sarala pathe paricAlita karavena|

yakhana se mAdaiYAnera kuYAra kAche peৗ~chala, sekhAne ekadala mAnuSake dekhala, yArA tAdera pazuderake pAni pAna karAcche| Arao dekhala tAdera pechane du’jana nArI, yArA tAdera pazuguloke AgaliYe rAkhache| mUsA tAderake valala, tomarA kI cAo? tArA valala, AmarA AmAdera pazuguloke tatakSaNa paryanta pAni pAna karAte pAri nA, yatakSaNa nA samasta rAkhAla tAdera pazuguloke pAni pAna kariYe cale yAYa| AmAdera pitA ati vRddha|

takhana mUsA tAdera sammAnArthe tAdera pazuguloke pAni pAna kariYe dila| tArapara ekaTi chAYAsthale phire Asala| tArapara valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAra prati ye kalyANa varSaNa karave Ami tAra bhikhArI|

kichukSaNa para sei dui nArIra ekajana lAjuka bhaGgimAYa he~Te he~Te tAra kAche Asala| se valala, AmAra pitA ApanAke DAkachena, Apani ye AmAdera pazuguloke pAni pAna kariYe diYechena, tAra pArizramika deoYAra janya| sutarAM yakhana se nArIdvaYera pitAra kAche ese peৗ~chala evaM tAke tAra samasta vRttAnta zonAla, takhana se valala, kona bhaYa karo nA| tumi jAlema sampradAYa hate mukti peYe giYecha|

nArIdvaYera ekajana valala, AvvAjI! Apani eke pArizramikera vinimaYe kona kAja dina| Apani pArizramikera vinimaYe kArao theke kAja nite cAile sejanya emana vyaktii uttama, ye zaktizAlI have evaM AmAnatadArao|

tAra pitA valala, Ami AmAra ei dui meYera ekajanake tomAra sAthe vivAha dite cAi, ei zarte ye tumi pArizramikera vinimaYe ATa vachara AmAra ekhAne kAja karave Ara yadi tumi daza vachara pUrNa kara, seTA tomAra nija ekhatiYAra| Ami tomAke kaSTa dite cAi nA| inazAAllAha tumi AmAke sacAdArIdera ekajana pAve|
mUsA valala, AmAra o ApanAra madhye e viSaYaTA sthira haYe gela| Ami dui meYAdera yeTii pUrNa kari tAte AmAra prati kona vAr3AvAr3i calave nA| Ara AmarA ye kathA valachi, AllAhai tAra rakSAkartA|

mUsA yakhana meYAda pUrNa karala evaM nija strIke niYe raoYAnA haYe gela, takhana tini tUra pAhAr3era dike eka Aguna dekhate pelena| tini nija parivAravargake valalena, tomarA apekSA kara| Ami eka Aguna dekhechi, haYata Ami sekhAna theke tomAdera kAche Anate pArava kona saMvAda athavA Agunera ekaTA jvalanta kATha, yAte tomarA uttApa grahaNa karate pAra|
sutarAM se yakhana Agunera kAche peৗ~chala, takhana DAna upatyakAra kinArAYa avasthita varakatapUrNa bhUmira ekaTi vRkSa theke Deke valA hala, he mUsA! Amii AllAha jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|

Arao valA hala, tomAra lAThiTi nice phele dAo| ataHpara se yakhana lAThiTike dekhala sApera mata choTAchuTi karache, takhana se pichana dike ghure pAlAte lAgala evaM se phireo tAkAla nA| (tAke valA hala,) he mUsA! sAmane eso| bhaYa karo nA| tumi sampUrNa nirApada|

tumi tomAra hAta jAmAra sAmanera phokar3era bhetara DhokAo| tA kona roga vyatireke samujjvalarUpe vera haYe Asave| bhaYa dUra karAra janya tomAra vAhu nija zarIre cepe dhara| e du’Ti tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate valiSTha pramANa, phira‘Auna o tAra pAriSadavargera prati| tArA ghora avAdhya sampradAYa|
mUsA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami tAdera ekajana lokake hatyA karechilAma| tAi Ami AzaMkA kari tArA AmAke hatyA kare phelave|
AmAra bhAi hArUnera yavAna AmA apekSA vezi spaSTa| tAkeo AmAra saGge AmAra sAhAyyakArIrUpe pAThiYe dina, yAte se AmAra samarthana kare| AmAra AzaGkA tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valave|

AllAha valalena, Ami tomAra bhAiYera dvArA tomAra vAhu zaktizAlI kare dicchi evaM tomAdera ubhaYake emana prabhAva dAna karachi ye, AmAra nidarzanAvalIra varakate tArA tomAdera paryanta peৗ~chatei pArave nA| tomarA o tomAdera anusArIrAi jaYI haYe thAkave|
yakhana mUsA AmAra suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha niYe tAdera kAche upasthita hala, takhana tArA valala, eTA Ara kichui naYa, kevala vAnoYATa yAdu| AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera kAle erUpa kathA zunini|
mUsA valala, AmAra pratipAlaka bhAlo karei jAnena ke tAra nikaTa theke hedAYAta niYe eseche evaM pariNAme ke lAbha karave utkRSTa ThikAnA| eTA nizcita ye, jAlemagaNa saphalakAma have nA|

phira‘Auna valala, he pAriSadavarga! Ami to AmAra nijeke chAr3A tomAdera anya kona mAvuda Ache vale jAni nA| Ara he hAmAna! tumi AmAra janya Aguna diYe mATi jvAlAo (arthAt iTa tairi kara) evaM AmAra janya ekaTi u~cu imArata tairi kara, yAte Ami tAra upara uThe mUsAra prabhuke u~ki mere dekhate pAri| AmAra pUrNa vizvAsa se ekajana mithyAvAdI|
vastuta phira‘Auna o tAra vAhinI bhUmite anyAYa ahamikA pradarzana karechila| tArA mane karechila tAderake AmAra kAche phire Asate have nA|
sutarAM Ami tAke o tAra sainyaderake dhRta kare sAgare nikSepa karalAma| evAra dekha jAlemadera pariNati kI haYeche|
Ami tAderake vAniYechilAma netA, yArA mAnuSake jAhAnnAmera dike DAkata| kiYAmatera dina tArA kArao sAhAyya pAve nA|
duniYAYa Ami tAdera pechane abhisampAta lAgiYe diYechi Ara kiYAmatera dina tArA have sei sava lokera antarbhukta, yAdera avasthA have ati manda|
Ami pUrvavartI jAtisamUhake dhvaMsa karAra para mUsAke diYechilAma emana eka kitAva, yA chila mAnuSera janya jJAna-tattvasamRddha evaM hedAYAta o rahamata, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

(he rAsUla!) Ami yakhana mUsAra upara vidhAnAvalI arpaNa karechilAma, takhana tumi (tUra pAhAr3era) pazcima pArzve upasthita chile nA evaM yArA tA pratyakSa karachila, tumi tAderao antarbhukta chile nA|

vastuta Ami tAdera para vahu mAnavagoSThI sRSTi karechi, yAdera upara diYe dIrghakAla atikrAnta haYeche evaM tumi mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye upasthita chile nA ye, tAderake AmAra AYAtasamUha par3e zonAve; varaM Amii (tomAke) rAsUlarUpe preraNa karechi|

evaM Ami yakhana (mUsAke) DAka diYechilAma takhana tumi tUra pAhAr3era pAdadeze upasthita chile nA| vastuta eTA tomAra pratipAlakera rahamata (ye, tomAke ohIra mAdhyame esava viSaYa avahita karA hacche) yAte tumi emana eka sampradAYake satarka karate pAra, yAdera kAche tomAra Age kona satarkakArI Aseni| haYata tArA upadeza grahaNa karave|

evaM tAdera kRtakAryera kAraNe tAdera upara kona musivata Asale tArA yAte valate nA pAre, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Apani AmAdera kAche kona rAsUla pAThAlena nA kena? tAhale AmarA ApanAra AYAtasamUha anusaraNa karatAma evaM AmarAo ImAnadAradera antarbhukta haYe yetAma|

ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra pakSa hate satya ese gela, takhana tArA valate lAgala, mUsA (AlAihisa sAlAma)ke yemanaTA deoYA haYechila, se rakama jinisa eke (arthAt ei rAsUlake) kena deoYA hala nA? pUrve mUsAke yA deoYA haYechila, tArA ki pUrvei tA pratyAkhyAna	kareni? tArA valechila, e duToi yAdu, yAra ekaTi anyaTike samarthana kare| AmarA era pratyekaTii asvIkAra kari|
(tAderake) vala, AcchA, tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tave AllAra pakSa theke emana kona kitAva AnaYana kara, yA e du’Ti apekSA vezi hedAYAta samvalita| tAhale Ami tAra anusaraNa karava|

tArA yadi tomAra pharamAYeza mata kAja nA kare, tave vujhave, tArA mUlata tAdera kheYAla-khuzIrai anusaraNa kare| ye vyakti AllAhara pakSa hate Agata hedAYAta chAr3A kevala nija kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kare, tAra ceYe vezi pathabhraSTa Ara ke hate pAre? nizcaYai AllAha jAlema sampradAYake hedAYAta dAna karena nA|
eTA eka vAstavatA ye, Ami tAdera kalyANArthe ekera para eka (upadeza) vANI pAThAte thAki, yAte tArA satarka haYe yAYa|
Ami kuraAnera Age yAderake AsamAnI kitAva diYechi, tArA era (arthAt kuraAnera) prati ImAna Ane|
tAderake yakhana tA par3e zonAno haYa, takhana vale AmarA era prati ImAna AnalAma| nizcaYai eTA satya vANI, yA AmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eseche| AmarA to era Ageo anugata chilAma|

erUpa vyaktiderake tAdera pratidAna deoYA have dviguNa| kenanA tArA savara avalamvana kareche, tArA mandake pratihata kare bhAlora dvArA evaM Ami tAderake yA diYeche, tA theke (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare|
tArA yakhana kona vehudA kathA zone, tA er3iYe yAYa evaM vale, AmAdera janya AmAdera karma evaM tomAdera janya tomAdera karma| tomAderake sAlAma| AmarA ajJadera sAthe jar3ita hate cAi nA|
(he rAsUla!) satyi kathA hala, tumi nije yAke icchA karave tAke hedAYAtaprApta karate pArave nA; varaM AllAha yAke cAna hedAYAtaprApta karena| kArA hedAYAta kavula karave tA tinii bhAlo jAnena|

tArA vale, AmarA yadi tomAra sAthe hedAYAtera anusaraNa kari, tave AmAderake nija bhUmi theke utkhAta karA have| Ami ki tAderake emana eka nirApada harame pratiSThita karini, yekhAne AmAra pakSa hate pradatta riyakasvarUpa sarvaprakAra phalamUla AmadAnI karA haYa? kintu tAdera adhikAMzei jAne nA|

Ami emana kata janapada dhvaMsa karechi, yAra vAsindAgaNa tAdera artha-sampadera var3Ai karata| oi to tAdera vAstubhiTA (yA tomAdera sAmane raYeche), tAdera para sAmAnya kichukAla chAr3A tA Ara AvAda hate pAreni| Amii haYechi tAra uttarAdhikArI|

tomAra pratipAlaka emana nana ye, tini janapadasamUhake dhvaMsa kare divena tAra kendrabhUmite AmAra AYAtasamUha tAderake par3e zonAnora janya kona rAsUla preraNa nA karei| Ami janapadasamUha kevala takhanai dhvaMsa kari yakhana tAra vAsindAgaNa jAlema haYe yAYa|
tomAderake yA-kichui deoYA haYeche, tA pArthiva jIvanera pu~ji o tAra zobhA| Ara AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA uttama o sthAYI| tathApi ki tomarA vuddhike kAje lAgAve nA?

AcchA vala to Ami yAke uttama pratizruti diYechi, ataHpara se tA avazyai lAbha karave, se ki sei vyaktira samAna hate pAre, yAke Ami pArthiva jIvanera kichuTA bhoga-upakaraNa diYechi, ataHpara kiYAmatera dina se have sei sava lokera antarbhukta, yAderake dhRta kare AnA have?
evaM sei dina (-ke kakhanao bhulo nA), yakhana AllAha tAderake DAka diYe valavena, kothAYa AmAra (prabhutvera) aMzIdAragaNa, yAdera (aMzIdAra haoYAra) dAvi tomarA karate?

yAdera viruddhe (AllAhara) vANI cUr3Anta haYe geche, tArA valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! erAi tArA yAderake AmarA vipathagAmI karechilAma, tAderake vipathagAmI karechilAma sebhAvei, yemana AmarA nijerA vipathagAmI haYechilAma| AmarA ApanAra sAmane tAdera sAthe samparkaccheda ghoSaNA karachi| vastuta tArA AmAdera ivAdata karata nA|

evaM tAderake (arthAt kApheraderake) valA have, tomarA yAderake AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta karechile tAderake DAka| sutarAM tArA tAderake DAkave, kintu tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A deve nA| tArA takhana zAsti pratyakSa karave| AhA! yadi tArA hedAYAta kavula karata|
evaM sei dina (-ke kichutei bhulo nA) yakhana AllAha tAderake Deke valavena, tomarA navIgaNake kI uttara diYechile?
se dina yAvatIYa saMvAda (yA tArA nijedera pakSa hate tairi karata) vilupta haYe yAve| phale tArA eke anyake kichu jijJAsAvAdao karate pArave nA|
tave yArA tAovA kareche, ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, pUrNa AzA rAkhA yAYa tArA saphalakAmadera antarbhukta have|
tomAra pratipAlaka yA cAna sRSTi karena evaM (yA cAna) veche nena| tAdera kona ekhatiYAra nei| AllAha tAdera ziraka hate pavitra o samucca|
tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera antara ye sava kathA gopana kare tAo jAnena evaM tArA yA prakAza kare tAo|
tinii AllAha| tini chAr3A keu ivAdatera upayukta naYa| prazaMsA tA~rai, duniYAYao evaM AkherAteo| vidhAna kevala tA~rai evaM tA~rai dike tomAdera sakalake phiriYe neoYA have|

(he rAsUla! tAderake) vala, AcchA tomarA kI mane kara? AllAha yadi tomAdera upara rAtake kiYAmata paryanta sthAYI kare dena, tave AllAha chAr3A emana kona mAvuda Ache ki, ye tomAderake Alo ene dite pAre? tave ki tomarA zunate pAo nA?

vala, tomarA kI mane kara? AllAha yadi tomAdera upara dinake kiYAmata paryanta sthAYI kare dena, tave AllAha chAr3A emana kona mAvuda Ache ki, ye tomAderake emana rAta ene deve, yAte tomarA vizrAma grahaNa karate pAra? tave ki tomarA kichui vojha nA?
tinii nija rahamate tomAdera janya rAta o dina vAniYechena, yAte tomarA tAte vizrAma nite pAra o AllAhara anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA zukara AdAYa kara|
evaM sei dina (-ke bhulo nA) yakhana tini tAderake (arthAt muzarikaderake) Deke valavena, kothAYa AmAra (prabhutvera) zarIkagaNa, yAdera (zarIka haoYAra) dAvi tomarA karate?

Ami pratyeka ummata theke ekajana sAkSI vera kare Anava tArapara valava, tomarA tomAdera pramANa upasthita kara| takhana tArA upalavdhi karate pArave ye, satya kathA chila AllAharai| Ara tArA mithyA yA-kichu udbhAvana karechila, tAdera theke tA antarhita haYe yAve|

kArUna chila mUsAra sampradAYera eka vyakti| kintu se tAderai prati juluma karala| Ami tAke emana dhanabhANDAra diYechilAma, yAra cAviguli vahana karA ekadala zaktimAna lokera pakSeo kaSTakara chila| yakhana tAra sampradAYa tAke valechila, var3Ai karo nA| yArA var3Ai kare AllAha tAdera pachanda karena nA|

AllAha tomAke yA-kichu diYechena tAra mAdhyame AkherAtera nivAsa lAbhera ceSTA kara evaM duniYA hateo nija hisyA agrAhya karo nA| AllAha yemana tomAra prati anugraha karechena, temani tumio (anyadera prati) anugraha kara| Ara pRthivIte phAsAda vistArera ceSTA karo nA| jene rekha, AllAha phAsAda vistArakArIdera pachanda karena nA|

se valala, esava to Ami AmAra jJAnavale lAbha karechi| se ki etaTukuo jAnata nA ye, AllAha tAra Age emana vahu mAnavagoSThIke dhvaMsa karechilena, yArA zaktite tAra apekSA pravala chila evaM janasaMkhyAYao vezi chila? aparAdhIderake tAdera aparAdha samparke jijJesao karA haYa nA|

ataHpara (ekadina) se tAra sampradAYera sAmane nija jA~kajamakera sAthe vera haYe Asala| yArA pArthiva jIvana kAmanA karata tArA (tA dekhe) valate lAgala, AhA! kArUnake yA deoYA haYeche, anurUpa yadi AmAderao thAkata! vastuta se mahA bhAgyavAna|

Ara yArA (AllAhara pakSa hate) jJAnaprApta haYechila, tArA valala, dhika tomAderake! (tomarA erUpa kathA valacha, athaca) yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera janya AllAha pradatta saoYAva katai nA zreYa! Ara tA lAbha kare kevala dhairyazIlagaNai|
pariNAme Ami tAke o tAra vAr3iTi bhUgarbhe dhasiYe dilAma| ataHpara se emana ekaTi dalao pela nA, yArA AllAhara viparIte tAra kona sAhAyya karate pAre evaM nijeo pArala nA AtmarakSA karate|

Ara gatakAlai yArA tAra mata haoYAra AkAGkSA karachila, tArA valate lAgala, dekhale to! AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA riyaka prazasta kare dena evaM (yAra janya icchA) saMkIrNa kare dena| AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha nA karale tini AmAdera bhUgarbhe dhasiYe ditena| dekhale to kApheragaNa saphalatA lAbha kare nA|
oi parakAlIna nivAsa to Ami sei sakala lokera janyai nirdhAraNa karava, yArA pRthivIte var3atva dekhAte o phAsAda sRSTi karate cAYa nA| zeSa pariNAma to muttAkIderai anukUle thAkave|
ye vyakti kona puNya niYe Asave se tadapekSA uttama jinisa pAve Ara keu kona mandakarma niYe Asale, yArA manda kAja kare tAderake kevala tAdera kRtakarma anupAtei zAsti deoYA have|

(he navI!) yei sattA tomAra prati ei kuraAnera dAYitvabhAra arpaNa karechena, tini tomAke avazyai phiriYe Anavena (tomAra) priYabhUmite| vala, AmAra pratipAlaka bhAlo jAnena ke hedAYAta niYe eseche evaM ke spaSTa vibhrAntite lipta|
(he rAsUla!) pUrva theke tomAra e AzA chila nA ye, tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karA have| kintu eTA tomAra pratipAlakera rahamata| sutarAM tumi kakhanao kApheradera sAhAyyakArI haYo nA|

tomAra prati AllAhara AYAtasamUha nAyila haoYAra para tArA yena kichutei tomAke era (anusaraNa) theke phiriYe rAkhate nA pAre| tumi nija pratipAlakera dike mAnuSake DAkate thAka evaM kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|

evaM AllAhara saGge anya kona mAvudake Deka nA| tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| savakichui dhvaMsazIla, kevala AllAhara sattAi vyatikrama| zAsana kevala tA~rai evaM tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
mAnuSa ki mane kare ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’ e kathA valalei tAderake parIkSA nA kare cher3e deoYA have?
athaca tAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche tAderakeo Ami parIkSA karechi| sutarAM AllAha avazyai jene nevena kArA satyaniSThAra paricaYa diYeche evaM tini avazyai jene nevena kArA mithyAvAdI|
