yArA manda kAryAvalIte lipta tArA ki mane kare tArA AmAra upara jite yAve? tArA yA anumAna karache tA katai nA manda!
yArA AllAhara saGge milita haoYAra AzA rAkhe, tAdera nizcita thAkA ucita AllAhara nirdhArita kAla avazyai Asave evaM tinii sava kathA zonena, savakichu jAnena|
Ara AmAra pathe ye vyaktii zrama-sAdhanA kare, se to zrama-sAdhanA kare nijerai kalyANArthe| nizcaYai AllAha vizva-jagatera sakala theke anapekSa|
yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, Ami avazyai tAdera mandasamUha tAdera theke miTiYe deva evaM tArA yA karache tAra utkRSTatama pratidAna tAderake avazyai deva|

Ami mAnuSake Adeza karechi tArA yena pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadvyavahAra kare| tArA yadi AmAra sAthe emana kichuke zarIka karAra janya tomAra upara valapraYoga kare, yAra samparke tomAra kAche kona pramANa nei, tave se vyApAre tAdera kathA mAnave nA| AmArai kAche tomAderake phire Asate have| takhana Ami tomAderake avahita karava tomarA kI karate|
yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, Ami avazyai tAderake neka lokadera antarbhukta karava|

mAnuSera madhye kataka loka emana Ache, yArA vale, AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi| ataHpara yakhana AllAhara pathe tAdera kona kaSTa-kleza dekhA deYa, takhana tArA mAnuSera deoYA kaSTake AllAhara AyAva tulya gaNya kare| AvAra yadi kakhanao tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke (musalimadera janya) kona sAhAyya Ase, takhana tArA valavei, AmarA to tomAderai sAthe chilAma| vizva-jagatera samasta mAnuSera antare yA Ache, AllAha ki tA bhAlobhAve jAnena nA?
AllAha avazyai jene nevena kArA ImAna eneche evaM tini avazyai jene nevena kArA munApheka|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA muminaderake vale, tomarA AmAdera patha anusaraNa kara, tAhale AmarA tomAdera gunAhera vojhA vahana karava, athaca tArA tAdera gunAhera vojhA Adau vahana karate pArave nA| nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|

tArA avazyai tAdera nijedera gunAhera vojhA vahana karave evaM nijedera vojhAra sAthe Arao kichu vojhA| tArA yA-kichu mithyA udbhAvana kare, kiYAmatera dina tAderake se samparke avazyai jijJAsAvAda karA have|
Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma| se tAdera madhye avasthAna karechila paJcAza kama hAjAra vachara| ataHpara plAvana tAderake grAsa karala, yehetu tArA chila jAlema|
ataHpara Ami nUhake o naukArohIderake rakSA karalAma evaM eTAke jagadvAsIdera janya ekaTi nidarzana vAniYe dilAma|
evaM Ami ivarAhImake pAThAlAma, yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valechila, AllAhara ivAdata kara o tA~ke bhaYa kara| eTAi tomAdera pakSe zreYa, yadi tomarA jJAna rAkha|

tomarA to AllAhara parivarte kevala pratimAderai pUjA karacha evaM racanA karacha mithyA| tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAdera ivAdata kara, tArA tomAderake riyaka deoYAra kSamatA rAkhe nA| sutarAM AllAhara kAche riyaka sandhAna kara, tA~ra ivAdata kara evaM tA~ra kRtajJatA AdAYa kara| tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
tomarA yadi AmAke mithyAvAdI vala, tave tomAdera pUrveo vahu jAti navIderake mithyAvAdI valechila| suspaSTabhAve vArtA peৗ~chAno chAr3A rAsUlera Ara kona dAYitva thAke nA|
tave ki tArA lakSya kareni, AllAha kibhAve mAkhalukake prathamavAra sRSTi karena? ataHpara tinii tAderake punarAYa sRSTi karavena| AllAhara pakSe e kAja ati sahaja|

vala, pRthivIte ekaTu bhramaNa kare dekha, AllAha kibhAve mAkhalukake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena| tArapara AllAhai (tAderake) AkherAtakAlIna utthAne utthita karavena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|
tini yAke icchA zAsti devena, yAra prati icchA daYA karavena evaM tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
tomarA bhUmiteo tA~ke (AllAhake) akSama karate pArave nA evaM AkAzeo nA| AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM sAhAyyakArIo nei|
yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha o tA~ra sAkSAtake asvIkAra kareche, tArAi AmAra rahamata theke nirAza haYe geche| tAdera janya Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

kintu ivarAhImera sampradAYera uttara e chAr3A kichui chila nA ye, tArA valechila, tomarA tAke hatyA kare phela athavA tAke jvAliYe dAo| anantara AllAha tAke Aguna theke rakSA karalena| nizcaYai yArA ImAna Ane, tAdera janya e ghaTanAra bhetara vahu zikSA Ache|

ivarAhIma Arao valechila, tomarA to AllAhake cher3e mUrtigulokei (prabhu) menecha, pArthiva jIvane tomAdera pArasparika vandhutva rakSAra lakSe| parizeSe kiYAmatera dina tomarA eke anyake asvIkAra karave evaM eke anyake lAnata karave| tomAdera ThikAnA have jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera kona rakama sAhAyyakArI lAbha have nA|
ataHpara lUta tAra prati ImAna Anala| ivarAhIma valala, Ami AmAra pratipAlakera dike hijarata karachi| nizcaYai tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ami tAke isahAka o iYAkuva (-era mata santAna) dAna karalAma evaM tAra vaMzadharadera madhye navuoYAta o kitAvera dhArA cAlu rAkhalAma evaM duniYAYa tAke tAra puraskAra dAna karalAma Ara nizcaYai AkherAte se sAlehInera madhye gaNya have|
evaM Ami lUtake pAThAlAma, yakhana se nija sampradAYake valala, vastuta tomarA emanai azlIla kAja karacha, yA tomAdera pUrve vizvajagatera Ara keu kareni|

tomarA ki puruSadera kAche upagamana kara evaM pathe-ghATe DAkAti kara Ara tomAdera bharA majalise anyAYa kAje lipta hao? ataHpara tAra sampradAYera lokadera uttara echAr3A Ara kichui chila nA ye, tArA valala, tumi yadi satyavAdI hao, tave AmAdera upara AllAhara AyAva niYe eso|
lUta valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! phAsAda sRSTikArIdera viruddhe AmAke sAhAyya karuna|

yakhana AmAra prerita phirizatAgaNa ivarAhImera kAche (tAra putra janma neoYAra) susaMvAda niYe peৗ~chala, takhana tArA valechila, AmarA ei janapadavAsIderake dhvaMsa karava| kenanA era adhivAsIgaNa var3a jAlema|

ivarAhIma valala, se janapade to lUta raYeche| phirizatAgaNa valala, AmAdera bhAlobhAvei jAnA Ache, sekhAne kArA Ache| AmarA tAke o tAra parivAravargake avazyai rakSA karava, tave tAra strIke chAr3A| se yArA pechane theke yAve tAdera madhye thAkave|

yakhana AmAra prerita phirizatAgaNa lUtera kAche Asala, takhana tAdera janya se viSaNNa haYe par3ala evaM tAdera vyApAre tAra antara kuNThita hala| phirizatAgaNa valala, Apani bhaYa karavena nA evaM duzcintA karavena nA| AmarA ApanAke o ApanAra sAthe sampRktaderake rakSA karava, tave ApanAra strIke chAr3A, ye theke yAve yArA pechane thAkave tAdera madhye|
e janapadera vAsindAgaNa ye kukarma kare yAcche, tAra pariNAme AmarA tAdera upara AsamAna theke AyAva nAyila karava|
Ami vodhasampanna vyaktidera janya rekhe diYechi e janapadera kichu spaSTa nidarzana|
mAdaiYAne pAThAlAma tAdera bhAi zuAivake| se valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara evaM zeSa divasake bhaYa kara Ara bhUmite arAjakatA vistAra kare ver3io nA|
ataHpara ei ghaTala ye, tArA zuAivake mithyAvAdI ThAorAla, pariNAme bhUmikampa tAderake AghAta hAnala evaM tArA nija-nija gRhe mukha thuvar3e par3e thAkala|

Ami Ada o chAmUdakeo dhvaMsa karalAma| tAdera gharavAr3i dvArAi tAdera dhvaMsaprApti tomAdera kAche spaSTa haYe Ache| zaYatAna tAdera kAryAvalIke tAdera dRSTite manorama vAniYe diYe tAderake sarala patha theke nivRtta rekhechila, athaca tArA chila vicakSaNa|
Ami kArUna, phira‘Aona o hAmAnake dhvaMsa karechilAma| mUsA tAdera kAche ujjvala nidarzana niYe esechila, kintu tArA deze var3atva pradarzana karechila, kintu tArA to (AmAra upara) jitate pAreni|

Ami tAdera pratyekake tAra aparAdhera kAraNe dhRta kari| tAdera keu to emana, yAra viruddhe pAThAi pAthara varSaNakArI jhar3o-jhaJjhA, keu chila emana yAke AkrAnta kare mahAnAda, keu chila emana, yAke bhUgarbhe dhasiYe dei evaM keu chila emana, yAke kari nimajjita| vastuta AllAha emana nana ye, tAdera prati juluma karavena; varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karachila|

yArA AllAhake cher3e anya abhibhAvaka grahaNa kareche, tAdera dRSTAnta hala mAkar3asA, ye nijera janya ghara vAnAYa Ara nizcaYai gharera madhye sarvApekSA durvala mAkar3asAra gharai haYe thAke| AhA! tArA yadi jAnata|
AllAha bhAlo karei jAnena tArA AllAhake cher3e kAke kAke DAke| tini kSamatAra mAlika, hekamaterao mAlika|
Ami mAnuSera kalyANArthe esava dRSTAnta diYe thAki, kintu tA vojhe kevala tArAi, yArA jJAnavAna|
AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIke yathArtha (uddezye) sRSTi karechena| vastuta ImAnadAradera janya era madhye avazyai nidarzana Ache|

(he navI!) ohIra mAdhyame tomAra prati ye kitAva nAyila karA haYeche, tA tilAoYAta kara o nAmAya kAYema kara| nizcaYai nAmAya azlIla o anyAYa kAja theke virata rAkhe| Ara AllAhara yikirai to sarvApekSA var3a jinisa| tomarA yA-kichu kara, AllAha tA jAnena|

(he musalimagaNa!) kitAvIdera sAthe vitarka karave nA uttama panthA chAr3A| tave tAdera madhye yArA sImAlaGghana kare, tAdera kathA svatantra evaM (tAderake) vala, AmarA ImAna enechi sei kitAvera prati yA AmAdera upara nAyila karA haYeche evaM ye kitAva tomAdera upara nAyila karA haYeche tAra pratio| AmAdera mAvuda o tomAdera mAvuda ekai| AmarA tA~rai AnugatyakArI|

(he rAsUla!) ebhAvei Ami tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi| sutarAM yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi tArA ete ImAna Ane evaM tAdera (arthAt mUrtipUjakadera) madhyeo keu keu ete ImAna Anache| vastuta AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare kevala kApherarAi|
tumi to era Age kona kitAva par3ani evaM nija hAte kona kitAva lekhaoni| se rakama kichu hale bhrAntapatha avalamvanakArIrA sandeha karate pArata|
prakRtapakSe e kuraAna emana nidarzanAvalIra samaSTi, yA jJAnaprAptadera antare sampUrNa suspaSTa| AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare kevala jAlemagaNai|

tArA vale, tAra prati (arthAt mahAnavI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAmera prati) tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate kena nidarzanAvalI avatIrNa karA hala nA? (he rAsUla! tAderake) vala, nidarzanAvalI to AllAharai kAche| Ami ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI mAtra|

tave ki tAdera janya eTA (arthAt ei nidarzana) yatheSTa naYa ye, Ami tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi, yA tAderake par3e zonAno hacche? nizcaYai ye samasta loka vizvAsa kare tAdera janya ete raYeche rahamata o upadeza|

vala, AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSya dAnera janya AllAhai yatheSTa| tini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache savai jAnena| yArA bhrAnta viSaYe ImAna eneche o AllAhake asvIkAra kareche, tArAi kSatigrasta|

tArA tomAke tAr3AtAr3i zAsti ene dite vale| yadi (zAstira janya) eka nirdiSTa samaYa nA thAkata, tave tAdera upara avazyai zAsti ese yeta| Ara tA avazyai tAdera upara emana atarkitabhAve Asave ye tArA Terao pAve nA|
tArA tomAke zAsti tAr3AtAr3i ene dite vale| nizcaYai jAhAnnAma kApheraderake pariveSTana kare phelave,
sei dina, ye dina AyAva tAderake Acchanna karave upara dika thekeo evaM tAdera pAYera nica thekeo| Ara tini valavena, tomarA tomAdera kRtakarmera svAda grahaNa kara|
he AmAra mumina vAndAgaNa! nizcaYai AmAra bhUmi ati prazasta| sutarAM tomarA AmArai ivAdata kara|
jIva mAtrakei mRtyura svAda grahaNa karate have| tArapara tomAdera sakalake AmArai kAche phiriYe AnA have|

yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, Ami tAderake avazyai jAnnAtera emana vAlAkhAnAYa vasavAsa karate deva, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| tAte tArA sadA-sarvadA thAkave| ati utkRSTa pratidAna sei karmazIladera janya
yArA savara avalamvana kareche evaM tArA nija pratipAlakera upara bharasA rAkhe|
emana kata jIvajantu Ache, yArA nijedera khAdya saGge vaYe ver3AYa nA| AllAhai tAderake riyaka dAna karena evaM tomAderakeo| tinii sava kathA zonena, sakala kichu jAnena|

tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara, ke AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM sUrya o candrake kAje niYojita karechena, tave tArA avazyai valave, AllAha! tAhale tArA dikabhrAnta haYe kona dike phire yAcche?
AllAha nija vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA riyaka prazasta kare dena evaM yAra janya icchA saMkIrNa kare dena| nizcaYai AllAha pratiTi viSaYe samyaka jJAta|

tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara, ke AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karechena ataHpara tA dvArA bhUmike tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita karechena, tave tArA avazyai valave, AllAha! vala, ‘AlahAmadulillAha’| kintu tAdera adhikAMzei vuddhike kAje lAgAYa nA|
ei pArthiva jIvana khelAdhulA chAr3A kichui naYa| vastuta AkherAtera jIvanai prakRta jIvana, yadi tArA jAnata!
tArA yakhana naukAYa car3e, takhana tArA AllAhake DAke tA~ra Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe| tArapara tAderake uddhAra kare yakhana sthale niYe Asena, amani tArA zirake lipta haYe par3e|
Ami tAderake ye ni‘Amata diYechi, tArA tAra akRtajJatA karate thAkuka evaM luTe nika kichu majA! sei samaYa dUre naYa, yakhana tArA savai jAnate pArave|

tArA ki lakSya kareni, Ami (tAdera nagarake) eka nirApada harama vAniYe diYechi, athaca tAdera AzapAzera lokadera upara haYa atarkita hAmalA| tAraparao ki tArA alIka vastura prati vizvAsa rAkhache o AllAhara ni‘Amatera nAzokarI karache?

tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre, ye AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda Aropa kare kiMvA yakhana tAra kAche satya vANI peৗ~che, takhana tA pratyAkhyAna kare? (erUpa) kApheradera ThikAnA ki jAhAnnAme naYa?
yArA AmAra uddezye praceSTA cAlAYa, Ami tAderake avazyai AmAra pathe upanIta karava| nizcaYai AllAha satkarmazIladera saGge Achena|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
romakagaNa parAjita haYeche,
kintu nikaTavartI aJcale tArA tAdera parAjaYera para vijaYa arjana karave
vachara kaYekera madhyei| samasta kSamatA AllAharai, pUrveo evaM pareo| se dina muminagaNa Anandita have
AllAha pradatta vijaYera kAraNe| tini yAke icchA vijaYa dAna karena| tinii kSamatAra mAlika, parama daYAluo vaTe|
eTA AllAhara kRta oYAdA| AllAha nija oYAdAra viparIta karena nA| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
tArA pArthiva jIvanera prakAzya dikaTAi jAne Ara AkherAta samparke tArA sampUrNa gAphela|

tave ki tArA nijedera antare bheve dekheni? AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIke evaM etadubhaYera mAjhe vidyamAna jinisake yathAyatha uddezya o nirdiSTa meYAda vyatireke sRSTi karenani| kintu mAnuSera madhye anekei nija pratipAlakera sAthe milita haoYAke asvIkAra kare|

tArA ki bhUmite calApherA kareni, tAhale dekhate peta tAdera pUrve yArA chila tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche? tArA zaktite chila tAdera ceYe pracaNDatara evaM tArA jami cASa karata evaM tA AvAda karata tAdera AvAda apekSA vezi| tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechila| vastuta AllAha emana nana ye, tAdera prati juluma karavena; varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karechila|
ataHpara yArA manda kAja karechila, tAdera pariNAmao mandai haYeche| kenanA tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karechila evaM tArA tA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
AllAhai sRSTira sUcanA karena evaM tinii tAke punarAYa sRSTi karavena| tArapara tomAderake tA~rai kAche phiriYe neoYA have|
ye dina kiYAmata saMghaTita have, se dina aparAdhIrA nirAza haYe yAve|
tArA yAderake AllAhara zarIka menechila, tAdera madhye keu tAdera supArizakArI have nA evaM tArA nijerAo tAdera zarIkadera asvIkArakArI haYe yAve|
evaM ye dina kiYAmata saMghaTita have, se dina mAnuSa vibhinna dale vibhakta haYe yAve|
sutarAM yArA ImAna enechila o satkarma karechila tAderake jAnnAte Ananda dAna karA have, (yA tAdera cehArA theke vicchurita have)|
Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha o AkherAtera sAkSAtakArake asvIkAra karechila tAderake AyAve dhRta karA have|
sutarAM AllAhara tAsavIhate lipta thAka yakhana tomarA sandhyAYa upanIta hao evaM yakhana tomarA bhorera sammukhIna hao|
evaM tArai prazaMsA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte evaM vikAla velAYa (tAra tAsavIhate lipta hao) evaM juharera samaYao|

tini prANahIna theke prANavAnake vera kare Anena evaM prANavAna theke prANahInake vera kare Anena| Ara tini bhUmike tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita karena| ebhAvei tomAderake (kavara theke) vera karA have|
tA~ra (kudaratera) ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, tini tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tomarA dekhate nA dekhate mAnavarUpe (bhUmite) char3iYe par3ale|

tA~ra eka nidarzana ei ye, tini tomAdera janya tomAderai madhya hate strI sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA tAdera kAche giYe zAnti lAbha kara evaM tini tomAdera parasparera madhye bhAlovAsA o daYA sRSTi karechena| nizcaYai era bhetara nidarzana Ache sei sava lokera janya, yArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|
evaM tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye Ache AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRjana evaM tomAdera bhASA o varNera vaicitrya| nizcaYai era madhye nidarzana Ache jJAnavAnadera janya|
evaM tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye Ache rAta o dine tomAdera ghuma evaM tomAdera kartRka tA~ra anugraha sandhAna| nizcaYai era madhye nidarzana Ache sei sakala lokera janya, yArA kathA zone|

evaM tA~ra ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, tini tomAderake dekhAna vijalI, bhaYa o AzA saJcArakarUpe evaM AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karena, anantara tA dvArA bhUmike tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita karena| nizcaYai era madhye nidarzana Ache, sei sava lokera janya, yArA vuddhike kAje lAgAYa|
tA~ra ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, AkAza o pRthivI tA~rai hukume pratiSThita Ache| tArapara tini yakhana mATi theke (uThe AsAra janya) tomAderake ekavAra DAka divena saGge-saGge tomarA vera haYe Asave|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache sava tA~rai mAlikAnAdhIna| sakale tA~rai AjJAvaha|

tinii sei sattA, yini sRSTira sUcanA karena| tArapara tinii tAke punarjIvita karavena Ara eTA tAra janya sahajatara| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte tA~rai mahimA sarveAcca| tinii kSamatAra mAlika, prajJAmaYa|

tini tomAdera janya tomAdera nijedera madhya hatei ekaTi dRSTAnta peza karechena| Ami tomAderake ye riyaka diYechi, tomAdera dAsa- dAsIdera madhye keu ki tAte tomAdera emana aMzIdAra Ache ye, tomarA o tArA tAte sama-maryAdAra evaM tomarA tAderake Thika se rakamai bhaYa kara, yemana bhaYa kare thAka tomarA paraspare eke anyake? yArA vuddhike kAje lAgAYa, tAdera janya Ami ebhAvei nidarzanAvalI suspaSTarUpe vivRta kari|
kintu jAlemagaNa ajJAnatAvazata tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kareche| kAjei AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karechena, ke tAke hedAYAta dite pAre? erUpa lokera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|

sutarAM tumi nija cehArAke ekaniSThabhAve ei dInera abhimukhI rAkha| AllAhara sei phitarata anuyAYI cala, ye phitaratera upara tini mAnuSake sRSTi karechena| AllAhara sRSTite kona parivartana sAdhana sambhava naYa| eTAi sampUrNa sarala dIna| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
(phitaratera anusaraNa karave) tA~rai (arthAt AllAharai) abhimukhI haYe tA~ke bhaYa karave, nAmAya kAYema karave evaM antarbhukta have nA muzarikadera
yArA nijedera dInake khaNDa-khaNDa kare pheleche evaM vibhinna dale vibhakta haYe par3eche| pratiTi dala Apana-Apana panthA niYe utphulla|

mAnuSake yakhana kona duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana tArA tAdera pratipAlakera abhimukhI haYe tA~kei DAke, tArapara tini yakhana nijera pakSa hate tAderake kona rahamatera svAda grahaNa karAna, amani tAdera ekadala nija pratipAlakera sAthe ziraka zuru kare deYa
Ami tAderake yA-kichu diYechi tAra nA-zokari karAra janya| Thika Ache! kichuTA majA luTe nAo, zIghrai tomarA savakichu jAnate pArave|
Ami ki tAdera upara emana kona dalIla nAyila karechi, yA tArA AllAhara saGge ye ziraka karache tAderake tA karate vale?
Ami mAnuSake yakhana rahamatera svAda grahaNa karAi takhana tArA tAte utphulla haYa| pakSAntare tAderai kRtakarmera kAraNe yakhana tAdera kona aniSTa sAdhita haYa, amani tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
tArA ki dekheni AllAha yAra janya icchA riyaka prazasta kare dena evaM (yAra janya icchA) saMkIrNa kare dena? nizcaYai era madhye nidarzana Ache sei sava lokera janya, yArA ImAna Ane|
sutarAM AtmIYake tAra haka diYe dAo evaM abhAvagrastake o musAphirakeo| yArA AllAhara santuSTi kAmanA kare tAdera janya eTA zreYa evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

tomarA ye suda dAo, yAte tA mAnuSera sampade (yukta haYe) vRddhi pAYa, AllAhara kAche tA vRddhi pAYa nA| pakSAntare AllAhara santuSTi vidhAnera uddezye tomarA ye yAkAta diYe thAka, to yArA tA deYa tArAi (nijedera sampada) kaYeka guNa vRddhi kare neYa|

AllAha sei sattA, yini tomAderake sRSTi karechena, tArapara tini tomAderake riyaka diYechena, tArapara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna, tArapara tini tomAderake jIvita karavena| tomarA yAderake AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta karecha, tAdera madhye ki emana keu Ache, ye era konaoTi karate pAre? tini pavitra o sei ziraka theke samucca, yAte tArA lipta raYeche|
mAnuSa nija hAte yA kAmAYa, tAra phale sthale o jale azAnti char3iYe par3e, AllAha tAderake tAdera kataka kRtakarmera svAda grahaNa karAvena vale, haYata (era phale) tArA phire Asave|
(he rAsUla!) tAderake vala, bhUmite vicaraNa kare dekha pUrve yArA gata haYeche tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche| tAdera adhikAMzai chila muzarika|
sutarAM tumi nija cehArA vizuddha dInera dike kAYema rAkha, sei dina AsAra Age, AllAhara pakSa theke yA TalavAra kona sambhAvanAi nei| se dina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ye vyakti kuphara kareche, tAra kupharera zAsti tAkei bhoga karate have| Ara yArA satkarma kareche, tArA nijedera janya patha tairi karache|
phale yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche AllAha tAderake nija anugrahe puraskRta karavena| nizcaYai AllAha kApheraderake bhAlavAsena nA|

evaM tA~ra (kudaratera) ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, tini vAYu preraNa karena (vRSTira) susaMvAdavAhIrUpe, tomAderake tA~ra rahamata AsvAdana karAnora janya evaM yAte nauyAna tA~ra nirdeze (pAnite) calAcala kare, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna kara evaM tAra zokara AdAYa kara|

(he rAsUla!) Ami tomAra Ageo vahu rAsUla pAThiYechi tAdera Apana-Apana sampradAYera kAche| tArA tAdera kAche suspaSTa dalIla-pramANa niYe esechila| ataHpara yArA anyAYa-aparAdhe lipta haYechila Ami tAderake zAsti diYechi| Ara muminaderake sAhAyya karAra dAYitva Ami nijera upara rekhechi|

AllAhai sei sattA, yini vAYu preraNa karena| se vAYu meghamAlA saJcAlana kare| tArapara tini yebhAve cAna tA AkAze char3iYe dena evaM tAke kaYeka stara viziSTa (ghanaghaTA) vAniYe dena| phale tomarA dekhate pAo tAra bhetara theke vRSTi nirgata haYa| yakhana tini tAra vAndAdera madhye yAdera nikaTa icchA haYa se vRSTi peৗ~chiYe dena, takhana sahasAi tArA haYe oThe Anandotphulla|
athaca tAra Age yatakSaNa tAdera upara vRSTipAta karA haYani, tatakSaNa tArA chila hatAzAgrasta|
AllAhara rahamatera phala lakSya kara, tini kibhAve bhUmike tAra mRtyura para jIvana dAna karena| vastuta tini mRtadera jIvanadAtA evaM tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
Ami yadi (kSatikara) vAYu pravAhita kari, phale tArA tAdera zasyakSetrake pItavarNa dekhate pAYa, erapara tArA akRtajJatAYa lipta haYe par3e|
(he rAsUla!) tumi to mRtaderake kona kathA zonAte pArave nA evaM vadhirakeo pArave nA DAka zonAte, yakhana tArA pichana phire cale yAYa|

evaM tumi andhaderake pathabhraSTatA theke mukta kare saThika pathe Anate pArave nA| tumi to kevala tAderakei nijera kathA zonAte pArave, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna Ane ataHpara haYe yAYa AjJAnuvartI|

AllAha sei sattA, yini tomAdera sRSTi (zuru) karechena durvala avasthA theke, durvalatAra para tini dAna karena zakti, phera zaktira para dena durvalatA o vArdhakya| tini yA cAna sRSTi karena evaM tinii sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|
ye dina kiYAmata saMghaTita have se dina aparAdhIrA kasama kare valave ye, tArA (varayakhe) muhUrta kAlera vezi avasthAna kareni| ebhAvei tArA (duniYAYao) ulTo mukhe calata|

Ara yAderake ilama o ImAna deoYA haYechila tArA valave, tomarA to AllAhara lekhA (tAkadIra) anusAre punarutthAna dina paryanta (varayakhe) avasthAna karecha| eTAi sei punarutthAna-divasa| kintu tomarA to vizvAsa karate nA|
yArA julumera patha avalamvana karechila, se dina tAdera ojara-Apatti tAdera kona kAje Asave nA evaM tAderake AllAhara asantuSTi dUra karateo valA have nA|

vastuta e kuraAne Ami mAnuSa (-ke vojhAno)-era janya sava rakama viSaYa vivRta karechi evaM (he rAsUla!) tumi yadi tAdera kAche konao nidarzana niYeo Asa, kApheragaNa tathApi valave, tomarA bhrAnta pathei Acha|
yArA jJAna-vuddhike kAje lAgAYa nA, AllAha ebhAvei tAdera antare mohara kare dena|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi savara avalamvana kara| nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya| yArA iYAkIna kare nA, tArA yena kichutei tomAke diYe zithilatA pradarzana karAte nA pAre|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
egulo hekamatapUrNa kitAvera AYAta
yA satkarmazIladera janya hedAYAta o rahamatasvarUpa|
(sei sakala lokera janya,) yArA nAmAya kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM AkherAtera prati paripUrNa vizvAsa rAkhe|
tArAi tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate sarala pathe pratiSThita Ache evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

kataka mAnuSa emana, yArA ajJatAvazata AllAhara patha theke mAnuSake vicyuta karAra janya kharida kare emana sava kathA, yA AllAha samparke udAsIna kare deYa evaM tArA AllAhara patha niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa kare| tAdera janya Ache lAJchanAkara zAsti|

erUpa vyaktira sAmane yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa, takhana se dambhabhare mukha phiriYe neYa, yena se tA zunatei pAYani, yena tAra kAna du’Tite vadhiratA Ache| sutarAM tAke eka yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda zuniYe dAo|
kintu yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tAdera janya Ache ni‘AmatapUrNa udyAnarAji|
tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| eTA AllAhara satya oYAdA| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tini tomAdera dRSTigocara haYa emana stambha chAr3A AkAzamaNDalI sRSTi karechena evaM tini pRthivIte pAhAr3era bhAra sthApana karechena, yAte tA tomAdera niYe dola nA khAYa Ara tini tAte char3iYe diYechena sava rakama jIvajantu| Ami AkAza theke vArivarSaNa karechi tArapara tAte (arthAt pRthivIte) sarvaprakAra mUlyavAna udbhida udagata karechi|
ei hala AllAhara sRSTi| evAra tini chAr3A anyarA kI sRSTi kareche AmAke dekhAo| prakRtapakSe e jAlemagaNa suspaSTa vibhrAntite lipta raYeche|

Ami lukamAnake dAna karechilAma jJAnavattA (evaM tAke valechilAma) ye, AllAhara zokara AdAYa karate thAka| ye-keu zokara AdAYa kare, se to kevala nija kalyANArthei zokara AdAYa kare Ara keu nA-zokarI karale AllAha to ati veniYAya, prazaMsAyogya|
evaM (sei samaYake) smaraNa kara, yakhana lukamAna tAra putrake upadezacchale valechila, he vAchA! AllAhara sAthe ziraka karo nA| nizcaYai ziraka carama juluma|

Ami mAnuSake tAra pitA-mAtA samparke nirdeza diYechi (kenanA) tAra mA kaSTera para kaSTa saYe tAke garbhe dhAraNa kareche Ara tAra dudha chAr3Ano haYa du’ vachare tumi zokara AdAYa kara AmAra evaM tomAra pitA-mAtAra| AmArai kAche (tomAderake) phire Asate have|

tArA yadi emana kAuke (prabhutve) AmAra samakakSa sAvyasta karAra janya tomAke cApa deYa, ye samparke tomAra kona jJAna nei, tave tAdera kathA mAnave nA| tave duniYAYa tAdera sAthe sadbhAve thAkave| emana vyaktira patha avalamvana karo, ye ekAntabhAve AmAra abhimukhI haYeche| ataHpara tomAdera sakalake AmArai kAche phire Asate have| takhana Ami tomAderake avahita karava tomarA yA-kichu karate|

(lukamAna Arao valena) he vAchA! kona kichu yadi sariSAra dAnA varAvarao haYa evaM tA thAke kona pAtharera bhetara kiMvA AkAzamaNDalIte vA bhUmite, tavuo AllAha tA upasthita karavena| nizcaYai AllAha ati sUkSmadarzI, savakichura khavara rAkhena|
vAchA! nAmAya kAYema kara, mAnuSake satkAjera Adeza kara, manda kAje vAdhA dAo evaM tomAra ye kaSTa dekhA deYa, tAte savara kara| nizcaYai eTA atyanta himmatera kAja|
evaM mAnuSera sAmane (ahaMkAre) nija gAla phulio nA evaM bhUmite darpabhare calo nA| nizcaYai AllAha kona darpita ahaMkArIke pasanda karena nA|
nija padacAraNAYa madhyapanthA avalamvana kara evaM nija kaNThasvara saMyata rAkha| nizcaYai sarvApekSA nikRSTa svara gAdhAderai svara|

tomarA ki lakSya karani AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache AllAha seguloke tomAdera kAje niYojita rekhechena evaM tini tAra prakAzya o gupta ni‘AmatasamUha tomAdera prati paripUrNabhAve varSaNa karechena? tathApi mAnuSera madhye kataka emana raYeche, yArA AllAha samparke vitarke lipta haYa, athaca tAdera kAche nA Ache kona jJAna, nA kona hedAYAta Ara nA kona dIptimAna kitAva, (yA tAderake vibhrAntira andhakAre konarUpa Alo dekhAte pAre)|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tAra anusaraNa kara, takhana tArA vale, nA, varaM AmarA to AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake ye pathe peYechi tArai anusaraNa karava| yadi zaYatAna tAderake (arthAt tAdera vApa-dAdAderake) jvalanta Agunera dike DAke tavuo ki (tArA tAderai anugAmI have)?
ye vyakti AjJAvaha haYe nija cehArAke AllAhara abhimukhI kare evaM se haYa satkarmazIla, nizcaYai se vyakti A~kar3e dharala eka majavuta hAtala| sakala viSaYera zeSa pariNAma AllAharai upara nyasta|

(he navI!) kona vyakti kuphara avalamvana karale tAra kuphara yena tomAke vyathita nA kare| zeSa paryanta to tAderake AmArai kAche phire Asate have| takhana Ami tAderake avahita karava tArA yA kareche| nizcaYai antare yA kichu (lukAno) Ache tAo AllAha puropuri jAnena|
Ami tAderake kichuTA majA luTate dicchi| ataHpara Ami tAderake eka kaThina zAstira dike Tene niYe yAva|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara, ke AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena, tArA avazyai valave, AllAha! vala, AlahAmadulillAha! tA sattveo tAdera adhikAMzai jJAna-vuddhike kAje lAgAYa nA|
yA-kichu AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte Ache tA AllAharai| nizcaYai AllAhai emana sattA, yini sakala theke anapekSa, sakala prazaMsAra upayukta|

bhUmite yata vRkSa Ache tA yadi kalama haYe yAYa evaM ei ye sAgara, era sAthe yadi e chAr3A Arao sAta sAgara mile yAYa (evaM tA kAli haYe AllAhara guNAvalI likhate zuru kare) tavuo AllAhara kathAmAlA niHzeSa have nA| vastuta AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomAdera sakalake sRSTi karA o punarjIvita karA (AllAhara pakSe) ekajana mAnuSa (-ke sRSTi karA o punarjIvita karA)-era matai| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu jAnena, savakichu dekhena|

tumi dekhani AllAha rAtake dinera madhye praviSTa karAna evaM dinake rAtera madhye praviSTa karAna evaM tini sUrya o candrake kAje niYojita kare rekhechena, pratyekaTi nirdiSTa kAla paryanta vicaraNazIla evaM (tumi ki jAna nA) AllAha tomarA yA-kichu karacha se samparke paripUrNa avagata?
esava ejanya ye, AllAha tinii satya (mAvuda) evaM tArA (arthAt muzarikagaNa) tA~ra parivarte yesava (mAvuda)ke DAke tA bhittihIna| Ara AllAha samucca, mahimAmaYa|

tumi ki dekhani jalayAnasamUha AllAhara anugrahe sAgare vicaraNa kare, tini tomAderake nijera kichu nidarzana dekhAvena vale? nizcaYai era bhetara Ache sei vyaktira janya vahu nidarzana, ye pracaNDa dhairyazIla, parama kRtajJa|

taraGgamAlA yakhana meghacchAYAra mata tAderake Acchanna kare takhana tArA AllAhake DAke bhakti-vizvAsake tA~rai janya khAlesa kare| ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake uddhAra kare sthale niYe Asena, takhana tAdera kichu saMkhyaka sarala pathe thAke| (avaziSTa sakale punarAYa zirake lipta haYa) AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare kevala pratyeka emana loka, ye ghora vizvAsaghAtaka, carama akRtajJa|

he mAnuSa! nija pratipAlaka (era asantuSTi) theke ve~ce thAka evaM sei dinake bhaYa kara, yakhana kona pitA tAra santAnera upakAre Asave nA evaM kona santAnerao sAdhya have nA tAra pitAra kichumAtra upakAra karAra| nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya| sutarAM pArthiva jIvana yena tomAderake kichutei dheA~kAYa phelate nA pAre evaM sarvApekSA var3a pratAraka (zaYatAna)-o yena AllAhara vyApAre tomAderake kichutei dheA~kA dite nA pAre|

nizcaYai kiYAmata (-era kSaNa) samparkita jJAna kevala AllAharai kAche Ache| tinii vRSTi varSaNa karena| tinii jAnena mAtRgarbhe kI Ache| kona prANI jAne nA se AgAmIkAla kI arjana karave evaM kona prANI eTAo jAne nA ye, kona bhUmite tAra mRtyu have| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu samparke samyaka jJAta, savakichu samparke paripUrNa khavara rAkhena|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
eTi rAvvula AlAmInera pakSa hate avatIrNa kitAva, yAte kona sandeha nei|

loke ki vale navI nije eTA racanA kare niYeche? nA, (he navI!) eTA to satya, yA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke eseche, yAte tumi era mAdhyame satarka kara emana eka sampradAYake, yAdera kAche tomAra Age kona satarkakArI Aseni, yAte tArA saThika pathe ese yAYa|

AllAha sei sattA, yini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o era madhyavartI yAvatIYa vastu chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| tArapara tini Araze ‘isatioYA’ grahaNa karena| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM nei kona supArizakArI| tAraparao ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
AkAza theke pRthivI paryanta pratiTi kAjera vyavasthApanA tini nijei karena| tArapara se kAja emana eka dine tAra kAche upare peৗ~che, tomAdera gaNanA anuyAYI yAra parimANa hAjAra vachara|
tini gupta o prakAzya vastura jJAtA| tini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
tini yesava vastu sRSTi karechena, tAra pratyekaTike karechena sundara| Ara mAnava sRSTira sUcanA karechena kAdA hate|
ataHpara tAra vaMzadhArA cAlu karechena niHsArita tuccha pAni theke|
tArapara tAke ThikaThAka karata tAra bhetara nija rUha phu~ke diYechena evaM (he mAnuSa!) tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena kAna, cokha o antara| tomarA alpai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
tArA vale, AmarA yakhana mATite mize hAriYe yAva, takhanao ki AmarA eka natuna janma lAbha karava? prakRtapakSe tArA tAdera pratipAlakera saGge milita haoYAke asvIkAra kare|
vale dAo, mRtyura ye pherezatAke tomAdera janya niYojita karA haYeche, se tomAderake puropuri usula kare neve| tArapara tomAderake tomAdera pratipAlakera kAche phiriYe neoYA have|

evaM hAYa! tumi yadi sei dRzya dekhate, yakhana aparAdhIrA nija pratipAlakera sAmane mAthA nuiYe (dA~r3iYe) thAkave (evaM valave!) he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA (evAra prakRta viSaYa) dekhalAma o zunalAma| sutarAM AmAdera punarAYa (duniYAYa) pAThiYe dina| tAhale AmarA satkAja karava| AmarA yathArtha vizvAsI haYe giYechi|
Ami cAile pratyeka vyaktike (prathamei) tAra hedAYAta diYe ditAma| kintu AmAra pakSa hate kathA sthirIkRta haYe geche ye, Ami jAhAnnAmake jina o mAnava dvArA avazyai bhare phelava|

evAra (jAhAnnAmera) svAda bhoga kara, yehetu tomarA tomAdera e dinaTi bhule giYechile, Amio tomAderake bhule giYechi| tomarA yA-kichu karachile tAra vinimaYe ekhana sthAYI AyAvera svAda bhoga karate thAka|

AmAra AYAtasamUhe to ImAna Ane kevala tArA, yArA era dvArA yakhana upadeza prApta haYa, takhana sijadAYa luTiYe par3e evaM nija pratipAlakera saprazaMsa tAsavIha pATha kare| Ara tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|

(rAtera velA) tAdera pArzvadeza vichAnA theke pRthaka haYe yAYa evaM tArA nija pratipAlakake bhaYa o AzAra (mizrita anubhUtira) sAthe DAke| Ara Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tA theke (satkAje) vyaYa kare|
sutarAM kona vyakti jAne nA erUpa lokadera janya tAdera karmaphala svarUpa cokha jur3Anora kata ki upakaraNa lukiYe rAkhA haYeche|
AcchA vala to, ye vyakti mumina, se ki oi vyaktira mata hate pAre, ye phAseka? (valAvAhulya) tArA samAna hate pAre nA|
yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI vasavAsera udyAna, yA tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera puraskAre prAthamika AtitheYatAsvarUpa deoYA have|

Ara yArA avAdhyatA kareche tAdera sthAYI AvAsana hala jAhAnnAma| yakhanai tArA tA theke vera hate cAve, tAderake tAtei phiriYe deoYA have evaM tAderake valA have, tomarA Agunera ye zAstike asvIkAra karate tAra majA bhoga kara|
evaM sei var3a zAstira Age Ami tAderake avazyai laghu zAstira svAdao grahaNa karAva| haYata tArA phire Asave|

sei vyakti apekSA var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre, yAke tAra pratipAlakera AYAtasamUha dvArA nasIhata karA haYeche Ara se tA hate mukha phiriYe niYeche| Ami avazyai erUpa jAlemadera theke vadalA niYe chAr3ava|
nizcaYai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma| sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi tAra sAkSAta samparke kona sandehe theko nA| Ami se kitAvake vanI isarAIlera janya vAniYechilAma patha-nirdeza|

Ara Ami tAdera madhye kichu lokake, yakhana tArA savara karala, emana netA vAniYe dilAma, yArA AmAra nirdeza anusAre mAnuSake patha pradarzana karata evaM tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe gabhIra vizvAsa rAkhata|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka kiYAmatera dina tAdera madhye sei sava viSaYe mImAMsA kare devena, yA niYe tArA matavirodha karachila|

tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa) ki kona patha-nirdeza lAbha kareni e viSaYa dvArA ye, tAdera pUrve Ami kata mAnava goSThIke dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yAdera vAsabhUmi diYe tArA calApherA kare thAke? nizcaYai era madhye tAdera janya Ache vahu nidarzana| tave ki tArA zone nA?
tArA ki dekhe nA Ami uSara bhUmira dike pAni Tene niYe yAi tArapara tA dvArA udagata kari zasya, yA theke khAYa tAdera gavAdi pazu evaM tArA nijerAo? tave ki tArA kichu upalavdhi karate pAre nA?
tArA vale, tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAkale (vala,) e mImAMsA kave have?
vale dAo, ye dina mImAMsA have, se dina asvIkArakArIra janya tAdera ImAna AnaYana kona upakAre Asave nA evaM tAderake kona avakAzao deoYA have nA|
sutarAM (he navI!) tumi tAderake agrAhya kara evaM apekSA kara| tArAo apekSamAna raYeche|
he navI! AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka evaM kAphera o munAphekadera Anugatya karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke tomAra prati ye ohI pAThAno hacche tAra anusaraNa kara| tomarA yA-kichu kara, AllAha nizcitabhAve se samparke paripUrNabhAve avagata|
evaM AllAhara prati bharasA rAkha| karma vidhAnera janya AllAha tAAlAi yatheSTa|

AllAha kArao abhyantarei du’To hRdaYa sRSTi karenani| Ara tomarA tomAdera ye strIderake mAYera piThera sAthe tulanA kara, tAderake tomAdera mA vAnAnani| Ara tomAdera mukhera DAkA putraderake tomAdera prakRta putra sAvyasta karenani| eTA to tomAdera mukhera kathAmAtra| AllAha satya kathAi valena evaM tinii saThika patha pradarzana karena|

tomarA tAderake (poSyaputraderake) tAdera pitR-paricaYe DAka| e paddhatii AllAhara kAche paripUrNa nyAYasaGgata| tomarA yadi tAdera pitR-paricaYa nA jAna, tave tArA tomAdera dInI bhAi o tomAdera vandhu| tomAdera dvArA kona bhula haYe gele sejanya tomAdera kona gunAha have nA| kintu ye viSaYe tomAdera antara icchA poSaNa kare (tA karale tomAdera gunAha have)| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

muminadera pakSe navI tAdera nijedera prANa apekSAo vezi ghaniSTha| Ara tAdera strIgaNa tAdera mA| tathApi AllAhara kitAva anuyAYI anyAnya mumina o muhAjiragaNa apekSA garbha-sUtrera AtmIYagaNa (mIrAchera vyApAre) eke anyera upara agrAdhikAra rAkhe| tave tomarA yadi tomAdera vandhu-vAndhavera (pakSe kona asiYata kare tAdera) prati saujanya pradarzana kara seTA bhinna kathA| ekathA kitAve lipivaddha Ache|

evaM (he rAsUla!) sei samaYake smaraNa rAkha, yakhana Ami samasta navI theke pratizruti niYechilAma evaM tomAra thekeo evaM nUha, ivarAhIma, mUsA o IsA ivane mAraYAma thekeo Ara Ami tAdera theke niYechilAma ati kaThina pratizruti,
satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAdItA samparke jijJesa karAra janya evaM kApheradera janya to tini eka yantraNAmaYa zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena|

he muminagaNa! AllAha tomAdera prati sei samaYa kIrUpa anugraha karechilena tA smaraNa kara, yakhana vahu sainya tomAdera prati car3Ao haYechila, tArapara Ami tAdera viruddhe eka jhar3o hAoYA pAThAi evaM eka vAhinI yA tomarA dekhate pAoni| Ara tomarA yA-kichu karachile AllAha tA dekhachilena|

smaraNa kara yakhana tArA tomAdera upara car3Ao haYechila upara dika thekeo evaM nicera dika thekeo evaM yakhana cokha visphArita haYechila evaM prANa mukhera kAche ese par3echila Ara tomarA AllAha samparke nAnA rakamera bhAvanA bhAvate zuru karechile|
takhana muminagaNa kaThinabhAve parIkSita haYechila evaM tAderake tIvra prakampane kA~piYe deoYA haYechila|
evaM smaraNa kara yakhana munAphekagaNa evaM yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache, tArA valachila, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla AmAderake ye pratizruti diYechilena, tA pratAraNA chAr3A kichui naYa|

evaM yakhana tAderai madhyakAra katipaYa loka valachila, he iYAsarivavAsI! ekhAne tomAdera kona sthAna nei| sutarAM oYApasa cale yAo evaM tAderai madhye kichu loka (vAr3i yAoYAra janya) ei vale navIra kAche anumati cAila ye, AmAdera ghara arakSita, athaca tA arakSita chila nA; varaM tAdera abhiprAYa chila kevala (konao upAYe) pAliYe yAoYA|
madInAra cAradika theke yadi tAdera kAche zatrudera praveza ghaTata Ara tAderake vidrohe yoga dite valA hata, tave tArA avazyai tAte yoga dita evaM takhana gRhe avasthAna karata alpai|
vastuta tArA pUrve AllAhara saGge aGgIkAra karechila ye, tArA pRSTha pradarzana karave nA| Ara AllAhara saGge kRta aGgIkAra samparke avazyai jijJAsAvAda karA have|

(he navI! tAderake) vale dAo, tomarA yadi mRtyu athavA hatyAra bhaYe palAYana kara, tave se palAYana tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA evaM sekSetre tomAderake (jIvanera) Ananda bhoga karate deoYA have ati sAmAnyai|

vala, emana ke Ache, ye tomAderake AllAha hate rakSA karate pAre, yadi tini tomAdera kona kSati karAra icchA karena athavA (emana ke Ache, ye tAra rahamata ThekAte pAre), yadi tini tomAdera prati rahamata karAra icchA karena? tArA AllAha chAr3A kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
AllAha tAderake bhAlo karei jAnena, tomAdera madhye yArA (jihAde) vAdhA sRSTi kare evaM nija bhAiderake vale, AmAdera kAche cale eso Ara tArA nijerA to yuddhe Ase ati sAmAnyai|

(evaM tAo) tomAdera prati lAlAYita haYe| sutarAM yakhana vipada ese par3e, takhana tumi tAderake dekhave mRtyu bhaYe mUrchita vyaktira mata tomAra dike ghUrNita cokhe tAkAcche| ataHpara yakhana vipada keTe yAYa takhana tArA arthera lobhe tIkSNa bhASAYa tomAderake viddha kare| tArA Adau ImAna Aneni| phale AllAha tAdera karma niSphala kare diYechena Ara eTA to AllAhara pakSe ati sahaja|

tArA mane karache sammilita vAhinI ekhanao cale yAYani| tArA (punarAYa) ese par3ale tArA kAmanA karave, yadi tArA dehAtIdera madhye giYe vasavAsa karata (evaM sekhAne thekei) tomAdera khavarAkhavara jene nita! Ara tArA yadi tomAdera madhye thAkata, tavu yuddhe alpai aMzagrahaNa karata|
vastuta rAsUlera madhye tomAdera janya raYeche uttama Adarza emana vyaktira janya, ye AllAha o AkherAta divasera AzA rAkhe evaM AllAhake adhika parimANe smaraNa kare|

muminagaNa yakhana (zatrudera) sammilita vAhinIke dekhechila, takhana tArA valechila, eTAi sei viSaYa yAra pratizruti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla AmAderake diYechilena| AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla satyai valechilena| Ara e ghaTanA tAdera ImAna o Anugatyera cetanAke Arao vRddhi kare diYechila|

ei ImAnadAradera madhyei emana lokao Ache, yArA AllAhara saGge kRta pratizrutike satye pariNata kareche evaM tAdera madhye emana lokao Ache, yArA tAdera najarAnA AdAYa kareche evaM Ache emana kichu loka, yArA ekhanao pratIkSAYa Ache Ara tArA (tAdera icchAra bhetara) kichumAtra parivartana ghaTAYani|

(e ghaTanA ghaTAnora kAraNa) AllAha satyaniSThaderake tAdera satatAra puraskAra devena evaM munAphekaderake icchA karale zAsti devena athavA tAdera tAovA kavula karavena| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara AllAha kApheraderake tAdera krodha sahakAre emanabhAve phiriYe dilena ye, tArA kona suphala arjana karate pArala nA| muminadera pakSa hate yuddhera janya AllAhai yatheSTa| AllAha sarvazaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

kitAvIdera madhye yArA tAderake (arthAt musalimadera zatruderake) sAhAyya karechila, AllAha tAderake tAdera durga theke avataraNe vAdhya karalena evaM tAdera antare emana bhIti saJcAra karalena ye, (he musalimagaNa!) tAdera katakake to tomarA hatyA karachile Ara katakake karachile vandI|
AllAha tomAderake oYAriza vAniYe dilena tAdera bhUmi, ghara-vAr3i o artha-sampadera evaM emana bhUmira, yA (ekhanao paryanta) tomarA padAnata karani| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
he navI! nija strIderake vala, tomarA yadi pArthiva jIvana o tAra zobhA cAo, tave eso Ami tomAderake kichu upahAra sAmagrI diYe saujanyera sAthe vidAYa dei|
Ara yadi tomarA AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o AkherAtera nivAsa kAmanA kara, tave nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera madhye yArA satkarmazIlA, tAdera janya mahA pratidAna prastuta kare rekhechena|
ohe navI patnIgaNa! tomAdera madhye keu prakAzya azlIlatAYa lipta hale tAra zAsti dviguNa vRddhi kare deoYA have| Ara AllAhara pakSe tA ati sahaja|
Ara tomAdera madhye ye-keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera anugata haYe thAkave o satkarma karave Ami tAke puraskArao deva dviguNa evaM Ami tAra janya sammAnajanaka jIvikA prastuta kare rekhechi|

he navI patnIgaNa! tomarA sAdhAraNa nArIdera mata nao yadi tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana kara| sutarAM tomarA komala kaNThe kathA valo nA, pAche antare vyAdhi Ache emana vyakti lAlAYita haYe par3e| Ara tomarA valo nyAYasaGgata kathA|

nija gRhe avasthAna kara (para-puruSake) sAjasajjA pradarzana kare ver3io nA, yemana prAcIna jAhelI yuge pradarzana karA hata evaM nAmAya kAYema kara, yAkAta AdAYa kara evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara| he navI parivAra (Ahale vAita)! AllAha to cAna tomAdera theke malinatA dUre rAkhate evaM tomAderake sarvatoprakAre pavitratA dAna karate|
evaM tomAdera gRhe AllAhara ye AYAtasamUha o hekamatera kathA pATha karA haYa, tA smaraNa rAkha| nizcaYai AllAha ati sUkSmadarzI evaM sarvaviSaYe avahita|

nizcaYai Anugatya prakAzakArI puruSa o Anugatya prakAzakArI nArI, mumina puruSa o mumina nArI, ivAdatagojAra puruSa o ivAdatagojAra nArI, satyavAdI puruSa o satyavAdI nArI, dhairyazIla puruSa o dhairyazIla nArI, AntarikabhAve vinIta puruSa o AntarikabhAve vinIta nArI, sadakAkArI puruSa o sadakAkArI nArI, royAdAra puruSa o royAdAra nArI, nija lajjAsthAnera hephAjatakArI puruSa o hephAjatakArI nArI evaM AllAhake adhika smaraNakArI puruSa o smaraNakArI nArI AllAha edera sakalera janya mAgapherAta o mahA pratidAna prastuta kare rekhechena|

AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla yakhana kona viSaYe cUr3Anta phAYasAlA dAna karena, takhana kona mumina puruSa o mumina nArIra nijedera viSaYe kona ekhatiYAra vAki thAke nA| keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera avAdhyatA karale se to suspaSTa gomarAhIte patita hala|

evaM (he rAsUla!) smaraNa kara, yAra prati AllAha anugraha karechilena evaM tumio anugraha karechile, tAke yakhana tumi valachile, tumi tomAra strIke nija vivAhe rekhe dAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara| tumi nija antare emana kathA gopana karachile, AllAha yA prakAza kare deoYAra chilena| tumi mAnuSake bhaYa karachile athaca AllAhai e viSaYera vezi hakadAra ye, tumi tAke bhaYa karave| ataHpara yAYada yakhana nija strIra sAthe samparkaccheda ghaTAla takhana Ami tAra sAthe tomAra vivAha sampanna karalAma, yAte musalimadera pakSe tAdera poSyaputradera strIgaNake vivAha karAte kona samasyA nA thAke, yakhana tArA tAdera sAthe samparka zeSa kare phelave| Ara AllAhara Adeza to kAryakara haoYArai chila|

AllAha navIra janya yA vidhisammata karechena, tA karAte tAra prati Apattira kichu nei| pUrve yArA gata haYeche, tAdera (arthAt sei navIdera) kSetreo eTAi chila AllAhara nIti| AllAhara phAYasAlA mApAjokhA, sunirdhArita haYe thAke|
(navI to tArA,) yArA AllAhara prerita vidhAnAvalI mAnuSera kAche peৗ~che deYa, tA~kei bhaYa kare evaM AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke bhaYa kare nA| hisAva grahaNera janya AllAhai yatheSTa|
(he muminagaNa!) muhAmmAda (sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) tomAdera kona puruSera pitA nana, kintu se AllAhara rAsUla evaM navIdera madhye sarvazeSa| AllAha sarvaviSaYe paripUrNa jJAta|
he muminagaNa! AllAhake smaraNa kara adhika parimANe|
evaM sakAla o sandhyAYa tAra tAsavIha pATha kara|
tinii tomAdera prati rahamata varSaNa karena evaM tA~ra pherezatAgaNao, tomAderake andhakAra theke mukta kare Alote niYe AsAra janya| tini muminadera prati parama daYAlu|
muminagaNa ye dina AllAhara sAthe milita have, sedina tAderake abhyarthanA jAnAno have sAlAma dvArA| AllAha tAdera janya maryAdApUrNa puraskAra prastuta kare rekhechena|
he navI! Ami to tomAke pAThiYechi sAkSyadAtA, susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe
evaM AllAhara nirdeze mAnuSake AllAhara dike AhvAnakArI o Alo vistArakArI pradIparUpe|
muminaderake susaMvAda zuniYe dAo ye, tAdera janya AllAhara pakSa theke raYeche mahA anugraha|
kAphera o munAphekadera Anugatya karo nA evaM tAdera pakSa theke ye kaSTa-kleza tomAke deoYA haYa, tA agrAhya kara evaM AllAhara prati bharasA rAkha| karmavidhAYakarUpe AllAhai yatheSTa|

he muminagaNa! tomarA mumina nArIderake vivAha karAra para tAderake sparza karAra Agei tAlAka dile tomAdera janya tAdera upara kona iddata oYAjiva naYa, yA tomAderake gaNanA karate have| sutarAM tAderake kichu upahAra sAmagrI dive evaM saujanyera sAthe tAderake vidAYa karave|

he navI! Ami tomAra janya vaidha karechi tomAra sei strIgaNake, yAderake tumi tAdera moharAnA AdAYa kare diYecha| tAchAr3A AllAha ganImatera ye sampada tomAke dAna karechena tAra madhye ye dAsIgaNa tomAra mAlikAnAYa eseche tAderakeo (tomAra janya hAlAla karechi) evaM tomAra cAcAra kanyAgaNa, phuphura kanyAgaNa, mAmAra kanyAgaNa o khAlAra kanyAgaNakeo, yArA tomAra sAthe hijarata kareche| tAchAr3A kona mumina nArI vinA moharAnAYa nijeke navIra nikaTa (vivAhera janya) peza karale, navI yadi tAke vivAha karate cAYa, tAkeo (hAlAla karechi)| vizeSabhAve tomArai janya, anya muminadera janya naYa| muminadera strIgaNa o tAdera dAsIdera samparke tAdera prati ye vidhAna Ami Aropa karechi, tA AmAra bhAlobhAvei jAnA Ache| (Ami tA theke tomAke vyatikrama rekhechi ejanya), yAte tomAra kona asuvidhA nA thAke| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tumi strIdera madhye yAra pAlA icchA kara mulatavi karate pAra evaM yAke cAo nijera kAche rAkhate pAra| tumi yAderake pRthaka kare diYecha, tAdera madhye kAuke oYApasa grahaNa karate cAile tAte tomAra kona gunAha nei, e niYame vezi AzA karA yAYa, tAdera cokha jur3Ave, tArA vedanAhata have nA evaM tumi tAderake yA-kichu deve tAte tArA sakale santuSTa thAkave| tomAdera antare yA-kichu Ache AllAha se samvandhe avahita evaM AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

erapara anya nArI tomAra pakSe hAlAla naYa evaM eTAo jAYeya naYa ye, tumi edera parivarte anya strI grahaNa karave, yadio tAdera saundarya tomAke mugdha kare| avazya tomAra mAlikAnAYa ye dAsIgaNa Ache (tArA tomAra janya hAlAla)| AllAha savakichura upara satarka dRSTi rAkhena|

he muminagaNa! navIra ghare (anumati chAr3A) praveza karo nA| avazya tomAderake AhAryera janya AsAra anumati deoYA hale bhinna kathA| takhana ebhAve Asave ye, tomarA tA prastuta haoYAra apekSAYa vase thAkave nA| kintu yakhana tomAderake dAoYAta karA haYa takhana yAve| tArapara yakhana tomAdera khAoYA haYe yAve takhana Apana-Apana patha dharave; kathAvArtAYa mazagula haYe par3ave nA| vastuta tomAdera e AcaraNa navIke kaSTa deYa, kintu se tomAderake (tA valate) saGkocavodha kare| AllAha satya valate saGkocavodha karena nA| navIra strIgaNera kAche tomarA kichu cAile pardAra Ar3Ala theke cAve| e panthA tomAdera antara o tAdera antara adhikatara pavitra rAkhAra pakSe sahAYaka have| navIke kaSTa deoYA tomAdera janya jAYeya naYa evaM eTAo jAYeya naYa ye, tAra (mRtyura) para tomarA tAra strIderake kakhanao vivAha karave| AllAhara dRSTite eTA gurutara vyApAra|
tomarA kona viSaYa prakAza kara vA tA gopana rAkha, AllAha to pratiTi viSaYe paripUrNa jJAna rAkhena|

navIra strIgaNera janya tAdera pitAgaNa, tAdera putragaNa, tAdera bhAigaNa, tAdera bhAtijAgaNa, tAdera bhAginAgaNa, tAdera Apana nArIgaNa o tAdera dAsIgaNera kSetre (arthAt tAdera sAmane pardAhInabhAve AsAte) kona gunAha nei evaM (he nArIgaNa!) tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kare calo| nizcaYai AllAha pratiTi vastura pratyakSakArI|
nizcaYai AllAha o tA~ra pherezatAgaNa navIra prati darUda pAThAna| he muminagaNa! tomarAo tAra prati darUda pAThAo evaM adhika parimANe sAlAma pAThAo|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake kaSTa deYa, AllAha duniYA o AkherAte tAdera upara lAnata karechena evaM tAdera janya prastuta kare rekhechena lAJchanAkara zAsti|
yArA mumina nara o mumina nArIderake vinA aparAdhe kaSTa dAna kare, tArA apavAda o spaSTa pApera vojhA vahana kare|

he navI! tumi tomAra strIdera, tomAra kanyAdera o mumina nArIderake vale dAo, tArA yena tAdera cAdara nijedera (mukhera) upara nAmiYe deYa| e panthAYa tAderake cenA sahajatara have, phale tAderake utyakta karA have nA| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

munAphekagaNa, yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache evaM yArA nagare gujava raTiYe ver3AYa tArA yadi virata nA haYa, tave Ami avazyai tAdera viruddhe tomAke diYe vyavasthA grahaNa karAva, phale tArA e nagare tomAra sAthe alpa kichudinai avasthAna karate pArave
abhizaptarUpe| ataHpara tAderake yekhAnei pAoYA yAve pAkar3Ao karA have evaM tAderake eka-eka kare hatyA karA have|
eTA AllAhara rIti, yA pUrve yArA gata haYeche tAdera kSetreo kAryakara chila| tumi kakhanai AllAhara rItite konarUpa parivartana pAve nA|
loke tomAke kiYAmata samparke jijJesa kare| vale dAo, era jJAna kevala AllAharai kAche Ache| tomAra kI kare jAnA thAkave? haYata kiYAmata nikaTei ese par3eche|
nizcaYai AllAha kApheraderake tA~ra rahamata theke vitAr3ita karechena evaM tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena jvalanta Aguna|
tAte tArA sarvadA ebhAve thAkave ye, tArA kona abhibhAvaka pAve nA evaM sAhAyyakArIo nA|
ye dina Agune tAdera cehArA olaTa-pAlaTa kare phelA have, tArA valave, hAYa! AmarA yadi AllAhara Anugatya karatAma evaM rAsUlera kathA mAnatAma!
evaM valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! prakRtapakSe AmarA AmAdera netRvarga o AmAdera gurujanadera Anugatya karechilAma, tArAi AmAderake saThika patha theke vicyuta kareche|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tAderake dviguNa zAsti dina evaM tAdera prati lAnata karuna, mahA lAnata|
he muminagaNa! tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA mUsAke kaSTa diYechila, ataHpara AllAha tArA yA raTanA karechila, tA hate tAke nirdeASa pramANa karena| se chila AllAhara kAche atyanta maryAdAvAna|
he muminagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM satya-saThika kathA vala|
tAhale AllAha tomAdera kAryAvalI zudhare devena evaM tomAdera pAparAzi kSamA karavena| ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare se mahA sAphalya arjana karala|

Ami AmAnata peza karechilAma AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o pAhAr3a-parvatera sAmane| tArA tA vahana karate asvIkAra karala o tAte zaGkita hala Ara tA vahana kare nila mAnuSa| vastuta se ghora jAlema, ghora ajJa|

pariNAme AllAha munApheka puruSa o munApheka nArI evaM muzarika puruSa o muzarika nArIderake zAstidAna karavena Ara mumina puruSa o mumina nArIdera prati rahamatera dRSTi dAna karavena| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini emana ye, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, sava tA~rai evaM AkherAteo prazaMsA tA~rai| tinii prajJAmaYa, sarvaviSaYe avahita|
tini sei sava kichu jAnena, yA bhUmite praveza kare, yA tA theke nirgata haYa, yA AkAza theke avatIrNa haYa evaM yA tAte utthita haYa| tinii parama daYAlu, ati kSamAzIla|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA vale, AmAdera upara kiYAmata Asave nA| vale dAo, kena Asave nA? AmAra Alimula gAYeva pratipAlakera kasama! tomAdera upara tA avazyai Asave| aNu parimANa kona jinisao tAra dRSTira Ar3Ale thAkate pAre nA nA AkAzamaNDalIte evaM nA pRthivIte| Ara nA tAra ceYe choTa kona vastu Ara nA var3a kichu| savai eka suspaSTa kitAve (arthAt lAohe mAhaphuje) lipivaddha Ache|
(kiYAmata Asave) ejanya ye, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche AllAha tAderake puraskRta karavena| erUpa lokadera janya raYeche mAgaphirAta evaM maryAdApUrNa riyaka|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha kare deoYAra ceSTA kareche, tAdera janya Ache musivatera yantraNAmaYa zAsti|

(he navI!) yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche, tArA bhAlo karei vojhe tomAra prati tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche tA satya evaM tA sei sattAra patha dekhAYa yini kSamatArao mAlika, samasta prazaMsArao upayukta|

kApheragaNa (eke anyake) vale, AmarA ki tomAderake emana eka vyaktira kathA jAnAva, ye tomAderake saMvAda deYa ye, tomarA (mRtyura para) yakhana chinna bhinna haYe yAve, tAraparao tomarA eka natuna jIvana lAbha karave?
(ke jAne) se ki AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa karache nA ki se vikAragrasta? nA, varaM yArA AkherAte vizvAsa rAkhe nA tArA AyAva o ghora vibhrAntite raYeche|

tave ki tArA AsamAna o yamInera prati lakSa kareni, yA tAdera sAmaneo vidyamAna Ache evaM pichaneo? Ami icchA karale tAderake bhUmite dhasiYe deva athavA tAdera upara AkAzera kichu khaNDa phele deva| vastuta era madhye nidarzana Ache pratyeka emana vAndAra janya, ye AllAhara dike ruju haYa|

nizcaYai Ami dAUdake vizeSabhAve AmAra nikaTa theke anugraha dAna karechilAma| he pAhAr3a-parvata! tomarAo dAUdera saGge AmAra tAsavIha par3a evaM he pAkhirA tomarAo| Ara Ami tAra janya lohAke narama kare diYechilAma|
yAte tumi pUrNa mApera varma tairi kara evaM kar3AsamUha jor3Ara kSetre parimApa rakSA kara| tomarA sakale satkarma kara| tomarA yA-kichui kara Ami tAra draSTA|

Ami vAYuke sulAYamAnera AjJAdhIna kare diYechilAma| tAra bhorera saphara hata eka mAsera dUratve evaM sandhyAra sapharao hata eka mAsera dUratve| Ara Ami tAra janya galita tAmAra eka prasravaNa pravAhita karechilAma| kataka jina chila, yArA tAra pratipAlakera nirdeze tAra sAmane kAja karata| (Ami tAdera kAche ekathA pariSkAra kare diYechilAma ye,) tAdera madhye ye-keu AmAra Adeza amAnya kare vA~kA patha avalamvana karave Ami tAke jvalanta Agunera svAda grahaNa karAva|

sulAYamAna yA cAita, tArA tAra janya tA vAniYe dita u~cu u~cu imArata, chavi, hAujera mata var3a var3a pAtra evaM bhUmite dRr3habhAve sthApita Dega| he dAUdera khAndAna! tomarA (ivAdata-Anugatyera) kAja kara kRtajJatA jJApanArthe| AmAra vAndAdera madhye zokaragujAra loka alpai|

ataHpara Ami yakhana sulAYamAnera mRtyura siddhAnta nilAma takhana jinaderake tAra mRtyu viSaYe jAnAla kevala mATira pokA, yArA tAra lAThi khAcchila| sutarAM yakhana se par3e gela takhana jinarA vujhate pArala, tArA yadi gAYevera jJAna rAkhata tave ei lAJchanAkara kaSTe par3e thAkata nA|

nizcaYai sAvA sampradAYera janya tAdera vAsabhUmite chila eka nidarzana| DAna o vAma ubhaYa dike chila vAgAnera sAri| nija pratipAlakera deoYA riyaka khAo evaM tA~ra zokara AdAYa kara| ekadike to utkRSTa nagara, anyadike kSamAzIla pratipAlaka!

tA sattveo tArA (hedAYAta theke) mukha phiriYe nila| phale Ami tAdera upara vA~dhabhAGgA vanyA cher3e dilAma evaM tAdera du’pAzera vAgAna du’Tike emana du’Ti vAgAna dvArA parivartita kare dilAma, yA chila visvAda phala, jhAu gAcha o sAmAnya kichu kula gAcha samvalita|
Ami tAderake e zAsti diYechilAma e kAraNe ye, tArA akRtajJatAYa lipta haYechila| Ara Ami to zAsti dei kevala ghora akRtajJaderakei|

Ami tAdera evaM ye sakala janapade varakata dAna karechilAma, tAdera madhyavartI sthAne sthApita karechilAma, (dUra theke) dRzyamAna vahu janapada evaM tAra madhye bhramaNake mApAjokhA vibhinna dhApe vaNTana kare diYechilAma (evaM valechilAma) esava janapade dine o rAte nirApade bhramaNa kara|

tArA valate lAgala, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera sapharera (manajilasamUhera) madhye vyavadhAna vAr3iYe dAo| Ara ebhAve tArA nijedera prati juluma karala, yAra pariNAme Ami tAderake kAhinIra viSaYavastu vAniYe dilAma evaM tAderake sampUrNarUpe chinna-bhinna kare vikSipta kare phelalAma| nizcaYai e ghaTanAra madhye pratyeka dhairyazIla, zokaragujAra lokera janya vahu nidarzana Ache|
vastuta ivalisa tAdera samparke nija dhAraNAke saThika pela| sutarAM tArA tAra anugAmI hala, kevala muminadera ekaTi dala chAr3A|

tA~dera upara ivalisera kona Adhipatya chila nA| tave (mAnuSake vibhrAnta karAra kSamatA Ami tAke ejanya diYechilAma ye,) Ami dekhate cAcchilAma ke AkherAtera prati ImAna Ane Ara ke se samvandhe thAke sandehe patita| tomAra pratipAlaka sakala viSaYera tattvAvadhAYaka|

(he rAsUla! oi kApheraderake) vale dAo, tomarA yAderake AllAhara parivarte upAsya mane karate tAderake DAka| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte tArA aNu parimANa kichurao mAlika naYa evaM AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte (konao viSaYe AllAhara sAthe) tAdera kona aMzIdAritva nei evaM tAdera madhye keu tA~ra sAhAyyakArIo naYa|

yAra janya tini (supArizera) anumati dena, tAra chAr3A (anya kArao) kona supAriza AllAhara sAmane kAje Asave nA| parizeSe yakhana tAdera antara theke bhaYa dUra kare deoYA haYa, takhana tArA vale, tomAdera pratipAlaka kI valechena? tArA uttara deYa, satya (kathA valechena) evaM tinii samucca, mahAna|
vala, ke AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI theke tomAderake riyaka dAna kare? vala, tini AllAha! evaM AmarA athavA tomarA haYata hedAYAtera upara Achi athavA spaSTa gomarAhIte|
vala, AmarA ye aparAdha karechi se samparke tomAderake jijJesa karA have nA evaM tomarA yA karacha se samparkeo AmAderake jijJesa karA have nA|
vala, AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAdera sakalake ekatra karavena tArapara AmAdera madhye nyAyya phAYasAlA karavena| tinii zreSTha phAYasAlAkArI, sarvajJa|
vala, AmAke dekhAo, tArA kArA, yAderake tomarA zarIka vAniYe AllAhara sAthe jur3e diYecha? kakSaNao naYa, (tA~ra kona zarIka nei); varaM tinii AllAha, yini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
evaM (he navI!) Ami tomAke samasta mAnuSera janya ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpei pAThiYechi, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa vujhache nA|
evaM tArA (tomAke) vale, tomarA satyavAdI hale (vala kiYAmatera) e pratizruti kave pUraNa have?
vale dAo, tomAdera janya emana eka dinera meYAda nirdiSTa Ache, yA theke tomarA eka muhUrta pichAte pArave nA evaM sAmaneo yete pArave nA|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA vale, AmarA kakhanao e kuraAnera prati ImAna Anava nA evaM era pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhera pratio naYa| tumi yadi sei samaYera dRzya dekhate yakhana jAlemaderake tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane dA~r3a karAno have Ara tArA eke anyera kathA rada karave| (duniYAYa) yAderake durvala mane karA haYechila tArA kSamatA-darpIderake valave, tomarA nA hale AmarA avazyai mumina haYe yetAma|

yArA kSamatAdarpI chila tArA, yAderake durvala mane karA hata tAderake valave, hedAYAta tomAdera kAche ese yAoYAra para AmarAi ki tomAderake tA theke phiriYe rekhechi? prakRtapakSe tomarA nijerAi aparAdhI chile|

yAderake durvala mane karA haYechila tArA kSamatAdarpIderake valave, nA, varaM eTA to tomAdera divA-rAtrera cakrAntai chila (yA AmAderake hedAYAta theke phiriYe rekhechila), yakhana tomarA AmAderake Adeza karachile AmarA yena AllAhara kupharI kari evaM tA~ra sAthe (anyaderake) zarIka sAvyasta kari| tArA yakhana AyAva dekhave takhana tArA anutApa gopana karave evaM yArA kupharI avalamvana karechila Ami tAdera sakalera galAYa ver3i parAva| tAderake to kevala tAdera kRtakarmerai pratidAna deoYA have|
Ami ye janapadei kona satarkakArI (navI) pAThiYechi, tAra vittazAlI lokerA valeche, tomarA ye vArtAsaha prerita haYecha AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna kari|
Arao valeche, AmarA dhane-jane tomAdera ceYe vezi Ara AmarA zAstiprApta haoYAra nai|
vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlaka yAra janya icchA karena riyaka prazasta kare dena evaM (yAra janya icchA) saMkIrNa kare dena, kintu adhikAMza loka ekathA vojhe nA|

tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati emana kichu naYa, yA tomAderake AllAhara naikaTya dAna karave| kintu ye vyakti ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, erUpa vyaktivarga tAdera karmera dviguNa saoYAva lAbha karave evaM tArA (jAnnAtera) prAsAde nirApade thAkave|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha kare deoYAra ceSTA kare, tAderake zAstite grephatAra karA have|

vala, AmAra pratipAlaka nija vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA riyakera prAcurya dAna karena evaM (yAra janya icchA) tA saMkIrNa kare dena| tomarA yA-kichui vyaYa kara, tini tadasthale anya jinisa diYe dena| tini zreSTha riyikadAtA|
sei dina (-ke bhule yeo nA), yakhana AllAha sakalake ekatra karavena tArapara pherezatAderake valavena, satyii ki erA tomAdera ivAdata karata?
tArA valave, AmarA ApanAra pavitratA varNanA kari| AmAdera samparka ApanAra sAthe; tAdera sAthe naYa| prakRtapakSe tArA jinadera ivAdata karata| tAdera adhikAMza tAderai prati vizvAsI chila|

sutarAM Aja tomarA paraspare eke anyera kona upakAra karate pArave nA evaM apakArao naYa| Ara yArA julume lipta haYechila, tAderake valava, tomarA AsvAdana kara Agunera zAsti, yA tomarA avizvAsa karate|

tAderake yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha par3e zonAno haYa, takhana tArA (AmAra rAsUla samparke) vale, ei vyakti Ara kichui naYa, kevala eTAi cAYa ye, se tomAderake tomAdera sei mAvudadera theke phiriYe deve, yAderake tomAdera vApa-dAdA pUjA kare Asache evaM tArA vale, e kuraAna eka managar3A mithyA chAr3A Ara kichui naYa| Ara yakhana kApheradera kAche satyera vANI ese gela, takhana tArA se samparke valala, eTA suspaSTa yAdu chAr3A kichui naYa|
athaca Ami tAderake (era Age) emana kona kitAva deini, yAra paThana-pAThana tArA kare evaM (he navI!) tomAra Age Ami tAdera kAche kona satarkakArI (navI) pAThAini|

tAdera pUrvavartI lokerAo (navIderake) asvIkAra karechila| tAderake Ami yA (artha-sampada) diYechilAma erA (arthAt Aravera muzarikagaNa) tAra eka-dazamAMzeo peৗ~chate pAreni| tA sattveo tArA AmAra rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila| sutarAM (tumi dekhe nAo) AmAra pradatta zAsti kemana (kaThora) chila|

(he rAsUla!) tAderake vala, Ami tomAderake kevala ekaTi viSaYe upadeza dicchi| tA ei ye, tomarA AllAhara uddezye du-du’jana athavA eka-ekajana kare dA~r3iYe yAo, tArapara cintA kara (tA karale avilamvei vujhe ese yAve ye,) tomAdera e sAthIra (arthAt muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAmera) madhye kona vikAragrastatA nei| se to sukaThina eka zAstira Age tomAdera janya eka satarkakArI mAtra|
vala, Ami e kAjera vinimaYe tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAile tA tomAderai thAkuka| AmAra pArizramika to kevala AllAharai kAche| tini samasta kichura draSTA|
vale dAo, AmAra pratipAlaka upara theke satya pAThAcchena| tini gAYevera yAvatIYa viSaYa bhAlobhAve jAnena|
vale dAo, satya ese geche Ara mithyA nA pAre kichu zuru karate, nA punarAvRtti karate|

vale dAo, Ami yadi vipathagAmI haYe thAki, tave AmAra vipathagAmitAra kSati AmAkei bhoga karate have Ara Ami yadi sarala patha peYe thAki, tave eTA sei ohIrai vadaulate, yA AmAra pratipAlaka AmAra prati avatIrNa karachena| nizcaYai tini savakichura zrotA, sakalera nikaTavartI|
(he navI!) tumi yadi sei dRzya dekhate, yakhana tArA bhIta-vihvala haYe par3ave evaM pAliYe yAoYAra kona jAYagA thAkave nA Ara tAderake nikaTa thekei pAkar3Ao karA have|
evaM (takhana tArA) valave, AmarA tAra prati ImAna AnalAma| kintu etaTA dUravartI sthAna theke tArA kona jinisera nAgAla pAve kI kare?
tArA to pUrve tAke asvIkAra karechila evaM aneka dUravartI sthAna theke adRzya viSaYe anumAne Dhila chu~r3ata|

takhana tArA yAra (arthAt ye ImAnera) AkAGkSA karave tAra o tAdera madhye antarAla kare deoYA have, yemana karA haYechila tAdera pUrve tAdera anurUpa lokadera sAthe| prakRtapakSe tArA eka vibhrAntakara sandehe patita chila|

samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA, yini pherezatAderake vArtAvAhIrUpe niyukta karechena, yArA du’-duTi, tina-tinaTi o cAra-cAraTi pAkhA viziSTa| tini tA~ra sRSTite yA-icchA vRddhi karena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
AllAha mAnuSera janya ye rahamata khule dena, tA rodha karAra keu nei, Ara yA tini ruddha karena, emana keu nei ye tArapara tA unmukta karate pAre| tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he mAnuSa! AllAha tomAdera prati ye ni‘Amata varSaNa karechena tA smaraNa kara| AllAha chAr3A Ara kona khAleka Ache ki, ye AsamAna o yamIna theke tomAderake riyaka dAna kare? tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| sutarAM tomarA vipathagAmI haYe kona dike yAccha?
evaM (he rAsUla!) tArA yadi tomAke mithyAvAdI vale, tave tomAra pUrveo rAsUlagaNake mithyAvAdI valA haYechila| yAvatIYa viSaYa zeSa paryanta AllAharai kAche phiriYe neoYA have|

he mAnuSa! nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya| sutarAM ei pArthiva jIvana yena tomAderake kichutei dheA~kAYa nA phele evaM AllAhara samparkeo yena mahA dheA~kAvAja (zaYatAna) tomAderake dheA~kAYa nA phele|
nizcaYai zaYatAna tomAdera zatru| sutarAM tAke zatrui gaNya karo| se tAra anusArIderake dAoYAta deYa kevala e janyai, yAte tArA jAhAnnAmavAsI haYe yAYa|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti Ara yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAdera janya Ache mAgaphirAta o mahA puraskAra|

tave ki yAra dRSTite tAra manda kAjagulo sudRzya kare dekhAno haYeche, phale se tAra manda kAjake bhAlo mane kare, (se ki satkarmazIla vyaktira samAna hate pAre?)| vastuta AllAha yAke cAna vipathagAmI karena Ara yAke cAna saThika pathe paricAlita karena| sutarAM (he navI!) emana yena nA haYa ye, tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) janya Aphasosa karate karate tomAra prANaTAi cale yAYa| nizcaYai tArA yA-kichu karache, se samparke AllAha pUrNa jJAta|

AllAhai sei sattA, yini vAYu preraNa karena, tArapara tA megha saJcArita kare, tArapara Ami tA cAliYe niYe yAi emana nagarera dike, yA (kharAra kAraNe) nirjIva haYe geche| tArapara Ami tA (arthAt vRSTi) dvArA bhUmike tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita kari| ebhAvei punarutthAna have|

ye vyakti maryAdA lAbha karate cAYa (se jene rAkhuka) samasta maryAdA AllAharai hAte| pavitra kAlemA tA~rai dike ArohaNa kare evaM satkarma tAke upare tole| yArA manda kAjera Sar3ayantra kare, tAdera janya Ache kaThina zAsti Ara tAdera Sar3ayantra sampUrNa vyartha haYe yAve|

AllAha tomAderake mATi dvArA sRSTi karechena tArapara zukravindu dvArA| tArapara tomAderake jor3A-jor3A vAniYe diYechena| nArI yA garbhe dhAraNa kare evaM yA se prasava kare tA AllAhara jJAtasArei kare| kona dIrghAYu vyaktike ye AYu deoYA haYa evaM tAra AYute yA hrAsa karA haYa, tA savai eka kitAve lipivaddha Ache| vastuta esava kichui AllAhara pakSe ati sahaja|

du’Ti dariYA samAna naYa| ekaTi miThA, tRSNA nivAraka, supeYa Ara anyaTi ati lonA| pratyekaTi thekei tomarA khAo (mAchera) tAjA gozata o AharaNa kara alaMkAra, yA tomarA paridhAna kara| Ara tomarA jalayAnasamUhake dekha tA (dariYAra) pAni cire calAcala kare, yAte tomarA anusandhAna karate pAra AllAhara anugraha evaM yAte tomarA zokara AdAYa kara|

tini rAtake dinera madhye praviSTa karAna evaM dinake praviSTa karAna rAtera madhye| tini sUrya o candrake kAje lAgiYe rekhechena| (era) pratyekaTi eka nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta paribhramaNa kare| inii AllAha tomAdera pratipAlaka| sakala rAjatva tA~rai| tA~ke cher3e yAderake (arthAt yesava alIka prabhuke) tomarA DAka, tArA khejura vIcira AvaraNera samAnao kichura adhikAra rAkhe nA|

tomarA tAderake DAkale tArA tomAdera DAka zunavei nA Ara zunaleo tomAderake kona sAr3A dite pArave nA| kiYAmatera dina tArA nijerAi tomAdera zirakake asvIkAra karave| yAvatIYa viSaYa samparke avagata sattAra mata saThika saMvAda tomAke Ara keu dite pArave nA|
he mAnuSa! tomarA sakalei AllAhara mukhApekSI, kintu AllAha kArao mukhApekSI nana evaM tini Apanii prazaMsAra upayukta|
tini cAile tomAdera sakalake dhvaMsa kare dite pArena evaM astitve AnaYana karate pArena eka natuna sRSTike|
Ara e kAja AllAhara janya kichumAtra kaThina naYa|

kona bhAra vahanakArI anyera vojhA vahana karave nA evaM yAra upara bhArI vojhA cApAno thAkave se anya kAuke tA vahana karAra janya DAkale, tA theke kichui vahana karA have nA yadio se (arthAt yAke vojhA vahanera janya DAkA have se) kona nikaTAtnIYa haYa| (he navI!) tumi to kevala tAderakei satarka karate pAra, yArA tAdera pratipAlakake nA dekhe bhaYa kare evaM yArA nAmAya kAYema kare| keu pavitra hale se to nijerai kalyANArthe pavitra haYa| zeSa paryantaAllAharai kAche (sakalera) pratyAvartana|
andha o cakSuSmAna samAna hate pAre nA
evaM andhakAra o Aloo nA|
Ara nA chAYA o roda|
evaM samAna hate pAre nA jIvita o mRta| AllAha yAke icchA kathA zuniYe dena| yArA kavare Ache, tumi tAderake kathA zonAte pArave nA|
tumi to ekajana satarkakArI mAtra|
Ami tomAke satyavANIsaha preraNa karechi ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe| emana kona jAti nei, yAdera kAche kona satarkakArI Aseni|

tArA yadi tomAra prati mithyAvAdI vale, tave tAdera Age yArA chila, tArAo (arthAt sei kApheragaNao rAsUlagaNake mithyAvAdI valechila| tAdera rAsUlagaNa tAdera kAche esechila suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI, sahIphA o dIptimAna kitAvasaha|
ataHpara yArA asvIkRtira panthA avalamvana karechila Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao kari| sutarAM dekha AmAra zAsti kemana (bhaYAnaka) chila|

tumi ki dekhani AllAha AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karechena, tArapara Ami tA dvArA vicitra varNera phala-phalAdi utpanna karechi? Ara pAhAr3era madhyeo Ache vicitra varNera aMza sAdA, lAla o nikaSa kAlo|
evaM mAnuSa, pazu o catuSpada jantura madhyeo Ache anurUpa varNa-vaicitrya| AllAhake to kevala tArAi bhaYa kare, yArA jJAnera adhikArI| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, ati kSamAzIla|

yArA AllAhara kitAva telAoYAta kare, nAmAya kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tA theke (satkAje) vyaYa kare gopane o prakAzye, tArA emana vyavasAYera AzAvAdI, yAte kakhanao lokasAna haYa nA,
yAte AllAha tAderake tAdera pUrNa pratiphala dena evaM nija anugrahe Arao vezi dAna karena| nizcaYai tini ati kSamAzIla, atyanta guNagrAhI|

(he navI!) Ami ohIra mAdhyame tomAra prati ye kitAva nAyila karechi tA satya, yA tAra pUrvavartI samasta kitAvera samarthakarUpe eseche| nizcaYai AllAha nija vAndAdera samparke paripUrNa avagata, savakichura draSTA|

ataHpara Ami e kitAvera oYAriza vAniYechi AmAra vAndAdera madhye tAderake, yAderake Ami manonIta karechi| tAdera madhye kataka to nijera prati atyAcArI, kataka madhyapanthI evaM kataka emana yArA AllAhara icchAYa satkarme agragAmI| eTA (AllAhara) virATa anugraha|
sthAYI vasavAsera jAnnAta, yAte tArA praveza karave| sekhAne tAderake sonAra vAlA o motira dvArA alaMkRta karA have Ara sekhAne tAdera pozAka have rezama|
tArA valave, samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAdera theke samasta duHkha dUra karechena| nizcaYai AmAdera pratipAlaka ati kSamAzIla, atyanta guNagrAhI|
yini svIYa anugrahe AmAderake sthAYI avasthAnera nivAse ene dAkhila karechena, yekhAne AmAderake kakhanao konao kaSTa sparza karave nA evaM kona klAntio AmAdera dekhA deve nA|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna| sekhAne tAdera karma sAvAr3a karA have nA ye, tAdera mRtyu ghaTave evaM tAdera theke jAhAnnAmera zAstio lAghava karA have nA| pratyeka akRtajJa (kAphera)ke Ami ebhAvei zAsti diYe thAki|

tArA tAte ArtanAda kare valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake mukti dAna karuna, AmarA Age ye kAja karatAma tA cher3e bhAlo kAja karava| (uttare tAderake valA have) Ami ki tomAderake emana dIrgha AYu deini ye, takhana keu satarka hate cAile satarka hate pArata? evaM tomAdera kAche satarkakArIo esechila| sutarAM ekhana majA bhoga kara| kenanA emana jAlemadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
nizcaYai AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra gupta viSaYe jJAta| nizcaYai antare lukAYita viSaYAvalI samparke tini pUrNa oYAkiphahAla|

tinii pRthivIte tomAderake (pUrvavartIdera) sthalAbhiSikta karechena| ye vyakti kuphara karave tAra kuphara tArai upara patita have| kApheradera janya tAdera kupharI tAdera pratipAlakera krodha chAr3A kichu vRddhi kare nA evaM kApheradera janya tAdera kupharI kSati chAr3A kichu vRddhi kare nA|

(he navI!) tAderake vala, AcchA tomarA AllAhake cher3e yei managar3A zarIkadera pUjA karacha tAdera viSaYaTA bheve dekhecha ki? AmAke ekaTu dekhAo to tArA pRthivIra kona aMzaTA tairi kareche? kiMvA AkAzamaNDalIte (arthAt tAra sRjane) tAdera kI aMzIdAritva Ache? nAki Ami tAderake kona kitAva diYechi, yAra suspaSTa kona nirdezanAra upara tArA pratiSThita Ache? nA, varaM esava jAlema eke anyake kevala mithyA pratizrutii diYe thAke|

vastuta AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIke dhare rekhechena, yAte tArA sthAnacyuta hate nA pAre| yadi tArA sthAnacyuta haYa, tave AllAha chAr3A emana keu nei, ye tAdera dhare rAkhate pAre| nizcaYai AllAha ati sahanazIla, parama kSamAzIla|

(pUrve) tArA atyanta jorAlo zapatha karechila ye, yadi tAdera kAche kona satarkakArI (navI) Ase tave tArA anyAnya ummata apekSA adhikatara hedAYAta grahItA have, kintu yakhana tAdera kAche eka satarkakArI Asala, takhana tAra Agamana tAdera satya-vimukhatAi vRddhi karala

pRthivIte tAdera Atmagarva evaM (satyera virodhitAYa tAdera) kUTa cakrAntera kAraNe, athaca kUTa-cakrAnta khoda tAra udyoktAderakei pariveSTana kare neYa| tave ki tArA pUrvavartIdera kSetre yA kAryakara haYechila sei niYamerai apekSA karache? kintu tomarA AllAhara sthirIkRta niYame kona parivartana pAve nA evaM tomarA AllAhara sthirIkRta niYamake kakhanao Talateo dekhave nA|

tArA ki pRthivIte kakhanao saphara kareni, tAhale tArA dekhate peta tAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche tAdera pariNAma kI haYechila, yadio tArA edera apekSA vezi zaktimAna chila? AllAha emana nana ye, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra kona vastu tAke vyartha karate pAre| nizcaYai tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

AllAha mAnuSake tAdera pratiTi kRtakarmera janya pAkar3Ao karate zuru karale bhU-pRSThe vicaraNakArI kAuke chAr3atena nA| vastuta tini eka nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta tAderake avakAza dicchena| yakhana tAdera nirdiSTa meYAda ese yAve takhana AllAha svaYaM tA~ra vAndAdera dekhe nivena|

hekamatapUrNa kuraAnera zapatha!
nizcaYai tumi rAsUlagaNera ekajana|
sarala pathe pratiSThita|
e kuraAna avatIrNa karA hacche sei sattAra pakSa hate, yini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAmaYa
yAte tumi satarka kara emana eka sampradAYake, yAdera vApa-dAdAderake pUrve satarka karA haYani| phale tArA udAsInatAYa nipatita|
vastuta tAdera adhikAMzera vyApAre kathA pUrNa haYe Ache| sutarAM tArA ImAna Anave nA|
Ami tAdera galAYa civuka paryanta ver3i pariYechi| phale tArA UrdhvamukhI haYe Ache|
evaM Ami tAdera sAmane eka antarAla dA~r3a kariYe diYechi evaM pichaneo eka antarAla dA~r3a kariYe diYechi Ara ebhAve tAderake sava dika theke Dheke diYechi, phale tArA kona kichu dekhate pAYa nA|
tumi tAderake satarka kara athavA satarka nAi kara ubhaYaTAi tAdera janya samAna| tArA ImAna Anave nA|
tumi to kevala emana vyaktikei satarka karate pAra, ye upadeza anuyAYI cale evaM daYAmaYa AllAhake nA dekhe bhaYa kare| sutarAM erUpa vyaktike susaMvAda zonAo mAgaphirAta o sammAnajanaka puraskArera|
nizcaYai Amii mRtaderake jIvita karava evaM tArA yA kichu sAmane pAThAYa tA likhe rAkhi Ara tAdera karmera ye phalAphala haYa tAo| eka suspaSTa kitAve pratiTi viSaYa saMrakSaNa kare rekhechi|
evaM (he rAsUla!) tumi tAdera sAmane dRSTAnta peza kara eka janapadavAsIra, yakhana tAdera kAche esechila rAsUlagaNa|

yakhana Ami tAdera kAche (prathame) pAThiYechilAma du’jana rAsUla, takhana tArA tAderake mithyAvAdI valala| tArapara tRtIYajanera mAdhyame Ami tAderake zaktizAlI karechilAma| tArapara tArA sakale valala, nizcaYai AmAderake tomAdera kAche rAsUla vAniYe pAThAno haYeche|
tArA valala, tomarA to AmAdera mata mAnuSai| daYAmaYa AllAha kichui nAyila karenani| tomarA sampUrNa mithyAi valacha|
rAsUlagaNa valala, AmAdera pratipAlaka bhAlobhAvei jAnena ye, AmAderake vAstavikai tomAdera kAche rAsUla vAniYe pAThAno haYeche|
Ara AmAdera dAYitva to kevala spaSTabhAve vArtA peৗ~chiYe deoYA|

janapadavAsI valala, AmarA tomAdera madhye azubhatA lakSa karachi| tomarA nivRtta nA hale AmarA avazyai tomAdera upara pAthara nikSepa karava evaM avazyai AmAdera hAte tomAderake marmantuda zAsti bhoga karate have|
rAsUlagaNa valala, tomAdera azubhatA khoda tomAderai saGge raYeche| tomAdera kAche upadeza-vANI peৗ~cheche valei ki (tomarA ekathA valacha?) prakRtapakSe tomarA eka sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa|
zaharera pratyanta aJcala theke eka vyakti chuTe Asala| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA rAsUlagaNera anusaraNa kara|
anusaraNa kara tAdera, yArA tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAYa nA evaM yArA saThika pathe Ache|
AmAra kI yukti Ache ye, Ami sei sattAra ivAdata karava nA, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena? evaM tArai dike tomAdera sakalake phiriYe neoYA have|
Ami ki tAke cher3e emana sava mAvuda grahaNa karava, daYAmaYa AllAha AmAra kona aniSTa karate cAile yAdera supAriza AmAra kona kAje Asave nA evaM yArA AmAke uddhArao karate pArave nA?
tA karale niHsandehe Ami suspaSTa gomarAhIte patita hava|
Ami tomAdera pratipAlakera upara ImAna enechi| sutarAM tomarA AmAra kathA zona|

(zeSa paryanta janapadavAAsI tAke hatyA kare phelala evaM AllAha tAAlAra pakSa hate tAke) valA hala, jAnnAte praveza kara| se (jAnnAtera ni‘Amata rAji dekhe) valala, AhA! AmAra sampradAYa yadi jAnate pArata
AllAha kibhAve AmAke kSamA karechena evaM AmAke sammAnita lokadera antarbhukta karechena!
sei vyaktira para Ami tAra sampradAYera viruddhe AsamAna theke kona vAhinI pAThAini evaM AmAra tA pAThAnora praYojanao chila nA|
tA chila kevala ekaTi mahAnAda, yAte tArA sava nibhe nithara haYe gela|
Aphasosa esava vAndAra prati! tAdera kAche ye rAsUlai eseche tAke niYe tArA vyaGga-vidrUpa karata|
tArA ki dekheni tAdera pUrve Ami kata sampradAYake dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yArA tAdera kAche phire Asache nA?
evaM yata loka Ache tAdera sakalake avazyai ekatra kare AmAra sAmane hAjira karA have|
Ara tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana hala mRta bhUmi, yAke Ami jIvana dAna karechi evaM tAte zasya utpanna karechi ataHpara tArA tA theke kheYe thAke|
Ami se bhUmite sRSTi karechi khejura o AGgurera vAgAna evaM tA theke utsArita karechi pAnira prasravaNa
yAte tArA tAra phala khete pAre| tAto tAdera hAta tairi kareni| tavuo ki tArA zokara AdAYa karave nA?
pavitra sei sattA, yini pratiTi jinisa jor3A-jor3A sRSTi karechena bhUmi yA utpanna kare tAo evaM tAdera nijederakeo Ara tArA (ekhanao) yA jAne nA tAo|
tAdera janya ArekaTi nidarzana hala rAta, yA theke Ami dinera AvaraNa sariYe nei, amani tArA andhakArAcchanna haYe par3e|
sUrya Apana gantavyera dike paribhramaNa karache| esava parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa sattAra sthirIkRta (vyavasthApanA)|
Ara cA~dera janya Ami nirdiSTa kare diYechi vibhinna manajila| parizeSe tA (nija manajilasamUha atikrama kare) phire Ase purAno khejura DAlAra mata (saru haYe)|
sUrya pAre nA cA~dake giYe dharate Ara rAtao pAre nA dinake atikrama karate| pratyekei Apana Apana kakSapathe sA~tAra kATe|
tAdera janya ArekaTi nidarzana ei ye, Ami tAdera santAna-santatike vojhAi nauyAne Arohana kariYechilAma|
Ami tAdera janya anurUpa Arao jinisa sRSTi karechi, yAte tArA saoYAra haYe thAke|
Ami cAile tAderake nimajjita karate pAri, takhana tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA evaM tAdera prANa rakSA sambhava have nA
tave AmAra pakSa hate eka rahamata evaM eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta (jIvanera) Ananda bhogera suyoga hiseve (Amii tAderake rakSA kare thAki)|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, vA~ca tA hate (sei zAsti hate) yA tomAdera sAmane Ache evaM yA Ache tomAdera pechane, yAte tomAdera prati daYA karA haYa (takhana tArA tA grAhya kare nA)|
evaM tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tAdera kAche emana kona nidarzana Ase nA, yA theke tArA mukha pherAYa nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa AllAha tomAderake ye riyaka diYechena tA theke (garIvadera janyao) vyaYa kara, takhana kApheragaNa musalimaderake vale, AmarA ki tAderake khAvAra khAoYAva, yAderake AllAha icchA karale nijei khAoYAtena?
