(he musalimagaNa!) tomAdera avasthA e chAr3A kichui naYa ye, tomarA suspaSTa gomarAhIte par3e raYecha|
evaM tArA vale, (kiYAmatera) e pratizruti kave pUrNa have? (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA satyavAdI hale eTA vale dAo|
(prakRtapakSe) tArA ekaTi mahAnAderai apekSAYa Ache, yA tAderake pAkar3Ao karave tAdera vitarke lipta thAkA avasthAYa|
takhana Ara tArA kona asiYata karate pArave nA evaM pArave nA nija parivAravargera kAche phire yete|
evaM ziGgAYa (dvitIYa) phu~ deoYA have| amani tArA Apana-Apana kavara theke vera haYe tAdera pratipAlakera dike chuTe calave|

tArA valate thAkave, hAYa AmAdera durbheAga! ke AmAderake AmAdera nidrAsthala theke uThAla? (uttara deoYA have,) eTA sei jinisa, yAra pratizruti daYAmaYa AllAha diYechilena evaM rAsUlagaNa satya kathA valechila|
Ara kichui naYa, kevala ekaTi mahAnAda have, amani tAdera sakalake AmAra sAmane upasthita karA have|
sutarAM se dina kona vyaktira upara juluma karA have nA evaM tomAderake kevala tomAdera kRtakarmerai pratiphala deoYA have|
nizcaYai se dina jAnnAtavAsIgaNa Apana vyastatAYa magna thAkave|
tArA o tAdera strIgaNa nivir3a chAYAYa ArAmadAYaka Asane helAna diYe thAkave|
sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave phalamUla evaM tArA yA kichura pharamAYeza karave tAi tArA pAve|
daYAmaYa pratipAlakera pakSa hate tAderake sAlAma valA have|
Ara (kApheraderake valA have) he aparAdhIgaNa! Aja tomarA (muminadera theke) pRthaka haYe yAo|
he Adama santAnagaNa! Ami ki tomAderake gurutva diYe valini ye, tomarA zaYatAnera ivAdata karo nA, se tomAdera prakAzya zatru?
evaM tomarA AmAra ivAdata kara| eTAi sarala patha?
vastuta zaYatAna tomAdera madhya hate ekaTi var3a dalake gomarAha karechila| tavuo ki tomarA vojhani?
eTAi sei jAhAnnAma, yAra bhaYa tomAderake dekhAno hata|
Aja ete praveza kara| yehetu tomarA kuphara karate|
Aja Ami tAdera mukhe mohara lAgiYe deva| phale tAdera hAta AmAra sAthe kathA valave evaM tAdera pA sAkSya deve tAdera kRtakarmera|
Ami cAile (ihakAlei) tAdera cokha lopa kare dite pAratAma| takhana tArA pathera sandhAne choTAchuTi karata, kintu tArA kothAYa ki dekhate peta?
Ami icchA karale tAderake sva-sva sthAne vasiYe tAderake vikRta (paGgu) kare dite pAratAma phale tArA sAmane agrasara hate pArata nA evaM pichaneo phire Asate pArata nA|
Ami yAke dIrghAYu dAna kari sRSTigatabhAve tAke ulTiYe dei| tathApi ki tArA upalavdhi karave nA?
Ami tAke (arthAt rAsUlake) kAvyacarcA karate zikhAini evaM tA tAra pakSe zobhanIYao naYa| eTA to eka upadezavANI evaM emana kuraAna yA (satyake) suspaSTarUpe varNanA kare|
yAte pratyeka jIvitajanake satarka kare deYa evaM yAte kApheradera viruddhe pramANa cUr3Anta haYe yAYa|
tArA ki dekheni ye, Ami nija hAte sRSTa vastu rAjira madhye tAdera janya catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechi, ataHpara tArAi tAra mAlika haYe geche?
Ami se jantugulike tAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechi| sutarAM segulora kataka tAdera vAhana evaM kataka tArA AhAra kare|
evaM tAdera janye era madhye Ache Arao vahu upakAritA evaM Ache pAnIYa vastu| tathApi ki tArA zokara AdAYa karave nA?
tArA AllAha chAr3A vahu mAvuda grahaNa kareche ei AzAYa ye, haYata tArA sAhAyyaprApta have|
(athaca) tArA tAdera sAhAyya karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA; varaM tArA tAdera janya emana eka virodhI sainya haYe yAve, yAderake (kiYAmatera dina tAdera sAmane) upasthita karA have|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tAdera kathA yena tomAke duHkha nA deYa| Ami avazyai jAni tArA kI gopana rAkhache Ara kI prakAza karache|
mAnuSa ki lakSa kareni Ami tAke sRSTi karechi zukravindu dvArA? ataHpara sahasAi se prakAzya vitaNDAkArI haYe gela|
AmAra samparke se upamA racanA kare, athaca se nija sRjanera kathA bhule vase Ache| se vale, ke ei asthigulike jIvita karave egulo pace-gale yAoYA sattveo?
vale dAo, seguloke jIvita karavena sei sattA, yini tAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechilena| tini pratyeka sRSTi samparke paripUrNa jJAta|
tinii savuja-sateja vRkSa hate tomAdera janya Aguna sRSTi karechena| anantara tomarA tA hate prajvalanera kAja nAo|
tave ki ye sattA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena tini ki tAdera anurUpa (punarAYa) sRSTi karate sakSama nana? kena naYa? tini to mahAsraSTA, sarvajJa!
tA~ra vyApAra to ei ye, tini yakhana kona kichura icchA karena, takhana kevala valena, ‘haYe yA’| amani tA haYe yAYa|
ataeva pavitra sei sattA, yAra hAte pratiTi jinisera zAsana-kSamatA evaM tA~rai kAche tomAdera sakalake phiriYe neoYA have|
zapatha tAdera, yArA sArivaddha haYe dA~r3AYa|
tArapara tAdera, yArA kaThorabhAve vAdhA pradAna kare|
tArapara tAdera, yArA ‘yikara’-era telAoYAta kare|
nizcaYai tomAdera mAvuda ekai|
yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM era madhyavartI samasta kichura mAlika evaM tini mAlika nakSatrarAji udaYasthalerao|
nizcaYai Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake saundaryamaNDita karechi (vibhinna) nakazA dvArA arthAt nakSatramaNDalI dvArA|
evaM pratyeka duSTa (zaYatAna) theke hephAjatera mAdhyama vAniYechi|
tArA Urdhva jagatera kathAvArtA zunate pAre nA evaM sakala dika theke tAdera upara mAra Ase|
tAderake karA haYa vitAr3ita evaM (AkherAte) tAdera janya Ache sthAYI zAsti|
tave keu kona kichu cheA~ mere niYe yete cAile jvalanta ulkApiNDa tAra pazcAddhAvana kare|
sutarAM tAderake (arthAt kApheraderake) jijJesa kara, tAderake sRSTi karA vezi kaThina, nA AmAra anyAnya mAkhalukake? Ami to tAderake sRSTi karechi AThAla kAdA hate|
(he rAsUla!) tumi to (tAdera kathAYa) vismaYavodha karacha, kintu tArA karache vidrUpa|
tAderake yakhana upadeza deoYA haYa, takhana tArA upadeza grahaNa kare nA|
Ara yakhana kona nidarzana dekhe, takhana vyaGga kare|
tArA vale, eTA eka prakAzya yAdu chAr3A kichui naYa|
tave ki AmarA mare mATi o asthite pariNata haYe yAoYAra parao AmAderake punarAYa jIvita karA have?
emana ki pUrvekAra AmAdera vApa-dAdAderakeo?
vale dAo, hyA~ evaM tomarA lAJchitao have|
vyasa, tA to ekaTi mAtra mahAnAda have, Ara amani tArA (yata sava vIbhatsa dRzya) dekhate zuru karave|
evaM valave, hAYa, AmAdera durbheAga! eTA to hisAva-nikAzera dina|
(jI hyA~!) eTAi sei mImAMsAra dina, yAke tomarA avizvAsa karate|
(pherezatAderake valA have,) yArA juluma karechila, tAderake gherAo kare niYe eso evaM tAdera saGgIderakeo evaM tArA yAdera ivAdata karata tAderakeo|
AllAhake cher3e, tArapara tAderake jAhAnnAmera patha dekhAo|
evaM tAderake ekaTu dA~r3a karAo| kenanA tAderake jijJesa karA have|
tomAdera kI hala ye, eke anyake sAhAyya karacha nA?
varaM Aja tArA sakale mAthA nata kare dA~r3iYe Ache|
tArA eke anyera abhimukhI haYe paraspare saoYAla-jaoYAva karave|
(adhInastharA tAdera netRvargake) valave, tomarAi to atyanta zaktimAnarUpe AmAdera kAche Asate|
tArA valave, nA, varaM tomarA nijerAi ImAna AnAra chile nA|
Ara tomAdera upara AmAdera kona Adhipatyao chila nA| vastuta tomarA nijerAi chile eka avAdhya sampradAYa|
phale AmAdera upara AmAdera pratipAlakera ekathA sAvyasta haYe geche ye, AmAdera sakalakei zAstibhoga karate have|
phale AmarA tomAderake vibhrAnta karechi Ara AmarA nijerAo chilAma vibhrAnta|
moTakathA se dina zAstite tArA sakale eke anyera zarIka have|
AmarA aparAdhIdera sAthe e rakamai kare thAki|
tAdera avasthA to chila ei ye, tAderake yakhana valA hata, AllAha chAr3A kona mAvuda nei, takhana tArA ahamikA pradarzana karata|
evaM valata, AmarA ki emana nAki ye, eka unmAda kavira kAraNe Apana upAsyaderake parityAga karava?
athaca se (arthAt mahAnavI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) satya niYe esechila evaM se anyAnya rAsUlagaNerao samarthana karechila|
sutarAM (tAderake valA have), tomAdera sakalake marmantuda zAstira majA bhoga karatei have|
Ara tomAderake kevala tomAdera kRtakarmerai pratiphala deoYA have|
tave AllAhara manonIta vAndAgaNa vyatikrama|
tAdera janya Ache sthirIkRta riyaka
phalamUla Ara tAderake karA have sammAnita|
ni‘AmatapUrNa udyAne
tArA u~cu Asane sAmanA-sAmani vasA thAkave|
tAderake ghure ghure parivezana karA have emana svaccha surApAtra
yA have sAdA raMYera, pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu|
tAte mAthA ghurave nA evaM tAte tArA have nA mAtAla|
tAdera kAche thAkave DAgara cokhera nArI, yAdera dRSTi (Apana-Apana svAmIte) thAkave nivaddha|
(tAdera nikhu~ta astitva emana) yena tArA (dhulovAli hate) lukiYe rAkhA Dima|
ataHpara jAnnAtavAsIgaNa eke anyera sAmanA-sAmani haYe parasparake jijJAsAvAda karave|
tAdera eka vaktA valave, AmAra chila eka sAthI,
se (AmAke) valata, satyii ki tumi tAdera ekajana, yArA (AkherAtera jIvanake) satya mane kare?
AmarA yakhana mare mATi o asthite pariNata havo, takhana ki vAstavikai AmAderake (AmAdera kRtakarmera) pratiphala deoYA have?
sei jAnnAtI (anya jAnnAtIderake) valave, tomarA ki uki mere (AmAra sei sAthIke) dekhate cAo?
tArapara se nije (jAhAnnAme) u~ki mArave, takhana se tAke dekhate pAve jAhAnnAmera mAjhakhAne|
se (tAke) valave, AllAhara kasama! tumi to AmAke ekevArei varavAda kare dicchile!
AmAra pratipAlakera anugraha nA thAkale anyadera sAthe Amio dhRta hatAma|
(tArapara se AnandAtizayye tAra jAnnAtI saGgIderake valave) AcchA, AmAdera ki Ara mRtyu nei,
AmAdera prathame ye mRtyu esechila seTi chAr3A? evaM AmAdera zAstio have nA?
prakRtapakSe eTAi mahA sAphalya|
e rakama sAphalyera janyai AmalakArIdera Amala karA ucita|
vala to, ei AtitheYatA uttama, nA yAkkuma gAcha?
Ami se gAchake jAlemadera janya eka parIkSAra viSaYa vAniYe diYechi|
vastuta seTi emana gAcha, yA jAhAnnAmera taladeza theke udagata haYa|
tAra mocA emana, yena tA zaYatAnadera mAthA|
sutarAM jAhAnnAmavAsIgaNa tA thekei khAve evaM tA dvArAi peTa bharave|
tadupari tArA pAve phuTanta pAnira mizraNa|
tArapara tAdera pratyAvartana have sei jAhAnnAmerai dike|
tArA tAdera vApa-dAdAderake peYechila vipathagAmIrUpe|
sutarAM tArA lAphiYe lAphiYe tAderai padachApa dhare calate thAke|
tAdera pUrvavartIdera adhikAMzao pathabhraSTa haYechila|
Ami to tAdera kAche satarkakArI (rAsUla)derake pAThiYechilAma|
sutarAM dekhe nAo, yAderake satarka karA haYechila tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche|
tave AllAhara manonIta vAndAgaNa (nirApada chila)|
nUha AmAke Dekechila (lakSa kare dekha), Ami kata uttama sAr3AdAnakArI|
Ami tAke o tAra parivAravargake nAjAta diYechilAma mahAsaMkaTa theke|
Ara Ami tAra vaMzadharakei (duniYAYa) vAki rekhechi|
paravartIdera madhye tAra samparke ei aitihya cAlu karechi
(ye, tArA valave), jagadvAsIdera madhye nUhera prati sAlAma (zAnti varSita hoka)|
Ami satkarmazIladerake ebhAvei puraskRta kare thAki|
nizcaYai se AmAra mumina vAndAdera antarbhukta chila|
ataHpara Ami anyaderake pAnite nimajjita kari|
evaM tArai anugAmIdera antarbhukta chila ivarAhImao|
yakhana se tAra pratipAlakera kAche upasthita haYechila vizuddha antare|
yakhana se tAra pitA o tAra sampradAYake valala, tomarA kona jinisera ivAdata karacha?
tomarA ki AllAhake cher3e alIka upAsyaderake kAmanA karacha?
to yei sattA samasta jagatera pratipAlaka tAra samparke tomAdera kI dhAraNA?
era (kichukAla) para se tArakArAjira dike ekavAra tAkAla|
evaM valala, Ami asustha|
sutarAM tArA pRSTha ghuriYe tAra kAcha theke cale gela|
tArapara se tAdera (hAtegar3A) upAsyadera (arthAt mUrtidera) kAche Dhuke par3ala evaM (tAderake) valala, tomarA ye khAccha nA?
kI vyApAra, tomarA kathA valacha nA ye?
ataHpara savale AghAta hAnate tAdera upara jhA~piYe par3ala|
anantara tArA (kaomera lokajana) tAra kAche daur3e Asala|
ivarAhIma valala, tomarA ki nijerA yA vAnAo tAra pUjA kara?
athaca AllAha sRSTi karechena tomAderake evaM tomarA yA-kichu tairi kara tAderakeo|
tArA valala, ivarAhImera janya ekaTi imArata vAnAo evaM tAke (tAra bhetara) jvalanta Agune nikSepa kara|
ebhAve tArA ivarAhImera viruddhe eka dUrabhisandhi karate cAila| kintu Ami tAderake heYa kare chAr3alAma|
ivarAhIma valala, Ami AmAra pratipAlakera kAche yAcchi| tinii AmAke patha dekhAvena|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke emana putra dAna kara, ye have satlokadera ekajana|
sutarAM Ami tAke eka sahanazIla putrera susaMvAda dilAma|

ataHpara se putra yakhana ivarAhImera sAthe calApherA karAra upayukta hala, takhana se valala, vAchA! Ami svapne dekhachi ye, tomAke yavAha karachi| evAra cintA kare vala, tomAra abhimata kI| putra valala, AvvAjI! ApanAke yAra nirdeza deoYA hacche Apani seTAi karuna| inazAAllAha Apani AmAke savarakArIdera ekajana pAvena|
sutarAM (seTA chila eka vismaYakara dRzya) yakhana tArA ubhaYe Anugatya prakAza karala evaM pitA putrake kAta kare zuiYe dila|
Ara Ami tAke DAka diYe valalAma, he ivarAhIma!
tumi svapnake satye pariNata kare dekhiYecha| nizcaYai Ami satkarmazIladerake ebhAvei puraskRta kare thAki|
nizcaYai eTA chila eka spaSTa parIkSA|
evaM Ami eka mahAna kuravAnIra vinimaYe se zizuke mukta karalAma|
evaM paravartIdera madhye ei aitihya cAlu karalAma
ye, (tArA valave,) sAlAma hoka ivarAhImera prati,
Ami satkarmazIladerake ebhAvei puraskRta kare thAki|
nizcaYai se AmAra mumina vAndAdera antarbhukta chila|
Ara Ami tAke susaMvAda dilAma isahAkera, ye nekakAradera madhye ekajana navI have|
Ami tAra prati varakata nAyila karalAma evaM isahAkera pratio| tAdera AolAdera madhye kichu loka satkarmazIla evaM kichu loka nija sattAra prati prakAzya julumakArI|
nizcaYai Ami mUsA o hArunera pratio anugraha karechilAma|
Ami tAderake o tAdera kaomake eka mahA saMkaTa theke mukti diYechilAma|
Ara tAderake sAhAyya karechilAma, phale tArAi haYechila vijaYI|
Ara Ami tAderake eka suspaSTa kitAva diYechilAma|
Ara tAderake pradarzana karechilAma sarala patha|
Ara paravartIdera madhye ei aitihya cAlu karalAma
ye, (tArA valave) sAlAma hoka mUsA o hArunera prati|
nizcaYai Ami satkarmazIladerake ebhAvei puraskRta kari|
nizcaYai tArA chila AmAra mumina vAndAdera antarbhukta|
nizcaYai iliYAsao rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta chila|
yakhana se nija kaomake valechila, tomarA ki AllAhake bhaYa karo nA?
tomarA ki ‘vA‘la’ (nAmaka mUrti)-era pUjA karacha evaM parityAga karacha zreSThatama sraSTAke?
sei AllAhake, yini tomAdera pratipAlaka evaM tomAdera vApa-dAdAderao, yArA pUrve gata haYeche?
tArapara ei hala ye, tArA iliYAsake mithyAvAdI valala; era phale tAderake avazyai zAstira sammukhIna karA have|
tave AllAhara manonIta vAndAgaNa chAr3A (tArA thAkave nirApada)|
Ara paravartIdera madhye ei aitihya cAlu karalAma
ye, (tArA valave) sAlAma hoka iliYAsInera prati|
nizcaYai Ami satkarmazIladerake ebhAvei puraskRta kare thAki|
nizcaYai se chila AmAra mumina vAndAdera antarbhukta|
niHsandehe lUta chila rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|
yakhana Ami tAke o tAra parivAravargera sakalake rakSA karechilAma (AyAva theke)|
eka vRddhAke chAr3A, ye pazcAte avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta chila|
tArapara anyaderake sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa kare phelalAma|
(he makkAvAsIgaNa!) tomarA to tAdera (vasatisamUhera) upara diYe yAtAYAta kare thAka (kakhanao) bhora velA|
evaM (kakhanao) rAtera velA| tA sattveo ki tomarA anudhAvana karave nA?
nizcaYai iunusao chila rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|
yakhana pAliYe ekaTi vojhAi naukAYa peৗ~chala|
ataHpara se laTArite zarIka hala evaM tAte parAbhUta hala|
tArapara mAcha tAke gile phelala, yakhana se nijeke dhikkAra dicchila|
sutarAM se yadi tAsavIha pAThakArIdera antarbhukta nA hata
tave mRtaderake punarjIvita karAra dina paryanta se sei mAcherai peTe thAkata|
ataHpara Ami tAke pIr3ita avasthAYa ekaTi unmukta prAntare nikSepa karalAma|
evaM tAra upara udagata karalAma ekaTi latAyukta gAcha|
tAke rAsUla kare pAThiYechilAma eka lAkha, varaM tArao kichu vezi lokera kAche|
ataHpara tArA ImAna enechila| phale Ami tAderake ekaTA kAla paryanta jIvana bhoga karate dei|
sutarAM tAderake (makkAra muzarikaderake) jijJesa kara, tomAra pratipAlakera janyai ki raYeche kanyA santAna Ara tAdera janya putra santAna?
nAki Ami yakhana pherezatAderake nArI vAniYechilAma, takhana tArA tA pratyakSa karachila?
mane rekha, tArA tAdera managar3A kathAra kAraNe vale
AllAhara kona santAna Ache| vastuta tArA nizcitabhAvei mithyAvAdI|
AllAha ki putrera parivarte kanyAderai veche niYechena?
tomAdera hala kI? tomarA kemana vicAra karacha?
tomarA ki etaTukuo anudhAvana kara nA?
nA ki tomAdera kAche suspaSTa kona pramANa Ache?
tave niYe eso tomAdera sei kitAva yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
tArA AllAha o jinadera madhyeo vaMzIYa samparka sthira kareche| athaca svaYaM jinaroo jAne, tAderake aparAdhIrUpe hAjira karA have|
(kenanA) tArA yA-kichu vale AllAha tA theke pavitra|
tave AllAhara manonIta vAndAgaNa (nirApada thAkave)|
kenanA tomarA evaM tomarA yAdera ivAdata kara tArA
tomarA keu AllAha samparke kAuke vibhrAnta karate pAra nA
sei vyaktike chAr3A, ye jAhAnnAme praveza karave|
Ara (pherezatAgaNa to vale) AmAdera pratyekerai Ache eka nirdiSTa sthAna|
Ara AmarA to (AllAha tAAlAra Anugatye) sArivaddha haYe thAki|
evaM AmarA to tA~ra pavitratA varNanAYa rata thAki|
tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa) pUrve to valata
AmAdera kAche yadi pUrvavartI lokadera mata upadezavANI thAkata
tave AmarAo AllAhara manonIta vAndAdera antarbhukta haYe yetAma|
tA sattveo tArA tAra kupharIte lipta hala| sutarAM tArA acirei jAnate pArave|
AmAra prerita vAndAdera samparke pUrvei AmAra ekathA sthirIkRta raYeche
ye, nizcitabhAvei tArA sAhAyyaprApta have|
evaM nizcaYai AmAra vAhinIi have jaYayukta|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi kichu kAla paryanta tAderake upekSA kare cala|
evaM tAderake dekhate thAka| acirei tArA nijerAo dekhate pAve|
tave ki tArA AmAra zAstira janya tAr3Ahur3A karache?
tAdera AGginAYa yakhana zAsti neme Asave, takhana yAderake satarka karA haYeche, tAdera prabhAta have ati manda|
tumi kichu kAlera janya tAderake upekSA kara|
evaM dekhate thAka, acirei tArA nijerAo dekhate pAve|
tomAra pratipAlaka, yini kSamatAra mAlika, tArA yA valache, tA hate pavitra|
Ara sAlAma rAsUladera prati|
evaM samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
soYAda, kasama upadezapUrNa kuraAnera|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA kevala (e kAraNei tA avalamvana kareche ye, tArA) AtmambharitA o haThakAritAYa lipta raYeche|
Ami tAdera pUrve kata mAnava goSThIkei dhvaMsa karechi! takhana tArA ArtacitkAra karechila, kintu takhana to mukti pAoYAra samaYai chila nA|
tArA (kurAiza kApheragaNa) e kAraNe vismaYavodha karache ye, tAdera kAche ekajana satarkakArI eseche tAderai madhya hate! evaM kApheragaNa vale, se mithyAcArI yAdukara|
se ki samasta mAvudake eka mAvude pariNata kareche? eTA to var3a Ajava kathA!
tAdera madhyakAra netRvarga ei vale sare par3ala ye, cala evaM tomAdera upAsyadera pUjAYa avicalita thAka| nizcaYai eTA eka uddezyamUlaka viSaYa|
AmarA to anya dharme erUpa kathA zunini| Asale eTA eka managar3A kathA|
ei upadeza-vANI AmAdera parivarte tAra upara nAyila karA hala? vastuta tArA AmAra upadeza samparke sandehe patita; varaM tArA ekhanao paryanta AmAra zAstira svAda grahaNa kareni|
tave ki tAdera kAche tomAra sei ravvera rahamatera bhANDArasamUha raYeche yini kSamatAmaYa, mahAdAtA?
nAki AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM era madhyavartI savakichura rAjatva tAdera hAte? tA thAkale tArA yena razi TAniYe upare ArohaNa kare|
(tAdera avasthA to ei ye,) tArA yena virodhI dalasamUhera ekaTi vAhinI, yArA okhAnei parAsta have|
tAdera Age nUhera sampradAYa, Ada jAti evaM kIlakaviziSTa phira‘Aunao navIgaNake mithyAvAdI valechila|
evaM chAmUda jAti, lUtera sampradAYa evaM AYakAvAsIgaNao| tArA chila virodhI dalasamUhera loka|
tAdera madhye emana keu chila nA, ye rAsUlagaNake mithyAvAdI valeni| phale tAdera upara AmAra zAsti avatIrNa haYeche yathAyathabhAve|
evaM tArAo (arthAt makkAvAsIgaNa) emana eka mahA nAda-era apekSA karache, yAte kona virati thAkave nA|
evaM tArA vale, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! vicAra divasera Agei AmAdera prApya AmAderake nagada diYe dina|
(he rAsUla!) tArA yA-kichu vale tAte savara kara evaM smaraNa kara AmAra vAndA dAUda (AlAihisa sAlAma)ke, ye chila atyanta zaktizAlI| nizcaYai se chila atyanta AllAha-abhimukhI|
Ami parvatamAlAke niYojita karechilAma, yAte tArA tAra saGge sandhyAvelA o sUryeAdaYakAle tAsavIha pATha kare|
evaM pAkhiderakeo, yAderake ekatra kare neoYA hata| tArA tAra saGge mile AllAhara yikire lipta thAkata|
Ami tAra rAjatvake karechilAma sudRr3ha evaM tAke dAna karechilAma jJAnavattA o mImAMsAkara vAgmitA|
tomAra kAche ki sei mokaddamAkArIdera saMvAda peৗ~cheche, yakhana tArA prAcIra DiGgiYe ivAdatakhAnAYa praveza karechila?

yakhana tArA dAUdera kAche peৗ~chala, se tAdera dekhe ghAvar3e gela| tArA valala, bhaYa pAvena nA| AmarA vivAdamAna du’Ti pakSa| AmAdera eke anyera prati juluma kareche| sutarAM Apani AmAdera madhye nyAYavicAra kare dina evaM avicAra karavena nA evaM AmAderake saThika patha-nirdeza karuna|
e AmAra bhAi| tAra nirAnavvaiTi dumvA Ache| Ara AmAra Ache ekaTi mAtra dumvA| se valache, eTio AmAra yimmAYa diYe dAo evaM se kathAra jore AmAke durvala kare diYeche|

dAUda valala, se tAra dumvAdera sAthe melAnora janya tomAra dumvATike dAvi kare nizcaYai tomAra upara juluma kareche| yAdera madhye aMzIdAritva thAke, tAdera anekei eke anyera prati juluma kare thAke| vyatikrama kevala tArA, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche| kintu tArA var3a kama| takhana dAUda upalavdhi karala ye, mUlata Ami tAke parIkSA karechi| kAjei se tAra pratipAlakera kAche kSamA prArthanA karala evaM sijadAYa luTiYe par3ala Ara AllAhara abhimukhI hala|
anantara Ami tAke kSamA kare dilAma| prakRtapakSe AmAra kAche raYeche tAra vizeSa naikaTya o uttama ThikAnA|

he dAUda! Ami pRthivIte tomAke khalIphA vAniYechi| sutarAM tumi mAnuSera madhye nyAYavicAra karo evaM kheYAla-khuzIra anugAmI haYo nA| anyathAYa tA tomAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karave| nizcaYai yArA AllAhara patha theke vicyuta haYa tAdera janya Ache kaThina zAsti, yehetu tArA hisAva divasake vismRta haYechila|

Ami AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI evaM era mAjhakhAne yA-kichu Ache, tA nirarthaka sRSTi karini| eTA yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera dhAraNA mAtra| sutarAM kApheradera janya raYeche dhvaMsa jAhAnnAmarUpe|
yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, Ami ki tAderake sei sava lokera samAna gaNya karava, yArA pRthivIte azAnti vistAra kare? nA ki Ami muttAkIderake pApAcArIdera samAna gaNya karava?
(he rAsUla!) eTi eka varakatamaYa kitAva, yA Ami tomAra prati nAyila karechi, yAte mAnuSa era AYAtera madhye cintA kare evaM yAte vodhasampanna vyaktigaNa upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ami dAUdake dAna karalAma sulAimAna (-era mata putra)| se chila uttama vAndA| nizcaYai se chila atizaYa AllAha abhimukhI|
(sei samaYaTi smaraNIYa) yakhana sandhyAvelA tAra sAmane utkRSTa prajAtira bhAlo-bhAlo ghor3A peza karA hala|
takhana se valala, Ami AmAra pratipAlakera smaraNArthei ei sampadake bhAlovesechi| avazeSe tA pardAra Ar3Ala haYe gela|
(anantara se valala,) oguloke AmAra kAche phiriYe Ana| ataHpara se (tAdera) pAYera gochA o ghAr3e hAta vulAte lAgala|
avazyai Ami sulAimAnake parIkSA karechilAma evaM tAra siMhAsane ekaTi dhar3a ene phele diYechilAma| anantara se (AllAhara) abhimukhI hala|
se valate lAgala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke kSamA kara evaM AmAke emana rAjatva dAna kara, yA AmAra para anya kArao janya vAJchanIYa have nA| nizcaYai tumi mahAdAtA|
sutarAM Ami vAtAsake tAra adhIna kare dilAma, yA tAra Adeze se yethAYa cAita manthara gatite vaYe yeta|
evaM duSTa jinaderakeo tA~ra AjJAdhIna kare diYechilAma, yAra madhye chila sava rakamera nirmAtA o Duvuri|
evaM emana kichu jinnakeo, yArA zikale vA~dhA chila|
(tAke valechilAma) esava AmAra dAna| cAile tumi anugraha kare kAuke (era theke) kichu dAna karate pAra athavA nijera kAche rekheo dite pAra, kona hisAvera dAYa chAr3A|
vastuta AmAra kAche tAra raYeche vizeSa naikaTya o uttama ThikAnA|
AmAra vAndA AYyUvake smaraNa kara, yakhana se nija pratipAlakake Deke valechila, zaYatAna AmAke duHkha o kaSTe jar3iYeche|
(Ami tAke valalAma) tumi tomAra pA dvArA mATite AghAta kara| nAo, ei to gosalera ThANDA pAni, evaM pAnIYa|
evaM (ebhAve) Ami tAke dAna karalAma tAra parivAravarga evaM tAdera sAthe anurUpa Arao tAra prati AmAra rahamata evaM vodhasampanna vyaktidera janya upadezasvarUpa|

(Ami tAke Arao valalAma) tomAra hAte eka muTho tRNa nAo evaM tA dvArA AghAta kara Ara zapatha bhaGga karo nA| vastuta Ami tAke peYechi ekajana savarakArI| se chila ati uttama vAndA| prakRtapakSe se chila atyanta AllAha-abhimukhI|
AmAra vAndA ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYAkuvera kathA smaraNa kara, yArA (satkarmazIla) hAta o (dRSTizakti sampanna) cokhera adhikArI chila|
Ami ekaTi vizeSa guNera janya tAderake veche niYechilAma| tA chila (AkherAtera) prakRta nivAsera smaraNa|
prakRtapakSe tArA chila AmAra kAche manonIta, uttama lokadera antarbhukta|
evaM smaraNa kara isamAIla, Ala- iYAsA o yula-kiphalake| tArA sakale chila uttama vyaktivargera antarbhukta|
esava hala upadeza-vANI| nizcaYai yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tAdera janya raYeche utkRSTa ThikAnA
arthAt sthAYI vasavAsera jAnnAta, yAra darajAsamUha tAdera janya sampUrNarUpe unmukta thAkave|
sekhAne tArA helAna diYe vase vahu phalamUla o pAnIYera pharamAYeza karave|
Ara tAdera kAche thAkave emana samavaYaskA nArI, yAdera dRSTi (Apana-Apana svAmIte) nivaddha thAkave|
eTAi tAi (arthAt ni‘AmatapUrNa jIvana), hisAva divasera janya tomAderake yAra pratizruti deoYA haYechila|
nizcaYai eTA AmAra emana dAna, yA kakhanao niHzeSa have nA|
ekadike to ei| (anyadike) yArA avAdhya nizcaYai tAdera janya Ache nikRSTa ThikAnA|
arthAt jAhAnnAma, yAte tArA praveza karave| ataHpara tA have tAdera nikRSTa vichAnA|
ei hacche garama pAni o pu~ja! sutarAM tArA era svAda grahaNa karuka|
Arao Ache anurUpa vibhinna rakamera zAstira vyavasthA|
(yakhana tArA tAdera anugAmIderake Asate dekhave, takhana tArA eke aparake valave,) ei ArekaTi dala, yArA tomAdera saGge praveza kareche| tAdera janya abhinandana nei| erA sakalei Agune jvalave|
tArA (AgamanakArIrA) valave, nA, varaM abhinandana nei tomAdera janya| tomarAi to AmAdera sammukhe e musivata niYe esecha| kata nikRSTa thAkAra jAYagA eTi|
(tArapara tArA AllAha tAAlAke valave,) he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ye vyaktii AmAdera sAmane e musivata eneche tAke jAhAnnAme dviguNa zAsti dina|
evaM tArA (eke aparake) valave, kI vyApAra! AmarA yAderake manda lokadera madhye gaNya karatAma, sei lokaguloke ye (jAhAnnAme) dekhate pAcchi nA?
AmarA ki tave tAderake (anyAYabhAve) ThATTA-vidrUpera pAtra vAniYechilAma, nAki tAderake dekhAra vyApAre AmAdera cokhera vicyuti ghaTeche?
jAhAnnAmavAsIdera ei vAka-vitaNDA| eTA nirghAta satya|
(he rAsUla!) vale dAo, Ami to ekajana satarkakArI mAtra| AllAha chAr3A keu ivAdatera upayukta naYa, yini eka, sakalera upara pravala|
yini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI evaM e duYera madhyavartI savakichura mAlika, yAra kSamatA savakichu jur3e vyApta, yini ati kSamAzIla|
vale dAo, eTA eka mahA (satyera) saMvAda|
yA theke tomarA mukha phiriYe rekhecha|
Urdhvajagate tArA (arthAt pherezatAgaNa) yakhana saoYAla-jaoYAva karachila, se samparke AmAra kona jJAna chila nA,
AmAra kAche ohI Ase kevala ejanya ye, Ami ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka pherezatAderake valalena, Ami kAdA dvArA eka mAnuSa sRSTi karate cAi|
Ami yakhana tAke sampUrNarUpe tairi kare phelava evaM tAra bhetara AmAra rUha phu~ke deva, takhana tomarA tAra sAmane sijadAYa par3e yeo|
ataHpara samasta pherezatAi to sijadA karala
kintu ivalIsa karala nA| se ahaMkAra karala evaM kApheradera antarbhukta haYe gela|
AllAha valalena, he ivalisa! Ami yAke nija hAte sRSTi karechi, tAke sijadA karate kona jinisa tomAke vAdhA dila? tumi ki ahaMkAra karale, nAki tumi ucca maryAdAsampanna kichu?
se valala, Ami tAra (arthAt Adama) ceYe zreSTha| Apani AmAke Aguna dvArA sRSTi karechena Ara tAke sRSTi karechena kAdA dvArA|
AllAha valalena, tui ekhAna theke vera haYe yA| kenanA tui vitAr3ita|
nizcitabhAve kiYAmata divasa paryanta tora prati thAkala AmAra lAnata|
se valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAhale Apani AmAke sei dina paryanta avakAza dina, ye dina mAnuSake punarjIvita karA have|
AllAha valalena, tathAstu, toke avakAza prAptadera antarbhukta kare deoYA hala|
(kintu) nirdiSTa ekaTA samaYa paryanta|
se valala, tave ApanAra kSamatAra zapatha! Ami tAdera sakalake vipathagAmI kare chAr3ava|
tave tAdera madhyakAra ApanAra manonIta vAndAdera chAr3A|
AllAha valalena, tave satya kathA hala Ara Ami to satyai vale thAki
Ami toke dvArA Ara tAdera madhye yArA tora anugAmI have tAdera sakalera dvArA jAhAnnAma bhare phelava|
(he rAsUla! mAnuSake) vala, Ami era (isalAmera dAoYAtera) kAraNe tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA evaM Ami bhanitAkArIdera antarbhukta nai|
eTA to jagadvAsIdera janya eka upadeza mAtra|
evaM kichukAla parei tomarA era saMvAda jAnate pArave|
e kitAva nAyila karA haYeche AllAhara pakSa hate, yini mahA kSamatAvAna, hekamataoYAlA|
(he rAsUla!) nizcaYai Amii e kitAva tomAra prati nAyila karechi satyasaha| sutarAM tumi AllAhara ivAdata kara tA~ra janya Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe|

smaraNa rekha, khAlesa Anugatya tA~rai prApya| yArA tA~ke chAr3A anyasava abhibhAvaka vAniYe niYeche (ei kathA vale ye,) AmarA tAdera upAsanA kari kevala ejanya ye, tArA AmAderake AllAhara nikaTavartI kare deve, AllAha tAdera madhye sei viSaYe mImAMsA kare devena yAra mAjhe tArA matavirodha karache| nizcaYai AllAha emana kona vyaktike pathe Anena nA, ye carama mithyuka, ghora kAphera|

AllAha kona santAna grahaNa karate cAile nija sRSTira madhya hate yAke icchA veche nite pAratena, (kintu) tini (e viSaYa hate) pavitra (ye, tAra kona santAna thAkave)| tini to AllAha, eka evaM pracaNDa kSamatAra adhikArI|

tini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve| tini rAtake dinera upara vichiYe dena evaM dinake rAtera upara vichiYe dena| tini sUrya o candrake kAje niYojita karechena| pratiTi nirdiSTa eka meYAda paryanta saJcaraNa karache| smaraNa rekha, tini azeSa kSamatAra mAlika, parama kSamAzIla|

tini tomAdera sakalake sRSTi karechena ekai vyakti hate, Ara tAra jor3A vAniYechena tArai theke| Ara tomAdera janya catuSpada jantu hate ATaTi jor3A sRSTi karechena| tini tomAderake tomAdera mAtRgarbhe ebhAve sRSTi karena ye, tina andhakArera madhye tomarA ekera para eka sRjana stara atikrama kara| tinii AllAha, yini tomAdera pratipAlaka| samasta rAjatva tA~rai| tini chAr3A ivAdatera upayukta Ara keu nei, tAraparao ke kothA hate tomAdera mukha phiriYe dicche?

tomarA kuphara avalamvana karale nizcita jene rekha AllAha tomAdera kArao mukhApekSI nana| tini nija vAndAdera janya kuphara pachanda karena nA| Ara tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza karale, tini tomAdera janya tA pachanda karavena| konao vojhA vahanakArI anya kArao vojhA vahana karave nA| tArapara tomAdera sakalake tomAdera pratipAlakera kAchei phire yete have| takhana tini tomAderake tomAdera kRtakarma samparke avahita karavena| nizcaYai tini antarera kathAo bhAlobhAve jAnena|

mAnuSake yakhana kona kaSTa sparza kare, takhana se nija pratipAlakake tA~rai abhimukhI haYe DAke| ataHpara tini mAnuSake yakhana nijera pakSa theke kona ni‘Amata dAna karena, takhana se tA (arthAt sei kaSTera kathA) bhule yAYa, ye janya se itaHpUrve AllAhake DAkachila| Ara takhana se AllAhara janya zarIka sAvyasta kare, yAra phale se anyakeo AllAhara patha theke vicyuta kare| vala, kichudina nija kupharera majA bhoga kare nAo| nizcaYai tumi jAhAnnAmavAsIdera antarbhukta|

tave ki (erUpa vyakti sei vyaktira samatulya hate pAre,) ye rAtera muhUrtagulote ivAdata kare, kakhanao sijadAvasthAYa, kakhanao dA~r3iYe, ye AkherAtake bhaYa kare evaM nija pratipAlakera rahamatera AzA kare? vala, yArA jAne Ara yArA jAne nA ubhaYe ki samAna? (kintu) upadeza grahaNa to kevala vodhasampanna vyaktirAi kare|

vala, he AmAra mumina vAndAgaNa! antare tomAdera pratipAlakera bhaYa rAkha| yArA e duniYAte bhAlo kAja kare tAdera janya Ache kalyANa| AllAhara yamIna prazasta| yArA savara avalamvana kare tAderake tAdera saoYAva deoYA have aparimita|
vale dAo, AmAke to Adeza karA haYeche, yena AllAhara ivAdata kari tAra janya Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe|
evaM AmAke Adeza karA haYeche ye, yena Ami hai sarvaprathama AtmasamarpaNakArI|
vale dAo, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera avAdhyatA kari, tave AmAra bhaYa raYeche eka mahA divasera zAstira|
vale dAo, Ami to AllAhara ivAdata kari nija Anugatyake tArai janya khAlesa kare|

ataeva, tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAra icchA ivAdata kara| vale dAo, (vyavasAYe) kSatigrasta to tArAi, yArA kiYAmatera dina nijedera prANa o nijedera parivAravargera savai hArAve| mane rekha, eTAi suspaSTa kSati|

tAdera janya tAdera upara dika thekeo thAkave Agunera megha evaM tAdera nicera dikeo thAkave anurUpa megha| eTAi sei jinisa yA dvArA AllAha tA~ra vAndAderake satarka karena| sutarAM he AmAra vAndAgaNa antare AmAra bhaYa rAkha|
yArA tAgutera pUjA parihAra kareche o AllAhara abhimukhI haYeche, susaMvAda tAderai janya| sutarAM AmAra sei vAndAderake susaMvAda zonAo|
yArA kathA zone manoyoga diYe, ataHpara tAra madhye yA-kichu uttama tAra anusaraNa kare, tArAi emana loka, yAderake AllAha hedAYAta dAna karechena evaM tArAi vodhazaktisampanna|
tave ki yAra upara zAsti-vANI avadhArita haYe geche, tumi rakSA karate pArave tAke, ye Agunera bhetara peৗ~che geche?

tave yArA antare nija pratipAlakera bhaYa rAkhe, tAdera janya Ache vahu prAsAda, yegulora upare nirmita vahu prAsAda, yAra nice vaYe cale nada-nadI| eTA AllAhara oYAdA| AllAha kakhanao oYAdA bhaGga karena nA|

tumi ki dekhani AllAha AkAza theke vAripAta karechena, tArapara tA bhUmira nirjhare pravAhita karechena? tArapara tA dvArA vibhinna raMYera phasala utpanna karena| tArapara tA zukiYe yAYa| phale tumi dekhate pAo tA haluda varNa dhAraNa kareche| tArapara tini tA cUrNa-vicUrNa kare phelena| nizcaYai era madhye vodhazaktisampanna vyaktidera janya upadeza Ache|

AllAha isalAmera janya yAra vakSa khule diYechena, phale se tAra pratipAlakera deoYA Alote ese geche (se ki kaThora hRdaYa vyaktidera samatulya hate pAre?) sutarAM dhvaMsa sei kaThoraprANadera janya, yArA AllAhara yikira theke vimukha| tArA suspaSTa vibhrAntite nipatita|

AllAha nAyila karechena uttama vANI emana eka kitAva yAra viSaYavastusamUha paraspara susAmaJjasya, (yAra vaktavyasamUha) punarAvRttikRta, yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare era dvArA tAdera zarIra romAJcita haYa| tArapara tAdera deha-mana vigalita haYe AllAhara smaraNe jhu~ke par3e| eTA AllAhara hedAYAta, yAra mAdhyame tini yAke cAna saThika pathe niYe Asena Ara AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena, tAke saThika pathe AnAra keu nei|
(sei vyaktira avasthA katai nA manda have) ye vyakti kiYAmatera dina tAra cehArA dvArA nikRSTa zAsti ThekAte cAve? jAlemaderake valA have, tomarA yA arjana karate tAra svAda grahaNa kara|
tAdera pUrvavartI lokerAo (tAdera navIgaNake) asvIkAra karechila| pariNAme emana dika theke zAsti tAdera kAche Asala yA tArA dhAraNAo karate pArachila nA|
AllAha tAderake pArthiva jIvanei lAJchanA bhoga karAlena Ara AkherAtera zAsti to Arao var3a yadi tArA jAnata|
vastuta Ami e kuraAne mAnuSera janya sava rakamera dRSTAnta varNanA karechi, yAte mAnuSa zikSA grahaNa kare|
eTA AravI kuraAna, naYa vakratApUrNa, yAte mAnuSa tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

AllAha ekaTi dRSTAnta peza karechena ei ye, eka vyakti (arthAt eka golAma) emana, yAra madhye kaYeka vyakti aMzIdAra; yArA paraspara viruddha bhAvApanna Ara apara vyakti (anya golAma) emana, ye sampUrNarUpe ekai vyaktira mAlikAnAYa| e ubhaYa vyaktira avasthA ekai rakama hate pAre? AlahAmadulillAha! (e dRSTAnta dvArA viSaYaTi sampUrNa pariSkAra haYe geche), kintu tAdera adhikAMzei vojhe nA|
(he rAsUla!) nizcaYa tumi maraNazIla evaM tArAo avazyai maraNazIla|
avazeSe tomarA sakale kiYAmatera dina tomAdera pratipAlakera sAmane vAdAnuvAda karave|
sutarAM vala, sei vyakti apekSA var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre, ye AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare Ara yakhana tAra kAche satya kathA Ase tA pratyAkhyAna kare? kApheradera ThikAnA ki jAhAnnAme naYa?
Ara ye vyakti satya kathA niYe Ase evaM nijeo tA vizvAsa kare, erUpa lokai muttAkI|
tArA tAdera pratipAlakera kAche pAve vAJchita savakichu- eTAi satkarmazIladera pratidAna|
tA ejanya ye, tArA ye mandakAja karechila AllAha tA kSamA kare divena Ara yesava utkRSTa kAje rata chila tAderake tAra puraskAra dAna karavena|
(he rAsUla!) AllAha ki tAra vAndAra janya yatheSTa nana? tArA tomAke AllAha chAr3A anyadera bhaYa dekhAYa| AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena tAke pathe AnAra keu nei|
Ara AllAha yAke supathe Anena, tAke vipathagAmI karArao keu nei| AllAha ki parAkrAnta, zAstidAtA nana?

tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI ke sRSTi kareche? tave tArA avazyai valave, AllAha! (tAderake) vala, tomarA vala to, tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAdera (arthAt yei pratimAdera)ke DAka, AllAha AmAra kona kSati karate cAile tArA ki sei kSati dUra karate pArave? athavA AllAha yadi AmAra prati anugraha karate cAna, tave tArA ki tA~ra sei rahamata ThekAte pArave? vala, AmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| bharasAkArIgaNa to tA~rai upara bharasA kare|
vale dAo, he AmAra kaoma! tomarA Apana niYama anusAre kAja karate thAka, Amio (AmAra niYame) kAja karachi| acirei tomarA jAnate pArave
kAra prati Ase emana zAsti, yA tAke lAJchita kare chAr3ave evaM kAra prati avatIrNa haYa sthAYI zAsti|

(he rAsUla!) Ami mAnuSera kalyANArthe tomAra prati satyasaha e kitAva nAyila karechi| sutarAM ye vyakti saThika pathe ese yAve se Asave nijerai kalyANArthe Ara ye vyakti pathabhraSTatA avalamvana karave, se tAra pathabhraSTatA dvArA nijerai kSati karave| tumi tAdera tattvAvadhAYaka nao|

AllAha rUhasamUhake kavaya karena tAdera mRtyukAle Ara ekhanao yAra mRtyu Aseni tAkeo (kavaya karena) tAra nidrAkAle| ataHpara yAra samparke tini mRtyura phAYasAlA karechena, tAke rekhe dena Ara anyAnya rUhake eka nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta cher3e dena| nizcaYai era madhye vahu nidarzana Ache sei sakala lokera janya, yArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|

tave ki tArA AllAha (-era anumati) chAr3A supArizakArI grahaNa kareche| (tAderake) vala, tAdera (arthAt sei supArizakArIdera) kona kSamatA nA thAkaleo evaM tArA kona vodhavuddhi nA rAkhaleo (tAderake supArizakArI mAnate thAkave)?
vala, samasta supAriza to AllAharai ekhatiYAre| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra rAjatva tA~rai hAte| parizeSe tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
yakhana eka AllAhake smaraNa karA haYa, takhana yArA AkherAte ImAna rAkhe nA tAdera antara virakta haYa Ara yakhana tA~ke chAr3A anyera kathA valA haYa, amani tArA Anande utphulla haYe oThe|
vala, he AllAha! he AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sraSTA! samasta adRzya o dRzyera jJAtA! tumii tomAra vAndAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deve sei viSaYe yA niYe tArA matavirodhe lipta|

yArA julume lipta haYeche, yadi duniYAra samasta sampada tAdera thAke evaM tAra samaparimANa Arao, tave kiYAmatera dina nikRSTatama zAsti hate vA~cAra janya tA savai muktipaNa svarUpa diYe deve| Ara AllAhara pakSa hate tAdera sAmane emana kichu prakAza pAve, yA tArA kalpanAo kareni|
tArA yA-kichu arjana karechila, tAra manda phala tAdera sAmane prakAza haYe yAve evaM tArA ye viSaYa niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata, tA tAderake cAradika theke veSTana kare phelave|

mAnuSake yakhana kona duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana se AmAke DAke tArapara yakhana Ami AmAra pakSa hate tAke kona ni‘Amata dAna kari, takhana se vale, eTA to Ami lAbha karechi (AmAra) jJAnavale| nA, varaM eTA ekaTA parIkSA, kintu tAdera adhikAMzei jAne nA|
ekathAi valechila tAdera pUrvavartI (kichu) loka| phale, tArA yA arjana karata, tA tAdera kona kAje Asala nA|

evaM tArA yA arjana karechila tAra manda phala tAdera upara Apatita haYeche evaM tAdera (arthAt Aravadera) madhye yArA juluma kareche tAdera kRtakarmera mandaphalao acire tAdera upara Apatita have evaM tArA (AllAhake) vyartha karate pArave nA|
tArA ki jAne nA AllAha yAra janya icchA riyaka prazasta kare dena evaM tinii saGkucitao karena? nizcaYai era madhye vahu nidarzana Ache sei sava lokera janya, yArA ImAna Ane|

vale dAo, he AmAra vAndAgaNa! yArA nija sattAra upara sImAlaMghana kareche, AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYo nA| nizcaYai AllAha samasta pApa kSamA karena| nizcaYai tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera abhimukhI haYe yAo evaM tA~ra samIpe Anugatya prakAza kara tomAdera nikaTa zAsti AsAra Age, yAra para Ara tomAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|
evaM tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera upara uttama yA-kichu avatIrNa karA haYeche tAra anusaraNa kara tomAdera kAche atarkitabhAve zAsti AsAra Age, athaca tomarA tA jAnateo pArave nA|
yAte kAuke valate nA haYa ye, hAYa! AllAhara vyApAre Ami ye avahelA karechi tAra janya Aphasosa! prakRtapakSe Ami (AllAha tAAlAra vidhi-vidhAna niYe) ThATTAkArIdera antarbhukta haYe giYechilAma|
athavA kAuke valate nA haYa ye, AllAha yadi AmAke hedAYAta ditena tave Amio muttAkIdera antarbhukta haYe yetAma|
athavA zAsti cAkSuSa dekhAra para yena kAuke valate nA haYa, AhA! AmAra yadi ekaTivAra phire yAoYAra suyoga hata, tave Ami satkarmazIladera ekajana haYe yetAma|
avazyai (tomAke hedAYAta deoYA haYechila)| AmAra nidarzanAvalI tomAra kAche esechila, kintu tumi tAke mithyA valechile evaM ahamikA dekhiYechile Ara tumi chile kApheradera antarbhukta|
kiYAmatera dina tumi dekhave, yArA AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa karechila, tAdera cehArA kAlo haYe geche| erUpa ahaMkArIdera ThikAnA ki jAhAnnAme naYa?
yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche, AllAha tAderake mukti devena tAdera Amalasaha| kona kaSTa tAderake sparza karave nA evaM tAdera thAkave nA kona duHkha|
AllAha savakichura sraSTA evaM tini samasta kichura rakSaka|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra kuJjirAzi tA~rai nikaTa| yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche tArAi to kSatigrasta|
vale dAo, he ajJa vyaktirA! tAraparao ki tomarA AmAke AllAha chAr3A anyera ivAdata karate vala?

nizcaYai tomAke evaM tomAra pUrvera navIgaNake ohIra mAdhyame jAniYe deoYA haYechila, tumi yadi ziraka kara, tave nirghAta tomAra samasta karma niSphala haYe yAve evaM tumi avazyai kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|
varaM tumi AllAharai ivAdata kara evaM kRtajJadera antarbhukta thAka|

tArA AllAhake maryAdA deYani tA~ra yathocita maryAdA, athaca kiYAmatera dina goTA pRthivI thAkave tAra muThora bhetara evaM AkAzamaNDalI guTAno avasthAYa thAkave tAra DAna hAte| tini pavitra evaM tArA ye ziraka kare tA theke tini vahu Urdhve|

evaM ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have| phale AllAha yAke icchA karavena se chAr3A AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yArA Ache sakalei mUrchita haYe par3ave| tArapara tAte dvitIYa phu~ka deoYA have, amani tArA daNDAYamAna haYe tAkiYe thAkave|

evaM pRthivI nija pratipAlakera AloYa udbhAsita haYe uThave, AmalanAmA sAmane rekhe deoYA have evaM navIgaNake o sAkSIgaNake upasthita karA have Ara mAnuSera madhye nyAYavicAra karA have| tAdera upara kona juluma karA have nA|
pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pUrNa pratiphala deoYA have| Ara tArA yA kare se samparke AllAha paripUrNa jJAta|

yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila tAderake jAhAnnAmera dike hA~kiYe neoYA have dale dale| yakhana tArA tAra nikaTa peৗ~chave, tAra darajAsamUha khule deoYA have evaM tAra rakSIrA tAderake valave, tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera nijedera madhya hate rAsUlagaNa Aseni, yArA tomAderake tomAdera pratipAlakera AYAtasamUha par3e zonAta evaM tomAderake ei dinera sAkSAta samparke satarka karata? tArA valave nizcaYai esechila, kintu kApheradera prati zAstira kathA vAstavAYita haYe geche|
valA have, jAhAnnAmera darajAsamUhe praveza kara tAte sthAYIbhAve thAkAra janya| yArA ahamikA pradarzana kare tAdera ThikAnA kata manda!

Ara yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare caleche, tAderake dale dale jAnnAtera dike niYe yAoYA have| yakhana tArA sekhAne peৗ~chave evaM tAdera janya tAra darajAsamUha pUrva hatei unmukta thAkave (takhana var3a Anandaghana dRzya have)| tAra rakSIgaNa tAderake valave, ApanAdera prati sAlAma| ApanArA sukhI thAkuna| ApanArA ete praveza karuna sthAYIbhAve thAkAra janya|

tArA (arthAt jAnnAtavAsIgaNa) valave, samasta zokara AllAhara, yini AmAdera saGge nija oYAdA satye pariNata karechena evaM AmAderake (jAnnAtera) bhUmira emana adhikArI vAniYechena ye, AmarA jAnnAtera yekhAne icchA haYa ThikAnA vAnAte pAri| sutarAM satkarmazIladera puraskAra kata uttama!

tumi pherezatAderake dekhate pAve, tArA Arazera cArapAza ghire tAdera pratipAlakera prazaMsAra sAthe tA~ra tAsavIha pATha karache evaM mAnuSera madhye nyAYavicAra kare deoYA have Ara valA have samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
hA-mIma|
e kitAva nAyila karA hacche AllAhara pakSa hate, yini mahA kSamatAvAna, sarvajJAnera adhikArI|
yini gunAha kSamAkArI, tAovA kavulakArI, kaThina zAstidAtA, atyanta zaktimAna| tini chAr3A ivAdatera upayukta Ara keu nei| tA~rai kAche sakalake phire yete have|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArAi AllAhara AYAte vitarka sRSTi kare| sutarAM nagare-nagare tAdera (AYezI) paribhramaNa yena tomAke dheA~kAYa nA phele|

tAdera pUrve nUhera sampradAYa evaM tAdera para vahu dala (navIgaNake) asvIkAra karechila| pratyeka jAti nija nija rAsUlake grephatAra karAra abhisandhi karechila evaM tArA mithyAke AzraYa kare vitarke lipta haYechila tAra mAdhyame satyake miTiYe deoYAra janya| pariNAme Ami tAderake dhRta kari| sutarAM (dekha) AmAra zAsti kemana (kaThora) chila|
ebhAvei yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera samparke tomAra pratipAlakera ei kathA avadhArita haYe geche ye, tArA jAhAnnAmI have|

yArA (arthAt ye pherezatAgaNa) Araza dhAraNa kare Ache evaM yArA tA~ra cArapAze Ache, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera prazaMsAra sAthe tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kare o tA~ra prati ImAna rAkhe evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAdera janya mAgaphirAtera duA kare (ye,) he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tomAra rahamata o jJAna samasta kichu jur3e vyApta| sutarAM yArA tAovA kareche o tomAra pathera anusArI haYeche tAderake kSamA kare dAo evaM tAderake jAhAnnAmera AyAva theke rakSA kara|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tAderake dAkhila kara sthAYI jAnnAte, yAra oYAdA tumi tAdera sAthe karecha evaM tAdera pitA-mAtA, strI o santAnadera madhye yArA neka loka tAderakeo| nizcaYai tumii parAkrazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
evaM tAderake sakala manda viSaYa theke rakSA kara| se dina tumi yAke sava manda theke rakSA karave, tAra prati tumi avazyai daYA karale| Ara eTAi mahAsAphalya|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAderake DAka diYe valA have, (Aja) tomAdera nijedera prati nijedera ye kSobha hacche, tAra ceYe vezi krodha hata AllAhara, yakhana tomAderake ImAnera dAoYAta deoYA hata Ara tomarA tA pratyAkhyAna karate|

tArA valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAderake du’vAra mRtyu diYecha evaM du’vAra jIvana diYecha| evAra AmarA AmAdera gunAhera kathA svIkAra karachi| kAjei (AmAdera jAhAnnAma theke) niSkRtira kona patha Ache ki?

(uttara deoYA have,) tomAdera e avasthAra kAraNa hala, yakhana eka AllAhake DAkA hata, takhana tomarA tAke asvIkAra karate| Ara yadi tAra sAthe anya kAuke zarIka karA hata, tomarA tAte vizvAsa karate| ataeva ekhana phAYasAlA kevala AllAharai, yini samucca, sumahAna|
tinii tomAderake nija nidarzanAvalI dekhiYe thAkena evaM tomAdera janya AsamAna theke riyaka avatIrNa karena| upadeza to sei grahaNa kare, ye (hedAYAtera janya) AntarikabhAve ruju haYa|
sutarAM (he mAnuSa!) tomarA AllAhake DAka tAra janya Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe, tA kApheradera pakSe yatai aprItikara hoka|
tini samucca maryAdAra adhikArI, Arazera adhipati| tini nija vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA nija hukume rUha (arthAt ohI) nAyila karena| ei janya ye, se sAkSAta divasa samparke satarka karave
ye dina tArA sakale prakAzye ese yAve| AllAhara kAche tAdera kona kichui gopana thAkave nA| (valA have) Aja rAjatva kAra? (uttara have ekaTii ye,) kevala AllAhara, yini eka, parAkramazAlI|
Aja pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pratiphala deoYA have| Aja kona juluma have nA| nizcaYai AllAha ati druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

(he rAsUla!) tAderake satarka kare dAo Asanna dina samparke, yakhana vedama kaSTe mAnuSera prANa kaNThAgata haYe yAve| jAlemadera thAkave nA kona vandhu evaM kona supArizakArI, yAra kathA grahaNa karA have|
AllAha jAnena cokhera asAdhutA evaM seisava viSaYao, yA vakSadeza lukiYe rAkhe|

AllAha nyAYavicAra karena| Ara tArA tAke cher3e yAderake (arthAt yei mithyA upAsyaderake) DAke tArA kona kichura vicAra karate pAre nA| nizcaYai AllAhai emana, yini sava kathA zonena, savakichu dekhena|

tArA ki bhUmite vicaraNa kare dekheni, tAdera pUrve yArA chila tAdera kI pariNAma haYeche? tArA zaktiteo chila tAdera apekSA pravalatara evaM pRthivIte rekhe yAoYA kIrtiteo| ataHpara AllAha tAdera gunAhera kAraNe tAderake dhRta karena| tAdera emana keu chila nA, ye tAderake AllAha hate rakSA karave|

tA e kAraNe ye, tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe Asale tArA tAderake asvIkAra karata| phale AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karena| nizcaYai tini atyanta zaktizAlI, zAstidAne kaThora|
Ami musAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI evaM suspaSTa pramANa diYe pAThiYechilAma,
phira‘Auna, hAmAna o kArUnera kAche kintu tArA valala, se to ekajana yAdukara ghora mithyAvAdI|

ataHpara se yakhana AmAra pakSa hate satya niYe tAdera kAche upasthita hala, takhana tArA valala, tAra saGge yArA ImAna eneche tAdera putraderake hatyA kara evaM tAdera nArIderake jIvita rekhe dAo| athaca kApheradera cakrAnta pariNAme to vyarthai haYa|
phira‘Auna valala, AmAke cher3e dAo, Ami mUsAke hatyA karava Ara se tAra ravake DAkuka| AmAra AzaGkA se tomAdera dIna vadale phelave athavA deze azAnti vistAra karave|
mUsA valala, hisAva divase vizvAsa kare nA emana pratyeka ahaMkArI theke Ami sei sattAra AzraYa grahaNa karechi, yini AmAra pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka|

phira‘Aunera khAndAnera eka mumina vyakti, ye e paryanta nija ImAnera kathA gopana rekhechila, vale uThala, tomarA ki ekajana lokake kevala e kAraNe hatyA karave ye, se vale, AmAra pratipAlaka AllAha? athaca se tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera kAche ujjvala nidarzana niYe eseche| se mithyAvAdI hale to tAra mithyAvAdItAra janya sei dAYI have| Ara yadi se satyavAdI haYa, tave se ye zAsti samparke tomAderake satarka karache, tAra kichu to tomAdera upara avazyai Apatita have| AllAha kona sImAlaMghanakArI, mithyukake hedAYAta dAna karena nA|

he AmAra sampradAYa! Aja to rAjatva tomAdera, deze tomarAi pravala| kintu AmAdera upara yadi AllAhara AyAva ese par3e, tave emana ke Ache, ye tA~ra viparIte AmAderake sAhAyya karave? phira‘Auna valala, Ami yA saThika mane kari sei rAYai to tomAderake deva| Ami to tomAderake kevala saThika pathai dekhiYe thAki|
ye vyakti ImAna enechila, se valala, he AmAra kaoma! Ami tomAdera janya AzaGkA kari pUrvavartI sampradAYagulora anurUpa dinera (zAstira)|

(evaM nA jAni tomAdera avasthAo se rakama haYa) yemana avasthA haYechila nUha (AlAihisa sAlAma)-era kaomera, Ada o chAmudera evaM tAdera paravartI kAle yArA esechila tAdera| AllAha to vAndAdera prati juluma karate cAna nA|
he AmAra kaoma! Ami tomAdera janya bhaYa kari ArtanAda-divasera|
ye dina tomarA pichana phire pAlAte cAive, (kintu) AllAha hate tomAdera kona rakSAkArI thAkave nA| AllAha yAke vibhrAnta karena, tAra kona patha-pradarzaka thAke nA|

vastuta era Age iusupha (AlAihisa sAlAma) tomAdera kAche esechilena ujjvala nidarzanAvalI niYe| takhanao tomarA tAra niYe AsA viSaYe sandehe patita chile| tArapara yakhana tAra ophAta haYe gela, takhana tomarA valale, tArapara Ara AllAha kona rAsUla pAThAvena nA| ebhAvei AllAha pratyeka emana vyaktike pathabhraSTatAYa phele rAkhena, ye haYa sImAlaMghanakArI, sandihAna|

yArA tAdera kAche kona pramANa AsA chAr3Ai AllAhara AYAtasamUha samparke vitarke lipta haYa, tAdera e kAja AllAhara kAche ati ghRNArha evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAdera kAcheo| ebhAvei AllAha pratyeka ahaMkArI, svecchAcArI vyaktira antare mohara kare dena|
evaM phira‘Auna (tAra mantrIke) valala, he hAmAna! AmAra janya ekaTi u~cu prAsAda nirmANa kara, yAte Ami sei sava pathe peৗ~chate pAri

yA AsamAnera patha| tArapara Ami u~ki mere mUsAra mAvudake dekhava| Ami avazyai tAke mithyuka mane kari| ebhAvei phira‘Aunera duSkarmake tAra dRSTite zobhana kare tolA haYechila evaM tAke saThika patha theke nivRtta karA haYechila| phira‘Aunera Sar3ayantra to sampUrNa nasyAt haYe giYechila|
ye vyakti ImAna enechila, se valala, he AmAra kaoma! AmAra kathA mAna| Ami tomAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karava|
he AmAra kaoma! ei pArthiva jIvana to tuccha bhoga mAtra| nizcaYai AkherAtai avasthitira prakRta nivAsa|

ye vyakti kona manda kAja karave, tAke kevala tAra karmera anurUpa zAstii deoYA have| Ara ye vyakti satkarma karave, tA se nara hoka vA nArI, yadi se mumina haYe thAke, tave erUpa lokai praveza karave jAnnAte, sekhAne tAderake riyaka deoYA have aparimita|
he AmAra sampradAYa! kI vyApAra, Ami tomAderake muktira dike DAkachi Ara tomarA AmAke DAkacha Agunera dike?

tomarA AmAke dAoYAta diccha yena Ami AllAhake asvIkAra kari evaM tA~ra saGge emana vastuke zarIka kari, yAdera samparke AmAra kona jJAna nei| apara dike Ami tomAderake sei sattAra dike DAkachi yini ati kSamatAvAna, parama kSamAzIla|

satya to ei ye, tomarA yAra dike AmAke DAkacha, tA kona DAkera upayuktai naYa, nA duniYAYa evaM nA AkherAte| prakRtapakSe AmAdera sakalake AllAhara kAche phire yete have Ara yArA sImAlaMghanakArI, tArA have agnivAsI|
Ami tomAderake yA valachi tomarA acirei tA smaraNa karave| Ami AmAra viSaYa AllAhara upara nyasta karachi| nizcaYai AllAha vAndAdera samyaka draSTA|
ataHpara tArA yesava nikRSTa Sar3ayantra karechila, AllAha tAke (sei mumina vyaktike) tA hate rakSA karalena Ara phira‘Aunera sampradAYake pariveSTana karala nikRSTatama zAsti|
Aguna, yAra sAmane tAderake prati sakAla-sandhyAYa peza karA haYa| Ara ye dina kiYAmata saMghaTita have, se dina (Adeza karA have) phira‘Aunera sampradAYake kaThinatama zAstite praveza karAo|

evaM sei samaYake smaraNa rAkha, yakhana tArA jAhAnnAme eke anyera saGge jhagar3A karave| sutarAM (duniYAra) durvalagaNa AtmagarvIderake valave, AmarA to tomAdera anugAmI chilAma| tA tomarA ki AmAdera theke Agunera kichu aMza pratihata karave?
yArA AtmagarvI chila tArA valave, AmarA sakalei jAhAnnAme Achi| AllAha vAndAdera madhye phAYasAlA kare phelechena|
yArA Agunera bhetara thAkave, tArA jAhAnnAmera praharIderake valave, tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera kAche duA kara, tini yena AmAdera eka dinera zAsti lAghava karena|

tArA valave, tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe Aseni? jAhAnnAmIgaNa valave, avazyai (tArA ekera para eka esechila)| tArA valave, tAhale tomarAi duA kara| Ara kApheradera duA to nisphalai haYe yAYa|
nizcaYai Ami AmAra rAsUlagaNake evaM muminaderake pArthiva jIvaneo sAhAyya kari evaM sei dinao karava, ye dina sAkSIgaNa dA~r3iYe yAve
ye dina jAlemadera ojara-Apatti kona kAje Asave nA| tAdera janya raYeche lAnata evaM tAdera janya Ache nikRSTa nivAsa|
Ami mUsAke dAna karechilAma pathanirdeza Ara vanI isarAIlake karechilAma sei kitAvera oYAriza
yA vodhazaktisampannadera janya chila hedAYAta o nasIhata|

sutarAM (he rAsUla!) savara avalamvana kara| nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya evaM nija truTira janya kSamA prArthanA kara evaM sakAla o sandhyAYa nija pratipAlakera prazaMsAra sAthe tAsavIha pATha karate thAka|

nizcaYai yArA AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka sRSTi kare, athaca tAdera kAche (tAdera dAvira sapakSe) kona pramANa Aseni, tAdera antare ahamikA chAr3A Ara kichui nei, yAte tArA kakhanao saphala haoYAra naYa| sutarAM tumi AllAhara kAche AzraYa cAo| nizcaYa tinii sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
nizcaYai mAnava sRSTi apekSA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi vezi kaThina, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (etaTuku kathAo) vojhe nA|
andha o cakSuSmAna samAna naYa evaM tArAo nA, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche evaM yArA asatkarmazIla| (kintu) tomarA khuva kamai anudhAvana kara|
kiYAmatakAla avazyai Asave, tAte kona sandehera avakAza nei| kintu adhikAMza loka ImAna Ane nA|
tomAdera pratipAlaka valechena, AmAke DAka| Ami tomAdera DAke sAr3A deva| nizcaYai ahaMkAravaze yArA AmAra ivAdata theke mukha phiriYe neYa, tArA lAJchita haYe jAhAnnAme praveza karave|

AllAhai to, yini tomAdera janya rAta sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA tAte vizrAma grahaNa karate pAra Ara dinake vAniYechena dekhAra janya| vastuta AllAha mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza loka zokara AdAYa kare nA|
tinii AllAha, yini tomAdera pratipAlaka, pratiTi jinisera sraSTA| tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| sutarAM kothA hate kona vastu tomAderake vipathagAmI karache?
emanibhAve (pUrve) yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karata, tArAo vipathagAmI haYechila|

AllAhai to, yini tomAdera janya pRthivIke karechena avasthAnasthala evaM AkAzake karechena (u~cu gamvujasvarUpa) eka chAda evaM tomAdera AkRtike karechena sundara Ara utkRSTa vastu hate tomAderake riyaka dAna karechena| tinii AllAha, yini tomAdera pratipAlaka| tini ati varakatamaYa, jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
tini ciraJjIva| tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| sutarAM tomarA tA~ke DAka, tA~ra janya Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe| samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|

(he rAsUla! kApheraderake) vale dAo, tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka tAdera ivAdata karate AmAke niSedha kare deoYA haYeche yakhana AmAra kAche AmAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI ese geche| Ara AmAke Adeza karA haYeche, Ami yena jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera sAmane Anugatya svIkAra kari|

tinii to tomAderake sRSTi karechena mATi hate, tArapara zukravindu hate, tArapara jamATa rakta hate| tArapara tini tomAderake zizurUpe vera karena tArapara (tomAderake pratipAlana karena,) yAte tomarA upanIta hao pUrNa valavattAYa tArapara hao vRddha| tomAdera madhye kataka emanao Ache, yArA tAra Agei mArA yAYa evaM yAte tomarA eka nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta peৗ~cha evaM yAte tomarA vuddhike kAje lAgAo|
tinii jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna evaM tini yakhana konao viSaYe phAYasAlA karena, takhana kevala valena, ‘haYe yAo’, amani tA haYe yAYa|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhe vitarka sRSTi kare? ke kothA hate tAdera mukha phiriYe deYa?
erAi tArA, yArA asvIkAra kareche e kitAva evaM AmAra rAsUlagaNake yA saha preraNa karechilAma tAo| sutarAM tArA acirei jAnate pArave|
yakhana tAdera galAYa thAkave ver3i o zikala, tAderake he~car3Ano have,
garama pAnite, tArapara Agune dagdha karA have|
tArapara tAderake valA have, kothAYa, yAderake tomarA (tA~ra prabhutve) zarIka karate?
AllAha chAr3A tArA (arthAt tomAdera sei mAvudagaNa), tArA valave, tArA to AmAdera theke adRzya haYe geche; varaM pUrve AmarA kona kichuke DAkatAmai nA| ebhAve AllAha kApheraderake vibhrAnta karena|
esava haYeche e kAraNe ye, pRthivIte tomarA anyAYa viSaYa niYe ullAsa karate evaM e kAraNe ye, tomarA ahamikA dekhAte|
yAo, jAhAnnAmera darajA diYe praveza kara, tAte sthAYIbhAve thAkAra janya| kenanA ahaMkArIdera ThikAnA var3ai manda|

sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi savara avalamvana kara| nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya| Ami tAderake (arthAt kApheraderake) yAra (arthAt ye zAstira) bhaYa dekhAcchi, Ami tAra kichuTA tomAke (tomAra jIvane) dekhiYe dei athavA (tAra Agei) tomAke duniYA theke tule nei, sarvAvasthAYa tAderake AmAra kAchei phiriYe AnA have|

vastuta Ami tomAra pUrveo vahu rAsUla pAThiYechi| tAdera madhye kataka emana, yAdera katipaYera vRttAnta Ami tomAke jAniYe diYechi Ara kataka emana yAdera vRttAnta tomAke jAnAini| kona rAsUlera ei ekhatiYAra nei ye, se AllAhara icchA chAr3A kona mujiyA peza karave| ataHpara yakhana AllAhara Adeza Asave, takhana nyAYasaGgatabhAve phAYasAlA haYe yAve| Ara mithyAra anusArIrA takhana mArAtmakabhAve kSatigrasta have|
tinii AllAha, yini tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena catuSpada jantu, yAte tAra katake tomarA ArohaNa kara| Ara kataka tomarA khAo|

Ara tAte Ache tomAdera pracura upakAra evaM tAra uddezya eTAo ye, tomAdera antare (kothAo yAoYAra) ye praYojana Ache, tA pUraNa karate pAra| Ara tomAderake sei sava pazute evaM nauyAne car3iYe niYe yAoYA haYa|
AllAha tomAderake nija nidarzanAvalI dekhiYe thAkena| sutarAM tomarA kona kona nidarzana asvIkAra karave?

tave ki tArA bhUmite vicaraNa kare dekheni, tAdera pUrve yArA chila tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche? tArA saMkhyAYa tAdera ceYe vezi chila evaM zaktite o pRthivIte rekhe yAoYA kIrtiteo tAdera upare chila| tA sattveo tArA yA arjana karata tA tAdera kona kAje Aseni|

sutarAM tAdera rAsUlagaNa yakhana tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe Asala, takhanao tArA tAdera kAche ye jJAna chila tArai var3Ai karate lAgala| phale tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tAi tAderake pariveSTana kare phelala|
anantara tArA yakhana AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala, takhana valala, AmarA eka AllAhara upara ImAna AnalAma Ara AmarA yAderake AllAhara zarIka karatAma tAderake asvIkAra karalAma|

kintu tArA yakhana AmAra AyAva dekhe phelala, takhana Ara tAdera ImAna tAdera kona upakAre AsAra chila nA| jene rekha, eTAi AllAhara rIti, yA tAra vAndAdera madhye pUrva theke cale Asache| Ara sekSetre kApheragaNa haYeche kSatigrasta|
hA-mIma|
e vANI sei sattAra pakSa hate avatIrNa, yini sakalera prati daYAvAna, parama daYAlu|
AravI kuraAnarUpe eTi emana kitAva, jJAna arjanakArIdera janya yAra AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta haYeche|
yA avatIrNa susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe| tA sattveo tAdera adhikAMzai mukha phiriYe rekheche| phale tArA zunate pAYa nA|

(rAsUla sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAmake) tArA vale, tumi AmAderake yAra dike DAkacha, se viSaYe AmAdera antara gilAphe DhAkA, AmAdera kAna vadhira evaM AmAdera o tomAra mAjhakhAne Ache eka antarAla| sutarAM tumi Apana kAja karate thAka AmarA AmAdera kAja karachi|

(he rAsUla!) vale dAo, Ami to tomAderai mata ekajana mAnuSa| (avazya) AmAra prati ohI nAyila haYa ye, tomAdera mAvuda ekai mAvuda| sutarAM tomarA tA~rai abhimukhI thAka evaM tA~rai kAche kSamA prArthanA kara| dhvaMsa muzarikadera janya
yArA yAkAta AdAYa kare nA| AvAra tArA AkherAtera prati sampUrNa avizvAsI|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tAdera janya Ache niravacchinna puraskAra|
vale dAo, satyii ki tomarA sei sattAra sAthe kupharI panthA avalamvana karacha, yini pRthivI sRSTi karechena du’dine evaM tAra sAthe anyake zarIka karacha? tini to jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka!

tini bhUmite sRSTi karechena avicalita pAhAr3a, yA tAra upara utthita raYeche| Ara tAte diYechena varakata evaM tAte tAra khAdya sRSTi karechena suSamabhAve (savakichui) cAradine sakala yAcanAkArIra janya samAna|
tArapara tini AkAzera dike manoyoga dAna karalena, yA chila dheA~YA rUpe| tini tAke o pRthivIke valalena, tomarA cale eso icchAYa vA anicchAYa| ubhaYe valala, AmarA icchAkramei AsalAma|

ataHpara tini nija phAYasAlA anuyAYI du’dine tAke sAta AkAze pariNata karalena evaM prati AkAze tAra upayogI Adeza preraNa karalena| Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake pradIpamAlA dvArA sAjiYechi evaM tAke karechi surakSita| eTA parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa (AllAha)-era parimita vyavasthApanA|
tAraparao yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave vale dAo, Ami tomAderake satarka karechi temani vajra samparke, yemana vajra avatIrNa haYechila Ada o chAmUda (jAti)-era upara|

eTA sei samaYera kathA, yakhana tAdera kAche rAsUlagaNa esechila (kakhanao) tAdera sammukha dika theke evaM (kakhanao) tAdera pichana dika theke, ei vArtA niYe ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karo nA| tArA valechila, AmAdera pratipAlaka cAile pherezatAderake pAThAtena| sutarAM tomAderake ye viSaYasaha pAThAno haYeche AmarA tA mAnate asvIkAra karachi|

ataHpara Adera ghaTanA to ei ghaTala ye, tArA pRthivIte anyAYa dambha pradarzana karate lAgala evaM valala, zaktite AmAdera upare ke Ache? tave ki tArA anudhAvana karala nA ye, yei AllAha tAderake sRSTi karechena zaktite tini tAdera aneka upare? Ara tArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karate thAkala|

sutarAM Ami azubha kataka dine tAdera upara pAThAlAma pracaNDa jhar3o hAoYA, tAderake pArthiva jIvane lAJchanAdAYaka zAstira svAda grahaNa karAnora janya| Ara AkherAtera zAsti to Arao vezi lAJchanAkara evaM tArA pAve nA kona sAhAyya|

Ara chAmUdera ghaTanA hala Ami tAderake sarala patha dekhiYechilAma, kintu tArA sarala patha avalamvanera ceYe vibhrAnta thAkAkei vezi pachanda karala| sutarAM tArA yA arjana karechila tAra phale tAderake AghAta hAnala lAJchanAdAYaka zAstira vajra|
apara dike yArA ImAna enechila o tAkaoYA avalamvana karechila, Ami tAderake rakSA karalAma|
sei dinake smaraNa rAkha, ye dina AllAhara zatruderake ekatra kare Agunera dike niYe yAoYA have Ara tAderake vibhinna dale vibhakta karA have|
avazeSe yakhana tArA tAra (arthAt Agunera) kAche peৗ~chave, takhana tAdera kAna, tAdera cokha o tAdera cAmar3A tAdera kRtakarma samparke tAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve|

tArA tAdera cAmar3Ake valave, tomarA AmAdera viruddhe sAkSya dile kena? tArA valave, AllAha AmAderake vAkazakti dAna karechena, yini vAkazakti dAna karechena pratiTi jinisake| tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena prathamavAra Ara tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA hacche|

evaM (gonAha karAra samaYa) tomarA to tomAdera viruddhe tomAdera kAna, cokha o cAmar3Ara sAkSyadAna theke Atmagopana karate sakSama chile nA| varaM tomAdera dhAraNA chila AllAha tomAdera karmera vahu kichui jAnena nA|
Apana pratipAlaka samparke tomAdera e dhAraNAi tomAderake dhvaMsa kareche| pariNAme tomarA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYecha|
ekhana tArA dhairya dhAraNa karaleo jAhAnnAmai have tAdera ThikAnA Ara yadi ajuhAta pradarzana kare, tave yAdera ajuhAta gRhIta have, tAdera antarbhukta ederake karA have nA|

Ami (duniYAYa) tAdera pechane kichu sahacara lAgiYe diYechilAma, yArA tAdera sammukha o pichanera samasta kAjake tAdera dRSTite zobhana kare diYechila| phale tAdera pUrve ativAhita jinna o mAnava jAtisamUhera antarbhuktarUpe tAdera uparao (zAstira) kathA satye pariNata haYeche| nizcaYai tArA chila kSatigrasta|
evaM kApheragaNa (eke anyake) vale, ei kuraAna zuno nA evaM era (pAThera) mAjhe haTTagola kara, yAte tomarA jaYI thAka|
sutarAM oi kApheraderake Ami kaThina zAstira svAda grahaNa karAva evaM tArA (duniYAYa) ye nikRSTa kAja karata, tAra paripUrNa pratiphala deva|
AgunarUpe eTAi AllAhara zatrudera zAsti| tArai madhye have tAdera sthAYI ThikAnA, AmAra AYAtasamUhake ye tArA asvIkAra karata tAra pratiphalasvarUpa|

kApheragaNa valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ye sakala jina o mAnuSa AmAderake vipathagAmI karechila tAderake AmAdera dekhiYe dAo| AmarA tAderake AmAdera pAYera nice rekhe emanabhAve dalita karava, yAte tArA carama lAJchita haYa|

(apara dike) yArA valeche, AmAdera ravva AllAha! tArapara tArA tAte thAke avicalita, nizcaYai tAdera kAche pherezatA avatIrNa have (evaM valave) ye, tomarA kona bhaYa karo nA evaM kona kichura janya cintita haYo nA Ara Anandita haYe yAo sei jAnnAtera janya, yAra oYAdA tomAderake deoYA hata|

AmarA pArthiva jIvaneo tomAdera sAthI chilAma evaM AkherAteo thAkava| jAnnAte tomAdera janya Ache emana sava kichui, yA tomAdera antara cAve evaM sekhAne tomAdera janya Ache emana sava kichui yAra pharamAYeza tomarA karave,
ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu (AllAha)-era pakSa hate prAthamika AtitheYatAsvarUpa|
tAra ceYe uttama kathA Ara kAra hate pAre, ye AllAhara dike DAke, satkarma kare evaM vale, Ami Anugatya svIkArakArIdera ekajana|
bhAlo o manda samAna haYa nA| tumi mandake pratihata kara emana panthAYa, yA have utkRSTa| phale yAra o tomAra madhye zatrutA chila, se sahasAi haYe yAve tomAra antaraGga vandhu|
Ara e guNa kevala tAderakei dAna karA haYa, yArA savara kare evaM e guNa kevala tAderakei dAna karA haYa yArA mahAbhAgyavAna|
yadi zaYatAnera pakSa theke tomAra kakhanao kona kheA~cA lAge, tave (vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke) AllAhara AzraYa grahaNa karo| nizcaYai tini sakala kathAra zrotA, sakala viSaYera jJAtA|

tA~rai nidarzanAvalIra antarbhukta hala rAta, dina, sUrya o candra| tomarA sUryake sijadA karo nA evaM candrakeo nA| varaM sijadA karo AllAhake, yini eguloke sRSTi karechena yadi vAstavikai tomarA tA~ra ivAdata kare thAka|

tAraparao yadi tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa) ahamikA pradarzana kare, tave (tA karate thAkuka) tomAra pratipAlakera kAche yArA (arthAt yei pherezatAgaNa) Ache, tArA rAta-dina tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kare evaM tArA klAnti vodha kare nA|

tA~ra ArekaTi nidarzana hala, tumi bhUmike zuSkarUpe dekhate pAo, tArapara yakhana Ami tAte vAri varSaNa kari, amani tA Alor3ita haYa o ver3e oThe| vastuta yini bhUmite prANa saJcAra karena, tinii mRtaderakeo jIvita karavena| nizcaYai tini sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

AmAra AYAtasamUhera vyApAre yArA vA~kA patha avalamvana kare, tArA AmAra agocara naYa| AcchA valato, ye vyaktike Agune nikSepa karA have, se uttama, nA sei vyakti, ye kiYAmatera dina upasthita have nirbhaYe-nirApade? tomarA yA icchA kare nAo| jene rekha, tomarA yA karacha tini savai dekhachena|
yArA upadezavANI (kuraAna)-ke asvIkAra kareche tAdera kAche tA AsAra para (tArA nehAt manda kAja kareche), athaca eTi ati maryAdApUrNa kitAva|
kona mithyA era paryanta peৗ~chate pAre nA, nA era sammukha dika theke evaM nA era pechana theke| eTA prajJAmaYa, prazaMsArha (AllAha)-era pakSa theke avatIrNa|
(he rAsUla!) tomAke to sesava kathAi valA hacche, yA tomAra pUrvavartI rAsUlagaNake valA haYechila| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka kSamAzIla evaM marmantuda zAstidAtA|

Ami yadi e kuraAnake anAravI kuraAna vAnAtAma, tave tArA avazyai valata, era AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAve varNanA karA hala nA kena? eTA kemana kathA ye, kuraAna anAravI evaM rAsUla AravI? vala, yArA ImAna Ane tAdera janya eTA hedAYAta o upazamera vyavasthA| Ara yArA ImAna Ane nA, tAdera kAne chipi lAgAno Ache| tAdera janya eTA (arthAt kuraAna) vibhrAntira kAraNa| erUpa lokaderake vahu dUra-dUrAnta hate DAkA hacche|

. Ami mUsAkeo kitAva diYechilAma| tArapara tAteo matabheda haYechila| tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate ekaTi kathA pUrva thekei sthirIkRta nA thAkale tAdera vyApAre cukiYe deoYA hata| prakRtapakSe tArA vibhrAntikara sandehe nipatita|
. keu satkarma karale tA nijerai kalyANArthe kare Ara keu asat kAja karale, tAra kSatio tAra nijerai| tomAra pratipAlaka vAndAdera prati juluma karena nA|

kiYAmatera jJAna tArai dike pherAno haYa| AllAhara ajJAtasAre kona phala tAra AvaraNa theke vera haYa nA evaM kona nArI garbha dhAraNa kare nA evaM santAna prasavao kare nA| ye dina tini tAderake (arthAt muzarikaderake) Deke valavena, kothAYa AmAra sei zarIkagaNa? tArA valave, AmarA ApanAra kAche Araja karachi ye, AmAdera madhye ekhana keu e kathAra sAkSI naYa (ye, ApanAra kona zarIka Ache)|
pUrve tArA yAderake (arthAt yei mithyA upAsyaderake) DAkata ekhana Ara tArA tAdera kona hadisa pAve nA| tArA upalavdhi karave ye, tAdera Ara niSkRti nei|
mAnuSa maGgala prArthanAYa klAnta haYa nA| Ara tAke yadi kona amaGgala sparza kare, takhana carama hatAza haYe par3e, sava AzA cher3e deYa|

tAke ye duHkha-kaSTa sparza karechila, tArapara yadi Ami AmAra pakSa hate tAke rahamatera svAda grahaNa karAi, takhana se avazyai valave, eTA to AmAra prApya chila evaM Ami mane kari nA ye, kiYAmata saMghaTita have| Ara AmAke yadi AmAra ravvera kAche phiriYe neoYAo haYa, tave AmAra vizvAsa tA~ra kAcheo AmAra kalyANai lAbha have| Ami kApheraderake avazyai avahita karava, tArA yA-kichu kareche evaM tAderake avazyai kaThora zAstira svAda grahaNa karAva|

Ami mAnuSera prati yakhana kona anugraha kari, takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa o pArzva parivartana kare dUre sare yAYa| AvAra tAke yakhana kona amaGgala sparza kare, takhana se lamvA-caor3A duAkArI haYe yAYa|

(he rAsUla! kApheraderake) vale dAo, tomarA bheve dekhecha ki e kuraAna yadi AllAhara pakSa theke ese thAke, tAraparao tomarA eTAke asvIkAra kara, tave ye vyakti (era) ghora viruddhAcaraNe lipta thAke, tAra ceYe vezi vibhrAnta Ara ke hate pAre?

Ami AmAra nidarzanAvalI tAderake dekhAva vizvajagateo evaM khoda tAdera astitvera bhetarao, yAte tAdera kAche spaSTa haYe yAYa ye, eTAi satya| tomAra pratipAlakera ekathA ki yatheSTa naYa ye, tini sakala viSaYera sAkSI?
jene rekha, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera sAkSAta samparke sandehe par3e Ache| jene rekha, tini avazyai pratiTi vastuke veSTana kare Achena|
hA-mIma|
Aina-sIna-kApha|
(he rAsUla!) parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAha ebhAvei ohI nAyila karena tomAra prati evaM tomAra pUrvavartI (rAsUlagaNa)-era prati|
yA-kichu Ache AkAzamaNDalIte evaM yA-kichu Ache pRthivIte tA tA~rai| tinii samucca, maryAdAvAna|

AkAzamaNDalI upara theke bheGge par3Ara upakrama haYa, pherezatAgaNa tAdera pratipAlakera prazaMsAra sAthe tAsavIha pATha kare evaM pRthivIvAsIra janya isatigaphAra kare| mane rekha, AllAhai ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA tAke chAr3A anyake abhibhAvaka vAniYe niYeche, AllAha tAdera upara satarka dRSTi rAkhachena| Ara tumi nao tAdera yimmAdAra|

ebhAvei Ami tomAra upara nAyila karechi AravI kuraAna, yAte tumi satarka kara kendrIYa janapada (makkA) o tAra AzapAzera mAnuSake evaM satarka kara sei dina samparke, ye dina sakalake ekatra karA have, ye vyApAre kona sandeha nei| ekadala yAve jAnnAte evaM ekadala prajvlita Agune|
AllAha cAile tAdera sakalake ekai dala vAnAte pAratena| kintu tini yAke cAna nija rahamatera bhetara dAkhila karena| Ara yArA jAlema tAdera nei kona abhibhAvaka, nA kona sAhAyyakArI|
tArA ki tA~ke cher3e anya abhibhAvaka grahaNa kareche? prakRtapakSe AllAhai to abhibhAvaka| tinii mRtaderake jIvita karena evaM tini sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna|
tomarA ye viSaYei matabheda kara tAra mImAMsA AllAharai upara nyasta| tinii AllAha, yini AmAra pratipAlaka| Ami tA~rai upara bharasA karechi evaM Ami tA~rai abhimukhI haYechi|

tini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA| tini tomAderai madhya hate tomAdera janya jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM catuSpada jantudera madhyeo sRSTi karechena jor3A| era mAdhyame tini tomAdera vaMza vistAra karena| konao jinisa naYa tAra anurUpa| tinii sava kathA zonena, savakichu dekhena|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra samasta kuJji tA~rai hAte| tini yAra janya icche karena riyaka prazasta kare dena evaM (yAra janya cAna) saMkIrNa kare dena| nizcaYai tini savakichura jJAtA|

tini tomAdera janya dInera sei panthAi sthira karechena, yAra hukuma diYechilena tini nUhake evaM (he rAsUla!) yA Ami ohIra mAdhyame tomAra kAche pAThiYechi evaM yAra hukuma diYechilAma ivarAhIma, mUsA o IsAke ye, tomarA dIna kAYema kara evaM tAte vibheda sRSTi karo nA| (tA sattveo) tumi muzarikaderake ye dike DAkacha tA tAdera kAche atyanta kaThina mane haYa| AllAha yAke cAna veche niYe nijera dike TAnena| Ara ye-keu tAra abhimukhI haYa tAke nijera kAche peৗ~che dena|

evaM mAnuSa tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra parai kevala pArasparika zatrutAra kAraNe (dInera bhetara) vibheda sRSTi kareche| tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate yadi ekaTi kathA nirdiSTa meYAdera janya pUrvei sthirIkRta nA thAkata, tave tAdera viSaYe phAYasAlA haYe yeta| tAdera para yAderake kitAvera oYAriza vAnAno haYeche, tArA e samparke vibhrAntikara sandehe par3e Ache|

sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi oi viSaYera dikei mAnuSake DAkate thAka evaM tumi avicalita thAka (e dInera upara), yemana tomAke Adeza karA haYeche| Ara tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa karo nA| vale dAo, Ami to AllAha ye kitAva nAyila karechena tAra prati ImAna enechi Ara AmAke tomAdera madhye inasApha karate Adeza karA haYeche| AllAha AmAdera ravva evaM tomAderao ravva| AmAdera karma AmAdera evaM tomAdera karma tomAdera| AmAdera o tomAdera madhye (ekhana) kona vitarka nei| AllAha AmAdera sakalake ekatra karavena evaM zeSa paryanta tA~rai kAche sakalake phire yete have|
yArA AllAha samparke vitarka sRSTi kare, loke tA~ra kathA mene neoYAra parao, tAdera vitarka tAdera pratipAlakera kAche vAtila| tAdera upara (AllAhara) gajava evaM tAdera janya Ache kaThina zAsti|
tinii AllAha, yini satya samvalita e kitAva o nyAYera tulAdaNDa avatIrNa karechena| tumi kI jAna, kiYAmata haYata nikaTei|

yArA tAte ImAna rAkhe nA, tArAi tAra janya tAr3Ahur3A kare| Ara yArA ImAna eneche tArA tAra vyApAre bhIta thAke evaM tArA jAne tA satya| jene rekha, yArA kiYAmata samparke vitarka kare, tArA ghora gomarAhIte patita|
AllAha nija vAndAdera prati ati daYAlu| tini yAke cAna riyaka dAna karena evaM tinii zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

ye vyakti AkherAtera phasala kAmanA kare, tAra janya Ami tAra phasala vAr3iYe dei| Ara ye vyakti (kevala) duniYAra phasala kAmanA kare, tAke Ami tA thekei khAnikaTA dAna kari| AkherAte tAra kona aMza nei|

tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) ki emana zarIka Ache, yArA tAdera janya emana dIna sthira kare diYeche, yAra anumati AllAha denani? (AllAhara pakSa hate) yadi mImAMsAkara vANI sthirIkRta nA thAkata tave tAdera vyApAraTA cukiYei deoYA hata| avazyai jAlemadera janya Ache yantraNAmaYa zAsti|

(takhana) jAlemaderake dekhave, tArA yA arjana kareche tAra (pariNAmera) vyApAre zaGkita thAkave| Ara tA to tAdera upara Apatita havei| yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tArA thAkave jAnnAtera keYArite| tArA tAdera pratipAlakera kAche yA cAve tAi pAve| eTAi virATa anugraha|

erai susaMvAda AllAha tAra sei sakala vAndAke dAna karena, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche| (he rAsUla! kApheraderake) vale dAo, Ami era (arthAt tAvalIgera) vinimaYe tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA AtmIYera sauhArdya chAr3A| ye-keu satkarma karave Ami tAra janya se satkarme atirikta saundarya vRddhi karava| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, atyanta guNagrAhI|

tave ki tArA vale, se AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kareche? athaca AllAha cAile tomAra antare mohara kare dite pArena| AllAha to mithyAke miTiYe dena o satyake nija vANIra dvArA pratiSThita karena| nizcaYai tini antare lukAYita viSaYAvalIo jAnena|
evaM tinii nija vAndAdera tAovA kavula karena o gunAhasamUha kSamA kare dena| Ara tomarA yA-kichu kara tA tini jAnena|
yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tAdera duA tini zonena evaM nija anugrahe tAderake Arao vezi dAna karena| Ara kApheradera janya Ache kaThina zAsti|

AllAha yadi tAra samasta vAndAra janya riyakake vistAra kare ditena, tave pRthivIte tArA tAra avAdhyatAYa lipta hata, kintu tini ye parimANe icchA tA avatIrNa kare thAkena| nizcaYai tini nija vAndAdera samparke paripUrNarUpe jAnena, tAdera prati dRSTi rAkhena|
tinii mAnuSa hatAza haYe yAoYAra para vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM nija rahamata vistAra karena| tinii (sakalera) prazaMsAyogya abhibhAvaka|
tA~ra anyatama nidarzana hala AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRjana evaM sei sakala jIvajantu yA tini e du’Yera madhye char3iYe diYechena| tini yakhana icchA takhanai ederake samaveta karate sakSama|
tomAdera ye vipada dekhA deYa, tA tomAdera nija hAtera kRtakarmerai kAraNe dekhA deYa| Ara tini tomAdera aneka kichui (aparAdha) kSamA kare dena|
pRthivIte (AllAhake) vyartha kare deoYAra kSamatA tomAdera nei evaM AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei, nei sAhAyyakArIo|
tA~ra anyatama nidarzana hala sAgare (vicaraNakArI) parvata pramANa jAhAja|
tini cAile vAYuke stavdha kare dite pArena| phale samudrapRSThe tA ThAYa dA~r3iYe thAkave| nizcaYai era madhye nidarzana Ache pratyeka dhairyazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira janya|
kiMvA (AllAha cAile) mAnuSera kona kona kRtakarmera kAraNe jAhAjaguloke vidhvasta kare dite pArena evaM pArena anekake kSamAo karate|
evaM yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe vitarka sRSTi kare, tArA vujhate pArata, tAdera janya niSkRtira kona sthAna nei|
tomAderake yA-kichu deoYA haYeche, tA pArthiva jIvanera bhoga| AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA aneka zreYa o sthAYI tAdera janya, yArA ImAna eneche o nija pratipAlakera upara bharasA rAkhe|
evaM yArA var3a var3a gunAha o azlIla karma parihAra kare evaM yakhana tAdera krodha dekhA deYa, takhana kSamA pradarzana kare|

evaM yArA tAdera pratipAlakera DAke sAr3A diYeche, nAmAya kAYema kareche evaM yAdera kAjakarma pArasparika parAmarzakrame sampanna haYa evaM Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tA theke (satkarme) vyaYa kare|
evaM yakhana tAdera prati kona juluma karA haYa takhana tArA tA pratihata kare|
mandera vadalA anurUpa manda| tave ye kSamA kare deYa o saMzodhanera ceSTA kare, tAra saoYAva AllAhara yimmAYa| nizcaYai tini jAlemaderake pachanda karena nA|
yArA nijedera upara juluma haoYAra para (samaparimANe) vadalA neYa, tAdera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei|
abhiyoga to tAdera viruddhe, yArA mAnuSera upara juluma kare o pRthivIte anyAYabhAve vidroha kare ver3AYa| erUpa lokadera janya Ache yantraNAmaYa zAsti|
prakRtapakSe ye savara avalamvana kare o kSamA pradarzana kare, to eTA avazyai atyanta himmatera kAja|
AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena, tArapara tAra kono abhibhAvaka nei| jAlemagaNa yakhana zAsti pratyakSa karave, takhana tumi tAderake valate dekhave, phire yAoYAra ki kona patha Ache?

tumi tAderake dekhave, tAderake jAhAnnAmera sAmane ebhAve peza karA have ye, tArA apamAne avanata avasthAYa asphuTa cokhe tAkAcche| Ara muminagaNa valave, vAstavikai satyikArera kSatigrasta tArAi, yArA kiYAmatera dine nijederake evaM parivAravargake kSatira sammukhIna kareche| mane rekha, jAlemagaNa sthAYI AyAvera bhetara thAkave|
tArA emana kona abhibhAvaka pAve nA, yArA AllAhara viparIte tAdera kona sAhAyya karate pArave| Ara AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena, tAra (niSkRtira) kona patha thAke nA|

(he mAnuSa!) tomAdera pratipAlakera DAke sAr3A dAo sei dina AsAra Agei, yA AllAhara pakSa theke rada karA yAve nA| se dina tomAdera kona AzraYasthala thAkave nA evaM tomAdera kona Apattirao suyoga thAkave nA|

(he rAsUla!) tathApi yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave Ami tomAke to tAdera tattvAvadhAYaka kare pAThAini| (vANI) peৗ~chAno chAr3A tomAra kona dAYitva nei evaM (mAnuSera avasthA hala) Ami yakhana mAnuSake AmAra pakSa theke kona anugrahera svAda grahaNa karAi, takhana tArA tAte utphulla haYe oThe AvAra yakhana tAdera nijedera hAtera kAmAiYera kAraNe tAdera kona vipada dekhA deYa, takhana sei mAnuSai ghora akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra rAjatva AllAharai| tini yA cAna sRSTi karena| yAke cAna kanyA dena evaM yAke cAna putra dena|
athavA putra o kanyA ubhaYa miliYe dena| AvAra yAke icchA vandhyA kare dena| nizcaYai tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|
