kona mAnuSera e yogyatA nei ye, AllAha tAra sAthe kathA valavena (sAmanA sAmani), tave ohIra mAdhyame (valate pArena) athavA kona pardAra Ar3Ala theke kiMvA tini kona vArtAvAhI (pherezatA) pAThiYe devena, ye tA~ra nirdeze tini yA cAna sei ohIra vArtA peৗ~che deve| nizcaYai tini ati ucca maryAdAsampanna, prajJAmaYa|

ebhAvei Ami AmAra nirdeze tomAra prati ohIrUpe nAyila karechi eka rUha| itaHpUrve tumi jAnate nA kitAva kI evaM (jAnate) nA ImAna| kintu Ami eke (arthAt kuraAnake) vAniYechi eka nUra, yAra mAdhyame Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhya hate yAke cAi hedAYAta dAna kari| nizcaYai tumi mAnuSake dekhAccha hedAYAtera sei sarala patha
yA AllAhara patha, yAra mAlikAnAYa raYeche AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache savai| jene rekha, yAvatIYa viSaYa zeSa paryanta AllAharai kAche phirave|
hA-mIma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera|
Ami eke vAniYechi AravI kuraAna, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
prakRtapakSe eTA AmAra nikaTa mUla granthe (arthAt lAohe mAhaphuje) ucca maryAdAsampanna, hekamata- pUrNa kitAva|
Ami ki vimukha haYe tomAdera theke e kitAva pratyAhAra kare neva e kAraNe ye, tomarA eka sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa?
Ami to pUrvavartIdera mAjheo kata navI pAThiYechi!
tAdera kAche emana kona navI Aseni, yAke tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata nA|
ataHpara yArA edera (arthAt makkAvAsIdera) apekSA vezi zaktizAlI chila| tAderake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi| Ara sei pUrvavartIdera avasthA to gata haYeche|
tumi yadi tAderake (muzarikaderake) jijJesa kara, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI ke sRSTi kareche, tave tArA avazyai valave, egulo sRSTi karechena sei parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa (AllAha)|
yini tomAdera janya bhUmike vAniYechena vichAnA evaM tomAdera janya tAte vibhinna patha sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA gantavyasthale peৗ~chate pAra|
yini AsamAna theke vAri varSaNa karena parimitabhAve| tArapara Ami tAra mAdhyame eka mRta aJcalake natuna jIvana dAna kari| ebhAvei tomAderake (kavara theke) vera kare natuna jIvana dAna) karA have|
evaM yini sarvaprakAra jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janya nauyAna o catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA Arohana kare thAka|

yAte tomarA tAra piThe car3ate pAra, tArapara yakhana tomarA tAte car3e vasa, takhana tomAdera pratipAlakera ni‘Amata smaraNa kara evaM vala, pavitra sei sattA, yini ei vAhanake AmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena| anyathAYa eke vazIbhUta karAra kSamatA AmAdera chila nA|
nizcaYai AmAderake AmAdera pratipAlakera kAche phire yete have|
evaM tArA (arthAt muzarikagaNa) tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke tA~ra aMza (arthAt santAna) sthira kare niYeche| nizcaYai mAnuSa prakAzya akRtajJa|
tave ki AllAha Apana mAkhalukera madhya hate nijera janya kanyA veche niYechena Ara tomAdera janya pachanda karechena putra?

athaca tAdera kAuke yakhana tAra (arthAt kanyA janmera) susaMvAda deoYA haYa, yAke tArA daYAmaYa AllAhara prati Aropa kare rekheche, takhana tAra cehArA malina haYe yAYa evaM se mane mane tApita hate thAke|
tAchAr3A (AllAha ki emana santAna pachanda karechena) ye alaMkArera bhetara lAlita-pAlita haYa evaM ye tarka-vitarke nijera kathA khule valate pAre nA?
adhikantu tArA pherezatAderake, yArA kinA AllAhara vAndA, nArI gaNya kareche| tave ki tAdera sRjanakAle tArA upasthita chila? tAdera e dAvi lipivaddha karA have evaM tAderake jijJAsAvAda karA have|
evaM tArA vale, daYAmaYa AllAha cAile AmarA tAdera (pherezatAdera) ivAdata karatAma nA| tAdera e samparke kona jJAnai nei| tAdera kAja kevala anumAne Dhila cheA~r3A|
Ami ki era Age tAderake kona kitAva diYechilAma, yA tArA A~kar3e dhare Ache?
nA, varaM tArA vale, AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake ekaTA matAdarzera anusArI peYechi| AmarA tAdera padachApa dhare saThika pathei calachi|

evaM (he rAsUla!) Ami tomAra pUrve yakhanai kona janapade kona satarkakArI (rAsUla) pAThiYechi, takhana sekhAnakAra vittavAnerA ekathAi valeche ye, AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake ekaTA matAdarzera anusArI peYechi| AmarA tAderai padachApa anusaraNa kare calachi|

navI valala, tomarA tomAdera vApa- dAdAderake ye matAdarzera upara peYecha, Ami yadi tomAdera kAche tAra ceYe utkRSTa hedAYAtera vANI niYe Asi (tavuo ki tomarA sei matAdarzai anusaraNa karave)? tArA uttara dila, tomAderake ye vANIsaha pAThAno haYeche, AmarA tA asvIkAra kari|
phale Ami tAderake zAsti dAna karalAma| sutarAM dekhe nAo, avizvAsIdera pariNAma kemana haYeche?
sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana ivarAhIma tAra pitA o tAra sampradAYake valechila, tomarA yAdera ivAdata kara, tAdera sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei,
sei sattA vyatireke, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tinii AmAke patha dekhAna|
ivarAhIma e vizvAsake emanai eka vANI vAniYe dila, yA tAra AolAdera madhye sthAYI haYe thAkala, yAte mAnuSa (ziraka theke) phire Ase|
(tA sattveo vahu loka phire Asala nA) tathApi Ami tAderake o tAdera vApa-dAdAderake jIvana bhoga karate dei| parizeSe tAdera kAche Asala satya evaM suspaSTa hedAYAta dAnakArI rAsUla|
yakhana se satya tAdera kAche Asala, takhana tArA valala, eTA to yAdu| AmarA eTA asvIkAra kari|
evaM valala, e kuraAna dui janapadera kona var3a vyaktira upara nAyila karA hala nA kena?

tave ki tArAi tomAra pratipAlakera rahamata vaNTana karave? pArthiva jIvane tAdera jIvikAo to Amii vaNTana karechi evaM Amii tAdera ekajanake aparajanera upara maryAdAYa unnata karechi, yAte tAdera eke anyera dvArA kAja nite pAre| tomAra pratipAlakera rahamata to tArA yA (artha-sampada) saJcaYa kare, tA apekSA aneka zreYa|
samasta mAnuSa ekai matAvalamvI (arthAt kAphera) haYe yAve ei AzaGkA nA thAkale, yArA daYAmaYa AllAhake asvIkAra kare, Ami tAdera gharera chAdao kare ditAma rupAra evaM tArA ye si~r3i diYe car3e tAo|
Ara tAdera gharera darajAguli evaM sei pAlaGkagulio, yAte tArA helAna diYe vase|
varaM karatena sonAra tairi| prakRtapakSe esava pArthiva jIvanera sAmagrI chAr3A kichui naYa| Ara tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa muttAkIdera janya Ache AkherAta|
ye vyakti daYAmaYa AllAhara yikira theke andha haYe yAve, tAra janya niYojita kari eka zaYatAna, ye tAra saGgI haYe yAYa|
tArA (arthAt zaYatAnerA) tAderake satpatha theke virata rAkhe Ara tArA mane kare AmarA saThika pathei Achi|
parizeSe erUpa vyakti yakhana AmAra kAche Asave takhana (se tAra saGgI zaYatAnake) valave, AhA! AmAra o tomAra madhye yadi pUrva o pazcimera vyavadhAna thAkata| kenanA tumi var3a manda saGgI chile|
Aja ekathA kichutei tomAdera kona upakAre Asave nA, yehetu tomarA sImAlaMghana karechile| tomarA zAstite eke anyera aMzIdAra|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi ki vadhirake zonAte pArave kiMvA andha evaM yArA suspaSTa gomarAhIte lipta tAderake supathe Anate pArave?
sutarAM Ami haYata tomAke duniYA theke tule neva, tArapara tAderake zAstidAna karava
kiMvA tomAkeo tA (arthAt sei zAsti) dekhiYe deva, yAra oYAdA Ami tAdera sAthe karechi| tAdera upara to AmAra (du’Tira ye-konaTi karAra) pUrNa kSamatA Ache|
sutarAM tomAra prati ye ohI nAyila karA haYeche, tA dRr3habhAve dhare rAkha| nizcaYai tumi sarala pathe Acha|
vastuta e ohI tomAra o tomAra kaomera janya sukhyAtira upAYa| tomAdera sakalake jijJesa karA have (tomarA era kI haka AdAYa karecha?)|
tomAra Age Ami ye rAsUlagaNake pAThiYechi, tAderake jijJesa kara, Ami ki daYAmaYa AllAha chAr3A Arao kona mAvuda sthira karechilAma, yAdera ivAdata karA yAYa?
Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalIsaha phira‘Auna o tAra amAtyavargera kAche pAThiYechilAma| se tAderake valechila, Ami rAvvula AlAmInera prerita rAsUla|
anantara se yakhana tAdera sAmane AmAra nidarzanasamUha peza karala, amani tArA tA niYe ThATTA karate lAgala|
Ami tAderake ye nidarzanai dekhAtAma, tA tAra Agera nidarzana apekSA var3a hata| Ami tAderake zAstio dilAma, yAte tArA phire Ase|
tArA valate lAgala, he yAdukara! tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke ye pratizruti diYechena, tAra achilA diYe tA~ra kAche AmAdera janya duA kara| nizcaYai AmarA supathe cale Asava|
ataHpara Ami yakhana tAdera theke zAsti apasArita karatAma, amani tArA oYAdA bhaGga karata|

phira‘Auna tAra sampradAYera madhye ei vale ghoSaNA karala, he AmAra kaoma! misarera rAjatva ki AmAra hAte naYa? evaM (dekha) eisava nada-nadI AmAra nica diYe pravAhita hacche| tomarA ki dekhate pAccha nA?
varaM Amii oi vyakti apekSA zreSTha, ye ati hIna evaM pariSkAra kare kathA valAo yAra pakSe kaThina|
AcchA, (se yadi navI haYa, tave) tAke kena sonAra kA~kana deoYA hala nA| kiMvA tAra sAthe dalavaddhabhAve pherezatA Asala nA kena?
ebhAvei se nija sampradAYake vekuva vAnAla evaM tArAo tAra kathA mene nila| prakRtapakSe tArA sakale chila pApiSTha sampradAYa|
tArA yakhana AmAke asantuSTa karala Ami tAderake zAsti dilAma evaM tAderake karalAma nimajjita|
evaM tAderake vAniYe dilAma eka vigata jAti evaM anyadera janya dRSTAnta|
yakhana (IsA) ivane mAraYAmera udAharaNa deoYA hala, amani tomAra sampradAYa tA niYe hai-cai zuru kare dila|
tArA valala, AmAdera upAsyagaNa zreSTha, nA se? tArA kevala kUTatarkera janyai e dRSTAnta tomAra sAmane peza kare| prakRtapakSe tArA kalahapriYa loka|
se (arthAt hayarata IsA AlAihisa sAlAma) to AmAra eka vAndAi chila, yAra prati Ami anugraha karechilAma evaM vanI isarAIlera janya tAke vAniYechilAma eka dRSTAnta|
Ami cAile tomAdera madhya hate pherezatA sRSTi karate pAratAma, yArA pRthivIte eke anyera sthalAbhiSikta haYe thAkata|
nizcaYai se (arthAt IsA AlAihisa sAlAma) kiYAmatera eka AlAmata| sutarAM tomarA se samvandhe sandeha karo nA evaM AmAra anusaraNa kara| eTAi sarala patha|
zaYatAna yena kichutei tomAderake e patha theke phiriYe rAkhate nA pAre| nizcaYai se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

yakhana IsA suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe Asala, takhana se (mAnuSake) valala, Ami tomAdera kAche niYe esechi jJAnera kathA evaM esechi tomarA yesava viSaYe matabheda kara, tA tomAdera kAche pariSkAra kare deoYAra janya| sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
nizcaYai AllAha AmAra ravva evaM tomAderao ravva| sutarAM tA~rai ivAdata kara| eTAi sarala patha|
tAraparao tAdera madhye kaYekaTi dala matabheda sRSTi karala| sutarAM se jAlemadera janya Ache durbheAga yantraNAmaYa divasera zAstira|
tArA kevala kiYAmatera apekSA karache yA emana akasmAt tAdera sAmane ese yAve ye, tArA Terao pAve nA|
se dina vandhuvarga eke anyera zatru haYe yAve| kevala muttAkIgaNa chAr3A
(yAderake lakSa kare valA have) he AmAra vAndAgaNa! Aja tomAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tomarA have nA duHkhitao|
(AmAra sei vAndAgaNa,) yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna enechila evaM chila anugata!
tomarA jAnnAte praveza kara evaM tomAdera strIgaNao Anandojjvala cehArAYa|

sonAra peYAlA o pAnapAtra niYe tAdera sAmane ghorAghuri karA have evaM se jAnnAte tAdera janya emana sava kichui thAkave, yAra cAhidA mane jAgave evaM yA dvArA cokha prIti lAbha karave| Ara ei jAnnAte tomarA sarvadA thAkave|
eTAi sei jAnnAta tomAderake yAra adhikArI karA haYeche tomAdera karmera vinimaYe|
ekhAne raYeche tomAdera janya paryApta phala, yA theke tomarA khAve|
tave aparAdhIgaNa sthAYIbhAve jAhAnnAme thAkave|
se zAsti tAdera janya lAghava karA have nA evaM tArA sekhAne hatAza haYe par3ave|
Ami tAdera upara juluma karini, varaM tArA nijerAi chila jAlema|
tArA (jAhAnnAmera pradhAna pherezatAke) Deke valave, he mAleka! tomAra pratipAlaka AmAdera jIvana sAGga kare dina| se valave, tomAderake e avasthAYai thAkate have|
Ami to tomAdera kAche satya upasthita karechilAma| kintu tomAdera adhikAMzei satya apachanda kare|
tave ki tArA kichu karAra cUr3Anta siddhAnta niYe pheleche? tAhale Amio kichu karAra cUr3Anta siddhAnta kare phelavo|
tArA ki mane kareche Ami tAdera gopana kathAvArtA o tAdera kAnAkAni zunate pAi nA? avazyai pAi? tAchAr3A AmAra pherezatAgaNa tAdera kAchei raYeche, yArA (savakichu) lipivaddha karache|
(he rAsUla!) vale dAo, daYAmaYa AllAhara kona santAna thAkale Amii sarvaprathama ivAdatakArI hatAma|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra mAlika evaM Arazera mAlika tArA yA-kichu valache tA theke sampUrNa pavitra|

sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tAderake Apana avasthAYa cher3e dAo, tArA oi sava kathAYa mete thAkuka o hAsi-tAmAzA karate thAkuka, yatakSaNa nA tArA sei dinera sammukhIna haYa, ye dinera pratizruti tAderake deoYA hacche|
tinii (arthAt AllAhai) AsamAneo mAvuda evaM yamIneo mAvuda evaM tinii hekamatera mAlika, jJAnerao mAlika|
mahimAnvita tini, yAra hAte AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o e du’Yera antargata savakichura rAjatva| tA~rai kAche Ache kiYAmatera jJAna evaM tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
tArA tA~ke cher3e yesava upAsyake DAke tAdera supAriza karAra kona ekhatiYAra thAkave nA, tave yArA jenezune satyera sAkSya diYeche, tArA vyatIta|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara, tAderake ke sRSTi kareche, tArA avazyai valave, AllAha! etadasattveo ke kothA hate tAderake ulTo dike cAlAcche?
(AllAha rAsUlera) ekathA samparkeo avagata ye, he AmAra ravva! erA emana sampradAYa, yArA ImAna Anave nA|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi tAderake agrAhya karo evaM vale dAo, ‘sAlAma’| kenanA acirei tArA sava jAnate pArave|
hA-mIma|
zapatha kitAvera, yA (satyera) suspaSTakArI|
Ami eTA nAyila karechi eka muvAraka rAte| (kenanA) Ami mAnuSake satarka karAra chilAma|
e rAtei pratiTi prajJAjanocita viSaYa sthira karA haYa|
(tAchAr3A) AmAra nirdeze, Ami (eka) rAsUla pAThAvAra chilAma,
tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate rahamata svarUpa| nizcaYa tinii sakala kathA zonena, savakichu jAnena|
yini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI evaM ubhaYera madhyavartI sava kichura ravva yadi vAstavikai tomarA vizvAsI hao|
tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tini jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyuo ghaTAna| tini tomAdera pratipAlaka evaM pUrve gata tomAdera vApa-dAdAderao pratipAlaka|
(tA sattveo kApheragaNa ImAna Ane nA); varaM tArA sandehe nipatita theke khela-tAmAzA karache|
sutarAM sei dinera apekSA kara, yakhana AkAza spaSTa dheA~YAcchanna haYe dekhA deve
yA mAnuSake Acchanna karave| eTA eka yantraNAmaYa zAsti|
(takhana tArA valave) he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera theke ei zAsti apasAraNa karuna| AmarA avazyai ImAna Anava|
kothAYa tArA upadeza grahaNa kare? athaca tAdera kAche eseche emana rAsUla, ye satya spaSTa kare deYa|
tAraparao tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe rAkhala evaM valala, eke to zekhAno haYeche, se to unmAda|
Ami kichu kAlera janya zAsti apasAraNa karachi| eTA nizcita ye, tomarA AvAra e avasthAYai phire Asave|
ye dina Ami dharava sarvavRhat dharAYa, se dina Ami avazyai zAsti deva|
tAdera Age phira‘Aunera sampradAYake Ami parIkSA karechilAma evaM tAdera kAche esechila eka maryAdAvAna rAsUla|
(se valechila) AllAhara vAndAderake AmAra kAche samarpaNa kara| Ami tomAdera kAche eka vizvasta rAsUla haYe esechi|
Arao valala, AllAhara viruddhe auddhatya pradarzana karo nA| Ami tomAdera sAmane eka spaSTa pramANa peza karachi|
tomarA ye AmAke pAthara mere hatyA karave, tAra theke Ami AzraYa grahaNa karachi AmAra o tomAdera pratipAlakera|
tomarA yadi AmAra prati ImAna nA Ana, tave tomarA AmAra theke dUre thAka|
tArapara se nija pratipAlakake DAka diYe valala, erA to eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|
(AllAha tAAlA valalena,) tA hale tumi AmAra vAndAdera niYe rAtera bhetara raoYAnA haYe yAo| avazyai tomAdera pazcAddhAvana karA have|
tumi sAgarake sthira thAkate dAo| nizcaYai tArA emana eka vAhinI yA nimajjita have|
tArA pichane rekhe giYechila kata vAgAna o prasravaNa|
kata zasyakSetra o suraumya vasatavAr3i|
evaM kata vilAsa sAmagrI, yAra bhetara tArA Ananda-phurtite chila|
oi rakamai hala tAdera pariNAma| Ara Ami esava jinisera oYAriza vAniYe dilAma apara eka sampradAYake|
ataHpara tAdera janya nA AsamAna kA~dala, nA yamIna evaM tAderake kichumAtra avakAzao deoYA hala nA|
Ara vanI isarAIlake uddhAra karalAma lAJchanAkara zAsti hate|
arthAt phira‘Aunera theke| prakRtapakSe se chila sImAlaMghanakArIdera antarbhukta eka uddhata vyakti|
Ami tAderake jenezunei vizvavAsIra upara zreSThatva diYechilAma|
evaM tAderake diYechilAma emana nidarzana, yAra bhetara chila suspaSTa anugraha|
nizcaYai tArA vale thAke
AmAdera prathama mRtyu chAr3A Ara kichui nei| evaM AmarA punarAYa jIvita haoYAra nai|
tomarA satyavAdI hale AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake tule Ana|
tArA zreSTha, nA tuvvA’ra sampradAYa o tAdera pUrvavartIgaNa? Ami tAdera sakalake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| (kenanA) tArA avazyai aparAdhI chila|
Ami AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o tAra antargata vastu nicaYa krIr3Acchale sRSTi karini|
Ami tA sRSTi karechi yathArtha uddezye| kintu tAdera adhikAMzei vojhe nA|
vastuta mImAMsA divasai tAdera sakalera janya nirdhArita kAla|
ye dina eka mitra apara mitrera kichumAtra kAje Asave nA evaM tAdera kArao konao sAhAyya karA have nA,
AllAha yAra prati rahama karena, se vyatIta| nizcaYai tini paripUrNa kSamatAra mAlika, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai yAkkuma gAcha have
gunAhagAradera khAvAra
telera talAni-sadRza| tA tAdera peTe uthalAte thAkave
garama pAnira uthalAnora mata|
(pherezatAderake valA have,) tAke dhara evaM he~car3Ate he~car3Ate jAhAnnAmera mAjhakhAne niYe yAo|
tArapara tAra mAthAra upara uttapta pAnira zAsti Dhele dAo|
(valA have,) svAda grahaNa kara| tui-i to sei mahA kSamatAvAna, mahA sammAnI vyakti|
eTAi sei jinisa, ye samparke tomarA sandeha karate|
(apara dike) muttAkIgaNa avazyai nirApada sthAne thAkave
udyAnarAjite o prasravaNe!
tArA ‘sundusa’ o ‘isatAvarAka’-era pozAka parihita avasthAYa sAmanA sAmani vasA thAkave|
tAdera sAthe e rakamai vyavahAra karA have| Ami DAgara-DAgara cokhera huradera sAthe tAdera vivAha deva|
sekhAne tArA atyanta nizcinte sava rakama phalera pharamAYeza karave|
(duniYAYa) tAdera ye mRtyu prathame esechila, tA chAr3A sekhAne (arthAt jAnnAte) tAderake kona mRtyura svAda grahaNa karate have nA evaM AllAha tAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti hate rakSA karavena,
tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate anugraha svarUpa| (mAnuSera janya) eTAi mahA sAphalya|
(he rAsUla!) Ami e kuraAnake tomAra mukhe sahaja kare diYechi, yAte mAnuSa upadeza grahaNa kare|
sutarAM tumi apekSA kara, tArAo apekSAYa Ache|
hA-mIma|
e kitAva nAyila karA hacche AllAhara pakSa theke, yini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
prakRtapakSe vizvAsIdera janya AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte vahu nidarzana Ache|
evaM khoda tomAdera sRjana o seisava jIvera madhyeo, yA tini (pRthivIte) char3iYe diYechena, yArA dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe seisava lokera janya Ache vahu nidarzana|

(tAchAr3A) rAta-dinera parivartanera madhye, AllAha AkAza theke jIvikAra ye mAdhyama avatIrNa karechena, tArapara tA dvArA bhUmike tAra mRtyura para natuna jIvana dAna karechena, tAra madhye evaM vAYura parivartanera madhye vahu nidarzana Ache seisava lokera janya yArA vodhazaktike kAje lAgAYa|
esava AllAhara AYAta, yA Ami tomAke yathAyathabhAve par3e zonAcchi| sutarAM AllAha o tA~ra AYAtasamUhera para emana kona jinisa Ache, yAra upara tArA ImAna Anave?
durgati hoka pratyeka emana mithyuka pApiSThera

ye AllAhara AYAtasamUha zone, yakhana tAke par3e zonAno haYa, kintu tA sattveo se auddhatyera sAthe emanabhAve (kupharera upara) aTala thAke, yena AYAtasamUha zoneini| sutarAM emana vyaktike yantraNAmaYa zAstira susaMvAda (?) zonAo|
yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUhera madhya hate kona AYAta tAra jJAnagocara haYa, takhana se tA niYe hAsi-ThATTA kare| erUpa vyaktidera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|
tAdera sAmane Ache jAhAnnAma| tArA yA-kichu arjana kareche tA tAdera kona kAje Asave nA evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAderake nijedera abhibhAvaka vAniYeche tArAo nA| tAdera janya Ache eka mahAzAsti|
eTA (arthAt kuraAna AdyopAnta) hedAYAta| yArA nija pratipAlakera AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche tAdera janya Ache mahA musivatera marmantuda zAsti|
tinii AllAha, yini sAgarake tomAdera kAje niyukta karechena, yAte tA~ra nirdeze tAte cale jalayAna evaM yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA tA~ra zokara AdAYa kara|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA savai tini nijera pakSa theke tomAdera kAje lAgiYe rekhechena| nizcaYai era madhye vahu nidarzana Ache sei sava lokera janya, yArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|
(he rAsUla!) yArA ImAna eneche tAderake vala, yArA AllAhara dinasamUhera bhaYa rAkhe nA, tAderake yena kSamA kare| eijanya ye, AllAha mAnuSake tAdera kRtakarmera pratiphala dAna karavena|
ye vyaktii satkarma kare se tA kare nijera kalyANArthe Ara ye-keu manda karma kare, se nijerai kSati kare| avazeSe tomAdera sakalake tomAdera pratipAlakera kAchei phiriYe neoYA have|
Ami vanI isarAIlake kitAva, rAjatva o navuoYAta dAna karechilAma, tAderake utkRSTa vastu samUhera riyaka diYechilAma evaM jagadvAsIra upara tAderake diYechilAma zreSThatva|

Ara tAderake diYechilAma dInera suspaSTa vidhAnAvalI| ataHpara tArA matavirodhe lipta haYechila tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra parai, kevala tAdera pArasparika vidveSavazata| tArA yesava viSaYe matavirodha kare, tomAra pratipAlaka nizcaYai kiYAmatera dina tAra madhye phAYasAlA kare divena|
(he rAsUla!) Ami tomAke dInera eka vizeSa zarIYatera upara rekhechi| sutarAM tumi tArai anusaraNa kara evaM yArA prakRta jJAna rAkhe nA, tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa karo nA|
AllAhara viparIte tArA tomAra kichumAtra kAje Asave nA| vastuta jAlemagaNa eke anyera vandhu Ara AllAha vandhu muttAkIdera|
eTA (kuraAna) samasta mAnuSera janya prakRta jJAnera samaSTi evaM yArA dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe, tAdera janya pathanirdeza o rahamata|

yArA asat kAryAvalIte lipta haYeche, tArA ki bheveche Ami tAderake sei sakala lokera sama gaNya karava, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, phale tAdera jIvana o maraNa ekai rakama haYe yAve? tArA yA siddhAnta kare rekheche tA katai nA manda!
AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI yathAyatha uddezye sRSTi karechena evaM tA karechena ejanya ye, pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pratiphala deoYA have yakhana tAdera prati kona juluma karA have nA|

tumi ki dekhecha tAke, ye tAra kheYAla-khuzIke nija mAvuda vAniYe niYeche evaM jJAna thAkA sattveo AllAha tAke gomarAhIte nikSepa karechena evaM tAra kAna o antare mohara kare diYechena Ara tAra cokhera upara pardA phele diYechena? ataeva, AllAhara para emana ke Ache, ye tAke supathe niYe Asave? tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?

tArA vale, jIvana valate yA-kichu tA vyasa AmAdera ei pArthiva jIvanai| AmarA ekhAnei mari o vA~ci, Ara AmAderake kevala kAlai dhvaMsa kare, athaca e viSaYe tAdera konai jJAna nei| tArA kevala dhAraNAi kare|
yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAve tAderake par3e zonAno haYa, takhana tAdera kona yukti thAke nA ei kathA valA chAr3A ye, tomarA satyavAdI hale AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake (jIvita kare) niYe eso|

vale dAo, AllAhai tomAderake jIvana dAna karena, tArapara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena tArapara kiYAmatera dina tomAdera sakalake samaveta karavena, ye viSaYe kona rakama sandeha nei, kintu adhikAMza loke vojhe nA|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra rAjatva AllAharai| ye dina kiYAmata saMghaTita have, se dina vAtilapanthIgaNa kaThinabhAve kSatigrasta have|
Ara tumi pratyeka dalake dekhave hA~Tu bheGge par3e Ache evaM pratyeka dalake tAdera AmalanAmAra dike DAkA have (evaM valA have,) Aja tomAderake tomAdera kRtakarmera vadalA deoYA have|
eTA AmAra (lipivaddha karAno) daphatara, yA tomAdera samparke satya valache| tomarA yA-kichu karate Ami tA savai lipivaddha karAtAma|
sutarAM yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tAderake to tAdera pratipAlaka nija rahamatera bhetara dAkhila karavena| eTAi suspaSTa saphalatA|
Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana karechila, (tAderake valA have) tomAdera sAmane ki AmAra AYAtasamUha par3A hata nA? tA sattveo tomarA ahaMkAra karechile evaM tomarA chile eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|

evaM yakhana tomAderake valA hata, AllAhara oYAdA satya evaM kiYAmata emana eka vAstavatA, yAra madhye kona sandeha nei, takhana tomarA valate, AmarA jAni nA kiYAmata kI? e samparke AmarA mane kari eTA ekaTA dhAraNA mAtra| e samparke AmarA vilakula vizvAsI nai|
evaM tArA yA kichu karechila (takhana) tAra mandatva tAdera sAmane prakAza haYe yAve| Ara tArA ye viSaYa niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata, tA tAderake veSTana kare phelave|

tAderake valA have, Aja Ami seibhAvei tomAderake vismRta hava, yemana tomarA tomAdera ei divasera sammukhIna haoYAke vismRta haYechile| tomAdera ThikAnA Aguna evaM tomAdera kona rakamera sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|

tA e kAraNe ye, tomarA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake ThATTA-vidrUpera vastu vAniYechile evaM pArthiva jIvana tomAderake dheA~kAYa phele rekhechila| sutarAM Aja erUpa lokaderake tA theke vera karA have nA evaM tAderake kSamA prArthanA karateo valA have nA|
moddAkathA samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AkAzamaNDalIra mAlika, pRthivIra mAlika, jagatasamUherao mAlika|
evaM samasta gaurava tA~rai, AkAzamaNDalIteo evaM pRthivIteo| evaM tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
hA-mIma|
e kitAva nAyila karA hacche AllAhara pakSa hate, yini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ami AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM e du’Yera mAjhera vastusamUha sRSTi karini yathAyatha uddezya o sunirdiSTa meYAda chAr3A| yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tArA tAderake ye viSaYa samparke satarka karA haYeche, tA theke vimukha haYe Ache|

tumi tAderake vala, tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAderake DAka, tAdera niYe ki kakhanao cintA karecha? AmAke ekaTu dekhAo to tArA pRthivIra kona jinisaTA sRSTi kareche? athavA AkAza- maNDalIra (sRjanera) madhye tAdera ki kona aMza Ache? tomarA era pUrvera kona kitAva vA jJAnabhittika kona varNanA thAkale tA AmAra sAmane niYe eso yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

tAra ceYe var3a pathabhraSTa Ara ke hate pAre, ye AllAhake cher3e emana kAuke (arthAt managar3A devatAke) DAke, ye kiYAmata paryanta tAra DAke sAr3A dite sakSama naYa evaM tAdera DAka samparke tAdera khavara paryanta nei|
evaM mAnuSake (hAzarera mAThe) yakhana ekatra karA have, takhana tArA tAdera zatru haYe yAve evaM tArA tAdera ivAdatakei asvIkAra karave|
yakhana tAdera sAmane AmAra AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAve par3A haYa, takhana kApheragaNa tAdera kAche satya peৗ~che yAoYAra parao vale, eTA to pariSkAra yAdu|

tAdera kathA ki ei ye, navI tA nijera pakSa theke racanA kareche? vale dAo, Ami yadi eTA nijera pakSa hate racanA kare thAki, tave AllAhara dharA hate tomarA AmAke kichumAtra rakSA karate pArave nA| tomarA yesava kathAYa lipta Acha, tA tini bhAlobhAve jAnena| AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI haoYAra janya tinii yatheSTa evaM tinii ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

vala, Ami rAsUlagaNera madhye abhinava nai| Ami jAni nA AmAra saGge kI AcaraNa karA have evaM eTAo (jAni) nA ye, tomAdera saGge kI AcaraNa karA have| Ami to kevala AmAra prati ye ohI nAyila karA haYa, tArai anusaraNa kari| Ara Ami to kevala ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI mAtra|

vala, tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi eTA (arthAt kuraAna) AllAhara pakSa theke haYa Ara tomarA tAke asvIkAra kara| anyadike vanI isarAIlera kona sAkSI e rakama viSaYera pakSe sAkSya deYa evaM se tAra prati ImAnao Ane Ara tomarA nijedera ahamikAYa lipta thAka (tave eTA ki mArAtmaka avicAra have nA?)| nizcaYai AllAha jAlema sampradAYake hedAYAtaprApta karena nA|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA muminadera samparke vale, eTA (ImAna AnaYana) yadi bhAlo kichu hata, tave tArA era prati AmAdera ceYe agragAmI hate pArata nA evaM kApheragaNa yakhana era dvArA nijerA hedAYAta lAbha karala nA, takhana to eTAi valave ye, eTA sei purAno dinera mithyA|

era Age mUsAra kitAva eseche pathapradarzaka o rahamata haYe| Ara eTA (arthAt kuraAna) AravI bhASAYa avatIrNa kitAva, yA tAke satya vale sAkSya deYa, yAte eTA jAlemaderake satarka kare evaM satkarmazIladera janya haYa susaMvAda|
nizcaYai yArA valeche, AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAha, tArapara ete avicala thekeche, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
tArA have jAnnAtavAsI| sekhAne tArA thAkave sarvadA| tArA yA karata tAra pratidAnasvarUpa|

Ami mAnuSake tAra pitA-mAtAra prati sadvyavahAra karAra hukuma diYechi| tAra mA tAke ati kaSTera sAthe (garbhe) dhAraNa kareche evaM ati kaSTe tAke prasava kareche| tAke (garbhe) dhAraNa o dudha chAr3Anora meYAda haYa triza mAsa| avazeSe se yakhana tA~ra pUrNa sakSamatAYa peৗ~che evaM calliza vachara vaYase upanIta haYa, takhana vale, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke tAophIka dAna karuna, yena Apani AmAke o AmAra pitA-mAtAke ye ni‘Amata diYechena tAra zokara AdAYa karate pAri evaM emana satkarma karate pAri, yAte Apani khuzI hana evaM AmAra janya AmAra santAnaderakeo (sei) yogyatA dAna karuna| Ami ApanAra kAche tAovA karachi evaM Ami Anugatya prakAzakArIdera antarbhukta|

erAi tArA, Ami yAdera utkRSTa kAjasamUha kavula karava evaM tAdera manda kAjasamUha kSamA karava| (phale) tArA jAnnAtavAsIdera antarbhukta have, tAderake ye satya pratizruti deoYA hata tAra vadaulate|

apara eka vyakti emana, ye tAra pitA-mAtAke valala, Aphasosa tomAdera prati! tomarA ki AmAke ei pratizruti dAo ye, AmAke jIvita kare kavara theke oThAno have, athaca AmAra Age vahu mAnavagoSThI gata haYeche? pitA-mAtA AllAhara kAche phariYAda kare (evaM putrake vale,) Aphasosa tora prati! ImAna Ana| nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya| takhana se vale, prakRtapakSe esava pUrvavartIdera theke varNita haYe AsA upakathA chAr3A kichui naYa|
erAi tArA, yAdera samparke tAdera pUrve gata jina o mAnava jAtisamUhera mata (zAstira) vANI cUr3Anta haYe geche| prakRtapakSe tArAi kSatigrasta|
Apana kRtakarmera kAraNe pratyeka (dala)-era raYeche vibhinna stara evaM tA ei janya ye, AllAha tAderake tAdera karmera puropuri pratiphala devena evaM tAdera prati kona juluma karA have nA|

evaM sei dinake smaraNa rekha, ye dina kApheraderake Agunera sAmane peza karA have (evaM valA have,) tomarA nijedera aMzera utkRSTa jinisasamUha pArthiva jIvane (bhoga kare) niHzeSa kare phelecha evaM tA vejAYa bhoga karecha| sutarAM Aja vinimaYarUpe tomarA pAve lAJchanAkara zAsti, yehetu tomarA pRthivIte nAhaka gaurava karate evaM yehetu tomarA nApharamAni karate|

evaM Ada jAtira bhAi (hayarata huda AlAihisa sAlAma)-era vRttAnta ullekha kara, yakhana se tAra sampradAYake A~kA-vA~kA TilAmaYa bhUmite satarka karechila evaM e rakama satarkakArI gata haYechila tAra Ageo evaM tAra pareo (se tAderake valechila) ye, AllAha chAr3A kArao ivAdata karo nA| Ami tomAdera janya bhaYa karachi eka mahA divasera zAstira|
tArA valala, tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanyai esecha ye, AmAderake AmAdera upAsyadera theke vimukha kare deve? AcchA tumi yadi satyavAdI hao, tave AmAderake ye zAstira bhaYa dekhAccha tA niYe eso|

se valala, (se AyAva kakhana Asave era) yathAyatha jJAna to AllAharai kAche| AmAke ye vArtA diYe pAThAno haYeche Ami to tomAdera kAche tAi peৗ~chAcchi| tave Ami dekhachi tomarA eka ajJa sampradAYa (-era mata kathAvArtA valacha)|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAke (arthAt AyAvake) ekaTi meghakhaNDa rUpe tAdera upatyakAra dike egiYe Asate dekhala, takhana tArA valala, eTA megha, yA AmAderake vRSTi deve|’ nA, varaM eTAi sei jinisa, yAra janya tomarA tAr3Ahur3A karachile, eka jhar3o hAoYA, yAra madhye Ache yantraNAmaYa zAsti|

yA tAra pratipAlakera hukume savakichu tachanacha kare phelave| anantara tArA emana haYe gela ye, tAdera AvAsasthala chAr3A kichui dekhA yAcchila nA| aparAdhI sampradAYake Ami e rakamai zAsti diYe thAki|

evaM (he AravavAsI!) Ami tAderake emana viSaYe kSamatA diYechilAma, yAra kSamatA tomAderake deini evaM Ami tAderake kAna, cokha o hRdaYa savakichui diYechilAma, kintu nA tAdera kAna o cokha tAdera kona upakAre Asala Ara nA tAdera hRdaYa, yehetu tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karata| Ara tArA ye jinisa niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata, tAi tAderake pariveSTana karala|
Ami tomAdera AzapAzera anyAnya janapadakeo dhvaMsa karechi| Ami vibhinna rakamera nidarzana (tAdera) sAmane enechilAma, yAte tArA phire Ase|

tArA AllAhara naikaTya arjanera uddezye AllAha chAr3A yesava jinisake mAvudarUpe grahaNa karechila, tArA tAdera sAhAyya karala nA kena? varaM tArA sava tAdera theke antarhita haYe gela| vastuta eTA chila tAdera mithyA apavAda evaM yA tArA racanA karechila|

evaM (he rAsUla!) smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami eka dala jinake kuraAna zonAra janya tomAra abhimukhI kare diYechilAma| yakhana tArA sekhAne peৗ~chala, (eke anyake) valala, cupa kara| tA par3A haYe gele tArA Apana sampradAYera kAche phire gela satarkakArIrUpe|

tArA valala, he AmAdera kaoma! nizcaYai jene rekha, AmarA emana eka kitAva (-era pATha) zunechi, yA mUsA (AlAihisa sAlAma)-era para avatIrNa haYeche, tAra pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhera samarthakarUpe, yA patha-nirdeza kare satyera o sarala pathera|
he AmAdera kaoma! AllAhara pathe AhvAnakArIra DAke sAr3A dAo o tAra prati ImAna Ana| AllAha tomAdera gunAhasamUha kSamA kare devena evaM tomAderake rakSA karavena eka yantraNAmaYa zAsti theke|

ye vyakti AllAhara pathe AhvAnakArIra DAke sAr3A deve nA, se pRthivIra kothAo giYe AllAhake akSama karate pArave nA evaM AllAha chAr3A se konao rakamera abhibhAvakao pAve nA| erUpa loka suspaSTa pathabhraSTatAYa lipta|

tArA ki anudhAvana kareni ye, yei AllAha AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM esavera sRjane tA~ra vindumAtra klAnti dekhA deYani, tini niHsandehe mRtaderake jIvita karate sakSama? kenaivA havena nA? nizcaYai tini sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

ye dina kApheraderake Agunera sAmane upasthita karA have, (se dina tAderake jijJesa karA have,) eTA (arthAt jAhAnnAma) ki satya naYa? tArA valave, AmAdera pratipAlakera zapatha! eTA vAstavikai satya| AllAha valavena, tAhale tomarA ye kuphara avalamvana karechile tAra vinimaYe zAsti bhoga kara|

sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi savara avalamvana kara, yemana savara avalamvana karechila dRr3ha-pratijJa rAsUlagaNa evaM tumi tAdera (arthAt kApheradera) viSaYe tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| tAderake ye viSaYe satarka karA hacche, tA ye dina tArA dekhave, se dina (tAdera mane have) tArA yena (duniYAYa) dinera eka muhUrtera vezi avasthAna kareni| eTAi sei vArtA, yA peৗ~chiYe deoYA hala| ataHpara dhvaMsa to have kevala emana sava loka, yArA avAdhya|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM anyaderake AllAhara pathe vAdhA dAna kareche, AllAha tAdera karma niSphala kare diYechena|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche evaM muhAmmAda (sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma)-era prati yA-kichu avatIrNa haYeche Ara seTAi to tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate Agata satya tA AntarikabhAve mene niYeche, AllAha tAdera pApasamUha kSamA kare diYechena evaM tAdera avasthA saMzodhana kare diYechena|

tA eijanya ye, yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA mithyAra anugAmI haYeche evaM yArA ImAna eneche, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate Agata satyera anusaraNa kareche| ebhAvei AllAha mAnuSera kAche tAdera avasthAdi varNanA karena|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tAdera sAthe yakhana tomarA mukAvelA kara, takhana tAdera gardAne AghAta karave| avazeSe tomarA yakhana tAdera zakti cUrNa karave, takhana tAderake zaktabhAve grephatAra karave| tArapara cAile (tAderake) mukti deve anukampA dekhiYe athavA muktipaNa niYe| (tomAdera prati eTAi nirdeza,) yAvat nA yuddha tAra astra rekhe deYa (arthAt yuddha zeSa haYe yAYa)| (tAdera vyApAre) tomAdera prati ei nirdeza| AllAha cAile nijei tAderake zAsti ditena, kintu (tomAderake e nirdeza dicchena ejanya ye,) tini tomAdera katakake katakera dvArA parIkSA karate cAna| Ara yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYeche, AllAha kakhanai tAdera karma niSphala karavena nA|
tini tAderake gantavye peৗ~chiYe devena evaM (AkhirAte) tAdera avasthA bhAlo rAkhavena|
tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yA tAderake bhAlobhAve ciniYe diYechilena
he muminagaNa! tomarA yadi AllAha (tAAlAra dIna)-era sAhAyya kara, tave tini tomAdera sAhAyya karavena evaM tomAdera kadama avicalita rAkhavena|
Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche tAdera janya Ache dhvaMsa| AllAha tAdera karma vyartha kare diYechena|
tA ei janya ye, tArA AllAha yA nAyila karechena tA apachanda karechila| sutarAM AllAha tAdera karma niSphala kare diYechena|
tave ki tArA bhUmite vicaraNa kare dekheni tAdera pUrve yArA chila tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche? AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechena| Ara (makkAra) kApheradera janya raYeche anurUpa pariNAma|
tA ei janya ye, AllAha muminadera abhibhAvaka Ara kApheradera kona abhibhAvaka nei|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena emana udyAne, yAra taladeze nahara vahamAna thAkave| Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA (duniYAYa) majA luTache evaM catuSpada jantu yebhAve khAYa, sebhAve khAcche| tAdera zeSa ThikAnA jAhAnnAma|

emana kata janapada chila, yA tArA tomAke tomAra ye janapada theke vera kare diYeche tA apekSA vezi zaktizAlI chila, Ami tAdera sakalake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| takhana tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI chila nA|

sutarAM (vala to), ye vyakti tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka ujjvala pathe raYeche, se ki tAdera mata hate pAre yAdera duSkarmake tAdera dRSTite zobhana kare tolA haYeche evaM yArA tAdera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kare thAke?

muttAkIdera yei jAnnAtera pratizruti deoYA haYeche, tAra avasthA ei ye, tAte Ache emana pAnira nahara, yA kakhanao naSTa haoYAra naYa, Ache emana dudhera nahara, yAra svAda thAkave aparivartanIYa, Ache emana surAra nahara, yA pAnakArIdera janya atyanta susvAdu, Ache emana madhura nahara yA thAkave parizodhita evaM tAte tAdera janya thAkave sava rakama phalamUla o tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate mAgaphirAta| tArA ki oisava lokera mata hate pAre, yArA sthAYIbhAve jAhAnnAme thAkave evaM tAderake pAna karAno have uttapta pAni, yA tAdera nAr3ibhu~r3i chinna-bhinna kare phelave?

(he rAsUla!) tAdera madhye kichu loka emana Ache, yArA tomAra kathA kAna pete zone, kintu yakhana tomAra kAcha theke vera haYe yAYa, takhana yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche, tAderake jijJesa kare, eimAtra tini (arthAt navI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) kI valalena? erA emana loka, AllAha yAdera antare mohara kare diYechena evaM yArA anusaraNa kare nijedera kheYAla-khuzIra|
yArA hedAYAtera patha avalamvana kareche, AllAha tAderake hedAYAte utkarSa diYechena evaM tAderake dAna karechena tAdera (praYojanIYa) tAkaoYA|

tave ki tArA (kApheragaNa) kevala erai apekSA karache ye, kiYAmata tAdera upara AkasmikabhAve Apatita have? (yadi sei apekSAYai thAke) tave tAra AlAmatasamUha to ese geche| ataHpara tA yakhana tAdera sAmane esei par3ave, takhana tAdera upadeza grahaNera suyoga thAkave kothAYa?

sutarAM (he rAsUla!) jene rekha, AllAha chAr3A ivAdatera upayukta Ara keu nei Ara kSamA prArthanA kara nija truTi-vicyutira janya evaM musalima nara-nArIra janyao| AllAha tomAdera gatividhi o tomAdera avasthAnasthala samparke jAnena|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche tArA vale, kona (natuna) sUrA nAyila haYa nA kena? ataHpara yakhana yathocita kona sUrA nAyila haYa evaM tAte yuddhera ullekha thAke, takhana yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache, tumi tAderake dekhave tomAra dike tAkiYe Ache mRtyubhaYe mUrchita vyaktira tAkAnora mata| tAdera janya raYeche carama dhvaMsa|
tArA Anugatya jAhira kare o bhAlo-bhAlo kathA vale| yakhana (jihAdera) Adeza cUr3Anta haYe yAYa, takhana yadi tArA AllAhara sAthe satyavAditAra paricaYa dita, tave tAdera janya bhAlo hata|
ataHpara tomarA (jihAda theke) mukha phiriYe nile ki tomAdera dvArA bhUmite azAnti vistAra evaM raktera AtmIya়tA chinna karAra sambhAvanA Ache?
erAi tArA, yAderake AllAha lA’nata karechena (arthAt tA~ra rahamata theke dUra kare diYechena|) phale tAderake vadhira vAniYe diYechena evaM tAdera cokha andha kare diYechena|
tArA ki kuraAna samparke cintA kare nA, nAki antare lege Ache tAra (saMzliSTa) tAlA?
prakRtapakSe yArA tAdera sAmane hedAYAta parisphuTa haYe yAoYAra parao pechana phiriYe cale yAYa, zaYatAna tAderake phusalAni diYeche evaM tAderake asambhava AzA diYeche|

tA ejanya ye, yArA AllAhara nAyilakRta viSaYake apachanda kare tAderake tArA (arthAt munAphekagaNa) valeche, kona kona viSaYe AmarA tomAdera kathAo mAnava| AllAha tAdera gupta kathAsamUha bhAlobhAve jAnena|
pherezatAgaNa yakhana tAdera cehArAYa o pechana dike AghAta karate karate tAdera jAna kavaja karave, takhana tAdera dazA kI have?
tA ejanya ye, tArA emana patha anusaraNa kareche yA AllAhake nArAja kare evaM tArA AllAhara santoSa sAdhanake apachanda kareche| tAi AllAha tAdera karma niSphala kare diYechena|
yAdera antare (munAphekIra) vyAdhi Ache, tArA ki mane kare AllAha tAdera (antare) lukAYita vidveSa kakhanao prakAza kare devena nA?

Ami cAile tomAYa tAderake dekhiYe ditAma, phale tumi lakSaNa dekhe tAderake cine phelate evaM (ekhanao) tumi kathA valAra dharana dekhe tAderake avazyai cinate pArave| AllAha tomAdera kAryAvalI bhAlobhAvei jAnena|
(he musalimagaNa!) Ami avazyai tomAderake parIkSA karava, yAte dekhe nite pAri tomAdera madhye kArA jihAdakArI o dhairyazIla evaM yAte tomAdera avasthAdi yAcAi kare nite pAri|

nizcitabhAve jene rekha, yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM anyaderake AllAhara patha theke phiriYe rekheche evaM rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kareche, tAdera sAmane satpatha suspaSTa haYe yAoYAra para tArA kakhanai AllAhara kona kSati karate pArave nA| acirei tini tAdera yAvatIYa karma nasyAt kare devena|
he muminagaNa! AllAhara Anugatya kara, rAsUlera Anugatya kara evaM nijedera karma varavAda karo nA|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM anyaderake AllAhara patha theke nivRtta kareche, tArapara kuphara avasthAYai mArA geche, AllAha tAderake kakhanao kSamA karavena nA|
sutarAM (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA manovala hAriYe sandhira prastAva dio nA| tomarAi upare thAkave| AllAha tomAdera sAthe| tini kakhanai tomAdera karmaphala kharva karavena nA|

pArthiva jIvana to khela-tAmAzA mAtra| tomarA yadi ImAna Ana o tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave tini tomAderake tomAdera puraskAra dAna karavena evaM tini tomAdera kAche tomAdera artha-sampada cAvena nA|
tini yadi tomAdera kAche tA cAna evaM tomAderake savakichui dite valena, tave tomarA kArpaNya karave evaM takhana tini tomAdera manera asantoSa prakAza kare devena|

dekha, tomarAi to tArA, yAderake AllAhara pathe vyaYa karAra janya DAkA hacche ataHpara tomAdera madhye kichu loke kArpaNya karache| Ara ye-keu kArpaNya kare, se to kArpaNya kare nijerai prati| AllAha abhAvamukta evaM tomarA abhAvagrasta| tomarA yadi mukha phiriYe nAo tave tomAdera sthAne anya kona sampradAYake sRSTi karavena ataHpara tArA tomAdera mata have nA|
(he rAsUla!) nizcaYai Ami tomAke prakAzya vijaYa dAna karechi,
yAte AllAha tomAra atIta o bhaviSyatera samasta truTi kSamA karena, tomAra prati tA~ra ni‘Amata pUrNa karena evaM tomAke sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
evaM (yAte AllAha) tomAke sAhAyya karena, valiSTha sAhAyya|
tinii muminadera antare prazAnti avatIrNa karechena, yAte tAdera ImAne adhikatara ImAna yukta haYa| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra vAhinIsamUha AllAharai evaM AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

yAte tini mumina puruSa o mumina nArIderake dAkhila karena emana udyAne, yAra taladeze pravahamAna raYeche nahara, yekhAne tArA sarvadA thAkave evaM yAte tAdera theke miTiYe dena tAdera mandasamUha| AllAhara kAche eTAi mahAsAphalya|

Ara yAte sei munApheka puruSa o munApheka nArI evaM muzarika puruSa o muzarika nArIderake zAsti dAna karena, yArA AllAha samparke ku-dhAraNA poSaNa kare| mandera phera tAderai upara nipatita evaM AllAha tAdera prati ruSTa, tini tAderake nija rahamata theke vitAr3ita karechena evaM tAdera janya jAhAnnAma prastuta kare rekhechena Ara tA ati manda ThikAnA|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra vAhinIsamUha AllAharai| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
(he rAsUla!) Ami tomAke pAThiYechi sAkSyadAtA, susaMvAdAdAtA o satarkakArIrUpe|
yAte (he mAnuSa!) tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana evaM tA~ke sAhAyya kara o tA~ke sammAna kara evaM sakAla o sandhyAYa tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kara|

(he rAsUla!) yArA tomAra kAche vAYaAta grahaNa karache prakRtapakSe tArA AllAhara kAche vAYaAta grahaNa karache| AllAhara hAta tAdera hAtera upara| erapara ye-keu aGgIkAra bhaGga karave, tAra aGgIkAra bhaGgera pariNAma tAkei bhoga karate have| Ara ye-keu pUraNa karave, sei aGgIkAra yA se AllAhara saGge karache, AllAha tAke mahApuraskAra dAna karavena|

yesava dehAtI (hudAYaviYAra saphare) pechane theke giYechila, tArA zIghrai tomAke valave, AmAdera artha-sampada o parivAra-parijana AmAderake vyasta kare rekhechila| tAi AmAdera janya mAgaphirAtera duA karuna| tArA tAdera mukhe emana kathA vale, yA tAdera antare nei| (tAderake) vala, AllAha yadi tomAdera kona kSati karate cAna vA tomAdera kona upakAra karate cAna, tave ke tomAdera viSaYe AllAhara sAmane kichu karAra kSamatA rAkhe? varaM tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha se samparke sampUrNarUpe avagata|

vastuta tomarA mane karechile, rAsUla (sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) evaM anyAnya musalimagaNa kakhanao tAdera parivAravargera kAche phire Asate pArave nA| Ara e kathAi tomAdera antare prItikara mane haYechila evaM tomarA nAnA rakama ku-dhAraNA karechile| vastuta tomarA chile eka dhvaMsamukhI sampradAYa|
keu AllAha o rAsUlera prati ImAna nA Anale (se jene rAkhuka), Ami kApheradera janya prastuta kare rekhechi jvalanta Aguna|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra goTA rAjatva AllAharai| tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke cAna zAsti dena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(he musalimagaNa!) tomarA yakhana gaNImatera mAla saMgrahera janya yAve, takhana (hudAYaviYAra saphara theke) yArA pechane theke giYechila tArA valave, tomarA AmAderakeo tomAdera sAthe yete dAo| tArA AllAhara kathA pAlTe dite cAve| vale dio, tomarA kichutei AmAdera sAthe yAve nA| AllAha Agei e rakama vale rekhechena| takhana tArA valave, prakRtapakSe tomarA AmAdera prati vidveSa poSaNa kara| nA; varaM tArA var3a alpai vojhe|

ye sakala dehAtI pechane theke giYechila, tAderake vale dio, acirei tomAderake emana eka sampradAYera dike (yuddhera janya) DAkA have, yArA atyanta kaThina lar3Aku have| haYa tomarA tAdera sAthe yuddha karave athavA tArA Anugatya svIkAra karave| takhana tomarA (jihAdera e nirdezera sAmane) Anugatya karale AllAha tomAderake uttama puraskAra dAna karavena| Ara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo, yemana pUrve mukha phiriYe niYechile, tave AllAha tomAderake yantraNAmaYa zAsti dAna karavena|

(yuddha nA karAte) andhera janya kona gunAha nei, kheA~r3A vyaktira janya kona gunAha nei evaM rugNa vyaktira janyao kona gunAha nei| ye-keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave, AllAha tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra taladeze pravahamAna thAkave nahara| Ara ye-keu mukha phiriYe neve, tAke yantraNAmaYa zAsti devena|

nizcaYai AllAha muminadera prati khuzI haYechena, yakhana tArA gAchera nice tomAra kAche vAYaAta grahaNa karachila| tAdera antare yA-kichu chila se samparkeo tini avagata chilena| tAi tini tAdera upare avatIrNa karalena prazAnti evaM puraskArasvarUpa tAderake dAna karalena Asanna vijaYa|
evaM vipula parimANa ganImatera mAlao, yA tArA hastagata karave| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha tomAderake pratizruti diYechena pracura ganImatera, yA tomarA hastagata karave| tini tomAderake tAtkSaNikabhAve ei vijaYa dAna karechena evaM mAnuSera hAtake tomAdera theke nivArita karechena, yAte eTA muminadera janya haYa eka nidarzana evaM yAte tini tomAderake paricAlita karena sarala pathe|
Ache Arao ekaTi vijaYa| yAte tomarA ekhanao paryanta sakSama haoni, AllAha tA nija AYattAdhIna rekhe diYechena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe paripUrNa kSamatAvAna|
kApheragaNa yadi tomAdera sAthe yuddha karata, tave avazyai tArA pechana phire pAlAta| ataHpara tArA kona vandhu o sAhAyyakArI peta nA
eTAi AllAhara niYama, yA pUrva hate cale Asache| tumi AllAhara niYame kona parivartana pAve nA|

AllAhai makkA upatyakAYa tAdera hAtake tomAdera paryanta peৗ~chA hate evaM tomAdera hAtake tAdera paryanta peৗ~chA hate nivRtta rekhechena, tAdera upara tomAderake kSamatA dAna karAra para| tomarA yA-kichu karachile AllAha tA dekhachilena|

erAi to tArA, yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tomAderake masajidula hArAma theke nivRtta kareche evaM Avaddha avasthAYa dA~r3Ano kuravAnIra pazugulikeo yathAsthAne peৗ~chate vAdhA diYeche| yadi (makkAYa) kichu mumina puruSa o mumina nArI nA thAkata, yAdera samparke tomarA jAna nA ye, tomarA tAderake piSe phelate, phale tAdera kAraNe tomarA ajJAtasAre kSatigrasta hate (tave Ami oi kApheradera sAthe sandhira parivarte tomAderake yuddhe lipta karatAma| kintu Ami yuddha rodha karechi) ejanya ye, AllAha yAke cAna nija rahamatera bhetara dAkhila karena| (avazya) sei musalimagaNa yadi sekhAna theke sare yeta tave Ami tAdera (arthAt makkAvAsIdera) madhye yArA kAphera, tAderake yantraNAmaYa zAsti ditAma|

kApheragaNa yakhana tAdera antare ahamikAke sthAna dila yA chila jAhelI yugera ahamikA, takhana AllAha tA~ra rAsUla o musalimadera upara nija prazAnti varSaNa karalena evaM tAderake tAkaoYAra viSaYe sthita kare rAkhalena Ara tArA to erai vezi hakadAra o era upayukta chila| AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|

vastuta AllAha tA~ra rAsUlake satya svapna dekhiYechilena, yA chila sampUrNa vAstavasammata| AllAha cAna to tomarA avazyai masajidula hArAme nirApade praveza karave, emana avasthAYa ye, tomarA (kichu saMkhyaka) mAthA kAmAno thAkave evaM (kichu saMkhyaka) thAkave cula chA~TA| tomAdera kono bhaYa thAkave nA, AllAha emana sava viSaYa jAnena, yA tomarA jAna nA| sutarAM se svapna pUraNa haoYAra Age sthira kare dilena eka Asanna vijaYa|
tinii nija rAsUlake hedAYAta o satya dIna diYe pAThiYechena, anya samasta dInera upara tAke jaYayukta karAra janya| Ara (era) sAkSya dAnera janya AllAhai yatheSTa|

muhAmmAda (sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma) AllAhara rAsUla| tA~ra saGge yArA Ache, tArA kApheradera viruddhe kaThora evaM Apasera madhye eke anyera prati daYArdra| tumi tAderake dekhave (kakhanao) rukute, (kakhanao) sijadAYa, AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi sandhAne rata| tAdera AlAmata tAdera cehArAYa parisphuTa, sijadAra phale| ei hala tAdera sei guNAvalI, yA tAorAte varNita Ache| Ara inajile tAdera dRSTAnta ei, yena eka zasyakSetra, yA tAra ku~r3i vera karala, tArapara tAke zakta karala| tArapara tA puSTa hala| tArapara tA nija kANDera upara ebhAve sojA dA~r3iYe gela ye, tA kRSakaderake mugdha kare phele| eTA eijanya ye, AllAha tAdera (unnati) dvArA kApheradera antardAha sRSTi karena| yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, AllAha tAderake mAgaphirAta o mahA puraskArera pratizruti diYechena|
he muminagaNa! (konao viSaYe) AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera theke Aga ver3e yeo nA| AllAhake bhaYa kare calo| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

he muminagaNa! nijera AoYAjake navIra AoYAja theke u~cu karo nA evaM tAra sAthe kathA valate giYe emana jore valo nA, yemana tomarA eke anyera sAthe jore vale thAka, pAche tomAdera karma vAtila haYe yAYa, tomAdera ajJAtasAre|

jene rekha, yArA AllAhara rAsUla (sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYA sAllAma)-era sAmane nijedera kaNThasvara nicu rAkhe, tArAi emana loka yAdera antarake AllAha bhAlobhAve yAcAi kare tAkaoYAra janya manonIta karechena| tAdera janya raYeche mAgaphirAta o mahA puraskAra|
(he rAsUla!) tomAke yArA hujarAra vAire theke DAke, tAdera adhikAMzerai vuddhi nei|
tumi nijei vAire vera haYe tAdera kAche AsA paryanta yadi tArA dhairya dhAraNa karata, seTAi tAdera janya zreYa hata| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he muminagaNa! kona phAseka yadi tomAdera kAche kona saMvAda niYe Ase, tave bhAlobhAve yAcAi kare dekhave, yAte tomarA ajJatAvazata kona sampradAYera kSati kare nA vasa| phale nijedera kRtakarmera kAraNe tomAderake anutapta hate haYa|

bhAlobhAve jene rAkha ye, tomAdera madhye AllAhara rAsUla Achena Ara vahu viSaYe se yadi tomAdera kathA mene neYa, tave tomarA nijerAi saGkaTe par3e yAve| kintu AllAha tomAdera antare ImAnera bhAlovAsA saJcAra karechena evaM tAke tomAdera antare kare diYechena AkarSaNIYa| Ara tomAdera kAche kuphara, gunAha o avAdhyatAke ghRNya vAniYe diYechena| erUpa lokerAi saThika pathaprApta haYeche
AllAhara pakSa hate dAna o anugrahasvarUpa| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

musalimadera du’Ti dala Atmakalahe lipta hale tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dio| ataHpara tAdera ekaTi dala yadi anya dalera upara vAr3AvAr3i kare, tave ye dala vAr3AvAr3i karache tAra viruddhe yuddha karo, yAvata nA se AllAhara hukumera dike phire Ase| sutarAM yadi phire Ase tave tAdera madhye nyAYasaGgatabhAve mImAMsA kare dio evaM (pratiTi viSaYe) inasApha karo| nizcaYai AllAha inasAphakArIdera bhAlovAsena|
prakRtapakSe samasta musalima bhAi-bhAi| sutarAM tomarA tomAdera du’ bhAiYera madhye mImAMsA kare dAo, AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomAdera prati rahamata karA haYa|

he muminagaNa! puruSagaNa yena apara puruSaderake upahAsa nA kare| tArA (arthAt yAderake upahAsa karA hacche) tAdera ceYe uttama hate pAre evaM nArIgaNao yena apara nArIderake upahAsa nA kare| tArA (arthAt ye nArIderake upahAsa karA hacche) tAdera ceYe uttama hate pAre| tomarA eke anyake doSAropa karo nA evaM eke anyake manda upAdhite Deka nA| ImAnera para gunAhera nAma yukta haoYA var3a khArApa kathA| yArA esava theke virata nA have tArAi jAlema|

he muminagaNa! aneka rakama anumAna theke ve~ce thAka| kona kona anumAna gunAha| tomarA kArao gopana truTira anusandhAne par3ave nA evaM tomAdera eke anyera gIvata karave nA| tomAdera madhye keu ki tAra mRta bhAiYera gozata khete pachanda karave? eTAke to tomarA ghRNA kare thAka| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYai AllAha ati tAovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|

he mAnuSa! kasama nakSatrera, yakhana tA patita haYa|
(he makkAvAsIgaNa!) tomAdera saGgI patha bhule yAYani evaM vipathagAmIo haYani|
se tAra nija kheYAla-khuzI theke kichu vale nA|
eTA to khAlesa ohI, yA tA~ra kAche pAThAno haYa|
tAke zikSA diYeche eka pracaNDa zaktimAna (pherezatA)
ye kSamatAra adhikArI| sutarAM se AtmaprakAza karala,
yakhana se chila Urdhva digante|
tArapara se nikaTe Asala evaM jhu~ke gela|
emanaki dui dhanukera dUratva parimANa kAche ese gela, varaM tAra ceYeo vezi nikaTe|
ebhAve nija vAndAra prati AllAhara ye ohI nAyila karAra chila tA nAyila karalena|
se yA dekheche, tAra antara tAte kona bhula kareni|
tavuo ki se yA dekheche tA niYe tomarA tAra saGge vitaNDA karave?
vastuta se tAke (pherezatAke) Arao ekavAra dekheche|
sidarAtula munatAhA (sImAntavartI kulagAcha)-era kAche|
tArai kAche avasthita jAnnAtula mAoYA|
takhana sei kula gAchaTike Acchanna kare rekhechila sei jinisa yA tAke Acchanna kare rekhechila|
(rAsUlera) cokha vibhrAnta haYani evaM sImAlaMghanao kareni|
vAstavikapakSe, se tAra pratipAlakera var3a-var3a nidarzanera madhya hate vahu kichu dekheche|
tomarA ki lAta o uyayA (era svarUpa) samvandhe cintA karecha?
tRtIYa ArekaTi samvandhe yAra nAma mAnAta?
tave ki tomAdera thAkave putra santAna Ara AllAhara janya kanyA santAna?
tAhale to eTA var3a anyAYa vaNTana!

(edera svarUpa era vezi kichu naYa ye,) eguli kataka nAma mAtra, yA tomarA evaM tomAdera vApa-dAdAgaNa rekhecha| AllAha era sapakSe kona pramANa nAyila karenani| prakRtapakSe tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa) kevala dhAraNA evaM manera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kare| athaca tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tAdera kAche ese geche patha-nirdeza|
mAnuSa yA-kichu kAmanA kare, tAi ki tAra prApya?
(nA) kenanA AkherAta o duniYA sampUrNarUpe AllAharai ekhatiYAre|
AkAzamaNDalIte kata pherezatA Ache, yAdera supAriza (kArao) kona kAje Ase nA| tave AllAha yAra janya cAna yadi anumati dena evaM tAte tini santuSTa thAkena tAraparai tA kAje Asate pAre|
yArA AkherAte ImAna rAkhe nA, tArA pherezatAdera nAma rAkhe nArIdera nAme|
athaca tAdera e viSaYe kona jJAna nei| tArA kevala dhAraNAra pichane cale| prakRtapakSe satyera vyApAre dhAraNA kichumAtra kAje Ase nA|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) ye vyakti AmAra smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe niYeche evaM pArthiva jIvana chAr3A anya kichu kAmanAi kare nA, tumi tAke agrAhya kara|
tAdera jJAnera daur3a e paryantai| tomAra pratipAlakai bhAlo jAnena ke tAra patha theke vicyuta haYeche evaM tinii bhAlo jAnena ke tAra patha peYe geche|

yA-kichu AkAzamaNDalIte o yA-kichu pRthivIte Ache tA AllAharai| sutarAM yArA manda kAja kareche, tini tAderakeo tAdera kAjera pratiphala devena evaM yArA bhAlo kAja kareche tAderake uttama pratidAna dAna karavena|

sei sava lokake, yArA var3a-var3a gunAha o azlIla kAja theke ve~ce thAke, avazya kadAcit pichale par3ale seTA bhinna kathA| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka prazasta kSamAzIla| tini tomAdera samparke bhAlobhAvei avagata Achena yakhana tini tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena evaM yakhana tomarA tomAdera mAtRgarbhe bhrUNarUpe chile| sutarAM tomarA nijederake pavitra vale dAvi karo nA| tini bhAlobhAvei jAnena muttAkI ke|

ye sAmAnya kichu dAna kareche, tArapara theme geche?
tAra kAche ki adRzya-jJAna Ache, yA se dekhate pAcche?
tAke ki avagata karA haYani yA Ache musAra sahIphAsamUhe
evaM ivarAhImera sahIphAsamUheo, ye paripUrNa Anugatya karechila?
se sahIphAsamUhe yA chila, tA ei ye, kona vahanakArI anya kArao (gunAhera) vojhA vahana karate pAre nA|
Ara ei ye, mAnuSa nijera praceSTA chAr3A anya kona kichura (vinimaYa lAbhera) hakadAra haYa nA|
evaM ei ye, tAra ceSTA acirei dekhA yAve|
tArapara tAra pratiphala tAke puropuri deoYA have|
evaM ei ye, (sakalera) zeSa gantavya tomAra pratipAlakerai kAche|
evaM ei ye, tinii hAsAna o kA~dAna
evaM ei ye, tinii mRtyu ghaTAna o jIvana dAna karena|
evaM ei ye, tinii puruSa o nArIra yugala sRSTi karechena|
(tAo kevala) ekaTi vindu dvArA, yakhana tA skhalita karA haYa|
evaM ei ye, dvitIYa jIvana deoYAra dAYitva tA~rai|
evaM ei ye, tinii dhanavAna vAnAna evaM sampada saMrakSita karAna|
evaM ei ye, tinii zi‘rA nakSatrera pratipAlaka|
evaM ei ye, tinii ‘prathama ‘Ada’-ke dhvaMsa karechena|
evaM chAmuda (jAti)-keo| kAuke vAki rAkhenani|
evaM tAra Age nuhera jAtikeo (dhvaMsa karechena)| nizcaYai tArA chila sarvApekSA var3a jAlema o avAdhya|
ye janapadasamUha ulTe par3e giYechila, segulokeo tinii tule nikSepa karechilena|
ataHpara ye (bhaYAvaha) vastu tAke Acchanna karala, tA tAke Acchanna kare chAr3ala|
sutarAM (he mAnuSa!) tumi tomAra pratipAlakera kon kon ni‘Amate sandeha poSaNa karave?
se (arthAt rAsUla)-o pUrvavartI satarkakArIdera mata ekajana satarkakArI|
Asanna kAla to nikaTe ese geche|
AllAha chAr3A emana keu nei, ye tA rodha karate pAre|
tave ki tomarA e kathAYai vismaYavodha karacha?
evaM (eke upahAsera viSaYa vAniYe) hAsi-ThATTA karacha evaM kAnnAkATi karacha nA;
evaM tomarA spardhita audAsinye lipta raYecha?
ekhana (o samaYa Ache) AllAhara sAmane jhu~ke par3a evaM tA~ra vandegIte lipta hao|
kiYAmata kAche ese geche evaM cA~da pheTe geche|
(tAdera avasthA hala), tArA yakhana kona nidarzana dekhe, tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa evaM vale, eTA to eka calamAna yAdu|
tArA pratyAkhyAna karala evaM nijedera kheYAla-khuzIra anugAmI hala| pratiTi viSaYa zeSa paryanta eka pariNatite peৗ~chavei|
evaM tAdera (arthAt atIta jAtisamUhera) kAche emana sava saMvAda peৗ~chechila, yAra bhetara satarkavANI chila
emana jJAnagarbha kathA, yA hRdaYe peৗ~che yAYa| tA sattveo satarkavANIsamUha tAdera kona kAje Aseni|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumio tAderake agrAhya kara| ye dina AhvAnakArI AhvAna karave eka aprItikara jinisera dike,
se dina tArA avanamita cokhe kavara theke ebhAve vera haYe Asave, yena cAradike vikSipta paGgapAla
dhAvamAna thAkave sei AhvAnakArIra dike| ei kApheragaNai (yArA kiYAmatake asvIkAra karata) valave, eTA to ati kaThina dina|
tAdera Age nUhera sampradAYao avizvAsa karechila| tArA AmAra vAndAke mithyAvAdI sAvyasta karala evaM valala, se ekajana unmAda evaM tAke humaki-dhamaki deoYA haYechila|
phale se tAra pratipAlakake Deke valala, Ami asahAYa haYe par3echi| evAra Apanii vyavasthA nina|
sutarAM Ami bheGge nAmA pAni dvArA AkAzera duYAra khule dilAma|
evaM bhUmike phATiYe prasravaNe pariNata karalAma Ara ebhAve (ubhaYa prakArera) samudaYa pAni mile gela eka sthirIkRta kAjera janya|
evaM Ami nUhake ArohaNa karAlAma eka taktA o kIlaka-nirmita naukAYa,
yA calachila AmAra tattvAvadhAne, yAra akRtajJatA karA haYechila tAra (arthAt sei rAsUlera) pakSe vadalA grahaNera janya|
Ami eke vAniYe diYechi eka nidarzana| Ache ki keu ye upadeza grahaNa karave?
sutarAM cintA kare dekha, kemana chila AmAra zAsti o AmAra satarkavANI|
vastuta Ami kuraAnake upadeza grahaNera janya sahaja kare diYechi| sutarAM Ache ki keu, ye upadeza grahaNa karave?
Ada jAtio avizvAsa karechila| sutarAM dekhe nAo, kemana chila AmAra zAsti o AmAra satarkavANI|
Ami tAdera upara cher3e diYechilAma pracaNDa jhar3o hAoYA ekaTAnA azubha dine|
yA mAnuSake upar3e phele dicchila utpATita khejura kANDera mata|
cintA kare dekha, kemana chila AmAra zAsti o AmAra satarkavANI|
vastuta Ami kuraAnake upadeza grahaNera janya sahaja kare diYechi| sutarAM Ache ki keu, ye upadeza grahaNa karave?
chAmuda jAtio satarkakArIderake avizvAsa karechila|
sutarAM tArA valate lAgala, AmarA ki AmAderai madhyakAra ekA eka vyaktira anugAmI hava? erUpa karale niHsandehe AmarA ghora vibhrAnti o unmAdagrastatAYa nipatita hava|
AmAdera eta lokera madhye ki kevala tAra upara upadezavANI nAyila karA hala? nA; varaM se ekajana carama mithyAvAdI, dAmbhika|
(Ami navI sAleha AlAihisa sAlAmake valalAma,) AgAmIkAlai tArA jAnate pArave, ke carama mithyAvAdI, dAmbhika|
Ami tAdera parIkSArthe tAdera kAche ekaTi uTa pAThAcchi| sutarAM tumi tAderake dekhate thAka evaM savara avalamvana kara|
evaM tAderake jAniYe dAo ye, (kuYAra) pAni tAdera madhye vaNTana kare deoYA haYeche| pAnira prati pAlAYa upasthita have tAra hakadAra|
ataHpara tArA tAdera eka saGgIke DAkala| sutarAM se hAta vAr3Ala evaM (uTanITike) hatyA karala|
cintA kare dekha, kemana chila AmAra zAsti o AmAra satarkavANI|
Ami tAdera upara pAThAlAma ekaTi mAtra mahAnAda| phale tArA haYe gela khoYAr3a prastutakArIra zuSka vicUrNa kA~TAra mato|
vastuta Ami kuraAnake upadeza grahaNera janya sahaja kare diYechi| sutarAM Ache ki keu, ye upadeza grahaNa karave?
lUtera sampradAYa(o) satarkakArIderake asvIkAra karala|
Ami tAdera upara varSaNa karalAma pAtharera vRSTi, lUtera parivAravarga chAr3A, yAderake Ami sAharIra samaYa rakSA karechilAma|
eTA chila AmAra pakSa theke eka ni‘Amata| yArA kRtajJatA avalamvana kare Ami tAderake ebhAvei puraskRta kari|
lUta tAderake AmAra zAsti samparke satarka karechila, kintu tArA sava rakama satarkavANI niYe vitaNDA karate thAkala,
tArA lUtake tAra atithidera vyApAre phusalAnora ceSTA karala| phale Ami tAdera cokha andha kare dilAma| ‘AmAra zAsti o AmAra satarkavANIra svAda grahaNa kara|’
bhoravelA tAderake AghAta karala, (ekaTAnA) sthAYI zAsti|
bhoga kara AmAra zAsti o AmAra satarkavANIra majA|
vastuta Ami kuraAnake upadeza grahaNera janya sahaja kare diYechi| sutarAM Ache ki emana keu, ye upadeza grahaNa karave?
phira‘Aunera khAndAnera kAcheo satarkavANI esechila|
tArA AmAra samasta nidarzana pratyAkhyAna karala| phale Ami tAderake dharalAma, yemanaTA haYe thAke eka pracaNDa zaktimAnera dharA|
tomAdera madhyakAra kApheragaNa ki tAdera ceYe uttama, nAki tomAdera janya (AllAhara) kitAvasamUhe kona chAr3apatra lekhA Ache?
nAki tArA vale, AmarA AtmarakSAYa samartha eka saMghavaddha dala?
(satya kathA ei ye,) ei dala acirei parAsta have evaM tArA pichana phire pAlAve|
(etaTukui naYa); varaM tAdera prakRta pratizruta kAla to kiYAmata| kiYAmata to Arao vezi kaThina, aneka vezi tikta|
vastuta esava aparAdhI vibhrAnti o vikAragrastatAYa patita raYeche|
ye dina tAderake upur3a kare Agunera dike Tene neoYA have (se dina tAdera caitanya have evaM tAderake valA have), jAhAnnAmera sparza-svAda bhoga kara|
Ami pratiTi jinisa sRSTi karechi mApajopera sAthe|
AmAra Adeza ekavAra mAtra cokhera pAtA phelAra mata (muhUrtera madhye pUrNa) haYe yAYa|
tomAdera sahamata poSaNakArIdera Ami Agei dhvaMsa karechi| sutarAM Ache ki keu, ye upadeza grahaNa karave?
tArA yA-kichu kareche, savai AmalanAmAYa Ache|
evaM pratiTi choTa o var3a viSaYa lipivaddha Ache|
tave yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche, tArA thAkave udyAnarAji o nahare
satyikArera maryAdApUrNa Asane, sarvamaYa kSamatAra adhikArI mahA samrATera sAnnidhye|
tini to rahamAnai,
yini kuraAna zikSA diYechena
mAnuSake sRSTi karechena|
tAke bhAva prakAza karate zikhiYechena|
sUrya o candra ekaTi hisAvera sAthe Avaddha Ache|
tRNalatA o vRkSa tA~ra sammukhe sijadA kare|
evaM tinii AkAzake u~cu karechena evaM tulAdaNDa sthApana karechena,
yAte tomarA parimApe juluma nA kara|
evaM inasAphera sAthe ojana Thika rAkha evaM parimApe kama nA dAo|
evaM pRthivIke sRSTi karechena sRSTajIvera janya|
tAte Ache phalamUla evaM cumariyukta khejura gAcha|

sutarAM tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera kona kona ni‘Amatake asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYa sAgara theke utpanna haYa muktA o palA|
sutarAM tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera kona kona ni‘Amatake asvIkAra karave?
sAgare u~cu pAhAr3era mata calamAna jAhAjasamUha tA~rai niYantraNAdhIna|
sutarAM tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera kona kona ni‘Amatake asvIkAra karave?

sutarAM tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera kona kona ni‘Amatake asvIkAra karave?
