phale tA vikSipta dhulokaNAYa pariNata have|
evaM (he mAnuSa!) tomarA tina zreNIte vibhakta have|
sutarAM yArA DAna hAta viziSTa, AhA, kemana ye se DAna hAta viziSTagaNa!
Ara yArA vAma hAta viziSTa, kI (hatabhAgya) se vAma hAta viziSTagaNa!
Ara yArA agragAmI, tArA to agragAmIi!
tArAi AllAhara vizeSa naikaTyaprApta vAndA|
tArA thAkave ni‘AmatapUrNa udyAne|
vahu saMkhyaka have pUrvavartIdera madhya hate
evaM alpa saMkhyaka paravartIdera madhya hate|
sonAra tAre vonA u~cu Asane
tArA paraspara sAmanAsAmani helAna diYe thAkave|
tAdera sAmane (sevAra janya) ghorApherA karave cira kizorerA,
emana pAna-pAtra, jaga o prasravaNa-nisRta svaccha sUrA pAtra niYe,
yA pAne tAdera mAthA vyathA have nA evaM tArA cetanA hArAve nA
evaM tAdera pachandamata phala niYe,
evaM tAdera cAhidA mata pAkhira gozata niYe
evaM tAdera janya thAkave AYatalocanA hura
yena tArA lukiYe rAkhA muktA|
tAdera kRtakarmera pratidAnasvarUpa|
tArA se jAnnAte zunave nA kona ahetuka kathA evaM nA kona pApera kathA|
tave sekhAne have kevala zAntipUrNa kathA, kevalai zAntipUrNa kathA|
Ara yArA DAna hAta viziSTa, AhA, kemana ye se DAna-hAta viziSTagaNa!
(tArA AYeze thAkave) kA~TAvihIna kula gAchera mAjhe
evaM kA~di bharA kalA gAcha,
sudUra vistRta chAYA,
pravahamAna pAni
evaM pracura phalamUlera bhetara|
yA kakhanao zeSa have nA evaM yAte kona vAdhAo deoYA have nA|
Ara tArA thAkave u~cute rAkhA pharAze|
nizcaYai Ami se nArIderake diYechi nava utthAna|
sutarAM tAderake vAniYechi kumArI|
(svAmIdera pakSe) premamaYI o samavaYaskA|
savai DAna hAta viziSTadera janya|
(yAdera madhye) aneke have pUrvavartIdera madhya hate
evaM aneke have paravartIdera madhya hate|
Ara yArA vAma hAtaviziSTa, kI hatabhAgya se vAma-hAta viziSTagaNa!
tArA thAkave uttapta vAYu o phuTanta pAnite|
kAlo dhuYAra chAYAYa
yA have nA zItala, nA upakArI|
itaHpUrve tArA chila ArAma-AYezera bhetara|
ati var3a pApera upara anar3a thAkata|
evaM valata, AmarA yakhana mare yAva evaM mATi o asthite pariNata hava, takhanao ki AmAderake punarAYa jIvita karA have?
evaM AmAdera vApa-dAdAderakeo, yArA pUrve gata haYe geche?
vale dAo, nizcaYai Agera o parera samasta mAnuSake
nirdiSTa eka dinera sthirIkRta samaYe ekatra karA have|
ataHpara he avizvAsI pathabhraSTagaNa! avazyai tomarA
emana eka gAcha theke khAve, yAra nAma yAkkuma|
ataHpara tA dvArA udara pUrNa karave|
tadupari pAna karave phuTanta pAni|
pAnao karave seibhAve, yebhAve pAna kare tRSNAra roge AkrAnta uTa|
eTAi vicAra divase tAdera ApyAYana|
Amii tomAderake sRSTi karechi| ataHpara tomarA kena vizvAsa karacha nA?
AcchA vala to, tomarA ye vIrya skhalana kara
tA ki tomarA sRSTi kara nA Amii tAra sraSTA?
Ami tomAdera madhye mRtyura phAYasAlA kare rekhechi evaM emana keu nei, ye AmAke vyartha kare dite pAre
e vyApAre ye, Ami tomAdera sthale tomAdera mata anya loka AnaYana karava evaM tomAderake emana kona rUpa dAna karava, yA tomarA jAna nA|
tomarA to tomAdera prathama sRjana samparke avagata Acha| tA sattveo tomarA kena upadeza grahaNa kara nA?
tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, tomarA jamite yA-kichu vona,
tA ki tomarA udagata kara, nA Amii tAra udagatakArI?
Ami icchA karale tA cUrNa-vicUrNa kare dite pAri, phale tomarA hatavuddhi haYe par3ave
ye, AmarA to dAYagrasta haYe par3alAma,
varaM AmarA sampUrNa vaJcita halAma!
AcchA vala to, ei ye pAni tomarA pAna kara
megha theke tA ki tomarA varSaNa karAo, nA Amii tAra varSaNakArI?
Ami icchA karale tA lavaNAkta kare dite pAri| tavuo ki tomarA zokara AdAYa kara nA?
AcchA vala to, ei ye Aguna tomarA jvAlAo,
tAra vRkSa ki tomarA sRSTi kara, nA Amii tAra sraSTA?
Amii tAke vAniYechi upadezera upakaraNa evaM marucArIdera janya upakArI vastu|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi tomAra mahAna pratipAlakera nAma niYe tAra tAsavIha pATha kara|
ye sakala sthAne nakSatra patita haYa Ami tAra zapatha kare valachi,
Ara tomarA yadi vojha, to eTA eka mahA zapatha,
nizcaYai eTA ati sammAnita kuraAna,
yA eka surakSita kitAve (pUrva thekei) lipivaddha Ache|
eke sparza kare kevala tArAi, yArA atyanta pavitra,
eTA jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera pakSa hate alpa alpa kare avatIrNa|
tavuo ki tomarA e vANIke avahelA kara?
evaM tomarA (era prati) avizvAsakei tomAdera upajIvya vAniYe niYecha?
ataHpara emana kena haYa nA ye, yakhana (kArao) prANa kaNThAgata haYa,
evaM tomarA (vimarSa mane tAra dike) tAkiYe thAka,
evaM tomAdera ceYe Amii tAra vezi kAche thAki, kintu tomarA dekhate pAo nA|
yadi tomAdera hisAva-nikAza haoYAra nA-i thAke,
tave tomarA sei prANake phiriYe Anacha nA kena yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao?
atapara se (mRta vyakti) yadi AllAhara naikaTyaprApta vAndAdera ekajana haYa,
tave (tAra janya) zudhu ArAma, surabhi o ni‘AmatapUrNa jAnnAta|
Ara yadi haYa DAna hAta viziSTadera antarbhukta,
tave (tAke valA have ye,) tomAra janya raYeche zAnti, yehetu tumi DAna hAta viziSTadera antarbhukta|
Ara yadi haYa sei pathabhraSTaderaantarbhukta, yArA satya pratyAkhyAna karata,
tave (tAra janya Ache) phuTanta pAnira ApyAYana,
Ara jAhAnnAme praveza|
ete kona sandeha nei ye, eTAi yathArtha sunizcita viSaYa|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) tumi tomAra mahAna pratipAlakera nAma niYe tAra tAsavIha pATha kara|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, tA AllAhara tAsavIha pATha kare| tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra rAjatva tArai| tinii jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| tini pratiTi viSaYe paripUrNa kSamatAvAna|
tinii Adi, tinii anta evaM tinii vyakta o tinii gupta| tini savakichu paripUrNabhAve jAnena|

tinii AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| tArapara Araze isatioYA grahaNa karechena| tini emana pratiTi jinisa jAnena, yA bhUmite praveza kare evaM yA tA theke vera haYa evaM jAnena emana pratiTi jinisa, yA AkAza theke neme Ase evaM yA tAte utthita haYa| tomarA yekhAnei thAka, tini tomAdera sAthe Achena evaM tomarA yA-kichui kara, tA tini dekhena|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra rAjatva tA~rai evaM samasta viSaYa AllAharai kAche pratyAvartita have|
tini rAtake dinera bhetara praveza karAna evaM dinake praveza karAna rAtera bhetara evaM manera madhyakAra savakichu samparke tini jJAta|

AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna rAkha evaM AllAha ye sampade tomAderake pratinidhi karechena, tA theke (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kara| sutarAM tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche evaM (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kareche, tAdera janya Ache mahA pratidAna|

tomAdera emana kI kAraNa Ache, yaddaruna AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhave nA, athaca rAsUla tomAderake tomAdera pratipAlakera prati ImAna rAkhAra janya AhvAna karache evaM tomAdera theke pratizruti grahaNa kareche yadi vAstavikai tomarA mumina hao|
AllAhai to nija vAndAra prati suspaSTa AYAtasamUha nAyila karena, tomAderake andhakAra theke Aloke vera kare AnAra janya| nizcaYai tini tomAdera prati karuNAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

kI kAraNe tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa karave nA, athaca AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra samasta mIrAcha AllAharai janya| tomAdera madhye yArA (makkA) vijaYera Age vyaYa kareche o yuddha kareche tArA (paravartIdera) samAna naYa| maryAdAYa tArA sei sakala loka apekSA zreSTha, yArA (makkA vijaYera) pare vyaYa kareche o yuddha kareche| tave AllAha kalyANera pratizruti diYechena sakalakei, tomarA yA kara AllAha se samparke paripUrNa avagata|
ke Ache, ye AllAhake RNa deve, uttama RNa? tAhale tini dAtAra janya tA vahuguNe vRddhi kare devena evaM tAra janya raYeche mahA pratidAna|

se dina tumi mumina puruSa o mumina nArIderake dekhave, tAdera nUra tAdera sAmane o tAdera DAna dike dhAvita hacche (evaM tAderake valA have,) tomAdera janya Aja emana sava udyAnera susaMvAda, yAra nice nahara pravAhita thAkave, yAte tomarA sarvadA thAkave| eTAi mahA sAphalya|

se dina munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArIgaNa muminaderake valave, AmAdera janya ekaTu apekSA kara, yAte tomAdera nUra theke AmarAo kichuTA Alo grahaNa karate pAri| tAderake valA have, tomarA tomAdera pichane phire yAo, tArapara nUra tAlAza kara| tArapara tAdera mAjhakhAne sthApita have ekaTi prAcIra| tAra madhye thAkave ekaTi darajA, yAra abhyantare thAkave rahamata evaM vAire thAkave zAsti|

tArA muminaderake Deke valave, AmarA ki tomAdera saGge chilAma nA? muminagaNa valave, hA, chile vaTe, kintu tomarA nijerAi nijederake vipade phelecha| tomarA apekSA karachile, sandehe nipatita chile evaM mithyA AzA tomAderake dheA~kAYa phele rekhechila yatakSaNa nA AllAhara hukuma Asala| Ara sei mahA pratAraka (arthAt zaYatAna) tomAderake AllAha samparke pratArita kare yAcchila|

sutarAM Aja tomAdera theke kona muktipaNa grahaNa karA have nA evaM tAdera thekeo nA, yArA (prakAzye) kuphara avalamvana karechila| tomAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| tA-i tomAdera AzraYasthala evaM tA ati manda pariNAma|

yArA ImAna eneche, tAdera janya ki ekhanao sei samaYa Aseni ye, AllAhara smaraNe evaM ye satya avatIrNa haYeche tAte tAdera antara vigalita have? evaM tArA tAdera mata have nA, yAderake pUrve kitAva deoYA haYechila ataHpara yakhana tAdera upara diYe dIrghakAla atikrAnta hala, takhana tAdera antara zakta haYe gela evaM (Aja) tAdera adhikAMzai avAdhya|
jene rekha, AllAhai bhUmike tAra mRtyura para jIvana dAna karena| Ami tomAdera janya nidarzanAvalI suspaSTabhAve vyakta kare diYechi, yAte tomarA vuddhike kAje lAgAo|
nizcaYai yArA dAnazIla puruSa o dAnazIla nArI evaM yArA AllAhake RNa diYeche, uttama RNa, tAdera janya tA (arthAt sei dAna) vahu guNa vRddhi karA have evaM tAdera janya Ache sammAnajanaka pratidAna|

yArA AllAhara prati o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna eneche, tArAi tAdera pratipAlakera kAche siddIka o zahIda| tAdera janya raYeche tAdera pratidAna o tAdera nUra| Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra kareche, tArAi jAhAnnAmavAsI|

jene rekha, pArthiva jIvana to kevala khelAdhulA, vAhyika sAjasajjA, tomAdera pArasparika ahaMkAra pradarzana evaM dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite eke anyera upare thAkAra pratiyogitArai nAma| tAra upamA hala vRSTi, yA dvArA udagata phasala kRSakaderake mugdha kare deYa, tArapara tA tejasvI haYe oThe| tArapara tumi dekhate pAo tA haluda varNa haYe geche| avazeSe tA cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe yAYa| Ara AkherAte (eka to) Ache kaThina zAsti evaM (Areka Ache) AllAhara pakSa hate kSamA o santuSTi| pArthiva jIvana pratAraNAra upakaraNa chAr3A kichui naYa|

tomarA eke anyera agraNI haoYAra ceSTA kara tomAdera pratipAlakera kSamA o sei jAnnAta lAbhera janya, yAra prazastatA AkAza o pRthivIra prazastatA tulya| tA prastuta karA haYeche emana sava lokera janya, yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna eneche| eTA AllAhara anugraha, yA tini yAke cAna dAna karena| AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

pRthivIte athavA tomAdera prANera upara ye musivata dekhA deYa, tAra madhye emana konaoTii nei, yA sei samaYa theke eka kitAve lipivaddha nei, yakhana Ami sei prANasamUha sRSTio karini| nizcaYai AllAhara pakSe eTA ati sahaja|

tA ei janya ye, tomarA yA hAriYecha, tAra janya yAte duHkhita nA hao evaM yA AllAha tomAderake dAna karechena tAra janya ullasita nA hao| AllAha emana kona vyaktike pachanda karena nA, ye darpa dekhAYa o var3atva prakAza kare|
tArA emana loka, yArA kRpaNatA kare evaM anyakeo kRpaNatAra nirdeza deYa| keu mukha phiriYe nile (se jene rAkhuka) AllAha sakalera theke anapekSa, tini Apanii prazaMsAra upayukta|

vastuta Ami AmAra rAsUlagaNake suspaSTa nidarzanAvalIsaha pAThiYechi evaM tAdera saGge nAyila karechi kitAva o tulAdaNDa, yAte mAnuSa nyAYera upara pratiSThita thAke evaM Ami avatIrNa karechi lohA, yAra bhetara raYeche raNazakti evaM mAnuSera janya vahuvidha kalyANa| eTA ei janya ye, AllAha jAnate cAna, ke tAke nA dekhe tA~ra (dInera) o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera sAhAyya kare| nizcaYai AllAha mahAzaktimAna o sarvamaYa kSamatAra mAlika|

Ami nUha o ivarAhImake rAsUla vAniYe pAThiYechilAma evaM tAdera vaMzadharadera madhye navuoYAta o kitAvera dhArA cAlu karechilAma| ataHpara tAdera madhye kichu saMkhyaka to hedAYAtaprApta hala Ara vipula saMkhyakai avAdhya haYe thAkala|

ataHpara Ami tAderai padAGkanusArI kare pAThAi AmAra rAsUlagaNake evaM tAdera pechane pAThAlAma IsA ivane mAraYAmake| Ara tAke dAna karalAma inajila| yArA tAra anusaraNa karala, Ami tAdera antare dilAma mamatA o daYA| Ara rAhavAniYyAtera ye viSaYaTA, tA tArA nijerAi udbhAvana karechila| Ami tAdera upara tA vAdhyatAmUlaka karini| vastuta tArA (era mAdhyame) AllAhara santuSTi vidhAnai karate ceYechila, kintu tArA tA yathAyathabhAve pAlana kareni| tAdera madhye yArA ImAna enechila, tAderake Ami tAdera pratidAna diYechilAma| Ara tAdera vahu saMkhyaka haYe thAkala avAdhya|

he muminagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tAra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana, tAhale tini tomAderake tA~ra rahamatera du’Ti aMza dAna karavena| tomAdera janya sRSTi karavena emana Alo, yAra sAhAyye tomarA calave evaM tini tomAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tA ejanya ye, yAte kitAvIgaNa jAnate pAre, AllAhara anugrahera madhye tAdera kichumAtra ekhatiYAra nei evaM samasta anugraha AllAhara hAte, yA tini yAke icchA dAna karena| AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

(he navI!) AllAha sei nArIra kathA zunechena, ye tAra svAmIra vyApAre tomAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karache evaM AllAhara kAche phariYAda karache| AllAha tomAdera kathopakathana zunachena| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

tomAdera madhye yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe jihAra kare, (tAdera e kAja dvArA) tAdera se strIgaNa tAdera mA haYe yAYa nA| tAdera mA to tArAi yArA tAderake janmadAna kareche| prakRtapakSe tArA emana kathA vale, yA ati manda o mithyA| nizcaYai AllAha ati mArjanAkArI, ati kSamAzIla|

yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe jihAra kare, tArapara tArA tAdera se kathA pratyAhAra kare neYa, tAdera kartavya ekaTi golAma AyAda karA tArA (svAmI-strI) eke anyake sparza karAra Age| ei upadeza tomAderake deoYA hacche| tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha se samparke paripUrNa avagata|

ye vyakti e sAmarthya rAkhe nA, tAke ekaTAnA du’mAsa royA rAkhate have tArA ( svAmI-strI) eke anyake sparza karAra Age| ye vyakti se kSamatAo rAkhe nA tAra kartavya SATajana misakInake khAnA khAoYAno| eTA ejanya, yAte tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana| eTA AllAhara sthirIkRta sImA (vidhAna)| Ara kApheradera janya Ache yantraNAmaYa zAsti|

nizcaYai yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kare, tArA avazyai lAJchita have, yemana lAJchita haYechila tAdera pUrvavartIgaNa| Ami suspaSTa AYAtasamUha nAyila karechi| kApheradera janya Ache lAJchanAkara zAsti|

sei dina, ye dina AllAha tAdera sakalake punarjIvita karavena, tArapara tArA yA-kichu karata se samvandhe tAderake avahita karavena| AllAha tA guNe guNe saMrakSaNa karechena| Ara tArA tA bhule geche| AllAha savakichura sAkSI|

tumi ki dekhani AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache tA AllAha jAnena? kakhanao tinajanera madhye emana kona gopana kathA haYa nA, yAte caturtha jana hiseve tini upasthita nA thAkena evaM kakhanao pA~ca janera madhye emana konao gopana kathA haYa nA, yAte SaSThajana hiseve tini upasthita nA thAkena| emanibhAve tArA era kama hoka vA vezi, tArA yekhAnei thAkuka, AllAha tAdera saGge thAkena| ataHpara kiYAmatera dina tini tAderake avahita karavena tArA yA-kichu karata| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

tumi ki dekhani tAderake, yAderake kAne kAne kathA valate niSedha karA haYechila, tAraparao tArA tAderake yA karate niSedha karA haYechila tAi kare? tArA paraspare emana viSaYe kAnAkAni kare, yA gunAha, sImAlaMghana o rAsUlera avAdhyatA evaM (he rAsUla!) tArA tomAra kAche yakhana Ase, takhana tArA tomAke emana kathA dvArA abhivAdana jAnAYa, yA dvArA AllAha tomAke abhivAdana jAnAnani evaM tArA mane mane vale, AmarA yA valachi sejanya AllAha AmAderake zAsti dicchena nA kena? jAhAnnAmai tAdera (zAsti dAnera) janya yatheSTa| tArA tAtei giYe peৗ~chave evaM tA ati nikRSTa gantavyasthala|

he muminagaNa! tomarA paraspare yakhana kAne kAne kathA vala, takhana emana viSaYe kAnAkAni karave nA, yAte gunAha, sImAlaMghana o rAsUlera avAdhyatA haYa| varaM kAnAkAni karave satkarma o tAkaoYA samvandhe evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAra kAche tomAderake ekatra kare niYe yAoYA have|

erUpa kAnAkAni haYa zaYatAnera prarocanAYa, yAte se muminaderake duHkha dite pAre| kintu se AllAhara icchA vyatIta tAdera vindumAtra kSati karate pAre nA| muminadera ucita kevala AllAharai upara bharasA karA|

he muminagaNa! tomAderake yakhana valA haYa, majalise anyadera janya sthAna saMkulAna kare dAo, takhana sthAna saMkulAna kare dio| AllAha tomAdera janya sthAna saMkulAna kare devena evaM yakhana valA haYa, uThe yAo, takhana uThe yeo| tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche o yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche, AllAha tAderake maryAdAYa unnata karavena| tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha se samvandhe paripUrNa avagata|

he muminagaNa! tomarA yakhana navIra saGge nibhRte kona kathA valate cAve, takhana nibhRte kathA valAra Age kichu sadakA diYe deve| eTA tomAdera janya utkRSTa o pavitratama panthA| tave tomAdera kAche (sadakA karAra mata) kichu nA thAkale to AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA nibhRte kathA valAra Age sadakA karate ki bhaYa pAccha? tomarA yakhana tA karate pArani evaM AllAha tAAlAo tomAderake kSamA kare diYechena, takhana nAmAya kAYema karate thAka, yAkAta dite thAka evaM AllAha o tAra rAsUlera Anugatya kare yAo| tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha se samvandhe paripUrNa avagata|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA AllAha ye sampradAYera prati kruddha haYechena tAderake vandhu vAniYe niYeche? tArA tAdera dalerao naYa evaM tomAdera dalerao naYa| tArA jene zune mithyA viSaYera upara kasama kare|
AllAha tAdera janya kaThora zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena| vastuta tArA ye kAja karata tA ati manda|
tArA tAdera kasamasamUhake DhAla hiseve vyavahAra kare, ataHpara tArA anyaderake AllAhara patha theke nivRtta kare| sutarAM tAdera janya lAJchanAkara zAsti|
AllAhara mokAvelAYa tAdera artha-sampada o tAdera santAna-santati tAdera kona kAje Asave nA| tArA have jAhAnnAmavAsI| tArA sarvadAi tAte thAkave|

ye dina AllAha tAderake punarjIvita karavena, se dina tA~ra sAmaneo tArA ebhAve kasama karave, yemana tomAdera sAmane kasama kare| tArA mane karave kona (upakArI) jinisa peYe geche| mane rekha, tArA sampUrNa mithyAvAdI|
zaYatAna tAdera upara puropuri kartRtva pratiSThA kare niYeche| phale se tAderake AllAhara smaraNa theke gAphela kare rekheche| tArA zaYatAnera dala| mane rekha, zaYatAnera dalai akRtakArya haYa|
nizcaYai yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tArA hInatama lokadera antarbhukta|
AllAha likhe diYechena, Ami o AmAra rAsUlagaNa avazyai jaYayukta hava| nizcaYai AllAha ati zaktimAna, sarvamaYa kSamatAra adhikArI|

ye sava loka AllAha o AkherAta divase ImAna rAkhe, tAderake tumi emana pAve nA ye, yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tAdera sAthe vandhutva rAkhache| hoka nA tArA tAdera pitA vA tAdera putra vA tAdera bhAi kiMvA tAdera svagotrIYa| tArAi emana, AllAha yAdera antare ImAnake khodAi kare diYechena evaM nija rUha dvArA tAdera sAhAyya karechena| tini tAderake praveza karAvena emana jAnnAte, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa haYe gechena evaM tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa haYe geche| tArA AllAhara dala| smaraNa rekha, AllAhara dalai kRtakArya haYa|
yA kichu AkAzamaNDalI o yA-kichu pRthivIte Ache, savai tAra tAsavIha pATha kare| tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii kitAvIdera madhye yArA kAphera tAderake prathama samAvezei tAdera ghara-vAr3i theke uccheda karechena| (he musalimagaNa!) tomarA kalpanAo karani tArA vera haYe yAve| tArAo mane karechila tAdera durgaguli tAderake AllAha hate rakSA karave| ataHpara AllAha tAdera kAche emana dika theke Asalena yA tArA dhAraNAo karate pAreni| AllAha tAdera antare bhIti saJcAra karalena| phale tArA nijedera hAte nijedera ghara-vAr3i dhvaMsa kare phelachila evaM musalimadera hAteo| sutarAM he cakSuSmAnerA! tomarA zikSA grahaNa kara|
AllAha yadi tAdera bhAgye nirvAsana nA likhatena, tave duniYAtei tAderake zAsti ditena| avazya parakAle tAdera janya jAhAnnAmera zAsti raYeche|
tA ei janya ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe zatrutA kareche| keu AllAhara sAthe zatrutA karale AllAha to kaThora zAstidAtA|
tomarA ye khejura gAcha keTecha kiMvA yeguli mUlera upara khAr3A rekhe diYecha, tA to AllAharai hukume chila evaM tA ejanya ye, AllAha avAdhyaderake lAJchita karate ceYechilena|

AllAha tA~ra rAsUlake tAdera ye sampada ‘phAYa’ hiseve diYechena, tAra janya tomarA nA ghor3A hA~kiYecha, nA uTa, kintu AllAha nija rAsUlagaNake yAra upara icchA Adhipatya dAna karena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe paripUrNa kSamatAvAna|

AllAha tA~ra rAsUlake janapadavAsIdera theke ‘phAYa’ hiseve ye sampada diYechena, tA AllAhara, tA~ra rAsUlera, (rAsUlera) AtmIYavargera, iYAtImadera, abhAvagrastadera o musAphiradera prApya, yAte se sampada tomAdera madhyakAra kevala vittavAnadera madhyei Avartana nA kare| rAsUla tomAderake yA deYa, tA grahaNa kara Ara tomAderake yA theke niSedha kare tA hate virata thAka evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare cala| nizcaYai AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA|

(tAchAr3A ‘phAYa’-era sampada) sei garIva muhAjiradera prApya, yAderake tAdera ghara-vAr3i o artha-sampada theke uccheda karA haYeche| tArA AllAhara anugraha o tA~ra santuSTi sandhAna kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAhAyya kare| tArAi satyAzraYI|

(evaM ‘phAYa’-era sampada) tAderao prApya, yArA pUrva thekei e nagare (arthAt madInAYa) ImAnera sAthe avasthAnarata Ache| ye-keu hijarata kare tAdera kAche Ase, tAderake tArA bhAlovAse evaM yA-kichu tAderake (arthAt muhAjiraderake) deoYA haYa, tAra janya nijedera antare kona cAhidA vodha kare nA evaM tAderake tArA nijedera upara prAdhAnya deYa, yadio tAdera abhAva-anaTana thAke| yArA svabhAvagata kArpaNya hate mukti lAbha kare, tArAi to saphalakAma|

evaM (phAYa-era sampada) tAderao prApya, yArA tAdera (arthAt muhAjira o AnasAradera) pare eseche| tArA vale, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! kSamA kara AmAderake evaM AmAdera sei bhAiderakeo, yArA AmAdera Age ImAna eneche evaM AmAdera antare ImAnadAradera prati kona hiMsA-vidveSa rekha nA| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi ati mamatAvAna, parama daYAlu|

tumi ki dekhani munAphekaderake yArA kitAvIdera madhyakAra tAdera kAphera bhAiderake vale, tomAderake yadi vahiSkAra karA haYa, tave AmarAo tomAdera sAthe vera haYe yAva evaM tomAdera samparke kakhanao anya kArao kathA mAnava nA Ara tomAdera sAthe yadi yuddha karA haYa, tave AmarA tomAdera sAhAyya karava| AllAha sAkSya dicchena, tArA vilakula mithyuka|

vastuta tAderake (arthAt kitAvIderake) vahiSkAra karA hale tArA (arthAt munAphekagaNa) tAdera sAthe vera have nA evaM tAdera sAthe yuddha karA hale tArA tAderake sAhAyyao karave nA Ara yadi sAhAyya karate Aseo, tave avazyai pichana phire pAlAve| ataHpara tArA kona sAhAyya pAve nA|
(he musalimagaNa!) prakRtapakSe tAdera antare AllAhara ceYe tomAdera bhaYai vezi| tA ejanya ye, tArA emanai eka sampradAYa, yAdera vujha-samajha nei|

tArA sakale ekATTA haYeo tomAdera saGge yuddha karave nA, tave emana janapade (karave), yA prAcIra dvArA surakSita athavA (karave) deoYAlera Ar3Ale lukiYe| tAdera Apasera madhye virodha pracaNDa| tumi tAderake aikyavaddha mane kara, athaca tAdera antara vahudhA vibhakta| tA ejanya ye, tArA emanai eka sampradAYa yAdera Akala-vuddhi nei|
tAdera avasthA tAdera sAmAnya pUrve yArA nijedera kRtakarmera pariNAma bhoga kareche, tAderai mata| Ara tAdera janya Ache yantraNAmaYa zAsti|

tAdera tulanA hala zaYatAna| se mAnuSake vale, kAphera haYe yA| tArapara yakhana se kAphera haYe yAYa, takhana vale, tora sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei| Ami AllAhake bhaYa kari, yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
sutarAM tAdera ubhaYera pariNAma ei ye, tArA jAhAnnAmavAsI have, yAte tArA sthAYI haYe thAkave| eTAi jAlemadera zAsti|
he muminagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM pratyekei bheve dekhuka AgAmI kAlera janya se kI agrima pAThiYeche evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYai tomarA yA-kichu kara se samparke AllAha puropuri avagata|
tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA AllAhake bhule giYechila, phale AllAha tAke AtmabholA kare dena| vastuta tArAi avAdhya|
jAhAnnAmavAsI o jAnnAtavAsIgaNa samAna hate pAre nA| jAnnAtavAsIgaNai kRtakArya|

Ami yadi e kuraAnake avatIrNa karatAma kona pAhAr3era upara, tave tumi dekhate tA AllAhara bhaYe avanata o vidIrNa haYe geche| Ami esava dRSTAnta mAnuSera janya e kAraNe varNanA kari ye, tArA yena cintA-bhAvanA kare|
tinii AllAha, yini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tini gupta o prakAzya sava kichura jJAtA| tini sakalera prati daYAvAna, parama daYAlu|

tinii AllAha, yini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tini vAdazAha, pavitratAra adhikArI, zAntidAtA, nirApattAdAtA, sakalera rakSaka, mahA kSamatAvAna, sakala doSa-truTira saMzodhanakArI, gauravAnvita, tArA ye ziraka kare tA theke AllAha pavitra|

tinii AllAha, yini sRSTikartA, astitvadAtA, rUpadAtA, sarvApekSA sundara nAmasamUha tA~rai, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache tA tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kare evaM tinii kSamatAmaYa, hekamatera mAlika|

he muminagaNa! tomarA yadi AmAra santuSTi lAbhera uddezye AmAra pathe jihAdera janya (ghara theke) vera haYe thAka, tave AmAra zatru o tomAdera nijedera zatruke emana vandhu vAnio nA ye, tAdera kAche bhAlovAsAra vArtA peৗ~chAte zuru karave, athaca tomAdera kAche ye satya eseche tArA tA emanai pratyAkhyAna kareche ye, rAsUlake evaM tomAderakeo kevala ei kAraNe (makkA hate) vera kare dicche ye, tomarA tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAhara prati ImAna enecha| tomarA gopane tAdera sAthe vandhutva kara, athaca tomarA yA-kichu gopane kara o yA-kichu prakAzye kara Ami tA bhAlobhAve jAni| tomAdera madhye keu emana karale se sarala patha theke vicyuta hala|
tomAderake vAge pele tArA tomAdera zatru haYe yAve evaM nijedera hAta o mukha vistAra kare tomAderake kaSTa deve| tAdera kAmanA eTAi ye, tomarA kAphera haYe yAo|
kiYAmatera dina tomAdera AtmIYa-svajana o tomAdera santAna-santati tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA| AllAhai tomAdera madhye phAYasAlA karavena| tomarA yA-kichu karacha AllAha tA bhAlobhAve dekhachena|

tomAdera janya ivarAhIma o tAra saGgIdera madhye uttama Adarza Ache, yakhana se nija sampradAYake valechila, tomAdera saGge evaM tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAdera upAsanA karacha tAdera saGge AmAdera kona samparka nei| AmarA tomAdera (AkIdA-vizvAsa) asvIkAra kari| AmAdera o tomAdera madhye cirakAlera janya zatrutA o vidveSa sRSTi haYe geche, yatakSaNa nA tomarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna Anave| tave ivarAhIma tAra pitAke avazya valechila, Ami AllAhara kAche ApanAra janya avazyai mAgaphirAtera duA karava, yadio Ami AllAhara sAmane ApanAra kona upakAra karAra ekhatiYAra rAkhi nA| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ApanArai upara nirbhara karechi, ApanArai dike AmarA rujU haYechi evaM ApanArai kAche AmAderake phire yete have|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Apani AmAderake kApheradera parIkSAra pAtra vAnAvena nA evaM he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake kSamA karuna| nizcaYai kevala Apanii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

(he musalimagaNa!) nizcaYai tomAdera janya tAdera (karmapanthAra) madhye Ache uttama Adarza, pratyeka emana vyaktira janya, ye AllAha o AkherAta divasera AzA rAkhe| Ara keu mukha phiriYe nile (se yena mane rAkhe), AllAha sakalera theke anapekSa, Apanii prazaMsArha|
asambhava naYa ye, AllAha tomAdera evaM yAdera saGge tomAdera zatrutA Ache, tAdera madhye vandhutva sRSTi kare devena| AllAha sarvazaktimAna evaM AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yArA dInera vyApAre tomAdera saGge yuddha kareni evaM tomAderake tomAdera ghara-vAr3i theke vahiSkAra kareni, tAdera saGge sadAcaraNa karate o tAdera prati inasApha karate AllAha tomAderake niSedha karena nA| nizcaYai AllAha inasAphakArIderake bhAlovAsena|

AllAha tomAderake kevala tAdera sAthei vandhutva karate niSedha karechena, yArA dInera vyApAre tomAdera sAthe yuddha kareche, tomAderake tomAdera ghara-vAr3i theke vera kare diYeche evaM tomAderake vera karAra kAje eke anyera sahayogitA kareche| yArA tAdera sAthe vandhutva karave tArAi jAlema|

he muminagaNa! mumina nArIgaNa hijarata kare tomAdera kAche Asale tomarA tAderake parIkSA kare nio| tAdera ImAna samparke AllAhai bhAlo jAnena| ataHpara tomarA yadi jAnate pAra tArA mumina, tave tomarA tAderake kApheradera kAche pherata pAThio nA| tArA kApheradera janya vaidha naYa evaM kApheragaNao tAdera janya vaidha naYa| tArA (arthAt kApheragaNa moharAnA vAvada tAdera janya) yA vyaYa kareche tA tAderake phiriYe dio| Ara tAderake tomAdera viYe karAte kona gunAha nei, yakhana tomarA tAderake tAdera moharAnA pradAna karave| tomarA kAphera nArIdera sambhrama nijedera kavjAYa rekhe dio nA| tomarA (tAdera moharAnA vAvada) yA vyaYa karechile tA (tAdera natuna svAmIdera theke) ceYe nAo evaM tArAo (tAdera isalAma grahaNakArI strIdera upara) yA kichu vyaYa karechila tA (tAdera natuna musalima svAmIdera theke) ceYe nika| eTA AllAhara phAYasAlA| tinii tomAdera madhye phAYasAlA dAna karena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAdera strIdera madhye keu yadi tomAdera hAtachAr3A haYe kApheradera kAche cale yAYa, tArapara tomAdera suyoga Ase tave yAdera strIgaNa cale geche, tAderake, tArA (tAdera strIdera janya) yA vyaYa karechila, tAra samaparimANa artha diYe deve| AllAhake bhaYa kare calo, yAra prati tomarA vizvAsI|

he navI! musalima nArIgaNa yakhana tomAra kAche ei marme vAYaAta karate Ase ye, tArA AllAhara saGge konao jinisakei zarIka karave nA, curi karave nA, vyabhicAra karave nA, nijedera santAnaderake hatyA karave nA, emana kona apavAda raTAve nA, yA tArA nijedera hAta-pAYera mAjhakhAna theke racanA kareche evaM kona bhAlo kAje tomAra avAdhyatA karave nA, takhana tumi tAdera vAYaAta grahaNa karo evaM tAdera janya AllAhara kAche mAgaphirAtera duA karo| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa! AllAha yAdera prati kruddha, tomarA se sampradAYera sAthe vandhutva karo nA| tArA AkherAta samparke hatAza haYe geche| yemana kApheragaNa kavare dAphanakRta lokadera samparke hatAza|
yA kichu Ache AkAzamaNDalI o yA-kichu Ache pRthivIte, savai AllAhara pavitratA ghoSaNA kareche| tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
he muminagaNa! tomarA emana kathA kena vala, yA kara nA?
AllAhara kAche e viSaYaTA ati apachandanIYa ye, tomarA emana kathA valave, yA tomarA kara nA|
vastuta AllAha tAderake bhAlovAsena, yArA tA~ra pathe ebhAve sArivaddha haYe yuddha kare, yena tArA zizADhAlA prAcIra|

sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tA~ra sampradAYake valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA kena AmAke kaSTa diccha, athaca tomarA jAna Ami tomAdera kAche AllAhara rAsUla haYe esechi? ataHpara tArA yakhana vakratA avalamvana karala, takhana AllAha tAdera antarake vakra kare dilena| AllAha avAdhya sampradAYake hedAYAtaprApta karena nA|

evaM smaraNa kara sei samaYake, yakhana IsA ivane mAraYAma valechila, he vanI isarAIla! Ami tomAdera kAche AllAhara rAsUla haYe esechi, AmAra pUrve ye tAorAta (nAyila haYe-) chila, tAra samarthanakArIrUpe evaM sei rAsUlera susaMvAdadAtArUpe, yini AmAra pare Asavena evaM yAra nAma have ‘AhamAda’| ataHpara se yakhana suspaSTa nidarzanAvalIsaha Asala takhana tArA valate lAgala, e to eka spaSTa yAdu|
sei vyakti apekSA var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre, ye AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kare, athaca tAke isalAmera dike DAkA haYa? AllAha erUpa jAlema sampradAYake hedAYAtaprApta karena nA|
tArA tAdera mukha diYe AllAhara nUra nibhiYe dite cAYa, kintu AllAha tAra nUrake avazyai paripUrNa karavena, tA kApheradera janya yatai aprItikara hoka|
tinii to nija rAsUlake hedAYAta o satya dInasaha preraNa karechena, tAke sakala dInera upara vijaYI karAra janya, tA muzarikadera janya yatai aprItikara hoka|
he muminagaNa! Ami ki tomAderake emana eka vyavasAYera sandhAna deva, yA tomAderake yantraNAmaYa zAsti theke rakSA karave?
(tA ei ye,) tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Anave evaM tomAdera dhana-sampada o jIvana dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAda karave| eTA tomAdera pakSe zreYa yadi tomarA upalavdhi kara|

era phale AllAha tomAdera pAparAzi kSamA karavena evaM tomAderake praveza karAvena emana udyAne, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita thAkave evaM emana utkRSTa vAsagRhe, yA sthAYI jAnnAte avasthita| eTAi mahA sAphalya|
evaM tomAderake dAna karavena tomAdera pachandanIYa Arao ekaTi jinisa (Ara tA hala) AllAhara pakSa hate sAhAyya evaM Asanna vijaYa evaM (he rAsUla!) muminaderake (era) susaMvAda zuniYe dAo|

he muminagaNa! tomarA AllAhara (dInera) sAhAyyakArI haYe yAo, yemana IsA ivane mAraYAma (AlAihisa sAlAma) hAoYArIderake valechilena, AllAhara pathe ke AmAra sAhAyyakArI have? hAoYArIgaNa valala, AmarA AllAhara (dInera) sAhAyyakArI| tArapara vanI isarAIlera ekadala ImAna Anala evaM ekadala kuphara avalamvana karala| sutarAM yArA ImAna enechila, Ami tAderake tAdera zatrura viruddhe sAhAyya karalAma, phale tArA vijaYI hala|
yA kichu AkAzamaNDalIte o yA-kichu pRthivIte Ache savai AllAhara pavitratA ghoSaNA kare, yini vAdazAha, pavitratAra adhikArI, parAkramazAlI; prajJAmaYa|

tinii ummIdera madhye tAderai ekajanake rAsUla kare pAThiYechena, ye tAdera sAmane tA~ra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karave, tAderake parizuddha karave evaM tAderake kitAva o hekamatera zikSA deve, yadio tArA era Age suspaSTa gomarAhIte nipatita chila|
evaM (e rAsUlake yAdera kAche pAThAno haYeche) tAdera madhye Arao kichu loka Ache, yArA ekhanao tAdera sAthe ese yoga deYani evaM tini ati kSamatAvAna, prajJAmaYa|
eTA AllAhara anugraha, tini yAke icchA eTA dAna karena| tini mahA anugrahazIla|

yAdera upara tAorAtera bhAra arpaNa karA haYechila, ataHpara tArA se bhAra vahana kareni, tAdera dRSTAnta hala gAdhA, ye vahu kitAva vaYe rekheche| yArA AllAhara kitAvake asvIkAra kare tAdera dRSTAnta katai nA manda! AllAha erUpa jAlema lokaderake hedAYAtaprApta karena nA|
(he rAsUla!) vala he iYAhUdIgaNa, yadi tomAdera dAvi ei haYa ye, tomarAi AllAhara vandhu, anya kona mAnuSa naYa| tave mRtyu kAmanA kara yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
kintu tArA nija hAte yA sAmane pAThiYeche, tAra kAraNe tArA kakhanao mRtyu kAmanA karave nA| AllAha oi jAlemaderake bhAlobhAvei jAnena|

vala, tomarA ye mRtyu hate pAlAccha, tA tomAdera sAthe sAkSAta karavei| ataHpara tomAderake tA~ra (arthAt AllAha tAAlAra) kAche phiriYe neoYA have, yini samasta gupta o prakAzya samparke puropuri jJAta| ataHpara tini tomAderake jAniYe devena yA-kichu tomarA karate|
he muminagaNa! juma‘Ara dina yakhana nAmAyera janya DAkA haYa, takhana AllAhara yikirera dike dhAvita hao evaM vecAkenA cher3e dAo| eTAi tomAdera janya zreYa yadi tomarA upalavdhi kara|
ataHpara nAmAya zeSa haYe gele tomarA yamIne char3iYe par3a evaM AllAhara anugraha sandhAna kara, evaM AllAhake smaraNa kara vezi vezi yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao|

kataka loka yakhana vyavasAYa athavA kona khelA dekhala, takhana tomAke dA~r3Ano avasthAYa rekhe se dike chuTe gela| vale dAo, AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA vyavasA o khelA apekSA aneka zreYa| AllAha sarvazreSTha riyikadAtA|
yakhana munAphikarA tomAra kAche Ase takhana vale AmarA sAkSya dicchi Apani AllAhara rAsUla| AllAha jAnena Apani avazyai tA~ra rAsUla evaM AllAha sAkSya dicchena munAphikarA mithyAvAdI|
tArA tAdera zapathagulike DhAla vAniYe niYeche| ataHpara tArA anyaderake AllAhara patha theke nivRtta rAkhe| vastuta tArA yA karache tA ati manda!
tA e kAraNe ye, tArA (zurute vAhyikabhAve) ImAna eneche, tArapara AvAra kuphara avalamvana kareche| tAi tAdera antare mohara kare deoYA haYeche| phale tArA (satya) vojhei nA|

tumi yakhana tAderake dekha, takhana tAdera dehAkRti tomAra kAche var3a bhAlo lAge evaM tArA yakhana kathA vale tumi tAdera kathA zunate thAka, tArA yena (kona kichute) ThekanA deoYA kATha| tArA ye-kona hA~ka-DAkake nijedera viruddhe mane kare| tArAi (tomAdera) zatru| tAdera vyApAre sAvadhAna thAka| tAderake AllAha dhvaMsa karuna| tArA vibhrAnta haYe kona dike calache?
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, eso AllAhara rAsUla tomAdera janya mAgaphirAtera duA karavena, takhana tArA mAthA mocar3a deYa evaM tumi tAderake dekhave tArA ahaMkAra vaze mukha phiriYe neYa|
(he rAsUla!) tumi tAdera janya mAgaphirAtera duA kara vA nA kara ubhaYai tAdera janya samAna| AllAha kichutei tAderake kSamA karavena nA| AllAha emana avAdhyaderake kichutei hedAYAtaprApta karena nA|
tArAi vale, yArA rAsUlullAhara kAche Ache, tAdera janya vyaYa karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA nijerAi sare par3e, athaca AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra dhana-bhANDAra to AllAharai| kintu munAphikarA vojhe nA|

tArA vale, AmarA madInAYa phire gele, yArA maryAdAvAna tArA hInaderake sekhAna theke vera kare deve| athaca maryAdA to kevala AllAhara o tA~ra rAsUlera evaM muminaderai Ache| kintu munAphikarA jAne nA|
he muminagaNa! tomAdera artha-sampada o tomAdera santAna-santati yena tomAderake AllAha samparke gAphela karate nA pAre| yArA e rakama karave (arthAt gAphela have) tArAi (vyavasAYa) kSatigrasta|

Ami tomAderake ye riyaka diYechi tA theke (AllAhara hukuma anuyAYI) vyaYa kara, era Age ye, tomAdera kArao mRtyu ese yAve Ara takhana valave, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke kichu kAlera janya suyoga dile nA kena, tAhale Ami dAna-sadakA karatAma evaM neka lokadera antarbhukta haYe yetAma|
yakhana kArao nirdhArita kAla ese yAve takhana AllAha tAke kichutei avakAza divena nA| Ara tomarA yA-kichu kara, AllAha se samparke paripUrNa avahita|
yA kichu AkAzamaNDalIte o yA-kichu pRthivIte Ache, tA AllAhara pavitratA ghoSaNA kare| rAjatva tA~rai evaM tA~rai samasta prazaMsA| tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tomAdera madhye keu kAphera o keu mumina| tomarA yA-kichu kara AllAha tA bhAlobhAve dekhachena|
tini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI yathAyathabhAve sRSTi karechena| tini tomAdera AkRti gaThana karechena evaM tomAdera AkRtike sundara karechena| tA~rai dike zeSa paryanta (sakalake) phire yete have|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache savai tini jAnena| tomarA yA gopane kara evaM yA prakAzye kara tAo tini paripUrNarUpe jAnena evaM AllAha antarera viSaYAvalI paryanta bhAlobhAve jJAta Achena|

tomAdera nikaTa ki peৗ~cheni tAdera vRttAnta, yArA tomAdera pUrve kuphara avalamvana karechila, ataHpara tArA tAdera karmera pariNAma bhoga kareche evaM (bhaviSyate) tAdera janya Ache eka yantraNAmaYa zAsti?

tA ejanya ye, tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa dalIla-pramANa niYe esechila| kintu tArA valechila, (AmAdera mata) mAnuSai ki AmAderake hedAYAta deve? moTakathA tArA kuphara avalamvana karala o mukha phiriYe nila| Ara AllAhao tAderake apraYojanIYa ThAorAlena| vastuta AllAha abhAvamukta, Apanii prazaMsAyogya|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA dAvi kare, tAderake kakhanaoi punarjIvita karA have nA| vale dAo, kena naYa? AmAra pratipAlakera zapatha! tomAderake avazyai punarjIvita karA have| tArapara tomAderake avahita karA have tomarA yA-kichu karate| Ara eTA AllAhara janya ati sahaja|
sutarAM tomarA ImAna Ana AllAhara prati, tA~ra rAsUlera prati evaM sei Alora prati yA Ami nAyila karechi| tomarA yA-kichu karacha AllAha se samparke paripUrNarUpe avahita|

(dvitIYa jIvana have sei dina), ye dina AllAha tomAderake samaveta karavena ekatrIkaraNera dine| seTA kichu loka kartRka anyaderake AkSepe phelAra dina| Ara yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, AllAha tAdera gunAha kSamA kare devena evaM tAderake praveza karAvena emana jAnnAte, yAra nice nahara pravAhita thAkave| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| eTAi mahA sAphalya|
Ara yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche o AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche, tArA have jAhAnnAmavAsI| tAte tArA sarvadA thAkave evaM tA ati manda ThikAnA|
kona musivatai AllAhara hukuma chAr3A Ase nA| ye-keu AllAhara prati ImAna Ane, AllAha tAra antarake hedAYAta dAna karena| AllAha sarva viSaYe paripUrNa jJAta|
tomarA Anugatya kara AllAhara evaM Anugatya kara rAsUlera| tomarA yadi mukha phiriYe nAo, tave (jene rekha) AmAra rAsUlera dAYitva kevala spaSTa bhASAYa peৗ~che deoYA|
AllAha, tini chAr3A kono mAvuda nei| muminadera ucita kevala AllAharai upara nirbhara karA|

he muminagaNa! tomAdera strI o tomAdera santAna-santatidera madhye keu keu tomAdera zatru| sutarAM tAdera vyApAre sAvadhAna thAka| yadi tomarA mArjanA kara o upekSA kara evaM kSamA kara, tave AllAha to ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomAdera dhana-sampada o tomAdera santAna-santati tomAdera janya parIkSA svarUpa| AllAharai kAche Ache mahA pratidAna|

sutarAM tomarA yathAsAdhya AllAhake bhaYa kare calo evaM zona o mAna| Ara (AllAhara hukuma anuyAYI) artha vyaYa kara| eTA tomAdera janya uttama| yArA tAdera antarera lobha-lAlasA theke mukti lAbha kareche tArAi saphalakAma|
tomarA yadi AllAhake uttamabhAve RNa dAo, tave AllAha tA kaYeka guNa vAr3iYe devena evaM tomAdera gunAha mApha kare devena| AllAha ati guNagrAhI, mahA sahanazIlatAra adhikArI|
tini sakala gupta viSaYa o sakala prakAzya viSaYera jJAtA evaM atyanta kSamatAvAna, prajJAmaYa|

he navI! tomarA yakhana nArIderake tAlAka dAo, takhana tAderake tAdera iddatera samaYe tAlAka dio evaM bhAlobhAve iddatera hisAva rekha evaM AllAhake bhaYa karo, yini tomAdera pratipAlaka| tAderake tAdera ghara theke vera karo nA evaM tArA nijerAo yena vera nA haYa yadi nA tArA suspaSTa kona azlIlatAYa lipta haYa| eTA AllAhara (sthirIkRta) sImArekhA| keu AllAhara (sthirIkRta) sImArekhA laMghana karale se to tAra nijera uparai juluma karala| tumi jAna nA, haYata AllAha erapara kona natuna viSaYa sRSTi kare devena|

ataHpara tAdera (iddatera) meYAda zeSa paryAYe peৗ~chale tomarA haYa tAderake yathAvidhi (nijedera vivAhAdhIna) rekhe deve athavA tAderake yathAvidhi vicchinna kare deve| Ara nijedera madhya hate nyAYaniSTha du’jana lokake sAkSI rAkhave| tomarA AllAhara janya saThika sAkSya dio| (he mAnuSa!) eTA emana viSaYa, yAra dvArA tomAdera madhye yArA AllAha o AkherAta divasera prati ImAna rAkhe tAderake upadeza deoYA hacche| ye-keu AllAhake bhaYa karave, AllAha tAra janya saMkaTa theke uttaraNera kona patha tairi kare devena|

evaM tAke emana sthAna theke riyaka dAna karavena, yA tAra dhAraNAra vAire| ye-keu AllAhara upara nirbhara kare, AllAhai tAra (karma sampAdanera) janya yatheSTa| nizcaYai AllAha tAra kAja pUraNa karei thAkena| (avazya) AllAha savakichura janya ekaTA parimANa nirdiSTa kare rekhechena|

tomAdera strIdera madhye yAdera Rtu AsAra kona AzA nei, tomAdera yadi (tAdera iddata samparke) sandeha haYa, tave (jene rAkha) tAdera iddata hala tina mAsa| Ara ekhanao paryanta yArA RtumatIi haYani, tAderao (iddata eTAi)| yArA garbhavatI, tAdera (iddatera) meYAda hala tAdera santAna prasava| ye-keu AllAhake bhaYa kare AllAha tAra kAja sahaje samAdhAna kare dena|
eTA AllAhara nirdeza, yA tini tomAdera prati nAyila karechena| ye-keu AllAhake bhaYa karave, AllAha tA~ra pAparAzi mArjanA karavena evaM tAke divena mahA puraskAra|

tomarA tomAdera sAmarthya anuyAYI tAderake sei sthAne vAsa karate dAo, yekhAne tomarA nijerA vAsa kara| tAderake saMkaTe phelAra janya kaSTa dio nA| tArA garbhavatI hale tAdera janya vyaYa karate thAka, yatakSaNa nA tArA santAna prasava kare| tArapara tArA yadi tomAdera janya zizudera dudha pAna karAYa, tave tAderake tAdera pArizramika dio| Ara (pArizramika nirdhAraNera janya) uttama panthAYa nijedera madhye parAmarza kare nio| tomarA yadi eke anyera janya saMkaTa sRSTi kara, tave anya kona nArI tAke dudha pAna karAve|

pratyeka sAmarthyavAna vyakti nija sAmarthya anuyAYI kharacA deve Ara yAra jIvikA saMkIrNa kare deoYA haYeche, (arthAt ye garIva) se, AllAha tAke yA diYechena tA theke kharacA deve| AllAha yAke yataTuku diYechena tAra vezi bhAra tAra upara arpaNa karena nA| AllAha saMkaTera para svAcchandya sRSTi kare devena|
emana kata janapada raYeche, yegulo nija pratipAlaka o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera Adeza ahaMkAra vaze amAnya karechila| phale Ami tAdera hisAva nei kaThorabhAve evaM tAderake zAsti dei, adRSTapUrva zAsti|
ebhAve tArA tAdera karmera pariNati bhoga karala| vastuta kSatii chila tAdera karmera pariNati|

(Ara AkherAte) AllAha tAdera janya eka kaThina zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena| sutarAM he vodhasampanna vyaktigaNa, yArA ImAna enecha! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| AllAha tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechena eka upadeza

arthAt emana eka rAsUla, ye tomAdera sAmane pATha kare AllAhara AlokapAtakArI AYAta, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAderake andhakAra hate Alote AnAra janya| ye-keu AllAhara prati ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, AllAha tAke praveza karAvena emana udyAne, yAra nice nahara pravAhita thAkave, yAte tArA sarvadA thAkave| AllAha erUpa vyaktira janya utkRSTa riyakera vyavasthA rekhechena|

AllAhai sRSTi karechena sAta AkAza evaM tAra anurUpa pRthivIo| tAdera mAjhe AllAhara hukuma avatIrNa hate thAke, yAte tomarA jAnate pAra AllAha sarva viSaYe paripUrNa zakti rAkhena evaM AllAhara jJAna savakichuke veSTana kare Ache|
he navI! AllAha ye jinisa tomAra janya hAlAla karechena, tumi nija strIderake khuzI karAra janya tA hArAma karacha kena? AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAha tomAdera kasama theke mukti lAbhera vyavasthA dAna karechena| AllAha tomAdera abhibhAvaka| tinii sarvajJa, paripUrNa hekamatera mAlika|

evaM smaraNa kara, yakhana navI tAra kona eka strIke gopane ekaTi kathA valechila| tArapara sei strI yakhana se kathA (anya kAuke) vale dila evaM AllAha tA navIra kAche prakAza kare dilena, takhana se tAra kichu aMza jAnAla evaM kichu er3iYe gela| yakhana navI tA tAra sei strIke jAnAla, takhana se valate lAgala, ApanAke ekathA ke jAnAla? navI valala, AmAke jAniYechena tini, yini sarvajJa, savakichu avagata|

(he navI patnIgaNa!) tomarA yadi AllAhara kAche tAovA kara (tave tAi have ucita kAja), kenanA tomAdera antara jhu~ke par3eche| kintu tomarA yadi navIra viruddhe eke aparake sAhAyya kara, tave (jene rekha) tAra saGgI AllAha, jivarAIla o satkarmazIla muminagaNa| tAchAr3A pherezatAgaNa tAra sAhAyyakArI|

se yadi tomAdera sakalake tAlAka diYe deYa, tave tAra pratipAlaka tomAdera parivarte zIghrai tAke dite pArena emana strI, yArA have tomAdera ceYe uttama, musalima, mumina, anugata, tAovAkArI, ivAdatagojAra, royAdAra, pUrvavivAhitA vA kumArI|

he muminagaNa! nijederake evaM tomAdera parivAravargake rakSA kara sei Aguna theke, yAra indhana have mAnuSa o pAthara| tAte niYojita Ache kaThora svabhAva, kaThina hRdaYa pherezatAgaNa, yArA AllAhara kona hukume tA~ra avAdhyatA kare nA evaM seTAi kare, yAra nirdeza tAderake deoYA haYa|
he kApheragaNa! Aja tomarA ajuhAta dekhio nA| tomarA yA karate tomAderake tArai pratiphala deoYA hacche|

he muminagaNa! AllAhara kAche khA~Ti tAovA kara| asambhava naYa ye, tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera pApasamUha tomAdera theke mocana kare devena evaM tomAderake emana udyAne praveza karAvena, yAra nice nahara vahamAna thAkave, sei dina, ye dina AllAha navIke evaM tA~ra saGge yArA ImAna eneche tAderake lAJchita karavena nA| tAdera Alo tAdera sAmane o tAdera DAna pAze dhAvita have| tArA valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera janya e Aloke paripUrNa kare dina evaM AmAderake kSamA karuna| nizcaYai Apani sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|
he navI! kAphera o munAphekadera viruddhe jihAda kara evaM tAdera viruddhe kaThora haYe yAo| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| tA ati manda ThikAnA|

yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, AllAha tAdera janya nUhera strI o lUtera strIra dRSTAnta peza karachena| tArA AmAra atyanta nekakAra du’jana vAndAra vivAhAdhIna chila| ataHpara tArA tAdera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karala| phale AllAhara viruddhe tArA tAdera kona kAje Asala nA evaM tAderake (arthAt strI du’janake) valA hala, anyAnya pravezakArIdera sAthe tomarAo jAhAnnAme praveza kara|

Ara AllAha muminadera janya peza karachena phira‘Auna-patnIra dRSTAnta, yakhana se valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra janya ApanAra kAche jAnnAte ekaTi ghara tairi karuna evaM AmAke phira‘Auna o tAra karma hate mukti dina| Ara AmAke nAjAta dina jAlema sampradAYa hate|

tAchAr3A imarAna kanyA mAraYAmakeo (dRSTAnta rUpe peza karachena), ye tAra satItva rakSA karechila| phale Ami tAra madhye AmAra rUha phu~ke dilAma| Ara se nija pratipAlakera vANI o tAra kitAvasamUhake satya vale svIkAra karechila evaM se chila AnugatyakArIdera antarbhukta|
mahimAmaYa sei sattA, yAra hAte goTA rAjatva| tini savakichura upara paripUrNa zaktimAna|
yini mRtyu o jIvana sRSTi karechena tomAderake parIkSA karAra janya ye, karme tomAdera madhye ke uttama| tinii paripUrNa kSamatAra mAlika, ati kSamAzIla|
yini upara-nIca stara viziSTa sAta AkAza sRSTi karechena| tumi daYAmaYa AllAhara sRSTite kona asaGgati pAve nA| phera dRSTipAta kare dekha, kona phATala dekhate pAo ki?
ataHpara vAravAra dRSTipAta kara| dRSTi klAnta o vyartha haYe tomAra dike phire Asave|
Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake sAjiYechi ujjvala pradIpa dvArA evaM seguloke zaYatAnera upara nikSepera upakaraNao vAniYechi| Ara tAdera janya prastuta rekhechi jvalanta Agunera zAsti|
yArA tAdera pratipAlakera sAthe kupharI AcaraNa kareche, tAdera janya Ache jAhAnnAmera zAsti| tA ati manda ThikAnA|
yakhana tAderake tAte phelA have, tArA tAra garjana zunate pAve Ara tA have udvelita|
mane have yena tA roSe pheTe par3ache| yakhanai tAte (kApheradera) kona dalake nikSepa karA have, takhana tAra praharI tAderake jijJesa karave, tomAdera kAche ki kona satarkakArI Aseni?
tArA valave, hA~, avazyai AmAdera kAche satarkakArI esechila, kintu AmarA (tAke) mithyAvAdI ThAoriYechi evaM valechi, AllAha kona kichui nAyila karenani| tomarA kevala virATa gomarAhItei nipatita|
evaM tArA valave, AmarA yadi zunatAma evaM vuddhike kAje lAgAtAma, tave (Aja) AmarA jAhAnnAmIdera antarbhukta hatAma nA|
ebhAve tArA nijerA nijedera gunAha svIkAra karave| abhizApa jAhAnnAmIdera janya!
(pakSAntare) yArA tAdera pratipAlakake nA dekhei bhaYa kare niHsandehe tAdera janya Ache mAgaphirAta o mahA pratidAna|
tomarA tomAdera kathA gopane vala vA prakAzye vala (savai tA~ra jAnA| kenanA) tini to antaryAmI|
yini sRSTi karechena tini jAnavena nA? athaca tini sUkSmadarzI, samyaka jJAta!
tinii tomAdera janya bhUmike vazya kare diYechena| sutarAM tomarA tAra kA~dhe calApherA kara o tA~ra (deoYA) riyaka khAo| tA~rai kAche tomAderake punarjIvita haYe yete have|
tomarA ki AsamAnaoYAlAra theke e viSaYe nizcinta haYe gecha ye, tini tomAderake bhUmite dhasiYe devena nA, yakhana tA haThAt tharathara kare kA~pate thAkave?
nAki tomarA AsamAnaoYAlA hate nizcita haYe gecha e vyApAre ye, tini tomAdera upara pAthara-vRSTi varSaNa karavena nA, acirei tomarA jAnate pArave kemana chila AmAra satarkavANI?
tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArAo (navIgaNake) avizvAsa karechila| ataHpara (dekha) kemana chila AmAra zAsti?

tArA ki tAdera upara dike tAkiYe pAkhIderake dekhe nA, yArA pAkhA char3iYe deYa AvAra tA guTiYeo neYa? daYAmaYa (AllAha) chAr3A anya keu tAderake sthira rAkhena nA| nizcaYai tini savakichu paripUrNarUpe dekhena|
AcchA, daYAmaYa AllAha chAr3A se ke, ye tomAdera sainya haYe tomAderake sAhAyya karave? vastuta kApheragaNa nichaka dheA~kAra madhye par3e raYeche|
tini yadi tA~ra riyaka vandha kare dena, tave emana ke Ache, ye tomAderake riyaka dite pAre? etadasattveo tArA avAdhyatA o satyavimukhatAYa avicala raYeche|
AcchA ye vyakti ulTo haYe mukhe bhara diYe calache, sei ki vezi gantavyasthale peৗ~chave, nA se, ye sojA haYe sarala pathe calache?
vale dAo, tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janya kAna, cokha o hRdaYa vAniYechena| (kintu) tomarA zokara AdAYa kara alpai|
vale dAo, tinii tomAderake pRthivIte char3iYe diYechena evaM tA~rai kAche tomAderake ekatra kare niYe yAoYA have|
tArA vale, tomarA satyavAdI hale vala, ei pratizruti kakhana pUrNa have?
vale dAo, era jJAna kevala AllAharai kAche Ache| Ami kevala ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI|
yakhana tArA tA (arthAt kiYAmatera AyAva) Asanna dekhave, takhana kApheradera cehArA vimarSa haYe par3ave evaM valA have, eTAi sei jinisa, yA tomarA cAcchile|

(he rAsUla! tAderake) vale dAo, ekaTu vala to, AllAha AmAke o AmAra saGgIderake dhvaMsa karuna vA AmAdera prati rahamata karuna (ubhaYa avasthAYa) kApheraderake yantraNAmaYa zAsti hate ke rakSA karave?
vale dAo, tini daYAmaYa (AllAha)| AmarA tA~ra prati ImAna enechi evaM AmarA tA~rai upara bharasA karechi| acirei tomarA jAnate pArave ke suspaSTa gomarAhIte lipta|
vale dAo, ekaTu vala to, kona bhore tomAdera pAni yadi bhUgarbhe antarhita haYe yAYa, tave ke tomAderake prasravaNa hate pravAhita pAni ene deve?
nUna| (he rAsUla!) zapatha kalamera evaM tArA yA likhache tAra|
svIYa pratipAlakera anugrahe tumi unmAda nao|
nizcaYai tomAra janya Ache aniHzeSa pratidAna|
evaM nizcaYai tumi adhiSThita Acha mahAna caritre|
sutarAM acirei tumi dekhave evaM tArAo dekhate pAve—
tomAdera madhye ke vikAragrasta—|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka bhAlobhAve jAnena sei vyaktike, ye tA~ra patha theke vicyuta haYeche evaM bhAlobhAve jAnena saThika pathaprAptaderakeo|
sutarAM yArA (tomAke) mithyAvAdI vale, tumi tAdera kathAYa calo nA|
tArA cAYa tumi namanIYa hale tArAo namanIYa have|
evaM atyadhika kasamakArI hIna vyaktira kathAYao calo nA,
ye nindA karate abhyasta, cugali kare ver3AYa,
satkAje vAdhAdAnakArI, sImAlaMghanakArI, pApiSTha,
rUr3ha svabhAva, tAchAr3A ajJAtakulazIla|
ei kAraNe ye, se dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite samRddha|
tAra sAmane yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha par3A haYa, takhana se vale, (eTA to) atIta lokadera kisasA-kAhinI|
Ami acirei tAra zu~r3a dAgiYe deva|
Ami tAderake (arthAt makkAvAsIke) parIkSAYa phelechi, yemana parIkSAYa phelechilAma (eka) vAgAnaoYAlAderake, yakhana tArA zapatha karechila, bhora haoYA mAtra AmarA vAgAnera phasala kATava|
evaM (ekathA valAra samaYa) tArA kona vyatikrama rAkhachila nA|
ataHpara tArA yakhana nidrita chila, tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke sei vAgAne hAnA dila eka upadrava,
phale bhoravelA tA haYe gela kATA kSetera mata|
bhora hatei tArA eke anyake DAka dila|
tomarA phasala kATate cAile bhora velAYai kSete cala|
sutarAM tArA cupisAre eke anyake ei valate valate raoYAnA hala
ye, Aja yena kona misakIna tomAdera kAche e vAgAne Dhukate nA pAre|
evaM tArA sateje vera haYe par3ala zaktimattAra sAthe|
ataHpara yakhana vAgAnaTi dekhala, vale uThala, AmarA nizcaYai rAstA hAriYe phelechi|
(kichukSaNa para valala) nA, varaM AmarA to hRtasarvasva|
tAdera madhye ye savaceYe bhAlo chila, se valala, Ami ki tomAderake valini ye, tomarA tAsavIha par3acha nA kena?
takhana tArA valala, AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera tAsavIha (tA~ra pavitratA ghoSaNA) karachi| nizcaYai AmarA jAlema chilAma|
tArapara tArA eke anyera dike mukha kare parasparake doSAropa karate lAgala|
tArapara sakale (ekayoge) valala, hAYa Aphasosa! nizcaYai AmarA avAdhya haYe giYechilAma|
asambhava kichu naYa, AmAdera pratipAlaka e vAgAnera parivarte AmAderake Arao utkRSTa vAgAna dAna karavena| AmarA avazyai AmAdera pratipAlakera abhimukhI hacchi|
zAsti emanai haYe thAke| Ara nizcaYai AkherAtera zAsti kaThinatara yadi tArA jAnata!
tave muttAkIdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera kAche Ache ni‘AmatapUrNa udyAnarAji|
AcchA, Ami ki anugataderake aparAdhIdera samAna gaNya karava?
tomAdera kI hala? tomarA kI rakamera siddhAnta karacha?
tomAdera kAche ki emana kona kitAva Ache, yAra bhetara tomarA par3acha
ye, sekhAne tomarA yA pachanda kara tAi pAve?
nAki tomarA AmAra theke kiYAmata divasa paryanta valavat thAkave emana kasama niYe rekhecha ye, tomarA yA sthira karave tAi sekhAne pAve?
(he rAsUla!) tAderake jijJesa kara, tAdera madhye ke e viSaYera yimmAdAra?
nA ki (AllAhara prabhutve) tAdera (vizvAsa mata) kona zarIka Ache (yArA ei nizcaYatA grahaNa kareche)? tAhale tArA tAdera sei zarIkaderake upasthita karuka, yadi tArA satyavAdI haYa!
ye dina ‘sAka’ khule deoYA have evaM tAderake sijadAra janya DAkA have, takhana tArA (sijadA karate) sakSama have nA|

tAdera dRSTi thAkave avanata| hInatA tAderake Acchanna kare rAkhave, athaca yakhana tArA sustha o nirApada chila, takhanao tAderake sijadAra janya DAkA hata (takhana kSamatA thAkA sattveo tArA sijadA karata nA)|
sutarAM (he rAsUla!) yArA e vANIke pratyAkhyAna karache tAderake AmAra upara cher3e dAo| Ami tAderake emanabhAve kramAnvaya়e (dhvaMsera dike) niYe yAva ye, tArA jAnateo pArave nA|
Ara Ami tAderake avakAza diYe yAcchi| nizcaYai AmAra kauzala var3a zakta|
tumi ki tAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAccha ye, tArA jarimAnA-bhAre nyuvja haYe par3ache?
nA ki tAdera kAche gAYevera jJAna Ache, yA tArA likhe rAkhache|
moddAkathA tumi tomAra pratipAlakera nirdeza nA AsA paryanta savara karate thAka evaM mAcha-samparkita vyaktira mata haYo nA, yakhana se (AmAke) Dekechila vedanArta avasthAYa|
tA~ra pratipAlakera anugraha yadi tAke nA AgalAta, tave se kholA maYadAne nikSipta hata nikRSTa avasthAYa|
ataHpara tAra pratipAlaka tAke manonIta karalena evaM tAke puNyavAnadera antarbhukta kare nilena|
yArA kuphara avalamvana kareche, tArA yakhana upadeza-vANI zone, takhana mane haYa tArA yena tAdera (tIvra) dRSTi dvArA tomAke Achar3iYe deve evaM tArA vale, ei vyakti to pAgala|
athaca eTA to vizvajagatera janya kevalai upadeza|
avazyambhAvI satya!
ki sei avazyambhAvI satya?
tomAra ki jAnA Ache sei avazyambhAvI satya kI?
Ada o chAmUda jAti sei prakampitakArI (satya)ke asvIkAra karechila|
sutarAM chAmUda jAti(-era vRttAnta hala), tAderake dhvaMsa karA haYechila (mahAnAda-era) bhISaNa viparyaYa dvArA|
Ara Ada jAti (era vRttAnta hala), tAderake dhvaMsa karA haYechila emana pracaNDa jhaJjhAvAYu dvArA
yA AllAha tAdera upara pravAhita rekhechilena (ekaTAnA) sAta rAta, ATa dina virAmahInabhAve| takhana tumi (sekhAne thAkale) dekhate pete tArA sekhAne luTiYe par3e Ache phA~pA khejura kANDera mata|
ekhana ki tumi tAdera kAuke avaziSTa dekhate pAo?
phira‘Auna, tAra pUrvavartIrA evaM (lUta AlAihisa sAlAmera) ulTe yAoYA janapadao lipta haYechila aparAdhe
tArA tAdera pratipAlakera rAsUlera avAdhyatA karechila| phale tini tAderake kaThorabhAve pAkar3Ao karalena|
yakhana pAni niYantraNahArA haYe giYechila, takhana Ami tomAderake ArohaNa kariYechilAma nauyAne,
ei ghaTanAke tomAdera janya zikSaNIYa vAnAnora janya evaM yAte eTA (zune) saMrakSaNa kare saMrakSaNakArI kAna|
ataHpara yakhana ziGgAYa phu~ deoYA have ekaTi mAtra phu~,
evaM pRthivI o parvatasamUhake uttolita kare ekai AghAte cUrNa-vicUrNa kare phelA have,
sei dina ghaTave avazyambhAvI ghaTanA|
evaM AkAza pheTe yAve Ara sedina tA sampUrNa jIrNa haYe yAve
evaM pherezatAgaNa thAkave tAra kinArAYa evaM tomAra pratipAlakera Araza se dina ATajana pherezatA tAdera upare vahana kare rAkhave|
se dina tomAdera hAjirA have emanabhAve ye, tomAdera kona gupta viSaYa gopana thAkave nA|
ataHpara yAke AmalanAmA deoYA have tAra DAna hAte, se valave, he lokajana! ei ye AmAra AmalanAmA, tomarA par3e dekha|
Ami Agei vizvAsa karechilAma AmAke avazyai hisAvera sammukhIna hate have|
sutarAM se thAkave manaHputa jIvane|
sei samunnata jAnnAte
yAra phala thAkave jhu~ke (nikaTavartI)|
(valA have) tomarA vigata dinagulote yesava kAja karechile, tAra vinimaYe khAo o pAna kara svAcchandye|
Ara sei vyakti, yAra AmalanAmA deoYA have tAra vAma hAte; se valave, AhA! AmAke yadi AmalanAmA deoYAi nA hata!
Ara Ami jAnatei nA pAratAma, AmAra hisAva kI?
AhA! mRtyutei yadi AmAra sava zeSa haYe yeta!
AmAra artha-sampada AmAra kona kAje Asala nA!
AmAra theke AmAra sava kSamatA lupta haYe gela!
(erUpa vyakti samparke hukuma deoYA have) dhara oke evaM ora galAYa ver3i pariYe dAo|
tArapara oke jAhAnnAme nikSepa kara|
tArapara oke emana zikale ge~the dAo, yAra parimANa have sattara hAta|
se mahAna AllAhara upara ImAna rAkhata nA|
evaM garIvake khAdya dAne utsAha dita nA|
sutarAM Aja ekhAne tAra nAi kona vandhu
evaM nA kona khAdya gisalIna chAr3A
yA pApiSTharA chAr3A keu khAve nA|
Ami kasama karachi tomarA yA dekhacha tAra
evaM tomarA yA dekhacha nA tArao,
eTA (arthAt kuraAna) eka sammAnita vArtA vAhakera vANI
eTA kona kavira vANI naYa, (kintu) tomarA alpai ImAna Ana
evaM nA kona atIndriYavAdIra vANI, (kintu) tomarA alpai zikSA grahaNa kara|
e vANI avatIrNa karA hacche jagata-samUhera pratipAlakera pakSa hate|
Ara yadi se (arthAt rAsUla kathAra kathA) kona (mithyA) vANI racanA kare AmAra prati Aropa karata
tave Ami tAra DAna hAta dhare phelatAma
tArapara tAra jIvana-dhamani keTe ditAma|
takhana tomAdera keu tAke rakSA karAra janya vAdhA haYe dA~r3Ate pArata nA|
nizcaYai eTA muttAkIdera janya eka upadezavANI|
Ami bhAlo kare jAni tomAdera madhye kichu loka avizvAsIo Ache|
evaM eTA (arthAt kuraAna) erUpa kApheradera janya AkSepera kAraNa|
evaM eTAi nizcita satya vANI|
sutarAM tumi tomAra mahAna pratipAlakera nAmera pavitratA ghoSaNA kara|
eka yAcaka yAcanA karala sei zAsti,
yA kApheradera janya avadhArita, yA rodha karate pAre emana keu nei|
tA Asave AllAhara pakSa theke, yini ArohaNera pathasamUhera mAlika|
pherezatAgaNa o rUhula kudasa tA~ra kAche ArohaNa kare emana eka dine, yAra parimANa paJcAza hAjAra vachara|
sutarAM savara avalamvana kara uttamarUpe|
tArA tAke dUravartI mane karache|
athaca Ami tAke dekhachi nikaTavartI|
(se zAsti have sei dina) ye dina AkAza telera gAdera mata haYe yAve
evaM pAhAr3a haYe yAve raGgina pazamera mata|
evaM kona antaraGga vandhu antaraGga vandhuke jijJesao karave nA|
athaca tAdera parasparake dRSTigocara kare deoYA have| aparAdhI se dina zAsti theke vA~cAra janya tAra putrake muktipaNa hiseve dite cAve|
evaM tAra strI o bhAike
evaM tAra sei khAndAnake, yArA tAke AzraYa dita|
evaM pRthivIra samasta adhivAsIke, yAte (esava muktipaNa diYe) se nijeke rakSA karate pAre|
(kintu) kakhanai eTA sambhava have nA| tA to eka lelihAna Aguna|
yA cAmar3A khasiYe deve|
tA pratyeka emana vyaktike DAkave, ye pRSTha pradarzana kareche o mukha phiriYe niYeche|
evaM (artha-sampada) saJcaYa kareche ataHpara tA sayatne saMrakSaNa kareche|
vastuta mAnuSake sRSTi karA haYeche laghucitta rUpe
yakhana kona kaSTa tAke sparza kare, takhana se atyanta asthira haYe par3e|
Ara yakhana tAra svAcchandya Ase, takhana haYa ati kRpaNa|
tave nAmAyIgaNa naYa
yArA tAdera nAmAya AdAYa kare niYamita|
evaM yAdera artha-sampade nirdhArita haka Ache
yAcaka o vaJcitera|
evaM yArA karmaphala divasake satya vale jAne
evaM yArA tAdera pratipAlakera zAstira bhaYe bhIta|
nizcaYai tAdera pratipAlakera zAsti emana naYa, yA hate nizcinta thAkA yAYa|
evaM yArA nijedera lajjAsthAnake (sakalera theke) hephAjata kare,
tAdera strI o tAdera mAlikAnAbhukta dAsIdera chAr3A| kenanA esava loka nindanIYa naYa|
tave keu tAra vAire anya kichu kAmanA karale, tArA have sImAlaMghanakArI|
evaM yArA tAdera AmAnata o pratizruti rakSA kare,
evaM yArA tAdera sAkSya yathAyathabhAve dAna kare|
evaM yArA tAdera nAmAyera vyApAre puropuri yatnavAna thAke|
tArAi jAnnAte thAkave sammAnajanakabhAve|
(he rAsUla!) kApheradera hala ki ye, tArA tomAra dike chuTe Asache?
DAna dika thekeo evaM vAma dika thekeo, dale dale|
tAdera pratyekei ki pratyAzA kare ye, tAke dAkhila karA have ni‘AmatapUrNa jAnnAte?
kakhanao erUpa have nA| Ami tAderake sRSTi karechi emana jinisa dvArA yA tArA jAne|
Ami zapatha karachi (nakSatrarAjira) udaYasthala o astAcalasamUhera adhipatira, nizcaYai Ami e viSaYe sakSama
ye, tAdera sthalavartI karava tAdera apekSA utkRSTa mAnavagoSThIke evaM keu AmAke vyartha karate pArave nA|
sutarAM tumi tAderake cher3e dAo, tArA tAdera ahetuka vAka-vitaNDA o khelAdhulAYa matta thAkuka, yAvat nA sei dinera sAkSAta lAbha kare, ye dinera pratizruti tAderake deoYA hacche|
se dina tArA drutavege kavara theke emanabhAve vera have, yena tArA tAdera pratimAdera dike daur3e yAcche|
tAdera dRSTi thAkave avanata| hInatA tAderake Acchanna kare rAkhave| eTAi sei dina, yAra pratizruti tAderake deoYA hacche|
Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma (ei nirdeza diYe ye,) nija sampradAYake satarka kara tAdera prati yantraNAmaYa zAsti AsAra Age|
(sutarAM) se (nija sampradAYake) valala, Ami to tomAdera janya eka suspaSTa satarkakArI|
ei viSaYe ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara o tAke bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|

AllAha tomAdera gunAhasamUha kSamA karavena evaM tomAderake eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta vAki rAkhavena| nizcaYai AllAhara sthirIkRta kAla yakhana ese yAYa, takhana Ara tA vilamvita haYa nA yadi tomarA jAnate!
ataHpara nUha (AllAha tAAlAke) valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka!Ami AmAra sampradAYake rAta-dina (satyera dike) Dekechi|
kintu AmAra dAoYAta kevala tAdera palAYanaparatAi vRddhi kareche|

Ami yakhanai tAderake dAoYAta diYechi, yAte Apani tAderake kSamA karena, takhanai tArA tAdera kAne AGgula rekheche, nijedera kApar3a dvArA nijederake Dheke pheleche, (nijedera kathAra upara) jida vajAYa rekheche evaM zudhu ahamikAi prakAza kareche|
ataHpara Ami tAderake jora kaNThe dAoYAta diYechi|
tArapara Ami prakAzyeo tAdera sAthe kathA valechi evaM gopane-gopaneo tAderake vujhiYechi|
Ami tAderake valechi, nija pratipAlakera kAche kSamA prArthanA kara| nizcaYai tini atizaYa kSamAzIla|
tini AkAza theke tomAdera upara pracura vRSTi varSaNa karavena|
evaM tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite unnati dAna karavena evaM tomAdera janya sRSTi karavena udyAna Ara tomAdera janya nada-nadIra vyavasthA kare divena|
tomAdera kI hala ye, tomarA AllAhara mahimAke vilakula bhaYa pAo nA?
athaca tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena dhApe dhApe|
tomarA ki dekhani AllAha kibhAve sAta AkAzake upara-nica stara viziSTa kare sRSTi karechena?
evaM tAte candrake AlorUpe evaM sUryake pradIparUpe sthApita karechena?
evaM tomAderake bhUmi hate utkRSTa panthAYa udbhUta karechena|
tArapara tini tomAderake punarAYa tAra bhetarai pAThAvena evaM (sekhAna theke punarAYa) tomAderake puropuri vera kare Anavena|
AllAhai bhUmike tomAdera janya vichAnA vAniYe diYechena,
yAte tomarA tAra unmukta pathe calApherA karate pAra|

nUha valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra sampradAYa to AmAra avAdhyatA kareche evaM tArA anusaraNa kareche emana lokera (arthAt tAdera netRvargera) yAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati tAdera kSati chAr3A Ara kichui vRddhi kareni|
evaM tArA aneka var3a-var3a Sar3ayantra kareche|
evaM tArA (nijedera lokaderake) valeche, tomarA tomAdera upAsyaderake kichutei parityAga karo nA| kichutei parityAga karo nA ‘oYAdda’ o ‘suoYA’-ke evaM nA ‘iYAgUcha’ ‘iYAuka’ o ‘nAsara’-ke|
ebhAve tArA vahujanake vipathagAmI kareche| sutarAM (he AmAra pratipAlaka!) Apanio ei jAlemadera kevala vipathagAmitAi vRddhi kare dina|
tAdera gunAhera kAraNei tAderake nimajjita karA haYechila, tArapara tAderake dAkhila karA haYeche Agune Ara AllAha chAr3A tArA anya kona sAhAyyakArI pAYani|
nUha Arao valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! ei kApheradera madhya hate kona vAsindAkei pRthivIte vAki rAkhavena nA|
Apani tAderake vAki rAkhale tArA ApanAra vAndAderake vipathagAmI karave evaM tAdera ye santAnAdi janma neve tArAo pApiSTha o ghora kApherai have|

he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke kSamA kare dina evaM AmAra pitA-mAtAkeo evaM pratyeka emana vyaktikeo, ye ImAnera avasthAYa AmAra ghare praveza kareche Ara samasta mumina puruSa o mumina nArIkeo| Ara yArA jAlema tAdera zudhu dhvaMsai vRddhi karuna|
(he rAsUla!) vale dAo, AmAra kAche ohI eseche ye, jinadera ekaTi dala manoyoga sahakAre (kuraAna) zuneche ataHpara (nija sampradAYera kAche giYe) valeche, AmarA eka vismaYakara kuraAna zunechi|
yA saThika patha pradarzana kare| sutarAM AmarA tAra prati ImAna enechi| ekhana Ara AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera sAthe (ivAdate) kakhanao kAuke zarIka karava nA|
evaM ei (vizvAsa karechi) ye, AmAdera pratipAlakera maryAdA samucca| tini kona strI grahaNa karenani evaM kona santAnao naYa|
evaM ei ye, AmAdera madhyakAra nirveAdherA AllAha samparke sampUrNa avAstava kathA valata|
evaM AmarA mane karechilAma mAnuSa o jina AllAha samparke mithyA kathA valave nA|
evaM mAnuSera madhye kichu loka jinadera kichu lokera AzraYa grahaNa karata| ebhAve tArA jinaderake Arao vezi AtmambharI kare tulechila|
evaM tomarA yemana dhAraNA karate, temani mAnuSao dhAraNA karechila, AllAha kAukei mRtyura para punarAYa jIvita karavena nA|
evaM AmarA AkAze anusandhAna karate cAilAma, takhana dekhalAma tA kaThora pAhArAdAra o ulkApiNDa dvArA paripUrNa haYe Ache|
evaM AmarA Age saMvAda zonAra janya AkAzera kona kona sthAne giYe vase thAkatAma| kintu ekhana keu zunate cAile se dekhate pAYa eka ulkApiNDa tAra (upara nikSepera) janya prastuta raYeche|
evaM AmAdera jAnA chila nA jagadvAsIra kona amaGgala karAra icchA karA haYeche, nA tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake saThika patha pradarzanera icchA karechena|
evaM AmAdera madhye kataka nekakAra evaM kataka se rakama naYa| Ara AmarA vibhinna pathera anusArI chilAma|
